yang 'byung / /spos zhim dpal gyi lha yis de thos so/ /rgyal ba'i 'jig0)rten yid du 'ongalteb spong / /dge'ub ma lus rnams kyang rab tu skyed/ /'gro ba kun gyi dbang po rnam par sbyong / /dge bar snang ba'i lha yis de mthong ngo / /'gro ba kun na sangs rgyas shin tu 'phags/ /skye bo kun gyisnyibasam pa de mkhyen tedu / /sna tshogs sgo nas 'gro ba yongs smin mdzad/ /rnam dag kha dog 'od kyi rnam thar to/ /de la sman gyi lha phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/bsam pa kun nas rnam par lta ba'i gnon pas 'gro ba rab tu gnon pa zhes bya'o/ /sman gyi lha tsan dan gyisrinags tshal gyi shugs 'chang ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ blta ba donasheyod pas sems can 'dren pa'i 'od ces bya'o/ /sman gyi lha 'od rdul med pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams cadaponyon mongs pa rab tu zhi bas rdul dang bral ba'i sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ /sman gyi lha ming7kun tu grags pa'i glang po'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ ming bsgrags pas dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya mtsho yang dag par 'phel ba zhes bya'o/ /sman gyi lha spu'i glong hunya kun nas 'od byung 12ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ nad thams cad la snying rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi shugs kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya'o/ /sman gyi lhacamun pa rnam par sel cing rnam par sbyong ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ 'gro ba mdongs pa lta bu ⑩thams cad kyi/ ye shes kyi mig rnam par dag par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /sman gyi lha sgra dbyangs kun tu 'byung ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rab tu bsgrags pas/ don gyi dbyings 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /sman gyi lha nyi ma'i 'od 'gro7ba'i mchog gi rgyal mtshan gyi7rnam par thar pa ni/ 'gro ba thams cad la dge ba'i bshes su ston cing dge ba'i rtsa bas yang dag par bskul〈nyeb 35—99

zhes bya'o/ /sman gyi lha phyogs bcur rmongs pa med pa'i7rnam par thar pa ni/mos pa'i tshul gyis rnam par dag pa'i snying rje'i snying po zhes bya'o/ /sman gyi lha mdangs bzang po〈mikun tu 'gyed pa'i mig gi rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi nad rab tu ③zhi bar byed cing / sangs rgyas rjes su dran par sbyor (rmerab zhes bya'o/ /de nas sman gyi ⑧lha phun sum tshogs pas sangs rgyas kyi mthus / sman gyi lha'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab ltos/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa rab tu mkhyen/ /thabs kyi rnam pa sna tshogs sgo dag nas/ /sdug bsngal kun las sems can rab tu 'grol/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid de ltar bsam mi khyab/ /de yi mthu ni thams7cad don kyang yod/ /skye dgu rnams kyikyisdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad/ /tsan dan shugs dang ldan pa'i rnam thar57to/ /sngan cad rgyal ba'i chos nyid dag la ltos / /bskal pa rgya mtsho mtha' med spyod pa nathun/ /srid pa kun la chags pa gang yang med/ /de la rdul med 'od kyi lha 'jug go/ /rgyal ba bskal pa stong phrag brgya dag tu/ /mthong zhing mtshan nyid 3) de bzhin shin tu dkon/ /tshul rnams kun tu rang byung don yod de/ /de la rgyal mtshan mchog ni de ltar 'jug/rgyal ba'i spu yi sgo rnams kun nas kyang / /nad las rab tu grol57ba'i 'od bkye bas / /'jig rten nyon mongs ma lus zhi bar mdzad(rte/ /spu mdangs rgyun 8gyi rnam thar 'di yin no/ /sdug bsngal las dang nyon mongs sna tshogs pas/ /'gro ba mdongs shing rab tu ermongs gyur rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'od kyisarwagernam par spyod/ /de ni mun dang bral ba'i lhas mthong ngo / /rgyal ba'i gsung 35—100

gcig las nitumatha' yas pa'i/ /chos kyi sgo mo thams cad kun kyang 'byung / /de ni sems can ma lus kun kyang shes/ /'di ni sgrasadang ldan pa'i rnam thar to / /rgyal ba'i ye shes bsam gyis7mi khyab ltos/ /srid par sems can yongs su smin byas pa/ /de la 'gro kun mi mgon mngon du snang / /nyi rgya'od zhi ba'i lha yis de mthong ngo / /sangs rgyas thugs rje'i tshul ni rgya mtshosngone ste/ /'gro ba kun la phan don de skyes so/ /'gro ba kun la lam rnams shin tu ston/ /de ni phyogs su snang ba'i lhas shes so/ /sangs rgyas 'gro dbang rnams kyi 'od yangs pa / /phyogs rnams thams cad ma lus kun tu gang / /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i gzi brjid bskyedag/ /mdangs kyi0)'od du ldan pa'i rnam thar to// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bzhi pa/⑨ de la nagasaphamatshal gyi lha yal ga sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi rnam par thar pa ni / ye shes tu)rgya mtsho 1)yangs shing mtha' yas pa'i snying po zhes bya'o/ /nags tshal gyi7lha 'od kyi phung po sna tshogs kyi mig yid du 'ong ba'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni dge ba rgya chen po kun nas spungs pa'i shugs shes bya'o/ /nags tshal gyi lha myu gu yid du 'ong ba'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ mos pa sna tshogs kyi myu gu rnam par 'phel ba dang / yongs su dag par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /nags tshal gyi lha lo ma dri ma med pa'i phreng41zuba'i dpal gyi rnam par thar hunyepa ni/yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyan yongs su sbyong zhing rnam par sgom tsho/9pa zhes bya'o/ /nags tshal gyi lha yan lag rab tu 'chang ba'i 3 snagazi brjid kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ shes rab dri ma med pa'i sgo 3 ranas chos kyi dbyings la dmigs shing / kun nas rnam par dmigs pas rgyas par 'gongs 16pa zhes 35—101

bya'o / /nags tshal gyi lha dge ba'i 'od sna tshogs kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho la yang dag par 'jug pa'i chos kyi sprin mngon par sgrub pa zhes bya'o/ /nags tshal gyi lha sgra skad yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi yid du mi 'ong ba'i sgra la bzod pa rab tu thob pas chos kyi snang ba dri ma med pa zhes bya'o/ /nags tshal gyi lha kun nas spos mang po7ldang ba'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ spyod pa rgya chen po'i5gedakyil 'khor spyod pas yongs su dag par byed cing phyogs kun tu rnam par snang ba zhes bya'o/ /nags tshal gyi lha kun nas dpal gyi 'od rab tu 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ 'gro ba la phan pa'i don chos thams cad kyi yon tan gyis rgyas parasheyang dag par sbyong ba0zhes bya'o/ /nags tshal gyi lha me tog dang 'bras bu dang ro'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas skye ba thams cad la dga' bar lta zhing rjes su dran pa'i yon tan gyi rgyan gyisasnying po zhes bya'o/ /de nas nags tshal gyi lha yal ga sna tshogs kyi sprin gyisakyisangs rgyas kyi mthus nags tshal gyi lha'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /bsod nams stobs dang ye shes stobs rnams dang / /sngon tshe byang chub spyod pas sangs rgyas byung ske/ /stobs rnams kun gyisherang byung pha rol phyin/ /'gro ba kun na⑧'phags shing rnam par mdzes/ /'gro ba thams cad snyed kyi thugs rje'i sgo/ /de bzhin gshegs pas sngon tshe rab tu sbyangs/ /rang byung de bas 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /sna tshogs spungs 'od rnam7thar 'di la 'jug /sems can kun gyis bde gshegs mthong ma thaganye /mos pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /35—102

rgyal ba kun gyi lam yang yang dag ston/ /myu gu yid 'ong 'od kyi rnam thar yin/ /rgyal ba kun gyitub spu'i yon tan 'khor/ /bskal pa rgya mtshorakhuzad par mi nus te/ /'gro ba kun gyisashesangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /rnam thar 'di ni phreng ba'i dpal gyis mthong / /sngan cad rgyal bas sangs rgyas gang gi⑧rnams//zhing mang rdul snyed mchod pa de dag dran/ /kun tu shes rab dkyil 'khor rnam par sbyangs/ /yal ga 'od kyi brjid kyis 'di mthong ngo / /'gro ba kun gyi spyod pa rgya mtsho dag /skad cig gcigashegis sangs rgyas thugs su chud/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes chags med shin tu yangs/ /sna tshogs 'gyur spungs 'od kyis7'di mthong ngo / /bdeshegashegs gsung ni zhi bskoskyorab zhir gsung / /dga' ba yangs pa chen po rnam par skyed/ /sems can mos pa ji bzhin de dag shes(me/ /'di ni sgra rnams sgrogs tunyepa'i dbyangs kyis 'a/thos/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi dbyings rnams rgyas byas shing / /sangs rgyas byin rlabs 8rgya chen rab tu 'byung ske/ /rgyal ba'i sngon gyi spyod pa dag kyang ston/ /kun tu dri zhim 'od dpal 'di la 'jug /ma rungasalasems can yon tan med pa'i rnams/ /myos shing 'khor ba kun tu 'khor ba dag /de dag la ni thams cad mkhyen lam ston/ /'phags pa'i 'od kyi ⑩'khor gyis 'di mthong ngo / /sems can ma rungs sbyor ba spyod pa7rnams/ /bskal pa bye bas sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur/ /gzhan ni bde stegashegs skad cig gcig gis lta/ /ri'i〈nye'od kyi lha yis 'di mthong ngo / /de la ri'i lha rin po che'i rtse mo'i5) me tog shin tu rgyas par gnas pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ bsam gtan zhi zhing yangs la dben pa'i snang ba la rab tu 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ /ri'i lha nags tshal sna tshogs me tog shin tu rgyas pa'i 35—103

gtsug phud kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ 'gro ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin par byed pa'i byams pa sgom pa'i rgyan ces bya'o/ /ri'i lha kun nas shin tu 'phags pas rnam par snang ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi7rnam par thar pa ni/sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa rnam par lta ba'i dbang po la 'jug pas mngon par snang ba zhes bya'o/ /ri'i lha rdul thams cad dang mi gnas pas dri ma med pa'i gtsug phud kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ bskal pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas paraphumi skyo ba'i brtson 'grus kyis rab tu sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ /ri'i lha snang bas phyogs su gsol ba'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' yas pa'i snang ba rnam par bstan pa ston pa zhes bya'o/ /ri'i lha stobs la thub pa med pa'i snang ba'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i ci phyir gti mug yongs su sel ba'i rige'od ces bya'o/ /ri'i lta7kun nas gzi brjid dpal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ chags pa thams cad dang mnyam pa'i rgyan gyi ༷sdug bsngal yang dag par 'joms pa zhes bya'o/ /ri'i lha snang 8ba'i rdul chu bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstan pa'i yon tan snang ba yang dag par ston pa zhes bya'o / /ri'i lha kun tu mngon par lta ba'i mig gi ⑨rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi rmi lam gyi mthar yang dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel bar byed pa zhes bya'o/ /ri'i lha kun nas sra ba'ipha rdo rje'i mtshams kyi mig gi rnam par thar pa ni/ don rgya mtsho rgya chen po mtha' yas pa dang 'grogs pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas ri'i lha 11rin po che'i hu rtse mo me tog shin tu rgyas par gnas pas/sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ ri'i lha'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yod pa thams cad la 35—104

rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul mi zad tshad med ltos/ /sngon tshe spyod rab mtha' yas rgyal bas spyod / /rnam thar zhing gi rdul snyed sgomatsha3)mdzad pas/ /'gro ba ma lus dga' ba'i shugs kyang skyed②/ /sangs rgyas spu nas dri mas rimed dpal bkye4/ /yan lag mtshan brgyan⑧'gro ba kun bkang zhing / /byams tshul mtha' yas 'jig rten kun la ston/ /nags tshal rgyas pa'i gtsug gi 9)rnam thar to/ /sangs rgyas sku ni mtha' yas 'gro bar mngon/ /'jig rten kun tu phyogs bcu bkang zhing 'phags / /dbang po dang ba'i sems can rangs shing dga'/ /rnam thar 'di la 'phags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'jug /rang byung57tshomakha' mnyam 'jig rten kun tshon ma chags/ /bskal pa kun spyod brtson 'grus stobs mi skyo/ /sna tshogs mkhas spyo'agro sbyor balgem lus 'dul/ /dga' ba dri med gtsug phud rnam thar to/ /'jig rten kun ni mdongs hunyagyur mun sdug kyi zhugs/ /thugs rjes /nyider bskyed sangs rgyas 'od bkye zhing / /'gro khams yun ring bonyal ba sad par mdzad/ /rigs 8nas dga' 'od lha'i rnam thar to/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor spyad pa sngon spyod tshe/ /zhing rdul mnyam pa'i sems can gtso mchod pas/ /de dag dgyes bzhin sems can byang chub bkod/ /zhi ba'i sa 'di stobs 'chang lha 'jug go⑩ / /las kyi sprin sgrib g.yogs shing bsgribs pa 1 rnams/ /srid par sems can sdug bsngal 'khor gzigs nas/ /de dag mun pa ye shes 'od kyis bstsalahunye / /gzi brjid dpal 'od rnam thar 'di sems so/ /rgyal ba'i spu las sangs rgyas yon tan kun/ /phyogs dbyings sems can bsam pa bzhin du gragasanyunye / /rdzu 'phrul rnam pa bskal pa kun tu gnas/ /'od mang 30rdul gyi chu 35—105

bo'i lha 'jug go/ /sems can kun spyad7dge ba rgya mtsho kun/ /de la phyogs bkang sangs rgyas mngon par snang / /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'jig rten chos kyang ston / /tshul mngon mig gi lha yis de thos so/ /chos sgo rgya mtsho mi zad tshad med pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung gcig sems can kun la gsung / /bskal pa kun brjod5mi'ajig rten mang la ston/ /rdo rje tshul mig 'di yi gnas la 'jug /de la sa'i lha dpal gyi me tog kun nas shin tu rgyas pa7dri ma med pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ skad cig skad cig cing sems can thams cad la byams pa dang /snying rje'i dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par lta ba zhes bya'o/ /sa'i lha bsod nams brten ④pa shin tu bsags dupa'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi stobs dang shugs kyi rgyan ces bya'o/ /sa'i lha sems can ⑥rin po ches rgyas pa'i rnam ⑦par thar pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs bsgoms pa ④rnam par 'byed ⑨pa dri ma med pa zhes bya'o/ /sa'i ⑩lha dus dus51su dge ba'i mig rab tu ston pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams cad dga' zhing bde ba dang rtse ba'i sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ /sa'i lha gser gyi〈nyemig gi dpal gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ lus thams cad yongs su dag par byed pa'i tshul ston72pa zhes bya'o/ /sa'i lha spu las spos kyi 'od rnam par 'gyed pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rgya mtsho thams cad rnam par sgo7pa brjod pa zhes bya'o/ /sa'i lha sgra dbyangs yid du 'ong ba sgrogacapa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ 'gro ba thams cad smra ba'i sgra rgya mtsho7byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya'o/ /sa'i lha me tog gi klong sna tshogs kyi gtsug phud kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin dri ma med pa zhes 35—106

bya'ol/ /sa'i lha ①kun nas rdo rje'i rdul gyi rgyud kyi ②rnam par thar pa ni/sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi 'khor lo ②byin gyi rlabs kun nas rgyu zhing 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /sa'i lha khyim dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi tshul la yang dag par 'jug pa'i chos kyi rgyan bsgomasrepa 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas sa'i lha dpal gyi me tog kun nas shin tu rgyas pa dri ma med pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthusakyisa'i lha'i 'khoral)gyi dkyil 'khor yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sngan cad skad cig skad cig bde'ugashegs kyis/ /brjod du med pa'i snying rje'i sgo7rnams dang / /byams pa'i sgo yang mi zad bsgoms mipas na/ / de tshesngonasangs rgyas sku ni mi shigs sra/ /dus gsum gtogs pa'i sems can bsod nams dang / / ji snyedatshwa)byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams dag /rgyal ba'i spu gcig de snyed bsod nams 'od/ /bsod nams de mthong rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /'byung ba med cing byon pa gang yang med/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba rgya mtshocharab tu zhugs/ /sems can rgyan gyi sa 'di rab tu ston/ /'di ni sna tshogs shing gi ze ba'i sa yin no/ /sngan cad thub pas spyod pa spyad pa dang ske/ /'gro ba'i sgrib pa rnam par zlog 8pa ni/ /rin chen bkram pa'i 'od kyi sa yin te/ /rnam thar de la dga' bar lha lta'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa ni mtha' yas te/ /'jig rten kun tu skad cig gcig la78ston/ /dus tshod yang dag ston pa'i sa yi lha/ /dga' bar sangs rgyas yul la rnam par lta/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni mtha' yas bsam mi khyab/ /sems can kun bsgrags nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad/ /gser 'od mig gi dpal ni rab dga' bskya/ /sangs 35—107

rgyas yon tan mtha' yas mnga' ba stetshi/ /sangs rgyas sprul pas rnam par kun gzugs su/ /phyogs kun chos kyi dbyings su rgyas par mdzad/ /sruklelas dri zhim 'od kyi sa yi lha/ /sangs rgyas sems can 'dul ba de la lta/ /phyogs rnams yid 'ong dbyangs kyis gang byas shing / /'gro ba 'di ni phyi mtha'i bskal par brjod/ /yid du ri 'ong ba'i sgra dbyangs sa'i lha/ /rab tu dga' bar sangs rgyas dbyangs la nyan/ /rgyal ba'i spu las sems can mnyam pa yi/ /spos kyi 'od bkye 'jig rten kun bkang zhing / /sems can ma lus yongs su smin mdzad cing ge/ /me tog gtsug phud 'phyang bas yang dag mthong / /de bzhin gshegs pa sku rdo rje lta bu ste/ /mtshams su mi phyed sra ba'i ri bo 'dra/ /'gro ba kun gyis sangs rgyas bskyodam༅mi nus/ /rdo rje rdul gyi lha ni des dga' 'o / /de la grong khyer gyi lha rin chen rtse mo'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can la phan pa yang dag par sbyar tsheb 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /grong khyer gyi lha rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ 'gro ba'i dbang po yongs su smin par byed pa'i 'dul ba du 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /grong khyer gyi lha rin chen dri med shin tu dga' ri9)ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams cad bsod nams dang nyu dga' ba myong bar byed pa zhes bya'o/ /grong khyer gyi lha slos pa'i mya ngan thams cad spong bas /tshe rnam par snang ba'itshwa)rnam par thar pa ni/ skyob pa dang mi 'jigs pa dang / snying rje chen hunyepo zhes bya'o/ /grong khyer gyi lha sgron ma shin tu rgyas pa'i mig gi rnam par thar pa ni/ shes rab kyi mikun tu rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya'o/ /grong khyer gyi lha 'od 'phro ba'i dpal mngon par 'bar ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ thabs kyi sgo kun nas ston pa'i mthu zhes bya'o/ /35—108

grong khyer gyi yo)lha bsod nams kyi shugs snang ba'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/'gro ba kun gyisabasod nams 'byung ba'i〈misnang ba zhes bya'o/ /grong khyer gyi lha lus dri ma med pas mnyam pa'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can rmongs pa thams cad la rmi lam rnam par ston pa'i 'od ces bya'o/ /grong khyer gyi lha spos kyi rgyal mtshan gtsug phud kyi rgyan gyicha)rnam par thar pa ni/ nyon mongs pa dang mi dge ba'i dri masarnam par sel cing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dri yang dag par bskyedarnyupa zhes bya'o/ /grong khyer gyi lha rin chen dpal gyi 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sgrib pa'i ri rnam par 'jomasalokyepa'i 'od ces bya'o/ /de nas grong khyer gyi lha rin po che'i rtse mo'i 'od kyisashesangs rgyas kyi mthus/ grong khyer gyi lha'i 'khor gyimo/kye dkyil 'khor yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /mgon po'i chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /snang ba brnyes (7shing phyogs su rnam par mdzes / /sems can mtha' yas yongs su smin mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba kun la mngon du snang / /sems can thams cad dbang po sna tshogs te(nya/ /de dag ma lus rgyal bas 'gro bar mkhyen/ /rnam thar 'di ni rab tu thob pa'i phyir / /sna tshogs 'od 'byung lha yang rab tu dga'/ /rgyal bas bskal pa mtha' yas yang dag spyad/ /sngan cad rgyal bas chos kyang yang dag bzung 3nye/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis rtag tu de dag blangs/ /rnam thar 'di ni dga' ba'i 'od kyis mthongakhe/ /'gro ba 'dir ni thugs rje byams bskyed cing / /de bzhin gshegs pas sngan cad sems can rnams/ /kun gyi mya ngan mtha' yas rnam par zlogatso /nyon mongs yongs su sbyang khib 'di la dga'/ /rgyal ba'i shes rab 35—109

rgya che mtha' yas te/ /tshad med nam mkha' 'dra zhing mtshungs pa yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i shes rab rnam spyod pas/ /mar me'i hu)me tog 'od kyi lha dga' 'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pas 'gro mnyam sku gzugs rnams/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa rnams la bstan/ /de 'dra'i tshul la rab tu bsgoms7pa yis/ /mngon 'od 'phro ba'i (lha de rab tu dga'/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho rgya chen mtha' yas pa/ /sngan cad de bzhin gshegs pas yongs su sbyangs④/ /de 'dra'i rnam par thar la brnam lta bas/ /bsod nams dpal gyi 'od de rab tu dga' / /srid par rab tu rmongs pa'i sems can rnams/ /'khor gyur rab rib mdongs 6)pa gzigs pas na/ /de dag phan phyir sangs rgyas mngon du byung ske/ /dri med 'od kyis rnam thar 'di thob po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul stobs la ltos/ /'gro la sprin 'dra mtha' dang dbus yang0)med/ /de dag bstan cing 'gro ba rnam par 'dul/ /spos kyi rgyal mtshan 'od kyis 'di mthong ngo / /sems can rmongs pasamun pas mdongs0)gyur cing / /rnam pa sna tshogs sgrib nyu )pas bsgribs gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas 'od kyis rnam par kun shes 'gyur / /rtse mo'i 'od kyi lha ni 'di la 'jug /de la snying po57byang chub kyi lha dge ba dri hu ma med pa'i rgyan nyu gyis brgyan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa ni/sangs rgyas mang po mchod pa yang dag par 'byung77zhing / sngon gyi smon lam gyi rgyan ston pa zhes bya'o/ /snying po byang chub kyi lha ri rab spo'i rin posheche'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni 'gro ba thams cad dang mngon sum du byang chub kyi spyod pa yang dag par sgrub 8cing 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /snying po byang chub kyi lha dbyangs kyi 'brug sgra sgrog nyu tshopa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams 35—110

cad kyi bsam pa la sangs rgyas ston cing rmi lam gyi mthar/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'brug sgra sgrog ①pa zhes bya'o/ /snying po byang chub kyi lha me tog gi char sna tshogs 'bab pa'i mig gi rnam par thar pa ni/ dga'50ba thams cad yongs su gtong zhing rin po che'i char 'bebalgepa'i rgyan ces bya'o/ /snying po byang chub kyi lha 'od 'phro mang po shin tu dri ma med pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ 'dul ba'i sems can yongs su smin par byed cing snying po byang chub kyi〈dephun sum tshogs pa lkusna tshogs ston pa zhes bya'o/ /snying po byang chub kyi lha me tog gi phreng ba 'od kyi gtsug phud kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi dbang po bzhin du chos kyi〈tshul zab mo dran pa ston pa 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /snying po byang chub kyi lha rin po che'i rgyan ⑦gyi char rab tu 'bebs pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/dga' ba yang dag par myong ba mtha' yas pa la yang dag par 'jug pa zhes bya'o / /snying po byang chub kyi lha mthu dam pa spos kyi mig gi rnam par thar pa ni/sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang legs pa 3)rab tu brjodam49)pa'i byin gyi rlabs zhes bya'o / /snying po byang chub kyi lha rdo rje sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi rnam par thar pa ni/snying po byang chub〈pe rnam pa mtha' yas pa yang dag par ston pa'i rgyan ces bya'o/ /snying po byang chub kyi lha padmo'i shing snang ba'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ byang chub kyi shing yongs su zhi bas phyogs rgyas par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /snying po byang chub kyi lha dge ba'i lta ba sna tshogs rnam par ston pa'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs sna tshogs yang dag par rgyu ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas snying po byang chub kyi lha dge ba dri ma med pa'i rgyan gyis (1brgyan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis hunyesangs rgyas kyi mthus/ snying po byang chub kyi lha'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 35—111

yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas te①/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /bskal pa mang po mtha' dang dbus7med par/ /de bzhin gshegs pas ji ltar sngon spyad dran/ /sangs rgyas thams ②cad mchod cing bsgrubs pas na/ /de phyir de yi bsod nams nam mkha'i tshad/ /zhing rnams mtha' yas tshad med 'dra med par/ /mi zad gtong ba'i sgo nas sngon btang bas / /ri bo'i ④sgo'i 'od kyi lha de ni/ /bde gshegs dran zhing rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /bde gshegs sprul pa rnam pa mtha' yas pa/ /de dag zhing rnams kun tu rab tu rgyu/ /'gro bar sangs rgyas rmi lam bzhin ston cing / /sprin gyi sgra dbyangs lha de rab tu dga'/ /mtha' yas bskal par dka'akhub rab spyad deni/ /dang ba'i spyan gyis 'gro la phan pa'i phyir/ /rgya mtsho'i spyan yangasheyongs su sngon btang ste/ /de la me tog mig gi lha dga' 'o⑨ / /yon tan rin chen 'od 'phro mtha' yas sprin/ /'gro ba kun tu snying po byang chub nas//rab tu bkye ba'i sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'od 'phro 'gyed pa'i lus kyi lha yang dga'/ /sems can rnams kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho ste/ /de la5)rgyal ba chos kyi char yang 'bebs/ /ji ltar mos par nem nur rnam par sel/ /de yis gtsug phud 'phyang ba dga' ba thob/ /rgyan gyi char〈nye'abebs mig bzang lha de ni / /sems kyi skad cig gcig gis tshad med pa'i(nye/ /chos don dbyings kyi bye brag mtha' yas pa/ /rgya mtsho7tha dad yang dag shes pas 'jug /zhing rnams brjod du med pa thams cad du/ /'gro ba kun la sangs rgyas legs brjod pas//de phyir yon tan sangs rgyas zhing kun grags/ /de ni rjes su spos mig 37yang dran / /mtha' yas shing migi rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs/ /byang chub shing la kun 35—112

kyang ma lus bstan/ /rdo rje sna tshogs sprin gyi7lha de ni/ /byang chub shing la dga'akhubar rnam par lta/ /sangs rgyas ye shes snying po byang chub 'kho/ /phyogs rnams kun tu mtha' dang mu med de/ /padmo snang zhing gsal ba'i lha de ni/ /rnam thar rnam 0yangs 'di la rab dga' 'odu/ /sangs rgyas stobs rnams yongs dag bsam mi khyab/ /snying po byang chub 'dir ni kun kyang grag /yang dag bsgrubs pas byung ba de dag ni/ /thams cad sna tshogs snang ba'i 'od nyan to / /de la rkang gis 'gro rin chin dpal gyikyiphyag rgya'i rnam par thar pa ni/dga' ba yangs pa rin po che'i char gyis kun tu khyab pa zhes bya'o/ /rkang gis 'gro padmo snang ba'i 'od zer gyi 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku 'od zer gyi kha dog padmo'i dra ba thams cad du ston pas dga' bar byed pa zhes bya'o/ /rkang gis ⑦'gro me tog gtsug phud kyi dpal dri ma med pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ sems kyi skad cig thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbyibs dang rgyan 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /rkang gis 'gro shin tu mdzes par gnon pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ gom pa 'dor ba thams cad ⑧mtha' yas pa 'dul ba'i rgyan ces bya'o/ /rkang gis7'gro rin chen dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ skad cig gcig gis ⑩padmo'i dra ba sna tshogs sprul pa byed cing rin po che'i char pa dang dbyangs dang snang ba kun tu 'gyed pa zhes bya'o/ /rkang gis 'gro dga' ba'i dbyangs snyan pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ zodaga' ba'i〈nyeshugs dang nyams bde ba'itshwanyergya mtsho mtha' yas pa 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /rkang gis tunye'agro shing tsan dan gyi 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du spos kyi ngad sprin du ldang ba zhes bya'o/ /matso35—113

rkang gis 'gro padmo yid du 'ong ba'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ padmo'i gseb thams cad nas yid du 'ong ba'i chos kyi dbyangasatu'abyung bas snang ba skyed pa zhes bya'o/ /rkang gis 'gro rdul gyi shugs kyi 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/lus kyi 'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad kyi dra bas snang ba byed ②pa zhes bya'o / /rkang gisashe'agro me tog mang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par thar pa ni/sems can thams cad la dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya mtshos yang dag par skulaphub 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas rkang gis 'gro rin chen dpal gyi phyag rgyasashesangs rgyas kyi mthus/ rkang gis 'gro ba'i7lha'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /dga' ba rgya mtsho'i tshul gyis7shugs bskyed cing / /bskal pa mtha' yas sngan cad spyod pa mdzad/ /zhing rnams kun⑧rdul shin tu phra mnyam pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang dgyes pa'i thugs kyis ⑨mchod/ /skad cig ⑩ sems la padmo brjod yangs 37pa/ /dri zhim sna tshogs mngon par sprul mdzad nas/ /zhing rnams kun tu rgyal ba gshegs mdzad 1)pa/ /snang ba'i 'od zer lha (nyedes rab tu mthong / /'dren pa rnams kyi chos nyid bsam mi khyab/ /'khor rnams kun tu 'byams7klas mtha' yas pa'i/ /rnam par 'phrul pa mi zad rab tu ston/ /me tog gtsug phud lha des de mthong ngo / /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad kun tu gshegs shing bzhud pa yis8/ /sems can mtha' yas yongs su smin par mdzad/ /shin tu mdzes pas dga' bar de mthong ngo ske/ /sems can snyed kyi sprul pa kun 'phros pasatso/ /re re'i sku yis chos kyi dbyings kyang 'gengs/ /rin chen dri med 'od kyang rab tu gtong / /rkang 35—114

'gronyedapal gyi mtshan gyis〈'di mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul mtha' yas te/ /'khor du rgyal ba chos kyi char yang 'bebs/ /bde5migashegs de yi 'khor na dgar gnas shing / /dga' sgra dbyangs kyi5gernam thar de mthong ngo ske/ /sangs rgyas dbyangs ni mkha' dang mnyam pa ste/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag yon tan kun dang ldan/ /'jig rten kun bkang sems can rnam par 'dul/ /tsan dan shing gi 'od ni de la nyan/ /spu rtse kun nas rgyal ba rnam 'phrul dang / /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba'i mtshan rnams kyis / /sgra bsgrogs4)thos shing dga' ba skyer 'gyur te/ /de ni rdo rje 'od kyi lhas mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs sku bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /gom pa gom par yon tan rgya mtsho ston/ /de dag sems can ji ltar mos pas mthong / /rdul gyi 'od kyi lhas ni de mthong ngo ske/ /'jig rten mgon po rnam 'phrul9)rnam mang gis/ /phyogs bcur sems can yang dag skul badza2)mdzad/ /me tog 'khor mang rkang pas 'gro ba'i lha/ /mthong zhing dga' ba yangs pa rab tu 'thobatsos/ /de la lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha khrel dang dge bas rgyas pa'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran pas rnam par dpyod pa zhes bya'o / /lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha 'od zer phyogs su snang ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams mutsha/ )med par sangs rgyas kyi 'od rnam par ston pa'i rgyan ces bya'o/ /lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha sgras 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dpal gyi rnam par thar pa ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung 'dul ba'i sems can thams cad la brjod tunyecing yang dag par skul bas dga' ba nyuge'abyung ba zhes bya'o / /lus kyi ris su gtogs nyunyepa'i lha rgyan bzang po'i me tog gtsug phud kyis735—115

rnam par thar pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku nam mkha'i mtshan nyid kyi byin gyi rlabs kun nas rab tu gnas pa 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha spyod yul mtha' yas dpal gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul 'gro ba rnams la yang dag par ston pa'i mthu zhes bya'o/ /lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha snang ba'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'i dpal gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams cad gsalatub dang 'dres pa'i mdangs7kyis dga' ba zhes bya'o/ /lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha spos dri ma med pa'i sprin las char 'babasalgepa'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i dri ma mngon par sel ba'i sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ /lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha srung 'dzin yongs su sdudasrepa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi bdud kyi las dang rmongs pa rnam par zlog pa zhes bya'o/ /lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha sgo kun nas yongs su gnon pa la mngon du gyur pa'i mig gi rnam par thar pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi gnas su rgyal ba rnam par dmigs par mngon du ston pa'i rgyan ces bya'o/ /lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha khrel dang dpal mi g.yo ba'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i shugs thams cad yang dag par 'dzin cing /yang dag par sbyong ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha khrel dang dge bas rgyas pa'i 'od kyis rtso)sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ lus kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas / de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /ri rab rdul phran shin tu phra snyed kyi/ /bskal pa de dag pha snga'i bskal pa ni/ /rdul ces bya bar 'od 35—116

mdzes 'od zer rgyal/ /mchod de smon lam btab pa bdag gis dran/ /sangs rgyas sku las 'od 'phro rab bkye ba/ /de'i 'od zer chos kyi dbyings su rgyu/ /rgyal ba'i 'od zer dra ba sems can 'dul/ /'od 'phro 'od zer lha yis de mthong ngo / /dbyangs kyi yan lag yon tan kun rgyas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni zhing rnams kun tu sgrogs①/ /'gro ba ma lus thams cad yang dag bsku'akhoske/ /dbyangs kyis 'dul ba de la dga' bsakhunyan/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rab tu zhi ba0ltos/ /sku gzugs du ma'ang mtshan nyid mi mnga' ste/ /'gro ba kun na'ang bzhugs 0par rab tu snang / /me tog gtsug gis ji bzhin nyid du mthong / /'dren pa'i chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /sems can de dag dad pa ci ⑦bzhin du/ /la la bzhugs dang bzhengs dang gshegs par mthong ske/ /de yang spyod lam 'byung ba'i lhasalgemathong ngo / /rgyal ba'i tshems kyishematshams rnams thams cad nas/ /dri zhim 'od 'phro sgron ma'i sprin bkye bas/ /'gro ba kun gyi nyon mongs zhi bar 'gyur/ /dri med spos kyi sprin gyis de mthong ngo ske/ /sangs rgyas mgon po 'gro ba'i skyabs su byung / /nyon mongs shin tu sdug bsngal gzir ba (7rnams/ /mgu bar mdzad cing nyon mongs thams cad bsaladzoske/ /snang ba'i phreng ba 'chang bas 'di mthong ngo / /'dren pa bskal pa brgyar yang shin tu dkon/ /rang byung 'jig rten don mdzad skyes pa ni/ /'jig rten kun gyi dbul ba rnam par sel/ /khrel yod dpal gyi 'od snang de skad smra/ /sems can nyon mongs sgrib pas nyon mongs shing / /bdud kyi las kyis dkrugs te 'phyen5nyepa'i rnams/ /de dag rgyal bsnyernam thar lam ston teyi//srung zhing skyong ba'i dpal gyis ⑩de mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam 35—117

par 'phrul pa ltos/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis chos kyi dbyings mnan cing / /'jig rten dbang po gnas su sems can 'dul/ /kun sgo'i mig gi dpal gyi spyod yul lo/ /de la lag na rdo rje mthu chen kha dog bzang po'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ yon tan mtha' yas pa dang / gzugs kyi sku rnam par dpyod pa yang dag par ston pa zhes bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje nyi ma'i shugs kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ba spu las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprin sna tshogs kyi rgyan 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje ri rab me tog 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ rnam par 'phrul pa rgya chen po bstan pas/ yon tan mtha' yas pa'i lus su 'phrul pa zhes bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje rnam dag sprin gyi dbyangs kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbyangs mtha' yas tshad med pa'i rjes su song ba zhes bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje dbang po shin tu mang ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa ston cing / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis yang dag par skulatub zhes bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje rdo rje'i 'odasayid du 'ong ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi dbyings rab tu phye ba thams cad ma lus pa la yang dag par spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje shing gi sgra dbyangs kyi rnam par thar pa ni/shing gi lha thams cad 'dren pa'i rgyan yid du 'ong bas brgyan pa zhes bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje seng ge'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod nams kyi dkyil 'khor yangs pa'i tshogs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i 'od ces bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje 'od 'phro stug po'isngoshedapal gyi mig gi rnam par thar pa ni/ sems can ma rungs pa'i rgyud la lus 'jigs 'jigs ltar rab tu ston 35—118

cing kun tu rnam par lta ba zhes bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje rin chen gtsug phud padmo'i (me'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gtsug gisnyinor bu rin po che thams cad kyi char mngon par 'bebs pa zhesang bya'o / /de nas lag na rdo rje mthu chen kha dog bzang po'i 'od kyisam risangs rgyas kyi mthus/ lag na rdo rje'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /chos rgyal chos kyis mdzes pa yi/ /chos nyid de la rnam par ltos/ /yon tan mtha' yas sku gzugs kyis⑤/ /'jig rten kun tu rnam par mdzes/ /sangs rgyas ba spu thams cad nas/ /'od zer dra ba bsam myi khyab/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra ba ste/ /phyogs bcu kun tu rnam par mdzes/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul de dag gis / /chos kyi dbyings su khyab byas shing / /'gro ba kun ladzodamangon sum du/ /mi zad sku ni shin tu ston/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /zhing rnams kun tu rab tu sgrog / gsung gis ni sems can thams cad kyi97/ /bsam pa thams cad rab tu 'gengs/ /'jig rten dbang po kun gnas na/ /thub pa rab tu bzhugs par snang / /de dag thams cad 'khor rnams la/ /'dren pa dag gi chos ston mdzad/ /rgya mtsho chos kyi sgo bskul bas/ /gzhan dang gzhan gyi tshul dag gis/ /thams cad chos kyi bye brag don/ /rgyal ba zad med rab tu ston/ /rgya hu chen mtha' med tshul dag la/ /rgya mtsho 'khor rnam 1rterab tu 'jug /sangs rgyas 'od zer rab 'dres pas/ /kun gyis 'dren pa mthong bar 'gyur0/ /zhing rnams bye ma'i mardul snyed du/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun mchod pas/ /bsod nams rgya chen nam mkha' bzhin/ /kun gyis 35—119

'dren pa rab tu mthong / /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul ma 'dres pa/ /thams cad zhing du ston pa mdzad/ /'gro la sangs rgyas mngon sum du/ /byang chub snying por rnam par mdzes/ /'od zer sna tshogs dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'od 'phro sprin ni kun tu snang / /chos dbyings kun tu khyab byas shing / /sangs rgyas spyod yul rab tu ston/ /①de la byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa ni/ tshul7rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho la 'jug ste/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba dang / 'gro ba gdul7ba la mthar thug⑧par mngon par sgrub pa zhes ⑤bya ba'i rnam par thar pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung du phyin pas/ yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad kyi yul zhes bya ba'i rnam par thar pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sa nas sar smon lam rgya mtshos rab tu gnas pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rnam par thar pa dang / sgo thams cad nas chos kyi dbyings su bdag gi lus kyi sprin rdul snyed mtha' yas pas rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba'i rnam par thar pa dang / zhing thams cad du rang gi ming bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'khor lo sgrog pa'i byin gyi rlabs shes bya ba'i rnam par thar pa dang / rdul shin tu phra ba'i0thams cad kyi sbubs su byang chub sems dpa'i yul dang / rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' dang dbusashemed pa yang dag par ston pa zhes bya ba'i rnam par thar pa dang / dus gsum gyi bskal pa skad cig gcig tu ston pas 'byung ba dang / 'jig pa rab tu 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rnam par thar pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho'i yul phan ②tshun du 'jug pa yang dag par ston pa zhes ⑨bya ba'i rnam 35—120

par thar pa dang / gang 'di chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus7med pa rang gi lus kyi sprul pas rgyas par rnam par mi'aphrul pa'i byin gyi rlabs shes bya ba'i rnam par thar pa dang / gang 'di byang chub sems dpa'i chos thams cad kyi tshul phan tshun du ston pa rgya chen pos thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshul la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i rnam par thar pa dag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po rnam par thar pa'i tshul rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho la 'jug cing sangs rgyas kyi mthus/'khor rgya mtsho yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /zhing rnams rgyal bas dri med rnam par sbyangs/ /mkha' yangs rdul bzhin yon tan tshad kyang myed/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sras po dri med kyis / /de la bsam yas chos sprin char yang phab/ /ji ltar rgyal ba gdan la bzhugs snang ba/ /de bzhin rdul sbubs ma lus kun nang skyekha/ /'on kyang bde gshegs gshegs dang 'pho ba med/ /zhing rnams kun tu yul yangakhurab tu ston/ /sa yi tshul la 'jug pa tshad med de/ /spyod pa thub pas byang chub sems dpa' bstan/ /bsam gyis mi khyab tshul ni kun gsungs pas/ /rgyal sras rnams ni chos kyi dbyings la 'jug /chos dbyings 'jug tshul rnam pa rgya che rsā/ /mtha' yas phyogs su mtha' dang dbus57med sgo/ /rdul phran sbubs su rgyal ba 'phrul ba spros/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa kun kyang rab tu mkhyen/ /phyogs rnams thams cad zhing rnams kun tu yang / /'jig rten gtso mtshan 'gro dang mnyam par byung / /thams cad tshul sgor sangs rgyas don yod de/ /'dul bas sems can thams cad rnam par spyod/ /rdul sbubs kun tu mtha' 35—121

dang dbus 1med pa'i/ /rnam 'phrul yangs pa rang byung shin tu ston/ /sngan cad thub pa'i byang chub spyod pa rnams/ /ci7bzhin kun kyang snying po byang chub brjod / /yangs dus bskal pa ji snyed yod pa'i rnams/ /skad cig skad cig sangs rgyas ma lus ston/ /der ni sems can 'byung zhing 'jig pa'ang bstan/ /'jig rten gtso bos ye shes mtha'am④yas ltos/ /'byamadzanyaklas mi zad mtha' yas lo grangs 5)pas/ /rgyal sras thams cad sangs rgyas de57)lta ste/ /thams cad sgor yang sangs rgyas mtha' dbus nyemed/ /rgyal sras kun gyis shes par sla spub min/ /sangs rgyas mkha' nyu sna'adra rnam par mi rtog ste/ /chos nyid mi gnas chos kyi sprin dag gis/ /sprul pas spyod tshe kun tu rgyas mdzad cing / /shing mchog kun drung nyunyabyang chub 'tshang rgya bstan/ /sangs rgyas gsung de rab tu brjod pas na/ /chos gnas thams cad ma lus brjod pa yin/ /'gro ba thams cad re re'i sgo dag nas/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams kun la rab tu 'jug /de la byang chub sems dpa' dge ba dri ma myed pa'i gzi brjid kyi 'od yid du 'ong ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ chos hu kyi dbyings thams cad du mngon par byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 'gro ba'i rgyan byed pa zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan 'od mchog kun tu sgron ma'i rnam par thar pa ni/sems skad cig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sgo zad mi shes pa ston cing ske/ chos ston 1 kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pas yongs su smin pa dang rnam par 'dul bar byed pa'i 'od ces bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu 'bar ba seng ge'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs dang zhing yang dag par 'byung ba la rnam 35—122

par lta ba zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi 'od zer kun tu 'od 'phro'i7rnam par thar pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi yul gyi gernam par spyod pa don yod pa zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan rgya mtsho kun tu sgra dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan thams cad 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du yang dag par ston pa zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul ye shes kun tu snang ba'i 'od kyi rnam par thar pa ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su kun nas song zhing chos kyi dbyings la rnam par spyod7pa'i sprin chen po'i snying po zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gtsug na rin chen kun tu rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi spyod pa la rab tu zhugs shing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mtha' yas pa shin tu 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i gsung kun tu 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad bsnyen bkur zhing mchod par nye bar 'gro ba'i snying po zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams mi zad dri med kun tu gzi brjid kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad kyi ri byin gyi rlabs rgya chen po 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtshan gyi 'od zer kun tu snang ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/de bzhin gshegs pa'i ④sku med pa las sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid kyi 'od yid du 'ong bas sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho'i phyogs thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshis/sa su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /ji snyed gang dag 35—123

phyogs rnams kun gyi zhing / /rgyal bas de kun skad cig thugs kyis7sbyangs/ /'gro bshekun tu zhi ba med pa'i gsung / /sangs rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor la/ /skad cig thugs kyi chos dbyings kun bkang ste/ /mtha' yas spyod yul dbyings rnams rgyal ba ston/ /'gro ba kun lamasnyisnying po byang chub tu/ /byang chub 'tshang rgya rnam par 'phrul pa mdzad/ /bskal pa brgya phrag stong rnams tshad med du/ /de bzhin gshegs pas sngan cad spyod spyad de/ /nam mkha' 'dra bar byas nas rab bkye zhing / /sangs rgyas zhing 'di sngon tshe rab tu sbyangs//mtha' dang dbus yimed bskal par la la yisame/ /skyo ba med par rgyal ba'i yul bsams kyangasnyi/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul stobs la dbus med pa⑨/ /phyi ma'i mtha' yi bskal pa kun tu 'gengs/ /rgyal ba'i rdzu 'phrul yul la rnam par ltos / /phyogs bcu'i zhing rgyan de dag rnam dag pa/ /rgyal bas 'dir ni kun kyang rab tu bstan/ /skad cig skad cig sna tshogs gzugs kyang snang / /bskal pa brgya stong tshad med pa dag tu/ /rgyal ba'i ba spu gcig mtha' shes par dka'atso / /tshul rnams kun sgor nyunyesangs rgyas chags pa med/ /'gro ba 'di nachargya chen bsam yas mdzes/ /sngon tshecabaskal par rgyal bas 'gro kun tu/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rgya chen bsnyen bkur bas/ /de bas 'jig rten gtso la chosalgedabyings rnams/ /kun nas mchod pa mang po rgya chen 'byung / /phyogs rnams bkang ste sangs rgyas 'byung〈nyeb dag /rdul gyi sbubs su tshad med zhing yang ston/ /de dag yul du mi zad mtha' yas pa'i/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor byin gyis rlobalgepa mdzad/ /sngon tshe'i bskalam par rgyal bas 'gro don spyad/ /thugs rje'i rgya mtsho tshad med rab skyedarwanyecing / /'gro ba rgya mtsho kun nas 'khor 35—124

ba yi/ /'khor rnams rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun kyang sbyangs/ /sangs rgyas mtshan med sku med rdul dang bral/ /de bzhin nyid gnas chos dbyings snying po ste/ /'gro ba kun natumatha' yas gzugs su snang / /'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal kun zhi mdzad/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer rgya mtsho 'od chen57dpal gyi zla ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang sa'i shugs kyis gsems can gyi khams kyi tshul dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnamatshamapar dag pa yang0)dag par 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sprin gyi nga rorsā)rgya mtsho dri med 'od kyi snying po'i rnam par thar pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sems skad cig la chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul gyis khyim sna tshogs la rnam par ⑦lta ba zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan rin chen 'byung ba ye shes dpal gyi gtsug phud kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ bskal 3)pa bsam gyis mi khyab par 'gro ba rnams la mngon sum du yon tan dri ma med pas yongs su dag pa sgrub pa zhes bya'o / /byang chub sems dpa' rgya chen 'od 'bar blo gros dbang phyug gi rnam par thar pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi snying po byang chub tu thog ma 'gro ba'i ye shes kyi phyogs yang dag par 'byung ba'i rgyun ces bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' padmo rnam par gnon pa 'od zer gtsug phud kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 3)tha myi dad par 'gro ba thams cad kyi dbang po dang / mos pa rgya mtsho'i 'od ces bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu ye shes sprin gyi nyi ma'i rgyal mtshan snang ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyitshwa)ye shes bsgrub7tshe/par bskal pa mtha' yas pa dag tu byin gyis rlob cing rnam par spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu stobs brtson 'grus rdo 35—125

rje yangs pa'i snying po'i rnam par thar pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi phyag rgya mtha' dang dbus )tshomed pa la yang dag par 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi 'od 'phro shin tu 'bar ba'i 'od kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa ni / sangs rgyas da ltar byung ba thams cad kyi thog ma'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa shes pa'i dkyil 'khor yang dag par sgrub lapa zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' 5)rnam par snang mdzad yon tan yangs pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa ni/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad kyi dbyings ④la rab tu gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams yangs pa shin tu 'phags pa'i 'od mchog yon tan 'byung ba'i blo gros kyi rnam par thar pa ni / sangs rgyas kyi yul zab mo chos kyi dbyings thams cad la kun nas rab tu gnas pa 5)rnam par spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer rgya mtsho 'od chen dpal gyi zla bas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' rnam par phye ba rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa la rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /pha rol phyin pa rgya mtsho bsam yas dang / /sa yi dkyil 'khor rgya chen kun kyang yongs su rgyas/ /tshad med sems can rnam yepar 'dul ba'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas zhing yangs rnams57kyang rnam par sbyangs/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing kun rgyas byas te/ /sangs rgyas sems can khams sbyin 'dul mdzad pa/ /skad cig thugs kyisasngogechos kyi 'khor lo dag /mtha' yas 'gro mnyam bsam pa tshim par stonashes/ /bskal pa rgya che mi zad mu med par//rgyal ba 'gro la mngon sum kun nas bzhugs/ /mgon pos sngan cad ji ltar sbyangs tshul du/ /rgyal bas spyod yul rnam dag rab tu bstan/ /chos rgyal de 35—126

dag ji ltar rnam 'phrul pa/ /phyogs rnams rgya mtsho ma lus kun na snang / /snying po byang chub kun na'ang rgyal ba dag /'khor gyis bskor cing chos rnams gsung ba snang / /'gro ba'i bsam pa thams cad tshim mdzad cing / /'jig rten dag na sangs rgyas tshul kun mdzes/ /dbang po ji bzhin chos kyi char yang 1)'bebs / /sangs rgyas chos sku yangs pa rnam par mdzes/ /de bzhin nyid ltar mtshan nyid lus med de/ /rgyal ba dri med 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /ye shes zhi ba'i sku ni tshad med de/ /phyogs dbyings kun bkang chos kyi char yang 'bebs/ /chos rje thams cad stobs kyis rnam par dag /bde gegashegs ye shes mkha' 'dra mtha' yas te/ /rgyasachen 'gro ba mtha' dbus bamyed bkang zhing / /rgyal ba stobs la 'jug pa rab tu ston/ /sangs rgyas 'od kyis chos dbyings kun bkang zhing / /sangs rgyas spyod pa thams cad rdzogs par bstan/ /rgyal bas sngon tshe ji ltar rnam sbyangs pa/ge/ /de bzhin ye shes sa rnams rgyal bas bstan/ /phyogs rnams kun tu rang byung rnam par mdzes/ /smon lam rnam par 'phrul pa ma lus ston/ /ji ltar sngon tshe rgyal bas yongs sbyangs pa/ /rgyal ba'i 'od zer dra ba kun nas sgrog /sangs rgyas yul ni phyogs su zad pa med/ /dbus ne dang mtha' med gzhal med mtha' yas dbyings/ /chos du dbyings kun tu chags med brnyes pa niphya)/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams kun na shin tu mdzes/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi seng ge'i khri dang / pad mo'i ze ba'i dri thams cad dang /nor bu'i rgyal po thams cad kyi tho kyingos dang / 'khor lo'i lte ba thams cad sna rmedang ske/ me tog gi ze ba'i dri thams cad dang / stegs bu'i ngos thams cad dang ske/ rta babs kyi sgo thams cad dang / nor bu'i gzugs kyi ngos thams 35—127

cad dang / rin po che7'od 'phro ba'i sgo thams cad dang / 'od zer sgron ma'i sgo thams cad dang / seng ge'i khri'i rgyan gyi sgo thams cad nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' mang po 'thon par gyur 2te/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i blo gros rnam par rol pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sgra dbyangs kun tu sgrog pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor shegatsug phud dang / byang chub sems dpa' ye shes chen po'-i nyi mas byarab tu gnon pa'i blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' yon tan rin po che bsam gyis mi khyab pa ye shes rgya mtsho'i dpal dang /byang chub sems dpa' mig brgya pa padmo'i0)sna tshogs kyi gtsug phud dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i tshul padmo sna tshogs kyi gtsug phud dang / byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi skyo'od 'phro gzi brjid dkyil 'khor gyi 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu sgra mchos kyi dbyings kyi dbyangs gyedang / byang chub sems dpa' sprin yid du 'ong ba dri ma ⑨med pa'i zla ba dang / de dag la stsogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mchod pa'i sprin rnam pa sna tshogs rab tu 'gyed cing / 'di ltar nor bu rin po che'i me tog gi sprin thams cad ni rab tu 'byinahu sku/ spos kyi sprin thams cad ni shin tu 'gyed / rin po che'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin thams cad ni mngon par 'byin / yul mtha' yas pa'i spos kun tu 'phro ba'i bdug pa'i sprin ni rnam par 'gyed cing / nor bu nyi ma'i snying po hunya'akhor lo'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi (nyesprin ni rab tu gtong / sil snyan gyi sgra dbyangs yid du 'ong ba'i sprin ni rab tu 35—128

sgrog /rin po che7'od 'phro ba kha dog mtha' yas pa'i sgron⑧ma'i sprin gyis ni rab tu snang bar byed/ nor bu sna tshogs kyi shing gi yal ga las me tog gi dog pasnyeni rnam par spyod/ rin po che'i 'od dri ma med pa zad mi shes pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po'i char ni rab tu 'bebs④/ rgyan mdzes pa thams cad yang dag par ston pa'i nor bu'i rgyal po'i sprin gyi char ni rab tu 'bebs shing / de lta bu dag la stsogs pa byang chub sems dpa' re reshogazhing yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing giposardul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi mchod pa'i sprin gyi char rab tu 'bebs par ⑦byed cing lhags par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yod pa thams cad du mchod pa'i sprin rgyun mi 'chad pa'i char mngon par phab nas gang nas 'ongs pa'i phyogs su brten te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon du bltas nas seng ge'i khri rin po che〈sna tshogs du ma'i padmo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te/ skyil mo krung bcas te'u'akhod par gyur to nyu bye/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang spyod yul rgya mtsho rgyalanyachen po yongs su dag pa rnams so/ /sgo kun nas chos kyi snang ba rab tu thob pa rnams so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul chags pa med pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams so/ / tha dad pa hunyeyang dag par shesatshwanyepa thams cad kyis 8chos rgya mtsho la zhugs pa rnams so/ /rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i snang ba rab tu thob pa rnams so/ /sgo kun nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa'isnyidabyings rab tu thob pa rnams so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rgya mtsho thams cad kyis chos rgya mtsho rab tu 'dzin pa rnams so/ /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi sa la rab tu gnas pa rnams so/ /dga' ba'i shugs nya 7rgya chen 35—129

po rabasanyu1tu thob pa rnams so/ /bsod nams kyisnyidakyil 'khor mu med pa yongs su dag pa'i ri rnams te/ chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha' la rnam par rgyu zhing sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa mngon par bsgrub (gepa la rab tu brtson pa sha stag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i blo gros rnam par rol pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa'i rgyal pos sangs rgyas kyi〈de)mthus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho thams cad yel rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas rnam par sangs rgyas mnyam nyid mkhyen/ /chags med rnyed dzo)pas nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /phyogs rnams zhing kun rab tu snang byas nas/ /'byam5bklas 'khor na bzhugs pa rnam par mdzes/ /bde7gshegs rang byung mtha' dang dbus 7med de/ /thams cad phyogs kyi chos dbyings kun rgyas par/ /dbang phyug chen po kun gyis mchod bskor cing / /shing gi rgyal po kun gyi drung na bzhugs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul stobs dag gis/ /skad cig sems la zad med 11yon tan gzugs/ /rnam thar gzhan dang gzhan dag thob pas mthong / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul ni mtha' yas so/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor sngan cad spyod pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pas srid pa rgya mtsho 12'dir/ /sna tshogs thabs kyisarwanyesems can smin byas pa/ /de dag rgyal ba de yi chos 'dzin to/ /yongs dag dri med 'khor rnams 'khod pa dag /thams cad sangs rgyas lta zhing rnam par gnas/ /padmo'i snying po padmo thugadan bzhugs pa/ /tshogs kyi nang na rgyal ba mngon par mdzes / /sangs rgyas gang natshamabazhugs pa'i seng ge'i khri/ /rin chen nor bu'i rgyal po'i 'od 'phro zhing / /spos 'phro tsosprin rnams mtha' yas rab tu 'byung te/ /35—130

snying po du ma'i me tog phreng spyangs7)pa'o/ /rin chen 'od 'phro'i sprin ni rtag tu 'gyed / /'od zer sgron ma rgya chen rab tu 'bar/ /rta babs rnam pa sna tshogs rnams kyis7brgyan/ /thub pa de bzhugs mngon par rab tu mdzes/ /sgra dbyangs yid du 'ong ba rab tu 'gyed/ /rin chen tshon du sna tshogs padmo 'phyang //nor bu'i rgyal pos skar khung kun gnasas brgyan/ /sangs rgyas de bzhugs rnam par rab tu mdzes/ /zla gam rin chen mang pos yongs su bzungasre/ /rdo rje 'od 'phro snang ba'i snying pos brgyan/ /gtsug na nor bu'i byang chub sems dpas bzung ske/ /sangs rgyas de bzhugs rnamadzanyapar shin tu mdzes/ /phyogs bcur sprul pa'i dra ba rab bkye zhing / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam sgra yang sgrog /gzugs brnyan bzhin du zhing rnams kun na snang / /thub pa de 'dra'i seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sgra dbyangs kun tu sgrogadza 'upas / sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du9)yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'di ni bdeshegashegs sangs rgyas byin rlabs te5)/ /byang chub spyod pa sngan chad spyad pa dang ske/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa'i mchod pa du ma dag /rgyal ba'i gdan las de dag thams cad snang / /spos ma'od snang ba nor bu'i rgyal po can/ /me tog snying po seng ge'i gdan gyi 'khor/ /rgyan rnams thams cad gzugs brnyan gyur pa dang / /'khor rnams de dag thams cad kun bkang ste37/ /skad cig skad cig rgyan gyi kha dog kun/ /rnam pa du mar sangs rgyas gdan las snang / /sems can ji ltar mos pa de dag kyang / /'khod cing sangs rgyas tshad med gdan7la lta/ /rin chen lda nyu ldi padmo mang btags pa/ /phyi tsho/0zhing byang chub 35—131

sems dpa' mang po rnams/ /sgra dbyangs yid du 'ong ba rab 'byin cing / /sangs rgyas gdan la bzhugs la stod ①pa byed/ /sangs rgyas bsod nams tshad med nam mkha' bzhin/ /'di dag rgyan kun de las rab tu byung / /sa rnams re re'i rgyan rnams gang yod pa/ /'gro ba kun gyis de dag bsam mi nus//mi phyed mtshams kyi rdo rje sna tshogs pa/ /'khor yangs〈rnam dag shin tu mnyam pa ste/ /nor bu'i dra ba sna tshogs kun tu bkram/ /byang chub shing gi sa yi 'khor kun to/ /sa phyogs gang na rgyal ba'i gdan yod pa/ /kha dog mtha' yas rgya chen sna tshogs te②/ /me tog mngon gtor rin chen rnam par bkram/ /gser tshonasemadzes pas de ni rab tu brgyan/ / sa yi lha mo de dag rab dga' zhing ske/ /skad cig sems kyis mi zad sa yang ston/ /kun kyang rgyal ba'i zhal du mngon lta zhing / /kha dog thams cad rgyan gyi sprin gtong ngo / /rin chen sgron ma mang po gsal bar 'bar/ /spos mang dri zhim mang po rtag tu 'byung / /dus dang tshod kyi rnam pa mang ston cing / /lha rnams kun kyang sangs rgyas mchod pa byed / /phyogs rnams bcu na zhing rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag sa rgyan phun sum tshogs yod pa/ /de dag kun kyang sa dkyil 'di na snang / /sangs rgyas byin rlabs mnyam pa med pas byungs/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gtsug phud kyis sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'od kyishedakyil 'khor yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas(spre/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sngan cad spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe de dgatso /zhing kun phun sum tshogs pa mthong ba nyu)rnams/ /snying po byang chub 'khor gyi sa 'di la / /myi zad sa dang de dag rab tu snang / /rnam par7yangs pa gang na snang 35—132

ba yi/ /sa la rin chenatumadzes kun rnam par bkram/ /rin chen mang pos dkyil 'khor kun tu gtor/ /sangs rgyas 'od kyishesprin kyang rab tu snang / /sa rnams kun brgyan shing gi dam pa'i drung / /kun nas nor bu'i rgyal pos rgyan ge byas las/ /bsod nams 'od kyi dbyangs kyi 'brug sgra 'byung / /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul tshul yang rab tu brjod/ /rin chen mang po sgron ma'i char phab cing / /rin chen mdzes par bkod pa rnam par mdzes/ /sgra dbyangs kun gyi 'brug sgra shin tu sgrog /sa yi lha rnams sa yang yang dag ston/ /rin chen 'od 'phro sgron ma rnam par snang / /'od zer sprin ni sa las rab tu 'byungakyi/ /nor bu dra ba sil ma kun nas bkram/ /rin chen sna tshogs rigs kyisheyan lag brgyan/ /sa rnams kun nas mdzes pa 'di dag ltos/ /rin chen mang po tshon bzang rgyan7du bkye/ /'gro ba dag la chos kyi rgya mtsho sgrog /de dag chos nyid rnam par dag pa mthong / /ma lus phyogs na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub shing gi phun sum tshogs pa dag /sa yi dkyil 'khor 'di na kun snang ste/ /de dag chos nyid rnam par dag pa brjod⑩/ /sangs rgyas gdan las chos rnams rgya mtsho yi/ /chos sgo bde bar gshegs pas gang gsungs pa/ /sems can kun kyiphosprebasam pa ji bzhin du/ /sa 'khor rnams kyang kun nas rab tu 'byung //dri zhim 'od rnams rtag tu 'byung bas na/ /de dag ji bzhin snod kyi 'gro btso'agengs/ /srog chags rnams kyi nyon mongs zhi7bar byed/ /sa 'khor de nas de 'dra rab tu sgrog /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul phun sum gang dag dang / /dri med sa ni gang gis mdzes gyur pa'i/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan rnams re re zhing / /bskal pa bye ba dag tu'ang brjod myi nus/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ye 35—133

shes chen po'i nyi mas rab tu gnon pa'i blo gros kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po lnga panyu/ 'jig rten kun gyi bsam pa tshim mdzad cing / /sangs rgyas chos kyi gzhal med khang na mdzes/ /'byam bklas phyogs rnams kun tu mngon sum du/ /sangs rgyas 'gro gtso gzhal med khang na snang / /rin chen kun gyisasnying po rab tu brgyan/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis de bzhin mdzes shing 'bar/ /sangs rgyas pho brang 'od ni bsam myi khyab/ /de na bzhugs shing sangs rgyas rab tu mdzes/ / ka ba'i bsargyan ni nor bu sna tshogs ten)/ /phyogs rnams kun sgor rta babs sprin kyang bris/ /stegs bu'i phreng ba kun shinas rgyan medu bkod/ /gser gyi dril bu'i sprin kyang rnam par brgyusagashe/ /me tog bla re rnam pa7sna tshogs ltos/ /rin chen shing sdong dar gyi bla re bres/ /nor bu thams cad sgo nas phreng ba 'brul7/ /de nas nyu1ye shes rgya mtshorasngonarab tu mdzes/ /spos dri rgyal mtshan rin chen dra ba ste / /'od zer sgron ma'i sprin gyis hunyekun tu g.yogasasnyi/ /rgyan rnams sna tshogasalgekun nas shin tu bres/ /de na sangs rgyas rab tu 'phags pa bzhugs/ /phyogs rnams kun sgo sprul pa'i sprin gyi rnams/ /dbyangs kyis 'jig rten khyab par grag tshebyed cing / /'byamatshwanyeklas phyogs kyi sems can rnamarwanye'adul ba/ /sangs rgyas pho brang 'di na de dag grag /me tog shing dang rin chen spungs spel hurteb / /'phags pa nu )phyogs rnams kun tu mngon par mdzes/ /de las tedus gsum zhing rnams thams cad kyang / /gzugs brnyan gyur par de dag rab tu 35—134

snang | /phyogs rnams kun tu rin chen mang 0)bkye ba/ /de dag sna tshogs mdzes par rnam par 'bar/ /phyogs rnams kun tu skar khung ②mdzes par brgyan / /rta babs mda' yab sna tshogs mang pos brgyan/ //chosadri med 'od zer kun nas snang ba yi/ /sangs rgyas pho brang rnam pa bsam yas te/ /gzhal med khang mang thams cad de la snang / /de dag kun na'ang rgyal ba bzhugs shing mdzes / /phyogs rnams kun na 'khor rnams ji snyed pa/ /rgyal ba'is7pho brang 'dir ni kun bzhugs7kyang / /mtha' med dbus ༄6)myed mu yang de bzhin du3)//rang byung sangs rgyas pho brang de na bzhugs/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yon tan rin po che bsam gyis mi khyab pa ye shes rgya mtsho 87dpal gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ 'khor rje)gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yod pa de dag thams cad la rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas zhing rdul shin tu phra snyed 3 )kyi/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho rnam par rab sbyangs te / /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul smon lam yang dag byung / /snying po byang chub dri med rnam par mdzes/ /spos zhim thams cad rtsa ba 31yang dag rgyu/ /yid bzhin nor mchog rgyal 32pos kun nas brgyan/ /rdo rje phye nyanama'i nor bu'i rgyal po 7bris/ /shing sdong rtsa ba rin chen kun las byas/ /rdo rje phye ma'i nor bu 'khor lo 'byung //lhun rnams thams cad rin chen rgyan nyu2gyis brgyan/ /yal ga stug po sprin ltar kun nas 'khyil/ /snying po byang chub de na rgyal ba mdzes/ /yal ga dog pa kun nas mngon pa ste/ /'khor rnams snum 'jam phyogs rnams kun tu 'phags/ /me tog 'bras bu rgyun 8rnams kun kyang 'gyed/rte/ /snying po byang chub rgya chenatshwanyebasam myi khyab/ /'od rnams bkye ba phyogs su rnam par mdzes/ /dri ma med 35—135

pa'i 'od 'bar zad mi shes/ /yal ga'i sgo nas sprin kun char yang 'bebs/ /snying po byang chub smon lam yangs pa0)byung / /me tog nor dang rin chen mi zad nor / /mu tig nor bus③phyogs rnams kun nas brgyus/ /phye ma nor gyi gnas kyi sprin 'gyed de/ /snying po byang chub phyogs50rnams kun tu 'byin/ /bde gshegs snying po ④byang chub 'di la ltos(ge/ /padmo'i dra ba nor bu dri med mang / /rin chen 'od zer dkyil 'khor kun nas 'phro/ /dril bu'i dra ba sprin gyi༅sgra dbyangs 'byin/ /phyogs bcu'i shing bzang gzugs rnams gang yod pa/ /'byam ri7)klas zhing gi ma lus thams cad dag /byang chub shing la de dag kun nas snang / /de drung sangs rgyas dri med rnam par mdzes/ /yal ga kun nas rin chen mi zad nor/ /byang chub sems dpa' dag kyang rtag⑧'byung zhing / /bsod nams rgya chen dkyil 'khor char phab ste/ /phyogs bcur rgyal ba mchod phyir de dag 'dong7/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sngan cad cir gyur dang / /byang chub spyod las byung ba 'di dag ltos/ /yal ga kun nasaspyo )rin chen nor mi zad//sangs rgyas yul kun bsam gyis myi khyab po/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' myig brgya pa pad mo sna tshogs kyi gtsug phud kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'khor rgya mtsho yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul ba/ /de dag rin chen sgo nas kun kyang grags/gle/ /de ni mtha' dang dbus yang5)myed pa ste/ /snying po byang chub 'di la kun snang ngo / /me tog mang po'i phreng ba sbyangs hunyebakye zhing / /'od zer sprin gyis phyogs rnams kun bkang ste/ /byang chub shing la gnas pa'i lha yisarnams/ /sangs rgyas blta7zhing rtag tu mchod 35—136

pa byed①/ /spos kyi rgyal mtshan nor bu sna tshogs 'bar/ /spos kyi 'od 'phro bdugashesgos rtag tu 'byung / /'khor gyi rgya mtshor kun la khyab par zhim/ /shing gi rgyal po de phyir phyogs su mdzes/ /padmo 'brul ba stug ④cing gser mdog 'drag / /rgyal ba'i sprin sgra rtag par rab tu 'gyed/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams ma lus khyab byas shing / /sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs gdung ba sel/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor ni tshad med rgya che ste/ /phyogs rnams kun nas snying po byang chub la/ /gzugs brnyan snang zhing dri med 'od mchog 'gyed/ /byang chub shing gi rnam 'phrul 'di dag ltos/ /smon lam sgra dang dbyangs kyi mar me rnams/ /rin chen sna tshogs yal ga kun nasapo)'bar/ /srid pa rgya mtsho kun na sngan cad du / /rgyal ba'i spyod pa ji ltar byung ba ston/ /byang chub lha rnams zhing gi rdul snyed do/ /de dag thams cad snying po byang chub gnas/ /thub pa'i byang chub shing la skad cig cing / /rnam thar gzhan dang gzhan mang de dag ston/ /rang byung spyad pa thams cad spyod pa'i tshe/ /sngon chad de bzhin gshegs pa gang mchod pa/ /de dag mtshan bcas sngon gyi sbyor bcas pa/ /thams cad rin chen sgo nas rab tu 'byungashe/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can ji snyed snod gyur pa/ /de dag nithams cad 'di las sgra 'byung ste/ /de dag cis 'dul rnam dag ci 'dra ba'ang / /snying po byang chub 'di lasamathokun brjod do/ /byang chub shing rnams mtha' yas phyogs kun na/ /bsam gyis myi khyab rgyan gyi sprin can dag /mtha' yas sna tshogs rgyan pa tsho/nye thams cad kyang / /sngan cad de bzhin gshegs pas yongs sbyangs pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' gser gyi 'od 'phro gzi brjid dkyil 'khor (7gyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ 'khor gyi dkyil 35—137

'khor yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor byang chub spyod mdzad tshe/ /mos pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su smon dag cing / /gnas dang gnas min stobs rnams thugs chud pa'i/ / bde gshegs stobs rnams7)rnam par dag pa mthong / /bskal pa kun tu rgya mtsho'i (b.las sbyangs te/ /mnyam nyid chos bsgoms ri ji ltar bsgrubs pa rirnams/ /sangs rgyas 'od las de bzhin phyogs bkang zhing / /las rnams rgya mtsho de bzhin rab tu brjodage/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'byamachu)klas stobs spyod tshe/ /bskal pa snga mar 'gro ba'i dbang po bzhin/ /yongs su smin byas de bas 'khor kun kyang / /sems dag sangs rgyas dbang po'i stobs la 'jug /'jig rten kun gyi mos pa sna tshogs dang / /bsam pa ji bzhin sbyor ba rnam spyod pa/ /de dag ji bzhin rgyal ba chos ston te/ /rang byung mos pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ston to/ /phyogs rnams ma lus zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang / /'byam 7skuklas sems can khams dang chos kyi khams/ /nam mkha'i khams rnams mnyam nyid mkhyen mi rtog /rang byung spu rtser khams mkhyen stobs kyang bston she/ /bde 9rigashegs ye shes rgya chen kun tu 'gro/ /skad cig gcig gis dus gsum ma lus 'gengs/ /phyogs dang zhing dang bskal pa 'gro bkang zhing / /sems can kun la stobs 'jug mngon par bstan/ /bsam gtan rnam thar stobs mtha' dbus med pa/ / /ting 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshul ni 'gro kun snyed/ /thams cad rgyal ba'i sku la bstan nyu pas na/ /sems can bsam pa'i chos nyu2kyi nyon mongs sel/ /sangs rgyas ye shes dus gsum sgrib 32pa med/ /skad cig kun la dus gsum spu rtser bstan1 / /zhing dang sems can sangs rgyas de bzhin chos/ /35—138

de ltar rgyal bas rjes su dran stobs bstan/ /thub pa'i spyan ni nam mkha' mnyam pa ste/ / de nas0)chos dbyings ma lus gsal bar gzigs/ /thams cad tshul gyis chags med gzhal yas khang tshon/ /brnyes pas ye shes spyan ni rnam mang bstan/ /'jig rten kun gyi sbyor mang ji snyed dang / /'gro ba'i bag chags bag nyal ma lus par/ /thabs sgo kun nas nyon mongs zhi mdzad cing / /rgyal ba 'jig rten gang bar kun nas byung / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings kyi dbyangs gakun nas sgrog la pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'khor rgya mtsho yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rgya chen sangs rgyas byin rlabs phyogs kun tu/ /sangs rgyas ston kyang rtog pa mi mnga' ste/ /pha rol phyin pa rgya chen yongs bkang ba / /byang chub spyod pa rgya chen de dag snang / /'gro ba rnams la thugs rje che bskyed cing / /sbyin pa'i mthar phyin sngon chad sbyangs pas (5)na/ /de phyir thub pa'i sku ni mtshan gyis rgyas0/ /'gro ba kun gyis blta zhing dga' ba bskyedani / /bskal pa rgya mtsho mang po mtha' yas stonan/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa yongs 497sbyangs pas/ /de phyir bskal pa phyogs su dri med cing / /shin tu 'phags par 'jig rten sdug bsngal sel/ /ma log mnyam pa nyid la dad bskyed de/ /sngon chad bzod pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam 3 mosbyangs pas/ /'gro dang mtshungs mnyam yon tan kun ston to1te/ /de bas phyogs su 'od rnams shin tu 'phro/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho mang por sngon spyod tshe/ /'gro ba rnams kyi sgrib pa 'thibs po bsal12//de phyir phyogs bcu'i 'gro ba kun bkang ste/ /zhing rab drung na rgyal ba mngon par mdzes/ /bsam gtan yan lag rgya mtsho spyod pa'i nyunyetshe/ /bskal pa yangs 35—139

par rgyal ba01rab tu spyadal/ /de bas 'gro ba'i gzhal med dga' ba bskyedag/ /nyon mongs dri mas bsgribasate④pa kun kyang sel/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i drung du sngon spyad 45)cing / /shes rab mthar phyin rgyal bas sngon bkang ste/ /'gro ba'i gti mug mun pa yongs su bsa'atsho/ /de bas rgyal ba kun tu rnam par mdzes/ /'gro ba kun mnyam thabs sgo thams cad kyis/ /yang dag byung zhing 'gro ba rnam sbyangs pas/ /phyogs rnams kun na kun la mngon par bzhugs/ /phyi ma'i bskal par 'gro ba mngon du ltas/ /smon lam pha rol phyin pa rab spyod tshe/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho shin tu rgya che zhing / /phyi ma'i bskal pa7'gro ba'i sprin mnyam par / /spyad pas de phyir 'gro ba kun na mdzes/ /rgyal bas chos kun stobs kyi mthar phyin pa/ /bskal pa gzhal yas mang por yongs su sbyangs/ /de phyir rang byung stobs pho )kyi pha rol phyin/ /phyogs kyi zhing rnams kun na de phyir 'phags/1ri / /thams cad mkhyen nyid nam mkha'atshwa)mtshungs mnyam pa'i/ /ye shes kun gyi sgo nas sngon sbyangs pas/ /de phyir chags med ye shes pha rol phyin/ /phyogs bcu nya)kun na rgyal ba mngon par mdzes/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sprin yid du 'ong ba dri ma med pa'i zla bas sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ 'khor rgya mtsho yod pa thams cad la78rnam par bltas minas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul yul ni phyogs rnams kyi/ /'gro ba'i rgyud dbyings nam mkha' mnyam par snang / /sa rnams yangs pa ji ltar sngon bskyed pa/ /de bzhin kun kyang rin chen sgo nas brjod( sna/ /dang po'i sa ni dga' ba'i shugs kyi yul/ /chos 3nyedabyings kun gyi bde (cegashegs rnams (3 mthong zhing (1/ /gzhal med bskal par dri med yongs gsungs rdunyepas chos 35—140

dbyings yangs la ye shes rab tu byung / /thams cad chos la dri myed sa gnyis te① / / bskal pa rgya mtsho mang por rnam spyad cing / /rgyal ba tshad med rgya mtsho mchod byas nas/ /'gro ba tshad med dri med sbyangs pas byung / /bsod nams dkyil 'khor 'od ni sa gsum ste/ /(misnying po bzod pa'i dkyil 'khor lhag mthong brten / /gang du de skyes rin chen sgo dag nas/ /chos kyi sprin ni rgya chen rab tu thos/ /'od 'phro rgya mtsho ldan pa gzhal med sa/ /mthu yi 'khor 'od snying po snying rje ste/ /zhing rnams kun tu sgrib dang mnyam pa'i lus/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs kun nas rnam sbyangs pa'o/ /dga' rgyal snying po mnyam dbyings mnyam nyid de/ /zhing rnams kun tu 'gro zhing zhi la gzhol/ / sa rnams chos yul kun nas rab tu skyes/ /de yang rnam dag ji bzhin rgyal bas bstan/ /shes rab rgya mtsho yangs pa'i sprin la spyod/ /'byamatsha3)klas chos kyi mthar thugasayirnam pa kun/ /zhing rnams kun la mngon sum nam mkha' 'dra/ /de 'byung〈 byang chub shing chen 'di las grag /chos dbyings mtha' dang mnyam pa'i ri8)lus can te/ /'gro ba kun 'gengs 'gro ba kun snang byed/ /'byam7)klas thabs kyi sgo nas rnam par dag /ring du song mchog de ni rgyal bas bstan/ /thams cad chos dang smon lam spyod mang dang / /zhing rnams rgya mtsho'i dbyings kyang mnyam rtogs pas/ /bskal pa kun tu 'gro mchog mi g.yo ste/ /gzhal med sa de'i sprin kyang rab tu sgrog /tshad med yul can stobs kyis 13 rab tu snang / /rdzu 'phrul chos77kyis 'gro zhing stobs la 'jug /'di ni rdul med dge ba'i blo gros sa/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor byang chub shing las brjod(2/ /chos kyi sprin ni rgya chen sa bcu ste/ /dus rnams kun 'gengs nam mkha'i rang bzhin 'dra/ /35—141

sangs rgyas yul gyi sgra dang dbyangs kun tu/ /rgyal ba'i byin gyis 'di las rab tu grag /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnam par gnon pa gti mug med pa'i 'od zer gyi rgyal mtshan gyis sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcur rnam par bltas nas / de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rnam pa du mar 'khor rnams gnas pa ni/ /dad pa sna tshogs yongs su dag pa'i sems/ /rgyan dang yul rnams kun la rab tu zhugs/ /de dag sangs rgyas ye shes 'jug7)par 'gyur / /phan tshun smon lam rnam dag spyod yul te/ /dag pa mtha' yas bya ba rab tu byas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam 'phrul thams cad kyang / /gzhan dang gzhan gyi sgo nas rab tu mthong / /bde gegashegs chos kyi sku la zhugs pa dag /la las rgyal ba'i chos sku de nyid la/ /kun tu sprin 'dra gzhal du med pa yi dzi / /mtha' yas chos kyi rang bzhin chos nyid mthong / /la las rgyal ba'i gzugs sku de nyid la/ /phyogs bcu kun tu rnam par 'phrul mdzad cing / /yon tan mtha' yas 'od sprin rab 'bar ba/ /'gro ba ngang tshul sprin du gyur par mthong / /la la rgyal ba'i ye shes chags med 'jug /dus gsum mnyam nyid mkha' dang 'dra ba'i sku/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa'i tshul 'byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas stobs la rab tu 'jug pa ri —)mthong / /sangs rgyas gsung phye/ni thogs pa med 'byung ste/ /phyogs kun zhing rnams ma lus rgyas 46'gyur zhing / /'gro ba snod bzhin bskul shesabar byed pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la la la 'jug /la la sangs rgyas snang ba sna tshogs 'jug /sna tshogs snang bas 'gro ba kun bkang zhing / /rgyal ba'i rdzu 'phrul kun tu snang mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas 'od ni la las der yang mthong / /ba spu'i sgo nas 'od zer rab bkye kye 35—142

ba'i / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin la la la 'jug /sngan cad rgyal ba'i spyod pa bstan pa la/ /la la dga' zhing rgyal ba shes par byed/ /la las bsod nams sna tshogs mtshan gyi rnams/ /bde tsho)gshegs bsod nams 'byung ba ji50bzhin mthong ske/ /pha rol phyin pa rgya mtsho sbyong ba'i tshe( —/ /ji ltar dag gyur mtshan kyang la las mthong / /sgo rnams kun nas rgyal ba tshad myed de/ /mtha' dang dbus ④med chos kyi dbyings bkang zhing / /sangs rgyas byin rlabs kun rab brjodasnyepa kun / /rnam 'phrul sangs rgyas yul ni4)la las mthong / /de nas sangs rgyas kyi ④byin gyi rlabs kyis/ 'jig rten gyi khams me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gzhi dang snying po rgya mtsho thams cad rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /rab tu g.yos so/ /kun tu g.yos so/ /'gul to rab tu 'gul to/ /kun tu 'gul to / /ldeg go rab tu ldeg go/ /kun tu ldeg go/ /chem chem rab tu chem chem/kun tu chem chem mo/ /'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur8)/ kun tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /shig shig rab tu shig shig /kun tu shig shig go/ /'jig rten gyi dbang po de dag thams cad re res kyang mchod pa mngon par bsgrubartso1)pa'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i char de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par rab tu phab po/ /'di ltar spos kyi me tog sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char thams cad rab tu phab po/ /rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi sprin dang / rin po che'i 'od 'phro ba'i padmo'i dra ba thams cad kyi sprin dang / nor bu rin po che'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor kha dog mtha' yas pa'i sprin dang / rin po che kha dog sna tshogs dang ske/ mu tig thams cad kyi sprin dang / spos dang tsandan dang hu sna/ rin po che thams cad kyi sprin dang / rin po che'i gdugs thams cad kyi sprin dang /35—143

nor bu'i rgyal po'i 11sgra dbyangs bzang po yid du 'ong ba'i sprin dang / nor bu'i gnyi ma'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba mang po'i sprin dang / rin po che'i 'od zer gyi mdzod thams cad kyi sprin dang / rang rang gi lus las rgyan thams cad 'phyang ba'i sprin dang / de lta bu dag la (stsogs pa 'jig rten gyi dbang po mare res kyang mchod pa mngon par bsgrub gepa'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i char de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyis nodakyil 'khor rgya mtsho thams cad du mngon par phab po /ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 'jig rten gyi dbang po rnams rab tu dga' bar gyur pa de bzhin du/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i 'jig rten gyi dbang po rnams57re res kyang mchod pa mngon par bsgrubartsonapa'i sprin gyi char de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dag tu rab tu phab param1)gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yang 'jig rten gyi dbang po rnams mos pa gzhan dang gzhan dang hu )/dmigs pa gzhan dang gzhan dang hunya/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul gyi sgo rgya mtsho gzhan dang gzhan dang / tshogs gzhan dang gzhan dang / yang dag par sgrub pa gzhan dang gzhan dang / dga' ba'i shugs kyis spyod pa gzhan dang gzhan dang 12/ phyogs kyi tshul gzhan dang gzhan dang / chos kyi tshul la 'jug pa gzhan dang gzhan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul dang / byin gyi rlabs la 'jug pa gzhan dang gzhan dang / yul dang stobs la 'jug pa gzhan dang gzhan dang hunye/ rnam par thar pa'i tshul rgya mtsho'i sgo gzhan dang gzhan gyis/de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po byang chub la bzhugs pa la hustekhong du chud par byed do / /'di na ji lta ba bzhin phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings rgya mtsho'i nam mkha'i 35wa 144

dbyings kyi mtha'7klas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad na yang de bzhin no/ /mi'ajig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi rgyan gyi50tshul rab tu byung ba zhes bya ba'i ste le'u dang po'oge// //tsu)de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi dbang po de dag 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi sa ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi yul ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la〈byin gyi rlabs ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi stobs ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi myi bsnyengasalgepa ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen po ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi mi 'phrogs 3 —)pa ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi spyan ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi snyan ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi shangs ni ji lta bu zhig mnga' / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi ljags ni ji lta bu 35—145

zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi sku ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams (1la sangs rgyas kyi thugasalo snyeni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi 'od ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer ni ji lta bu 5zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi gsung ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni ji lta bu zhig mnga'/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la rab tu 'jug pa rgya mtsho thams cad ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la tshogs rgya mtsho thams cad ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la theg pa rgya mtsho rnams ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la rab tu gnas pa rgya mtsho thams cad ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la spyod pa rgya mtsho rnams ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'byung ba rgya mtsho rnams ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mngon par shes pa rgya mtsho rnams ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho rnams ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la sa 0rgya mtsho rnams ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/ byang chub sems dpa' thams 35—146
