cad la smon lam rgya mtsho rnams ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ye shes rgya mtsho rnams ni ji lta bu zhig tu yongs su ston/bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la yang thugs brtse 3)ba nye bar bzung ste/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho rnams kyang bstan pa mdzad grang / sems can rgya mtsho rnams kyang bstan pa mdzad grang / sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rnams kyang bstan pa mdzad grang na/ sangs rgyas kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho rnams kyang bstan pa mdzad grang / sangs rgyas kyi ④rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho rnams kyang bstan pa mdzad grang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho rnams kyang bstan pa mdzad grang / sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa rgya mtsho rnams kyang bstan pa mdzad grang lta/ sangs rgyas kyi shin tu bstan pa rgya mtsho rnams kyang bstan pa rinemadzad grang / sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rgya mtsho rnams kyang bstan pa mdzad grang / sangs rgyas kyi sku che'i tshad rgya mtsho rnams kyang bstan pa rtsonamadzad grang 8/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi byin5brlabs kyis/ mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sprin de dag las 1 tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag byung ngo / /mtha' yas rgya chen bskal par 11rab spyad de/ /byang chub shing drung rang byung yang dag skyes/ /phyi mtha'i bskal par 'gro ba'i sprin gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas sku ni byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba ma lus kun gyi the tsom hurtegacod/ /mos pa'i stobs ni yangs pa rab tu bskyed1na/ /sems can sdug bsngal mtha' yas zhi bar mdzad/ /sangs rgyas bde la 'gro ba thams cad 'god/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas zhing rdul snyed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blta skezhing kun nas gnas/ /de dag bsam pa spyod yul ji 35—147

bzhin du/ /the tsom0)bsal bar chos rnams rab bstan gsol/ /rgyal bsnyekun gyi sa ni ji lta bu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul gyi rgyud rnams dang / /sangs rgyas byin rlabasamasamatha' dang dbus7med pa/ /de dag tshul ni rnam dag bstan du gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul ci yis 'jug /rgyal ba'i mkhyen laskon)ji ltar 'jug pa dang / / ye shes rgya chen mthu stobs rnam par sbyangs6)ske/ /rgyal sras kun la yang dag bstan du gsol/ /sangs rgyas ting 'dzin ji ltar mtha' yas dang / /mi snyems 7chos nyid ji ltar nam ⑤sbyangs dang ske/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu yang mtha' dang dbus7med pa/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa rnams la bsgrag tu gsol/ /ji ltar chos rgyal pho brang mnga' mdzad cing / /rgyal ba'i spyod yul ji ltar mi 'phrogs7) dang / /sangs rgyas chos gzhan rgya chen de dag kyang / /thugs brtse'i slad du yang dag bstan du gsol/ /rgyal ba'i spyan ni ji ltar tshad myed cing / /snyan dang shangs dang de bzhin ljags dang sku/ /sangs rgyas thugs kyang ji ltar mtha' yas pa/ /'di dag tshul la 'jug (nyepa bstan du gsol/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho ji ltar sems can khams/ /chos dbyings tshul rnams rgya mtsho de dag dang / /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus (rtemed pa/ /'di dag rgyal ba'i sras la bstan du gsol/ /pha rol phyin pa rgya mtsho bsam yas dang / /rnam par thar la 'jug tshul rgya mtsho dang / /chos rnams kun gyi tshul rnams rgya mtsho dag /byang chub snying por thams cad bstan du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sems kyi yongs su rnam par rtog pa thugs kyis thugs su chud nas/zhal gyi sgo tshems nyunyekyi mtshams kyi gseb nas 'od zer/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 35—148

rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu bkye ba 'di lta ste/ rin po che'i ze ba rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer dang / 'di lta ste chos kyi dbyings su dbyangs sna tshogs kyis rgyan byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer dang / 'di lta ste 'od shin tu phra ba'i sprin kun nas lding ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer dang / 'di lta ste phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul dang snying7po byang chub kyi 'od ces bya ba'i 'od zer dang /'di lta ste rin po che thams cad 'od 'phro ba'i gdugs kyi sprin ces bya ba'i 'od zer dang / 'di lta ste rnam par snang bas chos kyi dbyings rab tu snang ba'i 'od ces bya ba'i 'od zer dang / 'di lta ste sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'byung zhing 'khyil ba'i rgyan ces bya ba'i 'od zer dang / 'di lta ste rin po chekhurdo rje dri ma med pa mang po'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i 'od zer dang / 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du nye bar 'gro ba'i rgyan ces bya ba'i 'od zer dang / 'di lta ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan gyi 'khor lo'i sgra rab tu sgrog pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer dang / de dag la stsogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'od zer rab tu bkye ste/ 'od zer de dag re re zhingasa'akhor gyi 'od zer sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed do/ /'od zer de dag re re zhing yang rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog shin tu ston pa dag ste/ de dag rab tu 'phros chenas phyogs bcur sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar byas tergya/byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho nas/ 'od zer gyi sgo de dag thams cad kyi mthus gzhi dang snying po me tog gi (7rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 35—149

rgya mtsho dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad mthong bar gyur to/ /'od zer de dag thams cad kyi sgo nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag byung bar gyur to/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas spyod spyad de/ /phyogs rnams rgya mtshor sangs rgyas kun kyang mchod/ /sems can rgya mtsho 1)rnam par dag byas nas/ /rnam par snang mdzad byang chub mngon sangs rgyas/ /phyogs rnams kun tu snang zhing mngon par mdzes/ /spu rnams kun nas sprul pa'i sprin kyang50'gyed/ /des ni sems can snod bzhin bskul byas nas/ /byang chub sbyor ba chags med rnam par dag /srid pa'i rgyud na sngan cad 'khor ba'i tshe/ /rgyal bas sems can yongs su smin mdzad pa/ /de dag skad cig gcig gis rab tu bgrolaX / /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul 'di dag mtha' yas so/ /rgyan rnams sna tshogs kun tu 'od kyang snang / /byang chub shing ni yal ga rin chen 'phyang / /'od rnams bkye ba kun tu rnam par brgyan/ /byang chub bsam gyis myi khyab de snyesangs rgyas/ /phyogs rnams kun tu sgra ni rab tu sgrog /sems can kun gyi sems bzhin tshim byas te/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi sgo nas dzonarnam par 'dul/ /de las chos nyid zhi sgra rab tu 'byung / /zhing rnams stong gi rdul snyed shesasngan cad du/ /spyod tshe pha rol phyin kun rgyas par mdzad / /stobs rnams kun la sangs rgyas rab bzhugs kyangaphu/ /rgyal ba de'i zhal ltar 'okun kyang deng nya )/ /zhing gi rdul snyed phyogs rnams thams cad nas/ /rgyal sras mang po rab tu dga' ste lhags/ /mchod pa sna tshogs char pa rab 'bebs shing / /thams cad 'khod de rgyal ba mngon sum lta37/ /gsung dbyangs gcig las mtha' yas mdo yi rnamasahurte/ /rgya mtsho dag kyang sangs rgyas 35—150

shin tu ston/ /'gro kun yid bzhin chos kyi char 'bebs kyis1)/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo de la bltar yang 'dong rin/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i smon lam gang yod pa//skad cig thugs la de dag mngon sum ste/ /rgyal ba byang chub shing drung ston mdzad kyisal/ /rgyal ba'i drung du myur du la 'dong bar gyis/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad ye shes mtsho/ /'od zer kun gyi sgo nas rab tu snang / /'a)chos nyid ji lta ci56)'dra de dag ltos3/ /sangs rgyas 'gro kun mngon sum chos ston torka/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de dag nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer gyis yang dag par bskul ri ba'i rnams/ byang chub sems dpa' rang rang gi kha'akhor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang lhan cig tu 'phags te/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad gang na ba der 'ong bar gyur te/nge / 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di dang 'dab 31chags su/ shar phyogs logs na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho padmo'i dpal dri ma myed par snang ba'i rgyan 32ces bya ba yod de / 'jig rten gyi khams bar ma'i rgyud de dag las 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che'i phreng ba rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba na3sne/ de bzhin gshegs pa 34chos kyi chu bo rnam par sangs rgyas pa/ nam mkha' mtha' yas pa'i rgyal po bzhugs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya nyu5mtsho nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dpal padmo rnam par blta ba'i rgyal ⑩mtshan zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig nya tu 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/tsho / bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der 'ong bar gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog 35—151

par byin gyis rlob 1)cing rin po che'i char gyi 'od zer padmo'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / rin po chesngo ri bo'i zom gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nyi ma'i 'khor lo'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / rin po che'i me tog gi phreng ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / sil snyan sgra thams cad 'byin pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang /phye ma'i shing gi mdzod kyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / spos dang bdug spos gzugs thams cad yongs su ston pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / spos thams cad kyi shing gi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang /de dag la stsogs pa mchod pa'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba 5)snyed kyis nam mkha' 4)kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa ⑤byed cing /bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der phyin te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas shar phyogs su brten te/ me tog snang ba sna tshogs kyi snying po can gyi seng ge'i khri mngon par sprul nas skyil mo krung bcas te55)'khod par gyur to/ /de nas yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya rinamatsho 'di dang 'dab 〈chags su lho phyogs ⑨na(nye/'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho rin po che thams cad snang bas rnam par brgyan pa'i snying po zhes bya ba yod de/ 'jig rten gyi khams bar ma'i rgyud de dag las 'jig rten gyi khams 'od mtha' yas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyanatsha/ston/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas mkhyen pa'i 'od dpal gyi ri bo'i 1)rgyal po bzhugs pa'i 35—152

'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho nas byang chub sems dpa' chos hu)rnam par snang ba'i blo gros shes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i ri 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de nas 'phags teni / bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der 'ong bar gyur (gi)te/ nor bu'i rgyal po rgyan gyi thuyul thams cad kyis rnam par gsal bar byas pa'i snying po'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis rlob cing / nor bu'i rgyal po kun nas snang ba ri'u/rin po che'i rgyan gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nor bu'i rgyal po rin po che 'od 'phro ba rab tu 'bar zhing sangs rgyas kyi mtshan shin tu sgrog pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nor bu'i rgyal po kun nas sgra 'byin cing sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad sgrog pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nor bu'i rgyal po shing gi yal ga sna tshogs kyi57)snying po byang chub kyi rgyan byed pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nor bu'i rgyal po sgo kun nas rin po che'i 'od zer dang / sangs rgyas kyi sprul pas snang bar byed pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nor bu'i rgyal po rgyan thams cad dang ma 'dres par 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du gzugs brnyan ston pa'i sprin bcus na/nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nor bu'i rgyal po 'od 'phro baphaḍashin tu sdug pa'i〈 nyesgron mas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul rjes su sgrog pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nor bu'i rgyal po sangs rgyas kyi zhing bsam gyis myi khyab pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzhal 35—153

med khang gi gzugs brnyan yang dag par ston pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nor bu'i rgyal po rin po che sna tshogs kyi tshon gyis tsho)dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan rnam par snang ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / de dag la stsogs pa nor bu'i rgyal po'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul phra mo snyed kyis nam mkha' tshikun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa nibyed cing / bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der phyin te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ lho phyogs su brten nas / yin dra nī gel dang / 'dzam bu nā4)da dang / padma rā ༄7)ga sna tshogs kyi snying po can gyi 8)seng ge'i khri mngon par sprul nas/ skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgyatswamatsho 'di dang 'dab chags su nub phyogs na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho rin po che'i 'od yid du 'ong bar rab tu 1)snang ba zhes bya ba yod de/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag las 'jig rten gyi nyu1khams gos kyi stan yongs su 'byung ba na(rte/de bzhin gshegs pa spos mngon du snang ba'i yon tan rin po ches brgyan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho nas/ byang chub sems dpa' spos 'od 'phro ba'i rgyan zla ba'i 'od ces bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der 'ong bar kyi gyur te/ rin po che dang spos dang me tog sna tshogs thams cad kyi khang pa brtsegs /4pa'i sprin gyi 1snyenam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis rlob cing ske/ nor bu'i rgyal po kha dog mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas 7yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / rin 35—154

po che'i 3)sgron ma dang spos 'od 'phro ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / mu tig thams cad kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang ske/ rin po che thams cad kyi me tog gi ze ba'i khang pa brtsegs rinapa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog ri par byin gyis brlab pa dang / rin po che'i phreng bas yongs su brgyan pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / 'od zer gyi snang ba phyogs kun tu 5 'phro ba'i snying po dang ldan pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa rgyan 6thams cad 'byung ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / rin po che'i tshon thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan cing rgyan du ma yang dag par ston pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / phyogs thams cad rgyan 77gyis rab tu brgyan par kun nas rin 'gengs pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin bcus nam 9tshomakha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / sgo kun tu me tog gi rta babs dang dril bu'i dra ba bres 1 pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin bcus nam 11mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / de dag la stsogs pa khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 12kyis nam mkha' kun nas 1 yog par byin gyis brlab pa 8byed cing / bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der phyin te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ nub phyogs su brten te/ seng ge'i khri rin po che'i padmo chen po lo ma sna tshogs gser las byas pa'i snying po can mngon par sprul nas skyil mo krung skubacas te 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas yang 'jig rten gyi khams 35—155

rgya mtsho 'di dang 'dab chags su byang phyogs na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bee ḍūryapha3)padmo'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi snying po zhes bya ba yod de/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud de dag las 'jig rten gyi khams me tog utpa la'i rgyan na de bzhin gshegs pasag ye shes kyi dpal kun tu dbyangs kyi rgyal po bzhugs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 0rgya mtsho nas byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i 'od zer snang bas mthu 'byin pa'i blo gros shes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / lhan cig tu 'phags nas bcom ldan 'das gang na chogeb der 'ong bar 5)gyur te/ spos dang nor bu sna tshogs thams cad kyi shing gi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis rlob cing ske/ sgo thams cad nas lo ma'i dog pa'i sprin 'byung ba'i spos kyi shing gi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab 6)pa dang / shing gi gzugs thams cad las rgyan mtha' yas pa yongs su ston pa'i shing gi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / me tog thams cad kyi sprin rab tu rin po che'isheme tog gi shing gi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / rin po che (kye'od 'phro ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyis rnam par snang bar byas pa'i shing gi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / tsandan gyi phye ma thams cad dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus phyed yang dag par ston pa'i shing gi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / sngon gyi snying po byang chub kyi rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab par kharab tu ston pa'i shing gi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / kha dog mtha' yas 35—156

mtshams su brten te/ seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che snang ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi padmo sna tshogs kyi snying po can mngon par sprul nas skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas5gyi'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'di dang 'dab chags su shar dang lho'i phyogs mtshams na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bai ḍūrya'i (ba'od zer kun tu snang ba gser gyi rgyan ces bya ba yod de 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud de dag las 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi dpal dri ma med par snang ba na(57)/de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu dga' ba'i shugs dpal gyi rgyal po bzhugs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho nas byang chub sems dpa' ye shes kyi 'od zer shes rab kun nas sgron ma'i blo gros shes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig 7tu 'phags te/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der 'ong bar sku)gyur te/ nor bu yid bzhin gyi rgyal po thams cad kyi bla re'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / rin po che ind+ra nī 8la'i ze ba can gyi me tog thams cad kyi rgyan gyi bla re'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang /spos rin po che'i bla re thams cad sgyukyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / rin po che 'od 'phro ba sgron ma'i gzugs kyi bla re'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nor bu'ispyo snargyal po sangs rgyas kyi rdzu hunye'aphrul dang 'od dang sgra dbyangs rab tu ston pa'i bla re'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nor bu dang gos dang rgyan thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan yang dag par ston pa'i bla re'i sprin bcus nam mkha' gyu 2kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / me 35—159

sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzugs brnyan gyi khongs su chud pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' ①kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang /rin po che'i yal ga'i sgo kun nas sangs rgyas kyi yul rab tu sgrog pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang ske/ nor bu'i rgyal po rin po che bai ḍūrya'idzagyirigs kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / sems skad cig gcig ①gis sems can mtha' yas pa'i gzugs yongs su ston pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlabasrepa dang / dusangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam 'byung ba'i sgra yid du 'ong bsnyurab tu gtong ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du sems can 'dul ba'i sgra sgrog pa nor bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / de dag la sogs pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin bcus (pe'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 'unyenam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa 7)byed cing /bcom ldan 'das (3 gang na ba der phyin te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas nub dang byang gi phyogs mtshams su brten te/ seng ge'i khri 'od zer 'bar bsngo)myi zad pa'i gzi brjid kyi snying po canarwa mngon par sprul nas skyil mo krung〈lhabacas te 'khod do/ /de nas yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'di dang 1ge'adab chags su 'og gi phyogs na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho padmo dri zhim dpal gyi snying 35—163

po zhes bya ba yod de/ 'jig rten gyi khams bar ma'i rgyud detulas 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che'i seng ge〈snang zhing 'bar ba na⑧de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings snang bar mdzad pa'i 'od zer bzhugs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho nas/ byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings su 'od 'phro ba rnam par snang ba 'byungasnyiba'i blo gros shes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba5gesnyed dang lhan cig tu 'phags nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der 'ong bar7gyur te/ rin po che thams cad kyi 'od zer gyikhusprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis rlob7cing / spos thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi 0sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / rin po che bo'od 'phro ba thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi5tesprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad brjod pas khyab par byed pa'i 'od zer gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rgyananyegyis rnam par snang bar byas pa'i 'od zer gyi sprin bcus nam mkha'apha/nyekun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / me tog gi khang pa brtsegasalgepa thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang /bskal pa thams cad gcig nas gcig tu brgyud par sangs rgyas yang dag par 'byung zhing sems can yongs su smin par bya bar brjod7pa'i 'od zer gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab 8pa dang / rin po che zad mi shes pa thams cad dang hu me tog thams cad kyi ze ba'i〈nye'od zer gyi sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / de dag la 35—164

stsogs pa 'od zer gyi sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab panyebyed cing / bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ 'og gi phyogs su brten nas seng ge'i khri rin po che'i sgron ma rab tu 'bar ba 'byung ba'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas skyil mo krung ②bcas te 'khod do/ /de nas yang ②'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan 0pa 'di dang 'dab chags su steng gi phyogs na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'od rgya mtsho'i rgyan ces dubya ba yod de/'jig rten gyi khams bar ma'i rgyud de dag las 'jig rten gyi khams mtshan yid du 'ong ba rnam par snang ba0zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan dang grags pa thogs pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa rab tu snang ba'i rgyal po bzhugs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho nas/ byang chub sems dpa' stobs dang brtson 'grus chags pa med pa'i blo gros shes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu 'phags nas / bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der 'ong bar gyurapo)te/ rin po che kha dog mtha' yas par 'od 'phro ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis rlobanyecing / nor bu rin po che kun nas 'od kyi dra ba 'od 'phro ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan rgya chen pos rnam par snang bar 'od 'phro ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / spos thams cad 'odamanya'aphro ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / rgyan 35—165

thams cad 'od0)'phro ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul 'od 'phro ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa gedang / shing dang ze5)ba rnam pa sna tshogs su 'od 'phro ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / rdo rje sna tshogs 'od 'phro ba'i sprin bcus nam byamakha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nor bu'i rgyal po byang chub sems ⑤dpa'i spyod pa mtha' yas pa brjod cing 'od 'phro ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / mu tig gi sgron ma 'od 'phro ba'i sprin bcus nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa dang / de dag la stsogs pa 'od 'phro ba'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis ri7rinam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa 3)byed cing / bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der phyin te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas steng gi phyogs su brten (9te/ seng ge'i khri sangs rgyas kyi gsung sgrog pa'i 'od zer 'byung ba'i padmo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod do// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po drug pa/ nyu de dag la stsogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtshorwaskyesangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba rnyedatshwa nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis bskor cing mdun du byas te(rte/ byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing yang 35—166

rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyi mchod pa'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mcho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis nam mkha' kun nas yog par byin gyis rlobatucing 'ongs par gyur te/ ②gang nas 'ongs pa'i phyogs su brten te/ seng ge'i khri rin po che sna tshogs kyisasnying po can dag mngon par sprul cing skyil mo krung bcas te 'khod par gyur to/ /'khod pa'i rjes la byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi ba spu'i khungane'urithams cad re re nas 'od zer gyi sprin rin po che ⑥thams cad ltar kha dog sna tshogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtshosngonebacu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu byung bar gyur to/ /rin po che7re re'i sgo nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i khri padmo'i snying po can la 'khod pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho7)bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu byung bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho'i khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 7thams cad kyi sbubs gang bar byas nas/ rdul shin tu phra ba re re la yang zhing 'byam klas77pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du rab tu 'jug par gyur to/ /zhing re rer yang dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad shes shing mthong b.ral gyur to/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la yang mitshwa lam lta bu'i rnam par 'phrul pa yang dag par bstan pa'i sgo dag nas yang dag par bskul bsabyed par gyur to/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la yang 'jig rten gyi ske khams rgya mtsho'i 0rdul shin tu phra ba snyed re re'i lha'i gnas thams cad du skye ba dang shi 'phos patshwa yang dag par bstan pa'i sgo dag nas yang dag par bskul ba 12byed par gyur to/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la tsho/ca'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i ( tshordul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams 35—167

cad shin tu bstan pa'i sgo dag nas yang dag par bskul ba byed par7gyur to/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tusrephra ba snyed kyi zhing 'byam klas pa〈mithams cad rab tu bskyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rab tu brjod cing rnam par 'phrul pa'i sgo dag nas yang dag par bskul bsrebyed par gyur to/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba dang ske/ smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad rab tu bsgrag pa'i sgo dag nas yang dag par bskul bamagu byed par gyur to/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dngalo'agro ba thams cad kyi nges pa'i tshig dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi7yan lag rnam par bstan cing brjod pa'i sgo dag nas yang dag par bskul ba7byed par gyur to/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed hunyechos kyi sprin thams cad kyi char bab hurtepa'i sgo dag nas yang dag par bskul bsngo)byed par gyur to/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su chos kyi dbyings snang bas tustergyas par rnam par 'phrul pa'i mthu'i sgo dag nas yang dag par bskul ba 8byed par gyur to/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi skus chos kyi dbyings gang bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa dang / 'od thams cad kyi sgo dag nas yang dag par bskul btsobyed par gyur to/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi nyu tshodakyil 'khor rgya mtsho thams cad na/ byang chub 35—168

sems dpa' kun tu bzang po rab tu gnas pa'i sgo dag nas yang dag par bskul ba7byed par gyur to/ /de lta bu'i chos kyis chos kyisadabyings rgyas par bkang ste/ sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par bskul ba ③byed cing / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam bu klas pa dag tu rab tu brdal7te zhing re re yang sems kyi skad cig re re la sems can ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi ngan song gi rgyud du gtogs pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad ni rab tu zhi bar byed deni/ sems can phyin ci log la nges pa ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed ni yang dag par nges pa'i phung po la rab tu 'god do/ /sems can ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed ni dge ba dang / yid du 'ong ba dang /mtho ris su skye bshel rab tu 'god do/ /sems can ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la rab tu 'god do/ /sems can ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkuratshwa) ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs la rab tu 'god do/ /zhing de dag re rer yang sems can ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed ni sngon chad ma bskyed (1pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed7do/ /zhing de dag re rer (snyeyang sems can ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed ni〈hebyang chub sems dpa'i sa phyir mi ldog pa yang dag par thobalgepa la yang dag par bskul 8lo/ /zhing de dag re re dag0 moyang sems can ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan chos thams cad kun nas snang zhing gzigs pa la yongs su sbyangs te rab tu 'god go)/ /zhing de dag re re la yang sems can ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed stobs thams cad kyis 6)rab tu gnas pa dang / ye shes kyi tshogs zad mi shes pa dang /35—169

sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i smon lam rgya mtsho0)la rab tu 'god do / /zhing de dgashere rer yang sems can ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi gdung dang rgyud yang dag par 'byung ba'i gnas rgya mtsho rnam par spyod pa la rab tu 'god do/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi 'od zer gyi sgo thams cad nas kyang tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu dag byung bar gyur to/ /'od zer thams cad sgo nas sgra 'byung ste/ /ji snyed byang chub spyod par 'jug pa dang / /rgyal sras yon tan phun sum gang yod pa'i//dbyangs kyi tshogs snyernams kun tu bkang zhing sgrog /bskal gepa rgya mtshor skyo med spyad pa spyod/ /sdug bsngal kun nas gye'agro ba kun 'grol ༅kyang / /yid la skyo myed zhum pa gang yang med/ /'di yi tshul la rgyal sras rab tu zhugs/ /chos kyi sgo rnams kun la rab spyod cing / /tshul 'dir bskal pa rgya mtsho7zad par byed/ /mtha' med dbusarabamed lhag ma gang yang med/ /de dag chos nyid zhi ba rab tu sgrog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i smon lam gang yod pa/ /rgyal sras de dag 'gro la phan don du/ /de dag thams cad ma lus yongs su spyod/ /de dag spyod pa'i rgyan ni 'di 'dra'o/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'khor du nyer phyin te/ /phyogs rnams kun na gzugs brnyan lus 'chang zhing / /rgyal sras ye shes rgya mchosare blo gros can/ /de dag chos nyid zhinga'akhya'ajug 'di 'dra'o/ /'od zer sgo rnams re re nyu snamatha' yas pa'i/ /bsam yas zhing rnams de dag rab tu 'juganyunya /spyod pas myig ni kun nas yongs 3rnyedag ste/ /rgyal sras de dag spyod yul 'di yin no//skra rtse 1snyegacig tu de dag rab tsoganas shing / /zhing rnams dbyings 8kun kun nas bskyod byas kyang / /sems can rnams la 'jigs pasamyi byed de(rte/ /sa 35—170

'di rnam dag tshulatu'achang dag gi 'o/ /tshul rnams kun la bsam gyis myi khyab lus / /de dag kun tu zhing rnams sna tshogs sprul/ /skad cig sems la 'chi 'pho skye bskrusnang / /rgyan 'di sems la chags med rnams kyi 'o/ /dus gsum bskal pa gang yod ma lus par/ /skad cig gcig gis thams cad rab tu ston//sgyu ma lta bu lus med dngos kyang med/ /de 'dra'i chos nyid chags med blos morartogs so/ /bzang po'i spyod pa mchog la zhugs pa rnams/ /'gro ba kun la yid du 'ong ba'i lus/ /rgyal sras de dag chos nyid 'di yin te/ /'od zer kun gyi sgo nas dbyangs kyang sgrog /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gebyang chub sems dpa' mtha' dang dbusasnyimed pa de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la rnam par spyod pas rnam par 'phrul pa thob par bya ba'i phyir/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas 'od zer chen po byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ye shes kyi snang bas phyogs rnam (7par ston pa'i snying po zhes bya ba rab tu bkye'o/ /'od zer rin po che thams cad kha dog sgron ma'i sprin du brdal727ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rab tu snang ba de byung nas/ tshul thams cad kyi phyogs 'byam klas pa rab tu snang bar byas te/ phyogs thams cad kyi dbyings rgya mtsho rnams rab tu snang bar spubyas nas sems can rgya mtsho rnams rab tu snang bar byas te(7/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 3)thams cad rab tu bstan nas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po thams cad rab tu bskyod pa'i rgyan gyi 12tshul thams cad kyisacharab tu bskyod nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sprin 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed/ rdul shin tu phra ba thams cad dang mnyam pa dag tunyerab tu spros nas/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang mos pa ci polta 35—171

ba rgya mtsho dag tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo'i sprin gyi char dus gsum gyi rdul shin tu phra ba dang mnyam pa phab ste/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho rab tu bstan nas/ sems can thams cad ma lus par 'khor ba thams cad las rab tu gdon par bya ba'i phyir / mos pa ji bzhin du byung ①ba dang mthun pa'i sprin gyi ②char rab tu dbab pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi smon lam ma lus pa'i sprin gyi char rab tu dbab pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i 'khor dag tu dga' bar phrad par ①byas nas/bcom ldan 'das la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar padmo chen po chu bsnyerin po che thams cad las bsgrubs pa/ nang rim nor bu'i rgyal po'i mdzod sna tshogs las byas pa lo ma rin po che thams cad kyi rigasarsākyi char 'bebalgepa/ ze ba'i phreng ba'i rgyan spos rin po che thams cad las byas pa/ snying po 'dzam bu chu klung gi⑧gser gyi tshon gyis rab tu mdzes par bris pa/ 'od kyi 'khor rnam par dag cing 'od zer gyi dra bas rnam par snang bar ⑨byas pa'i sprin dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad rab tu 'byung ba sems kyi skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' yas ston pa'i sgra rab tu 'byung ba/ nor bu'i rgyal po mtha' yas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan gyi01sprin gyis thams cad du gang bar byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / smon lam thams cad rab tu ston pa'i dbyangs 'byin par gyur te byung ngo / /padmo chen po derwa)byung ba'i rjes su byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad la pham pa med pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 35—172

'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi mdzod 57de nyid nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das la lan du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor bsnyebyas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te padmo chen po de'i snying po la 'dug nigo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyedatshagepo de dag kyang ze ba'i 'phreng ba de dgashel 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad la pham pa med pa'i dbyangs0chos kyi dbyings rgya che zhing tshad med pas rab tu dga' ba'i shugs shin tu skyes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod yul gyi rjes su song ba'i ye shes can/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku rgya mtsho bsam gyis myi khyab pa la rab tu zhugs pa'i mthu7dang ldan pa/ zhing 'byam7klas pa thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi zhabs kyi drung du phyin pa dang tso/ ba spu thams cad las sprul pa'i sprin zad mi shes pas kun tu khebs par byed pa/ sems kyi skad cig thams cad la dmigs pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings kun tu bsgyur btume/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad la dus gsum khyab par byed pa'i spyod yul gyis rnam par spyod pa/ phyogs thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs 'chang ba/ting nge 'dzin thams cad la rab tu 'jog cing phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mur thuganyepar ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par thar pa la rnam par spyod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa thams cad dang chos kyi dbyings kyi lus dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang / rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' dang dbus 8med pa la rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas 77ni chos kyi dbyings kyis 8gsal/ /'gro ba kun 35—173

la rgyal ba mngon sum ste/ /ji ltar mos pa'i sems can rgyas bkang nas/ /snying po byang chub de la rgyal ba bzhugasatsho)/ /zhing rnams kun gyi rdul phran mchog snyed kyi/ /rgyal ba spu rtse kun la rab bzhugs te/ /byang chub sems dpa'i⑧'khor gyis kun nas bskor/ /kun kyang bzang po'i spyod pa mchog ston to/ /spu gcig rtse la zhing mang rgya mtsho ste/ /byang chub snying po padmo'i chagadan la bzhugs / /chos dbyings rgya chen thams cad kun bkang ste/ /spu rnams kun la rnam par 'phrul pa ston/ /zhing rnams re re dag na rab bzhugs shing / /zhing rnams 'byam (noklas kun tu rgyas mdzad pas/ /phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i sprin gyi rnams/ /kun kyang snying po byang chub drung du 'dong / /zhing rnams kun gyi rdul phran mchog snyed kyi/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'od/ /sangs rgyas kyi niloga'akhor du nye bar 'dong / /chos dbyings 'byam 56 klas rtag tu rgyas par 'gengs/ /zhing rnams thams cad gzugs brnyan rab tu ston/ /chos dbyings rdul rnams ye shes spyod yul can/ /kun kyang bzang po'i spyod la rab tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor du yang dag byung ske/ /byang chub sems dpa' ye shes mchog yul can/ / sangs rgyas mchos sprin nyan cing rab tu mkhasasakyi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor rnams kun na gnas / /zhing rnams kun tu bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod/ /rgya mtsho'i tshechos la rnam par snang bar spyod/ /de dag rgyal ba'i sa rnams rgya mtshor bzhugasanyurte/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams gzhanas/stodang gzhan byung hurteb/ /de dag smon lam rgya mtshor rab tu 'jug /sangs rgyas yon tan legs parwanyergya mtsho dang / /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa 14de dag shes/ /sangs rgyas chos kyitsodabyings rnams kun bkang zhing / /35—174

de dag rnamanye'aphrul rgya chen kun la zhugs/ /zhing rnams kun gyi rdul phran mang snyed kyi/ /lus kyi sprin ni rtag par rab tu ston/ /sems can kun bkang 'od kyis kun la skyob/ /bsam pa yid bzhin chos kyi char yang 'bebs/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dpal padmo rnam par lta ba'i rgyal mtshan gyis/sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas ye shes shin tu zab/ /dus rnams kun tu de 'byung ste/ /chos dbyings thugs su chud pas na/ /'jig rten mgon zhes rab tu brjod/ /yang dag dusasangs rgyas chos kyi sku/ /'dres pa med cing gnas pa med/ /sems can thams cad yid57bzhin du/ /gzugs kyi skur yang rab tu mthong / /chos rnams thams cad mngon sangs rgyas/ /chos rnams kun la rab tu zhugs / /thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs//zhing rnams kun na rnam par mdzes/ /kha dog bsam gyis mi khyab par/ /sems can thams cad yid bzhin du/ /sems can mchog gi 'od rnams dang / /de bzhin sku yi sprin kyang mthong / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dag las/ /mi zad sangs rgyas sprul pa 2rnams/ /zhing rnams kun tu rab sgrog cing / /chos kyi rgya mtsho shin tu ston/ /spu rnams re re kun nas kyang / /phyogs bcur 'od zer dra ba dag /sangs rgyas gsung ni rab 'byin cing / /gdul dka'achu)thams cad rnam par 'dul/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer sgopa rnams nas/ /sgra dbyangs zab mo rtag tu 'byung / /sangs rgyas yon tan rgya mtsho ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i0)spyod yul lo/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo dag /mtha' dang dbus7med rab tu bskorahu sna/ /ye shes zab mo 31shes bya ba/ /rgya che 32phyogs su 35—175

rab tu ston/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad du/ /rnam par 'phrul pa gzhan dang7)gzhan/ /chos kyi dbyings rnams kun bkang zhing / /yang dag sangs rgyas ston pa mdzad/ /sku rnams re re kun nas7kyang / /zhing rnams kun gyi rdul mnyam paral/ /sangs rgyas sems can mnyam phyung zhing / /rnam par 'phrul pa rab tu ston/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyisematsho rnam par snang ba'i blo gros kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te / de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /chos kyi dbyings rnams kun khyab par/ /sangs rgyas sku ni rnam par mdzes/ /rgya chen gsung ni rang byung ba/ /zhing rnams rgya mtshor shin tu sgrog /'jig rten thams cad kun 'jug par/ /'jig rten mgon po shin tu mdzes/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam mkhyen cing / /byin gyi rlabs ni rab tu ston/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten kun la mngon(de)rka/ /sems can thams cad bsam pa bzhin/ /thams cad gzigs pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad mthong / /mtha' yas 'od mnga' sangs rgyas sprin/ /chos rnams rgya mcho'i 'brug kyang sgrog /ye shes rnamakhurgyu'i tshul bzhin du/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams de la 'jug /'jug pa rnams la 'byung ba med/ /'byung ba yod pa7rnam par bstan/ /gang la sangs rgyas bzhugs pa yi/ /chos rnamasashe'abyung ba nam mkha' bzhin/ /'pho dang gnas pa mi mnga' ste/ /'on kyang rgyal ba kun na snang / /sangs rgyas chos kyi dbyings las byung / /de phyir sangs rgyas rab tu brjod/ /yul na bzhugs med rang bzhin med/ /de la 'byung ba mi mnga' ste/ /sku dang mtshan kyang de bzhin med//rgyal ba tsogazugs brnyan 'dra ba 'o/ /'gro ba kun tu chos kyi sprin/ /bsam pa 35—176

kun la rab tu byungatu/ /yang dag sangs rgyas rnams7kun tu/ /sems can rgya mtsho 'dul ba mdzad/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad kyi/ /snying po byang chub kun na snang / / 'khod pa'i⑧rgya mtsho thams cad na/ /zhing rnams kun gyis rnam par mdzes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku dag la/ /yon tan rgya mtsho zad mi shes/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas te/ /de dag yon tan zad pa med//de nas byang chub sems dpa' spos 'od 'phro ba'i rgyan zla ba'isnyi'od kyis sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyisakyiphyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /bsam gyis myi khyab sangs rgyas sar/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang bzhugs pa/ /de dang de dag sangs rgyas kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnamasa'aphrul thams cad mthong / /ye shes lus kyis7zhugs pa rnams/ /zhing kun rdul gyi sbubs su yang / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / /bdag nyid lus kyang der mthong ngo / /gzugs brnyan zhing rnams thams cad dang ske/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyan sngar 'byung / /kun tu byin gyi rlabs rnams dang ske/ /rnam par 'phrul pa rab tu ston/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa gang gis rnam sbyangs pa/ /de dag zhing rnams thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rnam 'phrul mthong / /kun tu mnyam pal)nyid gyur cing / /kun tu lus kyis rab gnas te/ /ye shes kun gyi7rjes song na(nye/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul zhugasalgepa 'o/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zhugs pa7rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings la rnam par mdzes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi skukhedag tu/ /rgya mtsho'i zhing la rab tu 'jug /sangs rgyas kun gyi snyeng〈 phredag tu/ /byin gyi rlabs rnams rab bstan pas/ /gzhan dang gzhan gyirwanyelus ngag dang / /ming gis kun na7)rab 35—177

tu gnas/ /byang chub snying por rnam 'phrul dang / /byang chub mngon par 'tshang rgya zhing / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dag /skad cig sems kyis ston pa0)byed/ /zhing rnams 'byamadza klas thams cad dang / /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas dag /byang chub sems dpa' mnyam gzhagasho)rnams/ /skad cig sems kyis zhesarnam par ston/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams thams cad na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas sku la rnam spyod52kyang / /mtha' ma rnyed par myi rung ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' seng ge yi'od zer snang ba'i mthus ④'byin pa'i blo gros kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyisal/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor⑨/ /chos dbyings tshul rnams thams cad kyang / /sangs rgyas sprin gyis mngon du yog /'jig rten khams rnams rgya mtsho dgayo ) /phyogs bcu kun na gang yod pa / /thams cad kun tu 'khor lo 'khor/ /de ni smon lam rnam par nyunye'aphrul pa'o / /'khor rnams rgya mtsho rgya che ba/ /gzhan dang gzhan gyirwarteming dag gis/ /zhing rnams gnas pa kun tu yang / /chos kyi 'khor lo kun tu 'khor/ /rnam par snang mdzad byin hu rlabs kyis8/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho kun tu yang / /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dag /brjod 8cing zhing rnams kun tu 'byung / /zhing kun rdul la sku yi rnams/ /thams cad chos rabarka9rab tu 'bebs/ /'dres pa med cing 'byung ba med/ /'jig rten dag na rnam par mdzes/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med par/ /zhing kun rdul phran sbubs nya snadag tu/ /rnam par snang ba mdzad pa'i gsung / /sngon gyi spyod pa rab tu sgrog /zhing rnams thams cad 35—178

rdul snyed kyi/ /'od zer dra ba phyogs bcu na/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer kun sgo nas / /byang chub mchog phyir sems can 'dul/ /kun tu ma 'dres sku dag gis / /chos dbyings yongs su rab gsal te/ /'gro rnams 'dul ba ji bzhin dul/ /gzugs kyi skusheyang rab tu mthong / /dus gsum zhing rnams thams cad kyi / /mgon po ji snyed bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyi mtshan kyang sgrog /sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul la ltos/ /da ltar byungs(kyedang 'das pa dang / /sangs rgyas gang rnams ma byon pa/ /de dag kun gyi bsam yas pa chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu grag /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi yon tan gyi rimimadzod mi zad pa'i dpal gyi gzi brjid mar mes byasangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras sol/ /gang gis byang chub sems dpa' yige/ /ye shes tshogs 'di kun non cing ske/ /ye shes rtogs pa rnyed pa yirnams/ /de dag 'di yi tshul la zhugasame/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbyangs/ /zhing rnams kun tu rab tu 'byung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyod yul te/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ched du brjod/ /skad cig re re'i sems kun la/ /chos kyi dbyings su rnam par rgyu/ /de bzhin nyid la gnas shing rten6)/ /chos rnams rgya mtsho kun la zhugs/ /rgyan gyi pha rol phyin pa rnams/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sku dag dang7/ /zhing rnams kun na gnas shing spyod/ /rdul rnams re re'i steng ⑩ nas kyang / /chos rnams kun ni rab tu 'byung / /zhing rnams kun kyang khyab par byed/ /ye shes chags med spyod yul lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyod yul du/ / las pas37med par kun bkang zhing / /rnam par 'phrul 35—179

pa'i rnam spyod7pas/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul rnams la zhugs②/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rjes snyegs dbyangs/ /chos kyi dbyings ni rab sgrog pa/ /chos dbyings rjes su shes pa7rnams/ /dbyangs kyi rgya mtsho rnams la spyod/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor ma 'dres par/ /sgra dang dbyangs rnams shin tu sgrog /dus rnams thams cad shesalgepas gsal/ /dbyangs kyi de dag sa la zhugs/ /sgra yi shes la rmongs pa myed/ /sems can sgra yang spyod yul te/ /thams cad mkhyen pa kun gyi yang / /rnam par 'phrul pa'i dbyangs shes so/ /sa nas sar yang phyin gyur cing / /stobs kyi sa la rab gnas te/ /bskal pa bye bar sbyangs pasakyin / /chos nyid 'di la rab tu 'jug /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ye shes kyi 'od zer shes rab kun nas sgron ma'i blo gros kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gang la sangs rgyas bzhugs pa yi/ /chos rnams de dag mtshan nyid myed/ /ye shes sa ni thob pa7rnams/ /'jig rten gtso bo rab tu mthong //shes rab snang ba'i kun 'od can/ /byang chub sems dpa' mnyam gzhag ⑨rnams / /sangs rgyas thams cad kun gyi yang / /sku yi rnam par 'phrul la zhugs / /chos kyi dbyings la rnam spyad7 cing / /lus kyi dngos la rab 'jug ste / /zab mo'i chos rnams rtogs gyur nas/ /smon lam dag gis yang dag byung ske/ /bsod nams rgya mtshos byung gyur cing / /ye shes sa la rnam par gnas / /chos la rnam spyod khong du chud/ /spyod pa'i mchog la rab tu spyod/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi drung dag tu/ /chos kyi dbyings la spyad pas na/ /rang bzhin lus ni rab tu mthong / /zhing 35—180

rnams 'byamanyeklas thams cad du/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i chos kyi rnams/ /rgya mtsho kun la rab tu spyod/ /bdag mthong bas ni lus dang rdul/ /gcig tu 'dres pakshimangon par byas/ /ma skyes mtshan nyid med pa ste/ /zhing rnams kun tu'ang rnam par mdzes/ /'jig rten kun gyi bsam mthun parani/ /sems can kun la mngon sum du/ /lus kyi sprin ni bstan byas shing / /byang chub don du sems can 'dul/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mthu yis ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' brjod pa ste/ /gang gis mgon po mthong ba yi/ /rgyal ba'i byin rlabs shin tu zab/ /mgon po ji snyed gang bzhugs pa'i/ /byin rlabs mtha' dang dbus med de/ /chos dbyings rab tu gang byas nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam 'tshang rgya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' me tog kun nas 'od 'phro dugatsug phud rab tu 'phyang bas/sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /zhing rnams kun tu sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor sgra 'byin te/ /chos kyi dbyings rnams gang byas nas/ /yon tan sprin ni rab tu brjodabya/ /yang dag sangs rgyas chos kyi sku/ /rnam dgashenam mkha' 'dra ba ste/ /gzugs kyi sku yang rab ston cing / /chos nyid 'di la shin tu 'jug /dga' dang mos pa'i shugs rnams dang / /sangs rgyas stobs rnams thams cad la/ /rab tu gnas shing de dag ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes 'jug /shes rab chung5)ngus chos 'di dag /kun nas shes par mi nus te/ /ye shes mig ni rnamatshwa)sbyangs shing / /'di yi tshul la 'jug par 'gyur/ /rab tu gnas dang byin rlabs dang〈nye/ /chos kun rnam 35—181

par spyad pa dang / /rab tu 'jug dang ldang ba yo33/ /mnyam pa nyid la rab tu zhugs/ /chos rnams mtha' yas klongatshagegi rnams/ /chos kun mtshan nyid rnams la ste / /kun mkhyen nyid la rab zhugs shing / /chos kyi rgya mtsho kun la spyod / /sangs rgyas zhing na kun 'khod cing / /thams cad kun na rnam par mdzes / / 'ongs pa ri med cing 'phos pa med/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid de 'dra 'o / /gzugs brnyan 'dra ba'i sku rnams ni/ /sems can rgya mtsho'i nang na snang ske/ /mos pa ci 'dra yod pa (5)rnams/ /de bzhin mgon po kun gyis mthong ne/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa mang po sus sbyangs pa//de dag thams cad ba spu la'ang / /rnam 'phrul gzhan dang gzhan dag mthong / /lus kyi rnams ni re res kyang / /chos kyi dbyings rnams kun tu khyab/ /'khor lo kun na 'khor ba ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bsam mi khyab/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer dang gzi brjid mi zad pa'i rgyal po'i ①blo gros kyisal/sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas sku ni thams cad nas/ /'od zer sprin mang phyogs rnams bcur/ /kha dog mtha' yas 'bar ba'i 'od/ /sems can bsams3pa kun la 'phro/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams thams cad kyi/ /snying po byang chub kun na bzhugs/ /bdud rnams thams cad rab btul te/ /'khor gyi nang na rnam par mdzes/ /thams cad rdul na'ang tsom 'dres par/ /'od zer dkyil 'khor rgyas par 'gengs/ /phyogs rnams gzhan dang gzhan lam du/ /zhing gi rgyud rnams rab tu ston/ /zhing gi rnams ni rgya mtsho'i klong〈gle//phyogs kyi rnams kyang kun tu gnon/ /zhing rnams thang chen mnyam zhing dag /35—182

ind+ra nī spyilar kun nas gnas/ /spyi'u tshugs dag dang snrel zhi ②dang / /padmo'i dbyibs dang khyad ③khyad dang / /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i khyad par du/ /gzugs rnams kun gyis rab tu gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings rnams gar phyin par//thubasrepa myed par gram bdal7ba/ /de dag kun gyi 'khor rnams su/ /shin tu bstan pa'i chos 'byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dbyings na/ / 'khod pa'i zhuzhing rnams bsam myi khyab/ /de dag kun tu chos nyid 'di/ /'jig rten mgon po rnams kyang ston/ /tha dad med pa'i chos kyi dbyings/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu 'khor/ /tshigashegi tshul gyi rnam pa yis/ /chos bstan pa ni kun tu 'byung / /sangs rgyas gsung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /tshul rnams bsam cing nirab tu brjodame/ /dad pa rgya mtsho'i tshul dag gis/ /mi zad tshul rnams rab tu bstanayi/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams kun na yang / /rgyal ba rnams ni myig yor 'dra(te/ /snying po byang chub rnams na hu)snang / /'byung ba dag kyang yod pa myin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings su 'od 'phro ba'i (1dernam par snang ba'i 'byung ba7blo gros kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ snyide'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras sol/ /blta zhing blta zhing sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gzugs bsam gyis myi khyab ste / /dga' ba rgya mtsho kun kyang 'byung / /chos kyi shugs ni rab tu 'phel/ /mtshan rab kun nas sangs rgyas rnams/ /phyogs bcu kun tu rab tu 'byung / /rdul rnams kun tu 'jug pa yitsho/ /sangs rgyas sprin kyang de bzhin bstan/ /skad cig skad cig sems kun la/ /sangs rgyas 'od ni dpal gyis 'bar/ /rnam 'phrul gzhan dang gzhan dag gis/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho kun na snang / /35—183

byang chub sems dpa' shes rab che/ /rgya mtsho'i chos la byungatub rnams/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /'di yi yul la rnam par spyod/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la/ /gang rnams shin tu gnas gyur pa/ /de dang de rnams zhing dag tu/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul kun la bltakhya/ /ye shes zab mo rnamatsha gnon cing / /chos kyi dbyings la gzhol ba ni/ /mos pa rgya mtsho shes pa ste / /smon lam kun gyis byung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku dang gsung / /chags pa med la rab tu zhugs/ /spyod pa gzhan dang gzhan dag gis/ /spyod yul kun kyang khong du chud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gnas shing / /ye shes spyod yul gyur pasarnams/ /chos kyi dbyings la rab brtson pa/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sa gnon to/ /skad cig sems kyis zhing gi rnams/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi rdul mnyam pa/ /de dag chos nyid ji bzhin du/ /rdul gcigasnyisteng du rnam par spyod / /zhing rnams ji snyed thams cad niX/ /zhing gi rnam 'phrul gang yod pa/ /chos nyid 'di la zhugs pashernams/ /zhing gcig gtu ni sdud pa byed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' stobs dang brtson 'grus chags pa myed pa'i blo gros kyis/sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas7te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho thams cad du/ /de dag gsung ni zab mo 'byung / /dbyangs kyi yan lag kun rgyas pa/ /chos kyi sprin gyi char 'bebs so/ /brjod pa rgya mtsho thams cad kyis(nya/ /sems can kun gyi skad dag tu/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams kun tu yang / /chos rnams bstan pa rab tu 'byung / /zhing rnams kun tu ma lus par/ /sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul mthong zhing / /sangs rgyas gsung rnams thos pa dang / /byang 35—184

chub mchog phyir kun kyang 'jug /rdul rnams re re'i steng nas kyang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi phyogs tshul gyis/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams kun bkang zhing / /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul ston pa byed/ /chos kyi sku ni tha dad min/ /nam mkha' bzhin te chags pa med/ /gzugs kyi skur ni rnam dmyigs pa/ /mig yor snang ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /myig yor yul la mi gnas tehu)/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dngos po myed/ /mnyam pa nyid 'di rtogs gyur nas/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mthong bar 'gyural/ /sangs rgyas sku ni ma skyes te/ /gzung ba med cing 'byung snob med/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid dang mtshungs/ /gzung du myed las〈pe'adi bstan to/ /zhing rnams kun gyikyisangs rgyas rnams/ /de dag spu gcig rtse la tshogs/ /ye shes myig dang ldan pa yis/ /spu rnams kun tu rnam 'phrul mthong | /rnam par snang ba'ishesmon lam ste/ /chos kyi dbyings ni kun bkangadzas zhing / /bla med chos kyi 'khor lo dag /zhing rnams kun na rtag tu 'khor/ /ji snyed7bskal pa bsam yas par/ /spu rtse gcig5nye tu rnam sprul pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bshad mdzad kyang / /de yi mtha' ni rnyed par dka'aphonya/ /ji ltar gling bzhi pa 'dir de bzhin gshegs pas rnam par sprul pa'i snying po byang chub tu phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'dus par gyur pa de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i gling bzhirwartepa thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa re rer yang / de bzhin gshegs pas rnam par sprul pa'i snying po byang chub dag tu byang chub sems dpa' phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bye ba'i hu rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kun nas 'dus par gyur to/ /'di na ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi snying po byang chub de bzhin gshegs pas 35—185

rnam par sprul pa dag tu/ kun nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang ske/ chos nyid 'di kho 7)na rab tu ston to/ /kyede bzhin gshegs pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // ride nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po seng ge'i khri padmo'i snying po can de nyid la 'dug ste/de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'i snying po zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song ba'i rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par brtags ༅pa'i tshogs/ nam mkha'i dbyings na brdal ba cimed cing rgya che ba khyab par byed pa'i rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings rgya mtsho'i klong ri rimanyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song rtsizhing shin tu brdal ba'ishetshogs chos thams cad kyi sgo'i keting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor yang dag par 'byung bas rgyas par 'gengs pa/ phyogs thams cad du yang dag par zhugs pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi lus kyis kun nas yog par byas pa'i rang bzhin gyi snying po can dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i ye shes snang ba/ rgya mtsho'i klong tshephyogs thams cad du sgo kun nas tshul rgya mtsho rnam par rig par bya bas mngon tu yang dag par ston pa/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs dang rnam par thar pas byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi lus rgyas par 'gengs pa'i snying po can/ zhing 'byam 3)klas pa thams cad ma lus par chos kyi dbyings su 'jug pas rgyas par 'gengs pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgya mtsho thams cad yongs su grub par 35—186

byed pa bskal pa thams cad du smon lam rgya mtshos rnam par snang bar byed pa'i 'od can①/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo ston cing brjod7pa'i byin gyi rlabs la mnyam par bzhagate③par gyur to/ /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi drung du byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di la mnyam par bzhag pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam braklas pa chos kyi dbyings kyis ra klas pa nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs ④pa/ phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad kyi khongs su gtogs pa/ dus gsum thams cad na yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byung ba'i khams chos kyi dbyings rgya chen pos non pa'i risatsos gtogs pa shin tu phra zhing sgrib ⑧pa myed pa yidang / phyogs rgya chen po rgya mtsho thams cad snang ba 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i ris su gtogs pas rnam par gnon dzo )pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyis51 rnam par gzigs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs thogs pa myed pas chud pa/ chos kyi dbyings dang nyugesangs rgyas kyi sku thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan rab tu snang ba1nye/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rdul ma lus pa kun tu gtogs pa/ chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad du rgyas par gang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba dang mnyam pa dag tu rdul phra mo re re la'ang / zhing 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bordul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu zhugs nas zhing re re zhing yang de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa 12re re'i zhabs kyi drung du yang lus 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 35—187

kyil / ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di la mnyam par bzhag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'i snying po zhes bya ba de la mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes la/ de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byam (miklas pa thams cad nas de bzhin gshegs pa ④thams cad kyis zhal bstanasato/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis 'di skad ces kyang bka' stsal te⑤/ rigs kyi bu khyod de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku'i snying po 'di la mnyam par gzhog pa7legs so legs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras ༷khyod la phyogs ⑧bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad 'di'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi byin gyi rlabs dang / khyod kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam dang ske/ spyod pa7)yongs su dag pa'i mthus 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho thams cad kyi tunyernam par dbye ba dang / chos thams cad kyi tshul gyi ⑫phyogs rgya mtsho ma lus par snang bar bya ba dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang〈nyeb dang / chags pa med par 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam7klas pa thams cad yongs su gnananepa dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad la chags pa myed par 'jug par bya ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor thams cad sgo kun nas rab tu brjod pa dang /35—188

chos kyi0tshul gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la zhugs pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su bzung ②ba dang / chos kyi snang ba thams cad kyi tshul rnam par bltakhub dang / sems can gyi dbang po rgya mtsho thams cad yongs su shes par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi yan lag rgya mtsho'i dbyangs duyongs su bzung ⑤ba'i phyir byin gyis rlob pa mdzad do/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi stobs la rab tu 'jug pa'i ye shes kyang nye bar bsgrubs so/ /chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa la rab tu 'jug pa'i ye shes kyang nye bar bsgrubasasheso/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad yang dag par 'byung ba'i ye shes kyang nye bar bsgrubs so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad 'jig pa dang / 'du ba'i ye shes kyang nye bar bsgrubs so/ /chos kyi dbyings 'byamalleklas pa mtha' dang dbus7skyed pa'i ye shes kyang nye bar bsgrubs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa zab mo tha myi dad pa dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad la rnam par gnas pa'i ye shes kyang nye bar bsgrubs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho la rab tu 'jug pa'i ye shes kyang nye bar bsgrubs so/ /sems can thams cad kyi skad rgya mtsho dang chos kyi 'khor lo7tenges pa'i tshig gi ye shes kyang nye bar bsgrubs so/ /'jig rten gyi khams mang po thams cad kyi rjes su song zhing chos kyi dbyings thams cad du lus yang dag par gzhol ba'i sems7kyang nye bar bsgrubs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi yan lag dang sgra dang dbyangs kyang nye bar bsgrubs so/ /ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams 35—189

'di'i 1bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi drung na 'dug pa la nye bar bsgrubs pa de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par bkang ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag dang rdul shin tu phra ba'i khongs ②na lus 'khod pa thams cad la yang nye bar bsgrubs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin de nyid kyi chosamaganyid thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis/phyag g.yas pa mtshan dang dpe byad ④bzang pos rnam par mdzes par brgyan pa/'od zer gyi 55)dra ba'i me tog sna tshogs shin tu rgyas pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i sprin 'gyed pa/ rin po che 'od 'phro ba thams cad kyi sprin gyis 56)rnam par gsal bar gyur pa/ phyogs thams cad du spos4)'od 'phro ba'i sprin gyi 'od kyis rnam par snang ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi yan lag gi dkyil 'khor gyi rjes su sgra 'byin pa dnga'age/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba yang dag par ston pa/byang chub sems dpa' 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba rnarmes kyi kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyi dkyil 'khor rab tu snang ba rnam par ston pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo'i snang ba yang dag par ston pa/ dus gsum gyishede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan 'byung ba rnams brkyang ste3 )/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyi bor /1bzhag go/ /'dir ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad dang rdul shin tu phra ba'i khongs na yod pa thams cad du yang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi drung dag tu byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang 35—190

po'i spyi bo la phyag rgya mtsho'i sprin rnams rab tu bzhag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis/ reg ma thag tu de nas ①de'i mod la ting nge 'dzin de las ldang ba'i sgo rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed/ dus gsum thams cad du sems kyi skad cig re re la/ ting nge 'dzin las ldang ba'i ye shes ma 'dres pa la mkhas pa dang ting nge 'dzin las ldang ba'i byin gyis rlabs kyi sgo chos kyi dbyings dang ske/ dus gsumatsamanyam pasathams cad kyi sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad kyi sgo dang /sems can ma lus pa'i gnas thams cad dang / mnyam zhing sems can thams cad kyi sems rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i sgo dang / sems can thams cad kyi lus dang ske/ ming gi 'khor lo las ldang ba'i sgo dang / ③phyogs dang 6)mtshams thams cad du chos kyi dbyings rnam par 'byed pa'i sgo dang / rdul shin tu phra ba thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi sku'i sprin mtha' dang dbus ⑦skyed par 'byam 78)klas pa'i sgo dang / chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad rab tu bstan pa'i sgo dag nas langs par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po ting nge 'dzin de 9 las langs ma thag tu/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang so so re re zhing ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu zhugs par gyur to/ /gzungs rgya mtsho'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la yang rab tu zhugs par gyur to/ /chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la yang rab tu zhugs par gyur to/ / tha dad pa lke/nyayang dag par shes nyi pa'i tshul rgya 35—191

tu grags par gyur7te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor〈rgya mtsho thams cad du yang / nor bu'i rgyal po chen po7bcu'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab par gyur tedu / bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste nor bu'i rgyal po mtshan dang ldan pa'i gser dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi0dpal gyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /'di lta ste nor bu'i rgyal po 'od kyis rnam par gsal bar byed pa'i sprin gyi7char mngon par bab po/ /'di lta ste nor bu'i rgyal po phyogs bcur rin po che'i 'khor lo rab tu 'gremasalgepa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /'di lta ste nor bu'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan rin po che'i snying po'i yo)sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /'di lta ste nor bu'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan gyi khamasacarab tu sgrog pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /'di lta ste nor bu'i rgyal po zhing rnam par snang bar byed cing snying po byang chub tu dpal rab tu 'bar ba'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /'di lta ste nor bu'i rgyal po phyogs bcur snang ba'i sprul pa 'gyed pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /'di lta ste nor bu'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yon tan gyi 'khor lo dang mthu rab tu gragasarwaskrepar byed pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab po /'di lta ste nor bu'i rgyal po nyi ma'i dpal gyi gzi brjid kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab po/ /'di lta ste nor bu'i rgyal po rol mo'i sgra yid du 'ong bas phyogs thams cad khyab par byed pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab ste/ nor bu'i rgyal po'i sprin gyi char bcu po 'di dag mngon par bab par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang 'od zer gyi sgo thams cad nas kyang tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag byung bar gyur to/ /zhing rnams 'byamacha35—193

klas kun na kun tu bzang po de①/ / dbang po57yid du 'ong la rab tu 'jugasnyepa mthong / /kun tu rnam 'phrul rnam parasre'adi 'dra ston par byedabu/ /ting 'dzin yul la 'jug pa mtha' dang dbus myed do/ /lus rnams thams cad nas kyang kun tu bzang po de/ /sprul pa rab tu 'gyed cing chos dbyings rtag par 'gengs/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi tshul dang mying dang rnam 'phrul pa/ /thams cad dbyangs kyis chags pa skyed par ⑦rgya che sgrog /ting 'dzin thams cad gzhan dang gzhan gyi rnam 'phrul lagyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhabs kyi drung dag tu/ /rgyal ba kun gyi spyod yu la yangs pa gang byas te/ /zhing rnams kun tu rnam par 'phrul pa mang po ston/ /zhing kun rgyal ba kun gyi zhabs drung ji bzhin tu/ /de ltar zhing kun shin tu phra ba'i rdul phran la/ /ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad ma lus ston/ /rnam par snang mdzad smon lam dbyings la rab tu zhugs/ /kun tu bzang po'i lus ni nam mkha'i mtshan nyid do / /thams cad zhing la mi gnas de bzhin nyid la gnas/ /lus kyi sprin ni 'gro ba kun dang mnyam par kun bkye zhing / /sems can kun la bsam pa bzhin du de dag ston/ /sangs rgyas skushernams kun la53 zhing rnams gang yod pal/ /mtha' dang dbus7)myed kun la rab tu zhugs pa rnams/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gnas pa dag la bstan/ /rnam par 'phrul pa 'di 'dra dam pa tshad kyang med/ /'khor rnams rgya mtsho rdul phran mtha' dang dbus7skyed pa/ /tshad myed thams cad lus kyi nang du kun tshud〈nyecing / /dbyingasachal zhing mang dra bar rnam 'tshang rgya ba ston/ /skad cig sems la bskal pa mang po de bzhin ston / /zhing rnams thams cad 'byamanyeklas pa na rnam grags shing / /rnam 35—194

par 'phrul pa dam pa ston7par rab tu snang / /phyogs rnams kun gyi zhing gi dbyings rnams ma lus spyod②/ /kun tu bzang po de la rnam lta kun kyang mthong /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan ye shes stobs la zhugs/ /ting 'dzin sa ni tshul rnams kun gyis rab tu mnan①/ /chos rnams 'byam7klas gzhan dang gzhan la rab tu zhugs/ /rang gi byang chub spyod pas ⑤sngon cad spyad ⑥pa ston/ /de ltar zhing rnams kun tu bsam yas rnam 'phrul pa/ /phyogs rnams rgya che kun tu bkang ste rab tu bstanasti/ /ting ⑧'dzin rnams la sti'ajug pa rab tu bstan pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i 'od zer sprin las yon tan legs57skra 'byung / /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor yod pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mthus thal mo sbyar te/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la lta zhing dbyangasarwa1kyi nga ro gcig tu de'i tshe tshigs5)su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rgyal ba thams cad chos las skyes pa stekho/ /smon lam kun gyis sangs rgyas rab tu byung / /de bzhin nyid mnyam nam mkha'i snying po ste/ /chos kyi sku yis rnam par rab tu mdzes / /zhing rnams 'byamanyeklas kun la bzhugs myed kyang / /kun tu bzang po'i 'khor rnams kun na snang / /phyogs bcu kun tu yon tan grag pasatshwanyekhyab//ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu snang balgemanga'/ /rgyal ba thams cad sku thob phyir spyod pa / /phyogs bcu'i yon tan rgya mtsho yod pa'itshwa 7rnams/ /rdul sbubs kun tu de dag chud byas shing / /zhing5)rnams kun tu rnam par rab tu mdzes/ /zhing rnams kun gyi rgyal ba'i zhabs drung na/ /rgyal sras ting nge 'dzin dang spyad tu)pa dang ske/ /chos rnams kun la spyod cing gnas pa'i ( )rnams/ /rdul dang mnyam pa'i bskal par kun kyang snang / /chos kyi dbyings rnams lus kyis du nyekhyab 35—195

byas shing / /zhing rnams 'byamanyeklas kun la shin tu zhugasal/ /sems can rgya mtsho'i don du de spyod cing / /rdul phran kun la chos kyi dbyings su zhugs/ /chos kyi dbyings la de7ltar zhugs nas kyang / /rdul phran kun la mi zad tha mi dad/ /nam mkha'i dbyings ni lus kyisakhugang byas shing / /rgyal ba'i chos rnams yangs pa rab tu ston/ /yon tan rgya mtsho 'od kun gzhal du med/ /rnam yangs stobs chen 'od zer yon tan sprin/ /'gro ba rgya mtsho'i don du spyod byed cing / /rgyal ba'i spyod lam gzhal du med pa ston/ /gang gi don tu bskal pa rgya mtsho dag /mtha' yas par ni bzang po'i spyod spyad pa/ /de dag chos kyi dbyings rnams gang byas nas/ /thams cad chos kyi sprin las rab tu brjod/ /zhing rnams ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / /stobs bcu rnams kyang ji ltar 'byung 'gyur dang / /sems can rgya mtsho ji ltar 'byung 'gyur ba/ /sems can rnams la sgra dbyangs gtong zhing ston/ /'khor rnams yongasalgepa 'di dag thams cad kyang / /kun tu bzang po khyod la mngon sum gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gyeganang bar 'gyur ba yin⑦/ /chos kyi 'khor lo de ring khyod kyis bskorani / /⑨thun tu bzang po'i ting nge 'dzin dang rnam par 'phrul pa rab tu byung ba zhes bya batshwanyeste le'u gsum pa'o(nye// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi tunyerlabs kyis/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la rnam par bltas/ sems can gyi khams rgya mtsho la rnam par bltas/ chos kyi dbyings rgya mtsho la rnam par bltas/ci sems can thams cad kyi las rgya mtsho la rnam par bltas/ sems 35—196

can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang dbang po rgya mtsho la rnam par bltas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi rgya mtsho la rnam par bltas/ dus rgya mtsho la rnam par bltas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yang dag par 'byung ba'i smon lam rgya mtsho la rnam par bltas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho la rnam par bltas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' ①'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yod pa thams cad la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'du zhing 'jig⑧pa yongs su dag pa 'byung ba'i ye shes ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sems can thams cad kyi ③las 'byung ba rgya mtsho mkhyen pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad la rnam par gnas pa'i ye shes ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho thams cad mtha' dang dbus ⑤skyed par bstan pa'i ye shes ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sems can thams cad kyi las rgya mtsho rnam par dgod pa'i ye shes ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bsam pa dang / dad pa dang dbang po rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i ye shes ni bsam gyis myi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kyisasheskad cig gcig la dus thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid thugs su chud pa'i ye shes ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho yang dag par bstan pa'i ye shes nisnyibasam gyis myi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 35—197

kyi chos kyi 1)'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i ye shes ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rnam par dgod7pa rab tu bstan pa rgya mtsho ni bsam gyisam zhesamyi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rimasku rab tu bstan pa yongs su dag pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbusasnyeskyed pas rnam par snang ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasalgernams kyi mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po 9)yongs su dag pa ni bsam gyis nimyi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa mtha' yas pa ni bsam gyis myi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'od zer rgya mtsho kha dog sna tshogs kyi sprin rab tu dgye balgemadzad pa ni bsam gyis myi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi dpal rin po che 'phro ba'i rgya mtsho rnam par rgyu ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang dbyangs rgya mtsho rab tu 'grub pa ni bsam gyis myi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum yongs su bstan pas sems can rgya mtsho yongs su smin par mdzad pa dang / 'dul (1ba mdzad pa ni bsam gyis 8mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gdul nyunyeb rgya mtsho thams cad la brtson pa don yod pa ni bsam gyis ④mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi sa la rab tu bzhugasalgepa ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la 'jug pa ni bsam gyis 8mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byin gyi rlabs 35—198

kyi mthu ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi spyod yul rnam par rgyu ba ni bsam gyis7mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi stobs la thub pa myed pa ni bsam gyis ②mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mi bsnyengs pa zil gyis mikhunon pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzinasatha mi dad par spyod pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa ni bsam gyis gamyi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mnga' bshechen po'i ye shes rnam par dag pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos mi 'phrogs 1)pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab stenya / de dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis byin du brlabs tu)pas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rgya mtsho la gzung ba dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho la rab tu dgod nyurtepa dang /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan7pa dang / bskal pa rgya mtsho thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung rjes su bstsabatshwanyepa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsholathams cad du chos kyi rang bzhin gyis tunyedakyil 'khor rab tu brjod pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dad pa rgya mtsho tha dad pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu bstan pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho la sangs rgyas kyi chos5)tshul kun tu snang ba yang dag par bskyed pa dang / sems can 35—199

thams cad kyi bsam pa rgya mtsho'i sgrib pa'i ri thams cad rnam par gzhom pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi ①sems dang spyod pa rgya mtsho la 'byung ba'i lam rnam par sbyang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i smon rgyalam rgya mtsho la rab tu dgod pa'i phyir yang dag par bstan par bya'o / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos 'khor gyi ③dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho rnams de bas kyang shin tu dga' dubar bya ba dang / chos la dga' ba'i shugs thams cad rnam par 'phel bar bya ba dang / mos pa'i tshul yangs pa rgya mtsho yang dag par 'byung bar bya ba dang chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang snying po sgo kun dang ldan pa rnam par dag par bya ba dang / kun tu bzang po'i smon lam rgya mtsho la rab tu dgod par bya ba dang / ye shes kyi myig dus 4)gsum gyi rjes su song ba yongs su sbyang ba dang / 'jig rten zothams cad kun nas snang bar byed pa'i snying po shes rab chen po'i rgya mtsho rnam par 'phel bar bya ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad yongs su bzung ba'i phyiragyel/ gzungs kyi stobs7yang dag par7bskyed pa dang / snying po byang chub tshe0thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad/ rab tu brjod pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa〈mechos kyi tshul snang ba'i 'od chos kyi dbyings rgya chen po dang /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la dga' ba'i shugs rgya mtsho rnam par 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bdun pa/8 yon tan rgya mtsho rnams kyi ye shes zab/ /mtha' dang dbus ⑫med des ni zhing rnams khyab/ /sems can bsam la sbyor ba ci7bzhin snang / /35—200

rnam par snang mdzad chos kyi 'khor lo'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rgya mchoXre zhing yod pa/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor rgyal bas rnam sbyangs pas6)/ /sems can rgya mtsho yongs su smin⑧bya'i phyir/ /sems can nang na rgyal ba rnam par mdzes sems can rgya mtsho 'byung ba bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas yul la 'jug pa shin tu zab/ /srid pa'i gnas can dad pa chung ba yis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub shes par myi nus so/ /gzhan du gang rnams shin tu sems brtan7cing / /dge ba'i bshes kyis yongs su bzungasheb dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyikhubyin gyis rlabs pa dag /sangs rgyas ye shes 'di la rab tu 'jug /gang rnams sems dag g.yo med sgyu myed cing / /snying rje'i semasapo)can khong nas byams dga' dang ske/ /dad pa che zhing rlabs chen de dag ni/ /'di dag thos shing dga' ba thob par 'gyur/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam sa dag dang / /chos dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings su khyab pa la/ /gnas shing spyad7pa rab tu sus spyod pa/ /de dag rgyal ba'i spyod yul de'ushes so/ /gang gis rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul 'di mthong ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'7thob bya legs par thob/ /gzhan gyi yul gyis7shes par myi nus te/ /'di ni kun tu bzang pos rtogs pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis byin brlabs shing / /'gro ba mtha' dang dbus〈nyemed 'di dag na/ /kun tu chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu 'khor(kye/ /rnam par snang mdzad yul dang mthu yin no/ /bdag gisalus su zhing rnams thams cad kyang / /rab tu zhugs shing de zhugs zhing rnams kun/ /de dag spu rtse kun tu blta bar gyis8 / /rgyal ba'i spyod yul shin tu bshad par bya/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam spyod pa rnams/ /mtha' dang dbus tshimed mngon par bsgrub pa dang / /35—201
