kun tu myig gi yul dang lus ldan pa/ /de dag mgon po'i spyod yul 'di nyid do3)ske/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag bcu po 'di dag ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho shin tu bstan snyepa ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba rnams kyis gsungs so gsung ngo gsung bar 'gyur ro//bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'byung ba'i tshogs kyi rgyu rkyen shin tu bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gnas pa shin tu bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i dbyibs snyudang rnam pa geshin tu bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i lhun shin tu bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rkyen shin tu bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgyargya mtsho yongs su dag par bya ba'i tshul shin tu bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag tu sangs rgyas 'byung ba shin tu bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bskal pa'i byin gyi rlabs shin tu bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste bskal pa mtha' yas pa'i rgyud rgya mtsho shin tu bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho tha mi dad pa shin tu bstan pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu po 'di dag la ⑥sogs pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho shin tu bstan brtson/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba rnams kyis rin)gsungs so/ /gsung ngo gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad ni rgyu dang rkyen la dmigs pa'i sgo 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed phrag 35—202

bcus byung7ngo / / 'byung ngo 'byungs bar 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang / chos (5)nyid rab tu thob pa dang ske/ sems can rnams kyi las kyi tshogs dang / byang chub sems dpa' 4)thams cad thams cad5snyemakhyen pa nyid du yang dag par sgrub pa'i chos nyid dang /sems can rnams kyis kyang byang chub sems dpa' dag dang / bsod nams kyi rtsa ba skal ba mthun ⑥pa bsags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhing yongs su dag pa'i smon lam gyi khyad rim par dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pas/ rnam par bsgrubs pa'i smon lam gyis mngon par bsgrubs〈khupa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mos pa'i dbang rnam par dag pa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'gengs pa 99)'jig rten las 'das pa dang / rgyu 'thun nyu )pas mngon par 'tshang rgya zhing sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa khyu mchog gi mthu dbyung 31ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po rnams kyi smon lam gyis rnam 32par 'phrul pa'i sgo'o12/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar rgyu dang rkyen la dmyigs pa'i sgo bcu po 'di dag la 1 stsogs pa rgyu dang rkyen la dmyigs pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyisnyi'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad byung ngo / /'byung 7ngo 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byung ba shin tu bstan pa 'di 1 nyid gsal bar brjod pa'i phyir / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas ye shes yul ni bsam yas pas/ /byin rlabs rnam 3she'aphrul de dag 'di lta bu/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho bstan pa mtha' dbus 16med/ /35wa 203

rnam par snang mdzad chos kyi7yongs su sbyangs/ /byang chub sems ni kun gyishebasam pa bzhin/ /smon lam rgya mtsho bsam yas rnam sbyangs shing / /sems can las rnams rgya mtsho bsam yas pas/ /phyogs kun zhing rnams rgya mtsho thams cad 'byung / /byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi rnam 'phrul dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 'jug pa'i sgos/ /smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad mngon bsgrubasalashing ske/ /nam mkha'i dbyings la 'byam klas zhing 'byung ngo / /spyod pa rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus ⑤skyed rnams/ /spyod cing tshad med bde gshegs yul la 'jug /phyogs kyi zhing rnams rgya mtsho kun sbyong zhing / /bskal pa mtha' yas zhing rnams re rer spyod/ /sems can bsam dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i//las kyi7zhing rnams rgya mtsho thams cad byung / /nyon mongs las kyis de dag nyon mongs bcas/ /mos dang bsam pas rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam dag rgyan can rnams/ /rin chen ⑤rgyus byung sna tshogs dri med pa/ /dad pa rgya mtsho rnam par spel ba'i phyir/ /rgyal sras rnams ni phyogs bcu'i ⑩zhing rnams spyod/ /chos dbyings rdul gyi khongs su rgyal sras rnams / /kun tu bzang po'i spyad pa spyodarwaskrepa dag /rdul〈nyegyi khongs su mtha' yas zhing ston te/ /rnam dag mkha' bzhin mtha' dang dbus7yang myed/ /nam mkha'i dbyings 'dra'i rnam 'phrul 'di 'dra ste/ /snying po byang chub rgyal ba'i zhabs drung na/ /padmo'i stan 'khod kha dogachamatha' yas kun/ /de dag zhing bcas lus kyi nang na 'khod/ /skad cig sems kyis7dus gsum byung ba yi/ /zhing 'byung tshul dang 'jug pa kun kyang ston/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dus gsum zhing bstan7pa/ /rnam par snang mdzad rgya mtsho'i zhing myi zad/ /tshul gyi 35—204

khyad7par mtha' yas sna tshogs pas/ /rdul rnams kun la mtha' yas rgyan gyis nornams / /sangs rgyas skad cig gcig gel byin gyis rlob/ /rgyan gyi5gernam pa tshul kun rab tu mkhyen/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la gnas pa shin tu bstan gyurapa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho re re zhing yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed de/ 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni rgyan thams cad kyi rgya mtsho kun la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nam mkha'i dbyings 3)kyi gnas la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni7rin po che thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od kyi7dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho la tsorab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog gi mdog 17la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbyings 12kyi dkyil 'khor la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni sgyu ma lta bu'i las kyiwobyung ba lha ma yin dang mthu bo che lta bu'i lag na rdo rje rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni 'jig rten gyi khamasalgedabang po thams cad kyi lus kyi gzugs brnyan rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi hunyekhams rgya mtsho la la ni byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lus rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyi77byung ba'i rgyan rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas te/ de dag la 32stsogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rab tu gnas pa shin tu hu bstan pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho re 35—205

re zhing yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho zhurab tu gnas pa shin tu bstan mipa'i don 'di ①nyid yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/sangs rgyas kyi mthus de'i tshe tshigs su bcad7pa 'di dag smras so/ /kun kyang zhing rnams rgya mtsho 'di dag rin chen rang bzhin dri myed pa/ /rnam dag sna tshogs nor bu kun 'bar 'od zer rgya mtsho'i 'od ldan ltos/ /'di dag rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 5rgyu yis dbyings ri7legs 'khor bar rnam par ⑦snang / /de dag gis ni phyogs bcu (2)nam mkha'i dbyings rnams gzhi kun rab tu khyab/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho la la dri myed 'od can nam mkha'i dbyings la gnas/ /snang ba'i snying po 'od can nor bu'i rgya mtsho dag la legs par gnas/ /'gro ba de dbus rgyal ba 'khor la chos kyi 'khor lo bzang po bskor5she༄/ /'di ni sangs rgyas yul yin sems can rgya chen shin tu mgu ba byedamu )pa'o/ /la la me tog sgron ma kun tu rgyas pa'i mu tig nor bus brgyan/ /'od zer dra ba'i kun nas sprin 'bar spos 1 'phro sprin gyi nyuge'od can te/ /zhing mang mtha' dang dbus hu med rgya chen padmo'i rgya mtsho dag la gnas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab brgyan mizhing rnams 'byam beklas kun kyang rab tu mdzes/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho dkyil 8'khor dbyings rnams la la sangs rgyas byinal la gnas/ /yangs shing rin chen mang ldan rgya chen de dag byang chub sems dpas nyusnyegang / /lag na rdo rje rgya mtsho mang tshogs lha dbang lus la de bzhin gnas/ /de nas nyu)bcom ldan du 7rnam par nurtasnang ba 2mdzad kyi 'khor lo 32rtag tu 'khor/ /nor bu'i shing dang spos kyi 'od ri byu 'phro'i sprin rnams mnyam pa'i dbyings la gnas/ /chu yi phung po dag dang rdo 35wa 206

rje'i ①rgya mtsho brtan la'ang de bzhin gnas/ /la la gos dang brag dang rgyal mtshan me tog⑧rgya chen⑧dag la gnas/ /kun na'ang rnam 'phrul 'di dag rgya chen rnam par snang mdzad ston pa mdzad/ /zhing rnams ring dang thung dang glingam4)gi gzugs dang rnam pa sna tshogs te(5)/ /sna tshogs rgyan can dugasnying po dri ma bral ba yongs dag dri med snang / /rnam pa sna tshogs de dag smon lam rgya mtsho'i dbyings la rab tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis kun nas yog par rtag tu nam mkha'i dbyings ⑦la gnas/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho 'byam 8)klas la la spyi'u tshugs yod dang med la gnas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i cod pan rin chen 'khor los bzung bas dag par gnas/ /de na 9)sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul rgya chen thams cad kun nas rab tu snang / /rin chen sangs rgyas gsung rnams kun tu gtong ldan las kyis de dag sprul/ /chos kyi dbyings mnyam zhing rnams 'byam nyi snaklas mig yor sgyu ma dang yang 'dra/ /mig 'phrul rnam phye rnam dag dri med sems kyis shin du bskyed pa ste/ /nam mkha'i dbyings rnams sna tshogs rgyan gyi snying po gnas 'gyur 'di la snang / /las kyi yul ni bsam gyis mi khyab 'di dag bde bar gshegs pas bstan/ /skad cig sems kyis zhing rnams 'byam nyanyaklas 'gro ba'i 8kun dang mnyam pa'i rnams/ /zhing rdul kun la kun tu bzang po rtag 3lhapar rab tu sgrub 7byed cing / /de na bskal pa rgya mtshor 'gro ba smin par bya phyir spyad pa spyod/ /chos dbyings rgyas par bkang ste de dag kun tu rnam 'phrul rgya chenalaston/ /rdul rnams kun na chos dbyings yangs pa'i zhing rnams rgya mtsho kun kyang gnas/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis byin gyis brlabs pas kun kyang yog cing yongs su rgyas/ /ji ltar rdul phran gcig la rnam 'phrul 9de bzhin 'gro ba 35—207

kun na'o/ /rnam par snang ba'i sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul rgya chen rab tu ston pa mdzad / /zhing rnams 'byam0)klas thams cad mig yor lta bu sgyu ma snyig rgyu 'dra/ /snang ba med cing 'byung med phyogs bcu dag na ⑤'gro dang 'ong ba med/ /mkha' la gnas pa de dag rtag par 'byung zhing 'jig par de bzhin 'gyur/ /shin tu yangs pa de dag smon lam rnam sbyangs las kyis7yongs su bzung / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho rnams kyi dbyibs ni rnam pa sna tshogs te/de)/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam 0klas pa la la ni kun nas zlum po'o⑦/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam ⑤klas pa la la ni kun nas gru bzhi'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam 0klas pa la la ni nam mkha'i rnam pa du mar rnam par phye ba'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam klas pa hu skul la ni kun nas 'khyil ba'i dbyibs su 'dug go/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam nyunyaklas pa la la ni 'od 'phro ba'i ri'inyedabyibs su 'dug go/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam tunyeklas pa la la ni shing sna tshogs kyi lhun gyi dbyibs su 'dug go/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byamasaklas pa la la ni me tog sna tshogs kyi dbyibs su 'dug gos/ /'jig rten gyi7khams rgya mtsho 'byam klas pa la la ni khyim tu sna tshogs kyi dbyibs su 'dug tunyego/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam ru )klas pa la la ni sems can sna tshogs kyi lus kyi dbyibs tesu 'dug go/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam5)klas pa la la ni mtshan sna tshogs kyi dbyibs su 'dug ste/ de dag la5)stsogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dbyibs shin tu bstan pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed do / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos 'jig rten gyi khams rgya 35—208

mtsho'i dbyibs kyi tshul rgyanyematsho 'di nyid yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshesamitshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rgya mcho'i zhing la ltos/ /rnam phye sna tshogs mtha' yas dbyibs su gnas/ /dbyibs kyis rnam par phye ba sna tshogs te/ /phyogs rnams kun nas gzhing rnams rgya mtsho snang / /la la zlum po la la zur gsumasreste/ /de dag la la phyogs nangasagru bzhir gnas/ /nor bu padmo 'khor lo'i yanakyilag brgyad/ /kun kyang las rnams rgya mtshos57rnam par bris / /rdul med 'od kyi dbyibs dang tshul 'dzin cing(3/ /gser las grub pa rnam phye sna tshogs te⑨/ /sgo mang mtha' yas pa nas〈 )rgyu zhing 'jug /las rnams rgya mtsho bsam pa dag pas gnas/ /zhing rnamasamanyargya mtsho sna tshogs snying po can/ /nam mkha' 'di la ji ltar sprin gnas bzhin/ /de dag rin chen mang zhing〈nyernam par phye/ /de dag kun na ‘/nyesangs rgyas rnam par mdzes/ /zhing rnams 'di kun sems kyis rnam par brtags/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang snang bas kun nasalgeganas/ /rnam par 'phrul pa gzhan dang gzhan dag gis/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas ston pa mdzad/ /bde dang sdug bsngal myong bar gyur pa ni/ /rnam par dag dang nyon mongs tshul bzhin te/ /chos nyid 'di ni rtag tu yod pa yin/ /de ltar las rnams rgya mtsho bsam mi khyab/ /skra gcig rtse la bsam gyis ⑩mi khyab cing ⑩/ /thams cad rdul med 6)sna tshogs dbyibs su gnas / /kun nasarwacesangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs/ /'khor rnams rgya mtshor 0chos rnams rab tu ston/ /rdul gcig rtse la phra dang yangs pa'i rnams / /thams cad rdul snyed kha dog kun dang ldan/ /kha dogs(stodabyibs 35—209

rnams kun kyang rnam par brtags/ /de dag kun na rgyal ba'i 'khor lo 'khoranyu)rka/ /rdul rnams kun la rab tu zhing bstan pa/ /de dag smon lam rnam par 'phrul chogepa yin/ /nam mkha'i dbyings52su las kyisaphusprul pa ni/ /sna tshogs sems dang bsam pas (57rnam par brtags/ /sems can kun mnyam rdul rnams thams cad la/ /sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul pa sprul pa dag /rnam par snang mdzad chos nyid de yin te/ /rdul phran7kun la zhing rnams shin tu gnasal/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i lhun dag ni gzhan dang gzhan du shes par bya (3)ste/ 'di57ltar 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni rin po che'i rgyun pa'o)thams cad kyi lhun can no7/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni hu1rin po che gcig las rnam pa sna tshogs su bkod pa'i rgyan gyi5)lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni rin po cherwanyethams cad kyi 'od zer gyi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni 'od kha dog sna tshogs kyi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni rgyan thams cad kyi mdog gi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams7rgya mtsho la la ni rdo rje'i gzhi mi shigs pa'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul dang byin gyi brlabs kyi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni rin po che'i mtshan nyid kyi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni sangs rgyas kyi 8sprul pa'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nyi ma'i nor bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni rin po che 9shin tu phra ba 'dzin pa'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni snang ba'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la 35—210

la ni rin po che0)thams cad kyi kha dog 'od 'phro ba'i rnam pa'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni dri dang kha dog sna tshogs kyi spos kyi lhun can no / /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni rin po che ci thams cad kyi me tog codamogyepan gyi lhun can〈geno/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni rin po che thams cad kyi 'od kyi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni rgyan thams cad shin tu bstan phyepa'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni sems kyi rnam par rtog pa skad cig gcig 46)gis dmyigs pa thams cad yongs su bstan pa'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi rin po che'i dbyibs kyi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni rin po che thams cad kyi me tog gis57ze ba'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 48)la la ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung dbyangs rnam par dmigs pa'i lhun〈)can no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i lhun shin tu bstan pa rgya mtsho 'di nyid la rab tu huX gzud par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 3lhaphyogs bcur rnam par bltas tenyu2/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras sol/ /zhing gi rgya mtsho rnams la ni12/ /rin chen rang bzhin kun nas gnas/ /rdo rje bzhin du mi shigs sra/ /rin chen padmo rnams la gnas/ /la la 'od zer rang bzhin te/ /dag cing gzung med 'od zer 'byung / /rgyan rnams kun gyi 'od zer gyis/ /sna tshogs mkha' bzhin dri ma med/ /la la 'od kyi rang bzhin te / /dag cing 'od gsal gzer pil gnas/ /'od kyi sprin can sna tshogs 'odal/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gnas/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho la la ni/ /35—211

mig yor lta bur gnas pa ste/ /brjod du med cing gzung du med/ /smon lam dbang gis7rab tu byung / /la la nor bu mu tig rgyu/ /snying po thams cad rnam par 'bar/ /mu tig 'khor lo'i gzhiphudag la/ /byang chub sems dpa'aphuyongs su gang / /rin chen 'od 'phro byung ba'i zhing / /'od 'phro'i sprin gyis mngon khebs shing / /rin chen thams cad sna tshogs ldan/ /thams cad las kyi4)sprul pa yin/ /la la mtshan las byung ba ste/ /gzhi7kun mtshan gyis kun tu bris/ /cod pan rnam pa sna tshogs bkod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mngon par sprul/ /rgya mtsho'ikyisems las byung ba yi/ /zhing rnams mos pa nyid la gnas/ /yul na mi gnas sgyushem bzhin/ /yongs su rtog pas yang dag bskyedaXte / /sangs rgyas sku yi 'od zer gyis/ /nor bu7sna tshogs kun tu gnas / /sangs rgyas sprin rnams rnam par snang / /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab sprul nas/rte/ /la la kun tu bzang po yis/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho shin tu sprul/ /nam mkha'i rgyan rnams thams cad dang / /smon lam rnams kyis7rnam par bris / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rgyan shin tu bstan pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du shes par bya ste/ 'di ltar dmyigs pa'i7rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad kyi sprin rab tu 'phros pa'i rgyan tsodang / 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yon tan gyi 'khor lo rjes su brjod cing rab tu byung〈nyeba'i rgyan dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gtogs tunyepa'i sems can rnams kyi ⑥ rnam par smin pa rgya mtsho las rab tu byung ba'i rgyan dang / 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam rgya mtsho'i glong (7yongs su ston pa'i rgyan dang /35—212

'di lta ste dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzugs brnyanatusna tshogs rnam par dmigs pa'i rgyan dang / 'di lta ste sems kyi skad cig rgyal bskal pa mtha' yas par rnam par 'phrul pa'i yul yongs su ston pa'i rgyan dang / 'di lta ste rgyan gyikhudamigs pa thams cad lasakyisangs rgyas kyi sku rab tu byungasnyiba'i rgyan dang / 'di lta ste rin po che dang spos thams cad kyi sprin rab tu 'byung ba'i rgyan dang / 'di lta ste snying po byang chub kyi rgyan dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi ⑦rnam par ston pa'i rgyan dang / 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang / spyod pa yongs su ston pa'i rgyan dag ste/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag la stsogs pa'i ⑧'jig rten gyi khams rgya mcho'i rgyan shin tu bstan pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rgyan shin tu bstan pa 'di nyid yongs su bstanamatho)pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rgya che mtha' yas te/ /rnam dag las kyisarwa)rnam pa sna tshogs gnas/ /phyogs bzhirwartezhing rnams rgya mtsho rnams kun kyang / /sna tshogs rgyan can yangs par kun nas gnas/ /kha dog sna tshogs yangs pa'i zhing gi rnams/ /rgya mtsho rtag par phyogs rnams kun tu 'byung ske/ /rgyan dang rin chen 'od 'phro sna tshogs sprin/ /sgra 'byin zhing gi dbyings7rnams khebs par byed/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan rgya mtsho rnams / /de dag kun kyang rgya mtsho'i zhing na grags(ste/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang smon lam sprin gyi rnams/ /de dag zhing mang rgya mtshor sgra yang 'byin/ /'gro 35—213

ba'i las rnams rgya mtsho yangs pa dag /rgyan gyi sprin rnams kun nas sgrar 'byin te / /sems can de dag rnam sbyin ci0)'dra ba/ /sangs rgyas byin gyis kun nas sgra yang sgrog /dus gsum 'byungalceba'i de bzhin gshegs pa yis③ /rnam 'phrul zhing rnams rgya mtsho kun na snang / /dmigs pa re re la yang sangs rgyas kun/ /de 'dra'i zhing mang rgya mtsho'i rgyan la ltos/ /'das pa'i bskal pa de bzhin ma 'ongs dang / /phyogs bcu'i da ltar 'byung ba5geji snyed pa'i/ /bskal pa de dag rgyan mang yangs pa yang / /zhing rnams rgya mtsho re re dag na snang ske/ /dmigs pa kun la sangs rgyas sprin gyi rnams/ /'gro dang mnyam pas 'jig rten kun tu 'gengs/ /rnam par 'phrul zhing sems can rnam par 'dul//'di ni zhing rnams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar to/ /spos 'od sprin dang de bzhin me tog klung snye/ /rgyan rnams sna tshogs thams cad kun nas kyang / /rtag par kun tu khyab par rab tu 'byung / /'di ni zhing rnams rgya mtsho'i rnam thar to④/ /phyogs bcu kun gyi snying po byang chub rnams/ /sna tshogs rgyan can kun kyang ma lus par/ /thams cad rgya mtsho'i zhing 'di dbyingasashedag na/ /nam mkha'i sprin bzhin rnam par ston pa snang / /rgyal sras kun tu bzang po thams cad kyi/ /zhing rnams mtha' yas 'byam ⑤klas rgyan gyi rnams/ /'gro ba'i grangs snyed bskal pa rgya mtshor rnam 59)sbyangs pa/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho kun na rab tu snang //kye rgyal ba'i huḥsras dag 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho yongs su dag par bya ba'i tshul rgya mtsho ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du shes par bya ste/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la bsten hu pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas skal ba hunyemanyam pa dang / byang chub 35—214

sems dpa' rnams kyi chos kyi ①dbyings kyi bsod nams rgya chen po'i sprin rnam par 'phel bar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mos pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya chen po rnam par dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rab tu brtan pa'i yul la rnam par spyod pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / yongs su sbyangs pa chadang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad kyi dbyings la rab tu 'god (bcing gzud pa'i rnam par spyod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa dang ske/ 'byung ba rgya mtsho la rnam par spyod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad mngon par bsgrub byapa rnam par dag pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyan55)rgya mtsho thams cad mngon par bsgrub ⑥pa rnam par dag pa la rab tu 'jug pa dang / 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs kyi tshul yang dag par bsgrub73)pa rnam par dag pa dang ske/ de dag lakhustsogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho yongs su dag par bya ba'i tshul rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mcho1re rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du shes par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho yongs su dag par bya ba'i tshul rgya mtsho 'di nyid rnam par bstanapo)pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 7phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tsherwa)tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /zhing hurtenams rgya mtsho thams cad sna tshogs rgyan/ /smon lam tshul rnams rgya mtsho kun gyis byung / /kha dog mtha' yas las kyi rgya mtsho dag /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rtag tu 'od mang 'gyed/ /sngan 35—215

cad dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur cing / / bskal patumanyam pa'i las dge yongs sbyangs te/ /snying rje byams pas dgongs50yangs kun bkangasazhing / /zhing rnams rgya mtsho yangs pa 'di kun sbyangs/ /chos sgo kun tu ting 'dzin sa kun gyis④/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rgya mtsho yangs0sbyangs te/ /bsam gtan tshul dang rnam thar sa sbyang zhing ⑥/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho sna tshogs yangs pa byung ske/ /mos pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas stobs bskyed cing / /rgyal ba'i mnyam nyid ma nor rtogs byas nas/ /bzod pa rgya mtsho'i tshul rnams yongs sbyangs shing / /rnam dag kha dog mtha' yas zhing rnams byung / /bsod nams sprin ni nam mkha' mnyam bskyed cing / /'gro ba kun phan bde don spyod spyad de//bsod nams rgya mtsho sems can kun bstan pas/ /'jig rten khams rnamasashergya mtsho kun kyang 'byung / /zhing rnams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed tshad med pa'i/ /pha rol phyin pa ma lus kun sbyangs te/ /smon lam mthar phyin mi zad goms byasalgepas / /dri med rgya mtsho'i zhing rnams yangs pa7'byung / /'byung ba'i spyod pa gang yod tshad med dang / /chos rnams thams cad yangs pa yongs sbyangs te/ /sna tshogs thabs sgos sems can sbyangs pas na/ /'di 'dra yid 'ong rgya mtsho'i zhing rnams 'byung / /rgyan rnams kun gyi tshul dang sa sbyangs shing / /rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho kun zhugs nas/ /'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal mtsho bskams pas(1 / /zhing gi mtsho yangs 'di kun dag7par 'gyur/ /stobs rnams rgya mtsho gzhal 8med yongs sbyangs shing / /'gro ba 'di 'dra tshad med rnams ⑫sbyangs te/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yangs7kun bsnyen bkur bas/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam mang rnam par dag /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi 35—216

khams rgya mtsho re rer sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i tshul rgya mtsho ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du shes par bya ste/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas 'byung ba la la ni sku chung7ngur kun tu ston to/ /'di lta ste sangs rgyas 'byung ba la la ni chos kyi dbyings thams cad gzugs kyi skus gang bar ston to/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba la la ni sku tshe'i tshad mi ring ngoshe/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba la la ni sku tshe'i tshadakhuring ngo / /sangs rgyas 'byung ba la la ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcigasnyiyongs su dag par byin gyis rlob po/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba la la ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad yongs su dag par byin gyis rlob po/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba la la ni tshul gcig gis bstan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo byin gyis rlob po/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba la la ni tshul bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo byin gyis rlob po/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba la la ni sems can gyi khams nyung ngu rnam par gdul ba byin gyis rlob po/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba la la ni sems can rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa rnam par gdul ba byin gyis rlob ste/ de dag la dusogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho re rer sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i tshul rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du shes par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang9)sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i tshul rgya mtsho'i phyogs 'di nyid yongs su bstan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi (7byin gyi rlabs kyis7phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rgyal ba 'byung ba thabs rnamasal 3sna tshogs kyi/ /sgo nas zhing rnams rgya mtshor rab tu 'byung / /de dag sems can bsam pa ji bzhin mkhyen//sangs rgyas thabs kyi sgo mang rgya mcho'iro/ /sangs rgyas chos sku (1bsam gyis myi 35—217

khyab ste/ /mig ①yor ma yin mtshan nyid med pa'i gzugs/ /gzugs kyi khyad par 'gro ba 'di dag tu/ /sems can bsam pa'i phyogs bzhin ston la ltos/ /sku tshe thung bar la la rnam par ston/ /la la bskal pa tsobasam yas byin gyis rlob / /chos kyi sku ni phyogs rnams kun gyi sgo/ /rab tu mdzes par 'gro ba 'di na zhe /bzhugs/ /la la zhing rnams rgya mtsho bsam yas dag / sbyong zhing 'byamachaklas phyogs bcu kun na yang / /la la zhing gcig rnam par sbyong bsnyemadzad/ /smon lam ma lus kun kyang tshul gcig go/ /la la bsam gyis mi khyab theg pa'i rgyan / /sems can yid bzhin sangs rgyas ston pa mdzad/ /la la theg pa gcig kyang rab ston te/ /rgyal ba'i thabs ni gcig7kyang mtha' yas so/ /rang byung la la byang chub sangs rgyas nas/ /sems can mi mngakhulam la gzhog pa mdzad/ /la la skad cig rinaXgacig gis sems can rnams/ /rgya mtsho bsam yas byang chub don du 'dul/ /la la spu yi sgo nas bsam yas pa'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sprin rnams rab tu 'gyed/ /'gro ba kun tu de dag mngon bkang zhing ske/ /thabs kyi sgo nas sems can 'dul ba mdzad/ /la la sangs rgyas gsung gis kun bkang zhing / /zhing du sems can yid bzhin rab tu sgrog /bsam yas bskal par pa'ide dag gsung sgrog cing / /sems can rgya mtsho mtha' yas rnam par 'dul/ /la la zhing rgyan 1— ribasam gyis mi khyab ste/ /'khor rnams yang 11dag kun nas 'khod /rtebacas pas/ /zhing mang rgya mtsho phyogs su gang byas shing ske/ /sangs rgyas mkha' la sprin ltar khyab par bzhugs/ /de ltar sangs rgyas thabs ni bsam mi khyab/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho kun tu rgyas bkang zhing / /'gro ba kun la sangs rgyas mngon sum ste/ /sna tshogs rgyan mang du ma'i tshul dang 35—218

ldan / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mcho'i bskal pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi tshul shin tu bstan pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul 3shin tu phra ba snyed du shes par bya ste/ 'di ltar zhing rgya mtsho la la ni bskalam pa grangs med par byin gyis brlabs pa'oge/ /zhing rgya mtsho la la ni bskal pa tshad med par byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /zhing rgya mtsho la la ni bskal (3)pa dpag tu med par byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /zhing rgya mtsho la la ni bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab par byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /zhing rgya mtsho la la ni bskal pa mtshungs pa med par byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /zhing rgya mtsho la la nisko2bskal pa kun nas mtha' yas par byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /zhing rgya mtsho la la ni bskal pa kun nas mu med par byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /zhing rgya mtsho la la ni bskal pa gzhalashone du med par byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /zhing rgya mtsho la la ni bskal pa brjod du med par byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ de dag laphaperdzogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bskal pa〈byin gyis rlabs kyi tshul7)shin tu bstan pa rgya mtsho ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bskal pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyi tshul shin tu bstan7pa 'di nyid yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'jig rten rgya mtsho'i 31bskal pa tha dad de/ /sna tshogs tshul 'jug rgyan rnams gzhan dang gzhan/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams rgya mtsho kun na snang / /bskal 32pa'i tshul ni rgya mtsho grangs kyang med/ /bskal pa mi mthun 'gro ba kun dang mnyam/ /phyogs dbyings 'jig rten rgya mtsho'i nyarte35—219

khams na snang / /bskal pa mtha' yas la la ring dang thungatu/ /bskal pa sna tshogs rgyal ba'i sgras kyang bsgrags/ /rgya mchoXre zhing rnams 'di dag phyogs dbyings snang / /byin rlabs bskal pa zhing rdul snyed dang ldan/ /la la gzhan rnams bskal ②pa gcig gis 'jug /la la bskal ①grangs smon lam du mas byung | /bskal pa la la dri med la la7nyon mongs can/ /la la rnam dag la lasanyon mongs rnam par dag /bskal pa'i ming ni smon lam rgya mtsho'i tshul gyis byung ske/ /sems can 'du shes rnam pas tha dad tshul la 'jug /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed sngon cad spyod spyad pasal/ /'jig rten khams rnams rgya mtsho shin tu yangs shing dag /de dag kun nas sangs rgyas yul rgyan tshad kyang med/ /'di dag rgya chen bskal pa'i 'jig rten rgya mtsho'i khams/ /bskal pa'i 'od dang 'od zer rin chen ming sna tshogs/ /bcom ldan dbyangasashedang 'od mnyam 'od 'phro'i mig snang ba/ /snang dang dri med bzang po bskal pa'i ming la 'jug /bskal pa 'di dag rnam dag7bskal pa kun las byung / /dri med bskal pa la lar sangs rgyas gcig skye'o/ /bskal pa la ⑩lar mi yi gtso bo mtha' yas 'byung ske/ / bskal pa'i hu)tshul rnams thams cad sa tshul zad mi shes/ /smon lam stobs mthus bskal pa sna tshogs 'jug par 'gyur/ /bskal pa la la mtha' yas rnams kyang bskal pa hurtegacig tu 'dus/ /bskal pa la la gcig kyang bskal parwanyebye ba'i mthu8/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho kun kyang sna tshogs sgo nas 'jug /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi nang nas sgra yang 'byin/ /bskal pa la lar bskal7pa kun gyi rkyenasakyang 'byung / /ming gi rgyan rnams rnam par dag pa'ang de la yod/ /bskal pa la la sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul mthu yis 'byungatso/ /bskal 35—220

pa'i tshul rnams kun gyi 'di ni rgyan yangs yin/ /zhing dang bskal pa rgya mtsho tshul ni gcig gis dag /zhing gi rdul rnams kun kyang tshad med gzhal du med/ /skad cig yud tsam nyi ma'i grangs kyis0)bskal par 'gyur/ /'di dag thams cad sems can 'du shes rnam par byung〈khu/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bskal pasamatha' yas pa'i rgyud kyi tshul rgya mtsho ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dusashes par bya ste/ 'di ltar chos nyid rab tu thob pas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag bskal pas 'jig cing 'du ba la rab tu 'jug par gnas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtshor gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pas bskal pa mtha' yas pa kun nas gnas pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtshor gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi bsod nams rgya mtsho rgya chen po stsogs ⑦pa rnam par dag pas ⑧'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho kun nas nyon mongs la rnam par dag par gnas pa dang / 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa' mos pa sna tshogs kyi spyod pa rnams skye bas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho rnam par dag la kun nas nyon mongs par gnas pa dang / 'di lta ste sems can rgya mtsho rgya chen po byang chub kyi sems la gnas pas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho shin du dag par gnas pa dang /'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang gzhan du 'dod pas bskal pa rgyan tha dad pa'i tshul du gnas pa dang 'di lta ste/phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtshor 'dus pas bskal pa mtha' yas pa rgyan shin tu mang por kun nas hu )gnas pa dang /'di lta ste de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bsarwate'ajig rten gyi 35—221

khams rgya mtsho dag gi rgyan nub par 'gyur ba dang / 'di lta ste sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho rnams0)rgyan gyis brgyan par kun nas gnas pa dang / 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par 'phrul pas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bskal pa mtha' yas pa ②yongs su dag par gnas pa dang ske/ de dag la5)stsogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bskalasnyipa rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa'i rgyud kyi tshul rgya mtsho ⑤kun nas gnas pa'i tshul ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'im4)rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du shes par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bskal pa mtha' yas pa'i tshul rgya mtsho 'di nyid yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi ༄8narlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho'i chos nyid 'di dag ltos/ /chos kyis rtsonabyung ste ji ltar gnas pa ltar/ /de dag 'byung zhing 'jig7par 'gyur ba hunyeyang ske/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho thams cad rab tu snang / /sems can nyon mongs mi zad /2ldan pa dang / /las dang nyon mongs ngan pas bsgribasalgepa'i rnams/ /de dag bsam la zhing gi rgya mtsho rnams/ /kun nas nyon mongs ldan par gyur pa yin / /sems /༄can rnam dag bsam pa ldan rnams dang / /bsod nams 8brtan dang rnam dag spyod yul can/ /rnam dag yul la nyon mongs ldan gyur rnams / /de dag mos pa sna tshogs spyod yul gyi/ /byang chub sems dpa' skye ba'i dus dag na/ /bskal pa de ni rnam par dag par snang / /sems can nyon mongs ldan par gyur pa yang / /de yi chos nyid bsam yas yangs pa yi/ /byang chub bsam pa ji ltar bskyed pa dang / /de dag bsam pa ji ltar rnam ma'aphel 35—222

bas / /de bzhin bskal pa rgya mtsho mang po dag /bsam gyis mi khyab zhing rgyan yongs su sbyong / /bye ba mang po mtha' yas mi zad0)pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyogs bcu kun rgyu yang / /rgyan la rnam pa tha dad yod pa min/ /bskal pa tha dad tshul gyi bye brag〈snang / /rdul rnams re re sbubs su dus kun tu/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi rdul dang mnyam pa yi/ /rgyal sras ji tshul 'dod pa de bzhin du / /zhing rnams7rgya mtsho de tshul dag par 'gyur(pe/ /gal te rgyal ba rnams ni skyer 'gyur na/ /zhing rnams rgyan gyis sne)shin tu brgyan par 'gyur/ /bsam pa yongs su dag bzhin rgyas 'gyur te/ /'di na52)zhing rgyan phun sum tshogs pa'ol/ /gal te rgyal ba mya ngan 'das gyur na1)/ /de tshe de zhing rgyan rnams 'grib par 'gyur/ /sems can rnams kyang snod du rung brdzo min/ /zhing gi rgya mtsho de yang nyon mongs ldan/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul rnam 'phrul yangs pa dag /bsam gyis mi khyab gang tshe ston pa na/ /de tshe zhing rnams rgya mtsho mang po dag /kun kyang rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan 31par 'gyur/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho tha myi dad pa'i tshul ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du shes par bya ste/ de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis〈shegasungs so/ /gsung ngo gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ni 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gcig 1)tu 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mcho1re rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams tha mi dad pa dang / 'di lta ste/'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag tu sangs rgyas skye zhing 'byung ba tha mi dad pa dang 'di lta ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag gi snying po byang chub thams 35—223

cad nas chos kyi dbyings kyi7phyogs rgyas par 'gengs pa tha mi dad pa dang 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag gi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor tha mi dad pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag gi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tha mi dad pa dang / 'di lta ste〈'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag tu sangs rgyas thams cadasakyi sprul pa'i sprin dang / mtshan gyi 'khor lo tha mi dad pa dang 'di lta ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor bskalasnyepa mtha' yas par brjod cing rgyas par bya ba'i byin gyi rlabs tha mi dad pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag tu chos kyi 'khor lo'i tshul tha mi dad pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag tu rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad yongs su 'du ba tha mi dad pa dang / 'di lta ste 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag tu rdul 'byam ⑤klas pa thams cad la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi yul rgya chen po ston cing brjod7pa tha mi dad pa dag ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag las༄stsogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho tha mi dad pa'i tshul 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phrasheb snyed du shes par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho tha mi 3) dad pa'i tshul rgya mtshorwaskreshin tu bstan pa 'di nyid gsal7bar bstan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas tunyete/de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rdul gcig steng na zhing mang rgya mtsho ste/ /kun na rgyan mang rnam dag kun yod kyang / /gnod pa med cing 'dra 35—224

ba gang yang med/ /'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab 'di la ltos/ /rdul rnams kun la bsam yas sangs rgyas bzhugs①/ /sems can kun gyi bsam pa yid bzhin du/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho thams cad khyab byas kyang / /de dag thabs la tha dad gang yang med/ /rdul rnams kun la shing dbang mtha' yas pa sna tshogs rgyan phyung kun nas bres sbyangs7te/ /phyogs rnams kun gyi zhing du mngon bkang yang / /de dag tha dad 'gyur ba nam yang med/ /rdul phran rgya mtsho rdul phran re re la/ /mi yi gtso bo 'khor rnams7kun bskor cing / /'jig rten kun tu bkang ste 'phags bzhugs kyang / /gnod pa dag dang 'drashiba'i nyes pa medarjo/ /rdul gcigakyil ni mtha' yas 'od kyi sprin/ /phyogs bcu'i7zhing rnams rgya mtsho kun bkang zhing / /bde gshegs rnams kyi byang chub spyod bstan kyang ske/ /rgya mtsho'i zhing rnams tha dad gang yang med/ /rdul rnams kun la kha dog bsam mi khyab/ /sprul pa'i sprin gyis kun tu gang byas te/ /sangs rgyas sprul pas sems can rnamasnye'adul yang / /'byam tso)klas phyogs na tha dad gang yang med/ /rdul rnams kun la rgya mtsho'i chos brjod detshi/ /de dag 'khor lo 3metshul bzhin 'khor mdzad cing / /thabs dang mthu yi sgo mo sna tshogs kyis/ /thams cad brjod kyang7de la tha dad med/ /rdul gcig la ni rgyal ba kun gyirwanyegasung ske/ /'gro ba snod du gyur la de dag brjod byas temi/ /rgya mtsho'i zhing du bskal par byin brlabs7kyang / /de dag gsung gi yan lag tha mi dad/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho mtha' yas rgyan gyi rnams/ /thams cad rdul sbubs gcig tu rab tu 'dzud/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu la ltos/ /las kyi dngos las de dag skyes pa min/ /rdul gcig la ni dus gsum rgyal ba dag /ji ltar byung 35—225

ba de dag thams cad snang / /de dag gshegs dang byon pa gang yang med/ /'gro ba kun nas 1)sangs rgyas rnam ②par 'phrul/ /ga'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho shin tu bstan pa'i phyogs gsal bar bya ba yang dag par bsgrubasalgepa zhes bya57ste le'u bzhi pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/⑥ bam po brgyad pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gegyis brgyan pa 'di/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/bskal pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis niyongs su dag par byas teshes/ bskal pa re re zhing yang de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi zhabs kyi drung du/ smon lam rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis ⑩yongs su dag par byas so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho (tegazhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa de ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed sna kyis shin tu bzung ba ste/ de la rlung gi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'og ma ni gzhi kun nas rton (nyepa zhes bya ste/ rin po che thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba 'bar bas brgyan pa'i gzhis rtonatsha8to/ /de'i steng na rlung gi dkyil 'khor rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan 'byung ba zhes bya ba yod de/ nor bu'i rgyal po 'od rnam par dag pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi gzhis rton to/ /de'i steng na rlung gi dkyil 'khor rin po che'i mthu zhes bya ba yod de/ rin po che thams 35—226

cad kyi dril bu'i gzhis rton0)to/ /de'i steng na rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'od 'phro ba mnyam par ston⑧pa zhes bya ba yod de/ nor bu'i rgyal po nyi ma snang ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi 'khor lo'i gzhis rton57to/ /de'i steng na rlung gi dkyil 'khor rgyana'agekun nas rnam par bres pa zhes bya ba yod de(5)/ 'od zer gyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi me tog gi gzhis rton yito/ /de'i steng na rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhi kun nas dri ma med cing yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba yod de/ me tog thams cad 'od ⑦'phro ba'i seng ge'i khri'i gzhis rton 6)to/ /de'i steng na rlung gi dkyil 'khor phyogs su sgra sgrog cing kun tu rgyu ba zhes bya ba yod de/ mu tig dang man shel gyi rgyal mtshan sna tshogs kyi gzhis rton tsheto/ /de'i steng na rlung gi dkyil 'khor rin po che thams cad 'dzin pa zhes bya ba yod de/ nor bu'i rgyal po'i shing dang me tog sna tshogs kyi glong gi gzhis rton huXto/ /de'i steng na rlung gi dkyil 'khor kun nas 'dzin pa'i shugs shes bya ba yod de/ sposamu kyi nor bu thams cad kyi ri rab kyi sprin gyi gzhis rton 3nyeto/ /de'i steng na rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyitswakhyim kun tu rgyu ba zhes bya ba yod de/ rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog dang spos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyi gzhis rton snagato/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag rlung gi dkyil 'khor ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed de dag thams cad kyi steng ma ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzi brjid bzang po dpal gyi snying po zhes bya ste/ nor bu kun nas snang ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i spos kyi chu rgya mtsho'i gzhis rton to/ /spos kyi chu rgya mtsho nor bu kun nas snang ba'i gzhis brgyan pa'i snying po zhes bya ba de las padmo chen po spos 7kyi rgyal mtshan khyer ba'i 'od zer dang ze ba sna tshogs shes bya ba mngon par byung 12ste/ padmo chen po de la 'jig rten gyi 35—227

khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa7kun nas gru bzhir 'dug pa rnam par dag pa shin tu brtan pa rdo rje dang nor bu thams cad kyi khor yug gisaphubaskor ba/ rim gyisalgegazhol bar gnas pa shing gi rgyudakyirgya mtsho sa la rab tu gnas pa 'di du'adug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi ⑥rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di nyid kyi yon tan rgya mtsho yongs su dag pa'i phyogs 'di nyid brjod pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te / de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gzhi rgyan me tog 'jig rten khams kyi rgya mtsho del/ /rin chen kun gyi snying po kha dog sna tshogs te④/ /rdul rnams kun dang mnyam pa'i sngan cad sangs rgyas kyil/ /drung du sngon tshe rgya mtshor sbyangs pas dri med pa(nya/ /rgya chen snying rje'i sprin gyis khams rnams kun bkang zhing / /zhing gi rdul dang mnyam pa'i lus kyang kun btang nas/ /sngon gyi bskal ⑩pa rgya mtshor spyod pa spyad pas na/ /'jig rten rgya mtsho'i khams de yangs shing rnam par dag /sangs rgyas rnam par snang bas smon lam che mdzad detunye/ /'od snang btang ba mkha'isnyidekyil na gnas pa ni/ /rlung gi phung pos btab kyang mi bskyod 8mi g.yo ste/ /nor bu kun rgyan tsosangs rgyas gzugs brnyan snying po'o⑩/ /me tog mdzod bkye gtor ba rin chen7yid 'ong bzhin/ /sngon gyi smon lam dbang gis mkha'i dbyings la gnas/ /rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnams thams cad sna tshogs brtan )par gnas/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun tu 'od kyi sprin kyang gtong te/ /nor bu thams cad sgo nas byang chub sems dpa'i rnams(nye/ /byung zhing 'od zer sprin 'bar phyogs rnams kun tu gtong / /35—228

'od zer me tog tshon dang 'od zer 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /phyogs rnams ma lus kun gyi chos dbyings khyab par byed/ /rin chen kun gyitu'od zer sprin rnams bkye ba ni/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun gyi zhing rnams khyab par byed/ /sdug⑧bsngal thams cad bcil zhing byang chub mchog la bgrodag/ /'jig rten rgya mtsho thams cad 'od 'phro durab tu 'bar/ /'gro ba kun dang mnyam pa'i sprul pa sna tshogs rnams/ /rin chen kun dang spu rnams kun nas rgyal ba 'gyed//brgya byin dag dang tshangs pa'angasnyi'akhor lo sgyur7'dra dang / /'gro ba kun gyi lus su lus rnams kun kyang gnas/ /sprul pas 'od bkye chos kyi dbyings kyi tshad mnyam pa/ /'od zer sgo nas sangs rgyas thams cad mtshan kyang sgrog⑦ /'gro ba mnyelus kun gyi bsam pa tshim byas nas/ /tshul rnams sna tshogs sgo nas sems can rnam par 'dul/ /'jig rten rgya mtsho me tog snying po de nang na/ /rdul phran kun gyi khongs na chos dbyings thams cad kyi/ /rin chen 'od kyi ⑨sangs rgyas sprin rnams 'bar bar snang / /rnam par snang mdzad chos dbyings rnam 'phrul ⑩zhing la ltos/ /bskal ba rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bstsal (tebyas te/ /smon lam yangs pa'i sprin ni chos kyi dbyings mnyam dang / /bzang po spyod pa brnyes7shing ye shes sa ldan pa'i/ /dgongs pa las ni rgyan mdzes de dag byung ba yin/ /8'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan7pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho yongs su dag pas snang ba zhes bya7nyeste/le'u lnga pa'o// //kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me 35—229

tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i 'khor ①yug chen po ni nor bu'i ②rgyal po padmo nyi ma'i gzhi la brtena'akhyab ste/ nor bu'i rigs rgya mtsho spos kyi tsandan thams cad las grub pa/ nor bu'i rgyal po rgyan gyi yul thams cad kyis lhun shin tu 'phags shing zil gyis gnon pa nor bu ④sgos zhim po gzi brjid kyi 'khor lo rnam par snang ba'i snying po can/ nor bu'i rgyal posardo rje sra zhing mi shigs0pa ltar shin tu mkhregs gshing sra ba rin po che'i chu thams cad kun nas 'byung ba rin po che'i shing gi nags tshal gyi rgyan thams cad me tog shin tu rgyas pa/ spos kyi rtsi mchog bzang po thams cad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ spos kyi me tog dpal can shin tu bzang bas rnam par brgyan pa/ nor bu'i rgyal po 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi dbyibs rin)lta bu'i dra bas kun nas bres pa ste/ de dag lashestsogs pa rgyan bzang po'i rnam pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis nyu norab tu brgyan pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang khor 31yug gi rgyan dang yon tan yongs su dag pa 'di nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'jig rten gyi khams nyugergya mtsho gang yod pa/ /mtha' dang dbus7)med sna tshogs rnam pa can/ /nor bu mang pos rnam dag mtha' yas mchogatso /de dag sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul pas byung / /dri med khor yug rgyan gyis7brgyan pa ni/ /nor bu mang po de bzhin spos mang dang / /mu tig gsal7ba'i tshogs la rab tu gnas//kha dog mtha' yas rin chen rnams kyis brtenahu sna/ /snying po nor bu'i sprin canamo/nyesna tshogs sra/ /'dzam bu chu klung 'od 'phro snying po'i tshogs/ /'od 'phro dam pa 35—230

phyogs su snang zhing 'tsher6)/ /khor yug dri ma med pa rnam par mdzes/ /nor bu'i rdo rjes byas shing sra zhing zhu)brtan/ /mtshams rnams mi phyed nor bu sna tshogs 'brul/ /mtshan ldan nor bu'i57rin chen rnam bkod54)pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis yongs su dag par snang / /spos chu'i sprin gyisakha dog mtha' yas te/ /rin chen tsandan me tog kun tu gramakhri/ /padmo sna tshogs gos kyis kun nas yog /rin chen rtsi mchog dri zhim rnams dang ldan/ /sna tshogs shing gi sprin gyis kun nas brgyan/ /nor bzang kun gyis kun nas gzi brjid 'bar/ /'od zer sprin gyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can/ /gos kyi mdzod kyis shin tu 'bar bar gnas / /spos7kyi 'od 'phro bdug pa〈migadugs 'chang ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' mang pos chos dbyings gang / /sgra dbyangs mang po rgya mtsho thams cad 'byin / /'di ni rnam par snang mdzad chos 'khor lo/ /rin chen mdzes pa de dag thams cad dang / /nor bu dag dang kun nas 'od 'phro'i shing / /kun la rnam par snang mdzad sku gsal ba/ /gzugs brnyan (9nitshul du nang na yod pa snang ske/ /thams cad gzugs su sku rnams mtha' yas te/ /sangs rgyas sprul mang kha dog mu med pasakyi/ /thams cad phyogs dang chos dbyings kun /nyabakang zhing / /sems can mang po tshad med rnam par 'dul/ /thams cad rgyan las sgra dbyangs kun 'byung ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad smon lam 'khor lo yis/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho yongs su dag byas pa/ /de kun de las rnam par 'phrul zhing grags()ske/ zha'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i 'khor 3)yug gi rgyan rgya mtsho shin tu bstan pa zhes bya ba ste/ le'u 8drug pa'o// //35—231

kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la khor yug chen po de'i nang gi ①'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i sa chen po'i gzhi ni nor bu mang po'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa / rdo rje ltar shin tu mkhregs7shing sra la brtan pa/ rin po che'i rigs thams cad las grub pa/ rgya mtshos rnam par phye ba mi shigs pa'i snying po can mi mtho ba mi dma' ba'i thang mnyam zhing rnam par dag pa/ nor bu rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog dang / 'od thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi dbyibs lta bu'i nor bu'i gzugs sna tshogs kyisakhurab tu bsgrubs ④pa/ rin po che'i tshon thams cad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rin po che yid du 'ong ba'i padmo thams cad kyis gzhi byas pa dmigs pa thams cad du sna tshogs su gyur pa'i sprin gyis kun nas yog pa/ nor bu'i rgyal po spos kyi mdzod thams cad kyisashegazhi mnyam par bdal7ba/ nor bu'i rgyal po dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhing gi rgyan gyisashesprin gyi dra ba rnam par bres〈nyepal/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod yul gyi 'od dang nor bu'i dra ba mig 'phrul lta bus nyugernam par phye ba ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag la tunyestsogs pa sa'i dkyil 'khor de'i rgyan shin tu bstan pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phrasheb snyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i 8gzhi'i rgyan rgya mtsho 'di nyid yongs su brjod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor gzhi ni rnam dag mnyam/ /'khor lo'i dra bas bsgrubs ⑩pa mi shigs sra/ /rin chen hu3sna tshogs mnyam pa'i gzhir gnas shing / /rin chen735—232

sna tshogs kun gyis kun tu yanganye/ zhayid 'ong sa ni rdo rje gser gyi gzhig/ /rin chen chu ba ri bo'i 'khor los bsgrubs/ /padmo'isnyidakyil 'khor gzhi yin me tog sa/ /tsandan phye ma rin chen kun tu bkram/ /'od zer sna tshogs rin chen me tog rnams/ /'od 'phro 'gyed pas phyogs su sprin kyang 'bar/ /sangs rgyas 'od snang nor bu rnam par bkram/ /sa kun me tog yid du 'ong bas yog /thams cad sprin ni phyogs na stug lding ⑥bas/ /mi zad yangs pa kun nas khebs par 'dug /zhing rnams thams cad phyogs rnams kun bkang zhing / /sangs rgyas chos ni snyan par rab tu sgrog /rin chen nang snang sangs rgyas smon lam kun/ /shin tu dus ring rtag tu kun tu ston/ /sngan cad spyod pa cikhu'adra spyod pa dag /kun kyang nor bu'i 'bru las gsal bar snang / /de yi rgya mtsho nor bu sna tshogs btingasnye/ /de yi nang na sangs rgyas spyod yul snang / /sangs rgyas spyod yul de dag zhing gi7rnams/ /rgya mtsho kun gyi rdul phran re rer snang / /me tog snying po tshon gyi 'khor los bsgrubs(7/ /der ni byang chub sems dpa' rtag 'dong zhing / /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam kun kyang sgrogatunye /snying po byang chub 'khor du rnam 'phrul〈nyelo/ /rin chen 'od zer 'od dang ldan pa dag /sa yi nor bu rgyan las rab tu 'byung / /sangs rgyas chos nyid 'di yang rtag tu ston / /chos dbyingasalgenam mkha' lta bu'i7kun tu 'gengs/ /sangs rgyas kun yul ye shes rgya chen dang / /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam sus shes pa/ /de dag phyogs rnams rgya mtsho kun tu yang / /zhing rnams rgya mtsho dbyings ⑩kyi 'phrul la 'jug /(nye'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i sa'i gzhi tunyergyan shin tu bstan pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bdun pa'o// //35—233

kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mcho1re gzhi sa'i dkyil 'khor de la spos7chu'i rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod de/ de dag kun kyang gzhi7rin po che thams cad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /nor bu'i rgyal po dang spos thams cad kyis rlungasherab tu bsgrubasalgepa'o / /nor bu'i rgyal po bzang zhing yid du 'ong ba 'odasnyernam par snang ba'i dra bas kun nas bres ⑥pa'o/ /rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog dang mdog ⑦tu snang ba'i spos kyi chus yongs su rgyas rigepa'o/ /rin po che thams cad kyi me tog sna tshogs glong du 'khyilapo)pa'o/ /tsandan gyi phye ma dang 'dres pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor dang smon lam rgya mtsho'i sgra 'byin pa'o/ /rin po che thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor gyi〈kye sprin rnam par snang ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi sprin me tog sna tshogs kyi kha dog lta bu (nyarab tu 'gyed pa'o/ /kha dog dang dbyibs mtha' yas pa'i gdugs kyis khebs par rnam par 'phrul pas brgyan pa'o/ /dmigs pa thams cad la 'jig rten gyi khams mang po rgya chen po thams cad snang ba'o/ /phyogs kun nas rin po che'i them skas kyi phreng ba bcu〈nyerab tu bkye ba'o/ /mu tig rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog lta bu'i mu khyud kyis hunyekun nas bskor ba'o/ /rin po che shel gyi rgyal mtshan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa bcus kun nas brgyan pa'o/ /'di lta ste nor bu dang me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa chu klung gaṅgā'i༄bye ma snyed kha dog mtha' yasalgepa bcus kun nas bskor ba'o⑩/ /'di lta ste nor bu thams cad kyi padmo yid du 'ong ba'i grong khyer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phragatshwanyebacus kun 35—234

nas bskor ba'o/ /'di lta ste nor bu rdo rje shin tu sra ba'i7gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rab tu bsgrubs pa'o/ /rin po che thams cad kyi me tog punda risaka dang / spos kyi chu yongs su rgyas pas kun nas bskor ba'o/ /'di lta ste rin po che'i shing gi phreng ba rin po che 'bar zhing kun nas ①'phyang ba'i nor bu'i dra ba can gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis kun nas bskorasnyiba'o/ /tsandan dang spos dang nor bu mang po sgra thams cad dang sangs rgyas kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag gis rnam par snang bar byas pa chu klung gaṅgā'i gebye ma snyed kyis 'gram 96)shin tu brgyan pa'o/ /'di lta ste rin po che dang gos dang rgyalamadzamatshan dang / dril bu mang po thams cad kyi sgra 'byung bas rgyan shin tu rgyas pa'o/ /rin po che yid du 'ong ba'i nor bu thams cad kyi ra ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pas kun nas bskor ba'o / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang spos chu'i57rgya mtsho'i rgyan 'di nyid ⑨yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi hu )byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sa stengs tunyede na spos kyi chu bo yi(rte/ /rgya mtsho nor bus brgyan pa rnams brjodatshwanyede/ /gzhi rnams rin chen gos kyi 3nyekun bting ba/ /mi shigs rdo rje lta bu susnyizhing mdzes/ /spos dang nor bu'i rgyal po mang po dang / /nyi ma'i nor bu'i skye'od 'phro stug hunyespyin dang / /padmo hunyerin chen 'phreng 3)ba'ang kun nas bres/ /gzhi rnams dri med yid du 'ong ba'o/ /spos kyi chu yis yongs su rgyas pa ste/ /rin chen 'od zer sna tshogs me tog glong / /sgra dbyangs rab tu gtong ba'i dbyangs kyis kyang / /sangs rgyas rnam 3 )par 'phrul pa rab tu 35wa 235

sgrog /them skas phreng ba yid du 'ong dang ldan/ /gzhi ni rin chen nor bu mang pos brgyan①/ /stegs bu kun bkod rin chen padmo yi/ /sprin stug7dra ba rnam par bres pa ste/ /rin chen nor bu'i shing gi 'phrengasab dag /rin chen gser gyi kha dog yid 'ong 'bar/ /'od kyi tshogs dang rol mo'i sgra dag kyangasnyi/ /rnam par 'phrul mang dbyangs su rab tu sgrog /spos chus yongakhugang rin chen bsgrubs pa ste/ /me tog punda ri kas kun nas bskoral/ /spos dang 'od dang bdugashesgos 'od zer 'gyed/ /de dag 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par yangs/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan mu tig 'bar ba can/ /gos dang nor bu sna tshogs kun 'phyang zhing / /rin chen nor bu'i dril bu dra ba dag /thams cad mkhyen par 'jug pa'i sgra yang sgrog /padmo'i grong khyer rnams kyis kun nas bskor/ /kha dog mtha' yas nor bus rnam par brgyan/ /phyogs rnams kun nas mu tig sprin bkye zhingarwate/ /grong khyer rgya mtshos de dag rab tu brgyan/ /dra ba bzang pos kun nas bskor ba ste/ /rin chen byas pa'i gzugs bzang khyab kyi b.ratso/ /rnam pa du mar 'bar zhing yid 'ong ba'i/ /rgya mtshos bzang zhing mdzes par rab tu brgyanatunye/ /sngon cad sangs rgyas7rnam par snang mdzad kyis8/ /sna tshogs rgya mtsho zhing rnams yongs sbyangs pa/ /shin tu rgya che mtha' dang dbus med pa'ang / /de dag kun na rnam par 'phrul pa byed8/ / spos chu'i7rgya mtsho de dag re re zhing yang du spos chu'i chu klung g.yas phyogs su 'khor zhing 'bab pa gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi khams〈 )rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis nye'akhor bar byas pa ste/ spos chu'i chu klung de dag thams cad kyang 'khor kun nas rdo rje'i padmo kha dog dang dri mtha' yas pas bsgrubs pa'o/ /nor bu'i 'khor lo dang nor bu'i 35—236

'od rnamanyepar dag pa sna tshogs kyis mtha' kun⑧nas dkris pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog lta bus rnam par snang bar byas pa'i 'od zer gyishesprin dang ldan pa'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i dril bu'i dra ba rin po che ④thams cad kyi kha dog tu ⑤'dug pas kun nas khebs pa'o/ /spyod pa'i 'od kyi klong sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan gyi dbyibs lta bu rab tu 'byung ba'o/ /nor bu'i rgyal po rgyan thams cad nang na snang zhing 'od shin tu 'bar ba 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho lta bur snang ba thams cad kyis ④shin tu yog par byas pa'o/ /nor bu'i rgyal po phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa rnam par snang ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i snying po'i me tog shin tu rgyas pas kun nas khebs ⑧pa'o/ /dus gsum dushegashegs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan gyi 'khor lo dbyangs su sgrog pa'o/ /spos kyi chu dang rin po che 'od 'phro ba thams cad kyi 'od dang / rkyunya'od zer gyi sprin rab tu 'byung ba ste/ chu klung de dag re re zhing yang rgyan shin tu bstan5)pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang spos chu'i chu7klung gi rgyanachadang / yon tan rgya mtsho 'di nyid yongs su bstan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /chu klung dri ma med pa'i chus rgyas shing ske/ /gzhi ni nor bu rdo rje'i7padmos byas/ /rin chen mang po sil bus gzhishebakram zhing / /kun nas brgyan pa sna tshogs yid du 'ong / /them skas phreng bas de dag kun nas bskor/ / padmo 'phyang〈nyeba'i mu khyud 'khor can te/ /me 35—237

tog brgyan pa'i mu tig phreng ba dang / /me tog lda ldis sna tshogs kun nas bres//nor bu'i0)chu bo spos chu 'byung ba ni/ /rin chen kun gyi kha dog mdogasheltar 'babarka/ /rin chen nor bu'i⑧me tog mdzes par bkod/ /sil snyan sgra ni sangs rgyas gsung skad brjod(lde)/ /de dag rtog pa nor bu zla ba ste/ zhagarinashechen sna tshogs thams cad dba' klong ngo / /phyogs rnams bcu po kun tu rtag par yang / /spos dang bdug pa 'od 'phro'i rgyan 'byung ngo / /chu bo rnams las rin chen thams cad kyi/ /'od zer 'phro ba kun tu rab tu 'byung / /me tog nor bu'i phung po gdugs rnams kyang / /rin chen kun gyisalgegazer du rab tu 'bar / /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi gzugs brnyan mang po dang / /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rin chen rnams las snang / /rin chen 'khor lo'i gzhi rten hurteyid 'ong las/ /spos chus rgyas pa'i chu klung rnams kyang 'bab/ /rin chen gser gyi hu dril bu'i dra ba yis/ /yog cing sangs rgyas gsung du sgra sgrog 'bab(snyel/ /rgyal ba kun gyisabyang chub spyod pa dang / /kun tu bzang po'i spyod mchog rab tu 'dzud/ /sangs rgyas smon lam sgra dbyangs rnam pa dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad sngon gyitsha8sbyor ba dag /rnamatsha8dag nor bu'i ngos dang ngogs kun nas/ /sgra rnams sgrog the 7pa kun na rab tu snang / /chu bo thams cad dba' klong hurtedag las kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'i sprin chen 'bar ba dag /chos kyi dbyings rnams rab tu rgyas byed pa/ /'byam hu)klas phyogs rnams kun na rab tu snang / /chu klung de dag thams cad dri med cing / /nor bu'i rgyal po sprin gyis kun khyab pa/ /mdzod spu'i ( kye dpal dang sangs rgyas gzi brjid (gle'abar / /nor bu'i rgyal po sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan5)snang / /spos chu'i chu 35wa 238

klung de dag gitubar dag kyang sa50sna tshogs la rin po che thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa ste/ chu klung gi bar de dag re re zhing yang rin po che'i me tog punda ridzaXku'i phreng ba/ gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis kun nas bskor ba'o/ /chu klung gi⑧bar de dag re re zhing yang rin po che'i shing gi phreng ba gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rnam par phye ba'o/ /shing gi gseb thams cad nas kyang rgyan thams cad kyi phyisprin rtag par rab tu 'byung ①ste/ nor bu'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i dpal 'byung ba'i sprin dang / 'od rnams kyang rab tu 'byung ngo / /shing gi bar de dag thams cad kyang 'od shin tu 'bar ba ste/ spos dang me tog sna tshogs kyisasherab tu gang ba'o/ /nor bu'i rgyal po (8)sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lasmon lam bskal pa thams cad du byin gyis rlob pa'i sgra sgrogs3 )pa'i sprin gyis yongs su gang ba'o / /spos 'od 'phro ba'i sprin gyi nyunya'od gzer tunyegyis rnam par snang bar byed pa'i sprin gyis mngon par khyab pa'o/ /spos kyi rgyal po yid du 'ong ba sna tshogs kyis rnam par rgyas pa'o/ /nor bu'i rgyal po rgyanarwartebasam gyis mi khyab pa'i kha dog yang dag par ston pas mnyam pa nyid du nyistemangon par gang ba'o/ /gos kyi tshogasasnyisna tshogs sprin lta bus mngon par yog pa'o/ /nor bu'i 8rgyal po phyogs bcur 'od gzer gyi dra ba'i sprin gyis yog par byed pas rnam par rgyas pa'o/ /nor bu'i rgyal po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i 'od kyis mngon par gang hunyeba'o/ /nor bu'i rgyal porwa/sems can thams cad kyi las rnam par smin pa rgya mtsho'i gzugs brnyan du )shin tu ston pas rgyas pa ste/ de dag la 31 stsogs pa chu klung gi bar de dag re re zhing yang rgyan shin tu bstan pa ni 'jig 35wa 239

rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang spos chu'i chu klung gi bar gyi7rgyan yongs su dag pa rgya mtsho 'di nyid yongs su bstan ②pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras li / /chu klung bar rnams shin tu rnam par dag /rin chen rgyan can gser gyis〈rnam par bresaX/ /yal ga me tog sprin rnams 'phyang lding ba'ime/ /shing gi phreng bas kun nas mngon par khyab/ /shing gi yal ga'i dkyil 'khor sgo dag nas / /rin chen mang po'i sprin rnams kun kyang 'byung ni/ / bome tog 'od mang rin chen snying po can/ /phyogs rnams kun sgor 'gro ba khyab par byed/ /gzhi rnamasashenor bu mngon par bkram pa ste/ /me tog rnam bres rin chen 'bru dang ldan/ /kun nas rin chen sprin gyis khyab pa ste/ /rgyan dang sems can thams cad gzugs brnyan7)snang / /sangs rgyas 'od kyi nor bu'i rgyal po yis/ /sa rnams thams cad kun nas rnam par gang / /phyogs rnams thams cad 'bar zhing snang ba'i sprin/ /rdul phran kun la gzugs brnyan gyur par7snang / /nor bu'i rgyan gyis shin tu rnam par rgyas/ /mu tig gsal ba'i dra bas rnam par phye/ /nor bu'i 'khor los (nyekun nas rab tu bkod/ /kun na 8rgyal ba rnam par 'phrul pa snang / /'byamasnyiklas 'od zer ldan pa'i rin chen gyisatso/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa bkye ba kun na snang / /sangs rgyas mang pos phyogs rnams kun khyab cing / /stobs bcu tunyemanga' ba'i chos nyid rab tu sgrog /rin chen sna tshogs punda rirwasheka yis/ /chu rnams kun rgyas snying po nor bu spos/ /de las mi zad 'od zer rgya mtsho'i hunyernams/ /rab tu 'byung ba'i padmo sna tshogs 'byung / /dus 35—240

rnams gsum po'i rgyan rnams thams cad kyang / /nor bu de dag 'bru yi nang na dzol/ /'byung ba med cing gzung du'ang yod pa min/ /de ni sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul pa'i mthu/ /rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad thams cad du/ /rgyan dang sprul pa thams cad rab tu 'gyed/ /sngon cadashesangs rgyas smon lam mthu dag gis/ /de dag 'gro zhing 'ong bar snang ba medal/ /rdul rnamasakyirgya mtsho thams cad dag la yang / /rgyal sras thams cad spyad pakhurab spyod de/ /rang gi zhing dang lung bstan sa yi rnams/ /bsam pa rnam dag tshul bzhin de dag mthong ske/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi/'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rgyan shin tu bstan ⑦pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dmigs pa dag la'ang dmigs pa re re zhing yongs su dag pa'i yon tan dang rgyan shin tu bstan ⑧pa rgya mtsho ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mcho'ishergal shin tu phra ba snyed du shes par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems7 dpa' kun tu bzang pos5)yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho yongs su dag cing yon tan mtha' dang dbus med pas yon tan7rnam par dag pa'i rgyan shin tu bstanasnyipa rgya mtsho 'di nyid yongs su bstan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /zhing gi rgya mtsho 'di rnams thams cad kyang / /rin chen rgyan can 'od zer gnas pa ste/ / sdug cing gsalasnyiba'i sprin gyis kun nas yog /rin chen thams cad 'od kyang rnam par 'bar/ /mu tig nor bu'i sprin rnams7zad mi shes/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan phyogs su rnam par snang / /35—241

zhing na yod pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la rtag tu ston pa byed/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi sprin ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /nor bu'i rgyal po thams cad snyan par sgrog /rnam par snang mdzad sngon gyi spyod pa rnams/ /rin chen rnams lasaturtag par snang zhing grag② /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad dri med 'od/ /rgyan rnams thams cad nang na rnam par snang / /'khor rnams gzugs brnyan mtshan nyid 'chang ba dang / /sprul pa rnams kyisalgezhing gi rgya mtsho gang / /sangs rgyas sprul pa rnams ni sgyu ma 'drabya/ /de dag la ni byon pa gang yang med/ /sangs rgyas yul rnams byin gyis brlabs pa yiX/ /56)zhing rnams kun na sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul/ /zhing rnams 'byam klas par ni rnam 'phrul zhingasnye/ /'o⑨ji snyed zhing du de dag kun rgyu ba/ /de dag nor bu kun la rab tu snang / /de ltar zhing gi rgya mtsho rnam par sbyangs/ /sprul pa rnams ni mig yor 'dra ba ste/ /thams cad dag na chos nyid 'di yang snang / /'di ni rnam par snang mdzad spyod yul te/ /smon lam rnam par 'phrul lasalgebyung ba 'o/ /bzang po'i 8spyod pas gang rnams byung gyur pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' shes mchog rgya mtsho can/ /de dag rdul phran kunatsol rang rang gis/he / /rang gi zhing rnams rgya mtsho dag par byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi zham 8ring du/ / bskal pa bye ba rgya chen bsam yas su/ /de dag spyod yul thams cad mthong bas na/ /skad cig⑩sems la de dag thams cad ston/ /zhing rnams mnyam med 'byung ba med pa ste/ /de dag mkha'arwanye'adra mnyam zhing mtshan nyid med/ /smon lam stobs kyis kun tu gnas pa ste/ /sems can rnams la phan phyir rab tu sbyangs/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi 35—242

khams7rnam par dgod pa shin tu bstan pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'jig rten gyi khams kyi ⑧sros chu'i rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bcu'i rdul shin tu phralab snyed posrede dag la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu gnas te⑤/'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud de dag re re zhing yang tha'ajig rten gyi khams 'byamasheklas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byamadzanyaklas pa de dag thams cad kyang gzhan dang gzhan la gnas pa/ dbyibs gzhan dang gzhan du 'dug —pa / phyogs gzhan dang gzhan la lta ba/ rnam pa7gzhan dang gzhan gyis〈 3'jug pa/ rgyan gzhan dang gzhan yod pa/ gzhan dang gzhan gyis5)rgyas par 'gengs pa/ gzhan dang gzhan du 'du ba/ rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan du ma 'dres pa/ rnam par 'phrul ba dang / byin gyi rlabs gzhan dang gzhan yod pa dag5nyeste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byamatshwanyeklas pa la la ni padmo'i rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams7rgya mtsho 'byam7klas pa la la ni rin po che'isnyikha dog mtha' yas pa'i me tog hu)rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byamatshwa)klas pa la la ni rin po che'i 'phreng7ba mu tig gi 'bru'i snying po can gyitshu — )rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam klas pa la la ni spos chu'i rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam zhunyeklas pa la la ni me tog thams cad kyi rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam rdunyeklas pa la la〈 steni nor bu rin po che'i dra ba'i rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig 35—243

rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam 7klas pa la la ni 'od gzer ②gyi rgya mtsho klong ③du gyur pa'i chu bo la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam klas pa la la ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i nor bu'i cod pan sna tshogs kyi rgyan la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam klas pa la la ni sems can gyi lus sna tshogs rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam klas pa la la ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsungashenor bu'i rgyal po la rab tu gnas so/ /de dag lakhustsogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byamasheklas pa'i gnas shin tu bstan pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed do/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad kyang dbyibs gzhan dang gzhan du 'dug pa sha stag ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'byam klas pa la la ni ri rab kyi dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byamanyeklas pa la la ni chu klung gi dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byamanyeklas pa la la ni kun tu 'khor ba'i dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam7klas pa la la ni kun nas 'khyil ba'i dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byamanyeklas pa la la ni 'khor lo'icadabyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa la la ni myig mangs〈rteris kyi dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byamanyeklas pa la la ni shing gi dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byamatshwanyeklas pa la la ni khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam nye klas pa la la ni rdo rje'i〈nyergyal mtshan gyi dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa la la ni phyogs 'byam 0klas pa'i dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa la la ni/ khang ba'i dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi 35—244

khams 'byamanyeklas pa la la ni padmo'i dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam7klas pa la la ni rta babs7kyi dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa la la ni sems can gyi lus kyi dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam0klas pa la la ni sprin gyi dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa la la ni sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam ⑤klas pa la la ni 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byamanyeklas pa la la ni dra ba sna tshogs bkye ba'i dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 7klas pa la la ni sgo kun nas yod ⑩pa'i dbyibs lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam tunyeklas pa la la ni dmigs pa thams cad kyi dbyibs lta bu ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de lakestsogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 0klas pa'i dbyibs rnam par phye ba shin tu bstan pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'ardul shin tu phra ba snyed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i tshul de dag ni lhun gzhan dang gzhan du bstan pa ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni phyogs thams cad kyi nor bu'i sprin gyi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni 'od kyi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni rin po che dang spos 'od 'phro ba thams cad kyi lhun7can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni rin po che7thams cad kyi me tog kha sprod las bsgrubs pa'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi gzugs brnyan gyi0 lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi dukhams kyi tshul la la ni sangs rgyas kyi 'od kyi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni rin po che'i 'od kyi lhun can no/ /'jig 35—245

rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni sangs rgyas kyi kha dog gi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni rin po che7thams cad kyisakha dog gi 'od kyi lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams rgya mtsho yang dag par 'byung ba'i sgra'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni sems can thams cad kyi las rgya mtsho yang dag par 'byung ba'i ( )sgra'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi 0khams kyi tshul la la ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa'i sgra'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam gyi ⑧rgya mtsho'i sgra'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni sangs rgyas kyi tshul thams cad mngon par bsgrub ⑥pa'i sgra'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni zhing gi rgyan thams cad 'byung ba dang 'jig pa'i sgra'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang dbyangs mtha' dang dbus7med pa'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i sgra'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni sems can thams cad kyi dge ba 'byungarwa༄ba'i sgra'i lhun can no/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshul la la ni sangs rgyas thams cad 0kyi yon tan rgya mtsho yongs su dag pa'i sgra'i lhun can no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag la hu )stsogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud 'byam (meklas pa'i tshul gyi nyurtelus ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams hunyergya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du shes par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud 'byamanyeklas pa'i tshul gyi7lus rnam par dgod pa 35—246

shin tu bstan pa 'di nyid gsal bar brjod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /zhing gi rgyud rgyan shin tu brtan7par grub/ /dri med dri bral 'od 'gyed snying po can/ /nor bu padmo rgya mtsho kun la gnas/ /la la gaṅgā'ikhurgya mtsho dag la gnas/ /rnam pa sna tshogs tshul gyisashegazhi gnas shing / /dbyibs kyang sna tshogs kha dog gzugs kyang mang / /ri rab grong khyer shing gi dkyil 'khor dang / /zhing rgyud thams cad la la phyogs kun lta/ /la la 'od lus me tog snying po can/ /nor bus byas pa kun nas sprin dang chu/ /la la'i rgyud gsal mu tig 'od zer lus/ /nor bu'i gzhi gnas kun kyang mi shigs sra//'byam0klas la la kha dog sna tshogs gsa'akho/ /'od 'dra 'od 'phro me mar sprin gyi mdog /la la'i rgyud ni sgra dang skad kyi lus/ /de lasakhesangs rgyas gsung dbyangs mtha' yas 'byung / /la la'i rgyud ni smon lam sgra yi lus/ /spyod pa rnam 'phrul sprin gyi sgra yi lus/ /la la bsod nams yangs dang las kyi sgra/ /la la'i lus ni rgyal ba'i yon tan sgra/ /zhing gi rgyud rnams rgya mtsho bsam yas pa//kun nas mi zad du ma'i sgo nas 'jug /rnam 'phrul yangs pa mi zad rgyan gyi rnams / /tshad med kun gyis phyogs kun rgyas par 'gengs/ /phyogs rnams kun tu zhing rnams 'du 'gyur te/ /yangs pa'i tshul gyis zhing gi rgyud zhugs par / /phyogs bcu kun tu 'du bar snang ba yang / /'gro ba med cing 'jug pa yod pa min/ /tshul gcig gis7ni rgyud rnams kun kyang 'gengasal/ /thams cad ma lus re rer rab tu 'du8/ /de la tha dad gang yang mi dmigs te/ /gzhi med kun 'gengs mtha' dang dbus yang〈nyamed/ /zhing rnams tshul gyis hurte35—247

rgyud la rnam 'phrul ba/ /sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad pa kun nas snang / /smon lam sgra ni rgya mtshosherab brjod cing / /zhing gi dbyings na sems can kun kyang 'dul / /zhing rnams sangs rgyas sku yis kun khyab snang / /bsam gyis mi khyab byang chub sems dpasashegang / /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul mi mnyam stobs ston cing ske/ /sems can mang po tshad med rnam par 'dul/ /①zhing gi rgyud kyi gnas shin tu bstan pa zhes bya ste le'u brgyad pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/du bam po dgu pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag0de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang chenashematsho'i dbyings de ni spos chu'i rgya mtsho mig 'phrul gyishernam par phye ba gzhi kun la rab tu gnas pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed de/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la gang7chen mtsho'i dbyings kyi spos chu'i rgya mtsho tunyesangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi nang na spos chu'i rgya mtsho dbus ma ni ze ba yid du 'ong zhing 'od tunyematha' yas pa zhes bya ste/de'i nang nas nor bu'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lus rnam par dmigs pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi rgyal mtshan gyi padmo chen po bzhi tu)spos dang nor bu'i rgyal po thams cad kyis brgyan 8pa'i rgyan can ces bya ba mngon par byung ste/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud phyogs kun nas rin po che 'bar ba'isnyi'od rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba/dmigs pa thams cad kyi rgyan7gyis brgyan pa'i lhun can rab tu gnas te/ de 35—248

dag las thams cad kyi 'og ma ni dpal 'byung ba'i 'od zer rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i ①'jig rten gyi khams te/ de ni rdo rje thams cad kyi rgyun dang /'od kyi 'khor lo'i sa mtshams nor bu7rin po che'i ze ba mang po la rab tu gnas pa/ nor bu'i 'khor thams cad dang nor bu'i ①rin po che'i me tog gi rgyan thams cad kyis rab tu yog par gyur pa ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor ④gyis bskor ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag kyang gzhan dang gzhan la gnas pa/ rgyan gzhan dang gzhan canasadag ste/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa tshul rnam par dag cing dri ma med pa'i mar me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams spos sna tshogs kyi padmo dpal gyi rgyan ces bya ba rgyan thams cad kyi sa mtshams can ⑥rin po che'i padmo shin tu mang ba la rab tu gnas pa seng ge'i khri'i dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/ mu tig gi 'bru rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog lta bu'i bla re'i sprin gyis kun nasakyiyog pa/ kun nas nyon mongs shing rnam par dag pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gnyis kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i 'od zer mchog gi 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i stengashesangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na⑩/ 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che thams cad kyi rgyan kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba spos kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi sa mtshams can rin po che'i me tog gi phreng ba sna tshogs la rab tu gnas pa/ nor bu'i 'khor lo5rtegazi brjid bzang po'i nyi ma'i sprin gyis kun nas yog pa/ yan lag brgyad du 35—249
