de / de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud phyogs tha dad pa mtha' dang dbus tshomed pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas snoso/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho snying po dang ldan zhing shin tu grub pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud phyogs tha mi dad pa mtha' dang dbus ri med pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho tshangs pa'i dbyangs yongs su dag pa'i sgra zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rgyan thams cad yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho tsan dan gyi dbyangs shin tu rnam par phye ba'i stegs bu'i snying po zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rgyal mtshan shin tu bsgrengs pa ④zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho spos kyi rgyal po ge'od zer gyis shin tu bsgrubs phyi pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud zhing gi stobs kun tu snang ba yongs su ⑦ston pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /naspos chu'i rgya mtsho padmo'i dbang po 9mang po me tog shin tu 1 )rgyas pa de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho dngul gyi 11padmo sna tshogs kyis bsgrubs nyi pa'i rgyan ces bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud yongs su gsal 1lhabar kun tu rgyu ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho bee ḍūrya'i spos 14'od 'phro ba'i sprin stug po zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud phyogs su dbyangs sgrog 8pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho phyogs kun tu gzi brjid kyis rgyal ba'i phung po 'od 'phro ba zhes bya ba yod de / de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud phyogs rnam par phye bar la'aphrul pa zhes 35—303

bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho gser gyi rgyal mtshan nor bu'i rgyal po'i dpal rab tu 'byung ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rdo rje'i rtse mo zhing gi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho tha dad pa med pa'i sprin 'bar ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de la ①'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud chos kyi dbyings kyi ②rnam par gnon pa'i gtsug ces bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i me tog zad mi shes pa shin tu rgyas pa'i dpal gyi〈migazi brjid ces bya ba yod debya/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud 'od mtha' yas pa rdul dang bral ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rgya che ⑤zhing gser ltar yongs su dag pa grags pa'i dpal gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud gzhi tshon tu bstan pa'i gnas shes bya brnyurab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho myig yor rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba yod de/de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud las kyis kun tu brgyan cing rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho sgra dbyangs zhi ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rab tu brgyus pa la mngon du blta geb zhes bya ba rab tu gnas te⑤/ de dag la7rtsogs pa spos chu'i rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi phyi rol 'khor nyu yug gi mtshams na/ spos chu'i rgya mtsho 'odarwanya'aphro ba stug po'i sprin gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig5)rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rgyan gyi dmigs pa thams cad kyi 'od ces bya ba snying po byang chub thams cad kyi de 35—304

bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgra yi lhun can rab tu gnas so/ /de thams cad kyi 'og na 'jig rten gyi khams dge ba'i mig sna tshogs shes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba gcig tu dag pa yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs thams cad rnam par snang ba rdo rje'i zla ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i stengatu'ajig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud kyi dbus na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rdo rje'i rgyalasnyomatshan zhes bya ba gzhisamanyam pa yod de/ de la bu'ajig rten gyi khams kha dog utas༄༄pa la dang / dpal gyi be'u zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus chen po blo gros bzang po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba gzhi mnyam pa mayod pa de na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtshams rdo rjesheltar sra ba sna tshogs shes bya ba yod de/ de nasnyide bzhin gshegs pa sa la'i7rgyal po rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng nas tso'ajig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bdun gyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud kyi thog ma la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag pa(spel/ sna tshogs shes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa zil gyis mi non par mngon par 'phags pa'i gzi brjid ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i 'byung gnas kyi mdzod shin tu bstsags hu pa zhes bya ba de dang /'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i 'od snang bas rnam par mdzes pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud grags pa7)dri ma med pa'i rgyan ces bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho 35—305

rin po che tshad med pa'i me tog shin tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud mtshan nyid nam mkha' lta bur tshirnam par dpyod pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas sog/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi dpal rnam par yangs pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 5rgyud thogs pa med pa 4kun tu snang ba'i rgyan ces bya ba rab tu gnas so5di / /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho shing tsan dan gyi ze ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho mtha' yas par 'khyil pa'i phyogs su rab tu 'jug pa zhes bya ba 76)rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su 7gser rin po che'i na gram bu rab tu 'byung ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la zhing gi 'khor lo ④rgyu ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas te/ de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho 'khor kun na/ rdo rje'i 1 me tog gi 'byung gnas yod pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rnam par phye ba bsam gyis mi khyab par ston pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho nor bu77yid bzhin gyi rgyal po 12'khor lo sna tshogs kyi gzhi zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rnam par rig pa chags pa med pas sangs rgyas bltarwa ba zhes bya ba 1 rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho gzhi 15rin po che'i phreng bas bstsags tshapa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud blo gros dge 1 ba mtha' yas pa'i gzi brjid ces bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho mu tig sna0)tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 19brgyan pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 35—306

rgyud sangs rgyas kyi yul dang smon lam gyi rgyu mthun she)pa las byung ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dag la stsogs pa spos chu'i rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdulatshanashin tu phra ba snyed kyi phyi rol khor yug gi 'tshams (snyan spos chu'i (brgya mtsho 'dzam bu'i zhi chu klung gi mdzod kyi dkyil 'khor ces bya ba yod de/ de la〈pe'ajig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud kun tu sgra sgrogatshan pa'i rgyal mtshan7zhes bya ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gzhan dang / gzhan gyi sgor rab tu 'jug pa'i dbyangs kyi lhun can mngon par byung ngo / /de thams cad kyi 'og na 'jig rten gyi khams me tog 1 tsho'od 'phro ba zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor 31ba gcig tu dag pa yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bas gsol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng natshwa 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba gzhi hu mnyam pa yod pa de na/ 'jig rten gyi khams pad mo rnam par snang ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba gcig tu dag pa yod de/ de na 'de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 8thams cad kyis rnam par 'phags pa'i sems kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba gzhi7mnyam pa yod pa de na/ 'jig rten gyi khams stobs bcu'i rgyan 1 ces bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba gcig tu dag pa kun nas nyon mongs shing rnam par dag pa yod de/35—307

de na de bzhin gshegs pa legs par 'byung7ba'i yon tan tshad med pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na⑧'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud kyi dang po la / 'jig rten gyi khams spos dang nor bu brtsegs ④pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba yod debu/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros rnam par yangs pa'i spyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /spos chu'i rgya5snyematsho rin po ches mthun par rnam par brgyan pa/de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho 'od gzer ⑦gyi mdzod kyi ri bo 'dzin pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud nam mkha'i sprin yangs pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rgyan sna tshogs kyi byin gyi rlabs kyi spyod yul zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud dri ma med cing sgrib rishepa med par rnam par phye bsherab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i pad mo 'dab ma stug po rab tu 'phyang ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud lus kyi rgyan 1 tshodam pa'i mar me zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che thams cad kyi rgyan shin tu gnas pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi dra ba 'byung gnas shes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho yang 11dag par bsgrubs pa shin tu mang ba zhes bya ba yod de/de na the 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rin po che'i ze batshwanyebyin gyi brlabs kyi gnas shes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya 8mtsho rin po che 8shin tu gtsang ba'i 7spyod pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud lus dam pa pho morgya mtsho'i rgyan ces bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 35—308

'dab chags7su spos chu'i rgya mtsho nor bu sna tshogs kyi phung po 'dzin⑧pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i snying po zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chagasashes spos chu'i rgya mtsho gzi brjid dag cing yangs pas rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud ind+ra nī ④la'i dbyibs ltar 'dug pa skar mda' ⑤ltar snang ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho yid du 'ong bar gram bu'i nor bumathamu tig rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba yod de / de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud dbyangs kyis ⑦kun tu sgrog pa'i nga ro la dga' ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas te3)/ de dag la7rtsogs pa spos chu'i rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra bcasnyed kyi phyi rol khor yug gi mtshams na spos chu'i rgya mtsho ind+ra nī (spel rab tu 'gyed〈nyepa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud phyogs kun tu snang zhing tha mi dad pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi chos yang dag par 'byung bar nga ro sgrog pa'i lhun can rab tu lho)gnas te/ de thams cad kyi 'og na 'jig rten gyi khams dge ba midam pa'i snying po zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis78bskor ba gcig tu dag pa yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mchog gi blo gros dam pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng ⑩'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi shwe/rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud kyi dbus gzhi7)mnyam pa yod pa de na/ 'jig rten gyi khams yang dag par gnas pa'i rgyan7)ces bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od lhag 35—309

par 'phags pas rab tu snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 1ces bya ba gzhi 2mnyam pa yod pa de na/ 'jig rten gyi khams bee ḍūryas bsgrubs pa kun nas 'khor lo zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab mar me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na rige'ajig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud kyi thog ma la 'jig rten gyi khams me tog gi rgya mtsho rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba gcig tu dag pa yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa sprul pa mi zad pa'i sprin gyi mnga' bdag ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /spos chu'i rgya mtsho sgra rdo rje ltar shin tu brtan pa'i dbyangs shes bya ba de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i 6rgya mtsho rin po che'i shing tags kyis 7)bskor ba shin tu 'phags pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rin po che'i rgyal mtshan shin tu 'greng 8ba zhes bya ba rab tu bzhugs 9so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho me tog gi rgyal mtshan gyis rab tu brgyan pa zhes bya ba yod de/de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud snang ba thams cad shin tu ston pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i sprin dam pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba yod de1 / de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud gzhi rin po che 11thams cad kyis brgyan pa 'od rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i shing gi 32ze ba'i kha dog kyi rgyan 1nyeces bya ba yod de/ de la 1 ci'ajig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud dge ba'i tshogs kyi gzi nyugebarjid rmad ga cad ces bya ba khorab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i nyu tshogos dam pas shin tu 35—310

brgyan77pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rgya mtsho'i 'od ces bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i shing gi yal ga brtsegs 5pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na ri 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rin po che 4)'od 'phro ba'i sprin la shin tu rten 5pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho gzhi yid du 'ong bar snang ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de na 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud chags pa med pa'i rdo rje kun tu rgyu ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho kun nas pad mos brgyan pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rgya mtsho'i 5ngogs mtha' yas pa'i glong 7zhes bya ba rab tu gnas sol/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i yan lag dam pas rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud zhing gi gshegazhi rnam par dmigs pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de las(stsogs pa spos chu'i rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi phyi rol 'khor 3)yug gi mtshams na/ spos chu'i rgya mtsho mi phyed par brtan pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud pad ma'i 1 dkyil 'khor shin tu 1 rnam par phye ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs la 'jug pa shin tu sgrog pa'i lhun can rab tu gnas te/ de dag 1rithams cad kyi 'og na 'jig rten gyi khams spos shin tu zhim pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dang sprul pa tshad med pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud de'i dbus na 'jig rten gyi khams rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba gzhi mnyam pa yod pa de na 'jig rten gyi 35—311

khams rgyan dang tshul gyi sgo bsamanyegyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes tshad med pa'i tshangs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba gzhi mnyam pa yod pa de na/'jig rten gyi khams snang ba'i phyogs me tog ②gi snying po zhes bya ba yod de/ de na rigede bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i spyan 'od 'phro ba'i sprin ces bya ba bzhugs so//de'i steng 'jig rten ④gyi khams kyi rgyud ri thog ma la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i dbyangs shes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa chu'i lha 'od 'phro ba'i sgo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /spos chu'i rgya mtsho lha'i grong khyer dang nor bu'i shing tog gis ridzibargyan pa zhes bya ba de dang 'dab chags ri su spos chu'i rgya mtsho snang ba'i 'khor los rnam par gsal ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud brjod du med pa'i phyogs kyi ༄8)gnas kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i tshon gyi srang rnam pa sna tshogs shes bya ba yod de/ de na 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud brgyud (9)pa du mas 'jug pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rgyan thams cad kyis kun tu gang ba zhes bya ba yod de/de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rin po che 3 )rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rin po che'i dra ba rnam par phye ba kun tu 'byung ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud tshul gyi 1nyamatshams sbyor ba 'byung ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rgyal mtshan dam pa'i rgyan ces bya ba yod de/de na /2'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud 'jig rten gyi khams rnams par dmigs pa 35—312

rgya mtsho'i sgra zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags sushispos chu'i rgya mtsho nyi ma'i gnas yongs su sbyong ba'i 'od ces bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud mig 'phrul gyis rgyas par 'jug pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho sil snyan ②thams cad kyi sgra dbyangs yid du 'ong ba brjod7pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud glong7thams cad kyi gting du rab tu 'jug pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho rgyan dam pas bsgrubs ⑥pa rnam pa sna tshogs shes bya ba yod de/ de la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud 'od dri ma med pa'i sprin stug po 'bar ba zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dang 'dab chags su spos chu'i rgya mtsho mar meshe'od 'phro bas kun tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na⑧'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud sangs rgyas kyi smon lam gyi dbyibs tha dad pa〈)byin gyis rlabs pa zhes bya ba rab tu gnas so/ /de dag la 0stsogs pa spos chu'i rgya mtsho7)sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi phyi rol khor yug gi mtshams na/ spos chu'i rgya mtsho phreng ba dang gos kyisatshwanyeshin tu bsgrubs〈rtepa zhes bya ba yod de/ de lacha'ajig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud kun nas snang ba'i 8gos bzang po shin tu sprul pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad kyi mtshan nyid shin tu sgrog pa'i lhun can mngon par byung ngo / /de thams cad kyi 'og na spos chu'i rgya mtsho dbang po'i me tog ze ba 'khyil pa'i snying po zhes bya ba yod de/de na 'jig rten gyi khams rab tu sgrol nyu9bas dga' ba byed pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor 35—313

ba gcig tu dag pa yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i ye shes kyis 17pham pa med pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng ②'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud kyi ga dbus na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba gzhi mnyam pa yod pa de na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che'i 'bru'i dra bas brgyan pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba gcig tu dag pa yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba tshad med pas dgyes la pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng na 45'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba gzhi mnyam pa yod pa de na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che'i gdan padmo dang seng ge zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba/kun nas nyon mongs shing rnam par dag pa yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa shugs dri ma med cing mnyan na don yod pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /de'i steng 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bdun gyi 59rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud kyi steng na/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud klu'i rin po che'i kha dog gi 'od ces bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyi shu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba gcig tu dag pa yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings yongs su gsal ba ri rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so / /kye de ltar rgyal ba'i sras dag spos chu'i rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa 9phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la 'jig rten gyi 35—314

khams kyi rgyud sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu gnas te/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud de dag thams cad kyang spos chu'i rgya mtsho de dag la nor bu'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i lus rnam par dmigs pa'i myig yor gyi rgyal mtshan gyis 1)rab tu brgyan padzagudang ldan pa'i pad mo la rab tu gnas pa sha stag go/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud〈khugazhan dang gzhan can mang po dang / mtshams 'dab chags su gnas pa sha stag go/ /'od rin po che gzhan dang gzhan gyi mkha dog tu 'gyed pa sha stag go/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gzhan dang gzhan gyis kun nas yog pa sha stag go/ /rgyan rnam par bres pa'i 'od gzhan dang gzhan can sha stag go/ /bskal pa'i grangs dang tshulakrugazhan dang gzhan du bstan pa sha stag go/ /sangs rgyas gzhan dang gzhan skye zhing gshegs pa sha stag go/ /chos rgya mtsho'i sgra gzhan dang gzhan rab tu bsgrags pa sha stag go/ /sems can gyi ༄6)lus gzhan dang gzhan gyisadzo)kun tu yog pa sha stag go/ /phyogs gzhan dang gzhan la 'jug pa ma 'dres pa sha stag gol/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs gzhan dang gzhan can sha stag go/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud de dag re re'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mtshams nas rab tu byung ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dra ba rgyan sna tshogs la rab tu gnas pa thams cad kyis 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa sna tshogs kyi tshul du 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba 'di thams cad yongs su gang ngo / /ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gi rgyud nas byung ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sa mtshams dang sgo rnam pa 35—315

sna tshogs kyi rgyan7)la gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi5)dra ba sna tshogs thams cad las byung ba kun gyis kyang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying po me tog gi5brgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di thams cad yongs su gang ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos yang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud mtha' dang dbus9)med pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam55)klas pa'i tshul shin tu bstan pa 'di nyid gsal bar brjod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis7phyogs bcur rnam par bltas57te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'jig rten khams ni rgya mtsho'i5kyernams/ /yangs dang myi yangs sna tshogs pa/ /nam mkha' dag gi dbyings la gnas/ /chos kyi dbyings ni tha mi dad / /'jig rten khams 'di rgya mtsho na/ /zhing gi rgyud ni bsam mi khyab/ /tha dad medalo)par rnam par gnas/ /rnam 'phrul gzhan dang gzhan dag go/ /rnam phye sna tshogs shin tu gnas/ /kha dog tha dad rab tu 'dug /zhing gi rgyud dag rnam phye ba/ /'jig rten khams kyi gang sna )chen mtsho/ /lhun dang dbyangs rnams tha dad de/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rnam 'phrul ba/ /zhing gzhanalorgyud rnams rab tu snang / /las kyi hu de dag shin tu bris3lhe/ /ri rab rgya mtsho'i dra ba dang / /'khor lo klong nyu ri gi dkyil 'khor dang / /padmo'i dbyibs 'dra 'byam 7klas pa/ /de dag de yis tshekun nas bskor/ / rdo rje'i 3)rgyal mtshan brtsegs pa dang / /rdo rje kun nas 'khor gnas pa/ /'byam 3)klas bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /de dag rgyud ni kun nas bskor/ /'od kyi dra ba bsam hu)mi khyab//mu tig mdog tri 7kyang rgya mtsho ste/ /zhing gi rgyud 31rnams kun kyang 'bar/ /padmo la yang kun gnas so/ /re re dag gi rgyud las kyang / /'od zer dra ba bsam 35—316

mi khyab/ /'od zer dag gi zhing gyur cing / /rgya mtsho'inyephyogs rnams kun tu 'gengasal / /zhing gi rgyud rnams thams cad kyishe/ /dmigs pa kun gyi sgo nas kyang ske/ /thams cad tshul la 'jug pa 4ge/ /mi zad tshul rnams rab tu snang / /zhing gi rnams ni bsam mi khyab/ /rgyud rnams mi zad shin tu 'byung / /rgyan rnams bstan pa tha dad de/ /drang srongasachen po'i byin rlabs so/ /zhing gi rgyud rnams de dag na/ /'jig rten bsam gyis mi khyab khams/ /kun nas 'du zhing rnam par 'jigasaX/ /'byung zhing 'jig par de bzhin 'gyural/ /ji ltar shing la lo masnyernams/ /'byung zhing lhung7bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin zhing gi rgyud rnams na/ /'jig rten khams na7'byung ba yin/ /ji ltar shingarwategi skye gnas nas/ /shing tog7)sna tshogs 'byung ba ltar/ /de bzhin zhing gi rgyud7rnams na/ /sems can sna tshogs 'byung ba yin/ /ji ltar sa bon khyad par gyis/ /'bras bu sna tshogs snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin las kyi khyad par gyis//sems can rnams dang zhing byung57ngo / /yid bzhin rin chen rgyal po77rnams/ /kha dog kun tu snang ba ltar/ /sems can bsam pa rnamachadag pas/ /de bzhin zhing rnams rab tu snang / / klu yi rgyal po'i sprin gyi〈rternams/ /namanyemakha'i dbyings la ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas smon lam gyis/ /zhing gi rnams ni 'byung ba yin/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan po sngags dag gis/ /sgo rnams sna tshogs ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sems can las rnams kyis/ /bsam gyis mi khyab zhing 'byung ngo / /ji ltar ri mo'i gzugs kyi rnams/ /ri mo'i las kyis bris pa ltar/ /de bzhin zhing rnams 'di dag kun/ /sems kyisam3)ri mor bris pa yin/ /sems can lus kyi rnam pa ciX dag /ji ltar sems kyis (nye)brtags 35—317

pa ltar/ /de bzhin zhing gi rnam pa yang7)/ /thams cad las kyis rnam par brisal/ /ji ltar gzhan dang gzhan gzugs su/ /sems can rnams kyi bsam pa bzhin / /mgon po rnams ni snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin zhing rnams snang ba'o/ /padmo'i dra ba'i phyi rol gyi ge/ /sems can zhing gi mtshams dag na/ /dbyibs dang kha dog gzhan dang gzhan/ /dri ma med pa sna tshogs snang / /pad mo'i dra ba de dag la/ /zhing gi dra ba rab tu gnas/ /rgyan dang bstan pa sna tshogs te/ /sems can sna tshogs mang po'i gnas/ /zhing gi dbyings rnams la la ni/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam par gnas/ /sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs las /chos nyid de dag nang na snang / /kun nas nyon mongs rnam rigedag tu/ /zhing gi rgyud ni bsam mi khyab/ /sems can bsam pas rab tu byung / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang 'khod/ /la la rnam dag nyon mongs can/ /zhing gi dbyings ni rnam pa sku mang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnam par 'phrul4ge/ /rgya mtsho'i las las byung ba yin/ /zhing rnams la la'i 'od btang ba/ /rin chen rang bzhin dri ma med/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dri med dag /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs su sbyangs/ /zhing gi rgyud rnams la la na47/ /bskal pa'i mye ni bsam mi khyab/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnams la ston/ /zhing gi dkyil 'khor shin tu sra/ /rlung ri skugi phung po smon lam dang / / chu yi58)phung la rab tu gnas/ /zhing gi rnam pa shin tu mang / /sems can las kyis tshorabasags pa yin/ /zhing na 1 gzhan dang gzhan dag gi11/ /zhing gi chos nyid snang la ltos/ /de dag 'byung ba gang yang med/ /de dag la ni 'jig pa'ang 12med/ /skad cig skad cig ri1 sems kun la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /zhing rnams 35—318

rab tu 'byung bshernams/ /shin tu dri med dag la ci ltos/ /zhing rnams la la sa yi7dngos/ /sra bar de dag byung gyur cing / /snang ba med cing 'ong ba'ang 4med / /sdig pa'i las kyi gnas yin no/ /zhing rnams la la rdo rje'i dngos/ /kun nas nyon mongs 'jigs pa tshege/ /bde ba chung zhing sdug bsngal 46)mang / /bsod nams ⑦zung ba'i gnas kyang yin/ / zhing rnams la la lcags kyi dngos/ga /la la zangs kyi dngos su gnas/ /sdig pa'i las kyis kun tu spugang ske/ /ri dang brag gis mimanyam pa med/ /'jig rten de na dmyal ba yi/ /sems can sdug bsngal57skyabs med pa/ /mun pa rjes su rnyed hu gyur cing / /mye lce rgya mtsho'is3nyenang na 'bar/ /'on kyang byol song skye gnas su/ /lus ni mngon par 'byung 'gyur 8te/ /bdag gi las kyi nyes pa yisanyuge/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba rab tu myong / /gshin rje'i 'jig 8rten rnams na'ang snang / /skom dang bkres pas rab tu mnar/ /mye yi ri yi gdung ba yis/rte/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba'ang hunyemyong bar 'gyur39/ /la la rin chen bdun las byung / /la la sna tshogs gzugs su gnas/ /dge ba'i las kyis byung ba ste/ /sna tshogs khyim gyis rab tu brgyan/ /mi dang lha rnams la la ni/ /mtho ris dag gi 'jig rten na / / dge ba'i ni )bsod nams 'bras bur ldan/ /dga' bde myong ba de dag ltos / /spu'i rtse mo gcig la yang / /zhing rnams bye ba bsam mi khyab/ /sna tshogs dbyibs kyang tha dad de(1/ /de dag 'dres pa gang yang med/ /rang rang so so'i las kyis〈rten/ /sems can khams rnams bsam mi khyab/ /'du shes sna tshogs 'dzin pa (snyernams/ /bde dang sdug bsngal nyams su myong / /zhing rnams la la mtha' yas 'od/ /sems can mang don kun nas gnas / /yongs 35wa 319

'byung〈sna)rdo rje utpa la/ /sna tshogs rnam dag dri ma med/ /zhing rnams la la 'od zer dngos(kye/ /'od kyi 'khor la57kun nas gnas/ /tsan dan gser las yongs su byung / /'od 'phro sprin gyi〈pemadog dang mnyam/ /zhing rnams la la nyikyizla'i dngos/ /spos kyi gos kyisapo)kun nas yogatso /la la pad mo gcig la ste/ /byang chub sems dpas57yongs su rgyas/ /la la mtshan gyi mdog dang 'od/ /zhing rnams rin chen dri ma med/ /mig 'phrul 'od kyang rab tu 'gyed⑨/ /'od zer dra bas snang bar byas/ /zhing rnams la la rdo rje dang / / pad mo'i dngos su spos7la gnas/ /la la nor bu'i 'od kyang yin/ /zhing rnams yongs su dag la ltos/ /me tog glong〈skrelas la la byung / /bsam gyis〈nyemi khyab zhing la ltos / /sangs rgyas sprul pas kun tu khyab/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'od dang mnyam / /la la me tog shing rnams dang / /lo ma'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs te/ /nor bu'i sprin gyis kun tu khyab/ /zhing gi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag /zhing rnams la la padmo'i 3༄dngos/ /snang ba bzang pos rnam par mdzes/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'ichagasung yang yin/ /zhing gi dra ba bsam mi khyab/ /rin chen cod pan sna tshogs dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan rnams dang / /gdan blalas de bzhin la la byung / /'od dang sprul pa'ang rab tu 'gyed/ /tsan dan phye ma sna tshogs dang / /mdzod spu'i 8rnam par snang ba'i 'od/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyi / tsho'od zer rnams/ /zhing rnams 'byung ba rab tu brjod/ /la la rgyan dang 'od gcig par/ /zhing rnams dri ma med pa hunyesnang / /la la rgyanamakhyernams thams cad kyis/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rab tu brgyan( 3/ /la la zhing rnams bcu dag gi/ /rgyan gyis mngon par rab tu brgyan/ /la la zhing rnams stong 35—320

dag kyang / /rnam par brgyan cing rab tu gnas/ /zhing gi rgyan mang byamanyu)ba yis / /zhing rnams la la rnam par bres/mi/ /rgyan dang tshul rnams tha dad par/ /sna tshogs mig yor lta bur snang / /brjod du med pa'i zhing gi rnams/ /rgyan gcigakhul yang rab tu snang / /'od ni gzhanas)dang gzhan bkye ba/ /sangs rgyas smon lam mthu las byung / /smon lam rgya mtsho rnamasasnyimang bas/ /zhing rnams la la rnam par sbyangs/ /de dag rgyan mang thams cad du/ /zhing gi rgya mtsho shin tu snang / /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyis(ye/ /zhing rnams yongs su gang sbyangs pa/ /de dag kun la dus gsum gyime/ /zhing gi rgyan rnams kun kyang snang / /zhing gi rgyud kyi rnam sprul pa/ /kye ma rgyal sras khyed ni 58)ltos/ /ma 'ongasalgepa yi zhing rnams kyang / / rmi lam bzhin 3 )du de dag snang / /ji snyed phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi37/ /'das pa'i zhing rnams rgya mtsho yang /zhing gcigatshwanyenang na thams cad snang / /mig yor bzhin du sprul pa yin/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lha/ /rnam sprul zhing rnams gang yod pa/ /zhing gi rgyud ni 'di la snang / /kun kyang nang na yod par gnas/ /zhing gi rdul gyi rtse mo la/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rnam 'phrul pa/ / shong bas8de dag kun nasasnyisnang / /mig yor mtshan nyid med pa'o/ /la la rgya mtsho'i dbyibs su 'dugayi /zhing brgyal)mang po de dag ltos/ /ri rab ri yi 32dbyibs 'dra dang ske/ /'jig rten khams ni bsam mi khyab/ /zhing rnams la la rnam par bris//myig yor dbyibs 3)su gnas pa ste/ /sna tshogs shing gi dbyibs ni su gnas/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang kun tu khyab rto/ /zhing rnams nor bum ge'akhor lo'i dbyibs/ /la la pad ma'i〈nyedabyibs su gnas/ /yan lag brgyad pa sna tshogs mang / /sna 35—321

tshogs kha dog dri ma med/ /la la khri yi dbyibs lta bu/ / grwa yi 3)dbyibs dang khyad khyud de/ /la la grong khyer dbyibs su 'dug /tshangs pa'i lus su rab tu gnas/ / lha yi dbang po'i na gtsug phud dbyibs/ /zla ba kham7ltar la la gnas / /nor bu'i ri yi dbyibs su 'khod/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbyibs kyang 'dra/ /spos chu ri mtsho yi klong lta bu 5ci/ /'jig rten khams rnams rab tu gnas / / 'od kyi dkyil phyi 'khor dbyibs 'dra ba/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis )sbyangs/ /'khor lo bkra shis dbyibs lta bu/ /'jig rten la la dkyil 'khor de/ /mdzod spu spyi gtsug nadabyibs lta bu/ /la la mig gi tshul yang 'dra//sangs rgyas phyag gi dbyibs lta bu/ /la la rishe)rdo rje'i dbyibs su 'dug /'od 'phro ri yi 1 dbyibs kyang 'dra/ /byang chub sems dpas nyutekun tu gang / /zhing rnams la la seng ge'i dbyibs/ /nor bu'i go car mngon par bsgrubs(rte/ /gzugs dang dbyibs ni du ma ste/ /gzugs rnams kun gyis nyunyerab tu gnas/ /zhing gi rgyud ni gcig la yang / /zhing gi dbyibs rnams mi zad pa/ /rab tu gnas pa nyu byin rlabs dang / /sangs rgyas smon 8lam rnams kyis byung / /zhing rnams la la bskal pa tsams/ /la la bskal pa bcu pa ste/ /zhing rnams la la rdul mnyam pa'i/ /bskal pa bye bar brjod pa yin/ /la la bskal pa gcig la yang ske/ /zhing rnams mang po 'byung ba lha snang / /tshad med grangs kyang med pa ste12rka/ /'jig 19pa de bzhin bsam mi khyab/ /zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas med//zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas bcas/ /la la'i 3 )zhing na sangs rgyas gcig /la la sangs rgyas mang po'o 1/ /sangs rgyas med pa'i zhing rnams dang / /'jig rten gzhan gyi khams su yang / /sangs rgyas sprul pa gshegs mdzad cing / /35wa 322

rnam par 'phrul pa rab tu ston/ /'pho dang 'byung dang sku tshe dang / /byang chub mngon par 'tshang rgya dang / /bdud kyi sde dag 'dul ba dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor7ba ston/ /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin du ci/ /gzugs rnams sna tshogs kun kyang ston/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor /ba/ /'jig rten kun na tha mi dad/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams re rerangagayang / /rgyal ba gcig ni skyer riga'agyur te/ /lo grangs bye ba phrag stong du/ /chos kyi dam pa rab tu ston/ /sems can snod du ma gyur la/ /sangs rgyas ston pa mi mdzad do me/ /sangs rgyas bsam dang ldan pas ni/ /de nyid gcig kyang kun tu mthong / /sangs rgyas mang po'i zhing gi rnams/ /zhing rnams re re dag tu yang / /sangs rgyas bye ba bsam mi khyab/ /rgyal ba rnams ni rab tu skye/ /rgyal ba so so de dag nan/ /sprul pa mang po rab 'gyed cing / /chos kyi dbyings ni khyab mdzad nas/ /sems can rgya mtsho 'dul ba mdzad/ /zhing rnams la la 'od med de/ /mun pa 'jigs pa shin tu che/ /reg na sdug bsngal spu gri 'ad9)/ /blta na mi bzad skyi 1 yang g.ya'/ /zhing rnams la la lha 'od can/ /la la khyim gyi71nya'od can te/ /la la nyirwa zla'i 'od dang ldan/ /zhing gi dra ba bsam mi khyab/ /zhing rnams la la rang gi 'od/ /shing gi 'od can dri ma med/ /gang du sdug bsngal 1lhami mthong ba//de dag sems can dge las nyu tshobyung / /la la ri yi tsha'od can te7/ /zhing rnams la la nor bu'i /rte'od/ /la la mar me'i 'od can te/ /sems can rnams kyi las kyis hu byung / /zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas 'od/ /byang chub sems dpas77kun tu gang / /zhing rnams la la pad mo'i 'od/ /'od 'phro 'od can rab tu mdzes/ /zhing rnams la la me tog 'od/ /spos chu'i 2 'od 35wa 323

dang ldan pa'ang yodamatsho/ /spos dang bdug patshaba'od 'phro can/ / smon lam dbang gis gernam par sbyangs/ /zhing rnams la la sprin 'od can/ /nor bu'i go ca'i 'od kyis gsalag/ /sangs rgyas byin gyi rlabs kyis snang / /yid du 'ong ba'i sgra dbyangs ldan/ /rin chen cod pan 'od dang ldan/ /rdo rje gser gyi 'od kyis 5snang / /yongs su dag pa'i sgra dbyangs can/ /de dag na ni sdug bsngal med/ /thams cad rgyan gyi 'od can dang / /zhing rnams la la nor bu'i 'od / /la la snying po byang chub 'od/ /'khor rnams kun tu rab tu snang / /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i snang ba can/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyis kun nas 0yog /kun tu 'od kyis rab tu snang / /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ / zhing rnams la la me yi 'od/ /47)zhing rnams la la 'jigs〈sgra can/ /mi zadaphro'ajigs pa'i nga ro can/ /rtsub cing brlang ba'i sgra rnams dang / /yid myong 'jigs pa chen po sgrog /dmyal ba byol song skye5) gnas dang / /gshin rje'i 11'jig rten sdug bsngal 12rnams/ /mya ngan rgya mtsho'i zhing gi rnams/ /nyon mongs ldan pa'i sgra yang 'byung / /la la dag na〈nyeyid 'ong sgra/ /dga' bar byed cing ston 'dems tshapa/ /bde 8ba'i las rnamasatso'abras bu'i dbyangs//zhing gi 'khor na rab tu sgrog /la la brgya byin lha dbang dbyangs/ /gzhan dag 1 tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs te/ /'jig rten kun gyi dbyangs su yang / /la la'i zhing na rab tu grag1snye /zhing rnams la la sprin gyi sgra/ /rin chen rgya mtsho7)'od zer dang / /nor bur du ༷shing gi gzugs sgra dang / /rol mo'i nyesgra yis kun tu khyab/ /'od zer klong gi sgra rnams dang / /sangs rgyas sprul pa mi zad dang ske/ /byang chub sems pa'i sa sgra dag dang / /'od zer sgra ni snyan pa 'byung / /35—324

chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgra rnams dang / /kha cig zhing na bsam yas pa'i/ /smonamanya lam rgya mtsho'i nga ro dang / /spyod pa'i sgra yang snyan paralami'abyung / /dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor mang po dang / /de dag zhing rnams 'byung ba'i sgra/ /zad pa med pa'i dbyangs su sgrogal /sangs rgyas rnams kyi stobs sgra dang / /tshad med sa dang pha rol phyin/ /chos kyi rang bzhin sgra dag kyang / /kha cig zhing na rab tu grag /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyibya/ /sgra ni zhing rnams bye ba 'byin/ /bskal par gnas shing rab tu sgrog /sgra dbyangs 'byin pa zad mi shes/ /zhing gi dbyings 5/rnams la la na / /sangs rgyas rnam par sprul pa yi/ /sgra yis chos kyi dbyings bkang ba/ /de dag kun nas gyerab tu gragatso /98)'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rnam par dgod pa shin tu bstan pa ⑨zhes bya ba ste/ le'u dgu pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/3 ) bam po bcu gnyis pa/ rigs kyi bu dag sngon 'das pa'i bskal 31pa 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol de bas kyang pha snga'i dus de'i tshe de'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 32tshul dri ma med par phyogs kun 1 snang ba zhes bya ba'i dbus nanyuste/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpal gyi sgra zhes bya ba byung ste/'jig rten gyi khams skyidapal gyi sgra zhes bya ba de ni/ rin po che'i pad mo mang po'i rgya mtsho la rab tu gnas pa rnam par dag cing kun nas nyon mongs pa/'jig rten gyi khams ri rab kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba/kun nas zlum pa'i dbyibs su 'dug pa/ gzhi rgyan mtha' yas pas brgyan 7pa/35—325

rin po che sna tshogs kyi shing 1gi khor yug brgya phrag gsum gyis kun nas bskor ba/rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyi sprin gyis kun nas yog pa/ ri rab dang grong khyer dang / khang khyim dri ma med cing 'od rnam paradzabasnang bas brgyan pa/ zas dang skom dang / gos kyi longs spyod yid kyis bsams gepas 'byung ba rgyan ④gyi rnam pa brjod 5pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa zhig ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpal gyi sgra zhes bya ba de'i dbus na/ spos chu'i rgya mtsho 'od rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de las me tog gi 46ri rab me tog 'od 'phro ba'i rgyan gyi rgyal ⑦mtshan zhes bya ba/ rin po che'i khri 'phangangagebacu'i 'khor gyis bskor cing brgyan pa zhig byung ste/ ri rab de'i steng na nags tshal po)chen po yal ga'i dkyil 'khor rin po che'i me tog rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ spos kyi rgyal mtshan stong phrag dpag tu med pa shin tu bsgrengs pa'i hu )rgyan can(1/ me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa dpag tu med pa'i phreng ba rnam par bres pa/ nor bu'i hu khang pa brtsegs pa rnam par bkod pa/ rin po che'i rdo rje'i hunyergyal mtshan dpag tu med pas kun tu skyabargyan pa/ rin po che'i me tog pun da ri 8ka dpag tu med pa'i phreng ba dag gis 7kun nas bskor ba/ spos dang / rin po che'i pad mo mang po dpag tu med pas kun 1 tu brgyan pa/ rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra yid du 'ong ba'i sprin dpag tu med pas kun tu nyu rirgyas pa/ spos dang bdug pa'i 'od 'phro ba'i sprin dpag tu med pas kun tu 19snang bar byas pa/ grong khyer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu sems can sna tshogs snang bas kun nas bskor ba ste/ 'di ltar nags tshal chen po yal 2 ga'i dkyil 'khor rin po che'i me tog rgyas pa zhes bya ba/de'i shar phyogs logs na grong khyer chen po 'od 'phro snang ba zhes bya ba mi yi rgyal 35—326

po'i gnas grong khyer (7brgya stong phrag bcu'i ci 'khor gyis bskor ba/ rin po che 'ba' zhig las byas pa chu dang zheng cadu dpag tshad stong phrag bdun yod pa/rin po che ⑤sna tshogs kyi shing tags 6dang / phru ma'i ra ba bdun gyis brgyan cing kun nas bskor ba/ rin po che'i 'obs spos kyi na/chus gang ba/ rin po che'i me tog utpa la dang / padmo dang / ku mu da 8dang / me tog pun da ri spyo kus rnam par brgyan pa bdun gyis kun nas bskor ba/ shing ta la'i phreng ba rgyan rnam pa0) sna tshogs kyi tshogs mang po 'byin pa bdun gyis kun nas bskor ba/rin po che'i rgyan dang khang bu 37brtsegs pas rab tu brgyan 12pa/ steng nas gser gyi dra ba dang / dril 1 bu'i dra ba dang / me tog gi phreng ba'i dra ba dang / ind+ra 45nyela'i dra ba dang / rdo rje 15pad mo'i dra bas kun nas yog las/ rin po che'i shing drung me tog gi dra ba dang / rol mo'i sgra mang po thams cad kyi sprin yid du 'ong bas kun tu khyab pa/ spos dang phreng ba'i lha rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan (2pa yod de/ de'i 'khor kun na 19sgo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu yod de/ sgo de dag thams cad kyang rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa ste / sgo de dag re re'i mdun ni )yang rin po che 21rdo yi rgyal mtshan rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bdun bdun gyis 22brgyan pa'o/ /bza' shing gi ra ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcus kyang kun nas bskor ba ste/ bza' shing gi ra ba de dag thams cad kyang spos dang rin po che'i shing sna tshogs las /spos kyi dri kun tu byung ( steb bya sna tshogs nideyid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'byin pa'o/ /grong khyer chen po 'od 'phro ba'i sprin ces bya ba der myi 9skyes pa thams cad kyang las kyi rnam par smin pas rdzu 'phrul thob pa dag ste/ nam mkha' las rgyu ba mi dang lha mnyam du 35—327

spyod pa/ yid bzhin gyi yul la7longs spyod pa sha stag go/ /de nas〈lho phyogs logs na lha yi zhugrong khyer shing gi me tog sna tshogs zhes ④bya ba yod do/ /de nas lho phyogs logs gnyen klu'i grong khyer kun tu rdzogs pa zhes bya ba yod do/ /de nas lho phyogs logs na gnod sbyin gyi grong khyer rdo rje'i dpal sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan 46)zhes bya ba yod do/ /de nas lho phyogs logs ⑦na dri za'i grong khyer gzhal med khang bzang po zhes bya ba yod do/ /de dang 'dab chags su lha ma yin gyi grong khyer 'khor lo'i tshon ces bya ba yod do/ /de dang 'dab chags su 'dab ma bzang po'i grong khyer rin po che sna tshogs bzang po'i lte ba zhes bya ba yod do/ /de dang 'dab chags su bram ze'i grong khyer rgyan bzang po sna tshogs zhes 3)bya ba yod de/ de dag la stsogs ⑨pa grong khyer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'o/ /grong khyer de dag re re zhing yang rgyan mang po du mas brgyan pa nyu ༷nas grong khyer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i bar du ste/ nags tshal chen po yal ga'i dkyil 'khor rin po che'i me tog rgyas pa zhes bya ba de'i dbus na/ snying po5nyabyang chub rin po che'i me tog rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba rin po che thams cad kyi shing hurte/ yal ga stug cing rgya che ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas pas kun nas bskor ba/ rin po che'i me tog gzugs dang / dbyibs rnam pa tha dad pa mang po shin tu rgyas pa spos dang mar me nyugerin po che thams cad kyi nyu9kha dog ltar 'dug pa'i phreng ba mang po rgya chen po'i sprin kun tu bkram nyu2pa/ rin po che'i 'od thur du 'phro bas zhing7kun turwa 7khyab pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i sprin gyis brgyan pa/ phyogs bcu 'od zer mang pos rnam par snang bar byas pa tsho/shergyan thams cad rin po cherwa1sna tshogs 35—328

mang pos spras pa/ rol mo thams cad kyi sgra dbyangs shin tu 'byungatub/ nor bu'i rgyal po thams cad las byang chub sems dpa'i lus 'byung ba/ phyogs bcur me tog sna tshogs mang po rab tu 'byung ba yod de/ de'i mdun50du pad mo chen po me tog gi ze ba 'od 'phro ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba rgyar〈midapag tshad bye ba phrag brgya yod pa/ rtsa ba spos dang rin po che dang rdo rje'i⑧rgya mtsho la zug pa/ chu ba 0rin po che sna tshogs kyi tshon ⑥gyis rnam pa sna tshogs su gyur pa/rin po che rnam pa tha dad pa tshad med pa'i 'dab tsom can/ rin po che (kye'od 'phro ba dang / spos kyi ze ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa/ snying po la rin po che kha dog mtha' yas pa'i tshon bkye ba pad mo'i dkyil 'khor brjod du med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ phyogs bcur 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rgya chen po rab tu 'gyed pa/ ze ba thams cad las yid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'byung ba mngon par byung ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams dpal gyi sgra zhes bya ba der/ de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste/de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed de dag las bskal pa'i thog ma pa thams cad kyi thog mar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa ni yon tan thams cad kyi ri bo ri rab kyi dbyangs lashes bya ste/ des 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i tshul dri ma med par phyogs kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba 'di yongs su sbyangs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'jig rten gyi khams dpal gyi sgra zhes bya ba der lo brgya na/de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ngo zhes bya ba'i tshe/ nags tshal chen po yal ga'i dkyil 'khor rin po che'i me tog rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ de yang rgyan thams cad 35—329

kyis brgyan ①par gyur te/ 'di ltar rin po che'i 'od 'phro ba'ishesprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa rab tu gtong ba'i snying po can du gyur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgra yang rab tu 'byin/ phyogs bcushedag kyang 'od zer gyi dra bas rnam par snang bar byed/ gzhal med khang dang khang khyim gyi grong rdalasathams cad kyang rab tu snang bar byed/ rin po che'i me tog dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin yang rab tu 'gyed/ sems can thams cad kyi sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yangs pa'i sgra dang / dus gsum gyi de bzhin (shegashegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan gyi 'khor lo rab tu mthong 46)ba'i sgra dang / byang chub sems dpa' tso thams cad kyi smon lam dang / spyod pa (shedang 'byung ba mngon par bsgrub ⑨pa'i sgra dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo'i nges pa'i tshig sna tshogs rab tu bsgrag 1 7pa'i sgra dag kyang rab tu 'byin to/ /de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba'i ltas te/ rgyan de dag byung bsngo2'jig rten gyi khams der de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar 'jig rten gyi dbang po rnams kyisatshwanyekhong du chud do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa las mnyan nyi pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin pa dang / sangs rgyas blta bar mos pa dang snying po byang chub tu mngon par gzhol ba de dag thams cad kyang ltas mngonatshamadu byung bas yang dag par bskul tos / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa / tshoyon tan thams cadasnyikyi ri bo ri rab kyi dpal sna/zhes bya ba mnyam pa nyid kyis chos kyi dbyings kun tu khyab pa'i sku can sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du yongs su skye ba (3 rab tu 'phros pa sku snying po byang chub thams cad la bzhugs pa/ gzugs kyi sku mtha' dang dbus med par 31rnam par dag pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du mngon par 35wa 330

'phags shing zil gyis gnon pa/ mtshan rin po che'i me tog thams cad shin tu rgyas pa/ sems can thams cad kyi gnas su gzugs brnyan rab tu 'byung ba/'gro ba thams cad la mngon du ston pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa kha dog mtha' yas pa'i sprin gyis ①da ba rab tu 'gyed pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams ②'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis khyab par mdzad pa/ 'od zer kyi dra ba kha dog mtha' yas pa rab tu gtong ba de pad mo chen po de la7mngon par byungasnyibar gyur to/ /ji ltar spos chu'i rgya mtsho rnam par dag pa'i 'od la rab tu gnas pa'i ri rab me tog gi 'od 'phro bas brgyan5shepa'i rgyal mtshan gser shin tu 'bar ba'i rgyan ces bya ba'i rtse mo la/ nags tshal chen po yal ga'i dkyil 'khor rin po che'i me tog rgyas par sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams dpal gyi sgra kun tu yang ri rab bye ba stong phrag drug cu 4)rtsa brgyad kyi rtse mo la bzhugs par kun na ⑦snang ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho kun tu tshul rgya che bshekun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam du'o)klas pa dag gi 7gling bzhi pa thams cad na'ang snying po byang chub la bzhugs par snang ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan thams cad kyi ri bo ri rab dpal gyi sprin gyi hunyamin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas 'od gzer hu dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su skyed pa zhes bya ba 'od zer sangs rgyas kyi zhing / zhingal gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba rab tu bkye ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par mdzad nas/ 'dul ba thams cad yang dag par bskul to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan thams cad kyi ri bo ri rab dpal gyi sprin 35—331

gyis 'od zer de dag bkye ma thag tu/ de'i mod la sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad kyang rab tu zhi bar gyur/ sgrib ①pa'i dra ba thams cad kyang shin tu bsayokye/ sangs rgyas blta ba la sgribalgepa'i ri thams cad kyang rnam par bcom/ sems can thams cad kyi rnyog pa yang rnam par dag /dge ba (brgya mtsho thams cad kyang rab tu byung / mos pa yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor yang yongs su dag /mi khom pa dang / ngan song dang / ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa dang / 'jigs pa thams cad kyang rnam par bstsa'akha/ lus dang sems kyi gnod pa thams cad kyang rab tu zhi/ sangs rgyas mthong bas dga' ba'i shugs kyang rnam par dag /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rab tu gzhol ba yang shin tu thob par gyur te/ de dag 'od gzer⑥des yang dag par bskulasheb dang / 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad 'khor brgya stong du ma dag gis bskor cing / bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der 'dong bar gyur to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la grong khyer chen po 'od 'phro ba'i 'od gces bya ba der rgyal po blta na dga' ba shin tu gtsangasheba'i blo gros shes bya ba/ grong khyer bye ba khrag khrig brgya 8stong phrag bcu'i bdag po byung ste/ de la bud med bsod nams kyi dpal la (1rtsogs pa stong phrag sum 3)cu rtsa bdun yod do/ /de la bu gzi brjid nyurtechen po la7༄stsogs pa lnga brgya yod do/ /rgyal po'i bu gzi brjid chen po la yang bud med blta na bzang ba la skostsogs pa stong phrag bcu yod do/ /de nas rgyal po hu9gzhon nu gzi brjid chen pos sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa〈nyemathong nas sngon gyi dge ba'i rgyus tsho/)chos bcu khong du chud par gyur to/ /bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor ces bya ba'i ting nge 35—332

'dzin khong du chud do/ /'di lta ste sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi dbyings la sgo kun nas rab tu 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin7khong du chud do/ /'di lta ste tshul yangs pa'i sprin gyi snying po zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khong du chud do / /'di lta ste/ 'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba'i rgyan chen po zhes bya ba'i byams pa chen po khong du chud do/ /'di lta ste sgra yi sprin gyis kun tu7rgyas par byed pa zhes bya ba'i snying rje chen po khong du chud do/ /'di lta ste yon tan mtha' dang dbus ①med pas yang dag par 'phags pa zhes bya ba ④dga' ba chen po khong du chud do⑤/ /'di lta ste chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i btang snyoms chen po khong du chud do/ /'di lta ste tshul gyi gzhi rgya chen posargya mtsho'isngonasnying po zhes bya ba'i mngon par shes pa chen po khong du chud do/ /'di lta ste mos pa rgya mtsho'i stobs dang shugs rnam par 'phel bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i smon lam gyi tshul gyi0)sgo chen po khong du chud do/ /'di lta ste thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi 'od la yang dag par gzhol ba'i shugs zhes bya ba tha dad paloshesayang dag par shes tu )pa'i ye shes chen po'i sgo khong du chud do/ /de nas rgyal po gzhon nu gzi brjid (rtechen po zhes bya ba de chos kyi snang ba chen po thob nas/sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 'khor gyirwartetshogs thams cad la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ nyi ma mang po stong gi rnams/ /mkha' la mngon par 'phags pa bzhin / /snying po byang chub dri med la/ /sangs rgyas 'od ni shin tu snang5)/ /bskal pa bye ba stong dag gishi/ /mgon po 'jig rten byung ba ni/ /sangs rgyas yang dag skyes pa rnams/ /rgyal ba kun na 8rab tu snang / /ltos 8shig sangs rgyas 'od zer la/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni bsam mi khyab/ /gnas rnams kun na 35—333

kun kyang snang / /de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam par gzhag3) /'od 'phro(1sprin rnams rab bkye geb/ /'od zer sprinasrel zad mi shes/ /'jig rten 'di dag snang bar byed/ /sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul la ltos/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku dag las/ /'od gzerashernams ni dri med pa/ /sems can kun dang mnyam pa'i lus/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rgyas 'gengs ltos/ /sangs rgyas gsung〈yeni yid 'ong ba/ /'gro ba kun tu rab tu bsgrags/ /'gro kun dbyangs kyi7yan lag tu/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rnam par brjod/ /sangs rgyas 'od kyis phog pa yi59/ /sems can kun kyang bde bar gyur/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi/ /'gro ba kun hu 5kyang dga' ba skyesanyunyu/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sprin gyi rnamasanyuge/ /rin chen sprin rnams rab 'gyed cing / /bstod 8pa'i sprin gyis rgyal ba'i drung / /phyogs bcu kun nas mngon par 'ong / /snying po byang chub 'di la yang / / sgra yi nyu6rgya mtsho zab mo gragatunye /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal zhi/ /sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul la ltos/ /kun kyang srim/nyezhu ldan gyur te/ /dga' shing shin tu mos byas shing / /chos kyi rgyal po bltarwa'eba'i phyir//'jig rten mgon po'i (ske /drung du 'dong / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag rgyal bu gzhon nu gzi brjid chen pos tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis (nye'ajig rten gyi khams dpal gyi sgra thams cad kyi sems can gyi gnas kun tu shin tu grag ni par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po blta na dga' ba shin tu gtsang 28ba'i blo gros kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag thos nas dga' ba chen po skyes te/ rang gi 'khor de dag la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ zhang blon rnams dang gzhon nu dang / /rgyal po'i mi dang blon po dang / /tshong sa pa 35—334

rnams dang de bzhin du/ /yul mi rnams kyang kun 'dus shig /grong khyer rnams ni kun tu yang / /rnga sgra dag gis0)myur du sgrogs/ /kun kyang 'thunamasapar lhan cig tu/ /rgyal ba blta ba'i phyir dengs ①shig /sung rnams thams cad kun tu yang / /dge ba'i dril gyi sgra sgrogs ④shig /bu dang chung ma rige'akhor bcas pa/ /rgyal ba blta ba'i phyir yang 'dong / /grong khyer rnams kyang brgyan par gyis/ /rgyan rnams kun tu bla re bresayi/ /rgyal mtshan dam pa bzang po'i rnams/ /nor bu sna tshogs brgyan par lnga/sgreng / /rin chen dra ba'i bla re rnams/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du bre bar kyigyis/ /nam mkha'acha'adi las thams cad du/ /sil snyan sprin gyi sgra dag phyung / /lam gyi srang yang brgyan par gyis/ /rin chen char yang kun tu phob/ /bzhon 3)pa rin chen bstad par gyis(nye/ /rgyal ba blta ba'i phyir 'dong ngo / /rang rang so so'i 'khor rnams kyis8/ /sna tshogs sprin gyi char phob shig / rgyan gyi hustesprin rnams thams cad kyis/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyang dgab par gyis(ge/ /spos dang pad mo5)'od kyi sprin/ /me tog gdugs rnams bsam yas dang / /se mo do dang phreng sprin dang hurte/ /gos kyi sprin gyi char phob shig /ri rab rnams dang spos kyi ri/ /nor bu'i 'khor los brgyan par gyis8/ /dri med tsan dan phye ma 37rnams / /nam mkha'i dkyil la rab tu ston/ /nor bu'i phreng ba du )me tog phreng 31/ /rin chen phreng ba dri med dang / /rin chen sgron gyi phreng ba ri rternams/ /nam mkha'i dbyings la bsgrub (nyepar gyis/ /thams cad sangs rgyas mngon gyis la / /dga' zhing spro ba'i sems bskyed de/ /bu dang 'khor du ri stobacas pa'i dgernams / /rgyal ba blta 39phyir kun 'dong ngo / /de nas rgyal po sa blta na dga' 35wa 335

ba shin tu gtsangatuba'i bdag po bsod nams dpal la stsogs pa bud med stong phrag sum cu rtsa bdun dang / gzi brjid chen po la sogs pa gzhon nu lnga brgya dang ske/ blo gros kyi stobs lasakhestsogs pa blon po stong phrag drug cu dang / de dag lakhustsogs pa 'khor bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bdun cu rtsa bdun gyisakyibaskor cing mdun tu bdar0te grong khyer chen po 'od 'phro snang ba nas byung nas sde'i 'khor dang bcas pa ⑦nam mkha'i dbyings gsu mngon par 'phags te/rgyal po'i7rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / rgyal po'ichamathu chen pos/ nam mkha' thams cad rgyan gyi sprinatshwarmethams cad kyis hunyernam par brgyan te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong tunyenas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/phyogs gcigasatu 'khod do/ /lha'i grong khyer shing gi me tog sna tshogs7shes bya ba nas kyang7lha'i dbang po rab mtshe nyu tshoma'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba lha bye ba khrag khrig brgyal stong dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das gang na brwanyeder dong ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /klu'i〈nye grong khyer kun tu rdzogs pa nas kyang klu'i rgyal po bcu dri ma myed pa'i 'od ces bya ba klu bye ba nyi shu rtsa lnga dang lhan cig5 teganod sbyin gyi grong khyer rdo rje'i dpal rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba nas kyang gnod sbyin gyi bdag po dpa' bas rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnod sbyin sa bye ba bdun cu rtsa bdun dang lhan cig /dri za'i grong khyer gzhal med khang bzang po nas kyang dri za'i rgyal po blta na dga' ba zhes bya ba dri za bye bsngo stedagu bcu rtsa bdun dang lhan cig ge /lha ma yin gyi grong khyer 'khor lo'i tshon nas kyang lha ma yin gyi dbang po gzugs rnam par dag pa las sems pa zhes bya ba lha ma yin bye ba stong phrag lnga brgya'i 'khor gyis bskor ba dang lhan cig nam 35—336

mkha' lding gi grong khyer rin po che sna tshogs bzang po'i lte ba nas kyang nam mkha' lding gi dbang ①po stobs bcu spyod pa zhes bya ba nam mkha' lding gi 'khor dgu ( gubacu rtsa dgu dang lhan gcig mi'am ci'i grong khyer rtse ba'i dga' ba dang ldan pa nas kyang mi'am ci'i dbang po rdo rjesadapal zhes bya ba mi'am ci bye ba phrag bco brgyad dang lhan cig /lto 'phye chen po'i grong khyer rin po che rdo rje sra ba'i rgyal mtshan nas kyang lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po rin po che grags pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba lto 'phye chen po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag gsum dang lhan cig /tshangs pa'i grong khyer rgyan bzang po sna tshogs nas kyang tshangs pa'i ⑦dbang po gzhan gyis pham pa med du pa zhes bya ba tshangs pa bye ba phrag bcashebargyad kyi 'khor gyis bskor cing mdun du byas te/ bcom ldan 'das yon tan thams cad kyi ri bo ri rab kyi dpal ⑩de bzhin gshegs pa gang na ba der dong nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig77tu 'khod do/ /de dag la7rtsogs pa grong khyer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grong khyer gyi 'khor dang bcas pa dag nas sems can gyi ris tha dad pa na gnas pa'i rgyal po mang po 'khor dang bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ phyogs gcig5nyetu 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan thams cad kyi ri bo ri rab kyi dpal gyisalgesems can de dag 'dul ba'i dbang nye bar bzung ⑩ste/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgya mtsho der dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag par 'byung ba'i chos rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba mdo'i tso'akhor 'jig rten gyi khams kyisngo rmerdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang bcas pa 3)bsam pa ci7)lta ba bzhin du sems can 35—337

rnams la yongs su bstan shenato/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid chen pos chos kyi gzhung zhu'adi bstan pa thos nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan thams cad kyi ri bo tshiri rab kyi dpalakhugyis sngon yang dag par bsgrubs ④pa'i chos rgya mtsho la chos kyi snang ba rab tu thob bo/ /'di lta ste chos thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo la ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu thob po/ /'di lta ste/ thoganyem chos thams cad la yang dag par gzhol ba'i byang chub kyi sems la gnas pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu thob po / /'di lta ste chos kyi dbyings kyi phyogs rnam dushepar snang ba'i snying po'i mig rnam par dag pa la ye shes kyi ri9)snang ba rab tu thob po/ /'di lta ste sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sna )rgya mtsho rab tu snang zhing rnam par dbye ba'i smon 3skyelam rgya mtsho la ye shes kyi 32snang ba rab tu thob po/ /'di lta ste yon tan chen po rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus 1 med pa rnam par dag pa la rab tu 'jug pa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la ye shes kyi rnyisnang ba rab tu thob po/ /'di lta ste sgo yangasalapa nas snang ba zab mo yang dag par 'byung ba rgya mtsho la ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu thob po/ /'di lta ste phyir mi ldog pa'i stobs chen po'i shugs kyi snying po dang mthu chen po'i rgya mtsho la ye shes kyi the tshosnang ba rab tu thob po/ /'di lta ste chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus hu med par sprul pas brgyan cing 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la ye shes kyi kyi(snang ba rab tu thob po/ /'di lta ste yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho tshad med pa rab tu zhu tsho'ajug pa la mngon par bsgrub pa rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyi snang ba rukārab tu thob bo/ /'di lta ste sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par dmyigs shing mos pa rgya mtsho sprin gyis rgyan 22yang dag par bsgrubarmānyepa rgya mtsho la 35wa 338

ye shes kyi ①snang ba rab tu thob bo/ /'di lta ste chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus7med pa dang / mnyam par de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par dmyigs par bya ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad mngon du bstan pa dang sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho la ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu thob po/ /'di lta ste sangs rgyas kyi chos stobs dang / mi 'jig⑧pa thams cad la ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu thob po / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan thams cad kyi ri bo ④ri rab kyi dpaladzabagyi sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho la ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu thob nas/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis rinade'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rgyal ba'i chos nyid 'di thos nas/ /bdag gisheye shes snang ba skyes/ /desangs ni sangs rgyas sngon spyod pa/ /rgya mtsho rnams kyang rab tu mthong / /sku tshe kun tu ji lta bur/ /phun sum tshogs gyur tshekun kyang mthong / /mtshan gyi rnam pa rnams lha )dmigs dang / /gang gi 37sangs rgyas mchod pa'ang shes/ /sngon chad sangs rgyas drung dag tu/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod spyad de/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mang mchod nas/ /zhing gi rgya mtsho yongs su sbyangs/ /sku yi rgya mtsho mang po dag / rgya chen hurteyongs su kun btang zhing / /spyod pa'i dam pa rab spyad nyusnyede/ /rgya mtsho'i zhing yang shin tu sbyangs / /snyan dang shangs tshamang rgya mtsho dang / /phyag zhabs dbu 8yang de bzhin te/ /rgyal srid btsun mo'i 'khor btang zhing / /zhing gi rgya mtsho yongs su sbyangs/ /zhing rnams so so re re la/ /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /byang chub spyod pa rab spyodatsha8de/ /zhing gi rgya mtsho rab tu sbyangs/rte/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyisahunye/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho kun spyad /rtenas/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 35wa 339

kun drung7du/ /zhing gi rgya mtsho rab tu sbyangs/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od snang bas//nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba bzhin/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'od snang bas/ /sngon gyi spyod pa rnams kyang mthong / /byang chub 'tshang rgya zhi ba yin②/ /chos kyi dbyings ni kun gang ba'i/ /zhing gi77rgya mtsho dag pa'i rnams/ /dri med 'od can kun kyang mthong / /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ /zhing gi rgya mtsho yangs pa'i rnams/ /de ltar bdag gis sbyang bar ④bya/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid chen pos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan thams cad kyi ri bo ri rab dunadapal gyis(9sprin de mthong ba dang / bsnyen bkur ba dang / mchod pas de bzhin gshegs pa las mngon par khong du chud de/ 'jig rten thams cad ni snang bar byed/ sngon gyi57sbyor ba rgya mtsho ni rab tu brjodani/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 47rgya mcho'i tshul ni rab tu sgrog /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i tshul ni shin tu brjod(2 / chos kyi dbyings thams cad la yang dag par gzhol ba'i (1ye shes kyi sgo yongs su sbyang ba ni shin tu ston/snying po byang chub thams cad la mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i〈nyernam par 'phrul pa ni rab tu brjod(ge/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs dang mi bsnyengs pa dang / ye shes tha mi dad pa ni shin tu brjodas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku sgo kun nas rnam par dmigs shing mthong ba ni rab tu brjod8/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing ⑩rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyi shin tu ston/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa mtha' dang dbus 32med pa'i rgyan ni rab tu ston byang chub sems dpa'5)kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang / smon lam ni mngon par bsgrub 6)pa byed cing /35—340

sems can ri rab kyi ①rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byang chub tu sems bskyed de/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'ang yongs su 'dzin du btsud ②do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan thams cad kyi ri bo ri rab dpal gyi sprin gyis / byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid chen po la tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir / /byang chub don du khyod zhugs pa/ /gzi brjid chen po legs so legs/ /bsod nams snying po grags pa che/ /snang ba khyod kyis rab tu non/ /chos kyi dbyings ni khyab byas shing / /bsod nams chen po'i krusprin ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mchod par gyurage/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed du/ /zhing gcig na yang spyod spyad cing / /nga yi ye shes ji lta bur/ /khyod kyisalamathong ba de ltar 'gyur/ /tshul 'di kun nas shes par ni/ /brtson 'grus chung ngus mi nus te/ /brtson 'grus stobs chen ldan pa'i rnams/ /rgya mtsho'i〈pezhing rnams dag par byed/ /thams cad rdul la 'jug tshul du/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor su spyod pa/ /rgya mtsho'ipozhing gi rgyan gyi rnams/ /de la 'di 'drar rab tu 'gyur/ /sems can rnams ni re re'i phyir/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod spyad7cing / /'khor kyang skyo ba med pa'i rnams/ /de dag 'jig rten mgon77por 'gyur/ /bskal pa phyi ma'i mthar thug pa(1/ /rgyal ba re re〈nyemachod byed kyang / /gang gi sems la skyo med na(nye/ /de dag de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i mgon po kun/ /khyod kyi bosmon lam dbang gis gsalo8/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor rnams ni⑩/ /khyod kyi lus kyang rab tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi smon lam dag⑩ /mtha' dang dbus7/med rgya mtsho la/ /blo chen gang 35—341

rnams 'jug pa natu/ /de dag tshul 'dirwaluganas par 'gyur/ /nga sel mchod pa byas pas kyang / /gzi brjid chen podzabastobs chen gyis⑤/ /sems can ri rab rdul mnyam pastsornyi/ /byang chub yongs su smin par byas/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen dag4)ri /kun tu bzang poshedapa' ba'i rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings ni kun bkang zhing / /zhing gi rgya mtsho dag par byed/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la bskal pa rgya 9)chen po rig pa zhes bya ba de la bskal pa bar ma chu klung gang gā'i 1 5bye ma snyed cig 911byung ste/ de'i dus na mi rnams kyi tshe yang bskal pa bar ma gnyis thub par gyur te/ rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan thams cad nya kyi ri bo hu ri rab dpal gyi sprin 8de'i sku che'i tshad ni lo bye ba phrag lnga bcur gyur to/ /de yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyan bzang po'i〈gergyan gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du nags tshal chen po yal ga'i dkyil 'khor rin po che'i me tog rgyas pa de nyid la byung stes/ de bzhin gshegs pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyan bzang po rgyan gyi rgyal po de mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa rgyal bu gzhon nu gzi brjid chen pos mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang sgo rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa'i snying po zhes bya ba rab tu thob po/ /ye shes rgya chen po'i 1)byin gyi rlabs dang chos kyi klong 13gi gzungs kyang rab tu thob bo/ /kun gyi rjes su song bar 'gro ba 'dul ba'i rnam par thar pa zhes bya ba'i byams pa chen po yang rab tu thob bo/ /dmigs pa'i sgo'i sprin thams cad kyis rgyas par byed pa zhes bya ba'i snying rje chenatshwa/po yang rab tu thob bo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rgya mtsho dang byin gyi rlabs kyi mdzod ces bya ba'i dga' ba chen po yang rab tu thob bo/ /chos kyi rang 35—342

bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings tsho rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i btang snyoms michen po yang rab tu thob bo/ /rang bzhin dri ma med pa'i chos kyi dbyings yongs su dag pa'i lus zhes bya ba'i gshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang rab tu thob bo/ /chags ④pa med pa'i dbyings rnam par snang ba'i rjes su song ba gezhes bya ba'i mngon par shes pa yang rab tu thob bo6)/ /rab tu khong du chud (7)pas dri ma med pa'i klong dun)la yang dag par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i tha dad par yang dag par shes nya pa yang rab tu thob bo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 31dkyil 'khor yongs su dag par byed pa zhes bya ba'i ye shes nyugesnang ba yang rab tu thob bo/ /de dag la hu)stsogs pa chos kyi sgo stong phrag bcu kun nas non par gyur 0te/ de nas rgyal bu gzhon nu gzi brjid chen pos sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 15'khor gyi tshogs thams cad la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bskal pa bye ba bsam gyis mi khyab tu/ /'jig rten gtso bo'i tshadam pa shin tu dkon/ /sangs rgyas zhing 'di sems can thob rab lha thob/ /de dag sangs rgyas gnyis pa 'di yang mthong / /sangs rgyas sku las 'od rnams rab bkye ba/ /kha dog mtha' yas rgya mtsho nyusnyernam par dag /'od zer spyan 19gyis 'jig rten kun tu khyab / /kun tu rgyal ba'i yon tan grags par byed/ /'od kyis rig du dzha snapa rmad kyi dga' ba skye/ /'gro ba de dag kun gyi sdug bsngal zhitsho 1/ /phan tshun srid 32zhu byams pa'i sems gyur cing / /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul 'di dag kun kyang mthong ske/ /sprul pa'i dra ba /sprin rnams bsam mi khyab/ /rnam pa du ma'i 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams kun kyang gang byas shing / /sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul pa rab tu ston/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi spu rtse re re nas/ /35—343

dbyangs sprin bkye bas nam mkha' kun bkang0)zhing / /mun nag chen po kun nas snang bar byed/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal kun kyang rnam par sel/ /sangs rgyas dbyangs ni phyogs rnams bcu po na / /sems can rnams kyi sngon dge rgya mtsho rnams/ /thams cad dbyangs kyis ⑧kun tu sgra yang sgrog /sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul pa de dag ltos/ /sangs rgyas 'khor rnams rgya mtsho rgya che ba/ /mtha' dang dbus gemed yang dag rab tu byung / /de na rgyal ba chos kyi 'khor lo bskorarig / /sems can rgya mtsho mi zad rnams kyang 'dul/ /tshad med rnam par 'phrul pa dag la ltos46/ /zhing rnams kun na rgyal ba mngon par bzhugs/ /de ltar bde gshegs ye shes chags pa med/ /sems can don du rnam par mngon sangs rgyas/ /dga' zhing mos par kun kyang 'dod par gyisatso/ /bde ba'i yid dang srid rinazhu spro ba yis/ /bde gshegs de ni blta ba'i phyir 'dong ngo / /de mthong sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed byas shing / /'gro ba kun la byams pa'i sems 'gyur she)te/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam kun btab cing / /chos rgyal ji bzhin bdag cag 'gyur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis de'i sgra la thogs tu )pa med pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab par gyur te/ de thos pa'i sems can tshad med pa /1rnams kyang byang chub tu smon lam btab par gyur to/ /de yangatsopha dang ma dang lhan cig tu 'khor thams cad dang / sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya 32stong de dag gis bskor cing mdun du byas te/ rin po che'i gdugs kyi sprin lngas nam mkha' thams cad 1stekun nas yog par byas te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ngo / /'ongs pa de dag la bcom ldan 'das pha rol 35—344

tu phyin pa'i spyan bzang po brgyan hu)gyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin dri ma med pa'i rgyan ces bya ba'i mdo 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi mdo'i 'khor can yang dag par bstan to/ /des de thos nas tshul thams cad rnam par dag pa la 'jug par (nya'abyung ba ((rab tu skyes so/ /ye shes kyi rim pa rnam par dag cing dri ma med pa'i snang ba zhes bya ba yang non par gyur to/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor 'gro ba thams cad dga' bar lta ba'i rgyan ces bya bar ④yang zhugs par gyur to/ /zhing thams cad du yang yang dag par 'jug pa dang snang ba mtha' yas par(6)mthong bas rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la yang rab tu zhugs so/ /spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor bsod nams kyi sprinadza dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi rgyal mtshan ces bya ba la yang rab tu zhugs par gyur to/ /rjes su rtog (8)pa'i dkyil 'khor chos kyiphorgya mtsho 'byam 7klas pa thams cad snang ba zhes bya ba yang rjes su rtogs 31par gyur to/ /'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor ye shes chen po'i shugs kyi rgyan ces bya ba la yang rab tu zhugs hurteso/ /rang 'byung kyi du 'gyur ba shin tu mthong ba'i shugs kyi dbang bskur ba'i ye shes rgya mtsho la yang zhugs par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i mtshan nyid kyi 'od rnam par snang ba'i 8snang ba chen pos kyang shin tu snang bar gyur to/ /smon lam gyi stobs tshad med pa la mos pa rgya mtsho'i snying po'i smon lam mngon par bsgrub tshapa'i ye shes kyi stobs la yang rnam par dag par gyur to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyan bzang po rgyan gyi rgyal pos byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid chen po la tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ legs so yon tan ye shes rgya mtsho can/ /35—345

sangs rgyas byang chub smon lam yang dag gnas/ /sems can kun7gyi mgon dang gnas gyur pa'i95/ /rgyal ba dam pa bsam gyis57mi khyab 'gyur/ /ye shes rgya mtsho chen por mngon par byung / /chos kyi dbyings su thams cad rgyas byas te//sangs rgyas spyod yul rgya chen mi zad pa'i/ /bsam gyis myi khyab tshul la 'jug par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad yon tan sprin mthong ba'i/ /ye shes sa0niyang mi zad non par gyur/ /pha rol phyin pa rgya mtsho kun gyi tshul/ /grags pa chen po yongs su rgyas par byed/ /gzungs kyi tshul rnams rgya mtsho mang po dang / / tha dad yang dag shes 5tshul mi zad dang / /spyod pa smon lam khyod kyis mngon bsgrubs pas/ /gzhal med ye shes ldan par khyod 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rgya mtshor 'jug par 'gyur/ /smon lam rgya mtsho'i nang du khyod skyes te/ /rnam 'phrul 'di la'ang phyi shin tu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'di ni sangs rgyas chos nyid bsam mi khyab/ /chos dbyings dam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /bsam pa rgya chen rnam par sbyangs 7byas te/ /sangs rgyas sprin la rnam par blta bar gyis / /rgya mtsho'i zhing rnams dri med rnam par sbyongs/ / nga yipo)byang chub spyod la 'jug par gyis9/ /sngon gyi sbyor tshul rgya mtsho mang po yi3 )/ /spyod pa ngas ni ji ltar rnam sbyangs pa11/ /de 'dra'i tshul yang khyod kyis 32shes par gyis/ /zhing rnams re rer nyunasangs rgyas mang po ngas/ /rgya mtsho brgya mang shin tu mchod pa byas / /sngon spyod sna de yi 'bras bu 'di yin to15/ /'di 'dra dri ma med pa'i rgyan la ltos/ /las kyi rgya mtsho mi zad rgya chen dang / /zhing rnams rgya mtsho dag bya'i spyod pa dang / /smon lam bsam yas go ca lobagos pas na/ /'di rnams 'di 'dra'i rnam par 'phrul par 'gyur rme/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ma lus mchod 35—346

byas shing / /zhing rnams rgya chen rgya mtsho sbyangs 51 byas nas/ /bskal pa 'byamasanaklas kun tu sbyangs ③byas shing / /rgyal ba 54)yon tan 'od 'uchen mnga' bar 'gyur / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyan bzang po rgyan gyi rgyal po de yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas blta na dga' ba shin tu gtsangakheba'i bdag po de yang dus byas par gyur te/ rgyal bu mgazhon nu gzi brjid chen pos 'khor los sgyur 8ba'i rgyal srid thob par gyur to/ /nags tshal chen po yal ga'i dkyil 'khor rin po che'i me tog rgyas pa zhes bya ba der yang de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams rgya mtsho shin tu 'phags shing zil gyis spyo mi non pa zhes bya ba gsum pa byung bar gyur te/ des de bzhin gshegs pa de mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa mthong 1 tshonas/ 'khor thams cad dang dpung gi yan lag bzhi'i tshogs dang / rin po che bdun dang / grong gi myi dang yul (7mir bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams rgya mtsho shin tu 'phags shing zil gyis 12mi non pa gang na bzhugs pa der dong nas/ des bcom ldan 'das de la rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa/ spos dang nor bu thams cad kyi rgyan gyi snying po zhes bya ba phul lo/ /der de bzhin gshegs pa des kun tu blta hu ba'i spyod pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa snang ba zhes bya ba'i mdo/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi mdo'i 'khor dang bcas pa'ang 14yang dag par bshad 15par gyur to/ /de sathos nas byang chub sems dpa' gzi brjid chen pos/ bsod nams chen po'i 1 rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu 18thob po/ /ting nge 'dzin de thob nas hurtekyang dus gsum gyi 3 byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bsod 35—347

nams rgya mtsho mngon du gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams rgya mtsho shin tu 'phags shing zil gyis ①mi non pas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la rnam par gzigs te/ byang chub sems dpa' ②gzi brjid chen po la tshigs su bcad de gsungs pa/ yon tan bsod nams kun gyi gzi brjid can/ /byang chub mchog gis smon lam yid ldan pa/ /'gro ba kun la snying rje rgya mtsho yis/ /nga yi drung du khyod 'ongs legs so legs/ /snying rje'i snying po khyod ni sems can rnams/ /sdug bsngal gyur pa kun grol donasnyizhugs pas/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgon dang skyabs su 'gyur/ /byang chub spyod pa'i tshul yang de yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' shin tu brtan pa rnams/ /skyo med yid kyis spyod pa spyad ri pa dgatsa) /mchog tu gyur cing dam pa chags med pa'irin / /ye shes 'di 'dra shin tu thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar khyod ni kun tu bzang po yi/ /mthu chen smon lam spyod par zhugs pas na⑨/ /bsod nams 'od nyu chodang bsod nams dpal yin te/ /bsod nams nyunya'abyung gnas bsod nams 12mchog kyang yin/ /bsam gyis myi khyab rgyal ba rgya mtsho dganyunye /mtha' dang dbus med pa ni 9khyod kyis geshes/ /mtha' dang dbus skyemed de dag mthong gyur 1 tshonas/ /de dag bsod nams rgya mtsho rtogs 1)par 'gyur/ /khyod kyis 19phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams thams cad kyi/ /rgyal ba'i sprin rnams kun kyang shin tu mthong shu ri/ /de dag spyod pa rgya mtsho thams cad kyang / /sngon chad ji ltar spyad pa bzhin du mthong / /'di tshul rgya mtsho 'di la su zhugs shing / /ye shes sa la su dag gnas gyur pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas kun gyi rjes slob cing / /thams cad gzigs par gdon myi za bar 'gyur(1/ /khyod ni zhingalo)kun rgya 35—348

mtsho'i rdul snyed kyi/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod pa rab spyodatsha༅/nas/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sngon spyad rgya mtsho rnams/ /bslabs5 nonas rang byung nyid du 'gyur bar 'ongasani / /zhing rnams rgya mtsho yongs su dag pa ri4)rnams/ /phyogs bcu dag tu ji ltar mthong ba bzhin/ /khyod kyi zhing yang rnam par dag 'gyur55)te/ /smon lam kun kyang shin tu sgrog par 'gyur/ /'khor gyi rgya mtsho 'di dag thams cad kyang ske/ /khyod kyi smon lam thos gyur rab tu dga'/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i lam dag gis/ /byang chub mchog la rab tu 'jug par 'gyur/ /mtha' dang dbus myed zhing rnams 'byams noklas par/ /bskal pa rgya mtshos dag tu spyad pa spyod/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa thams cad dang / /smon lam rnams kyang yongs su rdzogs par gyis/ /nags tshal chen po 8yal ga'i dkyil 'khor rin po che'i me tog rgyas pa de nyid du/ de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa rnam par 9grags pa'i spyan hu gepad mo'i dpal zhes bya ba byung bar gyur to/ /rgyal po gzi brjid chen po de yang de nas shi 'phos 11nas/ rgya mtsho'i 32steng na lha'i grong khyer rin po che tunyezhi ba'i gnas shes bya bar phyin te/ der bsod nams dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba salha'i rgyal po chen por gyur to/ /de nas de 7lha'i 'khor gyi tshogs chen po dang bcas te/ rin po che'i me tog gi sprin gyi 7char 'bebs shing / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa rnam par grags pa'i spyan padmo'i dpal gang na bzhugs pa der dong ngo / /der bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa rnam par 1 grags pa'i spyan padmo'i dpal gyis tshul yangs pa'i sgo kun tu rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i mdo38/'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i 39rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi mdo'i 'khor dang 35—349
