bcas pa yang dag par stonas17)to/ /des de dag thos nas dga' ba'i snying po kun nas sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob po/ /chos thams cad kyi tshul rgya mtsho'i dbyings su yang zhugs par gyur te(gu/ /cu rnam par snang mdzad kyi le'u zhes bya ba ri ste/ bcu pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/④ bam po bcu gsum pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gang chen yematsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyag gi mthil gyi snying po la rab tu gnas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab ni kun tu bzang po dzormetshangs pa'i lha'i lus kyi dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni yongs su 'dzin pa / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i lus kyi dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/ stong gnyis kyi na'ajig rten gyi khams kyi 9lhan cig spyod pa/ 'phrul dga'i lha'i lus kyi dbyibs star 'dug pa/ / stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams ni (1kun tu spyod paṇa/rnye/dga' ldan gyi lha'i lus kyi dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/ gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni gnas kyi dam pa/ mtshe nyinama'i lha'i lus kyi dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/gling ni byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i lus kyi dbyibs 7ltar 'dug pa/ grong rdal ni gemadzod mtha' yas pa khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbyibs ltar 'dug pa/ bza' shing gi ra ba ni mya ngan dang bral ba snying po byang chub mya ngan med pa'i dbyibs su 'dug pa/ khang pa brtsegs pa ni kun nas smad du med pa'i la'ajig rten gyi khams rang bzhin chos nyid kyis 1 tshoganas pa'i dbyibs 35wa 350

su 'dug pa na bzhugs te/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho tshad med pas kun nas bskor ba ste/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi4)mthil gyi snying po la gnas par ming mthun rinapa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i dbyibs su 'dug pa sha stag dang / gzhung de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyi lag gi mthil gyis — snying po la rab tu gnas par ming mthun rtso)pa thams cad kyang 5/ nyan thos kyi 67lus kyi 7dbyibs su 'dug pa sha stag dang / gzhung 85de bzhin du 9lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang glu/ dri za dang lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' 1 lding dang mi'am ci dang /lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i lag gi 11mthil gyi snying po la rab tu gnas par ming mthun nya pa thams cad kyang mi ma yin pa'i lus kyi dbyibs su 'dug pa sha stag gis nyi yongs su bskor ba ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de ni sangs rgyas kyi sa 3 rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho tshabacu'i rdul shin tu phra ba 8snyed kyi mgo dang ldan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi gnas 'phos pa/ rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi mgul dang ldan pa'o / /sangs rgyas kyi tshogs kyi 1 rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi phrag pa'i lhun dang ldan pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi lag pa dang ldan pa'o/ /snying rje chen po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi snying dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par grol ba chen po rgya mtsho 'jig rterno gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi lto 35—351

dang ldan pa'o/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rnam par grol ba rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi ba spu'i bu ga dang ldan pa'o/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi samanyu)rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi statshabazur dang ldan pa'o/ /nyan thos kyi sa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra bar snyed kyi brla dang ldan pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi byin pa dang ldan pa'o/ /sems can gyi khams kyi smon lam rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi rkang pa dang ldan pa ste / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de ni de rsha)bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gang chenasnyimatsho rnam par snang mdzad 46)sngon gyi smon lam rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi spyi gtsug dang ldan pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i 7'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'phral ba dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rang bzhin gyisalce'od gsal ba rgya mtsho 9'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi mdzod spu dang ldan pa'o/ /byang chub kyi lam rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi smin tshugs dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan gyi / khams gang chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi myig dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snyan 17gyi khams gang 12chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi rna ba dang ldan pa'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa shangs kyi khams gangatshwa chen mtsho rnam par snang 35—352

mdzad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams ①rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi snasadang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ljags kyi khams gangs chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi lce dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku'i khams gangasrechen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho riga'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi lus dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thugs 6)kyi khams gang chen 57mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi ri yid dang ldan pa'o//de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba nyu rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi sangs rgyas kyi nyu 7sku sprul pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi skra dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud 'dul ba dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi skur sprul pa rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho 11bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi ba spu dang ldan pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dad pa'i dbang po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi mdog dang ldan pa'o / /rnam par thar pa'i sgo 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi kha dang ldan pa'o/ /chos kyi ro rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi skom dang ldan pa'o/ /sems can yongs su smin pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi zas dang ldan pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho tshad med pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa ste/ 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sa kun nas yog 35—353

par khebs pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams me tog gi sprin rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi char mngon par 'bab pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i dril bu'i dra ba 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kun tu 91)bres pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bla re 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rnam par bkram pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi dunakun tu khengs sapar bkang ba'o ske/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de ni kha dog gi chu rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho ri bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi snying po dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin du gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya dang chos kyi chu rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi snying po dang ldan pa'o / /mig sna tshogs kyi chu rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi snying po dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin du rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus dang 6yid kyi chu 7rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi snying po dang ldan pa'o/ /kha dog gi chu rgya mtsho re re 8༄nas yid kyi chu rgya mtsho'i bar re re las kyang me tog utpa la dang / pad mo dang / ku mu ta dang / pun da ri 9ka 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thon 1 te/ me tog utpa la de dag re re dang / me tog pun da ri 31ka de dag re re la'ang me tog utpa la'i 'khor dang / me tog phun da ri sna ka'i 'khor gyi bar du 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dag tsho/snyedang ldan pa ste/ me tog utpa la dang / me tog pun da ri 1jika'i bar de dag re re 35—354

las kyang 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab rnam par phye ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i0rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par byung ba dag ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi ri'i rgyan dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nasapad mo'i tshal dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi snyig ma'i tshal mang po dag kyang mngon par 'thon napa sha stag go//ci'i phyir kha dog gi chu rgya mtsho rnams la/ kha dog gi chu rgya mtsho zhes bya ba gang 4zhe na/ de dag tu sems can gang yang rung ste/ chu 'thung ba'am khrus byas 45cipa de dag thams cad kyis 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'di'i gzugs su snang ba 6'das pa'am ma 'ongs pa'am da ltar byung ba 'am nang gi 'am phyi'i 'am/ che ba 'am / chung ba 'am/ bzang ba 'am ngan pa 'am/ rgyang ring po 'am 7)thag nye ba'ang7rung ste/ gang ji snyed yod pa 9de dag thams cad khongs na snang bar so so'i mig gis mngon par mthong bas/ de'i phyir kha dog gi chu rgya mtsho rnams la / kha dog gi chu rgya mtsho zhes bya ste/ de bzhin du gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya dang / chos kyi chu rgya mtsho dag kyang shes par 3 )bya'o ci'i phyir myig gi chu rgya mtsho la mig gi chu rgya mtsho zhes bya zhe na/ de dag tu sems can gang yang rung ste/ chu 'thung ba dang khrus byed pa de dag thams cad kyis 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho mang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dag na gzugs su snang ba 'das pa'am/ ma 'ongs pa'am/ da ltar byung ba'am / nang gi'am/ phyi'i 'am 11che ba'am chung ba'am bzang ba'am ngan pa'am / rgyang ring po'am thag nye ba'ang rung ste/ gang ji snyed yod pa de 1dzodag thams cad nang nyunyen snang bar rang rang gi 〉myig dang / gzhan gyi myig gis mngon par mthong bas de'i phyir mig gi chu rgya mtsho rnams la mig gi chu rgya mtsho 35wa 355

zhes bya ba hu7ste/ de bzhin du rna ba dang sna dang lce dang / lus dang yid kyi chu rgya mtsho dag kyang shes par bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams de ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i gzugs brnyan 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis lhun shin tu brgyan pa ste/ sems can gyi khams rgya mtsho rab tu snang ba'i dpe byadaskrubazang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rnam par gsal tshibar byas pa'i lus can no/ /chos kyi dbyings rgya mtsho zab mo 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi mtshan dang ldan pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho mang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du/ rdul shin tu phra ba re re la yang gzugs brnyan rtserab tu snang bar 'byung ba'o/ /ci'i phyir na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyi snying po la rab tu gnas pa de la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyisnyisnying po la/rab tu gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho zhes bya zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gangasachen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad de'i phyag gi mthil na rdul shin tu phra ba'i ④snying po zhes bya ba yod de/ de'i nang na rnam par shes pa'i khams rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod desaX/ de dag gi steng na chos kyi dbyings rgya mtshoshematha' yas pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu gnas so//de dag gi steng na nam mkha'i dbyangs nyu3 rgya mtshos mtshams yongs su chad pa〈nyamed pa zhes bya ba'i7)'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu gnas so/ /de dag gi steng na mye'i khams rgya mtsho drag shul can zhes bya ba 'jig 35—356

rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu gnas so/ /de dag gi steng na chu'i khams kyi rgya mtsho sbrang rtsi can zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu gnas so/ /de dag gi steng na sa'i khams rgya mtsho rin po che'i snying po can zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu gnas so/ /de dag gi steng nas 67me tog mtshan ma chamed pa las skyes pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thonas te/ me tog de dag kyang so so nas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho tsam gyi tha grubadang ldan pa dag ciltaste/ de dag gi steng na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'di 6)gnas pas/ de'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyi ri7)snying po la rab tu gnas pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyi dunaXsnying po la rab tu gnas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho zhes bya'o/ /9)de ltar de dag la sogs 1 tshopa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de ni yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho mang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dag na yon tan ji snyed yod pa'i yon tan de snyed ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de na yod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de na 31'jig rten gyi khams ri rab kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba tshangs pa'i lha'i lus kyi dbyibs su 'dug pa/'jig rten gyi khams ri rab 'jig rten gyi khams rgya metsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang ldan pa yod de/ 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab kun tu bzang po de ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i spos 12mngon par 'phags pa 'jig rten 35—357

gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bang rim chen po'i nyakhri 'phang du 'dug pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mchoXre ngos 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa'o/ / de ci'i phyir zhe nage/ 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab kun tu bzang po de la kun tu bzang po zhes bya zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab kun tu bzang po de ni rdo yongs su ma dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang yang myed de der sems can gang ji snyed skyes pa de dag thams cad chos gang dang gang la yongs su dmyigs par byed gepa'i dmyigs pa de dang des kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bas/ de'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab kun tu bzang po de gel kun tu bzang porsāzhes bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams ri rab de ni de ltar de dag la 57)sogs pa yon tan tshad med pa dgashedang ldan pa ste / mdor na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de na tsheyon tan ji snyed cig yod pa de snyed kyi yon tan ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab kun tu bzang po de na yod dol/ /'jig rten gyi khams ri rab kun tu bzang po de na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i lus kyi dbyibs su 'dug pa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams mang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba yod de/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'dzin pa de ni lha'i rnam par dgod pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas tso )/ /de bzhin du klu dang 35—358

gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' sna lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang mi ma yin pa'i rnam par dgod pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas sog/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par dgod pa'i gyi'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' dang ca / rang sangs rgyas dang nyan thos kyi rnam par dgod pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa'o/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 8'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba der sems can gang ji snyed cig skyes pa de dag kyang 'du shes tha dad pa ma gtogs par lam gyi rgyud (6tha dad pa med do/ /skye gnas tha dad pa med do theg pa tha dad pa med do/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba de la ci'i phyir yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya zhe na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'dzin pa der sems can gang ji snyed skyes pa de dag thams cad la ngan song gi 'jigs pa 7)med/ theg pa dma' bar dun)ltung ba'i 'jigs pa'ang med/ ser snar ltung ba'i 'jigs pa'ang med/ tshul khrims ngan par ltung ba'i 'jigs pa'ang med/ mi bzod par ltung ba'i 'jigs pa'ang med/ le lor ltung ba'i 'jigs pa'ang med/ rnam par 'khrugs 9par ltung ba'i 'jigs pa'ang med/ shes rab 'chal bar ltung ba'i 'jigs pa 'ang med pas/ de'i phyir yongs su 'dzin pa'i stong gsum gyi 1 stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar de dag la 31sogs pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'dzin pa de 32ni yon 35—359

tan tshad med pa mang po dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab kun tu bzang po na yon tan ji snyed cig yod pa de snyed kyi yon tan ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'dzin pa na yod do/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'dzin pa de na stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams lhan cig spyod pa zhes bya ba/ 'phrul dga'i lha'i dbyibs su 'dug pa/ stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams mang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 1)kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba yod de/stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams lhan cig spyod pa zhes bya ba de ni②/ rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od rgya mtsho mang po dang mi 'bral dulo/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer 4dra ba rgya mtsho dang mi 'bral ⑧lo/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rgya mtsho dang mi 'bral tre lo/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rgya mtsho dang mi 'bral 37lo/ /rtag tu de bzhin gsheg dugashegs pa'i mngon par chosarardzogs par 'tshang rgya ba nyu 7rgya mtsho dang mi 'bral7lo/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rgyal mtsho dang mi 'bral〈snyelo / /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po rgya mtsho dang mi 'bral /thulo/ /rtag tu mu stegs 8kyi gnas thams cad phu dud du bya ba rgya mtsho dang mi 'bral 37lo/ /rtag tu bdud kyi las thams cad yongs su gcod pa rgya mtsho dang mi 'bral hu)lo/ /stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams lhan cig spyod pa zhes bya ba der //sems can gang ji snyed cig 0skyes pa de dag thams cad kyang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa/ gzungs kyi sgo (1rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams 35—360

rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa/ satshamargya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa sha stag go//stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams lhan cig spyod pa zhes bya ba de la ci'i phyir na lhan cig spyod pa zhes bya zhe na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang lhan cig 'grogs shing / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho mang po/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi chos kyi dbyings rgya mtsho ji snyed pa de dag thams cad du rnam par spyod pas lhan cig spyod pa de la lhan cigashespyod pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar de dag lasadzabasogs pa stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams lhan cig spyod pa de ni yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i bya'ajig rten gyi khams yongs su 'dzin pa de na yon tan ⑤gang ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi yon tan ni/ stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams lhan cig spyod pa de na yod do/ /stong gnyis kyila'ajig rten gyi khams lhan cig spyod pa zhes bya ba de 3)na stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu spyod pa zhes bya ba dga' ldan gyi lha'i lus kyi dbyibs su 'dug pa/ stong gi 'jig rten gyi0)khams mang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba yod de/ stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu spyod pa zhes bya ba de ni ⑩ bde ba yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 3)rgyan rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyisamathe rab tu brgyan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kun tu nyirtematha' yas kyitshamachos kyi sku 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 8rgyas par gang ba/ chos kyi dbyings rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis mngon par 35—361

brlan pa ste/ stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu spyod pa zhes bya ba der sems can gang ji snyed skyes pa de dag thams cad kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho shibacu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa sha stag ste/ de bzhin du tshul khrims dang bzod pa dang brtson 'grus dang bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtshor bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa nas/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi bar la rab tu chogeganas pa mngon par shes pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la sa)rab tu gnas pa/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos gergya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa sha stag go/ /ci'i phyir zhe na 6stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu spyod pa rim de la kun tu spyod pa ri zhes bya zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho mang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dag na/ chos kyi khams rgya mtsho dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dang / sangs rgyas kyi khams rgya mtsho dang / byang chub sems dpa'i khams rgya mtsho dang / sems can gyi khams rgya mtsho gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kun nas rnam par spyod pas kun tu spyod pa de la kun tu spyod pa ri zhes bya'o/ /de ltar de dag la 1 sogs pa stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu spyod pa de ni/ yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams lhan cig spyod pa de na yon tan gang ji snyed yod pa'i 35—362

yon tan de dag ni stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu spyod pa na yod do/ /stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu spyod pa zhes bya ba de na/ gling bzhi ༅)pa gnas kyi dam pa zhes bya ba mtshe ma'i lha'i lus kyi dbyibs su 'dug pa gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams mang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang ldan pa yod deX / gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gnas kyishedam pa zhes bya ba de ni snying po byang chub rgya mtsho'i rgyan 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rnam par brgyan pa ste/ snying po byang chub kyi rgyan de dag re re la yang seng ge'i khri rgya mtsho'i 44)rgyan 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu gnas pa/ seng ge'i khri'i rgyanasnyide dag re re la yang byang chub sems dpa' rine rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mang po 'khod pa ste/ gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gnas kyi dam pa der sems can gang ji snyed skyes pa de dag thams cad kyang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i lus dang spyod lam rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa/ sgo mtha' yas pa nas mngon par bsgrub mapa'i mdo/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yongs su 'dzin pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa sha stag go/ /ci'i phyir na gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gnas kyi dam pa zhes bya ba58༄de la gnas kyi dam pa 9zhes bya zhe na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'dzin pa na/ sems can rnams kyi 'byung gnas dang gnas su bya ba'i gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang ji 35—363

snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na 'di mchog tu bya bas na/ de'i phyir gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gnas kyi dam pa zhes bya ba de la gnas kyi dam pa zhes bya'o//de ltar de dag las 3)sogs pa gling bzhi pa'i 'jig erten gyi khams gnas kyi dam pa zhes bya ba de ni yon tan gzhal du med pa dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu spyod pa na yon tan gang ji snyed yod pa'i yon tan de dag ni/ gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gnas kyi dam pa de nasheyod do/ /gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gnas kyi dam pa zhes bya ba de na gling byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i lus kyi dbyibs su 'dug pa/ gling bzhi pa'i55)'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba yod de/ gling byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba de ni rin po che'i ri khang pa brtsegs pa ltar 'dug pa/ rgya mtsho mang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis ⑥kun nas bskor ba/de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyi dra ba rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis ⑦kun tu khyab pa chos kyi dbyings rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis ⑧mngon par brlan pa ste/ gling byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba der sems can gang ji snyed skyes par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang ⑨ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyan tunye snying po byang chub kyi rgyan gyi dam par gyur pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa theg pa tha dad pas 'byung ba rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu (1phra ba snyed la mkhas pa(rnye/ chos kyi dbyings rgya mtsho tha mi dad pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu 35—364

phra ba snyed la rnam par spyod pa sha stag go/ /ci'i phyir na gling byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan de la byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ①zhe na/ gling byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba de na byang chub kyi shing nam mkha'i rten zhes bya ba/ byang chub kyi shing ②'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi ①'khor dang ldan pa yod de der skad cig skad cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bsaX / de'i phyir gling byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan de la byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya'o/ /de ltar de dag las〈ltasogs pa gling byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan de ni yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gnas kyi dam pa de na/ (zhe gang ji snyed yod pa'i ⑦yon tan de dag ni gling byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan de na yod do/ /gling byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan de na grong rdal mdzod mtha' yas pa zhes bya7ba khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbyibs su 'dug pal/ grong rdal 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang ldan pa yod de/ grong rdal mdzod mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa'i phyir rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'o1tsho/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa'i phyir rgya mtsho re re zhing yang ting nge 'dzin gyi 'obs rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyisarwa )yongs su bskor ba'ol/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi 'obs rgya mtsho de dag re re zhing yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhi gnas kyi chu rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis yongs su gang ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhi gnas kyi chu rgya mtsho de 35—365

dag re re zhing yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes dang yon tan gyi nyu)me tog utpa la dang / pad mo dang ku mu (gta dang pun da ri rishāka 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis kun nas khyab par gang ba'o④/ /grong rdal mdzod mtha' yas pa de ni byang chub kyi sems rin po che rigashin tu rnam par dag pa'i pha 'gu rgya mtsho rtso'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed las brtsigs 58pa/ sa bcu'i khang pa brtsegs pa dang / gzhal med khang gi phreng ba rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis sgro)rnam par phye ba ste/ grong rdal mdzod mtha' yas pa der sems can gang ji snyed skyes pa de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos kyi sku dang ngang tshul rgya mtsho la rab tu zhugs pa/ skad cig skad cig nyu )cing sems can gyi 11khams sna tshogs 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yongs su mya ngan las zlo 12ba 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po rgya mtsho'i khur 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 3)bkur ba la yongs su skyo ba med pa sha stag go/ /ci'i phyir na grong rdal mdzod mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba 8de la mdzod mtha' yas pa zhes bya zhe na/ grong rdal mdzod mtha' yas pa de'i sa'i khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba 'am/ chu'i khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba 'am/ me'i khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba 'am/ rlung gi khams kyi mardul shin tu phra ba 'am/ nam mkha'i khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba yang rung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis sade dag la chos kyi mdzod rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed ma bzhag 1 pa de lta bu gang yang med pas de'i 35—366

phyir grong rdal mdzod mtha' yas pa de la mdzod mtha' yas pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar de dag las ①sogs pa grong rdal mdzod mtha' yas pa de ni yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na gling (gebyang chub kyi rgyal mtshan na yon tan gang ji snyed yod pa'i yon tan de snyed ni grong rdal mdzod mtha' yas pa de na yod do/ /grong rdal mdzod mtha' yas pa de na5 cirabaza' shing gi ra ba mya ngan dang bral ba zhes bya ba snying po byang chub mya ngan med pa'i dbyibs su 'dug pa/bza' shing gi ra ba 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang ldan pa yod de/ bza' shing gi ra ba mya ngan dang bral ba de na/nags tshal rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod debya / nags tshal de dag kyang so so nas stong pa nyid kyi gser rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi rgyu las grub pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi 'od rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi me tog dang ldan pa'o/ /rnam par rtog pa'i gnyen po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'bras ri bu dang ldan pa'o56)/ /sems can ⑦gyi khams thams cad sdig rin pa las yongs su skyobs 47pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi lo ma phopho dang ldan pa'o / /sems can gyi nyu1khams yongs su mya ngan las zlo ba rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi grib ma bsil 32ba dang ldan pa'o1)//sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi bsam pa'i sa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la snying rje chen po'i rlom ba rab tu gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad ye shes gang 15chen mtsho'i sngon gyi smon 35—367

lam rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi yal ga dang ldan pa'o/ /rang bzhin yongs su dag pa'i dar gyi 37ldi dang chun po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kun tu bres pa'o/ /dri ma med cing yongs su ②dag pa'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par bsgreng ba'og/ /bza' shing gi ra ba mya ngan dang bral ba de ni rdzing rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis༄yongs su brgyan pa ste/ rdzing de dag re re zhing yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhisnyiganas rgya mtsho'i chu 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis yongs su gang ba'o / /rdzing de dag re re zhing yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes dang yon tan gyi7me tog utpa la dang / pad mo dang / phun da ri7ka 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 0kun nas khyab par gang ba'o/ /bza' shing gi ra ba mya ngan dang bral ba der sems can ji snyed cig 'dong bsngoX de dag thams cad kyang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad ye shes gang chen 37mtsho'i sku dang thugs dang 'phrin7las mnyam pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu thob par 'gyur ba 32sha stag ste/ dus gsum thams cad du thogasalgepa med pa'i ye shes la rnam par spyod pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /ci'i phyir na bza' shing gisnyir ba mya ngan dang bral ba de la/ mya ngan dang bral ba zhes bya zhe na/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams mya ngan dang bral ba zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan dang bral 35wa 368

ba zhes bya ba bzhugs te①/ de dang mthun ②pa'i rgyus grub pas de'i phyir na bza' shing gi ra ba mya ngan dang bral ba de la mya ngan dang bral bshezhes bya'o/ /de dag latswasogs pa bza' shing gi ra ba mya ngan dang bral ba de ni/ yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na grong rdal mdzod pa mtha' yas pa na/yon tan gang ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi yon tan ni bza' shing gi ra ba mya ngan dang bral ba de na yod do/ /bza' shing gi ra ba mya ngan dang bral bakhede'i nang na khang pa brtsegs pa kun nas smad du med pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams rang bzhin chos nyid kyis gnas pa'i dbyibs su 'dug pa khang pa ⑦brtsegs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang ldan pa yod deni/ khang pa brtsegs pa kun nas smad du med pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho7bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed las byung ba'o/ /sems can gyi〈sna khams thams cad kyi bsam pa sna tshogs rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi snying po dang ldan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs dam pa'i rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rjes su 'dong ba'o/ /khang pa brtsegs pa kun nas smad du med pa der sems can gang ji snyed skyes pa de dag thams cad kyang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gang chen hunyamatsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi ye shes sgyu ma rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho hunyebacu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 8sprul pa ye shes sgyu ma rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 8rnam par bsgrubs 8pa/ ye shes sgyu ma rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i 35—369

rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dam pa thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yongs su bsgrubs (1)pa gang ji snyed yod52pa de dag thams cad kyis tre/ sems can de dag gi ba spu'i bu ga re re nas mngon par grub pa sha stag go/ /ci'i phyir na khang pa brtsegs pa kun nas smad du med pa de la kun nas smad du med pa zhes bya zhe na/ chos kyi dbyings 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i phyir khang pa brtsegs pa kun nas smad du med pa de la kun nas smad du med pasnyizhes bya'o/ /de ltar de dag la 5sogs pa khang pa brtsegs pa kun nas smad du med pa ⑥de ni yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa ste/ mdor na bza' shing gi ra ba mya ngan dang bral ba na yon tan gang ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi yon tan ni khang pa brtsegs padza4)byekun nas smad du med pa de na yod do/ /de lta bu'i pho brang brtsegs pa kun nas smad du med pa de na/ byang chub sems dpa'i na/ye shes kyi rdo rje'i lhun dang ldan pa'i seng ge'i khri 95rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gang rmo )chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i07byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi rnam pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis kun nas bskor cing 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i rang nasangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi rnam pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 1 kun nas bskor te/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i nyan thos kyi kha'akhor gyi rnam pa rgya 35—370

mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyisamanyu)bskor cing /de bzhin du lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i 'khor rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis kun nas bskor cing bzhugs so rnam par spyod do byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho nas/ myi dang myi ma yin gyila'akhor rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho'i bar 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba de dag las byang chub sems dpa' de dag re re zhing yang byang chub sems dpa' 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i 'khor rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang ldan pa gerang sangs rgyas 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i 'khor nga)rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang ldan pa/ nyan thos 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i 'khor rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang ldan pa/ de bzhin du lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang /myi dang myi ma yin pa 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i 'khor rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'khor dang / de ltar 'khor dang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 5rigacig nas gcig tu brgyud (nyupa yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba 35—371

snyed du shes par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho de dag nas myi dang myi ma yin pa'i bar rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed po de dag las byang chub 17sems dpa' re re dang / myi dang myi ma yin pa'i bar re re dag kyang lus rnam pa tha dad pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa sha stag sterin/ lus rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtshomaju bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed poshogede dag las lus re re la yang / mgo rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod do/ /mgo rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed po de dag las mgo re re la yang mig gi dbang po rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod do/ /de bzhin du rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus dang yid kyi dbang po rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho'i bar du yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod de/ mig gi dbang po rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nas yid kyi dbang po rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho'i bar 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed po de dag la dbang po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag las dbang po 5re re la yang mig gi rnam par shes pa'i rnam par rtog pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod do/ /de bzhin du rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i rnam par rtog pa rgya mtsho'i phyi bar du 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod do la/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa'i rnam par 48)rtog pa rgya mtsho nas yid kyi rnam 35—372

par shes pa ①rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed po de dag la rnam par shes pa ji snyed cig yod pa de dag las rnam par shes pashere re la yang ye shes rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod do/ /ye shes rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed po de dag la ye shes ji snyed cig yod pa de dag las ye shes re res kyang / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho mang po'i sangs rgyas tha dad pa rgya mcho3re ye shes rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mcho'i tshul du chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu bskor bar 0byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ji lta ba de bzhin du rang sangs rgyas dang / de bzhin du nyan thos dang de bzhin du ④lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang ske/ nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams la 'ang shes par bya ste/ ye shes la ji lta ba de bzhin du chos thams cad la yang ⑤shes par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang myi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar de dag gi gnas kyi yon tan rnam7par phye ba rgya mtsho ji snyed cig yod pa dang / stan gyi yon tan rnam par phye ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang ske/ mtshan7dang dpe byad bzang po'i yon tan rnam par phye ba ji snyed cig yod pa dang / rgyan gyi yon tan rnam50par phye ba rgya mtsho ji snyed cig yod pa dang ske/ gos kyi yon tan rnam par phye ba rgya mtsho ji snyed cig yod pa de dag dang /byang chub sems dpa' nas mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar de dag gi mig gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nyu)re re nas lus kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nyuge rire re zhing 'jig 35—373

rten gyi khams thams cad du rgyas par 'gengs pa de dag ni/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyiphubaskal pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du bstan cing brjod kyang zad par mi rung ngo // // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po/② bam po bcu bzhi pa/ de nas mebacom ldan 'das ye shes gang chen stimatsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi sasku'i ba spu'i bu ga re re nas kyang 'od zer rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed bkye'o/ /'od zer rgya mtsho de dag re re las kyang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho pad mo rgya mtsho la bzhugs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par byung ste/ sangs rgyas re re'i sku'i ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang yang dag par bskul57ba'i tshigs su bcad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thonasheto//de dag las yang dag par bskul duba'i tshigs su bcad pa rgya mtsho re re zhing yangakushar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams ji snyed pa dang / rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams re re dang / rdul shin tu phra ba re re la 'ang5) byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho ji snyed cig yod pa dang / (nyerang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang ske/ nyan thos rgya mtsho ji snyed cig yod pa dang / lha dang kunedang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha'aphanyesding dang / myi'am ci dang /lto 'phye chen po dang / myi dang myi ma yin pa rgya mtsho ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad la yongs su bskul ba7byed do/ /shar phyogs dang 'dra bar phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad du'ang de bzhin te/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 35—374

de dag dang7mi dang mi ma yin pa rgya mtsho ji snyed pa de ②dag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gang ①chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi 'od zer gyis yang dag par bskul nas/ rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho dag na⑤ / sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gang bzhugs pa de dag la zhus te/ gnang nas byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho re re dang myi dang myi ma yin pa rgya mtsho'i bar de dag re re zhing byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rgya mtsho nas mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'khor rgya mtsho'i bar dang ldan par 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gi mthil gyi snying po la rab tu gnas pa gang na ba derala'adong bar gyur to④/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho de dag dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rgya mtsho'i bar de dag la byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed cig yod pa dun) dang mi dang mi ma yin pa ji snyed cig yod pa7de dag las byang chub sems dpa' re re dang / myi dang myi ma yin pa'i bar de dag re re zhing yang lus rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa sha stag ste/ lus re re la yang lag pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod pa/ lus re re la yang mgo rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin hu )tu phra ba snyed yod pa/ mgo re re la yang kha'i sgo rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod pa/ kha'i sgo re re la yang lce rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod pa sha stag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho de dag dang / myi dang myi ma yin pa'i bar rgya mtsho de dag gis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 3nye ye shes gang hu chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad la lus re res tunyekyang g.yas phyogs su bskor ba rgya mtsho 35—375

'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis bskor ba byas te/lag pa re re nas kyang me tog rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis mchod nas de bzhin du mar me dang / spos dang bdug spos dang / byug pa dang phye ma dang gdugasatudang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis mchod de②/lce re re zhing yang7bstod pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyisakhumangon par bstod nas/ rang rang gi stobs dang dzu 'phrul gyis sprul pa'i stan rgya mtsho dag la 'khod par gyur to/ /'khod nas kyang lce re re zhing zhu ba rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yongs su zhu ba byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gang chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad des zhus pa de dag re re la shin tu bstan pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 0shin tu ⑦bstan pa mdzad de/ byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtshosadang / myi dang myi ma yin pa rgya mtsho'i bar rnam pa de ltar 'dus pa de dag /thams cad la chos rgya mtsho mang po rnam grangs du mar rnam par phye'o/ /rnam par bkrol7lo/ /gsal bar mdzad do/ /yang dag par bstan to/ /de nas shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho (nyabacu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad kyi gnas kyi snying po zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi don rgya mtsho rnam par snang mdzad tunyeces bya ba bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong sto / thog mar yang dge bar du yang dge/ tha mar yang dge ba'i 35—376

chos don bzang po/ yi ge bzang po7dag pa yongs su gsal ba/ yongs su byang ba/ tshangs pa'i spyod pa yang dag par ston cing / byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la ②rab tu ston pa mdzad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi don rgyasamatsho rnam par snang mdzad de'i gnas kyi yo na tan rnam par phye ba rgya mtsho ji snyed cig mnga' ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan rnam par phye ba rgya mtsho ji snyed cig mnga' ba dang / sku tshe'i 0yon tan rnam par phye ba rgya mtsho ji snyed cig mnga' ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i yon tan rgyasnyimatsho ji snyed cig mnga' ba dang / sku yongs su bstan pa'i yon tan rnam par phye ba rgya mtsho ji snyed cig mnga' ba dang / chos bstan pa'i yon tan rnam par phye ba rgya mtsho ji snyed cig mnga' ba de dag ni/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho ⑦bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nikyis dus gsum rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du gsungs te/ bstan kyang zad par mi rung ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad kyi gnas kyi snying po zhes bya ba de na ⑨'khor los sgyur ⑩ba'i rgyal po rin chen7mang po zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bdag po lha dang myi'i dbang po yod de/'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de dag re re zhing yang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /'khor los sgyur7ba'i rgyal po rin chenatshwanyemang po de'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho re re na yang rin po che rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 35—377

bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod de/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi spyan rin po che rgya mtsho dang / de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi snyan dang / shangs dang ljags dang sku dang thugs rin po che rgya mtsho dang / sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rin po che rgya mtsho dang / thams cad kyis blta na yid du 'ong ba'i bud med rin po che rgya mtsho dang / don thams cad grubanyepa'i khyim bdag rin po che rgya mtsho dang / kun tu rnam par phye ba'i blon po rin po che rgya mtsho dang / nam mkha'i (gemathas klas pa'i nirta rin po che rgya mtsho dang ske/ yid bzhin du 'gro ba'i glang po rin po che rgya mtsho dang / chos kyi dbyings rdo rje'i lte ba can gyi 'khor lo rin po che rgya mtsho dang / kun tu snang bar byed pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rgya mtsho dang / nam mkha'akhergyan gyis 'gengs pa'i gdugs rin po che rgya mtsho dang / rang bzhin gyis dri ma med pa'i gos rin po che rgya mtsho dang / zla ba'isnyizer lta bu'i rdul yab rin po che rgya mtsho dang / shes rab kyi ral gri yirin po che rgya mtsho dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi bltar myi mthong ba'i spyi gtsug⑧bsgribs pa med pa rin po che rgya mtsho dang ske/ thams cad du 'gro ba'i lham rin po che rgya mtsho dang / ting nge 'dzin dang mnyam par gzhag〈pepa thams cad kyi mdzod du gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin rin po che rgya mtsho dang / chos gang 3 richen mtsho thams cad kyi klong dang ldan pa'i gzungs rin po che rgya nyunyamatsho dang / de ltar de dag lasngogesogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho re re na yang rin po che rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod de/ rin po che rgya mtsho de dag la rin po che ji snyed cig yod pa de dag las rin po che re re zhing yang las 'jig rten gyi khams rgya 35—378

mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byed pa sha stag go/ /'khor los sgyur tu)ba'i rgyal po rin chen ②mang po de la bu rgya mtsho kun kyang myi chen po'i mtshan rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa/ 'od chen po'i rgyan rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa/ lus dpe byad bzang po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rab tu gsal〈kyebar brgyan pa/ phas kyi rgol ba'i sde 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu 'joms pa / sa bcu rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pa/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtshokhu'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu thob pa/ snying po byang chub kyi rgyan rnam par phye ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yongs su gnon pa la mkhas pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod do/ /'khor los sgyurakhuba'i rgyal po rin chen mang po de la bu mo rgya mtsho kun kyang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis sprul pa'i bud myed rin po che dang 'dra bar ⑦yid kyi lus 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa srid pa'i ⑧lam gyi rgyud kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho spubacu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa/byang chub kyi sems bla na myed pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi mgo dang ldan pa/ chos kyi dbyings nam mkha' rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho nyu) bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'phral ba dang ldan 35—379

pa/ bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi smin tshugs can/ shes rab dang ye shes yangs pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi myig dang ldan pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las thos pa 'dzin pa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi rna ba yid du 'ong ba dang ldan pa/ sdom pa chen po yang dag par blangs pa7rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sna legs pa dang ldan pa/ chos rgya mtsho rab tu sgrog⑧pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi lce dang ldan pal/ chos kyi dbyings mtha' gnyis yongs su spangs pa 'dzudakyipar dgod pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed medang ldan pa/byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi lag pa dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don yongs su bsgrubs ⑦pas myi ngoms pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba〈snyed kyi snying dang ldan pa/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi nu ma legs pa dang ldan pa/ chos zab mo sna tshogs rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi lte ba dang ldan pa/ dmyigs pa thams cad yongs su bstsal7ba'i mthar thug pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i0rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rjes su rtogs71pa dang ldan pa/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin yangs shing mi shigs la brtan 32pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sta zur dang ldan panyunye/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das 35—380

pa thams cad rim gyis7'brel pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams7rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi rkang pa dang ldan pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag gi me tog sna tshogs kyi dra ba dang phreng ba rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mdzes par thogs pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa'i gos rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho nib cu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed shin tu bzang bar gyon pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi0rgyan rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis legs par brgyan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims dri zhim po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi spos kyis dulus shin tu byugs pa/ dga' ba'i rgyan dang thabs mkhas pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i⑧rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tusrephra ba snyed yod de①/ de dag gi kha nas ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i chos rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho ⑩bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'byung ngo / /de dag gi lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas kyang snying rje'i rjes su 'brang ba'i tsan dan gyi spos rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'byung ngo / /spos rgya mtsho de dag gi dri zhim pos kyang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul tunyeshin tu phra ba snyed kyi tunye'ajig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho mang po yongs su rgyas par 'gengs te/ de dag gi dga' ba'i rgyan dang / thabs mkhas pa rgya mtshos 'dul ba'i sems can rgya mtsho gang ji snyed 8yod pas dri zhim po rgya mtsho de dag tshor bar gyur pa de dag thams cad 35—381

kyang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims dri zhim po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu thobatupo/ /sems can gang dga' ba'i rgyan dang thabs mkhas pa rgya mtshos 'dul ba de dag gi⑧gzugs kyi yon tan rnam par phye ba rgya mtsho de dag mthong ba de ③thams cad kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i shes rab dang ye shes kyi sku rnam ④par dag pa duyongs su ston pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu 'thobalgebo/ /gang gis7dbyangs rgya mtsho thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las thos pa yongs su 'dzin pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu 'thobasnyepo/ /gang gis stilag nas bzung ba de dag thams cad kyang byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu 'thob (kye bo/ /gang gis mthong la reg ⑩pa de dag thams cad kyang bsod nams dang ye shes sna tshogs kyi tshogs 8rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu 'thob po/ /gang dang stan gcig5)la lhan cig tu 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyang snying po byang chubasheseng ge'i khri rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis nyu2kha dang khar phrad par byas pa de dag thams cad kyang rnam par thar pa'i sgo rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu7'thob hu 〉po/ /gang gis pang du khyud〈nyepa de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku mnyam pa nyid rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho nyurtebacu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu 'thob 3 po/ /gang dang chos kyi 35—382

dbyings su bsten7par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho mang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i ⑧rdul shin tu phra ba snyed na/sems can gyi khams rgya mtsho gang ji snyed yodashepa de dag thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su dag pa rgya mtsho la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu 'thob0pa dang / yongs su dag pa dang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bar sa bon rgya mtsho rab tu 'debs so/ /de nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rin chen mang po7des yang dag par bskulasheba'i tshigs su bcad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed thams cad du khyab pa'i rna ba rgya mtshos thos nas rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs rgya mtsho chags pa med cing bsgribasaphupa med pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi don gang7chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs gnyis la mgo rgya mtsho'i spyi bos btud de phyag 'tshal nas/ chos kyi dbyings rab tu sgrog pa'i lce'i dbang po rgya mtshos zhu ba yongs su zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar yang dag par bskul7 ba'i tshigs su bcad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ba de bu'i mthu las byung ba lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi don gang7)chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyis5)rgyal po rin chen〈nyemang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po 'di nas nub phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyi snying po la rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de 35—383

na7de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gangakhuchen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba da ltar bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngoshe/ /chosarnyuston to/ /yang dag par bskulasnyiba'i tshigs su bcad pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ba 'di yang de'i mthus byung ngo / /de nas rgyal po rin chen mang pos de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi don gang0chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyi snying po la rab tu gnas pa der/ de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gang mechen nimatsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhal blta ba dang / de la phyag bgyi ba dang / mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur ba dang / chos mnyan pa'i slad du mchi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi don gang7chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ rgyal po rin chen mang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po de'i dus la dbab par shes na 'gro la ragalamaste rgyal po chen po 'jig rten gyi khams/ rgya mtsho de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyi snying po la rab tu gnas pa der ni 'gro bar dka' ste/ der 'gro ba dang de bzhin gshegs pa de'i zhal blta ba dang / de la phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur ba dang / chos mnyan par ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis rlabs ma gtogasatshwa par/ byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin snying po byang chub kyi rgyan rnam par phye ba'i snying po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la rab tu gnas pas kyang bde blag tu bya bar sla ba ma yin gyi/ rgyal po chen po de lta ma yin pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho salgematshams bzang po'i ge 35—384

dbyangs zhes bya ba zhig yod dol/ /de khyod kyis sngan cad mthong ngam 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de phyogs ni gang na 'dug /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de 'di nas ni〈nye 'am ring / de na da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa nishegang zhig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa mdzad pa shes sam/ rgyal po rin chen mang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis0'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de mthong ba 'am 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de phyogs gang na mchis pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de 'di nas ni nye 'amakhuring zhig na mchis pa dang / de⑩ltar de na de bzhin gshegs pa gang bzhugs pa dang /'tsho skyong zhingasachos ston pa ni smos su 'ang ma mchis te/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de ni sngon tshe bdag gis〈nyem thos so/ /de nas de7 bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi tu7don gang lhonyechen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyis/rgyal po rin chen mang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de phyogs0)gang na yod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de 'di nas ji srid pa dang / de na da ltar de bzhin 8gshegs pa gang bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong bshedang chos ston pa legs par soms shig /de nas rgyal po rin chen mang pos 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad du yongs su gzhol ⑩ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho la lho )stsogs pa ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu5nyephra ba snyed la mnyam par bzhag7)kyang /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de phyogs gang na yod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de 'di nas nye 'am ring ba dang de na0) da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa gang bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba (skyedang / chos ston pa yang ma shes te/ 'jig 35—385

rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de'i mtshan ma tsam ①yang ma mthong ngo / /de nas rgyal po rin chen mang po ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho de dag las langs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi don gang mechen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de mthong ba'am/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de phyogs gang na mchis pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de 'di nas ring ngam ②nye ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gang zhig da ltar de na bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong bsredang / chos ston pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ bdag gis 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de'i mtshan ma tsam yang ma mthong ngo / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi don gangadzabachen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ rgyal po rin chen mang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de lta bas na rgyal po chen po durnam grangs des kyang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyi snying po 7)la rab tu gnas pa der ni ⑧de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs ma gtogs par/ ting nge 'dzin gyi〈snying po byang chub kyi rgyan rnam par phye ba 17snying po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtshos kyang 'gro bar bya ba'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa blta ba 'am/ de la phyag bya ba'am/ bsnyen bkur ba'am/de las chos mnyan pa bde blag ma yin par shes par gyis shig /de nas rgyal po rin chen mang pos de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi don gang chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bstan tu gsol/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de ni phyogs gang na mchis/ 'jig 35—386

rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de 'di nas ni thag ji srid cig na mchis/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni gang zhig da ltar de na bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba ①dang / chos ston pa bstan du gsol/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi don gangasachen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyisashergyal po rin chen mang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyisasdomakhams 'di'i7nub phyogs logs kyi sa mtshams kyi yimatha' 'di nas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'jig rtsomorten gyi khams klong nigi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sa mtshams spubazang po'i dbyangs zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa spyod pa thams cad dang myi mthun pho ripa'i phyogs yang dag par bsgrub pa'i gangatshwanyechen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba da ltar bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ngo chosatshwa ston to/ /de nas de skad ces bka' stsal kyang / rgyal po rin chen mang pos 'jig rten gyi khams rgya 1snyematsho de ma shes ma mthong nas 'di snyam du sems sos/ /8'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de de ltar nye na'ang bdag la mthu'i khyadamu)par myed na/ de bas ring ba lta 3)ci smos snyam nas/ de ltar rjes su bsams te()/ de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i ni )byin gyi rlabs legs par len pa'i ting nge 'dzin kun tu sgrib 21pa myed pa lam sogs pa ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la mnyam par bzhagatshu rtego/ /de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i mod nihel/ rgyal po rin chen mang po la de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho mang po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed na/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyis〈 snyede bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi 35—387

khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi byin gyis7brlabs pa mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis de ltar rgyal po rin chen mang ①po la byin gyis brlabs pa mdzad ma ③thag tu de'i med la/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sa mtshams ④bzang po'i dbyangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa spyod pa thams cad dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs yang dag par bsgrub pa'i gang chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad dang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyi snying po la rab tu gnas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gang mchen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad dang de ma yin pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtshotsha48)'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dag na sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gang ji snyed bzhugs pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi stobs dam pa/ rgya mtsho lashesogs pa ye shes rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis hunye rab tu shes so/ /dus gsum kun tu lta ba rnam par rgyu ba rgya mtsho la tho)sogs pa mig rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho hurtebacu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rab tu mthong ste/'di ltar dper na lag mthil du skyu ru ra'i hurte'abras bu bzhag tshupa 'am/ me long shin tu gsal 8ba'i dkyil 'khor la ngo snang ba bzhin no/ / de nas rgyal po rin chen mang pos ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho de dag las langs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi don gangatshwanyechen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad la yang gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyi snying po la rab tu gnas pa der/ de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gang 32chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhal blta ba dang /35—388

de la phyag bgyi ba dang / mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur ba dang / chos mnyan pa'i slad du mchi'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa⑥sems can thams cad kyi don gangasachen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ rgyal po rin chen mang po de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen posnyede'i dus la dbabasrepar shes na song la/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba'i skyes bu rgyasamatsho/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'di dag kyang / bcom ldan 'das ye shes gang7chen mtsho/ rnam par snang mdzad de la phul cig /de nas rgyal po rin chen mang po byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtshophubacu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed po de dag dang / bu rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed po de dag dang lhan cig ste/ bu re re zhing ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i 'khor los sgyur ba7rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig 'jig rten gyi tu)khams rgya mtsho'i 'khor los sgyur57ba rgya mtsho re re zhing ni 'jig rten gyi khams ri rab kyi 'khor los sgyur hurteb rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig /'jig rten gyi khams ri rab (nyekyi 'khor los sgyur ④ba rgya mtsho re re zhing ni hunyestong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi7'khor los sgyur hu snab rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor los bsgyurarwanyeb rgya mtsho re re zhing ni stong gnyis kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor los sgyur5)ba rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig stong gnyis kyi ni )'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor los sgyur (7ba 35—389

rgya mtsho re re zhing ni 〉stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor los sgyur tu)ba'i rgyal po rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor los sgyur ba (gergya mtsho re re zhing ni ma gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi pa'akhor los sgyuramatshab rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor los sgyur 95)ba rgya mtsho re re zhing ni gling gcig7gi 'khor los sgyur (8 ba rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig /gling gcig gi 'khor los sgyur 9ba rgya mtsho re re zhing ni khams kyi rgyal po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig /khams kyi rgyal po rgya mtsho re re zhing ni mi'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu 'dong bar chas pa dang 'khor los sgyur nya noba'i rgyal po rin chen mang po de'i chung ma'i 'khor rgya mtsho dang / bu mo rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed po de dag gis 'di skad ces smras te/ lha'i zhal sna snga nas gsan du gsol/ bdag cag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gi mthil gyi snying po la rab tu gnas pa der/ de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes gang the chen mtsho rnam par snang mdzad de'i zhal blta 1lhab dang / de la phyag bgyi ba dang / mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur ba dang / chos mnyan pa'i slad du mchi bar tsogasol lo/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / rgyal po rin chen snyemang pos chung ma'i 'khor rgya mtsho de dag dang ske/ bu mo rgya mtsho de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ / ji ste khyedas sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i zhal blta ba ni don du mi gnyer/ chos rgya mtsho mnyan pa ni tshor hu tsho35—390

bar myi byed/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho bsnyen bkur ba ni don du mi gnyer/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rgya mtsho mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba ni tshol bar myi byed/ranganyesangs rgyas kyi byang chub rgya mtsho mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba ni don du mi gnyer nyan thos kyi byang chub rgya mtsho mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgyasab ni don du mi gnyer/ yul rgya mtsho 'di nas ni 'gro bar 'dod pa myed/ yul rgya mtsho gzhan du ni bgrod par 'dod pa myed la/ gal te khyed sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang (ngaskurang sangs rgyas thams cad dang ske/ chos kyi dbyings la gnas par gyur te/ 'dod chags dang bcas pa dngasnyi/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la yang myi gnas/ sems can thams cad gsod phod kyang zhe snang ngam nyubyams pa la mi gnas/ mu stegs (hocan thams cad kyi lta ba nirgya mtsho la 'jug cing / spyod kyang log pa'i ye shes sam/ yang dag pa'i ye shes la myi gnas/ chos thams cad kyi tshig 9)rab tu dbye ba bstan pa yang ston la chos kyi dbyings las kyangaspyo )mi g.yo zhe na deng la rag go/ /'khor los sgyur5)ba'i rgyal po rin chen mang porwartedes bstan pa 'di shin tu bstan pa'i tshe / chung ma'i 'khor rgya mtsho de dag dang bu mo rgya mtsho de dag las chung ma re re dang ske/ bu mo re res kyang myig gi khams re res chos kyi dbyings thams cad la dbang sgyur hu ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sa nyi༄rgya mtsho la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi sa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu thob par gyur to / /rna ba'i khams re res kyang nam mkha' khong du chud pa'i sa 8rgya mtsho la stsogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i sa 14'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu thob par gyur to/ /sna'i khams re res kyang gcig la 35—391

brten ①pa'i sa rgya mtsho las ②sogs pa rang sangs rgyas kyi sa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu thob par gyur to/ /lce'i khams re resam kyang sgra'i rjes su 'gro ba'i sa rgya mtsho latswasogs pa nyan thos kyi sa 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu 'thob bo/ /lus kyi khams re res kyang pha rol tu phyin pa dri ma med pa rgya mtsho la sogs pa7pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu 'thob tso)bo/ /yid kyi 3)khams re res kyang sa'i dbang po'i stobs rgya mtsho la nyu)stsogs pa stobs rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu 'thob hu stapo/ /de nas rgyal po rin chen mang po'i chung ma rgya mtsho de dag dang / bu mo rgya mtsho de /rmidag gis theg pa chen po'i tshul rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi gting rnyed nas/ spyod pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul shin tu phra bsngo)snyed la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog par byas te/ rgyal po rin chen mang po la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/bdag cag kun gyis sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mthong / /yongs su mchod de bsnyen bkur zhu ba bgyis/ /'on hu kyang 'di 'dra rgya mtsho7chos ma thos/ /sa mang rgya mtsho 'di dag thob ma 'gyur/ /da teni sangs rgyas sprin las bsgrub pa yonye/ /sa mang rgya mtsho dmyig 32kyang thob par gyur/ /byang chub don du phyogs rnams kun dbyings su/ /rna bas spyod pa dam pa spyod5)par bgyi/ /sna yi khams kyis rang rgyal sa thob ste/ /rten 'brel 'byung ba'i chos rnams rtogs par gyur/ /lces zhu )kyang nyan thos sa mang rgya mtsho thob/ /des ni zhi ba'i bde ba thob par〈 spegyur / /lus kyis (rtes mang rgya mtsho thob pas na/ /bsgrub5nyepa sna tshogs rab tu 35—392

bsgrubatupar bgyi/ /yid kyis dus gsum chos mang rgya mtsho rnams/ /'tshal bar gyur pas gzhan la bstan par bgyi/ /④ de bzhin gshegs pa rmad ga cad kyi7le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o④// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdophyi/ bam po bco lnga pa/ bcom ldan 'das thog ma mngon par sangs rgyas pa ma ga dha'i chos kyi dgon pa'i snying po byang chub na bzhugs te/ blo shin tu rnam par dag pa/myi ⑧gnyis pas yang dag par spyod pa/ chos mtshan nyid myed pa la shin tu gzhol ba/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pas sangs rgyas thams cad dang /mnyam pa nyid brnyes pa/ sgrib ⑨pa myed pas rtogs par tu )thugs su chud pa/phyir myi ldog pa'i chos can spyod yul 'phrogs (7pa myed pa/ rnam par dgod pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la5)shin tu byung ba/ pho brang kun tu 'od na seng ge'i khri padmo'i snying po can la bzhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kun kyang skye ba gcig (rtegis thogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang gzhanatshwastenas 'dus pa/ sems can gyi khams la dpyod pa chos kyi dbyings la dpyod hunyepa/ 'jig rten gyi khams la dpyod7pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la dpyodasngo 7pa/ las kyi rnam par smin pa la dpyod7)pa/ bsam pa'i rgyud la dpyodarwa1pa/ don dang yi ge la dpyod pa/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa la dpyod༄) pa/ 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas pa la dpyod pa/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da 21 ltar byung ba la dpyod pa sha ( )stag dang thabs gcig zhugego/ /de nas byang chub 35—393

sems dpa' de dag 'di snyam hu)du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la thugs brtse〈gebar dgongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su bstan ①kyang rung / sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa yongs su bstan kyang rung / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan yongs su bstan kyang rung / sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid yongs su bstan kyang rung / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa bstan kyang rung / sangs rgyas kyi chos bshad pa yongs su bstan kyang rung / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rang bzhin yongs su bstan kyang rung / sangs rgyas kyi mthu yongs su bstan kyang rung / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan yongs su bstan kyang rung / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub yongs su bstan kyang rung / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ④byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dgodasnyipa bcu ji ltar rnam par dgod pa de dag 4)yongs su bstan kyang rung / byang chub sems dpa'i ⑦spyod pa bcu yongs su bstan kyang rung / byang chub sems dpa'i tshad myed pa bcu yongs su bstan kyang rung / byang chub sems dpa'i gter rnams yongs su bstan kyang rung / byang chub sems dpa'i sa rnams yongs su bstan kyang rung /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam rnams yongs su bstan kyang rung / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bcu rnams yongs su bstan kyang rung / byang chubasnyesems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa bcu yongs su bstan kyang rung / byang chub sems dpa'i mgo bcu yongs su nyu)bstan kyang rung / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yang dag par 'byung ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung myi gcad 1 snapa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab pa dang / 'jig 35—394

rten gyi khams thams cad nye bar nyon mongs pa med par bya ba dang / 'du byed thams cad yongs su shes par bya ba dang / chos thams cad yang dag par bstan par bya ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par dag par bya ba dang / the tsom0)thams cad yongs su gcadatre②pa dang / rnam nur thams cad shin tu bstsal ②ba dang / gnas thams cad rab tu gzhom par bya ba'i phyir / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i7yul bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul bstan kyang rung lta gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i myi bsnyengs /tshopa bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mnga' chen po bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i myi 'phrogs 7pa bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan bstan kyang rung /2) gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i snyan bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i shangs bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ljags bstan kyang rung /gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i spobs pa bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bstan kyang rung / gong du de bzhin gshegs pa'i khyu mchog gi mthu bstan kyang rung snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 59)byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sems kyi yongs su rnam 35—395
