par rtog par0)thugs kyis〈thugs su chud nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par 'du mdzad do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pa de dag mngon par 'du mdzad pasani/ shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i pha rol gyi/ 'jig rten gyi khams gser gyi stimadog ces bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa ⑤rig byed mi g.yo ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu7/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ shar phyogs su brten nas seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te/ skyil mo krung (7skabacas nas 'khod do/ /lho phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i⑧'jig rten gyi khams kha dog yid du 'ong ba zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa rig byed mi bskyod phyisapa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas dpal byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ lho phyogs su brten hu) nas seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te skyil mo krung 3stobacas nas 'khod donye/ /nub phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams pad mo'i mdog ces bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa rig byed bcings myed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' nor dpal byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 3)rdul shin 35—396

tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ nub phyogs su brten ①nas seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te/ skyil mo krung bcas nas 'khod do / /byang phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyedasa'adas pa'i / 'jig rten gyi khams tsam pa ku'i mdog ces bya bdu/ de bzhin gshegs pa rig byed kun spyod kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas/byang chub sems dpa' rin chen risnyedapal byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ byang phyogs su brten nas seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te skyilashemo krung bcas nas 'khod do/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams uta pa la'i mdog ces bya ba 48)de bzhin gshegs pa rig byed nyi ma'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' yon tan dpal byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams spu su brten nas seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te skyil mo krung bcas nas 'khod do/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams gser gyi mdog ces bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa rig hu 7byed mtha' rgal /1gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub 35—397

sems dpa' mig gi dpal byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ shar lho'i phyogasalgematshams su brten rgyanas seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te/ skyil mo krung bcas nas 'khod gdo/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams7su 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'isnyi'ajig rten gyi khams rin po che'i mdog ces bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa7rig byed dam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus dpal byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu/bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams su brten ④nas seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te/ skyil mo krung ④bcas nas 'khod do/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams su 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i pha rol gyi tho'ajig rten gyi khams rdo rje'i mdog ces bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ ri/ rig byed dbang phyug gi〈nyesangs rgyas kyi zhing nas / byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dpal nyu2zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong / ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/nub byang gi phyogs mtshams su brten nas/ seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te skyil mo krung bcas nas 'khod do/ /'og gi 8phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 35—398

'das pa'i pha rolatu'ajig rten gyi khams shel gyi52mdog ces bya ba ③de bzhin gshegs pa rig byed tshangs pa'i dbang po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' duye shes dpal byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig (nyetu/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ 'ogapo)gi phyogs su brtenashenas seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te/ skyil mo krung bcas nas 'khod do/ /steng gi laphyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i spu'ajig rten gyi khams 'dra ba'i mdog ces bya ba hu )de bzhin gshegs pa rig byed sna tshogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' bzang po'i dpal byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te / steng gi phyogs su brten 11nas seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te/ skyil mo krung nyu2bcas nas 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis hunyesangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyisayi/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun thams cad la bltas te 'di skad ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa 'di dag ni ngo mtshar thob pa sha stags/ltaste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni bsam gyis myi khyab pos/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa ni bsam gyis myi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan ni bsam gyis myi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs 35—399

rgyas kyi chos nyid ni bsam gyis myi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa ni bsam gyis ①snyi khyab po②/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyikhuchos bstan pa ni bsam gyis myi khyab bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni bsam gyis myi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun tu rgyu ba ni bsam gyis myi khyab po/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni bsam gyis myi khyab ste / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das7rnams ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag turnyusems can 'dul ba rnams kyi bsam pa thugs su chud cing / nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyis57klas pa dag tu chos ston te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'jig rten gyi khams myi mjed5kye'adi nyid dang / de ma yin pa'i gling bzhi pa gzhan dag na'ang sku gzhan dang gzhan mtshan gzhan dang gzhan/ kha dog dang dbyibs gzhan dang gzhan/ chu zheng gzhan dang gzhan/ sku tshe'i tshad gzhan dang gzhan/ skye mched brnyesalgepa gzhan dang gzhan/ dbang po brnyes pa gzhan dang hu )gzhan/ 'byung ba'i skye mched gzhan dang gzhan/ sku gzugs gzhan dang gzhan du de bzhin gshegs pa sems can rnams kyis5nyerab tu shes sol/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'jig rten gyi khams gling bzhi pa 32bcom pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba 'di nyid na yang de bzhin gshegs pa la tunyedon thams cad grub pa zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya bar husterab tu shes so/ /seng ge'i nga ro can zhes bya b.ranyerab tu shes so/ /35wa 400

shākya0thub pa zhes bya b.rasherab tu shes so/ /drang srong dam pa'i mchog ces bya b.rasherab tu shes so/ /rnam par snang mdzad ces bya b.rasnyirab tu shes so/ /go'ubata ma'i rigs zhes bya bar〈6)rab tu shes so/ /dge sbyong chen po zhes bya b.rasherab tu shes so/ /rgyal ba dam pa zhes bya b.rasherab tu shes so/ /mu stegs byed ces bya bar7rab tu shes sokyi/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag la 3lhasogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams gling bzhi pa bcom pa dang ldan pa na mtshan stong phrag bcur de bzhin gshegs pa sems can rnams kyisamo/nyerab tu shes so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gling bzhi pa 'di dang / 'dab chags su shar phyogs logs na gling bzhi pa shin tu bsrungs pa nyugezhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa la rdo rje zhes bya b.rardzosherab tu shes so/ /dbang phyug ces bya b.ratsorab tu shes so / /blo gros mnga' ba zhes bya bar skyarab tu shes so/ /thub par dka' ba zhes bya bar5)rab tu shes so/ /sprin gyi rgyal po zhes bya bar tsho/nyerab tu shes so/ /nyon mongs pa med pa zhes bya bar 16rab tu shes so/ /skyabs mdzad pa zhes bya bar0 )rab tu shes so/ /thugs dgyes pa zhes bya b.ramanyarab tu shes so/ /mtshungs pa myed pa zhes bya bar gerab tu shes so/ /tshig gcod pa zhes bya bar (nyerab tu shes thoste / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag la'agesogs pa gling bzhi pa shin tu bsrungs pa zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mtshan stong phrag bcur sems can rnams kyis ( nyerab tu shes so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gling bzhi pa 'di dang 'dab chags su lho phyogs logs na gling bzhi pa bzod par dka' ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa la dbang po zhes bya bar༄nyerab tu shes so/ /nor grags zhes bya bar du )rab tu shes so/ /dri ma med pa zhes bya bar5 )rab tu 35—401

shes so/ /yang dag par gsung ba zhes bya bar nyecirab tu shes so/ /②'dul ba zhes bya bar rab tu shes ri —so/ /dgyes pa mnga' ba zhes bya b.rasnyirab tu shes so//rnam par grags pa zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /don mdzad pa zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /mtha' yas pa zhes bya b.ras6)rab tu shes so/ /⑦dpal dang ldan pa zhes bya bar ne/rab tu shes soḍa / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag la sogs pa kyi )gling bzhi pa bzod par dka' ba na mtshan stong phrag bcur de bzhin gshegs pa sems can rnams kyis 31rab tu shes so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gling bzhi pa 'di dang / 'dab chags su nub phyogs logs na gling bzhi pa gnyen 8dang ldan pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de 1 na de bzhin gshegs pa la chu'i lha zhes bya b.rasnyirab tu shes so/ /blta na dga' 32ba zhes bya b.racharab tu shes so/ /rgyal po dam pa zhes bya bar 1)rab tu shes so/ /seng ge 'dul ba zhes bya b.racharab tu shes so/ /bden pa'i blo gros zhes bya bar nyusherab tu shes so/ /mtha' las 'das par gshegs pa zhes bya bar 2 rab tu shes so/ /dgyes pa zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /chos kyi blo gros zhes bya bar 32rab tu shes so/ /'phrinadza nyelas grub pa zhes bya bar 2 rab tu shes so/ /mkhas pa zhes bya b.radza nyerab tu shes jotsho//kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag las rdu tshosogs pa gling bzhi pa/ gnyen dang ldan pa zhes bya ba de na mtshan stong phrag bcur de bzhin gshegs pa sems can rnams kyis 2sherab tu shes so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gling bzhi pa 'di dang 'dab chags su byang phyogs logs na gling bzhi pa seng ge yod pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa la da/thub pa chen po zhes bya bar dud rab tu shes so/ /dka' thub kyis bsgrubs 1pa zhes bya b.ram rab tu shes so/ /zhing la dpa' ba 35—402

zhes bya bar merab tu shes so/ /thams cad thugs su chud pa zhes bya bar parab tu shes so/ /yid bzang po zhes bya bar ri sgyurab tu shes so/ /yongs su dag pa zhes bya b.rasherab tu shes so/ /shugs 'dzin ces bya bar gerab tu shes so/ /lda ldi bzang po zhes bya bar murab tu shes so/ /brtul 48)zhugs brnyes pa zhes bya bar〈nyerab tu shes tetsho/ 7/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag la 1nyasogs pa gling bzhi pa seng ge yod pa na mtshan stong phrag bcur de bzhin gshegs pa sems can rnams kyis hunyerab tu shes so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gling bzhi pa 'di dang 'dab 1nyichags su byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams na gling bzhi pa rnam par bstsags /byapa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa la bdud rnam par 'joms 35pa zhes bya bar tsharab tu shes so/ /yang dag par 'byung ba zhes bya bar 1 rab tu shes so//zhi ba zhes bya bar sna rab tu shes so/ /bzang po'i 17lha zhes bya bar 2 tshorab tu shes sol/ /'dod chags dang bral ba zhes bya bar 21rab tu shes so/ /blo 32gros mchog ces bya bar〈nyerab tu shes so/ /thugs mnyam pa zhes bya bar 5cirab tu shes so/ /gzhan gyis zhunyemi thub pa zhes bya bar da rab tu shes so/ /blo gros kyi dbyangs tsho zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /ring du bzhud pa zhes bya bar na rab tu shes tedu 6/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag la sogs pa tshogling bzhi pa rnam par bstsagasamanyapa zhes bya ba na mtshan stong phrag bcur de bzhin gshegs pa sems can rnams kyis tsharab tu shes so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gling bzhi pa 'di dang 'dab chags su/shar lho'i phyogs mtshams02na gling bzhi pa dga' ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jigs pa zhes bya b.rang rab tu shes so lha/ /mye'i phung po zhes bya bar0lharab tu shes so/ /thugs su chud pa zhes bya b.rabarterab tu shes so/ /35—403

khyab pa dang ldan pa zhes bya b.ramanyu)rab tu shes so/ /myi ldan pa zhes bya b.rakhurab tu shes so/ /rang bzhin 'dzin pa zhes bya bar〈gurab tu shes so/ /rigs par spyod pa zhes bya bar byarab tu shes so/ /myig gi rgyal po zhes bya b.rasnyirab tu shes so / /shin tu 'phags pa zhes bya bar g.yerab tu shes so/ /stobs kyi brtson 'grus 4mezhes bya bar gerab tu shes te༄ḍarī/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de dag la hubye sogs pa gling bzhi pa dga' ba na/ mtshan stong phrag bcur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sems can rnams kyis nyu1rab tu shes so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gling bzhi pa 'di dang 'dab chags su lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams na gling bzhi pa snying po dam pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa la myi g.yo ba zhes bya bar /derab tu shes so/ /mkhas pa'i rgyal po zhes bya b.ratshwanyerab tu shes so/ /yongs 8su rgyas pa zhes bya bar berab tu shes so/ /myi skyodam8pa zhes bya b.rarwarterab tu shes so/ /mdzes pa'i spyan can zhes bya bar 3sherab tu shes sorte/ /rgyal ba'i ( mchog ces bya bar 1rab tu shes so/ /dbyangs kyi dbang phyug ces bya bar tsho rterab tu shes so/ /thams cad gtong ba zhes bya bar〈nyerab tu shes so/ /drang srong 'dzin pa zhes bya bar 3 rab tu shes so/ /ri rab dpal zhes bya bar〈nyerab tu shes te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gling bzhi pa snying po dam pa na mtshan stong phrag bcur de bzhin gshegs pa sems can rnams kyis gyurab tu shes so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gling bzhi pa 'di dang 'dab chags su nub byang gi phyogs mtshams na gling bzhi pa sa bzang po zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa la yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya bar gi snarab tu shes so/ /'od 'phro ba dang ldan pa zhes bya bar tsunyerab tu shes so/ /rin po che'i5)gtsug phudarwa byeces bya bar5nyerab tu 35wa 404

'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can rnams kyisamanyunyerab tu shes so/ /gzhung de ltar lho phyogs dang / de bzhin du nub phyogs dang / ②de bzhin du byang shar gyi phyogs mtshamasashedang / de bzhin du shar lho'i phyogasasnyimatshams dang / de bzhin du lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang /de bzhin du nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / de bzhin du 'og gi phyogs dang /de bzhin du steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye bsnyibargya stong tshad med pa grangs med pa/ dpag tu med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshungs pa med pa/kun tu mtha' yas pa mu med pa sa mtshams med pa brjod du med pa khyachos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'58)dbyings kyi mthas gtugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na'ang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can rnams kyi7rab tu shes te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyisatshwanye byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i tshe/yongs su smin par mdzad pa de dag gis ni spyod pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang /gsung gi rnam pa tha dad pa dang / nga ro rnam pa tha dad pa dang / phrinasgo/spelas rnam pa tha dad pa dang / rnam par smin pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / skye mched rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sbyor ba rnam pa tha dad pa dang / dbang po rnam pa tha dad pa dang / mos pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang hunye/ skye mched rab tu thob pa gzhan dang gzhan gyis/ sems can rnams la chos yongs su bstan pa 'ang tunyerab tu shes so/ /1gesangs rgyas gyi mtshan shin tu bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/sko bam po 35—412

bcu drug pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di na sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di nyid na yang byung ba zhes bya'o/ /gnod pa zhes bya'o/ / skal btumi mnyam pa zhes bya'o/ /dmyigs pa zhes bya'o/ /kunamanya'abyung ba zhes bya'ol/ /gsal shing gi rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /gnas kyi rtsalasko ba zhes bya'o/ /gdon mi za ba zhes bya'o/ /shu ba'i gzebs cizhes bya'o/ /byis pa'i spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag snigang 'di na kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di nyid na yang yongs su 'brel ba zhes bya'o/ /chud za ba zhes bya'o/ /tshor bar gcen pa zhes bya'o/ /myong bar byed pa zhes bya'o/ /sbyor ba las byung ba zhes bya'o/ /nges pa zhes bya'o / /dranasko6)pa can zhes bya'o/ /brjod pa zhes bya'o/ /sems can gyi ④phyi bzhin snyegs dur pa zhes bya'o/ /phyin ci log 'o)gi rtsa ba nyi tshozhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di nyid na yang 'dzud pa zhes bya'o/ /rdul dang bral ba zhes bya'o/ /zhi ba zhes bya'o/ /mtshan nyid med pa zhes bya'o/ / mi nyams〈nyepa zhes bya'o/ /rang bzhin 12med pa zhes bya'o/ /so sor ldan pa zhes bya'ol/ /nub par 'grol sna ba zhes bya'o/ /rang bzhin thudu gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /rang bzhin la 8gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang yang sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di nyid na theg pa gcig ces bya'o/ /zhi bar 'gro tshab 35—413

zhes bya'o/ /dgra dang bral ba zhes bya'o/ /yongs su rtog bzang ba zhes bya'o/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag pa zhes bya'o/ /khur 'dor ba zhes bya'o/ /'gro ba med par 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /'phags pa'i rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya'o/ /drang srong gi spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /gter bcumanyu)zhes bya ston// kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de dag la shesogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di nyid na yang /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la ming bye ba brgya stong gephyag bzhi bcu ⑤yod de/de dag gisardzogasems can rnams bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul lo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di nyid na sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de pel/ du'ajig rten gyi khams khebs ⑨pa yod pa na/ tshol ba'i rtsa ba zhes bya'o/ /myi 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /rtsa ba myi brtan sna )pa zhes bya'o/ /bya ba ma byas pa zhes bya'o/ /rtsod pa thams cad ces bya'o / /rnam par phye 11ba nyam chung ba zhes bya'o/ /kun gzhi dang ldan pa zhes bya'o / /gsod pa'i mchog ces bya'o/ /'gul zhing g.yo ba zhes bya'o/ /dngos po'i gzugs brnyan ces bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang / 'jig rten gyi khams khebs pa yod pa na las su rung ba zhes bya'o/ /ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /srid thertepa zhes bya'o/ /'jigs pa zhes bya'o/ /'jigs hunyepa'i rtsa ba zhes bya'o/ /mtshams dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /sdig pa la spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /'dod pa zhes bya'o / /glud gepa na ba zhes bya'o/ /sgal ba zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de 8yang / 'jig rten gyi khams khebs pa yod pa na don ces bya'o/ /'jigs pa sel ba zhes bya'o //35—414

yon tan thob par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /dbugs 'byin pa zhes bya'o0)/ /tshul bzang po zhes bya'o/ /'dul ba zhes bya'o/ /yan lag gcig pu zhes bya'o/ /sdig pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba zhes bya'o/ /rtogs pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam gru'aphags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang (mi'ajig rten gyi khams khebs pa dang ldan pa na/ sde'i dbang po zhes bya'o/ /gyen du 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /sbyor ba dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /lta ba mnyam pa zhes bya'o/ /mtha' las grol ba zhes bya'o/ /rtogs par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /rjes sum ca)brtul ba zhes bya'o/ /myig dam pa zhes bya'o/ /phyogs su snang ba zhes bya stege/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de dag la 56)sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams khebs pa dang ldan pa na 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ( ming bye ba brgya stong phrag bzhi bcu yod de/ de dag gis sems can rnams bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul lo / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang 'jig rten gyi khams lhag pa na 'jig pa zhes bya'o/ /skal ba gcod pa zhes bya'o/ /smad pa'i gnas zhes bya'o/ /nye bar bsrabasalgepa zhes bya'o/ /rnam par sredam9pa zhes bya'o/ /khonapo du 'gyur ba zhes bya'o/ /nad dang ma bral ba zhes bya'o/ /rgyud 'khrugs pa zhes bya'o / / dka' b.rarwaskrebasgrubs pa zhes bya'o/ /rab tu brtags pa zhes bya'o/ /mos pa dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba nya/de yang 'jig rten gyi khams lhag pa na rab tu 'jigs 8pa zhes bya'o/ /gti mug gi rtsa ba zhes bya'o/ /dgra dam pa 35—415

zhes bya'o/ /bkres07pa'i yan lag ces bya'o/ /ro med pa zhes bya'o/ /kun skyes ri pa zhes bya'o/ /rang bzhin ma yin pa zhes bya'o/ /bkur bar bya bshezhes bya'o / /mun par57khyer ba zhes bya'o/ /blo gros bcom pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang ge)sdug bsngal 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang ske/ 'jig rten gyi khams lhag pa na don chen po zhes bya'o/ /phan pa'i yan lag ces bya'o/ /don gyi don ces bya'o/ /tshad med pa zhes bya'o/ /mthong ba zhes bya'o/ /rtog pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /mchog tu dul ba zhes bya'o/ /rtag tu mnyam pa zhes bya'o/ /gnas par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /yan lag byas pa med pa ri7)zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog par 'grosaba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang 'jig rten gyi khams lhag pa na me'i tsha ba zhes bya'o/ /yan lag dang po zhes bya'o/ /rnam par gdon myi za ba zhes bya'o/ /mi 'phrogs 9pa zhes bya'o/ /tshul zab mo zhes bya'o/ /'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /mi dma' ba 'izhes bya'o/ / rtogs pa51khong du chud pa zhes bya'o/ /grol ba'i rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /rab tu 'grelasab zhes bya'o⑩/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de dag la 1tswasogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams lhag pa na 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ming bye ba brgya stong phrag bzhi bcu yod de/ de dag gis 8sems can rnams bsam pa ci 8lta ba bzhin du 'dul lo8/ /kye rgyal ba'i7sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa lha/zhes bya ba de yang 3 —sku'ajig rten gyi khams rdul bstsal (meb na 'gyod pa zhes bya'o / /kun spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /gcig la gcig5)ces bya'o/ /kun tu 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /ro gcig pa zhes bya'o/ /chos ma yin pa zhes bya'o/ /kun gzhi 35—416

dang mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /log pa la gzhol tsa)ba zhes bya'o/ /log par lta ba zhes bya'o/ /grangs med pa zhes bya'o/ /dgra'i dpung zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang /'jig rten gyi khams rdul bstsal (2ba na 'dod chags pa zhes bya'o/ /smra ba zhes bya'o / /mi dkar ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhi las skyes pa zhes bya'o/ /gzungamu byeb zhes bya'o / /sdig pa'isnyikha ba zhes bya'o/ /lhag pa zhes bya'o/ /khur ⑧zhes bya'o/ /skyed ⑥pa zhes bya'o/ / sra ba ④zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang 'jig rten gyi khams rdul med5nyepa na skyemi mnyam pa zhes bya'o/ /bral ba zhes bya'o/ /dri ma med pa zhes bya'o/ /rtsa ba dang bral ba zhes bya'o/ /ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /bsgrims mipa med pa zhes bya'o/ /bag la nyal ba myed pa zhes bya'o/ /'phags pa zhes tsho/1bya'o/ /phyi ma zhes bya'o/ /dgra bcom pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la yang 'jig rten gyi khams rdul bstsal 32ba na dngos po'i snying po zhes bya'o/ /skal ba sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ /hu grol ba'i don gyi rtsa ba zhes bya'o/ /rang bzhin du gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /mi smad pa zhes bya'o/ /mchog tu rnam par dag pa zhes bya'o/ /srid pa'i mtha'atsha8zhes bya'o/ /sba ba'i snying po zhes bya'o/ /mthar thug par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /yongs su rtogs78pa dag pa zhes bya ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de dag la 7sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rdul bsal ba na 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ming bye ba brgya stong phrag nyartebazhi bcu yod de/ de dag gis 38sems can rnams bsam /tshepa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul lo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 35—417

dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par byung ba na 'dod chags kyis rgyas pa zhes bya'o/ /gtum pa'i rtsa ba zhes bya'o/ /rgya mtsho'i yan lag ces bya'o//yang dag pa las 'das pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ /skal7ba med pa'i rtsa ba zhes bya'o / /'phro ba zhes bya'o/ /skye zhing 'jig pa zhes bya'o/ /sgrib pa zhes bya'o/ /ral gri'i dngongoXzhes bya'o/ /tshal gastug po zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 0kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par byung ba na nor bulasbyin pa zhes bya'o/ /'dud par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /mi zad pa zhes bya'o/ /bskal7ba zhes bya'o/ /chags pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /seng ge zhes bya'o/ /dngos po len pa zhes bya'o/ /'brel ba zhes bya'o/ /snod ces bya'o/ /g.yo ba zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog pa na'aphags pa'i bden pa zhes bya bstso)de yang 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par byung ba na mtshams 1 5bral ba zhes bya'o/ /phye ba zhes bya'o/ /yi ge med pa zhes bya'o/ /sbyor ba med pa zhes bya'o/ /mthong ba med pa57zhes bya'o//bya ba med pa zhes bya'o/ /nye bar bsgrubs pa zhes bya'o/ /sred pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhol ba zhes bya'o/ / skyid de ba nya zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam khu'aphags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par byung ba na zhi bar byed pa brjod7pa zhes bya'o/ /khyab par 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /mngon du bya ba la sbyor bakhezhes bya'o/ /bde bar 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /tshe / tshad med pa zhes bya'o/ /shin tu bsgoms(nyepas mthar phyin pa zhes bya'o/ /lam gyi dam pa zhes bya'o/ /thob par dka' ba'i yan lag ces 35—418

bya'ol/ /pha rol gyi mtshams zhes bya'o/ /brgal dka'atub zhes bya ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par byung ba na 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi mying bye ba brgya stong phrag bzhi bcu yod de/ de dag gis ②sems can rnams bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul lo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'pho 2bar byed pa na 'phrog par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /smon pa'i bshes rngonaganyen zhes bya'o/ /mi brtan zhing 'jig ⑤pa zhes bya'o/ /brjod pa sna tshogs shes bya'o/ /nyam nga bas 'tsho ba zhes bya'o/ /don 'dul ba zhes bya'o/ /khur 'dor ba 6)zhes bya'o/ /rtsa ba zab pa zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin sems pa nazhes bya'o/ /nam mkha'i rtsa ba zhes bya'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'pho na bar byed pa na sred par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /shin tu sbyor ba 79 zhes bya'o/ /nyes pa'i 1 skyon can du gyur pa zhes bya'o / /rlabs shes bya'o/ /'dzin pa zhes bya'o/ /'du shes can zhes bya'o/ /'bras bu la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /brjod du mi rung ba zhes bya'o/ /tha dad pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /rab tu 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'pho 37bar byed pa na bzlog 12pa zhes bya'o/ /smra ba dang bral ba zhes bya'o/ /sgrub pa zhes bya'o/ /dga' ba zhes bya'o/ /'jigs pa bstsal 1lhab zhes bya'o/ /shin tu byung ba zhes bya'o/ /gti mug med pa zhes bya'o/ /nub pa nya zhes bya'o/ /'phags pa zhes bya'o/ / sel ba zhes bya'o/ /dkye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug 35—419

bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'pho 3)bar byed pa na brjod du med pa zhes bya'o/ /tshul nyams pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /rnam par rigadza pa'i lam zhes bya'o/ /bsngo ba dge ba zhes bya'o / /rgya chen po la mkhas pa zhes bya'o/ /rnam par phye ba'i tshul zhes bya'o/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /zil par gyur ga⑧zhes bya'o/ /ye shes kyi bdag po zhes bya'o/ /don yongs su shes pa zhes bya ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de dag la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams 'pho ④bar byed pa na 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ming bye ba brgya rin)stong phrag bzhi bcu yod de/ de dag gis yisems can rnams bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul lo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di ④na/ sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la 'ang 'jig rten gyi khams phan pa na khur tsa ba'i khur zhes bya'o/ /snying po med pa zhes bya'o/ /rkun po lta bu zhes bya'o/ /rga shi zhes bya'o/ /chags pa'i rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /shin tu mched pa zhes bya'o/ /ngal bar byed pa zhes bya'o/ /ngom zung gnag pal zhes bya'o/ /kun tu 'phel ba zhes bya'o/ /ral gri 9nodang 'dra ba zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang / 'jig rten gyi khams phan pa na 'jig 1 )pa zhes bya'o/ /'khrugs pa zhes bya'o/ /bskyod pa zhes bya'o/ /nyam chung ba zhes bya'o/ /'phrog pa zhes bya'o/ /bral ba zhes bya'o/ /mi ldan pa zhes bya'onyu1/ / thab mor gyur patshwa zhes bya'o/ / rtsod par gyur pa 32zhes bya'o/ /gnas su gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog pa 'phags hu༄pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang / 'jig 35—420

rten gyi khams phan pa na kun spyod pa zhes bya'o/ /yang dag pa zhes bya'o/ /zhum pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /yan lag g.yogs pa zhes bya'o/ /smad7pa spangs pa zhes bya'o/ /rjes su mthun52pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhir 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /yan lag spangs pa zhes bya'o/ /tha dad pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /glag gemed pa zhes bya'ol/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams phan pa na snang ba brjodaphupa zhes bya'o/ /thams cad kyi rgya nasazhes bya'o/ /bsam gtan gyi gter zhes bya'o / /snang ba yod pa zhes bya'o/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i chos can yizhes bya'o/ /dngos po zad pa zhes bya'o/ /lam yangs pa zhes bya'o/ /dul ba'i rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /dge ba yod pa zhes bya'o/ /rtsa ba rgyu ba med pa zhes bya stoX/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de dag la na sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams phan pa na 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ming bye ba brgya stong phrag bzhi bcu yod de/ de dag gis sems can rnams bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul lo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu 'gro ba na bsam pa thibs po zhes bya'o/ /gnas sna tshogs su bkram pa zhes bya'o/ /skye gnas su skyesashepa zhes bya'o/ /rim pas 'dug pa zhes bya'o/ /ngo tsha med pa zhes bya'o/ /shes par bya ba'i rtsa ba zhes bya'o/ /'ga' 'ga'i 3 )ro zhes bya'o/ / rtseg pa zhes bya'o / /(nyartag tu 'jig pa zhes bya'o/ / 'gal mye'i nya rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i sgo zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba hunye'aphags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu 'gro ba 835—421

na shin tu g.yo ba zhes bya'o/ /rig pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /blo gros dang ring ba zhes bya'o/ /'phongs 1par 'gyur ba zhes bya'o/ /'jigasalgepa zhes bya'o/ /kun tu 'dren pa zhes bya'o/ /nye bar bsgrub (pa zhes bya'o/ /rten du gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /dngos po'i bdag po zhes bya'o/ /mtshams sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu 'gro ba dugen ngoms pa zhes bya'o/ /bdud rtsi zhes bya'o/ /rgyu ba med pa zhes bya'o/ /rang gi med pa zhes bya'o/ /rtog pa byang ba zhes bya'o/ /yang dag par gzhog pa snizhes bya'o/ /rgyu ba dang bral ba zhes bya'o / /mched 56)pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /lam med pa zhes bya'o/ /mi gnyis pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu 'gro ba na snang bar byed pa zhes bya'o/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho zhes bya'o/ /don rnam ⑧par gdon mi za ba zhes bya'o/ /chos dang phrad pa zhes bya'o/ /'khor ba med pa zhes bya'o / /'brel ba med pa zhes bya'o/ /lam rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ /yang dag par phyin par 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /sbyor ba dag pa zhes bya'o/ /mthong ba'i bdag po zhes bya ste9ḍarī/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de dag la hu )stsogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu 'gro ba na 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ming bye ba brgya stong phrag bzhi bcu yod de/ de dag gisarmānyesems can rnams bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul lo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang hunye'ajig rten gyi khams yongs su dga' ba na skye bar byed pa hunyezhes bya'o/ /rnam par bsgrubs 0pa 35—422

zhes bya'o/ /chags shing7zhen pa zhes bya'o/ /khur khyer ba zhes bya'o/ /mi sdug pa'i rnam pasnyizhes bya'o/ /nada'agethibs po zhes bya'o/ /sdig pa byed pa zhes bya'o / /sdug bsngalasnyibar byed pa'i rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal5bkun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su dga' ba na gzhir 6)gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /sbyor ba dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /tshod melas 'das pa zhes bya'o/ /chos 'phel ba zhes bya'o / /rtogs57pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /sdud pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /sdud par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /lang du red pa zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi gzhi zhes bya'o/ /lta ba chung ba zhes bya'o/ /mthong ba chung ba zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal7'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la yang 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su dga' ba na/ gnas zhig pa zhes bya'o/ / rmongs pa nya tshomed pa zhes bya'o/ /yang dag pa zhes bya'o/ /des shin tu rtogs 11pa zhes bya'o/ /dge bar byed pa zhes bya'o/ /skyon med pa zhes bya'o/ /'khor 1 ba med pa zhes bya'o/ /mtshan nyid med pa zhes bya'o/ /bdag nyid rtogs hu pa zhes bya'o/ /ma skyes pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag sdug bsngal mi'agog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la yang 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su dga' ba na sa mtshams nye bar gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /sel ba dang 'grogs pa zhes bya'o/ /skal ba mi mnyam pa'i don 8can zhes bya'o/ /rang bzhin yangs pa zhes bya'o/ /yongs su rtog pa zad pa zhes bya'o/ /byin gyi rlabs kyi lam zhes bya'o/ /tshogs kyi tshul zhes bya'o/ /dran pa dang bral ba 3 zhes bya'o/ /rtag pa'i hu)lam zhes bya'o/ /grol ba bsgrub7)pa zhes bya ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de 35—423

dag la shisogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su dga' ba na 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ming bye ri ba brgya stong phrag bzhi bcu yod de/ de dag gis7sems can rnams bsam pa ji lta bshogebazhin du 'dul lo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na sdug bsngal 'phagasalgepa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams mi che ba na/ 'tshog⑧pa zhes bya'o/ /rdza ma lta bu zhes bya'o/ /nad dang mnyam pa zhes bya'o/ /lus la yod pa zhes bya'o/ /rab tu 'phel ba zhes bya'o/ / stsogs pa'i sgo zhes bya'o/ /④sdug bsngal gyilaskyon can zhes bya'o/ /rtag phyo)par bya ba zhes bya'o/ /rang la cigazhog pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /'gro zhing 'ong ba zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la yang 'jig rten gyi khams mi che ba na 'tshe ba zhes bya'o/ /mdud par 'dzin pa zhes bya'o/ /rab tu sbyor kyi ba zhes bya'o/ /tshor ba'i yan lag ces bya'o/ /a na sems parwa)zhes bya'o / /rab rab sna byed pa zhes bya'o/ /'dud par byed pa zhes bya'o/ /rnam par bral ba zhes bya'o/ /shin tu gdung ba zhes bya'o/ / kye hud nachazhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog pa(ge/ 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la yang 'jig rten gyi khams mi che ba na stsogs 8pa med pa77zhes bya'o/ /g.yo ba med pa zhes bya'o/ /skyon med pa zhes bya'o/ /ma nyams pa zhes bya'o/ /'grogs pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /tshad med pa zhes bya'o/ /yangs pa zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi yan lag zhes bya'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba zhes bya'o/ /ma chags pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la yang 'jig rten gyi khams mi che 35—424

ba na brtananyepa'i spyod yul zhes bya'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa mtshams nazhes bya'o/ /bden pa la thugane pa zhes bya'o/ /don rab tu chud pa zhes bya'o/ /rang bzhin la gtugs0pa zhes bya'o/ /lta ba yongs su dag pa zhes bya'o/ /dran pas bsgrubasalgepa zhes bya'o/ / grol ba 4)sdud pa zhes bya'o/ /skyobasam pa'i sa mtshams zhes bya'o/ /'khrug pa med par 'gro ba zhes bya ste(nya/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de dag la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams mi che ba na 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la ming bye ba brgya stongadzaspu phrag bzhi bcu yod de/ de dag gis sems can rnams 3)bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul lo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag (nye'ajig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di 3lhen sdug bsngal yi'aphags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la yang 'jig rten gyi khams dbyangs sgrog pa na bsam pa nub pa zhes bya'o/ /shin tu 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /yan lag gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /g.yo sgyu che ba zhes bya'o/ /'brel pa zhes bya'o/ /'dod pa 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /myingatsodu mi rung ba zhes bya'o/ /skye gnas ma rung ba 8zhes bya'o/ /nye bar 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /dngo hu 1skam pa hunyezhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba bu 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la(1/ yang 32'jig rten gyi khams dbyangs sgrog ninyepa na gdul (nyeba'i gzhi zhes bya'o/ /sems kyi tshul zhes bya'o/ /bcings pa dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /rjes su dran pa zhes bya'o/ /nges par rtogs5 nyepa ma yin pa zhes bya'o/ /rnal 'byor dang mi mthun pa zhes bya'o / /brtag5 stopar bya ba zhes bya'o/ /sgo zhes bya'o/ /rtog 3 par bya ba zhes bya'o / /bsgribs pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang 3 sdug bsngal 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams dbyangs sgrog 35—425

pa na gnas7med pa zhes bya'o/ /sbyin bsreg7gi dam pa zhes bya'o/ /phyir log pa zhes bya'o/ /mya ngan dang bral ba zhes bya'o/ /kun tu song ba zhes bya'o/ /chen po zhes bya'o/ /du ba med pa zhes bya'o/ /mi zad pa zhes bya'o/ /yangs pa zhes bya'o/ /shin tu mchod pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gang sdug bsngal ①'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya ba de la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams dbyangs sgrog pa na/ mthong bas mthong ba zhes bya'o/ /spang ba'i ④don ces bya'o/ /rnam par bsgom pa'i⑧rgya zhes bya'o/ /mtshan nyid la 'jug pa zhes yibya'o/ /rnyed par dka' ba zhes bya'o/ /de ma thag pa'i don ces bya'o/ /mkhas pas brtag dzopa zhes bya'o/ /'grogasalgepa'i don ces bya'o/ /mi g.yo ba la mngon du gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /khyad par gyi don ces bya ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de dag la 0sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams dbyangs sgrog phoX pa na 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ming bye ba brgya stong phrag bzhi bcu yod de/ de dag gis 11sems can rnams bsam pa ji lta bsngo)bzhin du 'dul lo / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di na ji ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yongs su bstan pa yod pa de bzhin du shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya stong tshad med pa dpag tu med pa grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab 32pa mtshungs pa med pa/ kun tu mtha' yas pa mu med pa sa mtshams med pa/ brjod du med pa hustechos kyi dbyings kyis liklas pa nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas nyanyagatugs pa dag na yang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yongs su bstan pa yod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams re re na yang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ming bye ba brgya stong phrag bzhi bcu bzhi bcus/ 7yod de de dag 35—426

gis sems can rnams bsam pa ci0)lta ba bzhin du 'dul lo/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na ji lta ba de bzhin du/ lho phyogs dang / de bzhin du nub phyogs dang / de bzhin du byang phyogs dang / de bzhin du byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / de bzhin du shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / de bzhin du lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / de bzhin du nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang de bzhin du 'og gi phyogs dang7/ de bzhin du steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med pa grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshungs pa med pa/ kun tu mtha' yas pa mu med pa sa mtshams med pa gzhal du med pa brjod du med pa chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs pa dag na yang / 'phags pa'i bden pa yongs su bstan pa yod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams re re na yang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi mying bye ba brgya stong phrag bzhi bcu bzhi bcu duyod de de dag gis ④sems can rnams bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul lo/ /'jig rten gyi khams gcig na ji lta ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad shar phyogs nas steng gi phyogs shes bya ba nas/ phyogs bcu ma lus pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar dag la ⑧yang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yongs gyes bstan pa yod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams re re na yang sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'i〈ming bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu0)bcu yod de/ de dag gis sems can rnams bsam pa ji lta b.lo)bzhin du 'dul lo/ /kun 'byung ba'i bden pa'i ming dang / 'gog pa'i bden pa'i ming dang / lam gyi bden pa'i ming dag kyang de bzhin no/ /nyu 3'phags pa'i bden pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu gsum pa'o/1ri// //35—427

brgya bkye ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang bar byas nas 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /shar gyi lus 'phags0)bye ba phrag brgya〈midang nub kyi ban lang55)spyod bye ba phrag brgyasadang / byang gi sgra mi snyan bye ba phrag brgya dang / rgya mtsho 45)chen po bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /khor yug rdo rje'i ri bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /byang chub sems dpa' skye ba bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /mngon par 'byung ba bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par 'tshang rgya ba bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor rimab bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba nabye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /ri rab ri'i rgyal po bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i khams kyi lha'i ris bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i nyu5ris bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /mtshe ma'i lha'i ris bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /'phrul dga'i lha'i ris bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i ris bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /gya nom snang ba bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /dge rgyas bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /'bras bu chen po bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ /'og min bye ba phrag brgya bstan to/ ri/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i khongs su gang ci meyang rung ste/ gtogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad ril gyis hunyebastan to/ /ji ltar 'di na 1snyebacom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs shing / byang 35—428

chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ bskor hu)cing mdun du byas par snang ba de bzhin du 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya kun na〈kyeyang de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag brgya bzhugs par snang ngo / /de dag thams cad du 'ang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis laphyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' bcu bcu 'ongs par gyur te(6)/byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba ⑤dag ste/'di ltar 'jam dpal dang / sangs rgyas dpal dang / nor dpal dang /rin chen yidapal dang / yon tan dpal dang / mig gi 9)dpal dang /brtson 'grus dpal dang / chos kyi dpal dang / ye shes dpal dang /bzang po'i dpal zhes bya bsnyedag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang / 'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa dag ste/'di ltar gser gyi mdog dang / yid du 'ong ba'i mdog dang / pad mo'i mdog dang / tsam pa ku'i mdog dang / ud pa la'i mdog dang / sa le sbram gyi mdog dang / rin po che'i mdog dang / rdo rje'i mdog dang / shel gyi mdog dang 'dra ba'i mdog ces bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa 9)mtshan 'di zhes bya ba nya ridag gi〈nyezham ring na tshangs pa'itshwa spyad pa spyod de1nye/ 'di ltar rig byed mi g.yo ba dang / rig byed mi skyod 8pa dang / rig byed bcings pa medasapa dang /rig byed kun spyod pa dang / rig byed bsgribs79pa med pa dang / rig byed mtha' rgalarwanyedang / rig byed dam pa dang / rig byed dbang phyug dang /rin byed tshangs pa dang / rig byed sna tshogs shes bya ba dag go/ /byang chub 35—429

sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu phyin te/ gcig ji lta ba de bzhin (thams cad do/ /thams cad na yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhes bya ba sha stag rtsidon 'di nyid brjod ①de/gcig na ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad na yang ste/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang so so nas smra bar gyur to/ /'jig rten kun dang mi ldan zhing / /bral bar gyur te dngos med pa'i/ /yang dag sangs rgyas sus geshes pa/ /de dag myig gi lam mi gnas/ /shes rab chen po sus mthong zhing / /dngos po'i 'du shes mi 'jug la/ /rnam par bsgoms shing shes gyur pa/ /de dag de bzhin gshegs par gyuralta/ /'jig rten khams 'di mthong gyur te4)/ /sangs rgyas che 47)ba nyid dag 8la/ /gang gi sems ni mi g.yo phyo)ba/ /de dag mi yi mchog tu 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas chos la gang gi rnams/ /mnyam pa'i sems su rab 1tswa'ajug cing / /mi gnyis 31mngon gyur 32brtan pa〈nyernams/ /de dag bsam gyis mi khyab 'gyur/ /gang rnams bdag dang sangs rgyas dag /rang bzhin mnyam par rab gnas shing / /mi gnas len pa med pasarnams/ /de dag bde bar gshegs par 'gyur/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /rnam par shes dang sems pa 'dag /grangs med de bzhin gshegs pa ( 9rnams/ /de dag thub pa chen por 'gyur/ /blta bar bya las 'das pa dang / /rnam par blta las de bzhin te/ /chos la nyu gang dag rmongs nyu2med pa/ /de dag rab tu 'od byed 'gyur/ /gang gis 1 shes rab chen po ( )rnams/ /sems bskyed kun la rab gnas shing / /thams cad mthong yang skye med pa/ /de dag grags pa 35—430

chen por 'gyur/ /sems can rnams la skye ba med/ /'jig pa'ang yod pa ma yin te/ /de ltar gang gis7)shes pa ni/ /de dag bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gisalgegacig la mang shes shing / /mang po'ang gcigasari tu rab rtogs te/ /gnas kyi rnams su'ang 'byung 'gyur ba④/ /de dag 'jigs pa med par 'gyur//de nas 'od zer de dag 'jig rten gyi na khams 'di nas 'das te/ shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams bcu bcu snang bar byas so/ /de bzhin du lho phyogs phyidang ske/ nub7phyogs dang / byang 78)phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams bcu bcu snang bar byas so/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang ske/ 'og gi 0phyogs dang steng gi phyogs dag tu yang 'jig rten gyi khams bcu bcu snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams re re zhing yang 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya bstan pa nas/ 'og min bye ba phrag brgya'i bar du yang 1 bstan te/'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi nyunyakhongs su gang ci'ang rung ste/ gtogs 1 par gyur pa de dag thams cad ril gyis bstan to/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das sangs༄tas kyi gdan la bzhugs shing / byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nyurtadang thabs gcig pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams re re dag gi gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya kun na yang de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag brgya bzhugs par snang ste/ thams cad du'ang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis7phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' bcu bcu 'ongs par gyur to / /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gethams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste / 'di ltar 'jam dpal dang / sangs rgyas dpal dang / nor dpal 35—431

dang ske/ rin chenatudapal dang / yon tan dpal dang / mig gi⑧dpal dang ske/ brtson 'grus dpal dang / chos kyi dpal dang / ye shes dpal dang /bzang po'i dpal zhes bya ba dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa dag ste/'di ltar gser gyi mdog dang / yid du 'ong ba'i mdog dang / pad mo'ikhumadog dang / tsam pa ma'i mdog dang / uta pa la'i mdog dang / sa le sbram gyi mdog dang / rin po che'i mdog dang / rdo rje'i mdog dang / shel gyi mdog dang 'dra ba'i mdog ces bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan 'di zhes bya ba dag gi zham ring srin/ tshangs pa'i spyad pa7spyod pa dag ste/ 'di ltar rig byed mi g.yo ba dang / rig byed mi skyod57pa dang / rig byed bcings pa med pa dang / rig byed kun spyod pa ⑧dang / rig byed bsgribasalgepa med pa dang /rig byed mtha' rgal dang / rig byed dam pa dang / rig byed dbang phyug dang ske/ rig byed tshangs pa dang / rig byed sna tshogs shes bya ba dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang / byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed tu )dang lhan cig tu phyin pa dag ste/ gcig ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad do/ /thams cad na yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhes bya ba sha stagatshwanyedon 'di nyid brjod tsho de/ gcig na ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad na yang〈gebarjod de/de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang so so nas smra bar gyur to/ /gang gis 8'gro ba shin tu gtses gyur cing / /sredashepa'i gsal shing ldan par kun shes 35—432

nas / /rang 'byung7kun mkhyen yon tan tshol bsho rnams/ /de dag chos nyid 'di 'dra 'di yinasheno/ /chos kyi rang bzhin gnas pa mthong gyur nas/ /mtha' gnyis gang gisasnyirab tu spangs ༄57gyur cing / /ldog pa med cing dgos pa kun shes pa/ /de dag nga yi4)'khor lo mtshungs med skor57)/ /gang rnams chos dang ldan pa'i bsam pa yis42)/ /'khor ba'i skye dgu tho kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bskal pa bsam yas rgya chen go gyon pa'i/ /drang srong chen po'i longs 7spyod 'di 'dra'o/ /gzhan gyis mi pham 11tshodapa' ba'i rgyal mtshan can/ /bdud rnams thams cad mthar 'byin mgon the po rnams/ /byams pas gang dag mi 'jigs sgra 'byin pa/ /de dag chos nyid 'di 'dra 'di yin no/ /'di dag nang nas byung ngo zhes bya bar/ /nyon mongs sel ba'i sems ni skad cig tu/ /thams cad shes pa su yi rgyud skyes pa/ /de dag rnam par 'phrul pa 'di dag ston/ / gang rnams〈nyechos kyi rnga ni rdung byed cing / /byang chub sems kyang srog chags thams cad la/ /phyogs bcu'i 39zhing rnams kun tu shes byed pa/ /rang byung de dag tshul ni 'di 'dra'o/ /gdul bar dka' ba mtha' yas spyod yul can/ /zhing rnams bye ba gang dag spyod gyur cing / /nam yang dngos po dag la mos med tshapa / /de dag de bzhin gshegs bzhin rnam par 'phrul/ /gang rnams dga' zhing mos pa mtha' yas pa7/ /rgyal ba rnams ni shin tu rnam dag cing / /de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' 'dra rjes dran pa1 tsho/ /de dag la ni smon lam 'di yang btabatunye / /sems can don la gang rnams mos gyur cing / /re re dag gis 19mnar med sdug bsngal ba/ /bskal pa dpag med smin par bya dad pa/ /de dag skyon med pham med shin tu srung ni )/ /gang rnams lus dang srog la mi lta 35—433

zhing ske/ /sangs rgyas chos la rtag tu brtul0)zhugs te/ /mkhas pa bdag med rnam par su spyod pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas chos nyid 'od thob gepo/ /de nas 'od zer de dag 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'das nas/ shar phyogs logasalgesu 'jig rten gyi khams brgya snang bar byas pa nas gzhung de bzhin du steng gi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams brgya snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang ④'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag snibargya bstan pa nas/ 'og min bye ba phrag brgya'i bar du bstan te/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi khongs su gang ci yang rung ste/ gtogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad ril gyis bstan to/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs ⑥shing / byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang thabs gcig pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams re re'i gling bzhi ⑦pa bye ba phrag brgya kun na yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bzhugs par snang ste/ thams cad du yang sangs rgyas kyi nabyin gyi rlabs kyis9)/ phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' bcu bcu 'ongs par gyur nyu chito/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/ 'di ltar 'jam dpal dang / sangs rgyas dpal dang ske/ nor dpal dang / rin chen 3tshedapal dang / yon tan dpal dang /mig gi dpal dang / brtson 'grus dpal dang / chos kyi hurtedapal dang / ye shes dpal dang / bzang po'i dpal zhes bya ba dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang / 'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa dag ste/ 'di ltar gser gyi mdog dang / yid du 'ong ba'i mdog dang / padmo'i mdog dang / tsam pa ku'i mdog dang / utpa la'i 35—434

mdog dang / sa le sbram gyi mdog dang / rin po che'i mdog dang / rdo rje'i mdog dang / shel gyi mdog dang 37'dra ba'i mdog ces bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa'o / /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs patshanamatshan 'di zhes bya ba dag gi zham ring na tshangs pa'i spyad pa spyod de/ 'di ltar rig byed mi g.yo ba dang / rig byed mi skyod pa dang / rig byed bcings pa med pa dang / rig byed kun spyod pa dang / rig byed bsgribs gepa med pa dang ske/ rig byed mtha' rgal 45dang / rig byed dam pa dang / rig byed dbangakhephyug dang / rig byed tshangs pa dang / rig byed sna tshogs zhes bya ba dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang / byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing / byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu phyin te / gcig 8ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad do / /thams cad na spuyang byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhes bya ba sha stag don 'di nyid brjod de3 )/ gcig na 11ji lta ba de 12bzhin thams cad na yang brjod de(nye/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang so so nas smra bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyipha sgyu ma'i skorang bzhin du/ /thugs su chud pas bsgribs pa samed gzigs te/ /zil gyis mi 3 non chags pa mi mnga' bar/ /skye dgu nyi rab tu 'dul bar shin tu snang / /la las gser gyi ri bo 'dra ba de/ /sku cher 19skye bar gyur pa rab tu mthong / /skyes bu 3 )zla ba rnam par mdzes pa de/ /tha ma'i sku yang (nya'adzin par la las mthong / /yon tan tshad las 'das pa kun mnga' zhing ske/ /dgongs pa mkhyen bzhin shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ / skye dgu'i 32seng ge don yod gshegs pa ste nye/ /la las 'chag cing gshegs par shin tu mthong / /35—435

phyogs bcu kun tu rnam par snang ba de/ /la las31mthon thing rimispyan du de bzhin mthong ske/ /'dod pa'i yon tan ldan pa'i skye dgu〈rnams/ /gzigs nas bzhad par de bzhin la las mthong / /gzi brjid mtshungs med mnga' la la lam geyis / /seng ge'i nga ror gsung ba de bzhin mthong / /zil gyisamanyami non ma log gsung mnga' 6ba/ /sku yi tha mar ston pa la las mthong bcings pa kun las rnam par grol ba de/ /la las khab nas 'byung bar rab tu mthong / /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas spyod pa rnams/ /gzigs shing zhi ba der gzhol4)la las mthong / /la las byang chub snying po dam pa la/ /chos rnams thams cad mngon par sangs rgyas shing / /yon tan thams cad pha rol phyin pa dang / /mun pa rdul bstsal tshon nyon mongs sbyangs pa mthong / /la las chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba thoyang / /thugs borje chen po brnyes (1pa de mthong ngo / /la las skye dgu 32tshad med rnam 'dul bar/ /skyes bu'i dam pa de ni de bzhin mthong / /la las gzi brjid mtshungs pa med pa de/ /'jig rten thams cad zil gyis hu mnan mdzad des/ /rdzu 'phrul chags med bla med stobs mnga' ba/ /seng ge'i nga ro sgrog par de bzhin mthong / /la las rab tu zhi ba'i thugs mnga' ba 'jig rten sgron ma mya ngan 'das par mthong / /rnam par 'phrul pa de dag mthong nas kyang ske/ /stobs bcu'i stobs mnga' de dag rab tu shes/ /de nas 'od zer de dag 'jig rten gyi khams de dag nyida'adas te shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams stong snang bar byas pa nas gzhung de bzhin du steng gi 7phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams stong gi bar du snang bar byas te( sgyu/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya bstan pa nas/ 'og min bye ba phrag brgya'i 35—436

bar du bstan to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi khongs su gang ci yang rung ste gtogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad ril gyis bstan to/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi gdan la 1 bzhugs par snang ba de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re'i du gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya kun na yang / de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs par snang ngo / /thams cad du yang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis /phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' bcu bcu 'ongs par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/ 'di ltar 'jam dpal zhes bya ba nas bzang po'i dpal gyi bar du'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang / 'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa dag ste/ 'di ltar gser gyi mdog ces bya ba nas 'dra ba'i mdog ces bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang thams cad 3de bzhin gshegs pa khrumatshan 'di zhes bya ba'i zham ring na tshangs pa'i spyad pa spyod pa dag ste/ 'di ltar rig byed mi g.yo ba zhes bya bsrenas rig byed sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad 7)kyang re re zhing byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu 37phyin pa dag ste/gcig ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad do/ /thams cad na yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhes bya ba sha stag don 'di nyid brjod 9de/ gcig na ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad na yang brjod do/ / /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang so so nas smra bar gyur to/ /gang gis 11bde gshegs rnams kyi chos zab pa/ /zil gyis non pa 12brjod pa med pa 1lharnams/ /gang la 'jig rten 35—437

rtag tu myos 'gyur ba/ /de dag thams cad rim gyis rab tu ston/ /gal te bdag gcig nyamed du zin na ni/ /de yi spyod yul stong pa zhi ba'angasamed/ /rang byung rdul rnams shin tu bstsal dab yi/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sku yang ji ltar 'byung / /mkhyen dang rnam grol zhabs dang ldan pa rnams/ /mtshungs pa med la grangs kyang nam yang med/ /de ni 'jig rten 'di na 5)la la dag /rgyu la thogs 0pa med par 'dod phyir ro/ /gang la phung po med cing khams med de//skye mched dag dang skye zhing 'chi pamed pa/ /de yi grangs ni 'jig rten 'di brnyes pas / /skyes bu rtenanoseng ge rnams su rab tu brjodarshar/ /nang dang phyi zhes bya bar nya rigadags pa rnams/ /de dag rang bzhin dngos nyid stong71pa ste/ /rtog pa med cing rnam rtog de bzhin med/ /gzhal du med pa'i chos nyid 'di 'dra'o / /de dag la ni g.yo ba nam yang med/ /snyems shing ldegatshwa dang sgrib pa gang yang med/ /'jig rten thams cad rjes su rab tu mkhyen/ /mtha' yas 'dul ba'i tshul ni 'di 'dra'o/ /zhi ba'i ting 'dzin spyod yul dgyes pa hu rnams/ /rtse gcig gnyis la spyod pa 1 ma yin te/ /yid kyis bstsags 8pa'ang de bzhin migang yang med/ /'dir ni sangs rgyas rnam 1 'phrul mtha' yas pa'o/ /rgyu dang rkyen dang bya ba rnam 91shedag dang / /las kyi rnam smin sems can spyod pa yis/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes mi ldog ste/ /bde gshegs chos 'di〈rjede ltar bsam mi khyab / /phyogs rnams bcu na ji ltar 'khod pa yi/ /'jig rten rnam pa sna tshogs kun gzigs shing / /sems can tshad med yongs su 'grel (ste mdzad kyang / /skyes bu'i dbang po de dag rtog mi mnga'/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni gser gyi mdog31 /de yang kun na rnam par kun tus snyeganas/ /de dag bsam pa ji sa 35—438

'dra jitubazhin du/ /thub pa rnams ni de ltar chos kyang ston/ /lade nas 'od zer de dag 'jig rten gyi khams de dag nas 'das te/ shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams stong phrag bcu snang bar byas so/ /gzhung de bzhin du steng gi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams stong phrag bcu snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang7'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya bstan pa nas/ 'og min bye ba phrag brgya'isnyibar du bstan te/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag gipo)khongs su gang ci'ang rung ste/ gtogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad ril gyis kyirabastan to / /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs shing / byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang thabs gcig ⑦par snang ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams re re dag gi gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgyasakun na'ang de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag brgyas3bzhugs par snang ste / thams cad du yang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcu 1 rinas byang chub sems dpa' bcu bcu 'ongs par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/ 'di ltar 'jam dpal nas bzang po'i dpal zhes bya ba'i bar dgatshwanyego/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyangs3)'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag 1snyenas 'ongs pa dag ste/'di ltar gser gyi mdog nas 'dra ba'i mdog gi bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa 14mtshan 'di zhes bya ba dag gisnyizham ring na tshangs pa'i spyad pa spyod pa dag ste/ 'di ltar rig byed mi g.yo ba nas/ rig byed sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i bar tsodag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad re re zhing yang nyi byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi 35—439

zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu phyin pa dag ste/ gcig ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad do/ /thams cad na yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhes bya ba sha stag don 'di nyid brjod shi)de/ gcig na ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad na yang brjod dozhu/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang so so nas smra bar gyur to/ /lha dang 'jig rten bcas pa zil mnan te/ /snying rje la ni gang zhig sems gtong zhing / /'gro ba thams cad bskyab ③par zhugs pa rnams / /de dag las ni 'di 'drar 'gyur bar 'ong / /bde gshegs rnams la snying nas dad bskyed cing / /gang gi sems ni nam yang〈gemi ldog par/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa yongs su mi gtong bar⑥/ /de dag las ⑦ni 'di 'drar 'gyur bar 'ong / /gang rnams gang du'ang 'jug pa yongs༄med cing / /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams las mi ri9 ldog pa/ /shin tu brtan pa blo gdung med pa rnams/ /de dag las ni 'di 'drar tsho/rte'agyur bar 'ong / /gang rnams 'gro zhing 'dug dang 'chag nyu1pa'i tshe/ /nyin mtshan rgyun tu rjes su sems byed cing / /sangs rgyas bdag nyid che la nyushesems spel ba/ /de dag las ni 'di 'drar hunye'agyur bar 'ong / /dus gsum thams cad rab tu gzhal byas kyang / /gang gi sems ni zhum par mi 'gyur zhing / /sangs rgyas yon tan rjes su slob mos pa /de dag las ni 'di 'drar 'gyur bar 'ong / /bdag gi rang bzhin yongs su gzhal byas shing / /thams cad ma lus zhi bar byed pa dang / /bdag dang bdag med 'dod chags bral ba'i sems/ /de dag las ni 'di 'drar 'gyur bar 'ong / /gzhan gyi khibasam pa yongs su gzhal byas shing / /rtog dang rnam rtog thams cad rab spangs te/ /spyod52pa 'di 'dra dag dang ldan gyur pa/ /35—440

de dag las7ni 'di 'drar 'gyur bar 'ong / /gang rnams bsam gyis mi khyab zhing 'jal7zhing / /sems can rgya mtsho yid kyis 'thung byed de/ / blo che7rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan gyur pa/ /de dag las ni 'di 'drar 'gyur bar 'ong / /gang gis zhing rnams rnam par bsams pas na/ /gzugs dang gzugs med 'du shes yodakyimed pa/ /thams cad grangs su nye bar 'gro ba ni/ /de dag las ni 'di 'drar 'gyur bar 'ong / /gang rnams zhing gi⑧rdul du gzhig byas shing / /thams cad phyogs su bkang zhing bgrang byas te/ /de dag nang du rgyal ba 'dzud byed pa/ /de dag las ni 'di 'drar 'gyur bar 'ong / /de nas 'od zer de dag 'jig rten gyi khams de dgashe'adas nas shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams stong phrag brgya snang bar byas paralanas/ steng gi phyogs kyishe 'jig rten gyi khams stong phrag brgya'i bar du snang bar byas so/ /3ske )'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya bstan pa nas/ 'og min bye ba phrag brgya'i bar du bstan te/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi khongs su gang ci 'ang rung ste gtogasalgepar gyur pa de dag hu)thams cad ril gyis bstan to/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs shing / byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang thabs gcig par snang ba de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re'i gling bzhi pa7bye ba phrag brgya dag na yang de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag brgya dag sangs rgyas 8kyi gdan la bzhugs par snang ste/ thams cad du yang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyisalgephyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' bcu bcu 'ongs par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/ 'di ltar 35—441

'jam dpal zhes bya ba nas bzang po'i dpal gyi bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa dag ste/ 'di ltar gser gyi mdog ces bya ba nas 'dra ba'i mdog ces bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan 'di zhes bya ba dag gi zhamanyering na tshangs pa'i spyad pa spyod pa dag ste/ 'di ltar rig byed mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba nas rig byed sna tshogs shes bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu phyin pa dag ste/ gcig ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad do/ /thams cad na yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhes bya ba sha stag don 'di nyid brjodasade/ gcig na ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad na yang brjod dori / /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang so so nas smra bar gyur to/ /mi 'dul kha lo sgyur ba mthu chen la/ /gang dag kha dog rigs kyis blta (5'dod pa/ /mig nyams log par lta ⑥bar gyur pa ste/ /de dag rgyal ba'i chos nyid mi shes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i kha dog dbyibasakyidag ni/ /'jig rten kun na na'ang shes par nus pa med/ /gang gis bskal pa bye bar bsam byas 9 kyang / /mthu chen rnams kyi kha dog mtha' med do/ /de bzhin gshegs la / snamatshan nyid mi mnga' ste/ /chos rnams thams cad mtshan nyid med cing dben/ /yan lag kun ldan blta na mnyam71 med pa/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 12kun na rab tu snang / /sangs rgyas chos rnams gzhal du yod pa min/ /gang rnams ci yang 'di yi tshul bshad de/ /ldan pa〈stem yin mi ldan ma yin pas/ /35—442

sangs rgyas chos rnams rang bzhin rab tu dben/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phung po 'jig ①pa med/ /'byung dang 'jig par spro bar du mi mdzad de/ /mnga' brnyes mnga' bsgyur rnam ri par gdon mi za/ /brjod du med par bstan 54pa rnam par spyod/ /lus dang sems kyang mnyam par ri'urab gyur cing / /nang dang phyi yis rnam par dben pas na/ /gnyis po bgrang du mi rung shes pa ༄9)rnams/ /chags med bcings med bde bar gshegs par 'gyur/ /gya rnam snang zhing thugs gsal 'od mdzad pa/ /spyod yul yongs dag 3kun tu snang gyur te/ /thams cad mkhyen pa kun gzigs kun na bzhugs/ /skye dgu'i de don kyang rgya chen yangs pa mdzad/ /gcig tu gyur cing mang por rtsonarab tu gyurahu sna/ /mang por gyur cing gcig tu de bzhin 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i khams ni du mar thugs chud cing / /thams cad tshul dang 'dra bar rab tu 'gyur/ /sku med de la chags pa gang yang med/ /byon pa med cing bstsags tshokāpa yod min yang thege/ /kha dog mtha' yas rnam par dgod byas shing / /'gro ba sna tshogs lus su de dag snang ske/ /'jig rten thams cad sems kyis brtags pa yin/ /sems ni rtogarwalhapa nam yang ma yin te/ /bde nyustegashegs ye shes 15de 'dra'i rang bzhin no/ /de phyir rgyal ba'i sku ni 'di 'drar snang / /de nas 'od zer de dag 'jig rten gyi khams de dag nas 'das te/ shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams brgya stong phrag bcur nyu9snang bar byas / 1nas gzhung de bzhin du steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams brgya stong phrag bcu'i bar du snang bar byas te/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya bstan pa nas/ 'og min bye ba phrag brgya'i bar du bstan to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi khongs su gang 35—443

ci yang rung ste/ gtogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad ril7gyis bstan to/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs shing / byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang thabs gcig par snang ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams re re'i gling bzhi pa bye ba ②phyag brgya dag na yang / de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag brgya dag sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs par snang ste thams cad du yang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis57phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' bcu bcu 'ongs par7gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/'di ltar 'jam dpal zhes bya ba nas bzang po'i dpal gyi bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa dag ste/ 'di ltar gser gyi mdog ces bya ba nas 'dra ba'i mdog ces bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan 'di zhes bya ba dag gi zham ring na tshang pa'i spyad pa spyod pa dag ste/ 'di ltar rig byed mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba nas rig byed sna tshogs shes bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dgasathams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu phyin pa dag ste/ gcig ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad dope/ /thams cad na yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhes bya ba sha stag don 'di nyid brjod del/ gcig na ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad na yang brjod dog9)/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang so so nas smra bar gyur to/ /'jig rten rang byung de las mchog med pa/ /35—444

mi gnas dam pa phul dang mchog gi rnams/ /drang srong chen po srid pa'i rgyud 'grel ba/ /yon tan kun ldan rnam dag 'di yin no/ /'du 'dzi med cing chags pa mi mnga' la/ /'du shes dngos med gnas pa med pa7rnams/ /phun sum dge ldan smad pa mi mnga' ba/ /mgon po rnams kyi chos nyid thub par dka' / /shin tu 'od snang dag par gyur padza rnams/ /brgal du glags med rtog pa med pa'i rnams/ /g.yo med mtha' ma rnam par spangs pa yokye/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi ye shes tshul 'di yin/ /lus dang sems la rnam par rtog med cing / /bde gshegs chos la gang zhig 'jug 'gyur ba/ /de dag chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin la/ /nam yang nem nur dbang du mi 'gro brngo)/ /'jig rten dag na dmyigs pa gang yod pa/ /de dag kun la bstan pa'i chos 'jug ste/ /gang dag phyir rgol med pas bstan mdzad kyang / /rang bzhin ldog par 'gyur ba gang yang med/ /dngos po rab shes las rnams yod min par / /the tsomasathams cad rnam par spangs byas te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu rtogs pa'i tshe/ /sems la rnam par 'byed pa namadza yang med/ /mi shes chos rnams rnam par phye ba dag /byung med tshig gi lam gyis rab brjod pa//sangs rgyas gsung gi rjes su 'brang〈nyebyas na/ /gcig kyang ma yin mang po'ang ma yin no/ /mang dang gcig pa nam yang yod min te/ /mang po rnams la gcig pa yod med do/ /mang7dang gcig pa rnam par bsgom byas na/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas shes par 'gyur/ /'jig rten kun tu sems can zhing rnams dang / /shin tu zhi ba'i chos rnams rnam bltas te/ /mi gnas sems la rtogatshwa)pa myed pa yis1ge/ /dran ldan sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /35—445

sems can chos dang de bzhin zhing gi rnams/ /de dag rang bzhin ji bzhin brtag tubyas na/ /gcig dang tha dad gyur pa ma yin te/ /de ltar sangs rgyas tshul 'di shes pa yin/ /de nas 'od zer de dag 'jig rten gyi khams de dag nas 'das te/ shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba〈snang bar byas pa zhunas steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba'i bar④du snang bar byas te5ge)rka/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya bstan pa nas 'og min bye ba phrag brgya'i bar du bstan to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi khongs su gang ci yang rungs/ste/ gtogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad ril7gyis bstan to/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs shing ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang thabs gcig par snang ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams re re'i gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya kun na yang / de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag brgya nidag sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs par snang ngo / /thams cad du yang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' bcu bcu 'ongs par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dgalokyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/'di ltar 'jam dpal zhes bya ba nas bzang po'i dpal gyi bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 1 'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa dag ste/ 'di ltar gser gyi mdog ces bya ba nas 'dra ba'i mdog ces bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan 'di zhes bya ba dag gi zham ring na tshangs pa'i spyad pa spyod pa dag ste/ 'di ltar rig byed mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba nas 35—446

rig byed sna tshogs shes bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu phyin pa dag 1)ste/gcig ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad do/ /thams cad na yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhes bya ba sha stag don 'di nyid brjod de/ gcig na ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad na'ang brjodaphudo/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang〈bso so nas smra bar gyur to/ /shes rab dpag med chos( /rnams mtha' yas pa / /srid pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin pa dag /tshe ring nad med mnyam med mtshungs med 'od/ /yon tan che mnga' 'di55)dag sbyor 'di'o/ /gang gis sangs rgyas chos rnams dngos rtogs shing / /dus gsum kun tu brtags kyang mi ngoms te/ /dmigs pa shes byed rnam par mi rtog pa/ /bsam yas mos pa de dag sbyor 'di yin⑥/ /sems can yul mos sems can 'du shes med/ /'jig tshogs chos shes lam gyi rgyud dang bral/ /bsam gtan nang dang sems la bcings pa med/ /chags med yid ldan de dag sbyor 'di yin/ /rtogs rimakhas rab tu rtogasalgepa'i chos can rnams/ /mya ngan 'das spyod rigs la brtson pa dag /thar pa'i lam brtson mnyam pa nyid ldan pa/ /zhi ba thob pa de dag sbyor 'di'o / /ded dpon rjes song sangs rgyas byang chub mchog /thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings bzhin rtogs shing / /bde kha'ajug mkhas pas sems can rnams 'don pa'o )/ /bde gshegs bsam can 11de dag sbyor 'di'o/ /sangs rgyas don tshig rjes su shes bya zhing / /chags med blo yangs rtogs shing bsam gtan byed/ /kun tu 'gro bar song las 12col spyod pa/ /rang byung spyod pa de 35—447

dag sbyor 'di'o/ /nam mkha'i dbyings dang sprul pa yid ldan rnams/ /gnas dang rang bzhin mtshan nyid shes pa dag /mya ngan 'das rigs spyod pa mkha' 'dra rnams/ /thob dka' thob pa rnams kyi sbyor 'di'o①/ /zla ba zla phyed nyin dang nub bgrang〈bzhing / /lo dang bskal pa'i rang bzhin su sems pa 'jig rten 'du zhing 'jig par 'gyur ba dang / /grangs tshul sus rtogs de dag sbyor 'di'o / /zhing gi sems can ji snyed skye 'chi ba/ /gzugs dang gzugs med 'du shes 'du shes med/ /de dag ming dang gnas pa rtogs shes pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rtogs pa'i sbyor 'di'o/ /'das pa'i dus dang ma 'ongs da ltar la//ngag gis tshulam gyis gang na rtogs sa)byed cing / /dus gsum rang bzhin ji bzhin5gertogs gyur pa/ /mnyam med de dag sbyor ba 'di yin no/ /de nas 'od zer de dag 'jig rten gyi khams de dag nas 'das te/ shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag bcu snang bar byas pa5nyanas/ steng gi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag bcu'i bar du snang bar byas nasal/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya bstan pa nas/ 'og min bye ba phrag brgya'i bar du bstan to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi khongs su gang ci yang rung ste/ gtogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad ril ⑤gyis bstan to/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs shing byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang thabs gcig par snang ba de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re'i gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya dag kun na yang de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag brgya dag sangs rgyas ⑨kyi gdan la bzhugs par snang ngo / /thams cad du yang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi 35—448

rlabs kyis phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' bcu bcu 'ongs par 1)gyur tol/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/'di ltar 'jam dpal zhes bya ba nas bzang po'i dpal gyi bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa dag ste/ 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khamasalgegaser gyi mdog ces bya ba nas 'dra ba'i mdog ces bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan 'di zhes bya ba dag gi zham ring na tshangs pa'i spyad pa spyod pa dag ste/ 'di ltar rig byed mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba nas rig byed sna tshogs shes bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang / byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / lhan cig tu phyin pa dag ste/ gcig ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad do/ /thams cad na yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhes bya ba sha stag don 'di nyid brjod de① / gcig naphuji lta ba de bzhin thams cad na yang brjod don)/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang so so nas smra bar gyur to/ /'das dus gang gis bsgrub dudaka'i brtul zhugs che ⑦brtsams shing / /nam yang zhum (5pa'i sems su gtong bar mi byed de/ /brgal dka'aphrorgal te bdag gis sems can kun gdulas(3 zhes/ /seng ge'i sgra sgrog5)de dag spyod yul 'di yin no/ /gang zhig 'dod dang sred pa 'byung zhing 'jug pa dang / /ma rig gzhol ba gti mug mun bsgribs 'jig rtenarwa rnams/ /sems can rang bzhin bdag med brtan pa bzod par 'gyur(nye/ /bdag kyang 'jig rten mgon 'gyur zhes pa de yul 35—449

'di / /'jig rten sems can mang po 'dod dregs7)'dam bying ba/ /med pa'i chos la rtog /bapas sdug bsngal mthong gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul chos la bag yod gang spyod cing / /bdag gis50sems can kun bsgral7de dag spyod yul 'di/ /sngon rin mtha' shes dka' tshad med brtan pas mthong gyur cing / /bdag rten rmesems can pha rol mtha' yas 'khor gyur pa/ /de dag rgyal bas theg pa zhi ba mchog la bkod/ /bdag gis po/de 'dra'i chos bstan de yi spyod yul lo/ /sems can khams rnams mgon med nad kyis gzir gyur cing / /ngan song gzhol ba 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug gdungs/ /me lce 'bar phung 'jigs59 gzugs mi bzad bsregs gyur pa/ /mthong nas sgrol 7phyir zhugs pa de dag spyod yul 'di'o/ /lam gol lam ma yin pa'i rkyen la spyod gyur cing / /mun pa chen por 11rtol bar dka' rnyed 'gro nyurtemathong nas/ /snang ba chen po bskyed de sangs rgyas chos ston nyunyeces/ /'di skad tshig brjod de dag spyod yul 'di yin no/ /srid pa'i mtshos g.yengs sems can rab tu mang ba dag /mtha' mi mthong zhing 7skyabs med do zhes mi dga' ba/ /mthong nas brtson 'grus stobs bskyedaskochos kyi gru sbyar cing / /pha rol su 'gro zhes brjod7de dag spyod yul 'di'o/ /sems can rtsa ba med la gnas pa mi mkhas kun/ /g.yang sa chen por ltung zhing 1 sems nyams rmongs mthong nas/ /snying rjes chos kyi zam la mkhas pa su 'god 18cing / /dran par gyis shes su smra de dag spyod yul 'di'o/ /shin tu dog pa'i btson 19rar sdug bsngal sems can rnams/ / nad dang rga bas gzir cing mtshams 2 kyis mnar ba dag /mthong nas bdag gis5)thabs kyi chos rnams kun brtsams te/ /sems can kun dgrol sems pa5)de dag spyod 35—450

yul 'di'o/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams thams cad thos gyur the tsom 17med/ /chos dbyings spyod yul phyogs bcu kun tu rgyas bkang ste/ /'di dag thams cad brtags〈nyen gsog kyang mi 'jigs shing / /sems can kun la snyoms byed de yi spyod yul lo/ /de nas 'od zer de dag 'jig rten gyi khams de dag nas 'das te / shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya snang bar byas so//'jig rten gyi khams bye ba stong snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya phrag stong snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgyas snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrigs44)stong snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong ⑤snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams tshad med papo)snang bar byas so/ / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhal du med pa snang bar byas so/ /9)'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa snang bar byas so/ /de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshungs pa med pa kun tu mtha' yas pa/ mu med pa sa mtshams med pa dpag tu med pa brjod du med pa dag kyang snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis rinaklas pa nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa thams cad kyang snang bar byas so/ /gzhung de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / de bzhin du nub phyogs dang / de bzhin du byang phyogs dang / de bzhin du byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / de bzhin du shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / de bzhin du lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang /de bzhin du nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / de bzhin du 'og gi phyogs nas steng gi phyogs kyi bar du 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba snang bar byas so/ / 'jig 35—451
