rten gyi khams bye ba brgya snang bar byas so/ /3)'jig rten gyi khams bye bkustong snang bar byas pa nas / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i bar gyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang 5)snang bar byas so/ /de ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams ⑥shin tu rgyas par byas pa9)nas/ chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyang snang bar byas so/ /'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang 'dzam bu'i gling bye ba phrag brgya bstan snopa nas/ gzhung de bzhin du 'og min bye ba phrag brgya'i bar du bstan to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi khongs su gang ci yang rung ste gtogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang ril she)gyis bstan to/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi nyu1gdan la bzhugs shing / byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang thabs gcigatshwa)par snang ba de hunyebazhin du 'jig rten gyi khams re re'i gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya kun na 8yang / de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag brgya dag sangs rgyas kyi gdan la bzhugs par snang ngo / /thams cad du yang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' bcu bcu 'ongs par 7gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/ 'di ltar 'jam dpal zhes bya ba nas bzang po'i dpal gyi yibar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa dag 7ste/ 'di ltar gser gyi mdog ces bya ba nas 'dra ba'i mdog ces bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan 'di zhes bya ba dag gi zham ring na tshangs pa'i spyod pa spyad 12pa dag ste/ 'di ltar rig byed mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba nas/35—452

rig byed sna tshogs shes bya ba'i bar dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang / byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu phyin pa dag ste/gcig ji lta0)ba de bzhin thams cad do/ /thams cad na yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhes bya ba sha stag don 'di nyid brjod demi/ gcig nas ji lta ba de bzhin thams cad na yang brjod dong)/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang so so nas smra bar gyur to/ /bskal pa gzhal yas bsama'a'ugyis mi khyab sems kyi skad cig la/ /gang gisalgemathong yang bstsags 77med 'gro dang dngos po'i tshul med pa'i/ /lam dusa'ajug pa de ni 1 /thams cad kun gyis shes 'gyur nyurtete / /stobs bcus tshul 'di ji ltar mkhyen 3stobazhin 'jigs med sangs rgyas 'gyur / /grags nyunyepa snyan par phyogs rnams kun tu mtshungs med grags gyur cing ske/ /bgegs rnams kun las 'das te chos nyid 'di 3)la dgar spyad debe/ /tshad med thams cad so sor zhi zhing don rnams kun rtogs 8pas/ /de phyir phyogs rnams kun bkang bde gshegs chos nyid 'di ston to/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin de ni spyod pa'i 'bras bu 'thun7pa ste/ /'jig rten don 'gyur de bzhin gshegs la mchod pa yongs〈nyebyas shing / /de dag thams cad so sor 'thun /—snyepar ye shes rnams bsgoms (7pas/ /sems can dam pa sangs rgyas rnam 2sdu 'phrul 'di 'drar 37phyogs bcur ston nya/ /thog mar nyan 'dod bla ma bsnyen bkur dgebazod pa des byas shing / /rang bzhin med pa'i chos la rab rtogs 2hebasam gtan bsnyen byed pa/ /bde gshegs nyid ni rtogs 'gyur 'gro ba rnam sgom rdugesems tshim byed/ /chos nyid de 'dra spyad 27pa myur du bde gshegs thob 35—453

par 'gyur/ /snying nas 'dri zhing phyogs rnams rgyas0)byed rtse gcig thobashebyed cing ske/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan mos las mi zlog ④spyod pas tshim ⑤byed pa/ / dngos dang dngos sa med thams cad shes byas spangs shing dngos zad payi/ /sangs rgyas bdag med dpe med mthong badzode dag lus 'di yin/ /bzang po'i spyod yul can gyi sems kyi 3)phyogs rnams kun bkang zhing / /zhing rnams thams cad chos kyi gter gyis khyab byas tshim byed pa/ /ji bzhin chos spuganas chos nyid mtha' la the tsom med pa'i nya )rnams/ /stobs bcu ci〈nya'adra de bzhin gyur pa'i lus ni 'di dag go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos turtegang sgra brjod de la 'jug byed cing / /chos sna kyi 'khor lo ji bzhin blta dka' gzhal yas rtagashebaskor ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i gsung kun byang chub yan lag rtogasal/ /de ltar 'jug pas rtag tu sangs rgyas sku rab 'di dag mthong / /mthong yang mig gi rnam shes tshul du rdul med mthong ba med/ /rnam shes sgyu ma bzhin pas mig 8stong stobs bcu mi mthong ngo / /'du shes thams cad rnam rtog 8yin gyi sangs rgyas mthong ba min( tsho/ /shin tu chags med yul med de ni rgyal ba mthong ba yin/ /sems can las mang bstsags〈snyepa de dag shin tu blta dka' ste/ /nang dang phyi dang dbyibs dang mdog tu phyogs bcu kun na med/ /de bzhin rang byung sku ni gzhal yas phyogs rnams kun 'gengs pa/ /shes par dka' ba 'dren pa chen po nyu)sgrib 3 pa med pas brnyes( skye/ /nam mkha'5 )dag la zhing rnams bye ba dngos por 2nyeganas par snang / /de nas 'ong ba med cing phyogs bcu kun tu 'gro ba med/ /gcig gecing gnas par 'gyur yang de dag ci la'ang gnas pa med/ /de bzhin rang byung rnams kyi sku ni mkha' dbyings 35—454

rtag tu 'gengs/ /①de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer las rnam par sangs rgyas pa / le'u7bcu bzhi pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po bcu bdun pa/① de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dgasarang bzhin gcig pa'i sems la bye brag tha dad pa'i rnam pa 'di lta bu dag 'di lta ste/ bde 'gror 'gro ba dang / ngan song du 'gro ba dang / dbang po tshang ba dang dbang po ma tshang ba dang / skye ba 'thun ra pa dang / skye ba mi 'thun 6pa dang / sdug pa dang / mi sdug pa dang / bde ba myong ba dang / sdug bsngal myong ba snang ba dag la ltos/ las mekyis ni sems mi shes so/ /sems kyis ni las5nimi shes so/ /tshor bas ni rnam par phyo spyin pa mi shes so/ /rnam par smin pas ni tshor ba mi shes so/ /sems kyis nya rini tshor ba mi shes so/ /tshor bas ni semasarwa)mi shes so/ /rgyus ni rkyen mi shes so/ /rkyen kyis ni rgyu mi shes so / /dngos pos ni dmigs pa mi shes so/ / dmigs pas ni dngos po mi shes sol/ /tu de nas byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ sems can bstan 1snyepar bya ba'i phyir/ /gang 'di yongs su dri ba dang kṣa/ /chos rnams chos nyid ci 'dra ba/ /'jam dpal bdag las mnyan par gyis/ /chos rnams 'di dag g.yo ba med/ /shin tu dngos po med pa ste/ /de phyir gzhan gyis gzhan dag gi / /ngo bo nyid kyang mi shes so/ /ji ltar chu klung rgyud kyi rnams/ /gzhan dang 35—455

gzhan du 'grogs rgyu yang / /gcig gis gcig ni mi shes te①/ /chos kyi chos nyid de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'bar ba'i mtshan ma can/ /'od 'phro gzhan dang gzhan 'grogasarsā kyang / /gcig gis gcig ni mi shes te/ /chos kyi chos nyid de bzhin no/ /ji ltar rlung ni stenadza tshul gyis/ /gzhan dang gzhan gyi bar du rgyubya / /gcig gis gcig ni mi shes te/ /chos kyi chos nyid de bzhin no/ /ji ltar sa yi khams kyi rnams/ /gcig la gcig ⑤ni gnas gyur kyang / /gcig gis gcig ni mi shes te/ /chos kyi chos nyid de bzhin no/ /mig dang rna ba sna dag dang / /lce dang lus dang yid kyi rnams/ / 'di dag lamasani rgyu 'khodakyikyang ske/ /byed pa po ni gang yang med/ /'byung ba'i rang bzhin med pa yis/ /'byung ba nye bar bstan byas kyang / /bstan par byas pasnyegang yang med/ /bstan pa la ni dngos po med1)/ /mig ni rang bzhin nyid kyis stong / /rna ba sna yang rang bzhin gyis/ /lce dang lus dang yid rnams kyang / /med de yongs su brtags pa yin/ /gang zhig /1rang bzhin dngos med par/ /tshul bzhin rab tu rtogs hurtebyed pa/ /de yi mig la 'khrul5nyepa med/ /chos mig bsam gyis mi khyab poyi/ /yang dag pa dang yang dag min/ /bden nam 'on te rdzunasnyiyang rung ske/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten kun/ / tshig gi las7kyis brjod pa'o(/ tsho / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa' nor dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag5)sems can thams cad sems can 3)med mod kyi 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can 'dul ba'i dus la ji ltar 'bab pa dang / sems can gyi5) tshe ji lta ba dang lus ji (1lta ba dang spyod pa ji lta ba dang / mos pa ji lta ba dang mtshan ma ji 35—456

lta ba dang bsam pa ji lta ba dang sbyor ba ji lta ba dang sems ji lta ①ba dang /spyod pa ji lta bsnyebazhin du sems can rnams kyis sems can rtsigadul ④ba'i phyir mthong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nor dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang rnams rab tu zhi spyod cingakyi/ /thos dang ldan pa'i sa 'di yin/ /'di don ji4)'dra de bzhin du/ /'jam dpal bdag las mnyan par gyis/ /bdag gi lus la su gnas zhes/ /gang gishenang ni rab shes pa/ /yang dag yod dam med pa'i don/ /des ni rab tu shes pa yin/ /lus kyi rnam par dgod pa ni/ /phyogs na ( mi gnas brjod pa yin/ /de bas shes pa de gnas la/ /nam yang chags7)par mi byed do / /lus ni rnam par spyad pa yis/ /dngos po kun kyang rnam par bsgoms/ /sems ni phyir ldog mi 'gyur te/ /dngos po kun nasarwatebartags pa'o/ /gang gi tshe ni rjes su 'brang / /gang gi tshe ni phyir ldog 'gyur/ /ji ltar mgal nyurteme 'khor lo yi/ /thog ma tha ma bskor〈nyeb bzhin/ /dngos po thams cad mi rtag par / /skye bo gang rnams rtogasalgepa yang / /lus la bdag kyang med pa'i phyir/ /'du shes phyir yang ldog par 'gyur/ /bdag med rmi lam lta bu yi/ /las ni kun tu rab tu 'byung / /rnam par smin pas rab tu 'byung / /phyi mtsha ji bzhin sngon de bzhin/ /sems ni dbang byed yin par bshad/ /dad pa'i tshul ni ji bzhin du/ /tshul bzhin ma yin phyin ci log /'jig rten thams cad ston par byed/ /ji snyed7'jig rten brda〈nyeyod pa/ /de dag thams cad brtags pa ste//chos nyid de ni nam du yang / /chos gcig la yang mi hu)gnas so/ /rkyen rnams la ni rten〈nyebacas te/ /chos rnams so sor rab tu 'byung / / phyi ma ji bzhin 35—457

sngon de bzhin/ /1)de dag ldog par de bzhin 'gyur/ /(9de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa' )rin chen dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag54)sems can thams cad kyi 'byung ba chen po bzhi rnams yongs su 'dzin pa med cing bdag gi medams)la mnyam pa yin yang ske/ 'on59)kyang bde ba'i tshor ba dag kyang52)snang / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba dag kyang snang / yid du 'ong bar byed pa dang / yid du mi 'ong bar byed pa dang ske/ nang du byed pa dang phyi rol du byed pa dang / tshor ba chung ba dang /tshor ba che ba dang / tshe 'di la myong ba dang / tshe gzhan la myongasnyob dag kyang snang la/ chos kyi dbyings la ni yid du 'ong ba'am/ yid du mi 'ong ba yang med pa 'di 49 ci zhig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ji ltar las rnams byas gyur pa/ /tshor ba de bzhin 'byung 'gyur gyisathe / /'di la byed pa gang yang med/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'o/ /shin tu phyis pa'i me long la//ngo 37ni ji ltar 'dug pa bzhin/ /de la de ni de bzhin snang / /chos kyi rang bzhin de bzhin no/ /ji ltar zhing dang sa bon dag /gcig gi gcig hurteni mi shes kyang / /rang bzhin nye bar ston par byed/ /las kyi rang bzhin de bzhin no / /sgyu ma byed pa mkhas pa zhig /lam po cher ni song 'dug ste/ /gzugs rnams ston par byed pa bzhin/ /las kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nonyunye/ /ji ltar shing gi 'khrul 'khor rnams/ /sna tshogs sgra mang brjod byed kyang tso/ /de ni bdag dang bdag med min/ /las kyi rang bzhin de bzhin no/ /ji ltar bya rnams mang po yis15/ /sgo nga'i sbubs ni phye ba las/ /sgra skad gzhan dang 35—458

gzhan 'gyur ba/ /las kyi rang bzhin de bzhin no/ /ji ltar ma yi mngal 1du yang ske/ /bu ni 'pho bar mi 'gyur te/ /'on kyang dbang po sna tshogs 'gyur/ /las kyi rang bzhin de bzhin no/ /ji ltar sems dmyal 'jigs pa na/ /gshin rje'i ris5nyagatogs sdug bsngal ba/ /de dag la ni 'ong ba med/ /las kyi rang bzhin de bzhin no/ /ji ltar rin chen mchog rnams dang / /lha yi bu rnams kun ldan yang / /'pho bar snang ba gang yang med/ /de bzhin las kyi rang bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'jig rten la la dag /bsam gyis mi khyab 'bar gyur kyang / /de dag 'ong ba gang yang med/ /las kyi rang bzhin de bzhin rino/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' yon ri snatan dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag sa de bzhin gshegs pas chos gcig mngon par sangs rgyas na 'on kyang chos tshad med pa yang yang 6 dag par ston/ zhing tshad med pa yang rnam par ston/ sems can tshad med pa yang 3)rab tu ston/ gsung tshad med pa yang shin tu sgrog /sku tshad med pa yang shin tu ston/ bsam pa tshad med pa yang thugs su chud/ rdzu 'phrul tshad med pa yang yang dag par 48)ston/ 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med pa yang shin tu skyong nyu)/ rgyan tshad med pa yang byin gyis rlobasanyu —/ spyod yul tshad med pa yang shin tu ston/sto/ chos kyi dbyings kyang rnam pa tha dad du mi snang ba 'di ci zhig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yon tan dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gnas 'di shes par dka' ba ste/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis pho bdag la dris/ /de ni mkhas pas rnam par shes/ /yon tan mos pa kyi dpyod par byed/ /ji ltar sa ni gcig pu yang / /sems can 35—459

mang po rab7tu rgyu/ /de la gcig dang tha dad med/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid de bzhin no/ /ji ltar mye ni gcig pu yang / /'jig rten kun na kun kyang 'bud / /de la mye lce tha dad med/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid de bzhin no/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho gcig pu las/ /chu klung tshad med 'bab gyur kyang / /de la chu yi bye brag med/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid de bzhin no/ /ji ltar rlung ni gcig pu yang ske/ /'jig rten kun nakhurgyu zhing ldang / /de la gcig dang tha dad med/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid de bzhin no/ /sprin chenas rnams ni 'brug bsgrags shing / /sa rnams kun kyang ngomasalgepar byed/ /de yi char lasabye brag med/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid de bzhin no/ /ji ltar sa ni gcig pu yang / /mya7gu sna tshogs 'byin cing ston9)/ /sa la bye brag 'byed pa med/ /sangs rgyas chos nyidasnyede bzhin no/ /ji ltar sgrib med nyi ma ni/ /phyogs bcu kun tu snang bar byed/ /de la 'od zer tha dad med/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid de bzhin no/ /ji ltar nam mkha'i zla ba ni/ /'jig rten kun la rab tu snang / /gnas nas 'gyur ba gang yang med/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid de bzhin no/ /ji ltar tshangs pa mi mjed bdag /stong gsum na ni 'dug mod07kyi/ /de la lus ni bye brag med/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid 1 de bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa' mig gi dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba bskyed pa (gegacig kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed rsāpa'i sems can rnams gzugs sna tshogs dang ske/ kha dog sna tshogs dang / rigasaphunasna tshogs dang / dbang po sna tshogs dang ske/ longs spyod sna tshogs dang / dbangam sna tshogs dang / 'khor sna 35—460

tshogs dang / ①yon tan sna tshogs dang / phyug dbul sna tshogs dang /(2shes rab sna tshogs su yang snang la de bzhin gshegs pa ni gang la yang mi mnyam pa'am / tha dad du dgongs pa gang yang med na 'di ci zhig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mig gi dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ji ltar sa ni ro gcig kyang / /sa bon tshul bzhin myu gu ston/ /byams dang snang bar sems pasamed/ /sangs rgyas yon phul de bzhin no/ /ji ltar chu ni ro gcig kyang / /snod kyi dbang gis rnam par 'gyur / /de bzhin sangs rgyas yon phul ba/ /rgyud kyi rnamasasnyil rnam par 'gyur / /ji ltar sgyu mkhan mkhas pa ni/ /rtag tu 'khor kyang mgu bar byed/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas yon phul ba/ /shin tu sbyangs pa dga' bar byed/ /ji ltar mkhas pa'i rgyal po dag /'gro ba mang po shes par byed/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas yon phul ba/ /ji ltar bskyed bzhin shes par byed/ /ji ltar dri med me long la/ /jitu'adra'i gzugs rnams7de bzhin snang / /de bzhin sems can bsam tshul deni/ /sangs rgyas yon phul rnam dag 'byung tshe/ /ji ltar dug phan sman gyi rnams/ /dug nad thams cad sos par byed/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas yon phul ba/ /nyon mongs dug ni chen po sel/ /ji ltar nyi ma shar ba ni/ /'grosngonab 'di dag snang bar byed/ /mun pa dag kyang rnam par7sel/ /sangs rgyas yon phul de bzhin no/ /ji ltar zla ba dri med pa/ /kun tu mnyam pa nyid byas te/ /sa ni rab tu snang bar byed/ /sangs rgyas yon phul de bzhin no/ /ji ltar chu yi stobs shugs kyis(rte/ /sa ni thams cad g.yo 'gyur btso/ /sangs rgyas yon phul de bzhin rnal/ /srid gsum 'gromathub 35—461

rnams kyang skyod/ /'bar dang 'od 'phro bcas pa'i me/ /thams cad dag tu sreg pa'i dngos/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas yon phul ba/ /'du byed thams cad sreg par byed/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' brtson71)'grus dpal la 'di skad ces smrasadza so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa gcig na thams cad lta ba mthun ⑧pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spong bar ci'i phyir mi 'gyur/ de dag kun la'angs ④gzugs ni gzugs nyid du zad/ tshor ba ni tshor ba nyid du zad/ 'du shes ni lta'adu shes nyid du zad/ 'du byed rnams kyang 'du byed rnams nyid du zad/rnam par shes pa'ang rnam par shes pa nyid du zad/ 'dod pa'i khams kyang 'dod pa'i khams nyid du zad/ gzugs kyi khams kyang gzugs kyi khams nyid du zad/ gzugs med pa'i khams kyang gzugs 45)med pa'i khams nyid du zad/ma rig pa yang ma rig pa nyid du zad/ sred pa'ang sred pa nyid du zad la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa'ang phan par byed pa 'am/ gnod par byed pa ma yin na7/ de ci'i phyiran / de nas byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus dpal gyisal/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ de ltar khyod kyis 9 dris pa gang 1 / /la la myur du rnam grol 31zhing / /la la dka' bar 'grol 'gyur ba/ /sangs rgyas sras po bdag la 32nyon/ /'di 'dra nyunyedapag tu med pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bstan 14gyi nyes ma yin/ /dad dang brtson 'grus nan tan gyis/ /rtag tu khyad mapar 'gyur ba yin/ /ji ltar rtsa tshadang shing gsher 1 ba/ /mer bcug shin tu nyams ྅2chung zhing / /ring por mi thogs 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin le lo 19bstan pa lari — —/ /ji ltar gtsub mas 35—462

gtsubs7pa'i tshe/ /ma byung bar zhuni myur bteg riXn/ /myur du 'chi bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /de ltar le lo bstan pa la/ /nyi ma'i nor bu'im phyi ba la/ /yang dang yang bzhag btegaspegepa 'kho/ /de la me 'byung 7)mi 'gyur te/ /de bzhin le lo bstan pa la/ /ji ltar nyi ma shar ba'i tshe/ /byis pa rnams ni mig brtsums7shing / /mi mthong ci phyir zhes smra ba/ /de bzhin le lo bstan pa la/ /rkang7lag med par skyes pa'i misakyi/ /ji ltar sgyug 11mda' kha bug gis/ /sa ni dbug par 'dod pa bzhin/ /de ltar le lo bstan pa la/ /ji ltar byis pa rgya mtsho7)las/ /yang du〈nyeyang du bcus57byas shing / /skam par la la 'dod pa ltar/ /de bzhin le lo bstan pa la/ /ji ltar bum pa chus bkang zhing bo/ /bskal pa'i me ni byung ba'i tshe/ /la la gsadam par 'dod pa ltar/ /de bzhin le lo bstan pa la/ /ji ltar la la phyogs bcu yis/ / /nam mkha' ji snyed tha mal pa'i/ /gzugs kyis rgyas par dgang smra ba(1)/ /de bzhin le lo bstan pa la / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa' chos dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras chos kyi tshul nyon mongs pa thams cad skems5)pa 'di nyid blangs kyang / sems can la la 'dod chags kyi dbang du 'gro/ la la zhe sdang gi gi )dbang du 'gro/ la la 31gti mug gi dbang du 'gro/ la la trigeng rgyal gyi dbang du 'gro/ 'chab pa'i dbang du 'gro/ khon 2nadu 'dzin pa'i dbang du 'gro/ phrag zhustedog gi dbang du 'gro/ ser sna'i dbang du 'gro/ sgyu'i dbang du 'grog nye/ g.yo'i dbang du 'gro la na chos de dag kyang sems med par yang tsu 〉gzung du 'ang mi nus te/ nyon mongs par gdags pa kun kyang rnam pa (2kun tu sems kyi rgyud tu zad na de ji lta bu/ de nas byang 35—463

chub sems dpa' chos dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la tshigs su bcad0)de smras pa/ gang gisashedon de dris parabarnams/ /sangs rgyas sras po nga lasanyon/ /yang dag sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di/ /thos pa tsam gyis mi 'grub bo/ /la la stobs med chu klung gis/ /nan()gyis khyer bar gyur pa dag /skom zhing shi bar gyur pa bzhin/ /ma bsgoms7chos kyang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'gro ba mang po la/ /zas dang skom dag sbyin byas kyang / /bdag nyid bkres pas57shi ba ltar/ /de bzhin chos la ma bsgomasalgepa'o/ /ji ltar sman pa la la zhig /sman rnams thams cad bdog7bzhin du/ / lto ba'i nad kyis shi ba bzhin/ /chos la ma bsgoms de bzhin no/ /ji ltar dbyig gi5nyamadzod dag tu / /rin chen mang po bgrang byed5)kyang / /nam5)phyed tsam yang myi 'thob pa/ /chos la ma bsgoms de bzhin no/ /ji ltar bde ba kun ldan pa'i/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor skyes kyang / /zas dang gosacadag mi bdog pa/ /de bzhin chos la ma bsgoms pa'o/ /ji ltar 'on pa rol mo yi/ /sil snyan glu la mkhas pa zhig /gzhan zhig de yid midaga' byed pa/ /chos la ma bsgoms7de bzhin no/ /ji ltar dmus long ri mo mkhan/ /tshong〈nyedus dbus su 'drir〈nye'ajug kyang / /bdag nyid kyis ni mi mthong ba/ /chos la ma bsgoms de bzhin no/ /ji ltar mtsho chen 3)mnyan pa zhig /skye bo mang po sgrol byed kyang / /bdag nyid de nang 'chir (2 'gyur ba/ /chos la ma bsgoms de bzhin no/ /ji ltar lam gyi bzhi mdor yang / /phun sum tshogs pa kun brjod cing / /bdag gis thob par mi 'gyur ba(1/ /chos la ma bsgoms de bzhin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dpal la 'di skad ces smras 35—464

sol/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i 47ye shes sngon du 'gro ba yin na/ de ci'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa sems can la la lamu ni sbyin pa brjodami/ la la la ni tshul khrims/ la la la ni bzod pa/ la la la ni brtson 'grus/ la la la ni bsam gtan/ la la la ni shes rab brjod pa mdzad / la la la ni byams pa/ la la la ni snying rje/ la la la ni dga' ba/la la la ni btang dusnyoms brjod par ⑥mdzad kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par7rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ni chos gcig 'gas0)'byung bar mi nus so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ sems can gzhan gyi bsam shes pa/ /ngo mtsharashirmad du byung ba ste/ /de ltar gang gis don dris pa/ /sangs rgyas sras po bdag larwatenyon/ /smra ba'i mchog ni gang yang rung / /chos gcig gis ni 'byungarwanyeb med/ /gang yang 'byung ba yod pa myin/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba de bzhin med/ /bskal5nyepa gang la gnas pa yi/ /bsam pa mkhyen nas don tshamadzad cing / /gang la jiḍūdag tshul 'thun pa/ /de bzhin chos kyang bstan pa mdzad / /ser sna can la sbyin pa brjod/ /tshul khrims ngan la nya 7tshul khrims rnams / /mi bzod panyeni bzod parwa)des/ /brtson 'grus 'byor pa le lo la'o//rnam par 'khrug5) la bsam gtan brjod/ /shes rab 'byor pa shes med la'o/ /gdug5nyepa'i sems la byams pa bshad/ /'tshe ba rnams la snying rje ste/ /zhum pa la ni dga' ba5)bshad/ /'khor ba'i sems la btang (2snyoms te/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams thams cad kyang / /rim pas de ltar 'byung ba yin/ /ji ltar sa la las byas pa( ste/ /khyim gyi dngos la rim pa yin/ /de bzhin sbyin pa tshul 35—465

khrims dag /byang chub sems dpa'i thog mar 'gro/ /rgyal po'ituganas dang grong rdal rnams/ /rung du ba'i phyir ni ra ba ste/ /de bzhin bzod pa brtson 'grus dag /byang chub sems dpa' rung 50phyir ro/ /ji ltar gdugs gcig rgyal po ni/ /sa rnams thams cad skyong bar byed/ /de bzhin bsam gtan shes rab dag /byang chub sems dpa'i skyabs〈gebazhin no/ /'khor los sgyurasnyiba'i rgyal po ni/ /bde ba 9)thams cad ster ba ltar/ /de bzhin tshangs pa'i gnas rnams kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bde ba 'byin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' bzang po'i dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ste sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'byung ba gcig na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams na sbyor ba rnamashepa tha dad pa dang 8/ 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa tha dad pa dngashe/ chos bstan pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sems can gdul 3 )ba rnam pa tha dad pa dang /tshe'i tshad rnam pa tha dad pa dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rnam pa tha dad pa dang /rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa rnams rnam pa /mtha dad pa dang / 'khor tshogs pa 32rnam pa tha dad pa dang / bstan pa'i tshul rnam pa tha dad pa dang /chos kyi byin 1 gyi rlabs 1 rirnam pa tha dad pa dag ci'i phyir snang bar 'gyuratunye/sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su ma rdzogs pa 7ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 1 rimangon par 'tshang rgya〈snyebar mi nus so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bzang po'i dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la tshigs su bcad de smras panyurte/ chos kyi rgyal po (nye chos nyid ni/ /'jam dpal rtag tu gcig pa ste/ /sgrib 27pa med pa gzigs pa yi/ /'byung nya35—466

ba de yang gcig pu'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sku gcig ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /shes rab thugs kyang gcig pa ste/ /mi 'jigs stobs kyang de bzhin no/ /sngon cad tibyang chub ༷zhugs pa'i tshe/ /ji ltar yongs su bsngo mdzadasapa/ /'khor du chos rnams bstan pa dang / /de dag zhing yang de bzhin 'gyur/ /zhing gi phun sum gang yod pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams la thams cad 'grub/ /sems can ji snyed 4 sbyangs pa'i 5 rnams/ /de yi rnam pa de ltar mthong / /ji ltar sangs rgyas chos nyid du/ /kun gyis sangs rgyas mi mthong ste/ /sangs rgyas zhing dang sku dag dang / /'khor du chos bstan de bzhin no/ /gang rnams smon lam mthun tsheldan zhing / /sngon chad bsam pa yongs sbyangs pas/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i tshul gyi rnams / /ji lta bzhin dusathams cad mthong / /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin dang / /las dang stobs kyang ji bzhin pa/ /de lta7de ltar mthong gyur nyu te/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam (1'phrul lo/ /sangs rgyas zhing la rtog mi mnga'/ /de dag byams sdang yod pa min/ /bsam pa'i tshul ni ji bzhin du/ /srog chags rnams kyis 12de bzhin mthong / /rnam pa tha dad 'jig rten khams/ /de ltar snang bar gyur pa gnye / /drang srong chen po bkun gzigs pa'i/ /nyes pa'i skyon las gyur pa med//gang na 'dul ba yod pa yi/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad du/ /skyes 5bu drang srong rnams kyang snang / /de ni sangs rgyas chos nyid do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag sathams cad kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i srasanyu / bdag cag gis rang rang gi spobs pa bstan pa tsho)rnams smras pa yin na/ da 19khyod kyis sangs rgyas 35—467

bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yul las brtsams te ①slobs par gyis shig② /sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi yul ④ni gang / sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi tshogs ni gang / sangs rgyas kyi yul du 'gro ba ni gang / sangs rgyas kyi yul la 'jug pa ni ji lta bu / sangs rgyas kyi yul khong du chud pa'i shes pa ni gang / sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi rjes su 45)'gro ba ni gang / sangs rgyas kyi yul shin tu bstan pa ni gang /sangs rgyas kyi yul shes par bya bsko6)ni gang / sangs rgyas kyi yul rtogs pa ni gang dushe/ sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi tshul ni ji lta bu/ sangs rgyas kyi yul ni ci7tsam du yangs/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' tsode dag thams cad la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ nam mkha'i yul hu15dang 'dra ba ste/ /kun tu 'od la 'dra ba med/ /sems can thams cad 'jug pa ste/ /chos nyid la ni 'jug pa med/ /tshogs rnams thams cad bstan par ni/ /bskal pa bye bar mi nus te(nya/ /ji snyed rgyal ba'i tshogs mnga' ba/ /de ni sangs rgyas yul yin no/ /blo gros sems kyang ji5nyebazhin du/ /sems can thams cad rab tu 'jug /de la bstan pa thogs pa med/ /de ni sangs rgyas yul 8yin no/ /'jig rten thams cad 'jug pa dang / /'jig rten rgyu ba gang yod pa/ /de dag kun la ye shes gnas/ /gzugs su snang ba ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas ye shes chags med patso/ /dus gsum kun la chags pa med/ /nam mkha' 'byung dang mtshungs〈rtepa yin/ /de ni ye shes yul yin no / /chos kyi dbyings ni tha mi dad/ /sems can khams rnams rtogs par mkhyen / /dbyings rnams thams cad rab tu brnyes(she/ /de ni sangs rgyas yul yin no/ /sgrar gdags ji snyed yod pa dang / /sems can kun gyi sgra skad du/ /35—468

sgra la mkhyen pa thugs chud kyang / /rnam par rtogatupa gang yang med/ /rnam shes rnam par shes bya med/ /sems kyis brjod pa'ang ma geyin te/ /ye shes rang bzhin shin tu dag /sems can rnams la'ang rab tu bshadag/ /nyon mongs med cing las med do'/ / dngos po med cing gnas pa med/ /(5)snang ba med cing rgyu ba med/ /'jig rten dag tu'ang57)mnyam par spyod/ /sems can kun gyi sems kyi rnams/ /dus gsum kun tu rab yangs pa sems gcig la nirnyurab 'jug pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes 'jug /de nas de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na/ sems can kun )gyi rgyud ji snyed pa dang / chos kyi rgyud ji snyed pa dang / las kyi rgyud ji snyed pa dang / 'jig rten gyi rgyud ji snyed pa dang / lus kyi rgyud ji snyed pa dang / dbang po'i rgyud ji snyed pa dang / skye ba'i rgyud ji snyed pa dang / tshul khrims kyi 'bras bu'i rgyud ji snyed pa dang / tshul khrims log pa'i 'bras bu'i rgyud hu noji snyed pa dang /yul gyi 'bras bu'i rgyud ji snyed pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mthus rab tu snang bar gyur tenyuhe/ ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams de dag tu rab tu snang bar gyur pa de bzhin du/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi hu khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med pa dpag tu med pa tunyegrangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/mtshungs pa med pa kun tu mtha' yas pa mu med pa/ sa mtshams blamed pa gzhal du med pa brjod 8du myed pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyis77klas pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs pa thams cad na yang sems can gyi rgyud hu )ji snyed pa zhes bya ba nas/ gzhung de bzhin du yul gyi 'bras bu'i rgyud ji snyed pa'i bar du lhanade dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mthus rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /de bzhin du 35—469

lho phyogs dang / de bzhin du nub phyogs dang / de bzhin du byang phyogs dang /de bzhin du byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / de bzhin du shar lho'i phyogs7mtshams dang / de bzhin du lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / de bzhin du nub byang gi phyogs mtshams rinodang / de bzhin du 'og gi phyogs dang / de bzhin du steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med pa〈khudapag tu med pa grangs med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshungasalgepa med pa/kun tu mtha' yas pa mu med pa/ sa mtshams cho5med pa gzhal du med pa brjod du med pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyis klas 6)pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs 3)pa dag na/ sems can gyi rgyud ji snyed pa zhes bya ba nas gzhung de bzhin du yul gyi 'bras bu'i rgyud ji snyed pa'i bar du de dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis rab tu snang bar gyur to/ /3)byang chub sems dpasashedris pa snang ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// //hu ride nas byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dpal gyis byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams ji ltar na 11kha na ma tho ba med pa'i lus kyi hu las dang ldan pa yin/kha na ma tho ba 1 med pa'i ngag gi las dang ldan pa yin/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i yid kyi las dang ldan pa yin/ lus kyi las 3sternam par ma nyams pa yin/ ngag gi las rnam par ma nyams pa yin/ yid kyi las rnam par ma nyams pa yin/lus kyi las ma smad pa yin/ ngag gi las ma smad pa yin/ yid kyi57las ma smad pa yin/ lus kyi las mi 'phrogs 8pa yin/ ngag gi las mi 'phrogs7)pa 35—470

yin / yid kyi las mi 'phrogs 3)pa yin/ lus kyi las mi zlog mipa yin/ ngag gi⑧las mi zlog ④pa yin/ yid kyi las mi zlog 5pa yin/ lus kyi las mi 'khrugs9)pa yin/ ngag gi las mi 'khrugs 7pa yin/ yid kyi las mi 'khrugs napa yin/ lus kyi las bsngags pa yin/ ngag gi las bsngags pa yin/ yid kyi las bsngags pa yin/ lus kyi las rnam par dag pa yin/ ngag gi las rnam par dag pa yin/ yid kyi las rnam par dag pa yin/ lus kyi las nye bar nyon mongs pa med pa yin/ ngag gi las nye bar nyon mongs pa med pa yin/yid kyi las nye bar nyon mongs pa med pa yin/ lus kyi las ye shes 99sngon du 'gro ba yin/ ngag gi las ye shes7)sngon du 'gro ba yin/ yid kyi las ye shes nyu1 sngon du 'gro ba yin/ rigs phun sum tshogs pa yin/ rus phun sum tshogs pa yin / rgyud phun sum tshogs pa yin/ gzugs phun sum tshogs pa yin/mtshan phun sum tshogs pa yin/ dran pa phun sum tshogs pa yin/ blo gros phun sum tshogs pa yin/ rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa yin3 / dga' ba phun sum tshogs pa yin/ blo phun sum tshogs pa yin/ blo gros mchog tu gyur pa yin/blo gros dam par gyur pa yin/ blo gros rab tu gyur pa yin/ blo gros tshad med7rtepa yin/ blo gros grangs 8med pa yin/ blo gros bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin/blo gros mtshungs pa med pa yin/ blo gros gzhal du med pa yin/ blo gros brjod du med pa yin/ rgyu'i stobs can yin/ bsam pa'i stobs can yin/sbyor ba'i stobs can yin/ rkyen gyi stobs can yin/ dmigs pa'i stobs can yin / dbang po'i stobs can yin/ rnam par lta ba'i stobs can yin/ zhi tshaganas kyipha7stobs can yin/ lhag mthong gi stobs can yin/ nges par rtogs 35—471

pa'i stobs can yin/ phung po la mkhas pa yin/ khams la mkhas pa yin/skye mched la mkhas pa yin/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la mkhas pa yin/①gzugs kyi khams la mkhas pa yin/ gzugs med pa'i khams la mkhas pa yin/'das pa la mkhas pa yin/ ma 'ongs pa la mkhas pa yin/ da ltar byung ba la mkhas pa (miyin/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag la mkhas pa yin/chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag la mkhas pa yin/brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag la mkhas pa yin/ dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag la mkhas pa yin/ rab tu byang bsnyeyang dag byang chub kyi yan lag la mkhas pa yin/ ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag la mkhas pa yin/ btang ④stoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag la mkhas pa yin/ stong pa nyid yongs su bsgoms pa yin/ mtshan ma med pa yongs su bsgomasamasapa yin/ smon pa med pa (67yongs su bsgoms pa yin/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ byams pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ snying rje'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ dga' ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ btang snyoms kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ ⑦gnas dang gnas ma yin par 3nashes par bya ba ༄9khong du chud pa yin/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs 8pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa shes par bya ba khong du chud pa yin/ dbang po dang brtson 'grus tha dad pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 9/1pa khong du chud pa yin/ khams sna tshogs dang 35—472

khams du ma'isheshes parashebya ba khong du chud pa yin/ mos pa sna tshogs dang /mos pa du ma shes par bya ba khong du chud pa yin/ kun tu 'gro ba'i lam shes par bya ba khong du chud pa yin/ bsam gtan dang rnam par thar pa dang /ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba dang ldangasab shes par bya ba khong du chud pa yin/ bsgribs〈pepa med pa'i rjes su dran pa shes par bya ba khong du chud pa yin/ lha'i⑧mig chags pa med par shes par bya ba khong du chud pa yin/ bag chags kyirsā)mtshams sbyor ba yang dag par gcadakyipa shes par bya ba khong du chud pa yin/ lha yi dbang pos yongs su bzung ⑧ba yin/ klu'i dbang pos yongs su bzung 6)ba yin/gnod sbyin gyi dbang pos yongs su bzung ba yin/ dri za'i dbang pos yongs su bzung ba yin/ lha ma yin gyi dbang pos yongs su bzung ba yin/ nam mkha' lding gi dbang pos yongs su bzung ba yin/ mi 'am ci'i dbang pos yongs su bzung ba yin/ lto 'phye chen po'i dbang pos yongs su bzung ba yin/ mi'i dbang pos yongs su bzung ba yin/ tshangs pa'i dbang pos yongs su bzung ba yin / lha yi dbang pos bkur5) ba yin/ klu yi dbang pos bkur ba yin/gnod sbyin gyi dbang pos bkur ba yin/ dri za'i dbang pos bkur ba yin/lha ma yin gyi dbang pos bkur ba yin/ nam mkha' lding gi dbang pos bkur hunyeb yin/ mi'am ci'itsha/nyedabang pos bkur ba yin/ lto 'phye chen po'i nyusnyedabang pos bkur ba yin/ mi yi dbang pos bkurakheb yin/ tshangs pa'i dbang pos bkur snyib yin/ sems can thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pa yin/ skyabs su gyur pa yinas dpung gnyen du gyur pa yin/ mgon 3 du gyur pa 35—473

yin / sgron mar gyur pa yin/ snang bar gyur pa yin/ 'od du gyur pa yin/'dren par gyur pas1)yin/ rnam par 'dren par gyur pa yin/ yongs su 'dren par gyur pa yin/ sems can thams cad kyi mchog tu ⑧gyur pa yin/gtso bor gyur pa yin/ thu bor gyur pa yin/ rab tu gyur pa yin/ dam par gyur pa yin/ phul du gyur pa yin/ bla na med par gyur shu)pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams mnyam pa med pa yin/ de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar khyod bskye bo mang po la 5phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang 'jig rten la snying brtse 46ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang phan pa dang / bde ba dang bde bar rnam par gzud pa'i 475phyir zhugs shing / de ltar khyod rnams)pa 'di lta bu'i gnas dag yongs su 'dri phyo)bar sems pa ni/ kye rgyal ba'i sras legs so legs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'atsha/ byedag gi sems kyi las yid la byed pa'i sbyor ba gang nyu1dang ldan pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams yon tan gyi khyad par 'di dag thams cad 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i lus nyu2su 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba rnams kyi lam du 'jug pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong pa'i sems kyang de dag la nye bar gnas pa dang / chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin dumanyunyernam par lta ba yang de dag la nye bar gnas pa dang / mi dge ba'i chos thams cad spangs par tsha'agyur ba dang / dge ba'i chos thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur ba 1235—474

dang ske/ kun tu bzang zhing kun tu mdzes pa dang / rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa dang / chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur (1)zhing srog chags thams cad la ston pa gnyis par 'gyur ba'i sems kyi las yid la byed pa'i sbyor ba yod dos/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dgas byang chub sems dpa'i 3sems kyi las yid la byed pa'i sbyor ba gang dngams)ldan pas/ yon tan kyi khyad par 'di dag thams cad thobs/)par 'gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi las yid la byed pa'i sbyor ba de dag gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di la byang chub sems dpa' khyim gyi nang du ④'dug pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad rang bzhin shes pa dang ldan pas mikhyim gyi thibs pos zil gyis mi non par gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /pha ma dang 'grogs pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas 9sems can thams cad skye bo thams cad yongs su bskyab nyudzi pa'i phyir sangs rgyas dang 'grogs par gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /bu dang bu mo dang 'grogs pa'i tshe/byang chub sems dpas 37sems can thams cad sred pa dang shin tu 12bral bas 1lhadaga' ba dang mi dga' ba dang rnam par bral bar gyur cig 1 cices sems bskyed do / /'dod pa'i yon tan dang 'grogs pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas lkesems can thams cad yon tan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas 'dod pa'i gsal shing rnam par sel bar gyur cig ces sems bskyed nyu5do/ /glu dang gar dang rol mo dang sil snyan hu phodang 'grogs pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas 18sems can thams cad gar mkhan gyis tshon 1)lta bur mthong ba 2 dang ldan zhing chos yang dag par 'gro ba'i brjod du nyapa rab tu thob par gyur cig 2ces sems bskyed do/ /chung ma'i 'khor gyi nang na 'dug pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas na sems can 35—475

thams cad 'dod pa'i gsal shing dang bral zhing 'phags pa'i sar chud par gyur cig7ces sems bskyed do/ /rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpasalgesems can thams cad srid par 'byung ba/ 'jig ①pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas khur bor bar gyur cig7ces sems bskyed do/ /khang thog du phyin pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas7sems can thams cad chos thams cad kyi khyad parashekhong du chud cing chos kyi khang stengs su〈nyephyin par gyur cig ces7sems bskyed do/ /sbyin pa gtong ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad bdag gir bya ba tunyemed de/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i sems med cing bdag gi thams cad yongs su gtong bar gyur cig5)ces sems bskyedatshwanyedo/ /ma bral zhingaca'agrogs pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas7sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar7phyin te/ 'du ba dang shin tu bral bar gyur cig5)ces sems bskyed do / /btson ra lasngo kha na ma tho ba7)mthong ba'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas nye sems can thams cad gnas med pa la spyod cing te/ gang du dga' bar 'dong bar gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /khyim nas khyim med par 'byung ba'i tshe/byang chub sems dpas du gesems can thams cad sems bcings pa dang grol ba med cing chags pa (gemed de mi dgos pa dang bral bar gyur cig steces sems bskyed do/ /dge 'dun gyi ra ba'i mtshams 'da' ba'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas du nyesems can thams cad 'gal ba med pa'i (9chos dang ldan zhing 'thun0 7par 'gro ba mang po dang ldan par gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /mkhan po dang slob zhushedapon gyi drung du 'gro ba'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas ( )sems can thams cad chos la rtsom zhingam chocho ga la mkhas par gyur cig57ces sems bskyed 35—476

do / /rab tu 'byung b.rashegasol ba'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas7sems can thams cad bar chad med cing phyir mi ldog pa'i chos can du ①gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /gos dkar posnyi'ador ba'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas52sems can thams cad sdig pa la brtson pa spangs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba shin tu sbyangs par gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /skras byedang kha spu 'breg pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas ⑦sems can thams cad shin tu mnyam par bzhag cing nyon mongs pa med par gyur cig5)ces sems bskyed do/ /gos ngur smrig gyonalo)pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas ⑩sems can thams cad drang srong chen po'i hu)sems dang ldan zhing rnyog pa med par gyur cig ces sems bskyed 12do/ /rab tu 'byung02ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas 8sems can rnams yiskye bo thams cad yongs su skyong7ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rab tu 'byung bar rab tu byung bar gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas tu)sems can thams cad dge ba la mos pa mngon par skyes 37pas / sangs rgyas kyi gdung mi 'chad pa'i don du brtson par gyur cig ces sems bskyedadza kye do/ /chos la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas du 1sems can thams cad chos kyi gter rab tu thob par gyur cig ( nyeces sems bskyed do/ /(nyedage 'dun la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad chags pa'i gnas dang bral zhing dge 'dun yongs su sdud par gyur cig (steces sems bskyed (snyedo/ /bslab pa'i tshig yang dag par len pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas59sems can thams cad tshul bzang po la yang dag par spyod cing bslab ni pa thams cad (2shin tu slob ri rtepar gyur cig ces 35—477

sems bskyed do/ /slob dpon gyis01bstan pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpasaphusems can thams cad log pa ma yin pa'i las la spyod ri(cing tshul dang spyod yul phun sum tshogs par gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /mkhan posasnyibastan pa'i tshe / /byang chub sems dpas〈sems can thams cad gnas med pa la yang dag par gzhol zhing mi skye ba'i ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin par gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas (9)sems can thams cad chos thams cad kyi lhakhyad par gyi pha rol tu phyin ste na thabs mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin par gyur cig 9ces sems bskyed donyurte/ /gtsug lag khang du 'gro ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas nyu1sems can thams cad mi 'phrogs 4)pa'i chos can du gyur te bla na med pa'i 1lhaganas la rnam par spyod par gyur cig husteces sems bskyed 15do/ / stan gding laba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas〈 sems can thams cad chos ji lta ba 18bzhin du mthong zhing legs par bkod pa'i chos can du gyur cig 19ces sems bskyed do/ /'dug pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas ji 3sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i sems kyis snying po (1byang chub la 'dug par gyur cig 22ces sems bskyed do/ /skyil mo krung du 'cha' ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas 3 sems can thams cad mi g.yo ba'i sa la dge ba'i rtsa ba shin tu brtan 2gepar gyur cig ces 27sems bskyed do/ /zhi gnas yongs su sbyong bar byed 2 tshopa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas ri 2sems can thams cad ma lus pa'i mthar thug ni pa la brtson zhing zhi ba dang / dul ba la rab tu gzhol bar gyur cig du staces sems bskyed do/ /lhag mthong yongs su sbyong ba ༄1byed pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas 2sems can thams cad shin tu nyon mongs pa medabasnyepa'i chos can 35—478

gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /chos ston pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas hu)sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyisachos thams cad lasayang dag par gzholasnyi zhing spobs pa mi zad pa dang ldan par gyur cig bces sems bskyed7do/ /phyir 'byung ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi ye shes nyams su myong ste/ khams gsum thams cad nas byung bar gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /chu 'bog pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyis7thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'bogs ⑨par gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /khrus byed pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad 'od mtha' yas pa dang ldan zhing lus dang sems dri ma med par gyur cig tunyeces sems bskyed do/ /dro ba la spyod pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad mu med par phyin pa ste hu)yongs su gdung ba bsil5nyebar gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /bsil ba la spyod pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad shin tu bsil bar gyur te/ bla na med pa'i bsil ba'i dngos po khong du chud par gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /chos thob par byed pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi gtam gyi rjes su 'gro zhing chos kyi dbyings dang 'dris par gyur cig7ces sems bskyed do/ /sangs rgyas mthong ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas7thams cad dang 'grogs pa rab tu thob ste bsgribs〈nyapa med pa'i mig dang ldan par gyur cig nyu ces sems bskyed do/ /mig mi 'gebs par ltarwadeba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad kun tu mdzes 4)pas kun tu bzang por gyur cig du )ces sems bskyed do/ /35—489

mchod rten mthong ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad 'gro ba kun gyis mchod par 'os 1shing mchod rten lta bur gyur cig ces sems bskyed do / /lta tsho riba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis lta (bar gyur cigs 7ces sems bskyed do/ /spyi bos 'thugashepa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi spyi gtsug bltar 6mi snang bar gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byed pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad thams cad 7mkhyen pa nyid du don dang 'thun 8par gyur cig ces sems bskyed do / /lan gsum du 9bskor ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu mos pa'i rab dang ldan par gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi yon tan brjod pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad yon tan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas yon tan mi zad par gyur cig 3 cices sems bskyed do/ /mtshan rnams brjod pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad mtshan nyid med pa'i chos la gzhol zhing yan lag dam pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig 11ces sems bskyed do/ /rkang pa 'khru ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad dri ma kyi med pa'i mthar phyin cing rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang dpas pha rol tu phyin par gyur cig 7ces sems bskyed do/ /lus myong 15ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad bsam pa la rnyog pa med cing lus kyi 'du byed shin tu bde bar gyur cig ces sems bskyed do/ /gnyid sad pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas sems can thams cad phyogs bcu thams cad du 17mthu chen po thob par gyur te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 35—490

shin tu rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur cigs3)ces sems bskyed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems kyi las yid la byed pa'i sbyor ba gang dang ldan pas yon tan gyi khyad par 'di dag tshuradang gzhan thams cad kyang thob par 'gyur zhing / lha dang 'jig rten du bcas pa dang ske/ bdud du bcas pa dang / tshangs par bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang bram zesadang skye dgurasrebacas pa dang / lha dang dri za dzitshodang / mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas su bcas pa thams cad kyis tsutshomi 'phrogs zhu)par 'gyur ba'i 9 byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi las yid la byed pa'i nyu 3sbyor ba rnams so/ /nyunyaspyod yul yongs su dag pa'i le'u ste/ bcu drug pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/nyurta bam po brtswa brgyadasngo pa/ /yon tan yangs pa'i spyod yul yongs dag pa/ /de skad smras nas sems can dri med pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byang chub yon tan rnams / /sems can dam pa bzang po'i dpal la dris/ /spyod yul yongs tsodag rgyal ba'i spyod pa'i 8rnams/ /bdag gis rgyal sras rnams la 'dir bshad do / /yon tan spyod pa ji snyed gang yod pa/ /rgyal sras rnams la da tsheni khyod kyis hu 〉shod/ /bzang po'i dpal gyisam38smras pa rgyal sras nyon/ /yon tan mtha' yas de dag yon tan las/ /mtsho (rtalas thigs 3)pa ji bzhin nyung shas sa shig /mgo smos tsam du cung du zad brjod par bya/ /byang chub don du rang byung nusnye'agyur bya zhes/ /thog mar byang chub sems skyes gyur pa yi/ /yon tan brjod 35—491

pa'ang mtha' yas dpag tu med/ /dpe zla med pas brjod kyang zad mi 'gyurahu)ske/ /pha rol phyin dang sa yi yon tan la/ /bskal pa bzangakhupor spyad pa ji bzhin5)smos/ /de dag yon tan chu bo thams cad ni/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bstan kyang zad limi 'gyur/ /yon tan mtha' yas rnams kyi yon tan las / /dpe59tsam cha shas cung57tsam brjod par bya/ /mkha' las 'dabashechags lam ltar shin tu chung5she/ /sa chen lhun las rdul phran gcig dang7'dra/ /byang chub yon tan bsam pa'i sems skye ba/ /rgyu medatshwa) ma yin rkyen las〈nya'abyung ba yin/ /rgyal ba rnams dang bde gshegs chos rnams dang / /dge 'dun rnams la dad pa bskyed /nyepas skye/ /de yang 'dod pa'i srid5nyepa rgyal srid dang //bdag bde'i don dang grags dang snyan phyir myin/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus gzhil ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten phan bskyed tsosems ni yongs su skye/ /de ni sems can rtag tu bde don btang ge/ /zhing sbyangs sangs rgyas mang po mchod pa'i rgyur/ /yongs su chos 'dzin byang chub 'tshang rgya zhing / /ye shes rnam par sbyong ba'i7sems skye 'o1 7/ /rgyal ba kun dang chos dang dge 'dun dang / /de bzhin bla mar gyur pa thams cad la/ /dad dang mos dang dga' ba bskyed5nyebyas te/ /sri hu zhur mchod byas byang chub sems kyang skye/ /rgyal ba bde gshegs chos la yid ches nas/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rnams la yid ches te/ /byang chub bla na med la byu )yid ches shing / /skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi sems skye 'o(spe/ / dad pa sngon tri 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste rte/ /yon tan thams cad yongs su skye (stezhing 'dren / /nem nur rnam sel nad zugalas rab tu sgrol/ /dad pa bde ba'i grong du phyin par byed/ /dad pa sems gsal rnyog pa med pa ste/ /nga rgyal rnam 35—492

spangs sri0zhu'i rtsa ba yin/ /dad pa spyod mchog nor dang gter yin te/ /lag pa lta bu dge sdud〈rtsa ba yin/ /yongs su gtong la dad pa dga' bar byed/ /rgyal ba'i chos la dad pa spro ba skyed/ /yon tan ye shes khyad par dad pa7byed/ /sangs rgyas lam la ston pa'ang rnyed par byed/ /dbang po rno zhing rab tu gsal ba dang / /gzhan gyis mi thub dngos la dad pa bstobs/ /nyon mongs thub pa med la gnas yin te/ /dad pa rang byung yon tan tshol ba yin/ /dad pa chags pa'i sgo dang mi 'grogs te/ /mi khom spong zhing 'du 'dzi ⑤med par byed/ /dad pa bdud kyi lam las bzlog〈pepa ste/ /thar lam dam pa yongs su ston pa yin/ /yon tan rgyu yin sa bon ma rul bzhin/ /dad pa byang chub shing rab rnam par spyodadu/ /ye shes khyad par sgo rnams 'phel bar byed/ /dad pa rgyal ba rnams kyi ston pa yin/ /de bas dad mos khyad par dga' ba la/ /spyod pa rim gyis rnam par brjod par byaspu/ /chos tshul 'di 'drarwa sku'ajig rten rnams na dkon/ /rin chen seng ge'i rgyal po77ji bzhin no/ /dad pas sangs rgyas sri zhu gang byed pa/ /de dag tshul khrims slob pa mi gtong ngo / /tshul khrims slob pa gang rnams mi gtong ba/ /de dag yon tan gnas pas yon tan ldan / /tshul khrims byang chub shes rab ston pa ste/ /bslab 8pas sa yi yon tan7legs la brtson/ /tshul khrims bslab pa yongs su ma btang na/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bstod cing bsngags par 'os/ /dad pas sangs rgyas sri mizhu gang byed pa/ /de dag rgyal ba'i mchod pa yangs pa byed/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod pa su byed pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas mos pa bsam mi khyab/ /dad pas chos la phurwanyedud gang byed pa/ /de dag rgyal ba'i chos kyis mi ngoms nyan/ /35—493

rgyal ba'i chos kyis 1/mi ngoms su nyan pa/ /de dag bsam gyis mi khyab chos la mos / /dad pas dge 'dun phu 3dud su byed pa/ /de dag mi ldog dge 'dun rnams la mos/ /nḍi ldog dge 'dun rnams la sum mos pa/ /de dag dad pa'i stobs kyis phyir mi ldog /dad pa'i stobs kyis gang rnams mi ldog pa/ /de dag dbang po rab tu gsal zhing rno/ /gang rnams dbang po rab tu gsal rno ba//des ni sdig pa'i grogs po rnam par spangs/ /gang gis sdig pa'i grogs po rnamasnyespangs pa/ /de dag chos kyi bshes gnyen yongs su 'dzin/ /chos kyi bshes gnyen gang gis yongs bzung ba/ /de dag dge ba ④rgya chen yongs su stsogs⑥/ /dge ba rgya chen yongs su gang stsogs dzopa/ / bdag nyid che ba de dag rgyu mthun ldan / /shenabadag nyid che ba rgyu 'thun 94rigang ldan pa/ /de dag mos pa'i khyad par yangs 7pa 'thob/ /mos pa yangs pa'i khyad par susarwatethob pa/ /de dag rtag tu rgyal bas nyugebyin gyis brlabs/ /rgyal ba'i byin gyis gang rnams brlabs gyur pa / /de dag byang chub don du sems kyang skye/ /byang chub don du gang gis sems skyes pa/ /de bzhin nyu drang srong chen po'i yon tan brtson/ /drang srong chen po'i yon tan gang 3 chibartson pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas rigs su rigs ldan skyes / /sangs rgyas rigs su rigs ldan gang skyes pa/ /de dag 'du dang 'bral ba rnam par spangs/ /'du dang 'bral ba gang gis rnam spangs pa/ /de dag bsam pa dang zhing rnam 12par dag /gang gis dang zhing bsam pa 8rnam dag pa/ /de dag lhag pa'i bsam pa dam pa'i mchog /lhag bsam dam pa'i mchog dang su ldan pa/ /de dag rtag tu pha rol phyin la spyod/ /pha rol phyin la rtag tu sus 1)spyod pa/ /de dag theg pa chen po 'di la spyod/ /theg pa chen po 35—494

'di la susatuspyod pa/ /de dag nan tan dam pas sangs rgyas mchod/ /nan tan dam pas sangs rgyas su mchod pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas rjes dran phyed pa med / /sangs rgyas rjes dran gang la mi phyed pa/ /de dag rtag tu sangs rgyas bsam yas mthong / /rtag tu sangs rgyas bsam yas sus mthong ba/ /de dag rtag tu sangs rgyas mi 'grogs min/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas mi 'grogs su ma 95yin / / de la chos ni nub pa namar1)yang med/ /gang la chos nub 'gyur ba med 'gyur ba ⑦/ /de dag spobs pa bsgribs pa de)med dang ldan/ /spobs pa bsgribs pa med dang su ldan pa/ /de dag chos rab ston pa mtha' yang yas/ /gang gi7chos rab bstan0pa mtha' yas pa/ /de dag 'gro la byams pas phan pa tshol/ /'gro la byams pas phan pa su tshol ba/ /de dag snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba brtan⑨/ /snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba su brtanatshwa )pa/ /de dag chos kyi 11dga' bas dbang po dga'/ /chos kyi dga' bas dbang po gang dga' ba/ /de dag 'du byed nyes la btang snyoms so/ /'du byed nyes pa gang gis btang snyoms pa//de dag nga rgyal rloms5)sems bag med spangs/ /nga rgyal rloms the sems bag med sus spangs pa/ /de dag rtag tu bdag dang gzhan don brtson/ /bdag dang gzhan don rtag tu suchabartson pa/ /de dag 'khor bas yongs su skyo ba med//gang la 'khor bas yongs su skyo med pa/ /de dag brtson 'grus dam pa mchog dang ldan/ /brtson 'grus dam pa mchog dang su ldan pa/ /de dag mngon shes rnam dag mngon par skyes8/ /gang gi tsomangon shes rnam dag mngon skyes pa/ /de dag spyod pa mchog gi dra bar zhugs/ /spyod mchog hu tshod bar gang rnams zhugs hunyegyur pa/ /de dag 'gro ba yongs su smin par mkhas/ /'gro ba yongs 35—495

su smin par gang mkhas pa/ /de dag 'gro sdud ye shes tshul la mkhas/ /'gro sdud ye shes tshul la 3)su mkhas pa/ /de dag bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la brtson/ /bsdu dngos bzhi la gang rnams brtson 'grusadza pa/ /de dag 'gro ba'i don mngasnyematha' yas byed/ /'gro ba'i don mang mtha' yas su byed pa/ /de dag shes rab thabs kyi stobs mchog ldan/ /shes rab thabs kyi stobs mchog su ldan pa/ /dpa' bo de dag bla med lam la gnas/ /bla med lam la dpa' bo gang gnas pa / /de dag bdud kyi dpung gis thub pa myin/ /gang rnams bdud kyi dpung gis thub min pa/ /de dag bdud lam bzhi las yongs su 'das/ /bdud lam bzhi las yongs su su 'das pa/ /de dag phyir mi ldog gi sar yang phyin/ /mi ldog sar ni gang gis phyin gyur pa/ /de dag mi skye'i bzod pa thob pa yin/ /mi skye'i bzod pa gang gis thob gyur pa/ /'jig rten sgron de rgyal bas lung yang bstan / /'jig rten sgron ma rgyal bas lung bstan pa/ /de dag rgyal ba kun dang mngon du gnas/ /rgyal ba kun dang mngon du su gnas pa/ /de dag rgyal ba'i rdzu 'phrul 4cigasang la mkhas/ /rgyal ba'i rdzu 'phrulasnyigasang la su mkhas pa/ /de dag rgyal ba kun gyis dgongs pa yin/ /gang rnams rgyal ba kun gyis dgongs gyur pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas yon tan yongs kyis brgyan/ /sangs rgyas yon tan yongs kyis 65su brgyan pa/ /de dag bsod nams dam pas lus kyang sbyangs/ /bsod nams dam pas gang gi ⑦lus sbyangs pa/ /de dag gser gyi 40ri bo 'dra bar 'bar/ /gser gyi ri bo 'dra bar su 'bar ba/ /de dag mtshan rab sum cu gnyis dang ldan/ /mtshan rab sum cu gnyis dang su ldan pa//de dag dpe57)byad bzang pos lus kyang bris/ /dpe〈rtebyad bzang pos gang gi〈kye35—496

lus bris pa/ /de dag lus 'od kun tu mtha' yas so/ /gang gi0)lus 'od kun tu mtha' yas pa/ /de dag 'od zer rgyanasko)kyang bsam mi khyab/ /gang la 'od gzerakhubasam yas rgyan yod pa/ /de dag 'od las padmo mang po 'byung / /gang gi 'od las padmo mang 'byung ba/ /de dag rgyal ba padmo'i gdan bzhugs tedu / /ston cing phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun tu yang / /don yod rnam par spyod cing sems can 'dul/ /gang rnams rgyal ba padmo'i gdan bzhugs pa/ /ston cing phyogs bcu'i 'jig rtenasakun tu yang / /don yod rnams spyod sems can 'dul7byed pa/ /de dag mngon shes rnam 'phrul mtha' yang yas/ /gang gi⑥mngon shes rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa/ /de dag bsam gyis mi khyab chos ston cing / /sems can bsam gyis mi khyab dgar byed pasahu ༵/ /bsam gyis mi khyab zhing ni7rnam par spyod/ /gang rnams bsam gyis mi khyab chos72ston cing ske/ /bsam yas sems can dga' bar sus5nyebyed pa/ /de dag bsam pa ji bzhin 'jig rten na/ /tha dad yang dag shes mthusatswasems can 'dul/ /tha dad yang dag7shes pa'i ye shes mthus/ /bsam pa ji bzhin sems can su 'dul ba/ /de dag lus dang ngag yid rtag dus su/ /ye shes sngon du 'gro bar shin tu 'byung / /gang gi lus dang ngag yid rtag dus su/ /ye shes sngon 7du 'gro bar rab 'byung ba/ /de dag smon lam stobs kyis ci dga' bar/ /sems can rgyud du gzugs mang yongs su ston/ /smon lam stobs kyis gang rnams ci dga' bar/ /sems can rgyud du gzugs mang ston byed pa/ /de dag tshig tu hu tshobarjod cing ci smra5)yang / /sgra la dbyangs kyi yan lag bsam mi khyab/ /tshig tu brjod cing ci dang ci smra yang / /gang gi5) sgra dbyangs yan lag bsam yas pa/ /35—497

de dag 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyi0ci/ /bsam pa'i sems rnams yud kyis rnam par shes/ /gang gis du ma lus 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /bsam pa'i sems rnams yud kyis ri rnam shes pa/ /de dag skye dang 'chi ④'pho nam yang med/ /nyon mongs rgyu ba'ang 5de bzhin skye ba med/ /skye dang 'chi7'pho gang la med gyur cing / /nyon mongs rgyud 77kyang de bzhin skye med pa/ /de dag yon tan chos nyid ye shes lus(8)/ /chos kyis smos par 'jig rten kun tu spyodame/ /yon tan chos nyid ye shes lus 1 tsholdan zhing / /chos kyis smos57par 'jig rten su spyod pa/ /de dag sa bcu rnams dang dbang bcu yi/ /pha rol phyin mchog rnam par thar la spyod/ /gang rnams sa bcu dbang rnams bcu po yi/ /pha rol phyin mchog rnam par thar spyod pa/ /de dag mngon shes rgyan〈nyegyis rnam par 'phrul/ /ting 'dzin dam pas rnam par spyod pa thob/ /mngon par shes pa'i rgyan gyis rnam 'phrul zhing / /ting 'dzin mchog gis rnam spyod sus thob pa/ /de dag phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad las/ /dbang bskur rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su nod/nye / /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad las/ /dbang bskur rgyan rnams thams cad nod skobyed pa/ /de dag spyi bor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis / /phyag mthil bdud rtsis mngon par dbang yang bskur/ /gang rnamasalgespyi bor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyisanyu9/ /phyag mthil bdud rtsis mngon par dbang bskur ba/ /de dag ma lus nam mkha' rgyas byas shing / /phyogs rnams kun tu mthu brtan gnas pa byed/ /gang rnams nam mkha' ma lus rgyas bkang zhing ske/ /phyogs rnams kun tu mthu brtan gnas byed pa/ /dpe med de dag spyod yul shes par ni/ /'jig rten lha dang bcas pas mi nus so/ /dpe med 35—498

gang gis7spyod yul shes bya bar/ /'jig rten lha dang bcas pas mi nus pa/ /de dag brtson 'grus thams cad don kyang yod/ /mthong dang ming thos spobs5gepa'ang don yod do / /gang rnams brtson 'grus thams cad don yod cing / /mthong dang mingashethos spobs pa don yod pal/ /skyes chen de dag sbyin bdag gtong ba yi/ /sbyin pas gnas te thams cad don kyang yod/ /skyes bu 7)dam pa de dag byin mthu yis/ /dam chos tshul ni mi 'jig brten58)par gnas/ /dge ba'i las lam dam pa mchog rnams kyang / /rin chen 'dra 5)mthus kun na rgyu shing gnas/ /rdo rje stug51po'i rin chen tshogs yod pas/ /de yi mthu yis rgya mtsho'i7rin chen rnams/ /mi zad 'phel zhing 'grib 3)pa gang yang med/ /de bzhin yon tan mtha' yas yon tan mtsho/ /sangs rgyas mi bzhugs zhing rnams gang yod pa/ /de dag kun tu byang chub sangs rgyas ston/ /phyogs rnams gang na dam chos med gyur pa/ /de dag kun tu 8chos kyi gter ston to/ /de dag mi rtog7rnam par mi rtog ste/ /lhun gyis grub par phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /zla ba lta bur gzugs brnyan ston byed cing / /thabs mang stong gis sems can 'dul ba byed/ /de dag skad cig re re mibyang chub tu/ /rnam par sangs rgyas phyogs bcu kun tu ston/ /'khor lo bskor (rtedang mya ngan 'das zhi dang ske/ /sku gdung〈nyergya chen de bzhin dpa' bo ston/ /mkhas pa de bzhinatshwarmenyan thos rang sangs rgyas( ) / /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul rgyan rnams mtha' yas pa/ /yongs su ston cing bskal pa bsam yas su/ /theg pa gsum gyi sgo nas sems can 'dul/ /khye'u dang bu mo de bzhin bud med lus/ /skyes pa lha dang lha min klu rnams dang / /gnod sbyin grul bum lto 'phye chen po'i gzugs/ /mos pa 35—499

thams cad tshul mkhas73)yongs su ston/ /ting 'dzin rgya mtsho'i brgya'uyi sgo dag nas / /'gro ba'i gzugs mang rgyud ni ji snyed dang / /cha byad spyod7pa sgra dbyangs tshul gyi rnams/ /thams cad ma lus dpa' bo ston pa byed/ /de dag zhing rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad mchod pa byed / /de dag 'od zer mang po bsam mi khyab/ /sems can 'brel pa'i ye shes mtha' yang yas/ / de dgashor)tshig gi rnam 'phrul ye shes rnam 'phrul dang / /lus kyi rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims rnam par 'phrul pasridang / /bzod pa brtson 'grus rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /de dag bsam gtan shes rab rnam 'phrul dang / /thabs dang mngon shes rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab / /sangs rgyas tshogs kyi ting 'dzin sgo dag nas/ /yon tan kun gyishernam 'phrul mtha' yang yas48)/ /de dag rdul phran 'jug pa'i ting 'dzin rnamasasti/ /rdul phran kun la mngon par bsgrub 34 )byed cing / /rdul phran rtse gcig bsam yas zhing rnams la31/ /ston par tsho/gebyed kyang rdul la 'phel ba myed/ /rdul gcig rtse la'ang sangs rgyas bzhugs zhing nyusnyedang / /sangs rgyas mi bzhugs zhing yang de bzhin ston/ / la la ④nyon mongs rnam dag dog pa dang / /yangs shing phra dang che ba'i zhing yang ston/ /zhing rnams la la 'jig cing 'du ba dang / /la la spyi mtshugs rim gyis gnas par ston/ /la la snrel zhi rtsig rgyu lta bu ste/ /de bzhin gzhan rnams mig 'phrul lta bur ston/ /de dag rdul gcig〈nyertser ston ji bzhin du/ /ma lus rdul rnams kun la de bzhin te/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul de 'dra'o/ /mtha' yas grags pa'i rnam thar de 'dra'o/ /rgyal ba mchod pa'i rnam 'phrul ting nge 'dzin/ /rgyal ba kun la mngon par sgrub byed 35wa 500

cingatu/ /lag pa'i mthil gyis stong gsum rgyas bkang zhing / /skyes bu chen po rnams la mchod pa byed/ /phyogs bcu kun na me tog phreng ba dang / /spos dang byug pa rin chen rin che ba/ /de dag byang chub shing drung bzhugs pa yi/ /rgyal ba mchod phyir lag pa'i mthil nas 'gyed/ /na bza' phye mashogyirin chen ji snyed dang ske/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs dam sna tshogs dang / /gser gyi rgyan dang rin chen bla re dag② /lag mthil de nas char du mngon par 'bebasani/ /phyogs rnams mtha' yas kun gyi yo byad rnams/ /drang srong che la mchod pa〈gegang 'os pa/ /de dag lag mthil de nas char du 'bebs/ /byang chub shing drung rgyal ba mchod pa byed/ /rol mo'i rnam pa phyogs na ji snyed pa/ /rnga chen rnga dang pi wang sgra snyan dang / /rol mo brdung dkrol57gling bu sgra rab rnams(2)//de dag lag mthil de nas sgra yang sgrog⑨ /phyogs bcu'i dpe (3 med ji snyed bzhugs pa yi/ /bde gshegs yon tan legs pa sna tshogs dang / /bstod pa'i tshigs bcad bsgrubasalgepa sna tshogs dang〈rte/ /lag mthil de nas sgra rab snyan par 'byung / /de dag 'od gzeratshwanyelas dges yongs bstsags 0pa/ /lag pa g.yas nas yongs su 'gyed byed cing / /rgyal ba'i zhing rnams spos chus ma lus par/ /kun tu btab cing 'jig rten sgron ma mchod/ /'od zer yid 'ong snang zhing rgyan ldan pa/ /lag pa'i mthil bkye thegepadmo bsam mi khyab/ /pad mo rgyan 'phyangatsomatshan sdug du ma'i gzugs/ /mang po bkye zhing rgyal ba mchod pa byed/ /'od zer me tog rgyan rnams rab bkye〈 1zhing / /me tog rgyan dang me tog bla re dang / /me tog sna tshogs kun tu yongs bkang zhing / /bdag nyid che ba de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /'od zer spos kyi rgyan rnams rab bkye zhing / /35—501

spos kyi rgyan dang spos kyi bla re dang / /sna tshogs spos kyis kun tu yongs bkang zhing ske/ /bdag nyid che ba de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /'od zer phye ma'i rgyan rnams rab bkye zhing / /phye ma'i rgyan dang phye ma'i bla re dang / /phye ma sna tshogs kun tu yongs bkang zhing / /bdag nyid che ba de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /'od zer na bza'i 3)rgyan rnams rab bkye zhing / /nam (5)bza'i rgyan dang na bza'i bla re dang ske/ /na bza' ri risna tshogs kun tu yongs bkang zhing / /bdag nyid che ba de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /'od zer rin chen rgyan rnams rab bkye zhing / /rin chen rgyan dang rin chen bla re dang / /rin chen sna tshogs kun tu yongs bkang zhing ske/ /bdag nyid che ba de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /'od zer pad mo'i rgyan rnams rab bkye zhing / /pad mo'i rgyan dang pad mo'i bla re dang / /pad mosnyisna tshogs kun tu yongs bkang zhing / /bdag nyid che ba de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /'od zer phreng ba'i rgyan rnams rab bkye zhing / /phreng ba'i rgyan dang phreng ba'i bla re dang / /phreng ba sna tshogs kun tu yongs bkang zhing / /bdag nyid che ba de dag rgyal ba mchod/ /'od zer rgyal mtshan mchog rgyan rab bkye zhing / /de dag rgyal snimatshan dkar dmar ser po dang / /sngo dang sna tshogs rnam mang rgyan can gyis/ /rgyal ba'i 47zhing rnams kun nas brgyan pa byed/ /de dag bde gshegs dbu la gdugs kyi na mchog /rin chen dra ba sna tshogs rgyan ldan pa/ /dar gyi lda ldi ba dan yongs sbyangs 9)shing / /dril sgreng rgyal ba'i gsung sgrogarwaskye'adzin pa 12byed/ / de dag sna lag pa'i mthil nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /mchod pa rgyal ba gcig la byed pa ltar/ /ma lus rgyal ba ⑩rnams la'ang de bzhin te/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul de 'dra'o(snye/ /de dag 'gro ba 35wa 502

yongs sdud ye shes kyis/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i ting 'dzin mngon bsgrubs gnyashing ske/ /bya ba'i tshul dang yon tan thams cad du/ /thabs dusamang stong gisamachosasems can 'dul ba byed/ /la la de bzhin gshegs pa krumachod sgo dang / /sbyin pa bsam gyis mi khyab gtong ba'i sgo/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan kun gyi tshul khrims sgo/ /bzod pa mi zad mi sgulasnyosgo dag dang / /la la brtul zhugs dka' thub brtson 'grus sgo/ /bsam gtan rab tu zhir〈phyiraganas sgo dag dang / /don dam〈rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab sgo/ /tshul rnams kun ldan thabs kyi sgo dag dang / /tshangs pa'i spyod pa dag dang mngon shes sgo/ /bsdu ba'i dngos pos phan tshol sgo dag dang / /bsod nams yongs su bstsagasa'2dang ye shes sgo/ /bden pa rten7pa'i rnam thar sgo dag dang / /la la stobs dang dbang po lam gyi sgo / /nyan thos theg pa rnam grol sgo dag dang / /rang rgyal theg pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo/ /theg pa dam pa rnam 'phrul sgo dag dang / /la la mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal sgo/ /la la bdag med srog med sgo dag dang / /mi sdug hu sna'adu shes 'dod chags bral ba'i sgo/ /la la zhi 'gog ting 'dzin sgo dag tu/ /'gro ba'i spyod sgo ji snyed yod rgyu ba(7/ /de snyed chos kyi sgo la rab zhugs denyu2/ /de dag kun gyi chos nyid7)sgo dag nas/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'jig rten sems can 'dul / /gang rnams kun gyi sgo yi sgo dag nas/ /bsam pa ji bzhin sems can 'dul ba byed8/ /de dag mtshan mar bzung mabar mi nus te/ /ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul tshul ni de 'dra'o/ /de dag dga' ba'i rgyan gyis 8ting 'dzin mchog /'gro ba thams cad yongs su nyu mosmin byed 'thun/snye/ /dga' bde spro ba rab dga'5)kun ldan pas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yongs ston sems can 'dul//35wa 503

gang tshe lo nyes thams cad dkon gyur pa/ /de tshe 'jig rten bde ba'i7yo byad rnams / /thams cad bsam pa rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing 'gro don byed/ /de dag zas mchog skom dang rgyan⑧mchog dang / /gos dang dgab pa ri rin chen sna tshogs dang / /rgyal srid nor dang bdag sdug⑧yongs btang bas/ /sbyin la mos pa'i 'gro ba 'dul ba byed/ /de dag mtshan rab kun gyis lus brgyan cing rigaci/ /gos dang rgyan mchog yongs su bgos btags te46)/ /phreng bas rnam brgyan ni)spos kyis bsku byas pa'i⑧/ /gzugs rnams yongs su btang bas 9)sems can 'dul/ /mthong bas dga' bde rab tu mos pa la/ /de dag gzugs mchog gzugs bzang cha byad mdzesakyi/ /gzugs kyi dam pa yongs su ston byed cing / /gzugs la mos pa'i sems can 'dul ba byed/ /de dag ka la ping ku'i sgra snyan dang / /ko kyil kun la〈spengang pa'i sgra dbyangs dang / /rnga dang tshangs parwartemi 'am ci yi sgras/ /mos pa thams cad tshul bzhin chos kyang ston/ /de dag stong phrag brgyad5)cu rtsa bzhi'o④/ /gang gis rgyal ba 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /chos kyi bye brag sgo mo de dag gis/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'jig rten sems can 8'dul/ /de dag bde dang sdug bsngal grogs 7kyang byed/ /don dang don med grogs kyang de bzhin te/ /sems can dgos la grogs su sna 'gyur byas shing / /grogs kyi sgo nas sems can rnam par 'dul/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'dus byas skyon gyi rnams/ /grogs kyi don du de dag bzod par nyunyebyed/ /'gro ba kun la phan don bde don du/ /de dag grogs don mi bde nyams su len/ /gang na7)'byung ba med cing chos med de / /dgon pa'i yon tan thar pa mi dmigs pa/ /de dag kun tu rgyal srid che 35—504

spangs shing / /zhi ba'i yid kyis gnas med mngon par 'byung / /de dag khyim gyi btsonatur sridakhuganas pa'i/ /'gro ba thams cad yongs su dgrol ba'i rgyur//'dod pa'i dga' ba kun la mi gnas par/ /mngon par byung zhing thar pa yongs su brjod/ /de dag spyod pa bcu rnams spyod 8)byed cing / /skyes chen rnams kyi chos la de dag spyod/ /drang srong spyod pa thams cad ma lus par /yongs su bsgomakhuzhing 'gro ba'i don kyang byed/ /gang nang sems can tshad med che ldan pa/ /bde ba phun ldan nyon mongs chung yod pa/ /de dag kun tu nad gzer nad bu can/ /bdag la dbang byed9)tsam gyi dbang sgyur stonal/ /'dod chags 'bar zhing zhe snang 'bar gyur tel/ /gti mug rgyu las 'jig rten mer 'bar zhing / /rga shi nad kyis rab tuphama'abar gyur pa'i/ /'jig rten bstan cing sems can 'dul ba byed/ /de dag sangs rgyas stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi/ /chos kyi khyad par ba'o〈nyebargyad rnams kyis kyang / /sangs rgyas bdag5nyenyid che ba brjodamanyebyed cing / /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams kyis 'gro don byed/ /de dag yongs ston rdzu 'phrul rjes ston gyisami/ /gzugs rnams byin rlob mthu yis mthu che ba8/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston byed cing ske/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pas sems can 'dul/ /de dag thabs kyi tshul mang sna tshogs kyisayi/ /'gro ba'i don du 'jig rten rim gror byed/ /'jig rten mi chags chu la〈nyepad mo bzhin/ /dga' ba mos pa skye bar rnam par spyod / /de dag rjod〈nyebyed brjod pa'i rgyal po byed/ /gar mkhan rnga mkhan kyirtegyad dang rol mo5) mkhan/ /mdzes shing sdug par bzhad 31gad byed pa dang / /sgyu mkhan gzugs mang nyekun tu5nyeston par byed/ /grong dngadza stegong dpon kha lo 35wa 505

sgyur 11ba dang / /ded dpon tshong dpon khyim bdag de bzhin te/ /rgyal po blon po mnga' rab pho nya dang / /sman pa mi 'jigs gtsug lag mkhas pa byed/ /de dag nags tshal sdong po chen por 'gyur/ /sman dang rin chen mi zad gter dag dang / /yid bzhin nor bu 'dod pa 'byin shing dang / /lam gol 'khyams la de bzhin lam ston 'gyur/ /'jig rten byung nas mi ring shes57gyur cing ske/ /sems can las kyi tshul la mi shes pa/ /de dag kun la rmosakhuthabs tshong thabs dang / /sna tshogs bzo rnams kun kyang brjod pasabyed/ /'tshe med gnod pa med pa'i sbyor ba rnams/ /sems can bde skyedasnyemakhas pas rab bsngags pa/ /rig 6rimathu sman dang gtsug lag sna tshogs rnamasal/ /kun kyang drang srong de dag rnam par brjod/ /drang srong rnams kyi spyod pa dam pa'i mchog /gang la lhar bcas 'jig rten dad gyur shedang / /brtul zhugs dka' spyod dka' ba 59rimachog gi rnams/ /kun kyang mkhas pa de dag ston par〈nye byed/ /de dag rgyud 11dang kun rgyu mu stegs can/ /dka' thub spyod yul mi smrar spyod pa dang ske/ /sgrin mo gos med ri yi dge sbyong la/ /mu stegs can gyi mkhan po mkhas pa byed/ /de dag yongs 'tsho chos la spyod pa dang / /bla na yod dang bla na med pa 12rnams/ /ral pa ring dang byis pa'i brtulas3)zhugs can/ /de dag du yang de dag mkhan por 'gyur/ /nyi ma'i rjes spyad hu dka' thub lnga ldan dang //khyi tshadang ba lang brtul zhugs ri dgas 7spyod/ /gle'u5)can mu stegs bcu gsum spyod pa'i rnams/ /de dag kun na'ang 3)de dag slob dpon 'gyur/ /lha rnams ye shes tshul la dga' ba dang / /mu stegs khrus byed yul du rgyu ba dang hu'e/ / rtsa ba 'bras bu chu 2 ril spyod pa'i rnams/1/ /chos sems nang na de dag dam par 35wa 506

'gyur / /gnas brtegatuganas dang gcig tu spyod pa dang / /tsher ma rtswa nadang thal ba'i mal can dang / /dbyig pa'i mal can gcig pu spyod pa'i rnams/ /de dag kun tu'ang de dag slob dpon 'gyur/ /phyi rol mu stegs can rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag bsam pa mos pa rtogs byas nas/ /bsgrub du dka' mi zadas ridrag shul dka' thub kyi/ /mu stegasasacan gyi sdug bsngal spangs pas ri'u'adul/ /'jig rten lta bas ⑦'khrugs pa shes byas nas/ /lta ba ngan la zhen pa'i mu stegs can/ /kun la phra ba'i tshig dang thabs tshul gyis/ /bden pa ston pa de dag kun tu byed/ /la lasadra byi la7yi sngags tshig tu/ /shin tu gsang ba'i tshig gis bden pa ston/ /la la dag la gsal zhing drang tshig gis/ /la la dag la lha yi gsang tshig gis/ /la la dag la yi ge dbye tshig dang 3 ri/ /don des 31 rtogs pa rdo rje'i tshig rnams dang / /rgol sngo ba 'dul ba'i ye shes tshig rnams dang ske/ /bstan7pa thub med thar pa'i tshig rnams kyis/ /la la dag la mi skad tshig rnams dang / /kun la 'jug pa'i tshig des tshig rnams dang / /la la dag la lha'i tshig des tshigasadang / /klu yi tshig des gnod sbyin tshig rnams kyis/ /la la dag la srin po 'byung po dang / /dri za grul bum lto 'phye chen po'i tshig /mi ci lha min nam mkha' lding tshig gis/ /bden pa bstan cing thar par 3ge'adren pa byed/ /de dag bden pa'i tshig desam tshul shes bzhin/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i chos rnams ma lus pa'i/ /chos nyid bsam yas tshig lam shes pas ston / /de dag ting 'dzin rnam7)'phrul de 'dra'o/ /de dag 'gro bde mchog gi ting nge 'dzin/ /'gro ba kun la mngon par sgrub 3)byed cing / /'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab rab bkye ( )ste/ /'od zer bkye nas sems can de dag 35—507

'dul / /'od zer mthong na legs pa rab bkye7zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer de shes pa/ /de dag mthong legs don med ma yin te/ /bla na med pa'i ye shes mchog gi rgyu/ /sangs rgyas bstan te chos rnams yongs bstan nas/ /dge 'dun bstan nas mi rnams lam bstan te/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs mchod rten bstan pas na / /des ni mthong na legs pa'i 'od zer grub/ /lha yi 'od zer zil gyis gnon pa yiri ci/ /'od zer 'od byed rab tu dgyesabyas shing / /mun pa kun dang rdul rnams kun bstsal 3)te/ /'jig rten phan pa'i 'od de rab tu snang / /'od des sems can ji snyed yongs bskul ba/ /de dag rgyal ba mchod phyir me mar 'dzin/ /rgyal ba mchod phyir mye mar bzung7byas pas/ /'jig rten sgron 7)ma mdzad pa'i rgyal bar 'gyur/ /'bru mar me mar mar gyi me mar dang / /shing dang rtswasngon dang smig ma spa yi sgron/ /spos dang ro mchog rin chen sgron ma dag /rgyal ba rnam tshegasol 'od byed de thob bo/ /'od zer sgrol zhes bya ba nyu norab bkye zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskul7ba/ /de dag sred pa rnam yangs srid 3 pa'i mtshor/ /sems can bsgral don go cha brtan pa 1)gyon/ /gang rnams sred pa'i rnam yangasatswasrid pa'i mtshor sems can bsgral phyir go cha bebartan gyon pa/ /de dag chu bo bzhi las sgrol bar7byed/ /mya ngan med pa bde ba'i grong yang ston/ /stegs dang zam pa gcig smin byas pa dang / /chu klung lam la sgrol ba'i gru byin te/ /'dus〈nyebyas sun phyung zhi ba bsngags 37pas na/ /des ni sgrol ba'i tri )'od zer de grub bo/ /'od zer skom〈 nyepa sel ba rab bkye zhu zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskulahū ba/ /'dod pa'i yon tan skom (stepa rab spangs shing / /chos kyis nyernam grol ro la 35wa 508

don du gnyer/ /'dod pa'i yon tan skomanyepa rab spangs te/ /chos kyis grol ba'i ro la don gnyer bas/ /sangs rgyas bdud rtsi char pa 'bebs par 'gyur/ /'jig rten sredakyipa'i skomasapa rnam par sel/ /rdzing dang chu klung khron pa lu gem dang ske/ /mtsho rnams byang chub don du byed btsud de/ /'dod pa rnams da)smad bsam gtan bsngags pasalgen/ /skom pa rnam sel de ni des sgrub po(8) /'od zer dga' bar byed pa rab bkye zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskul7ba/ /dga' bas rgyas shing byang chub mchog don du/ /rang 'byung 3 ri'agyur bar bya zhes sems bskyed do/ /thugs rje mnga' rnams 31sku gzugs mtshan brgyan pa/ /pad mo'i gdan la bzhugs pa byas bsgrubs shing / /rtag tu sangs rgyas yon tan brjod pas na/ /dga' ba byed pa'i 'od ni des grubadzwa bo / /'od zer mos par byed pa rab bkye zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskul ba/ /de dag thams cad sangs rgyas mos pas nyurtedaga'/ /chos la mos dga' dge 'dun mos pas dga'/ /de dag rtag tu sangs rgyas mos dga' ste / /chos la mos dga' dge 'dun mos dga' bsayi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang de bzhin dge 'dun dang / /rtag tu 'grogs 'thob bzod pa bla med 'thob/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran chos dang tshogs mchog〈nyel/ /sems can mang po bskul zhing7dran byas te/ /byang chub sems kyi yon tan bstan pas na/ /des ni 'od zer mos par byed pa grub/ /'od zer bsod nams bstsagasarwashepa rab bkye zhing / /sems can ji5)snyed 'od zer des bskul (7 ba/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub don gnyer cing / /sbyin pa sna tshogs du ma yongs su gtong / /de dag mchod sbyin lhug pa byed pa'i tshe/ /slongs07mo pa yi bsam pa rdzogs byas te//35wa 509

bsam pa kun tshul sbyin pa byin pas na/ /des ni 3)'od zer bsod nams bstsagasamanagrub bo/ /'od zer ye shes ldan pa rab bkye zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskul ba/ /chos gcig sgo nas chos gcig min pa yi/ /chos kyi sgo rnams yud ri kyis rjes dran nasarig/ /chos kyi bye brag sems can 'dzin btsud 55de/ /des 47)rtogs don gyi ye shes rnam phye zhing / /chos kyi tshig don brjod pa byas pa nas no/ /des ni ye shes ldan pa'i 'od zer grub/ /'od zer shes rab sgron ma rab bkye zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskul spub//stong pa bdag med ma skyes ma byung bsna ri/ /rang bzhin med pa'i chos la rab tu 'jug /bdag po med chos stong pa byed med pa/ /sprin dang smrig rgyu chu zla 'dra ba'i dngos/ /rmi lam lta bu gzugs brnyan 31rang bzhin rnams/ /bstan pas shes rab sgron ma de grub po/ /'od zer chos kyi kyirternam 'phrul〈nyerab bkye zhing / /sems can ji chasnyed 'od zer des bskul ba/ /mi zad gzugs kyi bangasnyemadzod rnams 7thob cing / /de bzhin gshegs pa nyu 7kun gyi mdzod kyang 'dzin/ /chos 'chad rnams la yongs su phan btags te/ /drang srong rnams la chos kyi bsrung5snyebyas shing / /'gro ba kun la chos bzhin phan btags hu)pas/ /'od zer chos kyi0 )rnam 'phrul de grub 21bo/ /'od zer gtong dang ldan pa rab bkye zhing / /sems can 'jungs pa 22ji snyed des bskul ba/ /skyid nisnyepa mi brtan mi rtag shes gyur nas/ /de dag rtag tu sbyin mos dga' bar 'gyur/ /'jungs pa gdul dka'i sems can ma dul dang / /nor rnams rmi lam sprin (stetshul shes gyur nas/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis sbyin pa rnam spel bas/ /gtong dang ldan pa'i 'od zer des bsgrub 2gepo/ /'od zer yongs su gdung med zhugarab bkye zhing / /tshul ngan 35wa 510

sems can cikhusnyed des bskul ba/ /tshul khrims rnam gedag rab tu gnas gyur te / /rang byung〈mi'agyur bar bya zhes sems bskyed 4)do/ /dge ba'i las lam yongs su dag pa dang / /tshul khrims bzang la sems can mang bskul zhing 5/ /byang chub sems la yang dag bskul byas pas/ /yongs su gdung med 'od zer de grub po/ /bzod pas rnam brgyan7'od zer rab bkye zhing / /mi bzod sems can ji snyed des bskul ba/ /khro ba'i5྅tha ba nga rgyal yongs spangs shing / /de dag bzod mos rabashetu dga' bar 'gyur/ /sdig sems ldan la nyes pa bzod byas te/ /byang chub don du 'khrug pa ma byas shing / /bzod pa'i yon tan rtag tu brjod byas pas/ /des ni bzod pas rnam brgyan de 3 )grub po/ /'od zer brtson dang ldan pa rab bkye zhing / /le lo'i sems can 11ji snyed des 12bskul ba/ /rigs hunyepar brtson zhing dkon mchog gsum rnams la/ /sbyor ba skyo med mchod pa byedatswapar 'gyur/ /rigs par brtson par mdakon mchog gsum rnams la/ /sbyor 8ba skyo ba med pas mchod byas nas/ /de dag bdud bzhi'i lam las yongs 'das te/ /myur du byang chub bla med rab tu thob/ /sems can mang po brtson 'grus bskul byas te/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa rab byas nas/ /tha ma'i dus su nyu 1dam chos yongs su bzung 18/ /des ni brtson ldan 3)'od zer de grub po/ /'od zer zhi bar byed pa rab bkye zhing / /rnam 'khrugs sems can ji snyed des bskul ba/ /de dag 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug rnams/ /nyams su mi gnod mnyam bzhag sems su gyur / /sdig to'i grogs po nyes ldan spyod can dang / /'du 'dzi ri 1yongs su rnam par spangs 2byas te/ /bsam gtan zhi ba'i dgon pa rab bsngags pas/ /des ni zhi byed 35—511
