'od zer de grub po/ /'od zer shes rab rnam brgyanasherab bkye zhing / /shes rab 'chal pa ji snyed des bskul pa/ /bden52dang brtan⑧dang rnam thar tshul rnams dang / /dbang po'i rgyus la rtog par〈geshes gyur cing / /nyi ma sgron ma'ipo)ting 'dzin thob gyur nas/ /shes rab 'od gsal mdzad pa'i rgyal bar 'gyur / /rgyal srid nor dang bdag phongs57yongs btang ste/ /byang chub don du chos rnams gang btsal ba/ /de dag rim gror rab tu brjod byas pas/ /shes rab rnam brgyan 'od zer des grub po/ /'od zer sangs rgyas ldan pa rab bkye zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskulaphub/ /sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab shin tu mngatswa/ /pad mo mchog la bzhugs par rab tu mthong / /sangs rgyas bdag nyid che dang rnam thar dang / /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul mtha' yas yongs bstan te/ /sangs rgyas stobs dang rdzu 'phrul brjod byas pas0/ /sangs rgyas ldan pa'i 'od zer des grub po/ /'od zer mi 'jigs sbyin pa rab bkye zhing / /'jigs mnar sems can ji snyed des phog pa/ /'byung po gza' dang bsad cing brdeg 11pa dang / /nad kyis〈nye'ajigs pa kun las rab tu grol3ge/ /mi 'jigs sbyin pas sems can bskyabs0stepa dngas/ /srog gcod las las sems rgyud phyir bzlog 39cing / /'jigs〈 tshopas skyabs tshol rnams la bskyabs 32byas pas/ /'od zer mi 'jigs sbyin pa des grub po/ /'od zer thams cad bde ba rab bkye zhing / /nad pa na ba ji snyed des reg pa//thams cad nad nyu)kyi sdug bsngal rnam par 'grol )/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin bde ba rnams kyang thobazhunya/ /nad gsos 'bras bu (rtesman dang rtsa ba dang / /rin chen si ro mchog spos dang byug pa dang / /bu ram sbrang rtsi 'o ma mar dag dang / /35wa 512

'bru mar zas skom byin pas de grub po/ /'od zer sangs rgyas ston paturab bkye zhing / /tshe zad mtharasheni ji snyed des bskul5)ba/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur/ /de dag shi 'phos sangs rgyas bzhugs shingang no'agro / /'chi ba'i dus su sangs rgyas dran byas te/ /dga'〈pe'agyur rgyal ba'i sku gzugs bsten0byas shing / /'chi gtso)sangs rgyas skyabs su btang dubyas pas/ /sangs rgyas ston pa'i 'od zer des thob po/ /'od zer chos rab brjod pa rab bkye zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskul ba/ /chos nyan brjodam13cing de bzhin 'dri ba byed/ /chos la mos pas rtag tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /chos kyi mu ge'i dus su chos brjod de/ /chos tshol rnams kyi bsam pa rdzogs byas shing ske/ /mos pa bskyed de 0chos la brtson gyis zhes/ /brjod pa 31chos rab brjod pa des7thob po/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams yongs su bskulamanyapa'i phyir/ /'od zer dbyangs dang ldan pa rab bkye zhing / /khams gsum sgra rgyud ji snyed yod pa dag /kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung du thos/ /gsal ba'i dbyangs sgrar drang srong cher brjod7de/ /rol mo sgra chen dril gyi sbyin pa rnams//'gro ba kun la rgyal ba'i gsung don du/ /yongs su btang bas 'od zer dbyangs ldan thob/ /'od zer 'chi med sbyin pa rab bkye zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskul ba/ /bag med spyod pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /yon tan kun la rnal 'byor nyams su len/ /'dus byas rtag tu bde ba med pa ste / /sdug bsngal 'tshe ba mang pos yongs su gang / /'gog pa rtag tu bde zhing 7zhi dga' zhes/ /brjod pas 'chi〈9med sbyin pa de thob bo/ /'od zer khyad par ldan pa rab bkye zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskul ba/ /35—513

tshul khrims khyad par ting 'dzin khyad par dang / /shes rab khyad par rgyal ba rnams las gyo)nyan/ /tshul khrims 'phags pa ting 'dzin 'phags pa ste/ /shes rab 'phags pa thub pa'i rgyal mtshan du zhes/ /byang chub don du bsngags shing bstod du dbyas pas/ /des ni 'od zer khyad par maldan pa thob/ /'od zer rin chen rnam brgyan rab bkye zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskul ba/ /rin chen gter mang mi zad thob gyur te/ /drang srong che la rin chen dam pas mchod / /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /rin chen phul zhing 'gro ba nyon mongs la/ /rin chen bsdud du de rin chen sbyin btang bas/ /rin chen rnam par brgyan pa'i 'od zer grub/ /'od zer spos mchog snang ba rab bkye zhing / /sems can ji snyed 'od zer des bskul ba/ /mi la med pa'i spos dri tshor gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rnams la nges par 'gyur/ /mi dang lha yi spos dang byug pa yis/ /mi yi gtso yil mchod pa rab byas te/ /spos kyisalgergyal ba'i sku gzugs mchod rten dag /byas pas 'od zer spos mchog snang ba grub / /'od zer sna tshogs rnam brgyan rab bkye zhing / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs mchog /rol mo sgra snyanamaduspos dang bdug spos kyis/ /pho brang dam pa 3yongs brgyan me tog 'gengs/ /sngon chad rgyal ba rol mos bsgralange byas te/ /me tog byug pa bdug spos phye ma dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan mchog dag gis/ /mchod pa byas pas sna tshogs rgyan grubatsa)bo/ /'od zer shin tu dang byed rab bkye zhing / /sa rnams lag mthil〈nyebazhin du gnas par byedarka/ /mchod rten drang srong gnas rnams sbyangasatshwanyebyas pas/ /des ni 'od zer shin tu dang byed grub/ /'od zer chen po5tesprin ldan rab bkye zhing / /35—514

spos kyi char 'bebs sprin rnams kun nas gnas/ /mchod rten gam yo spos chus yongs btabatupas/ /'od zer sprin dngakyildan pa rab tu thob/ /'od zer lhab lhub rnam brgyan rab bkye zhing / /gos med gos yod rgyan dang ldan par 'gyur/ /gos dang bgo bshephreng ba sna tshogs dag④ /yongs su btang bas7lhab lhub rnam brgyan grub/ /'od zer brosko7mchog ldan pa rab bkye zhing //bkres pa kha zas bro lamachog thob par 'gyur/ /zas dang skom dang bro 49)mchog sna tshogs rnams/ /byin pas0 )bro mchog ldan pa'i 'od kyang thob/ /'od zer nor ston5terab tu dgyerwa byas shing / / phongs pa 3nyerin chen gter rnams thob par 'gyur / /gnas dang gter rnams mi zad dkon mchog gsum/ /gsol bas nor ston 'od zer de thob bo/ /'od zer mig sbyong mirab tu dgye bebyas shing / /long ba de tshe sna tshogs gzugs 'thob 8'gyur/ /rgyal ba dgas3 tshodang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /mar me gsol bas mig sbyong nyushe'od zer grub19/ /rna ba rnam sbyongasngo kye 'od zer rab bkye zhing / /rna ba nyams pa sgra mang thos par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /sil snyan phul bas rna ba rnam sbyong thob / /'od zer sna sbyong rab tu dgye 21byas shing / /sngon chad ma tshor dri zhim tshor bar 'gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten la/ /spos zhim gsol bas sna sbyong 'od zer grub/ /'od zer lce sbyong rdu2rab tu dgye sa byas shing //sgra snyan yid du 'ong bas sangs rgyas stonas / /mi snyan brlang nisnyebar smra ba rnam ༷ 9spangs te/ /'jam par smra bas lce sbyong 'od zer grub/ /'od zer lus sbyong rab tu bkye〈 nabyas shing / /dbang po nyams pa dbang po ldan par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i mchod rten (snyel/ /lus kyis 2ltarab btudang tsholus sbyongs/35wa 515

'od zer thob/ /'od zer sems sbyong rab tu bkye7byas shing / /myosalgepa thams cad rang bzhin sems su 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin rjes su sems 'grorasherab byas pas/ /des ni sems sbyong 'od zer de grub po/ /'od zer gzugs sbyong rab tu dgye7byas shing / /bsam yas sku mnga'7mi'i dbang po mthong / /sku gzugs ri mo7sna tshogs mang po dang / /mchod rten rgyasakyibyas gzugs sbyongasnyithob par 'gyur/ /'od zer sgra sbyong rab tu bkye7byas shing / /sgra ni sgra min stong par rab tu shes/ /rkyen las byung bas sgra brnyan 'dra'o⑩zhes/ /sgra rnams bstan pas 'od zer de grub po/ /'od zer dri sbyong rab tu dgyerwa)byas shing / /dri nga thams cad dri zhim mchog tu 'gyur/ /spos mchog rab chus rgyal ba'i mchod rten dag /khrus byas byang chub shing gi 'od de yin/ /'od zer bro mchog〈rterab tu dgye7)byas shing / /dug can dug myed ro yi mchog tu 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyan thos bcas dang pha ma la/ /brokhemachog thams cad phul ba'i 'od de yin/ /'od zer reg sbyong rab tu dgye byas shing / /reg na mi bde thams cad 'jam bder 'gyur/ /tri hu tshoshul mdung〈nyedang ral gri mda' yi char/ /phreng ba yid 'ong utpa la padmor 'gyur/ /gos mang 'jam pa reg na bde ba'i rnams / /rgyal ba gshegs pa'i lam du bting bkram ste/ /me tog byug pa na bza' 'jam pa dang / /phreng ba bla re gsol bas 'odagye de yin/ /'od zer chos sbyong rab tu dgyes(1byas shing / /ba spu kun nas 'jig rten phan mdzad pa'i//bsam yas chos mang 'byung ba thos 2)par 'gyur/ /mos pa'i lam tshul bzhin du dga' bar byed/ /rkyen las byung bas ma skyes rang bzhin yin 3/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni chos kyi sku yin te/ /chos nyid nam mkha' bzhin du rtag gnas shes/ /35—516

brjod pas chos sbyongatu'od zer de thob po/ /'od zer sgo mo de dag la sogasalapa / /drang srong rnams kyi ba spu'i7sgo gcig nas/ / gang gā'i༄bye ma snyed kyi 'od zer byungakyi/ /kun kyang7tha dad las kyi tshul canasheno/ /ji ltar ba spu gcig sgoshesgo gcig⑨/ /'od zer gaṅgā'i bye snyed yongs 'byung ba/ /de bzhin ma lus spu rnams thams cad nas/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul de 'dra'o/ /yon tan gang gis 'od zer grub 'gyur ba'i(nya/ /yon tan de la bstang lha grogs sus byas pa/ /de dag 'od zer de dag nyid kyang 'byung / /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul de 'dra 'o/ /de dag bsod nams bstang grogs〈rtebyas pa la /rjes su yi rangs smon lam sus btab pa8/ /gang gis mthong ste dge ba bsags gyur pa/ /de dag kun kyang 'od zer de dag shes/ /gang gis bsod nams byas shing dge bsags te/ /sangs rgyas yang dang yang du mchod byas shing ske/ /sangs rgyas yon tan 'dod cing don gnyer ba/ /de dag kun la 'od zer de dag bsku'atsho/ /dmus long rnams kyis nyi ma mitshwa snamathong yang / /de med ma yin 'jig rten kun tu 'char/ /mig dang ldan pas shar bar shes gyur nas//kun kyang rang rang so so'i las la 'jug /de bzhin skyes chen hunye'od zer de dag kyang ske/ /med pa ma yin kun tu 'phro ba ste/ /de dag mos pa 37log pas mnar ba yikhya/ /phal gyis mi mthong blo gros yangs la modadu nye/ /rgyan dang nor bu bzhon༄rtepa gzhal med khang / /rin chen ro mchog spos dang byug pa rnams/ /de dag che bar gyur la yod mod kyi/ /nyon mongs longs pa rnams la yod pa min/ /gang gis 'od zer bye brag 'di thos te/ /dad ladza steyid ches mos pa skyes gyur na/ /bdag ni yon tan chen po'i rgyal mtshan du/ /mi 'gyur snyam du nem nur des mi 35—517

bskyed②ske/ /de dag 'khor gyi〈rgyan du rnam 'phrul bas / /ting 'dzin dam pa mngon par sgrub 0byed cing / /phyogs bcu kun tu dpe zla med pa yi/ /rgyal sras 'khor rnams yongs su ston pa byed/ /de dag padmo mdzes pa stong gsum tsamakhaske/ /'od kyi rnam brgyan (7byin gyis brlabs byas shing / /lus gcig skyilasamo krung gi padmo de/ /yongs su rgyas ston ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul/ /de dag zhing bcu'i rdul snyed pad mo gzhan⑩/ /'khor dang bcas pa byin gyis brlabs byas shing / /rgyal sras kun gyis kun nas yongs bskor pa(1/ /de dag ting 'dzin ting 'dzin 32med par spyod/ /drang srong des ni yongs su smin byas te//rgyal ba'i legs pa 32yongs su gang bsgrubs mipa/ /de dag pad mo chen po 'khor byed cing / /kun kyang thal mo sbyar te7ngor yang dzo sna/ /skyes bu chen po'i chos nyid de 'dra ste/ /gang rnams ting 'dzin rnamatshwanyespyod zhugs gyur pa/ /kun kyang rang rang slob mas bskor 3/'gyur te/ /zla ba skar ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bzhin/ /de dag ji ltar phyogs gcig 'jug byed cing / /sangs rgyas sras kyi ri nye'akhor rnams ston byed pa/ /de bzhin ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /ston te ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul de 'dra'o/ /de dag ting 'dzin rab rnams mngon sgrub ni cing / /phyogs kyi dra ba snrel zhir〈nyespyod pa byed/ /la la mnyam bzhag la la nam ri gelangs par/ /rang rang lus kyang phyogs rnams kun tu ston / /de dag shar gyi phyogs su mnyam bzhag cing / /dpa' bo de dag nub kyi phyogs nas ldang / /nub kyi phyogs su de bzhin mnyam bzhag cing / /shar gyi phyogs nas bdag nyid che ba ldang / /de bzhin phyogs bcu kun tu 'jug byed de//phyogs rnams gzhan ge tu mnyam par bzhag byas shing / /ye shes yon tan mang po 35—518

gzhan nas7ldang / /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul de 'dra'o/ /shar phyogs zhing grangs7ji snyed yod pasarnams/ /ma lus de dag kun gyi rang byung pa gi/ /spyan snga zhabs kyi drung na ting 'dzin la/ /zhi bar〈nyarnam par spyod pa 7de dag snang ske/ /der ni mnyam bzhag sems can bstan byas nas/ /nub kyi zhing rnams kun nas dpa' bo7rnams/ /langs7shing rgyal ba kun gyi spyan snga nanyi / /mchod pa rnam mang du ma byed par snang / /nub kyi zhing grangs 31ji snyed yod pa 12rnams / /ma lus de dag kun gyi sangs rgyas kyi/ /spyan snga zhabs kyi drung na nyinating 'dzin la/ /zhi bar rnam par spyod pa 8de dag snang / /der ni mnyam bzhag sems can brtan7byas nas/ /shar gyi zhing rnams kun nas dpa' bo 9rnams / /langs shing rgyal ba kun gyi spyan snga na/ /mchod pa rnam mang nyartedu ma byed par snang / /phyogs bcu'i zhing du 'jug pa de 'dra ste/ /phyogs rnams kun tu ma lus dpa' bo〈nyernams/ /la la mnyam bzhag la la 3)rnam par longs rme//'jig rten sgron ma kun la mchod byed snang / /de dag mig gi lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /bdag nyid che ba gzugs kyi lam las ldang / /'jig rten lhar bcas mos par 'gyur ba yi/ /bsam gyis mi khyab gzugs kyang ston par byed( nye / /gzugs kyi lam la mnyam par bzhag byas shing / /dran dang ldan pa 32mig gi lam las ldang / /mig ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par ston par5nyebyed/ /de dag rna ba'i lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /bdag nyid che ba sgra yi lam las ldang / /sgra dbyangs thams cad sgra brnyan 24bzhin du shes/ /'jig rten lhar bcas de la mos par 'gyur/ /sgra yi lam la mnyam par bzhag byas shing / /dran dang ldan pa 2gerna ba'i lam las ldang / /rna 35—519

ba ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par ston par7byed/ /de dag sna yi lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /bdag nyid che ba ②dri yi lam las ldang ske/ /dri rab mchog la 'jug par byarab tu zhugs/ /'jig rten lhar bcas de la mos par 'gyur/ /dri yi lam la mnyam par bzhag byas shing / /dran dang ldan pa sna yi lam las ldang / /sna ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par ston par byedabu/ /de dag lce yi lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /bro ⑥mchog kun gyi lam las ldang bar 9)byed/ /bdag nyid che ba de dag blo ⑧mchog shes/ /'jig rten lhar bcas de la mos par 'gyur/ / bro ba'i7mchog la mnyam par bzhag byas shing / /dran dang ldan pa lce yi lam las ldang / /lce ni ma skyes ma byung 3 )rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par ston paratshwa)byed/ /de dag lus kyi lam la 32mnyam bzhag cing / /bdag nyid che ba reg pa'i〈nyelam las ldang / /'jig rten bde ba bskyed 8pa'i reg la zhugs/ /'jig rten lhar bcas de la mos par 'gyur/ /reg gi lam la mnyam par bzhag byas shing 8/ /dran dang ldan pa lus kyi lam las ldang / /lus ni ma byung ma skyes rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par ston pa byed(nye/ /de dag sems kyi lam la mnyam bzhag cing / /bdag nyid che ba chos kyi lam las ldang / /chos sgrub 'jug par bya la 3nyerab tu zhugs/ /'jig rten lhar bcas de la mos par 'gyur / /chos kyi lam la mnyam par bzhag byas shing / /dran dang ldan pa sems kyi lam las ldang / /sems ni ma skyes ma byung rang bzhin te/ /stong pa byed pa med par ston pa hu)byed/ /gyis pa'i lus sumanye de dag mnyam bzhag cing / /gzhon nu dar la bab pa'i lus du nyasu ldang / /gzhon nu dar la bab par〈nyemanyam 35—520

bzhag cing / /rgan zhing 'khoganyepa'i lus su rnam par ldang / /rgan zhing 'khogs pa'i lus su mnyam bzhag cing / /dge bsnyen dad ②ma'i lus su rnam par ldang / /dge bsnyen dadasnyema'i lus su mnyam bzhag cingachad/ /dge bsnyen dad pa'i lus su rnam par ldang / /dge bsnyen dad pa'i lus su mnyam bzhag cing ske/ /dge slong ma yi lus su rnam par ldang / /dge slong ma yi lus su mnyam bzhag cing / /dge slong mang du thos pa'i lus su ldang / /dge slong mang thos lus la mnyam bzhag cing / /slob dang mi slob lus su rnam par ldang / /slob dang mi slob lus su mnyam bzhag cing / /rang rgyal lus las de dag rnam par ldang ske/ /rang rgyal lus la de dag mnyam bzhag cing / /sangs rgyas sku mchog phul du rnam par ldang / /sangs rgyas sku mchog phul la mnyam bzhag cing / /lha yi lus su de dag rnam par ldang / /lha yi lus su de dag mnyam bzhag cing / /'phrul chen klu yi lus su rnam par ldang / /'phrul chen klu yi lus su mnyam bzhag cing / /'phrul chen gnod sbyin lus su rnam par ldang / /'phrul chen gnod sbyin lus su mnyam bzhag cing / /'byung po kun gyi lus su rnam par ldang / /'byung po kun gyi lus su mnyam bzhag cing / /spu rtse gcig gi sgo nas rnam par ldang ske/ /spu rtse gcig gi sgo nasalgemanyam bzhag cing / /spu rtse kun gyi sgo nas rnam par ldang / /spu rtse kun gyi sgo lashemanyam bzhag cing / /skra rtse gcig gi sgo nas rnam par ldang / /skra rtse gcig gi sgo nas hu3 mnyam bzhag cing / /skra rtse kun gyi sgo nas rnam par ldang / /skra rtse kun gyi sgor ni mnyam bzhag cing / /rdul phran gcig las de dag rnam par ldang / /rdul phran gcig la71de dag mnyam bzhag cing / /rdul phran ma lus kun las rnam par ldang / /rdul phran kun la 835—521

de dag mnyam bzhag cing / /rgya mtsho rdo rje'i gzhi7)las rnam par ldang / /rgya mtsho rdo rje'i khugazhi la mnyam bzhag cing / /rin chen shing gi 'bras las rnam par ldang / /rin chen shing gi 'bras la mnyam bzhag cing / /rgyal ba'ikhu'od zer sgor ni rigernam par ldang / /rgyal ba'i 'od zer sgor⑥ni mnyam bzhag cing //rgya mtsho (6)chu dang chu klung kun nas ldang / /rgya mtsho mechu klung kun nas nimanyam bzhag cing / /bdag nyid che ba me yi lam las ldang / /me yi lam la de dag mnyam bzhag cing / /dran dang ldan pa rlung gi lam las ldang / /rlung gi lam la de dag mnyam bzhag cing / /bdag nyid che bas yi ge zhi7las ldang / /sa yi gzhi hu) la mnyam par bzhag byas shing / /lha yi gzhal med khang nas rnam par ldang ske/ /lha yi gzhal med khang du mnyam bzhag cing / /dran dang ldan pa klu yi gnas nas ldang / /yon tan mtha' yas bstsags nyu1 pa de dag sikhrirte/ /ting 'dzin rnam thar de dag bsam myi khyab/ /rgyal ba kun gyi7)bskal pa bsam yas su / / bstan par 1 mdzad kyang zad par myi rung ngo / /rgyal ba kun gyisasnyide skad ma gsungs 7phyin/ /'gro ba'i las kyi rnam smin bsam myi khyab/ /klu yi rnam 'phrul sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul dang / /bsam gtan pa yi rnam 'phrul bsam myi khyab/ /de dag kun 1 la'ang dpe bstan brjodarwanyepar bya/ /de la 'dra ba'i〈pedape lta yod min te/ /mkhas shing gsal ba'i skye bo dpe rnams kyis/ /bstan du 3 na myur du rnam par don shes 'gyur/ /sems kyi lam la rnam thar brgyad du nyaganas pa'i / /nyan thos gcig tu gyur cing mang por 'gyur/ /mang por gyur cing de bzhin gcig gyur te/ /nam mkha' 'di la bsam gtan 'cha' rdurtezhing 'bar/ /'og nas me 'bar nusasteng nas chu'i rgyun/ /steng nas me 'bar 'og nas chu'i 35wa 522

rgyun / /'gro 'dug nyal zhing 'greng ba de bzhin te/ /skad cig gcig la lus 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /de ni snying rje chen po ldan ma yin/ /byang chub mi tshol 'jig rten yal bar gzhog① /'on kyang lus 'phrul bsam gyis myi khyab ston/ /'jig rten phan tshol ci phyir de mi ston/ /nyi zla mkha' las rnam par rgyu 'dod zhing ske/ /phyogs rnams kun gyi mtsho dang lu ma dang ②/ /lteng ka khron pa rin chen rgya mtsho'ishesnod/ /chu klung kun tu gzugs brnyan ston pa ri7byed/ /de bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab gzugs kun kyang / /skyes bu dpa' bo de dag phyogs bcur ston / /ting 'dzin rnam thar kun gyi tshul la mkhas/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa rang byungasadapal/ /mtsho gsal yidang bar yan lag bzhi'i dpung / /so so 7 rang rang gzugs brnyan tshul bzhin mthong / /ral gri 8)shang lang sogs 9 ka mde'u thung mda'/ /bzhon ⑩pa theg pa go cha bcas pa nyu1mthong / /gang gi gzugs dang〈nyecha byad ci 'dra ba/ /chu gsal de la de bzhin ma nor mthong / /chu la zhe sdang byams pa rtog tunyepa med/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul de 'dra'o / /rgya mtsho'i lha mo sgra dang ldan yod pa/ /sems can rgya mtshor ji snyed skyes pa rnams/ /de dag 8sgra yi yan lag dbyangs 'tshul shes/ /sgra skad kun tu rang rang skad du brjod/ /dbyangs ldan de ni 'dod chags zhe sdang can/ /'on kyang sgra dbyangs las / 7kyi tshul la mkhas/ /gzugs 38dang chos kyi stobs la dbang thob pa4)/ /'jig rten lhar bcas ci phyir mgur mi byed/ /dga' byed chung ma sgra snyanam )ldan pa mo/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo sems las byung ba ste/ /dam tshig ( nyabaden bsgrub ( nyemi 'tshe ( snyedaga' ba yin byu/ /sems yid dag rnams byin gyis rlob pa byed/ /sgra snyan5nyeldan pa 'dod chags zhe sdang can/ /brtul zhugs 35wa 523

grub la dbyangs kyi 7rjes su 'brang / /'jig rten yid 'ong sgras kyang tshim par byed / /ye shes yon tan mang ba cir mi ston/ /sngags kyi tshul mkhas sgyu mkhumakhan po yang / /sna tshogs mtha' yas gzugs mang ston pa byed/ / nyin mtshan yud〈(dang zla ba lo brgya dang / /khyim bzang rgyas pa shin tu mdzes pa ston/ /'dod chagasasnyisnang ldan sgyu ma'i zhinamakhan po yang / /sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyis 'jig rten dga' bar byed/ /bsam gtan 6)mngon shes rnam 'phrul rab byang ba⑦/ /spyod padzan)tshul mkhas ci phyir dga' mi byed/ /lha dang lha min dbang po 'thab pa'i tshe/ /lha min lha yang rung ste gang phamanyepa/ /de dag bzhon pa theg pa gdugs bcas par/ /go ca 31gyon bzhin 'jigs pas kun tu byer/ /lha dbang de dag 'dod chags sdang ldan yang / /lus kyi rnam 'phrul bsam gyis myi khyab ston/ /dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul gnas pa'i dpa' bo7rnams/ /lus kyi rnam 'phrul ci phyir ston mi byed/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i glang po shugs ldan pa/ /'phrul chen glang po'i 3)dbang po'i 6'khor gyur pa'/ /mgo mang sum bcu rtsa gnyis sprul pa byed/ /mgo rnams kun la'ang mche ba drug drug7ste/ /so rnams re re kun la'ang rdzing gi nyurternams/ /bdunarwashebadun chus rgyas yongs sutshwa)sprul pa byed//rdzing rnams re re kun tu pad mo rnams/ /bdun bdun rgyan gyisasri rnam brgyan sprul pa byed/ /pad mo rer yang dunyalha yi bu mo dag /sgyu rtsal5 )kun mkhas bdun bdun sprul pa byed/ /de dag rtsed mo glu gar tshul la mkhas/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dbang po de dang rtse/ /glang po de yang glang po'i〈 nyelus btang zhing / /lha rnams kun dang mnyam zhing 'dra bar rdzu/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang longs spyod kun dang mthun(snye / /glang po mchog gi rnam 'phrul ci 'dra ltos(nye/ /de ni 'dod chags zhe 35—524

snang gti mug can/ /'on kyang de 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul ston byed na/ /shes rab thabs kyi stobs la byang gyur rnams①/ /ting 'dzin brgyas kyang ji robam 'phrul mi byed/ /sgra gcanasheci dga'i tshul dusalus rdzu na/ /rdo rje'i gegazhi la rkang pa'i mthil bor zhing / /rgya mtsho'i zabashering lte'ubar phyin tsam byed/ /ri rab rtse dang nyid kyi mgo yang snyoms6)/ /de ni 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug can/ /'on kyang de 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul ston byed na/ /'jig rten sgron ma bdud /nyarnams yongs 'dul ba/ /rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas ji robatshwanyeston mi byed/ /bsam yas brgya byin 'phrul la'ang7ltos shig dang / /lha dang lha dbang 'thab par gyur pa'i tshe/ /lha min bye ba 'phyesalgepa ji snyed pa/ /de snyed brgya byin rang gi lus 'phrul byed / /lha min dbang po lha min phal kun gyis/ /brgya byin rang rang mdun na 'dug par shes/ /de ni rdo rje 'chang bas gzung 'gyur 8ces/ /lha min dbang po kun kyang mgo rmongs so/ /'jigasalgepa'i gzugs kyisamathe/mig stong rab bstan te/ /rdo rje me lce 'bar ba rab gzas0) shing / /lus la go bgos gzi brjid thub0 dka' ba'i/ /brgya byin mthong nas lha min dbang po 'byer/ /de'i dubasod nams phal (nyegyi stobs dang mthus/ /lha rgyal don du rnam par 'phrul byed na/ /'gro ba ma lus kun gyi mgon gyur pa'i/ /bsod nams mi zad rnams ko nyecir mi 'phrul/ /lha rnams bskul5nyeba'i lha rdzas rnga' tshoyod pa/ /lha yi las rnams rnam par smin pas byung / /lha rnams bag med spyod par shes gyur nas/ /mkha' las rnga yi dbyangs kyang zhunyerab tu sgrog /'dod pa thams cad mi rtag mi brtan te( rkye/ /'jig cing mi gnas dbu ba'i rang bzhin 'dra/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu chu yi zla ba bzhin/ /srid pa kun kyang rmi lam sprin gyi dngos/ /35wa 525

bag med thams cad gcugs can7)mya ngan ldan/ /tshems7kyi lam yin 'chi med lam ma yin/ /ji snyed bag med rnam par spyod pasarnams/ /bdud kyi chu srin chen pos zos pa yin/ /yongs su 'dzin pa thams cad sdug bsngal rtsa/ /skye ba thams cad 'phags pa kun gyis 4 rismad/ /'dod pa'i yon tanasnyemathar zad rang bzhin gyis/ /chos la mos pas rtag tu dga' bar gyis/ /brgya byin lhar bcas rnga rine yis bskul byas nas/ /kun kyang chos bzang mdun mesar dong phyinamasate/ / lha mang 'o kun la chos gtam zhi ba'i rnams/ /'dod chags bral dang rjes su mthun pa brjod1 / /rnga rab de ni gzugs med mi mthong yang / /don chen rnga yi sgra ni sgrog /1byed na/ /bsam pa'i tshul bzhin gzugs mang hu ston byed pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi don chen cir myi byed1snye/ /lha dang lha min 'thab par gyur pa'i tshe/ /lha yi bsod nams khyad par mthu stobs kyis/ /lha rnams bskul 3 riba'i lha rdzas rnga yi mchog /lha rnams 'jigs sa re zhes sgra yang sgrog /rngas bskul gelha rnams yongs su dga' ba skyes/ /'jigs med stobs dang shin tu ldan par 'gyur/ /lha min dbang po 'jigs shing dngangs gyuratshwa tshanas/ /de ma thag tu 'jigs shing kun tu 'byer18/ /de bzhin rnga 'dra 'jigs tu/med stobs pa'i rnams/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgon dang dpung gyuramu )te/ /bdud dang nyon mongs bcom pa'i snying rje can/ /zhi ba'i sgra sgrog (1nyon mongs rab tu sel/ /dbang po'i lha mo dgu bcu rtsa gnyis te/ /dbang po'i〈 sprul pas kun kyang dga' bar 'gyur/ /gcig kyang ni bdag dang brgya byin rtse (stebar shes/ /gcig ltas〈gelha mo kun kyang de bzhin no/ /lha mo kun kyangarsā9dga' bar gnas snang yang / /chos bzangs 'dun sa 27kun na'ang de bzhin 'dug /lha rnams kun la chos 35wa 526

rab ston par yang / /brgya byin skad cig gcig gis rnam par 'phrul/ /brgya byin 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug can/ /sprul pas rang gi 'khor rnams dga' byed na/ /'gro don mi skyo0)spyod pa ci'i phyir/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 2'jig rten dgar〈nyemi byed/ /bdud kyi dkrugs tsum 'gro ba'i dbang bsgyur 5ba/ /de yi dbang du sems can 'di kun 'dong / /las dang nyon mongs kun tu 'khri 6zhags kyis/ /so so'i skye bo bdud 'khrugs des kyang bcings / /de ni 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug can6)/ /'gro ba mang po bdud kyi dbang byed na/ /dbang bcu'i dbang thob gyur pa ji rob nyu )ste/ /'gro ba thams cad rang gi phyogs mi gzhog /stong gsum bdag po tshangs pa chen po yang / /stong gsum kun gyi tshangs pa'i gnas rnams na(spe/ /ma lus kun tu 'dug par rab tu snang //tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs yid 'ong rnams kyang sgroganyi /de ni 'jig rten pa yi lam gyis ni3nye/ /bsam gtan mngon par shes pas rnam par 'phrul/ /'jig rten yongs 'das bla na med pa yi/ /bsam tshigatan rnam thar tshaganas pa cir mi 'phrul / /dbang phyug chen po'i ye shes rnam 'phrul ltos/ /rgya mtshor sprin gyi 7char rnams rab bkye ba/ /skad cig gcig gis thams cad 'grang 1 ba byed/ / thigs 'ga'i〈dezer kyang ma lus nges nyurtashes na/ /bskal pa bsam gyis myi khyab tshul bslabs te( — smi/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med thob rnams/ / ji rob 21 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyi/ /skad cig gcig la sems bsam 22shes mi 'gyur / /sems can las smin bsam gyis myi khyab pas/ /rlung las 3lha'ajig rten thams cad yongs su byung / /rgya mtsho ri dang lha yi gzhal med dang / /sa bon rnams shunamang kun kyang de las byung / /rlung las sprin byung 25char pa kun tu 35—527

'bab / /sprin mang zhi bar 'gyur ba'ang rlung gis 'gyur/ /lo toganyernam par 'phel ba'ang rlung gis te/ /'jig rten kun la rlung ni bde ba skyedal/ /de ni pha rol phyin la ma bslabs tedu )/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rlung gis bslabs min na'ang ske/ /'jig rten rnam grub bsam yas ston byed na/ /rang nyamasashethob pa ji rob ston mi byed/ /rgya mtsho'i 'brug sgra'i sprin gyi chushetshogs7ni/ /bya skad rnams dang ji snyed ri dgasalo)skad/ /khye'u dang bu mo bud med skyes pa'i skad/ /thams cad skad bzhin 'gro la rnam par sgrogatso /de bzhin sgra brnyan tunyerang bzhin sgra the shes nas/ /bsgribs nya pa med pa'i spobs pa rab ldan pas/ /'gro ba kun tu sgra brnyanasabarjod byas shing / /'jig rten thams cad yid 'ong sgrasalgetshim byed/ /rgya mtsho 'di la ngo mtshar rmad7kyi chos(rte/ /'gro ba thams cad rgya dang mnyam snang zhing / /chu dang 'byung po rin chen yongs mi zad/ /chu rnams bzung 3lhebs yongs su ngoms 37pa med/ /de bzhin de dag 'gro kun rgyar stsalalge te / /bsod nams bsam gtan rnam thar zad mi shes/ /shes rab ye shes yon tan de bzhin kun/ /bsod nams yon tan tshogs kyis〈nyengoms pa med/ /rgya mtsho'i klu 3)ni rnam par rtse nu byed na/ /sa yi gzhi nas dbang sgyur steganas kyi bar / /gling bzhi bcas par sprin chen rgyas par 'gengs/ /de dag kun kyang rgyan mang sna tshogs ldan/ /de ni dbang bsgyur nyeganas su 'dzam bu chu klung gi/ /gser gyi mdog du sprin mang rnam par bsgrubs(9/ /'phrul dga' mu tig dmar po'i mdog lta bu/ /dga' ldan gnas su kha ba ba mo'i mdog /mtshe rdunyemar mthon ting bai ḍūrya yi 2 mdog /sum cu gsum du a sma gar bha0)'dra/ /rgyal chen gnas su shel gyi mdog lta bu/ /rdo rje mi phyed sra mdog (nye rgya mtshor ro/ /35wa 528

mi yisheganas su〈spos mchog 'dres par te/ /klu yi gnas su pad mo'i mdog lta bu/ /gnod sbyin gnas su ngang pa chu skyar mdog /ri yi mdog tu lha min gnas su'o/ /byang du gser gyi kha dog tshi'od ston te/ /gling rnams gzhan du'ang sna tshogs rgyan du ston/ /'dzam bu'i gling du ri gnag 'dra bar te94)/ /sprin rnams gang rnams ji ltar grub pa bzhin/ /dbang sgyur5nyaganas su gser gyi sprin bstan nas/ /nyi ma'i mdog 'dra glogs༅kyang rab tu 'gyed/ / 'phrul dga'i gnas su zla 'od bzang 'dra dang / /dga' ldan gnas su 'dzam bu'i gser mdog⑤ston/ /kha ba ba mo'i mdog tu mtshe mar te/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas su gser mdog tu/ /rgyal chen gnas su dpal gyi snying po'i mdog /mu tig dmar po'i mdog tu rgya mtshor rngo7/ /myi ci'i huX gnas su mthon ting bai ḍūdusnyonye / /klu yi gnas su dpal gyi snying po'i mdog /gnod sbyin gnas su shel gyi kha dog ste/ /a sma'i mdog du lha min gnas su'o32/ /byang du ngang gis 32snang ba'i rin chen mdog /gling rnams gzhan du'ang rnam phye gzhan dang gzhan//'dzam bu'i gling du 'od 'phro andasnyirnyil/ /sprin gyi mtshan nyid tshul mthun klogatsha8kyang 'gyed/ /de ni tshangs pa'i dbang sgyur miganas su tshangs dbyangs su/ /'brug sgra sgrog byed 'phrul dgar hu)rnga yi dbyangs/ /rol mo'i sgrar yang dga' ldan gnas su ste/ /lha mo'i tu)dbyangs su mtshe ma dag tu'o/ /sum cu gsum du mi ci'i skad ( nye du ste/ /rgyal chen gnas su dri za'i skad du'o/ /ri 'thab dbyangs su rgya mtsho kun tu ste/ /mi 'am ci 'i gnas su gling bu'i sgra/ /klu yi gnas su thal mo brdabs pa'i sgra/ /gnod sbyin gnas su klu yi bu mo'i sgra/ /lha min gnas su lha rdzas rnga yi sgra/ /rgya mtsho'isaruḥshugs sgras rdurtemi yi gnas su'o/ /35wa 529

dbang bsgyur0)gnas su lha rdzas bsung 2)zhim pa'i/ /me tog sna tshogs rgyan mang char yang 'bebs/ /zla ba bzang po'i 'od 'dra 'phrul dgar te③/ /me tog manda ra rigeba'i phreng rinachar 'bebasayi/ /dga' ldan gnas su rin 0chen chen ⑧po'i char/ /rgyan gyi dam pa rin chen sna tshogs dang / /gtsug gi rin chen zla ba 'dra ba dang / /gser 'od bzang po'i char pa rab tu 'bebs/ /rgyal mtshan gdugs dang ba dan bzang po dang / /phreng ba byug pa rgyan gyi dam pa dang / /mu tig dmar po la ltar btags mdog tu/ /rol mo yid 'ong char pa mtshe mar 'bebs / /sum cu gsum du rin chen sna tshogs te/ /tsan dan dam pa'i spos dang a ga ru/ /gur gumarwage sar lha rdzas ta ma la/ /spos chu'i rgyan dang me tog 'dres par 'bebs11/ / nyam du rte'agyur ba'i kha zas skom gyi rnams/ /kha dog dri zhim ro dang ldan pa dang / /de min rin chen char 'bab bsam yas kyang ske/ /rgyal chen bzhi yi gnas su klu dbang 'bebs/ /de ni rgya mtsho chen por rgyun tu yang / /char rgyun nya rgyun mi 'chad pa gnya' shing tsamakha/ /mi zad rin chen shin tu rnam rgyal ba'i/ /rin chen char ni mtha' yas rgyun tu 'bab/ /mi ci'i skoganas su phreng ba sna tshogs dang / /padmo utpal tsodangos dang rin chen dang ske/ /me tog par shi ma la'i 3 tshobye ma spos/ /pi wang〈nyernga dang gling bu snyan par rol/ /klu yi gnas su mu tig dmar po ste/ /gnod sbyin gnas su rin chen dang snang 3geb/ /lha min gnas su ral gri mde'u thung mdung / /dgra 'dul gzhu dang ste'u ku'i 3 richar 'bebs so/ /byang du de ni phreng ba rin chen dang / /me tog par shi ma li tsam pa ku'i/ /phreng ba bzang po kun rdunyeran mug ta ka /gling rnams gzhan du'ang char pa sna tshogs so/ /'dzam bu'i gling du chu 'dong rab 35wa 530

gsal7gyi/ /char rnams sna tshogs ri shin tu phra bar 'bebs/ /me tog 'bras bu sman dang spos dang shing / / lo las chosade bzhin 'jig rten bde 'phel cabyed//de ltar sprin rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dang / /glog ri dang 'brug dang char pa rnams byed7kyang / /khyim nas mi g.yo rnam par rtog pa med/ /klu 7yi 'phrul yang de ltar bsam mi khyab/ /de ltar chu yi rgya mtsho 48)gnas pa yang / /klu yi rnam 'phrul bsam yas ston byed na/ /chos kyi rgya mtshor zhugs pa'i yon tan bdag /mtha' yas rnam 'phrul mang por lacir mi ston/ /dper bya de dag kun gyis mgo smos tsam/ /skyes bu de dag tsho/ )brjod byas yangs pa ste11/ /dpa' bo de dag dpe dang rnam par bral/ /de dag de 'dra'i rnam thar dbang sgyur 12ro//mtha' yas blo gros yangs pa'i blo gros can/ /ma nor blo gros mtha' yas blo gros can / /ye shes mchog dang khyad par blo ldan pa'i/ /rnam thar dam pa de 'dra'i tshul du bshad/ /gang gis rnam thar 'di dag thos gyur nas/ /yid ches 'dzin cing 'jig rten sgrog pa ni/ /ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos dang de ldan te/ / mi yul kun〈nyen de ni dga' yib byed/ /'di 'dra'i chos la yid ches dad byed payi / /so so'i7skye bo'i tshogs na'ang shin tu dkon/ / /dge bstsags 1 /bsod nams byas pa de dag ni/ /rgyu yi stobs kyis 'di la yid ches 'gyur/ /gang rnams nyan thos theg hu)la'ang yid ches pa'i/ /mi rnams 'jig rten kun na dkon zhu )pa ste/ /de bas rang rgyal theg la tsho 1dad pa dkon/ /theg chen dad byed de bas shin tu dkon/ /theg chen 'di la zhugs pa med 22pa ste/ /'di 'dra'i chos la dad pa shin tu dkon rte/ /'dzin cing spel byed smos kyang ci dgos te/ /yang dag ma nor 'jug pas shrīsmos ci dgos/ /la la stong gsum ri dang rgya lhamatshor 35wa 531

bcas6)ske/ /bskal〈mipar 'dzin cing mgo la khyer byed na'ang / /'di 'dra'i chos la dad parasabyed pa las④/ /de 'drashedaka' bar rtsi7ba ma yin no/ /la las stong gsum rdul snyed sems can rnams/ /bde ba kun gyis bskal par bsnyen bkur na'ang / /'di 'dra'i chos la yid chesashedad byed pa'i/ /bsod nams ci 'dra thob pa de la7min/ /la la zhing bcu ri dang mtshor⑥bcas pa/ /lag pa'i mthil gyis nam mkha'i dbyings 'dzin kyang / /'di 'dra'i chos la yid ches dad byed pa'i/ / dka' ba de 'dra de la yod pa min/ /la las7zhing bcu'i rdul snyed sems can la3)/ /bde ba kun gyis bskal par bsnyen bkur kyang ske/ /'di 'dra'i chos la yid ches〈nyedad byed pa'i/ /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'dra de la min/ /la las zhing bcu'i rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /bskal parachabade ba kun gyis bsnyen bkur te/ /la las le'u 'dinyeyongs su bzung byas na⑩/ /bsod nams 'di ni de las khyadatshwanyepar 'phags/ /rnam thar de dag yongs su bstan pa'i tshe/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams thams cad g.yos par 'gyur(shel/ /lha dang bdud kyi gnas rnams zil gyis mnan/ /'od mang bkye7bas ngan song rab tu zhi/ /phyogs bcu kun gyi mi yi seng ge rnams/ /thams cad kun gyis mngon par zhal bstan te/ /phyag brkyang mtha' yas yon tan mang bdogasnye pa/ /bzang po'i sirnyadapal gyi mgo la bzhag par gyur/ /phyag gi mthil gyis rdusemago la byug mdzad de/ /sangs rgyas de dag kun gyis gsung brjod pa/ /rnam thar 'di dag khyod kyis ni:legs bshad kyis( ste/ /legs par bstan la rjes su nged dgyes5)so/ /ninyebazang po'i dpal gyi le'u zhes bya ba ste/ bcu bdun pa'o// //35—532

sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/37 bam po bcu dgusapa/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dngas/ de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang /byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams ④dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams rjodang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og gi phyogs dang / steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gling bzhi pa 'di la sogs ⑦pa gling bzhi 6)pa re re na yang / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag de bzhin du bzhugs par snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis chos lho)ston cing /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi drung na 'khod par yang hu )so so nas shes te/bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa de ma brtul71bar byang chub kyi shing gi drung du5)ri rab kyi rtse mo'i lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi khang pa rnam par rgyal ba ga la tib der gshegs par snang ngo / /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das gling bzhi pa 'di'i/ ri rab kyi rtse mor gshegs par snang ba/ de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa yidag gi ri rab kyi rtse mor gshegs par snang stekho/ byin gyi rlabs snga ma dag kyang ma nyams par snang ngo / /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das rnam par rgyal ba'i khang pa logs su mngon par gshegs pa rgyang ring po nas mthong nas rnam par rgyal ba'i khang pa'i nang du rings pa'i gzugs su rdzu 'phrul gyi rang bzhin seng ge'i gdan phyogs rnam par snang ba'i snying po can pog re stong phrag bcus brgyan pa/ gser 35—533

gyi dra ba stong phrag bcu kun tu bres pa/ gnam yol stong phrag bcus bla reratubres pa/ gdugs stong phrag bcu du shin tu bzung ba dar gyi lda ldi stong phrag bcusherab tu sbyangs ④pa/ mu tig gi se mo do stong phrag bcumasnidaga' dga' ltar byas pa/gos stong phrag bcus mngon par bkaba'i6)pa/ lha'i bu mo tshestong phrag bcus mdun du byas pa/ tshangs pa stong phrag bcus kun nas bskor ba/ 'od zer stong phrag bcus shin tu snang bar gyur pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan du bshams so/ /ji ltar gling bzhi pa 'di'i 8)ri rab kyi rtse mor lha'i dbang po'istorsha)khang pa rnam par rgyal bar lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis sna )de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan bshams pa de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi ri rab kyi rtse mo dag tu 'ang lha'i dbang po brgya 31byin dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan dag tshul de 'dra ba dang rgyan de 'dra bar bshams par gyur to/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi 1rtagadan seng ge'i khri bcas nas/ zhe hunyes dang rim gro chen pos bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der thal mo sbyar te/ phyag mi'atshal nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gshegs su gsol / bde bar gshegs pa gshegs su gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bde bar gshegs sam tunyezhes gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis spyan drangs nas / rnam par rgyal ba'i khang par gshegs so/ /de 7ltar bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi lha'i khang pa dag tu'ang gshegs par snang ngo / /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis sangs rgyas kyi mthus sum cu rtsa gsum gyi khang pa thams cad du glu nyirtedang rol mo dang / sil 35—534

snyan brgya phrag mang po dag btang ste/ zhi bar byas nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snga ma dag las0)dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyedam pa de dag rjes su dran nas / de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /thugs rje chen po mnga' ba 'od srungs mirigs skyes pa/ /rnam par rgyal bar gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /gser thub bsgribs ④pa med par rab tu gzigs pa de/ /rin chen sna tshogs gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig⑤ /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /bsod skyabs gser gyi ri bo 'bar ba 'dra ba de/ /rtse mo mchog du gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir7yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /thams cad mnga' ba dgra bcom dri ma gsum sel ba/ /mdzod spu'i rtse mor gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas gtsug tor 47tshodagongs pa zil gyis mi non pa / /rin chen sna tshogs gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shisarani/dam pa gang zhig gis/ /rnam par gzigs pa skyes bu'i zla ba mi yi mgon/ /rin chen rgyan du gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /shin tu rgyas pa don dam mkhas shing brtan skyepa de/ /ma la ya'i rtse mor 1 rigashegs gyur 11pa / /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas ston mchog thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ /dri med zla bar gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra 32shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis 35—535

dam pa gang zhig gis/ /grags pa dri ma med pa mgon po7padmo'i bla/ /dri ma med par gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /mgon po mar me mdzad pa 'od snang mnga' ba de / /'od zer dra bar gshegs gyur pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /ji ltar lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis sangs rgyas kyi mthus yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcu'i〈mirgyal bshegashegs pa grur blangs te tshigs su bcad pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus lha'i dbang po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gzhan dang gzhan gyis/yang dag par rsha)rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcu'i rgyal ba gshegs pa dag glur len cing tshigs su bcad ④par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par rgyal ba'i khang par gshegs nas skyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar bzhugs pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yang de bzhin gshegs pa dag gdan ⑥de dag la bzhugs par snang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das de ltar bzhugs ma thag tu de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang pa de yang sum cu rtsa gsum thams cad kyi khang pa dang / lha'i ris tsam du che bar snang bar gyur te④/ 'di na ji lta ba ltar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na'ang de bzhin no/ /2)de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab kyi rtser gshegs pa'i le'u ste/ brtswa hu )brgyad pa'o31// //de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcu nas byang chub sems dpa' bcu bcu 'ongs par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag so so nas77'jig rten 35—536

gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol nas 'ongs pa sha stag ste/ byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi⑧rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu phyin par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/ 'di ltar chos kyi blo gros dang / thams cad blo gros dang / dpal gyi blo gros dang /yon tan blo gros dang / brtson 'grus blo gros dang / dge ba'i blo gros dang /ye shes blo gros dang / bden pa'i blo gros dang / mchog gi blo gros dang /dam pa'i blo gros dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mingakhu'adi zhes bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa dgas ༷ste bye/ 'di ltar dbang po'i me tog dang / pad mo'i me tog dang / rin po che'i me tog dang ske/ utpa la'i me tog dang / rdo rje'i me tog dang / spos kyi me tog dang /yid du 'ong ba'i me tog dang / 'od zer gyi me tog dang / ldum bu'i me tog dang ske/ nam mkha'i me tog dag bos/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan 'di zhes bya ba dag gi zham ring na tshangs par spyod pa dag ste/ 'di ltar zla ba gzhan ma yin pa dang / zla ba ma nyams pa dang / zla ba mi g.yo ba dang / zla ba mi sgul56)ba dang / zla ba chu'i lha dang /zla ba thogs pa med pa dang / zla ba'i ④'od zer dang / zla ba rdul med pa dang ske/ zla ba rnam par grub pa dag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcur rgyas par bkang nas gang nas 'ongs pa'i phyogs su brten 8)te/seng ge'i khri rnam par snang ba'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas skyil mo 35—537

krung 1)bcas te 'khod do/ /ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i ri rab kyi rtse mo la byang chub sems dpa' rnams lhags pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa thams cad dang lha'i dbang po'i khang pa kun na ②yang de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' ming de skad ces bya ba sha stag go/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyang de skad ces bya ba nas 'ongs pa sha stag go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yang mtshan de skad ces bya ba'i zham ring nas tshangs par spyod pa sha stag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 37zhabs kyi mthe bo rigeganyis nas 'od zer bye ba phrag 467stong bkye ste/ phyogs bcu rtso)thams cad snang bar byas nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang bstan 33to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis kyang 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa thams cad dang / ri rab kyi rtse mo thams cad na de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa yod pa thams cad kyang mthong bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo 9gros kyis sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag 3 )smras so/ /snang ba dri ma med la ltos31/ /ri rab rtse mo thams cad la/ /mgon po dag ni rab tu snang / /rnam par rgyal ba kun na bzhugs/ /lha'i rgyal po thams cad kyis/ /spyan drangs shing ni gshegs par gyur32/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas bcu dag dzirnye/ /rab tu gshegs pas mngon par bstod/ /kun gyi 'khor kyang gcig pa ste/ /byang chub sems dpa' mang po lhags/ /phyogs bcu dag nas 'ongs gyur cing / /yid du 'ong ba'i stan 1 la 'khod/ /kun gyi ming yang 'di nyid de/ /ji ltar ded mal btags pa bzhin/ /'jig rten khams kyi ming dag kyang / /de skad 35—538

dag0)nas kun kyang 'ongs/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad na/ /drang srong chen po'i mtshan kyang demi/ /de na tshangs spyod bla med la/ /the tsom med par de dag spyod/ /kye ma rgyal sras khyed ltos bshig /drang srong chen po'i byin rlabs kyis6)/ /'dzam bu'i gling rnams thams cad na/ /rgyal ba 'di na bzhugs snyamachu)byed/ /bdag cag rnams ni 'di snyams7)du/ /ri rab rtse la bde gshegs snyam/ /'jig rten khams nitshan)kun na yang / /sangs rgyas ngo mtshar rmad0)re che/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad na/ /byang chub mchog tu sems btang zhing / /de dag smon lam 'di btab ste/ /byang chub spyod pa rab tu spyod/ /kha dog mdog ni tshad med pas/ /gang zag mchog ni bskyod 11byed kyang ske/ /chos kyi dbyings la mi chags te/ /de dag sus kyang mi shes so/ /gang gis 'jig rten mun bstsalarwartezhing / /thams cad dus su rnam snang ba/ /de la 'dra ba gang yang med/ /de ni shes par ji ltar rung 3lha/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad blo gros kyis phyogs bcur 7rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dgatshamasmras so/ /'dren pa rnams ni mthong nas kyang //bskal pa mang po 'das gyur te/ /'jig rten mgon skyob de dag gisas/ /chos nyid de ni shes pa min/ /mtshan ma dag la spyod pa she rnams/ /gti mug dra ba 'phel bar gyuranyusnye/ /sangs rgyas gang gis ma mthong ba/ /'khor ba'i btson rar mdongs hurtepa yin/ /chos rnams 'di dag brtag rdu byas na/ /rang bzhin shes par mi rung ste/ /skye dang shi 'phos gyur pa 7rnams/ /ming tsam du ni bstan5 )pa yin/ /chos rnams gang yang 'gro lhab med/ /gang yang de bzhin skye ba med/ /chos nyid 'di ni shes gyur na/ /sangs rgyas kun na rab tu snang / /35wa 539

gzung du med cing bltar med cingashe/ /chos kyi rnams ni rang bzhin med/ /dngos med pa yi mtha' shes na/ /sangs rgyas rnams la tshad kyang med/ /tshad med pa yi chos rnams kyi/ /rang bzhin gang gis yongs shes pa/ /desani ci zhig yod ces par/ /mthong bar gyur pasnyegang yang med/ /gang rnams mtshan ma'i rjes 'brang ba/ /de dag byis pa'i chos nyid de/ /de phyir mtshan nyid kun med pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang mi mthong ngo / /dus gsum 'byung ba'i thub pa rnams/ /mtshan rab kun dang ldan pa ste/ /mi gnas tshul du bzhugs pa yin⑤/ /chos kyi dbyings la g.yo ba med/ /la la dag gi chos nyid shes/ /la la dag ni chos kyang brjodag/ /gang la the com7mi mnga' ba'i/ /yang dag sangs rgyas de ring mthong / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi7chos nyid 'di/ /chos kyi blo gros 'di cibarjod do/ /de thos nas kyang bdag cag gis(te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bsam yas shes/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi blo gros kyis〈rtesangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /kye ma sangs rgyas dpal mnga' ba'i/ /ye shes shes rab shin tu tshe / /de la 'jig rten shin tu rmongs/ /sangs rgyas chos ni bsam mi khyab/ /tshul bzhin ma yin 'du shes kyis/ /byis pa rnams ni sems byed pas/ /de phyir 'du shes kun sbyangs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mi mthong ngo / /shes rab chung ba thams cad ni/ /phung po'i 'du shes rnams la gnas/ /phung po rnam par ma bsgomasalgepas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi mthong ngo / /dngos med dngos su bshad pa ni/ /bdag gi dngos shes bya ba yin / /chos rnams thams cad shes gyis0)shing / /rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad 35—540

ltos① / /sngon chad phung po'i tshul bzhin du/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang sus mthong ba/ /ma 'ongs pa yi tshul shes pas/ /sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab ltosarin/ /ji ltar snang ba med pa yi/ /mun pa'i nang na gzugs mi snang / /de bzhin chos rnams bshad pa nisti/ /mkhas kyang shes par mi rung ngo / /ji ltar dri ma ldan mig gis/ /gsal ba'i gzugs kyang mi mthong bge/ /de bzhin sems ni ma sbyangs pas/ /sangs rgyas chos ni mi mthong ngo / /ji ltar nyi ma bsgribs med pa / /rab rib can gyi0mi mthong ba/ /de bzhin phug na gnas sems kyis/ /sangs rgyas dag ni mi mthong ngo / /de bas mig ni rnam par sbyongs(pe/ /gzugs kyi 'du shes rnam par bsgomasal/ /chos rnams mthong ba med pa yis/ /'od mdzad rab tu mthong ma7yin/ /ji ltar sngon blos kunasgokyebashad cing / /bdag gis ji ltar thos pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mi bsnyengs 31pa/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu mthong / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yon tan blo gros kyis sangs rgyas kyi5)mthus phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gnas med pa yi chos rnams la/ /gnas ni yongs su brtags pas nardzi/ /de phyir srid pa'i btson skor na/ /byis pa rnams ni rab tu 'khor⑩/ /brjod pas brjod du mi rung chos/ /blo zhan rnams kyis rnam par brtags/ /desatshwa 7ni yongs su bsgribs byas pas/ /bdag gi sems kyang rab rmongs byas3nye/ /shes rab chung la hu)lam nor cing / /bdag gi5nye sems la mi mkhas pa(nya/ /phyin ci log gi blo dag gis/ /mi bzad (rtelus ni 'phelahū bar byed/ /gang gis stong pa ma mthong ba/ /de dag 'khor zhing nyam yang nga / /chos mig bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /mig kyang de la yod 35—541

pa min/ /de bas mig ni sbyang bar gyis/ /bsam pa rnams kyang rnam0)par sems / /gang phyir bdag cag sngon cad du/ /bde gshegs ma mthong chud kyang zos / /yang dag sangs rgyas mthong de 'ang / /gang gi sems la7chags med pa / /des ni sangs rgyas cis0)byung ba'i/ /chos rnams de dag rab tu mthong / /gang gis shes rab che mnga' ba/ /chos su bde gshegs mthong ba co)rnams/ /de dag 'jig rten mig can te/ /gang gisasnyimathong ba mthong zhes bya/ /lhag mthong med par mthong ba ni/ /chos rnams ngan par ⑥mthong ba57ste/ /lhag mthong gis ni mthong gyur na/ /thams cad mthong ba med pa yin/ /kye ma chos kyi mechos nyid ni/ /yang dag sangs rgyas rnams kyis〈pebashad/ /de ni rang bzhin thams cad du/ /shi 3 )ba med cing 'tsho ba med/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ci nyunya'adra ba/ /dpal gyi blos ni sngon bstan te/ /de las bdag gis thos nas kyang ske/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid shes ma gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus blo gros kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rnam par rtog pa spyod pa yi/ /mig ni shin tu 'khrul ba hu yin/ /'khrul par mthong ba log pa ste/ /sangs rgyas la ni log mi mnga' / /gang gis log par shes gyur te/ /yang dag ji bzhin ma nor la/ /yang dag ma yin bden 12shes na/ /sangs rgyas dri med mthong ba yin/ /mthong ba dag gis dri mar 'gyuranya ri/ /rnam par mthong na de med de/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mthong 3gyedang bral/ /de bas rnam par tsogazigs shes bya/ /de ni 'jig rten spyod pa ste/ /'jig rten de yang rnam par brtags/ /'jig rten 'jig pa shes gyur na/ /snang ba dag ni skye bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten rnams kyi 35—542

snang ba ni/ /'jig rten mtshan nyid snang ba ste/ /yang dag ji bzhin bsam 1byas shing / /de ltar mthong bshemathong ba'o/ /de ltar mthong ba panyon mongs med / /dbang du gyur cing zag pa med/ /gang gis tha dad med mthong ba/ /dngos por brtags pa ma yin no/ /rtog dang rnam par rtog pa ni/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams brjodasapa ste/ /de dag yod pa ma yin pas/ /rang bzhin de phyir sbyangs pa yin/ /de dag rang bzhin rnam par dag /nam mkha' ge bzhin du mtshan nyid med/ /de dag la ni ston pa med/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis de ltar ltos6)ske/ /chos rnams la ni mos myed57)de/ /chos kyi 'du shes rnama' bsgoms shing ske/ /shes pa de yang ma bsgoms pa/ /des ni thub 1)chen mthong ba yin/ /ji ltar yon tan blos brjod pa/ /de ltar yang dag sangs rgyas mthong de mthong bas na 'du byed kun/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 31rnam par zhi/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i blo gros kyis sangs rgyas kyi nya byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /kye ma sangs rgyas dpal0 chen rnams/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med do/ /rnam grol thugs ni sdig ༅mi mnga'/ /'jig rten mthar phyin brgal ba'o'i/ /yang dag ji bzhin ma nor bar/ /bskal pa rnams ni tshad med pas/ /ji tshaltar mkhas pas mthong ba bzhin/ /'jig rten sgron mas rab tu gzigs/ /'du byed thams cad skad cig ma/ /so so'i nyu ciskye bo de dag 'gengs/ /nam mkha'i khams ni gzung 3)byas shing / /de dag de phyir khom pa med/ /khom pa med ces bya ba ni/ /ci yang brjod pa 3)med pa ste/ /khom pa med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /khom pa bsam gyis 3 )myi khyab thob/ /gang la dngos po med pa yi/ /35—543

mi zad khom pa med par bshad/ /yod pa'i rang bzhin shes gyur na/ /des ni grags chen mthong ba yin/ /mthong ba med pa mthong zhes bya/ /yod pa med pa'ang yod ces bya/ /mthong ba dag gam yod pa ni①/ /ma bsgoms na⑧ni rnam par bsgomasani/ /ji ltar lta ba sus mthong ba/ /de dag gis ni lta ba bshig /gang lasakyisangs rgyas smos pa yi/ /de dag chos rnams zhig pa med//ji ltar thub pas bstan pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas yongs su sus mthong ba/ /de ni 'jig rten snang bar byed/ /rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad bzhin/ /chos rnams kyi ni snang ba gcig /de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu bstan/ /des ni brtson blo brtan50pa de/ / chos mngashebye ba rab tu ston/ /yod dang med pa shes bya stoste / /gang gis〈nya'adu shes rnam bsgoms pa/ /des ni sangs rgyas mthong ba ste/ /yang dag mtha' la rab tu gnas/ /de nas〈nyebyang chub sems dpa' ye shes blo gros kyis〈nyesangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di thos pas/snang ba bdag 8cag shes par gyur/ /phyogs bcu kun tu snang ba yi/ /yang dag sangs rgyas des kyang mthong / /sems can rang bzhin yod gyur pa/ /de ni sems can g.yang sa stesnyi/ /'di la ci yang yod pa min/ /tshig gi lam rnams bsdus pa'o/ /byis pa 'dzin dang bcas pa7rnams/ /bdag lus yang dag 'dzin pa la/ /sangs rgyas snang bar mi 'gyur te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzung77ba med/ /yang dag sangs rgyas ma mthong zhing / /gang rnams mig yod ma yin pa/ /de dag ni )bskal pa grangs med du/ /srid pa'i gang techen mtsho na 'khor / /nyon mongs can ni 'khor bar bshad/ /nyon mongs med pa mya ngan 35—544

'das/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba yang / /rang bzhin rnyed par mi rung ngo ske/ /'khor zhes bya ba brdasheyin te/ /mya ngan 'das pa brjod pa yin/ /'phags pa'i chos rnams ma skyes pa/ /bla ma dag ni mi shes so/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rgyal ba 'di/ /'di yin 'di 'dra'i 'du shes can/ /de dag sangs rgyas mi mthong ste/ /tshul bzhin ma yin phyin ci log /zhi ba'i rang bzhin ji lta〈mibar / /gang gis zhi ba shes gyur pa/ /des ni tshigashegi lam 'das pa'i/ /yang dag sangs rgyas rab tu mthong / /chos rnams kun gyi spyod pa yinabya/ /rab tu brjod pa bstan pa med/ /'on kyang mnyam pa nyid du ltalta/ /rgyal ba chos rnams kun dang mnyam/ /yang dag sangs rgyas mtha' dbus med/ /thog⑧ma dag dang7tha mar yang / /'gal med rtsa ba med pas na/ / de ni5) sangs rgyas de phyir brjod/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bdenarwa1pa'i blo gros kyis sangs rgyas kyi 6)byin gyi brlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mnyamachapa'i phyir/ /bskal pa bsam gyis myi khyab par/ /sems can dmyal bar gnas kyang bla/ /de ni bde ba bsam mi khyab/ /ci phyir zhe na bskal pa7rnams/ /grangs med sdug bsngal sngan cad tsobyung 6)/ /'on kyang bde gshegs ma thos pas/ /bdag cag 'khor las ma grol lo/ /de bzhin ma nor chos kyi rnams/ /yang dag nyid du rtogs gyur te/ /gang la 'grogs〈nyepa med parwaternams/ /de dag byang chub bla na med/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang mngon sum pa/ / sngon cad5) ma byung 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gang phyir sangs rgyas brjod pa'i chos/ /de dag mtshan nyid med pa 'o/ /chos rnams blta dka'asho teji bzhin du/ /gang zhig de 35—545

ltar rtogs7pa ni/ /de dag sangs rgyas kun gzigs pa/ /yang dag bltakhubs shin tu mthong5kyi/ /yang dag la ni yang dag gzigs/ /yang dag min par yang dag min/ /'di yi mtha' ni stonasapas na/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas zhes kyangasabya/ /khong stso)du ma chud chos bstan te/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams rabashetu brjod/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bsgomasapa ste/ /gcig tu dmigs pa ma yin rnam/ /de ltar mang nyurmedang gcig gnas pa/ /mang po dag tu rnam par shes/ /gnas pa med pa'i chos rnams kyis/ /bstsagasatshwa )pa dag kyang rab tu byas/ /byas pa med cing byed pa med/ /las kyi 'du shes rnam57bsgoms shing / /las 'di citsha/glebazhin shes byas na/rte/ /rnam par〈hedag kyang mi dmigs so/ /gang la sangs rgyas bzhugs pa yi8/ /nges pa'i gnas ni dmigs med pas/ /gnas pa med pa'i chos rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas g.yo7ba gang yang med/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mchog gi hunyeblo gros kyis sangs rgyas kyi0)byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sems can chen po bla na med/ /sems can 'du shes rnam par bsgoms/ /'jug par bya ba gang yang med/ /de bas bla na med ces7bya/ /gang la phra ba yod min pa/ /de la sbom pa'ang yod pa min/ /de ni sangs rgyas〈 ste rnams kyis brnyes(1rka/ /rnam par mi rtogaspoge'adus ma byas/ /gang zhig nyesangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ /de la bgrang ༷ steb yod pa min/ /yang dag sangs rgyas bgrang dang bral / /de ni sangs rgyas chos nyid do/ /mun pa rnams ni rnam bsal5 nyecing / /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang / /de la snang5 stob gang yang med/ /mi snang ba yang ci yang med/ /thams cad chos la kun nas dga'/ /skyes pa med cing 35—546

gnas pa med/ /'dod chags med cing rten 31pa med/ /chos nyid de yang sbed pa med/ / gang la gnyis sushebagrang med cing / /gcig kyang yod pa ma yin pas / /jikhubazhin rab tu gnas pa yi/ /shes rab chen pos sa legs par mthong ske/ /mi gnyis pa la gnyis pa med/ /gnyis pa med pa 2stong pa ste/ /stong pa de yang khams gsum kun/ /de ni sangs rgyas mthong ba'o/ /byis pas byang chub mi shes kyang / /de dag de la rab tu gnas/ /gnas pa med pa'i chos rnams kyis4)/ /rang gi lus ni rjes su blta/ /lus med pa ni 7 lus su bshad / /'byung ba med cing bstan du med/ /'jig tshogs mang po bltar na med pa/ /sangs rgyas sku ni bla na med/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi 9cirang bzhin nyid/ /de skad bden pa'i blos smras te/ /de thos pas ni mig kyang sbyangs/ /shin tu 'od kyang dang zhing snang / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i blo gros kyis sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /drin gzo /nyamed pa'i sems can phyir/ /skyes bu drang srongal mchog gi rnams/ /dpa' chen 32sems can gtso bo dang lha rme/ /'od mdzad77pa ni rab tu byung / /thugs rje chen po bskyed tshamadzad de/ /sems can khams la rnamarwa phogazigs kyang / /srid pas bcings pa'i nyunyesdug bsngal ba'i//sems can rnams ni de nas gzigs/ /'jig rten lha dang bcas pa na/ /yang dag sangs rgyas dpal mnga' ba/ /sems can gtso bo ma gtogs par/ /skyob pa gzhan ni gang yang med/ /gal te sangs rgyas ma skyes la19/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di 'dra dag /med na 'jig rten khams kun na/ /sems can bde ba gcig 4) mi 'byung / /sems can gtso bo 'dren mdzad pa/ /de bzhin 35—547

gshegs pa7)skyes pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' 'di 'dra dag /'byungasab 'jig rten bde ba'i rgyu/ /gang gis de bzhin gshegs mthongakhub/ /de dag 'thob pa legs par 'thobaskyi/ /gang gis thos shing dad 'gyur ba/ /de yang 'jig rten mchod rten no/ /gang gis sangs rgyas mthong gyur pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyis 'thob ④legs thob/ /'di 'dra ba yi tshul thos pasal/ /kun kyang yang dag sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /'das pa'i dus na'ang dpal 'di yod/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyisani/ /shes rab mig ni rnam sbyangs pas/ /spyod yul 'di dag mthong bar 'gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad thub mthongashenas//da dung phyir zhing dad pa skye/ /de yi ye shes mtha' yas pas/ /da dung brjod du yod pa min/ /gang zhigatumachog gi blos smras paX/ /rgyal sras gzhan gyis bshad patshwanyernams/ /de dag da rung7bdag gis kyang / /bskal pa bsam yas bshad par bya/ /tsori rab kyi rtse mor de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i le'u ste/ bcu dgu pa'o// /dzi sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po nyi shu panyusnye/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros de'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyisngo ) byin gyi brlabs kyis(me/ sbyong5nyeb mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge nye'adzin la mnyam par gzhag go/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros kyis / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sbyong5 steb mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba de la mnyam par bzhag ma thag tu/ de'i mod la phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re'i 35—548

'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi0)pha rol nas/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kun kyang chos kyi blo gros zhes bya bar mtshan mthun⑧pa sha stag gisasnyezhal mngon par bstan pa mthong bar gyur te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis53)'di skad ces kyang rjobaka' stsal to④/ /chos kyi blo gros khyod de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sbyong ⑧ba mtha' yas pa la mnyam par gzhig 6nyepa legs so/ /legs so/ /de bas na rigs kyi bu khyod la phyogs bcu nas de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kun kyang mtshan mthun7pa sha staganyegis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sngon gyi smon lam dang / khyod bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa bas nye bar〈rte brten pas7'di lta ste/ chos thams cad bstan par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam par 'phel bar bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings su chud par bya ba dang / sems can gyi khams rnam par bsgom pa dang / chags pa myed pa nyid du chud par bya ba dang / bsgribs pa med pa'i spyod yul thob par bya ba dang / kun nas sbyor ba thob par bya ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su gzung bar bya ba dang / chos thams cad khong du chud par bya ba dang /dbang po thams cad yongs su shes par bya ba dang / chos bstan pa thams cad yongs su gzung ba dang / 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dgod (nyepa bcu la rtsom par bya ba'i phyir byin gyis brlabs pa mdzad kyis( bhe/rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis chos bstan pa 'di la spobs pa bskyedatswacig /de nas sangs rgyas bcom 35—549

ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros la chags pa myed pa nye bar bsgrub hu)pa mdzad do/ /thogs pa myed pa nye bar bsgrub pasnyimadzad do/ /mchod gupa myed pa nye bar bsgrub ④pa mdzad do/ /rmongs pa myed pa phyinye bar bsgrub pa snyamadzad do/ /tha dad pa myed pa nye bar bsgrub pasamamadzad do/ /kha na ma tho ba myed pa nye bar bsgrub pa chosamadzad do/ /dpag tu myed pa nye bar bsgrub pa sgomadzad do/ /zhum pa myed pa nye bar bsgrub patshwa )mdzad do/ /'phrogs hu)pa myed pa nye bar bsgrub pa 512mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid kyi chos nyid thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros kyi spyi bo la phyag g.yas pasarwanyebyug pa mdzad de/ de ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi phyag gisalgereg ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros ting nge 'dzin de las langs te / byang chub sems dpa' de dag la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa'i rigs shes bya ba 'di ni chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa'i/ nam mkha'i mthas logatugs pas shin tu yangs pa ste/ de la gnas pa'i〈nyebyang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi (snyerigs su skye ba yin/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs su skye ba yin/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs su skye ba yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub hu sems dpa' brtson par byed pa gang las ni )bsams te nyu/ de skad du smras pa de dag gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa ste/'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 35wa 550

rnams kyis gsungs pa dang / gsung ba dang / gsung bar 'gyur ba dag go/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems dang po bskyed 37pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa dang / las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa dang / rnal 'byor la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa dang / tsher ②skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa dang ske/ sbyor ba phun sum tshogasalgepa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa dang ske/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa dang ske/ phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa dang /gzhon nur gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa dang / rgyal tshab kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa dang / dbang bskur ra ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa'o0/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 7bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa ste/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs pa dang / gsung ba dang / gsung bar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang zhe na/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mthong nas/ mdzes pa dang bzang ba dang / myig tu 'ong ba dang ske/ kha dog rgyas pa dang / thub par dka' ba dang / mthu che bar mthong ba dang5ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / yongs su bstan pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / rjes su bstan pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa mthong ba 'am/sems can sdug bsngal brtso1)mthong ba 'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 35—551

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos rgya chen po thos par gyur nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du smon cing snga phyi myed par byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ sems bskyed pa dang po des ni thub par dka' ba'i gnas bcu yongs su bzung bar 'gyur te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar gnas dang gnas ma yin pa hu)shes pa dang / las kyi rnam par sbyin pa7shes pa dang /kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba shes pa dang / dbang po dang brtsonas 'grus rnam pa tha dad pa yongs su rdzogs pa mchog dang tha ma shes pa dang /mos pa tha dad pa dang / mos pa du ma shes pa dang / khams tha dad pa dang khams du ma shes pa dang / thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam shes pa dang / bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang /rjes su557bsgribs ⑥pa med pa shes pa dang / chags pa myed pa'i lha'i myig shes pa dang / dus gsum mnyamashepa nyid du zag pa myed pa shes pa'o/ /thub par dka'aspo ba'i gnas bcu po de dag yongs su zin par gyur〈nyete/ de ni sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa de ni sangs rgyas mchod pa la sbyar bar bya tu) ste/ byang chub sems dpa' bsten tuskrepar bde ba tunyeyang de la brjod par bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi nang na gtso bor gyur pa yang de la brjod par bya'o/ /phul du phyin pa yang de la brjod par bya'o/ /zil gyis myi non〈nyepa'i gnas kyang de la brjod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid che ba 'angasade la bstan par bya'ol/ /sangs rgyas tshad med pa dang 'phrad par 'gyur ba yang de la bstan par 35—552

bya'o / /rab tu zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor ba yang de la brjod par bya'o/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo las ldog par 'gyur ba yang de la brjod par bya'o/ /sems can sdug bsngal ba yongs su bskyab7pa yang de la brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la de bas kyang shas cher sems skye ②bar bya ba dang / gnas gang thos kyang de la bdag nyid sbyor bar bya ba dang ske/ bdag nyid gzhan gyi dringashe'ajog par mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir te/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' thog ma nyid du sems can thams cad la rnam pa bcur5gesems nye bar gzhog ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phan pa'i sems nye bar gzhog7go/ /snying brtse ba'i sems dang / bde ba'i sems dang / gnas pa'i sems dang / byams pa'i sems dang / phan 'dogs pa'i sems dang /yongs su bsrung7ba'i sems dang / mnyam pa'i sems dang / slob dpon gyi sems dang / ston pa'i sems nye bar gzhog go/ /rnam pa bcu po de dag gis sems can thams cad la sems nye bar gzhog ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni las dang po ba'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa de ni thog ma nyid du kha ton la yongs su bskul〈pebar bya'o/ /mang du thos nas dben par gnas pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o//rab tu dben par gyur nas dge ba'i bshes su 'gyur bar yongs su bskul bar bya'o / /dge ba'i bshes su gyur nas nga lo bde ba la yongs su bskul bar bya'o//35—553

nga kyi lo bde bar gyur nas dus bshesasrel yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /dus shes nas mi 'jigs pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /mi 'jigs par gyur nas don shes pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /don shes nas chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /chos kyi rjes su 'gro bar gyur nas rmongs pa med pa la yongs su bskula'age)bar bya'o/ /rmongs pa med par gyur nas rnam par dgod pa la yongs su (6)bskul bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/sems can thams cad mel de bas kyang shas cher ④snying rje chen po mngon du gzhog par bya ba dang / gnas gang thos kyang de la bdag nyid sbyor bar bya ba dang ske/ bdag nyid gzhan gyi dring 'jog par myi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir te/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di nimatshelas dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la rnal 'byor la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' dmyigs pa'i rnam pa bcus chos thams cad la brtson par byed de / bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltararwa rachos thams cad hunyami rtag pa dang / chos thams cad 12sdug bsngal ba dang / chos thams cad hunyestong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad bdag myed pa dang / chos thams cadatshwastebyed pa myed pa dang / chos thams cad myong ba myed pa dang / chos thams cad brdatshamaskyed pa dang / chos thams cad gnas skamyed pa dang / chos thams cad tsho/)rnam par rtog pa myed pa dang ske/ chos thams cad nyu riched du byed pa myed pa ste/ dmyigs pa'i rnam pa bcu po de dag gis chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i tshul du brtson par mdzad hunyede/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni rnal 'byor ( )la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /35—554

kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ltar rnal 'byor la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni sems can gyi khams brtaganyepa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /chos kyi khams brtag pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams brtag 2pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /sa'i khams brtag zhusapa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o / /chu'i khams brtag pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /mye'i khams brtag pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /rlung gi khams brtag pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /'dod pa'i khams brtag pa la yongs su bskul bar 5bya'o/ /gzugs kyi khams brtag pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i khams brtaganyepa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 7de bas kyang chos la snang ba 'byung ba dang / gnas gang thos kyang de la bdag nyid sbyor bar bya ba dang / bdag nyid gzhan gyi dring 'jog par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ten /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni rnal 'byor la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la cher skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i gsung ⑨rab la yongs su sbyin pa bcus skyes pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/'di ltar phyir mi ldog pa dang / sangs rgyas la shes pas mos pa'i mthar phyin pa dang ske/ chos nges par rtogs pa dang / sems can rnam par bsgoms 1 tshopa dang /zhing rnam par bsgoms pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par bsgoms pa dang ske/ las7)rnam par bsgoms pa dang / rnam par sbyin pa rnam par bsgoms 12pa dang / 'khor ba rnam par bsgoms pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa rnam par bsgoms tunyepa ste/ yongs su sbyin pa bcu po 'di tsodag gis 'phags pa'i 35—555

gsung rab las ②skyes pa yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni tsher ②skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /de ltar tsherasheskyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos rnam par bsgomasnyipa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnam par bsgomasapa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnamarnyupar bsgomashepa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par bsgrubasnyepa rnam par bsgom 1)pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par bsgrubasngo) par bya ba rnam par bsgom51pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par bsgrubasngo pa rnam par bsgom the pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chosalgeyongs su bsgrub 8pa rnam par bsgom7pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su bsgrub par bya ba rnam par bsgom pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su bsgrub5nyepa rnam par bsgom 37pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas mnyamasnye pa nyid rnam par bsgom 31pa la yongs su bskul bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la de bas kyang sems 'jug par bya ba dang / gnas gang thos kyang de la bdag nyid sbyor ba dang / bdag nyid gzhan gyi dring la 'jog par mi bya ba'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni tsher (nyeskyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ci ( nyertsom yang rung ste/35—556

de thams cad sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir rtsom mo sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir rtsom mo/ /sems can thams cad bde0)bar bya ba'i phyir rtsom mo/ /sems can thams cad la snying brtserwagyiba'i phyir rtsom mo / /sems can thams cad yongs su sbyin par bya ba'i phyir rtsom mo/ /sems can thams cad yongs su dgrol bar bya ba'i phyir rtsomar mo/ /sems can thams cad la gnod pa myed par bya ba'i phyir rtsom mo/ /sems can thams cad drangasaba'i phyir rtsom mo/ /sems can thams cad dang bar bya ba'i phyir com mo/ /sems can thams cad gdul duba'i phyir rtsom mo/ /sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir rtsom mo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste/ sbyor ba spyiphun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la ni semasashecan mtha' yas pa brjod par bya'o / /sems can tshad med pa brjod par bya'o/ /sems can grangs med pa brjodakyipar bya'o/ /sems can bsam gyis myi khyab pa brjod par bya'o/ /sems can gzugs myed pa brjod par bya'o/ /sems can dpag tu myed pa brjod par bya'o/ /sems can stong pa brjod par bya'o/ /sems can byed pa myed pa brjod par bya'o/ /sems can dngos po myed pa brjod par bya'o/ /sems can rang bzhin myed pa brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i sems de bas kyang shas cher mngon par zhen pa la mi gnas par bya ba dang /gnas gang thos kyang de la bdag nyid sbyor bar bya ba dang / bdag nyid gzhan gyi dring myi 'jog par bya ba'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 35—557

dag de la bsam pa phun sum tshogs ①pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang zhe na/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' chos bcu nyan na/ bsam pa nges pa ribarab tu 'thob pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas la snyan pa'am ri/ mi snyan par brjod kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos la bsam pa nges pa yin/ chos la snyan pa'am ④snyi snyan par brjod kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos la bsam pa nges pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' la snyan pa'am myi snyan par brjod kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos la bsam pa nges pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la snyan pa'am myi snyan par brjod kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos la bsam pa nges pa yin / sems can gyi khams chung ba dang / sems can gyi khams che ba brjod kyang sangs rgyas kyi khuchos la bsam pa nges pa yin/ sems can gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / sems can gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa medasrepar brjod kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos la bsam pa nges pa yin/ sems can gyi khams skyo bar sla ba dang /④ sems can gyi khams skyo bar dka' dub brjod kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos la bsam pa nges pa yin/ chos kyi dbyings chung ba'am/chos kyi dbyings che ba rte)brjod kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos la bsam pa nges pa yin/chos kyi dbyings 'grub pa'am/ chos kyi dbyings 'jig hu ripar brjod kyang /sangs rgyas kyi chos la bsam pa nges pa yin/ chos kyi dbyings yod pa'am/chos kyi dbyings med par brjod kyang / sangs rgyas kyi chos la bsamarwa1pa nges pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag hurtede ni byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dag /lhaste/ de ltar bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la chos la 'jug pa tshabacu brjod par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di 35—558

ltar chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa dang / chos thams cad mtshan nyid med pa dang / chos thams cad dngos po med pa dang / chos thams cad yod rpā ma yin pa dang / chos thams cad brdzun hu)pa dang / chos thams cad dben pa dang ske/ ca chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa dang / chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu dang ske/ chos thams cad mi lam lta bu dang / chos thams cad rtog pa med pa brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i bsam pa de bas kyang shas cher mi 'phrogs ②pa la rnam par bsgrub par bya ba dang / gnas gang thos kyang bdag nyid de la sbyor bar bya ba dang / bdag nyid tshagazhan gyi dring rtso)'jog par mi 'gyur bar bya0ba'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de la phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' dmyigs pa bcu nyan pa'i tshe brtan pa tsho6 rab tu 'thob ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas yod ces 'am sangs rgyas myed ce na yang sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir myi ldog go/ /chos yod ce 'am chos rin myed ce na yang sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir myi ldog go/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yod ce 'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa myed ce na yang sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir myi ldog go/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'byung zhe 'am/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la mi 'byung zhe na yang (9)/ sangs rgyas kyi chos las 1 7phyir mi ldog go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'das zhe 'am(nya/ de bzhin gshegs pa ma 'das zhe nyirten yang /sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir myi ldog go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byon ce 'am/35—559

de bzhin gshegs pa7)byon pa ma7yin cesan yang sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir myi ldog go/ /sangs rgyas da ltar byung༄zhe 'am/ sangs rgyas da ltar byung ba ma yin zhe na yang sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog go/ /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zad myi shes so zhe 'am/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zad shes so zhesalgen yang sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir myi ldog go/ /dus gsum mtshan nyid gcig ce 'am dus gsum mtshan nyid tha dad ce na yang sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste/ de ltar phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la ni chos 'byam7klas pa bcu brjod par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste gcig las rnam pa tha dad par 'gyur ba brjod par bya'o/ /mang po las tha mi dad par brjod par bya'o/ /don dang mthun5sepa'i yi ge brjod par bya'o/ /yi ge dang mthun7pa'i don brjod par bya'o / /dngos po (2 yod pa dang mnyam pa nyid du brjod par bya'o/ /dngos po yod pa nyu1med pa dang mnyam pa nyid du brjod par bya'o/ /mtshan ma myed pa mtshan ma dang mnyam pa nyid du brjod par bya'o/ /mtshan mnyematshan mnyeskyed pa dang mnyam pa nyid du brjod par bya'o/ /mtshan nyid myed pa mtshan nyid dang mnyam pa nyid du brjod par bya'o/ /mtshan nyid mtshan nyid med pa dang /mnyam pa minyid du brjod par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ci nas kyang de bas kyang shas cher mkhas pa thams cad la yongs su byang ba tunye'abyung (nyeb dang /gnas gang thos kyang bdag nyid de la sbyor bar bya ba dang / bdag nyid gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog par 'gyur bar〈 mobya ba'i phyir te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag〈nye'adi ni phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dgod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i 35—560
