kyi phung po ji 1tsam yod pa'i bsod nams tshon kyi phung po de la bskal pa tshad med par mnyes par byas pa'i sangs rgyas mchod pa dang / ris rim gro 4)las byung ba'i bsod nams 5kyi phung po kyi snga ma des ni brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /stong gi cha dang / brgya stong gi cha dang / bye ba brgya stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o7ske/ /grangs dang / cha dang / bgrang ba dang / dpe58)dang / rgyur yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dpe 9)snga ma de dag lta yang zhog gi/kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di la 1 skyes bu gnyis pa zhig byung ste31/ de'i sems bskyed pa gcig gis/ skyes bu snga ma de dang 'gro ba phal 'jig rten gyi khams tshadasngortemed par gtogs pa snga tu ma rnams kyis/ bskal pa tshad med par sangs rgyas hustemachod pa dang / rim gror 1snyemangon par 'du byas pa 8de desngo )dag sems bskyed pa gcig gis 1 mngon par 'du byed la/ tshul de lta bur sems bskyed 3)pa re rer mnyes par byed pas/ shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med par gtogs na pa'i sems can rnams dang lhan cig 21pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshad med pa mnyes par byas te52/ gzhung de bzhin du/ thog ma la ji skad du brjod pa de bzhin du gnyis pa la dpag tu med pa gsum pa la grangs med pa/ bzhi pa la bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ lnga pa la mtshungs shunyepa med pa/drug pa la kun tu mtha' yas pa/ bdun pa la mu med pa/ brgyad pa la sa mtshams 2 med pa/ dgu pa la gzhal du med pa'i bar du ste( snye/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dpe snga ma de dag lta zhog gi dzi/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di la skyes bu bcu pa zhig skyes te/ skyes bu snga ma dgu po de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhal du med pa bcur gtogs pa'i sems can phal de dag gis/ bskal pa dpag tu 35—610

med par sangs rgyas mchod pa dang / rim gros 3tshomanyes par byas pa de tsam du sems bskyed pa gcig gis mnyes par byed cing / tshul de ltar sems bskyed pa re rer mnyes par du byed pas/ shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med par gtogs pa'i sems can rnams dang lhan cigs pas/ zhal zas ro7bro ba'i mchog brjod du med pa zhes bya ba nas/ gzhan yang rgya cher te de lta bus sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das brjod du med pa 'amanyes par byas pa nas / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyi ༅phung po la bskal pa brjod du med ④par gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po snga mas brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro zhes bya ba nas/ rgyu'i bar du yang nye bar mi 'gro zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas skyes pa ⑧de tsam nyi tse (9)zhig mchod cing bsnyen bkur nyu chib 'am/sangs rgyas kyi mchod pa'i yo byad de tsam dag gi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems mi skye'i(1/ de ni 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam /tshaklas pa ma lus pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs pa brjod du med pa'i nyugeyang brjod du med pa/ phyogs bcu tshad las 'das pa 'byam tshaklas pa/ phyogs bcu'i rnam blagangs mtha' yas pa'i 8dra bas khyab pa/ mig 'phrul gyi rnam pas mtha' nyu yas pa/ 'jig rten gyi nyu8khams thams cad gzhi mnyam par chud pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus par 'dus pa'i tshul shin tu bstan pa/ 'du shes kyi rnam pa la gnas pa'i phyogs kyi dra ba 35—611

rnam par phye ba la gnas pa thams cad du gtogs pa/ lhag ma med pa7ma lus pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams (5grangs dang tshul shin tu bstan pa dag tu sngon gyi mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal pa grangs med pa'i mtshul shin ④cu bstan par gtogs pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi tshul gyis mngon par thugs su chud pa dag tu/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed ⑤nub par gyur te/yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / gang yang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa7yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / gang yang da ltar byung ba'i dus na da ltar phyogs bcu na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tshom57skyong ba dang / chos ston pa de dag thams cad mchod cing rim gror gebya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skye ste1ri/ sems bskyed pa de skyes ma thag nas / de dang der 'das pa'i grangs su gtogs pa dang hu )/ sngon gyi mur gyur pa ji snyed pa de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis31/ mngon par thugasamanyasu chud pa/de dag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed mya ngan las 'das pa de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba ji lta ba bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yid ches so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ma byon pa de dang de'i dus su gtogs pa〈nyephyi ma'i mtha'i mur bstan pa dpag tu med pa'i comatha' dang / dbus 8med par7shin tu bstan pa dpag tu med pa nyu dag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed 'byung bar 'gyur ba de dag gi /rnyedage ba'i rtsa ba la yang byang chub sems dpa' de yid ches so/ /da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mtha' 35—612

dang dbus ①med par bstan pa/ ma lus par mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba la yang byang chub sems dpa' de yid ches shing yongs su 'dzin par byed yongs su rgyas par byed/ rab tu 'thobashepar byed/ khong du chud par byed/ rab tu regs par byed/ shin tu bsgrubasrepar byed/ rgyud gcig tu gyur par byed/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang mnyam ⑤pa nyid du khong du chud par byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sems bskyed pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gdung rgyun 6)mi 'chad pa'i phyir skye'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad rgyas par dgang pa'i phyir skye'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gtogs 3)pa'i sems can yongs su bsgral ba'i phyir skye'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'du ba dang / 'jig pa yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir skye'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa dang ske/ rnam par byang ba yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir skye'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi srid pa'ugasum yongs su dag pa yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir skye'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang bag la nyal ba dang /bag chags thams cad yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir skye'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi shi 'pho dang / skye ba yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir skye'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi dbang po dang / sbyor ba yongs su shes pa bya ba'i phyir skye'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir skye'o//sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum gyi shes pa yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir skye ste / sems bskyed pa des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dag dang nye 35—613

bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba rnams dang nye bar 'gyur ro/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu nye bar 'gro'o / /ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu nye bar 'gro'o / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa rnams kyi chos kyang 'thob 3)par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma byon pa rnams kyi chos kyang 'thob tsho par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das da ltar byung ba rnams kyi chos kyang 'thob (ri par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa rnams dang mnyam pa nyid du nye bar 'gro'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba rnams dang mnyam pa nyid du nye bar 'gro'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi tshogs rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba rnams kyi ye shes kyi tshogs kyang rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i stobs la thub pa med par 4yang shin tu bstan gepar 'gyur ro/ /'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gi mi bsnyengs 6)pa yongs su dag pa byumo yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa rnams kyi bstan par bya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi rgyan 〈rimanyam pa nyid kyang rjes su thob ༄ḍasmibo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang nyu rim byon pa dang da ltar byung ba rnams kyi bstan par bya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi rgyan 11mnyam pa nyid kyang yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug pa/ chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med 35—614

par shin tu bstan pa'i dus gsum mnyam pa nyid ༅)thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyang rjes dusasu 'thob bo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ltar de ni sangs rgyas su shog shigasad/ces bya ba'i sems bskyed pa des/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nye ba yin/ ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nye ba yin/ 'das pa dang ma byon 4pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi yul rnams dang mnyam pa yin/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang mnyam pa yin no/ /ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang mnyam pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 5yul thams cad dang mnyam pa yin/ gcig tu nges pa'i lus gcig tu gyur pas kyang dus gsum du mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes dang / 'grogs pa yang thob pa skyo ste/ ye shes de dang 'grogs par 'gyur ba'i nasems bskyed pa'i 8'byung ba de skyes ma thag tu phyogs bcu na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang ched du brjod pa mdzad do/ /sems bskyed pa de nyid rten du mdzad de/'dul ba ji bzhin du chos kyang yang dag par stonatho/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang 'dul ba tshad med pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang 3 )rab tu g.yo bar 'gyur/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang snang bas rgyas par 'gyur/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi ngan song yang rgyun chad par 'gyur/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang yongs su dag par 'gyur11/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang 1 sangs rgyas 'byung ba yang nyusnyedag par ston par 'gyur/ sems can thams cad kyang rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ chos kyi chadabyings thams cad la yang 15rab tu 35—615

'jug par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs thams cad kyang yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur / sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyi snang ba thams cad kyang rab tu thob par 'gyur te / dus gsum du gtogs pa las sems bskyed pa der sangs rgyas sam/sangs rgyas kyi chos sam/ byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos sam/ rang sangs rgyas sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos sam/ nyan thos sam nyan thos kyi chos sam/ 'jig rten pa 'am 'jig rten pa'i chos sam/'jig rten las 'das pa 'am/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos sam sems can nam sems can 1 gyi chos kyang rung ste/ ma 'dus pa gang yang med de/thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni ma gtogs riso/ /de ltar na sems bskyed pa der ni chos kyi dbyings thams cad 'dus so/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ de'i tshe phyogs bcur 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rnam pa drug du g.yos par gyur te/ g.yos so rab tu g.yos so/ /kun tu g.yos so/ /'gul to/ /rab tu 'gul to/ /kun tu 'gul to/ /ldeg go rab tu ldeg go/ /kun tu ldeg go/ /chem chem rab tu chem chem/ kun tu chem chem mo/ /'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur ri/ kun tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /shig shig rab tu shig shigs kun tu shig shig go/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi ⑤mthu dang /sems bskyed pa de'i yon tan yang dag par brjod pa'i chos nyid rab tu thob pa'i phyir/ lha rdzas kyi me tog gi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi spos kyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi phye ma'i char yang mngon par bab bone rka/ /lha rdzas kyi phreng 7ba'i char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi gos kyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i char yang mngon par bab 35—616

bo / /lha rdzas kyi rgyan gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi rol mo du1rnams kyang mngon par sgra 'byin par gyur to/ /lha rdzas kyi snang ba yang rab tu byung〈(ngo / /lha rdzas kyi 'od kyang rab tu byungs ngo / /phyogs bcu'i ca'ajig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul ltashin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i pha rol nas / de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi ༅blo gros su mtshan btags pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi (7zhal mngon par bstan te/ gsung brjod pa 6)chos kyi blo gros legs so legs so/ /phyogs bcu na de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdulama'ishin tu phra ba snyed kyi77chos bstan pa de la ched du brjod pa mdzad do/ /nged kyis kyang chos bstan pa 'di nyid shin tu rnam par phye ste/ nged kyis ji ltar shin tu rnam par phye ba de bzhin du sangs rgyas thams cad kyis71kyang shin tu rnam par phye'o/ /'di nyid du yang khyod kyisaspyo chos bstan pa des byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong hurtegi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de dag kyang nged kyis lung bstan te/de dag ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus bskal pa stong phrag brjod du med pa'i mthar thams cad kyang dus gcig tu 'jig rten gyi khams ming tha dad pa dag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan gcig pa sha stag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'di ltar sems rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba sha stag tu 'gyur ro/ /nged kyis chos bstan pa 'di yang ji ltar ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma thos pa rnams kyis thos par bya ba dang / ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir sems can rnams kyis shes shing gling bzhi pa 'di'i ri rab kyi rtse mo la ji ltar sems can rnams 'dul bar gyur pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi 35—617

khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya 1stong tshad med pa grangs med pa/ bsam gyis du mi khyab pa mtshungs pa med pa/ kun tu mtha' yas pa/ dpag tu med pa/ sa mtshams med pa/ brjod du med pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa dag tu yang / sems can rnams 'dul bar 'gyur bar dbya ba'i phyir byin gyis brlab bo/ /thams cad na〈geyang chos bstan pa 'di nyid byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros shes bya ba sha stag /sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyis sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par bstan pa dang / ye shes kyi snang ba shin tu gsal bar 3ribya ba dang / don gyis 'dul 6ba'i snang ba thob pa dang / chos nyid rab tu thob 7ripar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams shin tu dga' bar bya ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi rgyud 8yang dag par bstan par bya ba spudang /sangs rgyas kyi chos mnyam pa nyid du bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings gnyis su med pa la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir rab tu ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros kyis phyogs bcur bltas te/ 'khor thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ nam mkha'i khams rnams 1 la ni rnam par dpyod11/ sems can gyi khams ni yongs su smin par byed/ las dang rnam par smin pa'i khams ni 'gal bar mi 12byed/ nam mkha'i khams ni yongs su dag par byed/ kun nas nyon mongs pa las byung ba ni rab tu sel/ mos pa yangs pa las byung ba ni shin tu 'phel bar byed/ sems can gyi dbang po tha dad pa la ni tsho/lharab tu 'jug dus gsum ni mnyam par byed/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la ni yang dag par rtog cing / rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i byustobs yongs su dag par 35—618

bya ba la gzhol ba'i phyir/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus tshigs su bcad 1pa 'di dag smras so/ /gang zhig phyogs rnams bcu po ma lus rgyas byas shing / /sems can zhing dang chos gsum dag kyang rtogs bgyur pa/ /sangs rgyas mtsho rimachog byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin te/ /de dag 'jig rten phan phyir sems kyi dam pa bskyedage/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas pa'i chos dbyings ji bzhin dang ske/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas chos rnams 'gro kun rjes song dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad kun tu khyab brnyes 5ji bzhin gyisakyi/ /'gro ba myi ldog don du phan par rab tu zhugs/ /'jig rten rnams la byams pas rtag par rab gnas shing ske/ /'tshe 3)ba med par spu'agro la phan phyir su zhugs te/ /snang ba mi zad 'od byed gnas su gyur pa 9)rnams/ /bsam gyis mi khyab stobs bcu mnga' bas byin gyis brlabs/ /de ni zhing rnams tha dad ma yin tshul yang rnyed 1 ri/ /de ni lus kyi rnam pa kun la rab tu zhugs/ /bsod nams 11ye shes de yang nya sangs rgyas byang chub bzhin/ /'di nyunyeni chags med gzhol ba ye shes rgyur skyes so/ /spyi'u tshugs rgyu ba'i 'gro ba sna tshogs ma lus par/ /gzhan yang zhing rnams 'byam 0klas chags 8skyed mthar thug 7pa/ /de dag phra 1 mosgom rgya che yangs pa thams cad du/ /byang chub sems mchog de ni gcig pu kun tu 'gro/ /brjod du med pa shin tu phra zhing myi gnas pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa 18mchog la rtag zhugs shing / /mkhas pa gang gis sangs rgyas chos mthong myi ngoms pa/ /de dag chos rnams rgya mtsho'i rnam par chud pa yin/ /'jig rten lam rgyud kun la su zhig snying brtse 17zhing / /'jig rten gsum po sbyang bar rtag tu zhugs pa 2 )rnams/ /phyi ma'i 21mthar thug sangs rgyas gdung gi rgyun mi gcod//35—619

de ni bdud kyi khyim yang rab tu bcom ༅pa yin/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams dang rgyud gcig dngos gyur cing / /shin tu phra ba'i tshul gyis lam la rtag brtson te / /su zhig sangs rgyas yul la dad sems pari kyi/ /de ni chags med thub pa kun gyis dbang yang bskur/ /rdo rje lta bur sra zhing brtan⑧la mi shigs pa/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo'i sa)mdzad pa rtag tu dran shes shing / /'dren pa'i spyod yul snang rab shin tu rnyed pa 5rnams/ /gzhan gyi dring la myi rgyug byang chub sems kyang skye46/ /'gro ba rnams kyi 'du shes rnam par57)mang shes shing / /de bzhin las dang 'bras bu sems kyi rnams kyang ste/ /gzhan yang dbang po'i mthu dang khams rnams du ma dag /kun kyang byang chub sems dpa' ⑧spyod yul gcig yin no/ /gang zhig chos kyi dbyings bzhin byang chub sems yangs shing / /rtag tu chos la mi gnas nam mkha' ji bzhin pa/ /chags med sems ldan de dag sangs rgyas ye shes zhugs/ /de dag rtogs1)med chos can yang dag mtha' la gnas/ /sems can bsam pa rnams nyu )'byed sems can 'du shes med/ /chos kyi rnam rtog khrag khrig pha mthar rab tu phyin/ /de dag rtog la mos shing rnam par myi rtog ste/ /de dag zhing rnams bye ba khrag khrig rjes su zhugs/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rjes sems shing / /gang zhig chos dbyings tshul gyi mdzod du zhugs gyur la/ /gang zhig sems can dbang po'i rnam par hu7mthar phyin pa/ /de dag sems can gtso bzhin chos nyid shesal pa yin/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa dge dang rtag par mngon ldan zhing / /skyes bu tu)seng ge'i bsnyen bkur phyir ldogs myi 'gyur la/ /'jig rten gtso botsomakhas pa mthong bas mi ngoms pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas khrag khrig bye bas byin gyis brlabs/ /zab 35—620

mo'i chos rnams rnam par 'byed kyang chags pa med/ /gnas pa med pas sems kyi dam pa rtag tu dag /de dag bskal pa mtha' yas skyes bu'i seng ge rnams17//dus gsum chags pa med par gtogs ②pa'i yid dang ldan/ /myi 'phrogs rigathub par mi nus7yid kyi dbang po dang phye/ /gsum pa rjes su song dang rtag tu ldan gyur cing / /chos rnams 'byam stso)klas shin tu bslabs pas rmongs med pa//de dag chos dbyings 'gengs kyang nam yang mi ngomasapo)so/ /tshig gi lam 'das ji bzhin mkhas pa zhi ba shes/ /de bzhin nyid la nam yang rnam par myi 'byed pa / /de dag sangs rgyas thams cad yul la rjes sems shing / /dus gsum chags pa med par () rtogs pa'i yid ldan 'gyur/ /mkhas pa gang zhig sems bskyed 'byamatshwanyeklas chos kyi dbyings/ /'gengs shing phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro ba ni/ /de dag khrag khrig tshul rnams brjod du med pa yi/ /snang ba rnyed〈nyepar gnas pa'i rgyal ba'i sras yin no/ /chos rab mu stegs snying rje'i tshul gyirwa)rjes song zhing / /byams pa'i pha rol phyin pa bar snang ji bzhin te/ /sems can khams la nam yang ciyongs su rtog 8med pa/ /de dag rnam rtog med la brtson zhing 'jig rten spyod/ /phyogs bcu dag tu bden pas 'gro ba yid 'bebs par/ /dong7pas sems can gtso bo de dag kun tu rgyu/ /bden pa'i tshig brtsonasngo mortag tu nges pa'i sems ldan pa/ /de dag phyogs bcu'i myi yi mchog gis byin gyis brlabs/ /'das par gyur pa'i dus kyang de dag rjes su dranam/ /de bzhin ma 'ongs dus la 'jug pa rnam par sgom1snye/ /de dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun na myi gnas te/ /sems can phan dang sgrol 37phyir kun tu rnam par rgyu/ /ye shes 'od mchog dam pas chags pa med gyur la ri/ /rgyu yi 35—621

rnam pa chos rab nem nur med brtan rnams/ /de dag the tsom 37thams cad rnam par ldog napa byed/ /chos kyi dbyings 'dir nem nur med par rab tu 'jug /gang zhig bdud rnams kun gyi gnas rnams 'joms dzebyed dang / /gang yang sems can rab rib shin tu sel byed dang / /gang rnams rtog 3)pa 'jig cing rnam pa rtog mi 'grogs pa/ /sems can gtso bo de dag yul la the tsom 6med/ /dus gsum ma lus the tsom 7rnam par ldog nibyas shing / /bsam pa'i mchog gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung 'gro ste/ /dad pa'i stobs dang ldan zhing blo brtan rnyed pa 9rnams/ /de dag don rtogs khong du chud cing blo yang dag /mkhas pa 'gro ba'i don du phyi ma'i mthar spro ste3 )/ /sems can don du rnam thar 'byam 11glas yongs su tshol1 / /yun ring dus su skyo ba med cing zhum pa med/ /sems can dmyal ba sdug bsngal mang po bzlog sna par byed/ /de dag bsod nams 1 mi zad ye shes ldan/ /'gro ba'i dbang po sna tshogs bsam la rab tu 'jug /skye dgu'i las kyi rgyud kyang shin tu shes byas shing / /bsam pa ji bzhin tshul 'di'i 15chos rnams mtha' yas brjod/ /'gro la byams pa'i sems 7rnams kun dang rjes su ldan/ /bdag med nyid rtogs 'on kyang btang snyom sa byed pa sna min/ /de dag snying brtse gcig tu gsal bar chos kyang brjod/ /'on kyang dmyigs par mi gnas de dag 'jig rten rgyu/ /de dag 'od zer dra ba sna tshogs mdog bkye zhing / /'gro ba'i mun pa bsal nyu8te kun tu snang byas nas//'od zer sgo yi pad mo dag la rgyal sras rnams/ /kun tu bstan te rdul dang bral ba'i chos kyang ston/ /spu gcig rtse la zhing rnams rgyal bas brgyan pa dang / /de bzhin rgyal ba'i sras kyis brgyan 19pa mngon par mthong / /'khor rnams blo 35wa 622

sems gzhan dang gzhan can dpo07med pa/ /'gro ba de dag sems shes rmongs med ston pa byed/ /sems 'jug gcig gis phyogs rnams bcu po thams cad kyi / /brjod du med pa khrag khrig zhing rnams kun bgrod cing / /song ste sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i don du mchod byas nas/ /dri 3rib khrag khrig don dang ldan pa sna tshogs 'dri/ /bder5snyugashegs rnams la pha yisage'adu shes nyer rabazhag cing / /chos kyi gter mkhas rtag tu shes rab rnon po can/ /ye shes 'byung gnas mkhas pas sangs rgyas chags med phyir/ /'gro ba'i don 'dod byang chub mchog gi spyod pa sgrubaskye/ /gang rnams chos dbyings rnam par phye zhing bsam byas kyang / /bskal pa mang po 'das byas zad par ma gyur te/ /chos nyid gnas med gang la'ang chud par ma gyur kyang / /chags med ye shes can rnams skyo sems med par spyod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rigs su rigs dang ldan 'gyur zhing / /bder57gshegs kun gyi sku las yang dag byung gyur pas/ /chos kyi lus can de dag 'gro la gzugs lus ston(2)/ /sgyu 49)mkhan mkhas pa yid 'ong sgyu ma ston pa bzhin / /mkhas pa de dag la lar spyod pa mchog brnyes 7snang / /la lar mkhas pa skye zhing mya ngan 'das par snang / /byang chub dam pa'i mchog kyang rnam par 'tshang rgya snang3rto/ /mya ngan 'da' ba 12ston pa'ang de bzhin la lar snang / /rang rgyal rnams dang nyan thos rgyal ba'i sa min pa'i/ /chos nyid de la ji ltar rab tu gnas pa ltos/ /lus nyusnyedang sgra med bsam med 'du shes ldan pa min/ /'on kyang bya ba sna tshogs du ma nye bar ston / /'gro bar chos rnams rnam par 'byed cing skyer 'gyur temi/ /'jig rten gtso bo 7mi bzhugs phyi na rgyal sras rnams / /chags med mthar phyin pa yi ye shes mi gnas lha te/ /sangs rgyas 35—623

byin rlabs rnam par 'phrul pa dag kyang ston)1/ /'jig rten 'di na de dag 'dra ba gang yang med/ /de dag bas kyang 'phags pasadza lta go cilogezhig smos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yangs pa ma thob par/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i thabs su rnam 'phrul mchog kyang thob/ /gang rnams chos rab 'phags par rtag tu 'jug byed pa/ /de dag chos rab dam pa gi mchog gi theg pa yin/ /'jig rten dus dang dus min tshod kyang shes byas shing / /de dag 'gro la phan phyir rnam par 'phrul pa ston no/ /dpa' bo gang rnams zhing kun dgapo /gi lus 'gengs shing ske/ /gang rnams 'jig rten 'od zer dra ba mchog gtong ba/ /mun pa bstsal ④cing snang bas 'jig rten rgyas par byed/ /klu yi dbang po bzhin du chos kyi char pa 'bebs/ /rmi 8)lam lta bu log pa'i sgyu ma 'dra ba yi/ /'du byed rab tu shes nas lam 1 rnams sbyor 'jug cing / /'gro ba thams cad snying rje chen pos khyab byas nas/ /rang bzhin dag pasarwanyathar lam bya ba med pararwarnyeston / /gang rnams rgyal ba'i stobs rnams ji bzhin tshad med dang / /gang rnams mkha' ltar 'gro ba kun tu mtha' yas shing / /gang rnams sems can khams kun 1 yongs su dgrol brtson pa/ /de dag bskal pa bye bar gegangs med spyad pa spyod/ /las 15mchog bla na med pa shin tu sbyangs pa 8yis/ /yon tan dam pa sna tshogs rnams kyang kun sems shing / /byang chub sems dpa' de dag spyod pa mchog myi gtong / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'byung ba rnam par lta / /sems 'byung gcig gis 'jig rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /'byam02klas kun tu rgyu zhing 'gro ba rab tu snang / /rtog dang rnam rtog myi byed dag pa'i sems dang ldan/ /de dag gcig min lus la lus gcig ston pa byed/ /de 35—624

dag 'jig rten kun la rtog 67par mi byed de/ /mgon po kun gyi chos nyid yongs su mi rtog go/ /de dag chos kun rnam (mi'abyed 'dod chags bral gyur pa(mi / /'gro ba thar par bya ba yongs su mi gtong57ngo / /'jig rten kun gyi 'du shes rnam pa gang yod pa/ /bzang ngan 'bring dang de bzhin chung dang sna tshogs kyirjo/ /'du shes thibs po dag dang rab rgal56)rnam phye ste/ /de dag byin rlabs rnam par 'phrul pa shin tu ston/ /ji ltar sgyu ma rnam pa sna tshogs tshad med pa / /de 'dra'i rnam par 'phrul pas chos dbyings 'di dag 'gengs/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha'0)klas lus kyi bye brag gis/ /'gro ba rnams kyi mos pa ji bzhin ston pa dubyed/ /de dag gang la'ang7)ma chags rtog 1 rmedang rnam rtog med / /dog51pa med cing nyon mongs de bzhin rlom sems med/ /de dag sangs rgyas chags pa'i blo med thar la min/ /'gro ba kun la'ang bde ba'i 'du shes rab tu skyed()/ /'jig rten kun na shes la mkhas rab mi 'jigs pa/ /'jig rten 'du shes gnas la 'jug par myi byed de/ /de dag chos kun 'di la 'du shes gang zhes rtog /de ltar gzhig (lhan dus gsum gang yang dmyigs pa 1 rmemyed / /sngon gyi mthar thug sipa yi dus la rab zhugs ste7/ /phyi ma'i mthar thug ma 'ongs pa la rab zhugs nas/ /zhing rnams kun na ci yod kun kyang de bzhin dul/ /shin tu shes kyang rtag par gang yang myi dmyigs so/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i dbyings la 'ang brtson par de bzhin gnas/ /nyon mongs med pa'i tshul gyis 1 rjes song mi gnas te /snye/ /de dag yang dag mtha' 'dra de la 'dra ba med/ /byang chub spyod pa las kyang dpa' bo myi ldog nyu7go/ /gang rnams byang chub brtan pa༄ )ri rab bzhin gnas shing / /sangs rgyas rgyal sras mkhas pas chos dbyings 35wa 625

thams cad dang / /'gro ba kun tu shin tu 1gang byas pa/ /'di ni dpa' bo7rnams kyi spyod pa'i mchog yin no/ /blo mchog dam pa gang zhig thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /rnam grol mdzes pa'i tshul mchog yangs pa 'dod pa ni/ /des ni gang las 5zag zad srid gsum bde 'byung ba'i/ /byang chub sems la rim pa med par 'jug par gyis/ /gang gis 4bsam pa rdul bral byang chub sems gnas pa/ /de dag yon tan legs pa zad par brjod mi5snyenas/ /'on kyang 'gro ba'i don du bde gshegs legs brjod phyir/ /yon tan ldan pa de yi spyod pa mchog kyang nyon/ /gang gis zhing rnams bye ba khrag khrig rdul byas tesku/ /phyogs rnams re re kun tu bkang ste bgrang byas shing / /de yi rjes su dpag pas rnam 'dren zad byed na/ /'du shes rnams ni mthar thug 7)zad par mi 'gyur rol/ /gang zhig sems can grangs mkhas sems can 'du shes med/ /spyod pa tsam nadu gzhol zhing sgra la ma chags dang 9/ /gang zhig 'jig rten khams 'byed chags pa med pa'i sems/ /de dag ldang dang grangs mkhas grangs dmigs med pa yin/ /yid kyis nam mkha'i dbyings ni mtha' yas rgya che dang / /dus rnams 'jig rten kun tu rtogs pa'i mkhas pa gang / /spar mos thal gtor bzhin du the tshom rnam 1 gtor ba/ /de dag sangs rgyas chos rtogs yid can chags pa med/ /gang dag phyogs rnams mtha' yas zhing la rab 'jug cing / /sems bskyed gcig gis blo nyams med par 'dod byed pa/ /de dag tha dad grangs la rtogs 11pas der zhugs te/ /skyo sna ba med pa'i chos la yang dag mtha' ltar mkhas/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig bsam yas pa'i/ /'khor du nye bar phyin te zham 1 ring 'khor gnas shing / /gtso bo dag la 'dri 35—626

ba'i thog mar gang 'gro ba/ /spyod yul mchog can de yi smon lam mchog 'di yinam/ /gang zhig phyogs rnams kun gyi mgon po kun dran 17zhing / /chos nyid de la nam yang gnas par ma gyur pa/ /khams gsum dge ba gang yod kun gyi rgyu yin te/ /de dag zhing rnams thams cad yongs su dag par spyod/ /gang rnams skye ba'i rgyud du srid gsum sna tshogs rnams/ /'jig rten kun na yod la ma chags mig gyur pa/ /de dag bag chags mkhas shing de bzhin dbang po mkhas / /mos pa bye ba khrag khrig bsam yas de bzhin mkhas/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa ji bzhin gang gis shes gyur cing / /shes rab chen po de dag de bzhin chos ston pa/ /de dag kun nas nyon mongs rnamatshunanodag tshul la mkhas/ /sems mngasarnam par sbyong ba'i lam ldan ston/ /gang zhig ting 'dzin bye ba khrag khrig brjod yasamazi)rnams/ /sems kyi rgyu ba gcig gidza rjes su zhugs gyur pa/ /de dag mtshan ma sna tshogs gnas pas3)rab tu shes/ /ldang ba'i rgyu la mkhas shing blo gros spyod yul shes/ /chags myed byang chub de la mngon du gang zhugs 7shing / /'gro la phan pa'i don du blo yangs〈su zhugs pa/ /ye shes 'byam 9)klas 'di 1 tshodang de dag ldan pa yin/ /de phyir de dag skyes bu mchog gi gsung yang sgrog /gang zhig bskal 31pa ring dang bskal pa thung mkhas shing / /nyin zhag mkhas shing de bzhin zla ba zla phyedamunamakhas/ /gang yang 'jig rten rtag tu skye ba mkhas gyur pa/ /zhing gi rnam pa mkhas shing rnam phye'i chos med pa'o/ /gang rnams phyogs la zhugs te pho phyogs kyi rjes 'brang zhing / /phyogs kun tshad ni rjes su shes par ma gyur paci/ /de dag dbus tsoms phyogs kyi rjes su 'gro byed cing / /zhing rnams sbyong yang yongs su dag rtogs chags pa med/ /stobs la 'jug pas 35—627

rgyal ba rnams kyi stobs shes panyu1/ /'gro ba rnams kyi gnas dang gnas min bsam byas nas(5)/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar byung ba'i las kyi sa/ /yang dag rtogs byas las kyi rnam par smin la gnas/ /'jig rten kun mkhas sna tshogs tha dad ji chabazhin du/ /srid gsum rnam par rgyu ba'i tshul yang ci7bzhin dang ske/ /dbang po rnonas po 'bring dang dbang po tha mar yang / /'gro ba ma lus kun gyi dbang po rnam par 'byed/ /mos pa rnam pa sna tshogs dge dang mi dge dang ske/ /bzang ngan de bzhin 'bring la rnam par sems byed cing / /'gro ba kun na gye 'gro ba brtan pa rnam par 'byed(sheste/ /srid gsum rgyu yi rgyud kyangasnyirab tu shes/ /bsam gtan rnam thar nyon mongs ji bzhin mtshan mthong zhing7/ /nyon mongs mtshams sbyor rnam byang ci / 'gyur dang / /sngon chad gnas kyi bde dang sdug nyu1bsngal rgyud rnams kyang / /brtanatshwa pa rnams ni sangs rgyas stobs rnams sbyong bar shārnyibyed/ /ji ltar 'gro ba'i lam rgyud nyon mongs las 'jug dang ske/ /'gro mirgyud thams cad 'jig cing zhig 8'gyur thams cad dang / /zag pa sna tshogs rnams kyang ji ltar skyes tsha'agyur ba/ /bag chags mtshams sbyor ci 1 bzhin de bzhin rab tu 'jug /ji ltar 'jig rten nyon mongs zad cing dag gyur pa/she/ /de la skyes bu khyu mchog spyod pa'i blo dang ldan/ /stobs 'chang dag ni stobs bcu rnams kyi 'od snang ste/ /rgyal ba'i stobs kyang thob min the tsom /9yod pa min/ /spu rtse gcig la gang rnams rnam par sems byed cing / /la la nyon mongs la la dog 2 dang yangs pa yi/ /sna tshogs zhing rnams tshad las 'das pa kun mthong nas/ /las dang bya ba sna tshogs rgyud du rab tu shes/ /gang rnams rdul gcig rtse la rnam sa sems brjod med pa'i/ /zhing dang bde 35wa 628

gshegs sras rnams sems can gtso mthong yang / /zhing rnams 'khrugs shing 'dres pa'i nyes pa gang med panyu/ /gcig nasashe'ajug pas rnal 'byor ldan pa kun 'jug las/ /spu gcig rtse la phyogs bcu thams cad rnam phye'i ste/ /nam mkha'i dbyings thug ⑤'jig rten khams rnams kun zhugs shing / /phyogs 'ga'4)tsam yang rgyal bas stong par mthong ba med/ /de bzhin zhing dang 'jig rten 'byam7klas de dag sbyong / /nide ltar brtan0)pas rgyal bas stong min zhing shes nas/ /'jig rten kun kyang spu rtse gcig la yod par 'jug /dus gsum rgyud rnams mtshan nyid tha dad khams kun dang / /nyin zhag dus dang zla phyed rgyud kyi rnam thar 'jug /de ltar rgyal sras 'jigs med byang chub sems dpa' rnams / /skyes bu khyu mchog ye shes rgyal sridarka3 /thob zhugs pa/ /de dag 'di 'dra shes nas rjes su sems byed cing / /bde gshegs rnams la dga' ba mtha' yas yangs pa 'thob/ /gang rnams bye ba khrag khrig sna tshogs lus sgyur 1 1 cing ske/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad mngon par mchod pa'i phyir/ /rnam 'phrul dam pa bzang (rtepo kun tu ston byed pa/ /de dag mgon 9/stepo rnams kyi spyod yul rab latswazhugs/ /gang rnams sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig drung bslabs shing7/ /gang rnams chos kyi mdzod rtogs yid la ngoms med de/ /gang dag mgon po khyu mchog rnams la dga' sems pa/ /de dag chos kyi sprin yin spyod pa mang la spyod/ /ye shes 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i chos kyi gnas mkhas pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas 'byung gnas ting 'dzin thob pa yin/ /ri rgyal lta bu de dag 3)dad pa'i 'byung gnas rten/ /ye shes 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i yon tan 'byung gnas so/ /gnas pa med pa dam pa shin tu yangs pa dang / /thams cad 35—629

mkhyen la mngon gyur mya ngan med pa dang / /sems can skyob0)cing nyon mongs rnyog pa med zhugs pa'i/ /byams pa'i bsam pas 'gro ba kun kyangaku'agengasani/ /de dag snying rje'i blo yang shin tu yangs pa 45yin/ /bdag la cir sems de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la/ /gzhan du nam mkha' phyi lta bur mtshan nyid med par 'jug /nyams par 'gyur ba'i (6sems can rnams mthong phyir zhing rtsom rim/ /byang chub sems la mkhas pa dag gi tshad dag ni/ /bskal pa bye ba'i mthas kyang brjod par mi nus te / /ci phyir zhe na de las sangs rgyas thams cad byung 9/ /dbang bdes rim gror 1 byas dang rang rgyal kun kyang 'byung / /phyogs bcu'i 11zhing rnams grangs med bcur ni bgrang0 gyur pa'i/ /sems can thams cad bskal pa gcig tu bdar bkod 12cing / /bslab pa bcu dang dge bcu bsam gtan 'thob 1 pa dang / /tshangs pa dag dang rnam grol zhi ba'i gnas bkod cing / /de dag bskal pa bye bar bde bar rab bkod de/ /dgra bcom nyon mongs zhi la rab tu dgod 'byas kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'im tshedage ba'i tshogs kyi char myi rung / /byang chub sems dpa' zhugs nya ma thag tu tshogs chen stsogs1 / /nyon mongs med cing shin tu phra lam rtogs pa yin37/ /rang rgyal sems can bye ba khrag khrig bkod gyur kyang / /bsod namasar chibasags pa des ni sa byang chub sems rab la/ /grangs dang cha dang bgrang ba'i rdu rnam par nyer myi 2 'gro/ /zhing gi rdul ni tshad kyis shes par rung yang srid/ /skad cig sems kyis zhing mang yongs su 'das byas shing / /de ltar bskal pa brjod yas zad par 'gro byas na/ /zhing mtha' thug par rung srid byang chub sems mchog min/ /mtha' rnams kun tu bskal pa mang po'i mtha' med de/ /sngon 35wa 630

gyi mtha'0)gyur bskal pa de bzhin ma 'ongs dang / /da ltar byung ba'i bskal napa zad dang thub0)med pa'i/ /bskal pa de dag zad sridam /byang chub sems ma yin / /ci phyir zhe na 'di ltar phyogs rnams kun bkang shing / /rtog 5dang rnam rtog yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir/ /skad cig gcig gis dus gsum rtogs pararsā)bya don tu/ /'gro ba'i don du 'dod cing sems mchog rin chen skye / /phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams stong mang kun tu mtha' yas pa'i/ /'gro ba rnams kyi mos pa bsam pa ci 'dra dang / /sbyor ba gang dang sems dang spyod 7pa de bzhin te/ /mthar thug rung srid mkha' 'dra'ims)byang chub sems mtha' min//de ni 'di ltar phyogs bcu byams dang snying rje dang / /bsam pa chen pos 'gro ba thams cad rgyas byas shing / /thar pa'i don du sangs rgyas yon tan kun spyod smyophyir / /rin chen sems kyi stobs ni tshad med0 sna rab tu skyes/ /mos dang 31bsam pa yid bzhin yang dag sbyor ba dang / /'gro ba'i dbang po sbyor bar sems /rtedang spyod pa 3nyernams/ /skad cig mugacig gis ji bzhin rtogs par bya ba'i 7phyir/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes lta bu'i sems skyes so/ /'gro ba'i tshalas dang nyon mongs sna tshogs 'byam 1 klas pa/ /gang gis khams gsum 'di dag tu ni skye /nye'agyur ba/ /de dag mtha' ni phyogs bcur rnyed 16par rung srid kyi( mee/ /byang chub sems kyi mchog la kun tu mtha' med do/ /ci phyir zhe na 'di ltar nyon mongs las grol 3stoba'i/ /sems ni de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa'i don du skye/ /nyon mongs grol byed 32de bzhin las kyi rgyud kyang gcod trī/ /dus gsum mun pa sel cing mi zad snying rjes byung / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas tshom lus thams cad dang / /sems can mang po thams cad sems gcig bskyed 35—631

pa yis/ /spos dang me tog phreng 11ba byug pa dam pa dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bza' btung na bzas rimachod par byed/ /gzhan yang gdanakhugyi rnam pa 'chag sa 4dam pa dang / /pho brang mang po sna tshogs tsan dan mchog bsangs zhunipa / /nor bu rin chen rnam par snang bas brgyan pa dang / /yid bzhin nor bu yid 'ong brgyan pas mchod byas te6 / /de ltar bde gshegs sems can mngon par mchod byed pas/ /bskal pa khrag khrig brjod du med param༅zad byas kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bde bstsags namathar phyin bde ba nyid/ /gang bsgrubasalo)byang chub sems la mnyam par nyer mi 'gro/ / /ji snyed dper brjod byas pa 'di dag thams cad kyang / /yang dag skyes pa'i byang chub sems kyi char mi rung ske/ /de yang 'di ltar dus gsum bzhugs pa'i skyes bumanyamachog /thams cad byang chub sems mchog de las byung ba yin/ /byang chub sems ni chags pa med pa'i mthar phyin te/ /thams cad tshad 1)la gnas kyang de la tshad yod min//thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gzhol zhing lha/tshad med stobs/ /sems can rang bzhin de bzhin byang chub mthar yang phyin/ /byang chub sems ni tshanam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa ste/ /chos rnams kun la khyab pa mchos dbyings ci4bzhin no / /tshad med de bzhin nyid kun de'i spyod yul gyur/ /des ni kun tu khyab pa'i nyu sems can gtso bzhin no18/ /de ni 'byam 3)klas chos rnams kun la rjes su zhugs/ /des ni zhing rnams ma lus ( ) 'byam klas 7kun tu khyab/ /des ni shes pa 'byam sa klas thams cad rtogs par chud/ /des ni sangs rgyas 'byam shusnyeklas kun dang 'gal med thob/ /rtag tu bsod nams bla na med pa dag dang ldan / /de bzhin rtag tu tshul khrims rnam ri dag mi gnas ldan/ /rtag tu kun 35wa 632

gtong 1)rtag par rab tu dge ba ste/ /ldog pa med pa'i brtson 'grus mchog dang rab tu ldan/ /bsam gtan mdzod la rtag par bsam gtan 'jug par nabyed / /shes rab shin tu yangs ③pa dang yang rtag tu ldan/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi sa rab dam pa gang yod pa/ /de dag don du ye shes kun tu bzang po byung / /'gro ba kun na skyes bu ye shes rigegang bzhugs pa/ /de dag gis ni byang chub semasalterab byin gyis brlabasayi/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi dam pas (7rab tu brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam 'phrul rnam pas rab tu 3brgyan/ /'jig rten kun 6)dang 'gro ba rnams kyi ji tsam tshad/ /nam mkha'i tshad kyang phyogs bcu dag tu ji tsam pa/ /de dag bas kyang byang chub sems 'di tshad med de/ /de las skyes bu'i seng ge kun kyang skyes shing byung / /byang chub sems 'di stobs bcu rnams kyi rtsa ba ste/ /brten pa bzhi yi gnas yin so sor shes pa'i sate/ /rgyal ba'i chos rnams brtswasngortebargyad yang dag 'byin pa ste/ /skyes bu'ishegatso bos mkhyen par bya ba'i chos kun 'byin/ /gzugs kyi sku ni mtshan rab rnams kyis bstsags khapa dang / /chos sku mnyam 8nyid rtog pa myi mnga' brnyes pa dang / /'gro bas mchod pa'i ye shes chags med gang byung ba/ /kun gyi rtsa ba 8'byung gnas byang chub sems 'di yin/ /rang rgyal theg pa 'byung zhing nyan thos theg pa'ang 'byung / /bsam gtan ting 'dzin bde ba gzugs kyi khams rnams dang / /gzugs med khams rnams 1 7ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba dag /kun gyi rtsa ba hunyebyang chub sems mchog 'di yin no/ /mi dang de bzhin lha yi dbang po'i hunabade ba dang / /lam rgyud sna tshogs kun kyang 'di la shin tu sbyangs / /brtson 'grus stobs dang dbang po'i bde ba gang yod pa/ /kun gyi 35—633

rtsa ba dang po byang chub sems 'di yin/ /ci phyir zhe na 'di ltar byang chub sems bskyed cing / /pha rol phyin drug brtson par spyad 1pa rab tu spyod/ /sems can rnams la'ang spyod pa yang dag rab tu ston/ /des ni khams gsum 'gro ba'i bde ba kun kyang 'byung / /sangs rgyas chags med thugs chud don dam mkhyen pa narnams/ /chos kyi dam pa'i samachog rnams yang dag kun ston cing / /rgya chen nyon mongs las las sems can grol ri mdzad de/ /mya ngan 'das pa dam pa mchog la dgod mdzad pa/ /ye shes 'od zer 'od yangs5genyi ma lta bu ste / /'gro bar spyod pa dkar pos yongs rgyas zla ba bzhin/ /yon tan shin tu bsags pa tshad med chu lta bu/ /dri med chags pa mi mnga' tshad med mkha' dbyings 'dra/ /gang zhig yon tan mtha' yas byang chub sems yangs pa/ /shin tu che zhing 6bde skyid 7tshad med smon byed cing / /phyi ma'i mthar thug spyod par smon pas su brtson pa/ /de dag sems can gdul ba'i don phyir rtag tu brtson / /'jig rten 'byam /klas thams cad rnam par sbyang shenaba'i phyir/ /smon lam bye ba khrag khrig bsam gyis mi khyab dang / /stong pa mtshan ma med pa smon med mi gnas pa'i1 / /smon lam bye ba brgyas ni sems de'11dag par 'gyur/ /chos kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bu sus rtogs shing / /zhi dang rab zhi nyer zhir nya thams cad mnyam gzhog pa/ /de dag chos grangs khrag khrig bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i / /grangs su 'gro la ston kyang de ni gnas pa med/ /phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gtso bo ji snyed pa/ /de dag kun gyi 12byang chub sems mchog 'di bsngags te / /yon tan brgya phrag bsam gyis mi khyab pas kyang brgyan/ /sems can gtso bzhin yang 15dag pha rol phyin pa yin/ /bskal pa sems can 35—634

snyed du gal te legs brjodam(1)kyang / /byang chub sems rab de la mthar thug nagang yang med/ /rgyal ba 'byung ba'i rin mi chen der ni gang skyes pa/ /de yi dpe ni khams gsum glongs kyang 4)gang yang med/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis gang zhig rnamane'ubastsags neXpa'i/ /byang chub sems rab de la smon lam kun gyis gyis ske/ /byang chub sems rab dam pa de ni tshebasod nams gter/ /des ni rgyal sras chags pa med pa rab tu 'thob/ /'gro ba'i sems dang spyod pa shes shing mthong rung srid/ /zhing rnams rdul (97du blags te bgrang bar 1 nus kyang srid / /bar snang skra yis 31mnyam par gzhal bar nus srid kyi/ /byang chub sems mchog yon tan hu mthar phyin myi nus so/ /'di las dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu byung〈rte/ /'di las 'jig rten 'gro ba kun gyi bde ba 'byung ske/ /'di las rgyal bas bsngags 7pa'i legs pa thams cad 'byung / /'dis ni sems can gtso la the tsom 8med par 'gyur/ /'dis ni 'jig rten kun gyi sgrib 7pa zad par 'gyur/ /'dis ni zhing rnams yongs su dag pa'i mchog du 'gyur/ /'di las 'jig rten dam pa shes dang ldan pa 'byung / /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba blta 3)bar 'dod pa dang / /gang zhig byin dang bsod nams 3)myi zad mdzod hu/'dod dang / /gang zhig 'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal zlog 'dod pa/ /des ni yon tan mtha' yas byang chub sems bskyed bya/ /3 cibyang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa'i bsod nams 21kyi phung po'i dpe ri ci yang dag par bsagasam pa tshigs su bcad 24pa'i le'u zhes bya ba 25ste nyi shu gnyis sodu lha// //35wa 635

sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/sti bam po nyi shu gsum pa/du de nas byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus blo gros kyisalabyang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems bskyed pa rab tu thob pa/ sems dang po bskyed pa la gnas pa/ de ltar tshad med pa'i bsod nams ri )kyi tshogs dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgya chen po la yang dag par 'dzeg ci pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med par shin tu chud pa/'jig rten kun 7)tu khrid par byed pa 8)rnam par bzlog 6)pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos nyid kyi rjes su song ba 'das pa dang ske/ ma byon pa dang / da nyu ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 37byin gyis brlabs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dgod pa la shin tu nges pa/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu rab tu gzhol ba de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 32bstan pa la 12ji ltar brtson /shepar 3gebyas pa'i rnam pa gang gis/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par dgod pa las 'das par 'gyur ba dang / spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po yongs su dag par 'gyur ba dang / smon lam chen po yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gter chen po rab tu thob par 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams la snod ji tsobazhin du sbyin pa ( tshobyed par 'gyur ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs yongs su myi gtong bar 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar dam bcas 18pa'i sems can rnams sgrol bar 'gyur ba dang /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi gdu mi chad 17par 'gyur ba dang /35wa 636

dge ba'i rtsa ba dmigs pa thams cad du sbyor ba don med par mi 'gyur ba dang /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis de la brtson par byas pas ༅/chos kyi yul 'di dag yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur bar ji ltar brtsams napar bya ba de legs par bshad pa nimadzod cig /'khor 'di dag thams cad ni nyan par 'dod do/ /sems can chen po de dag gisasnyibartson pa'i rnam pa ji lta bus ma rig pa'i mun nag thams cad bstsal7te/ bdud kyi5nyadakrugs ma'imatsha 'khor thams cad las shin tu rgyal bar byas nas/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad zil gyis mnan te/ sems kyi dri ma kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs thams cad kun nas bstsal dunas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad shin tu bsgrubs te / mi khom pa dang / ngan song dang / ngan 'gro'i lam thams cad rnam par bzlog nas/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rnam par byang bar byas te/ byang chub sems dpa'i tu )sa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang /gzungs5nyedang / ting nge 'dzin dang / mngon par shes pa dang / rig pa dang ske/ mi 'jigs pa lha yongs su dag pa rnams mngon par bsgrubs nas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rnam par dag pa dang / mtshan dang dpe 32byad bzang po dang / sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyan19/ mngon par bsgrub patshatshayongs su rgyas par byas te / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs dang /mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul rtogs par 'gyur ba dang /de ltar mngon par byang chub nas kyang bsam pa'i tshul bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su grub par gyur pa dag tu ji ltar yongs su smin par bya ba'i sems 35—637

can dag la/ dus dang dbang po'i 1/rgyud ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa 'byin 5par 'gyur ba de legs par shod gcig /'khor 'di dag thams cad ni nyan par 'dod do ri/ /ji ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa'i geyon tan 'di dang gzhan dag dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi yul rnams yongs su rdzogs par rtsi)byas te/myur du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mnyam pa nyid 'thob pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis57)bskal pa brgya (43stong grangs med par yang dag par 9bsgrubs pa'i chos kyi mdzod 'di yang yang tshedag par bsrung nyu1zhing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas shing / ston pa dang 'chad pa'i tshe/ bdud dang 12bdud kyi rigs su gtogs〈nyepa dang / phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyi 1 zil gyis mi non 8pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang skyo ba med par dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin par byed pa dang ske/ de yang dag par ston pa'i tshe/ lha'i dbang po rnams kyis rim gror tsobya ba dang / gzhung de bzhin du klu'i dbang po dang / gnod sbyin 7gyi dbang po dang ske/ dri za'i dbang po dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po dang / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po dang / mi 'am ci'i dbang po dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po dang / mi'i dbang po dang / tshangs pa'i dbang pos rim gror bya ba hunyerab tu 'thob pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha/chos kyi dbang pos rim gro (3 bya bamanya rab tu 'thob pa dang / de ltar rim gror rdu2byas nas kyang / 'jig rten (rtethams cad kyis phyag bya ba/ 'jig rten thams cad kyis mngon par mchod pa/35wa 638

'jig rten thams cad kyis dbang bskur hu7ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis shin tu (snyedagongs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis 5shin tu bsrungs pa④/ rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / smon 5)lam rab tu thob pa/chos dkar po chen po yang dag par spel bas skurnams/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi dzomadzod rnam par 'byed par 'gyur ba dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa rgya chen po rab tu 'byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rim gyis spyod pa 8yongs su bsgrubs 97pa / shin tu ston par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i gnas dag yang dag par bstan pa mdzod cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus blo gros kyis don 'di nyid bstan (7te brjod pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ spyod la 'jug pa mtha' yas yangs pa dag /rang 'byung 6)ye shes bsgrub pa tunyedage ba (sternams/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yon tan can/ /grags pa chen po rnams la legs par shod/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang rnams sems thob cing / /bsod nams ldan pa ye shes thob pa7rnams/ /skyon med zhugs pa'i nya9'jig rten rnams bzlog 3 cing / /yang dag sangs rgyas chos mnyam nyid thob rnams/ /de dag gis 18ni bde gshegs bstan pa la/ /brtson 'grus brtan pas 19ji ltar brtson par bya/ /gang gis (nye phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mnyes byas shing gisgo/ /yang dag sangs rgyas sa yang gnan bya dang / /spyod pa dag dang smon lam yongs snyedag dang / /ye shes gter chen rab tu thob rdunye'agyur zhing / /thob nas de dag 'gro kun mi gnas pas rwa / /yongs su blangs pa rtag tu gtong byed dang / /gang yang pha rol phyin 35wa 639

pa mchog gi lam/ /de dag mi gtong0)rab tu brjod ②pa dang / /sems can ji ltar sgrol byed dam bcas shing / /yang dag sangs rgyas bsam pa mnyam 'dzin dang / /mig gi dmyigs pa brtanastobapa thams cad kyi/ /'byung ba yon tan can la stobs gi)'gyur zhing / /skyes bu khyu mchog de dag brtson gyur pa'iX/ /rnam dag lam de khyu mchog khyod kyis ston no/ /ji ltar de dag mun pa kun bstsalakhucing ske/ /'khrug pa'i 'khor rnams thams cad phamasabyas nas/ /dri ma bral ba'i dge ldan mkhas pa rnams/ /skyes bu khyu mchog ye shes ldan 'gyur dang / /mi khom ngan song lam rnams yongs spangs shing / /ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor mchog spyod dang / /yon tan bzang po thams cad ldan 'gyur zhingashe/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes stobs kyang thob gyur nyu )dang / /skyes bu khyu mchog ye shes zhugs nas kyang la/ /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin ston byed cing / /mtha' yas yangasalgepa'i zhing rnams bsam yas su/ /ston pa chen po'i las kyang byed pa dang / /ci nas de dag spyod pa mchog thob nas/ /mi yi khyu mchog mdzod rnams ston byed de//zil hu gyis mi non gzhan gyis mi pham 3)par/ /rgyal ba'i chos nyid rtag tu 'dzin byed ston/ /seng ge bzhin du ji ltar 'jigasalgepa med/ / ji ltar zla bzhin dag pa'i mdog tu spyod/ /chu la pad mo bzhin du chags med pa/ /de dag rgyal ba'i yon tan ji ltar spyod/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus blo gros la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras khyod ni skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la7bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang tso/ phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhugs7)pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i 35—640

sras de ltar khyod7byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa shin tu rtogs〈 shing / rnam par dag pashebartsams te/ 'dri zhing de ltar rgyal ba'i sras khyod/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'dri ④ba chos mang po la rab tu gnas pa/ brtson 'grus chen pos shin tu bstsags ⑤pa/ brtson 'grus ldog pa myed pas shin tu 'byung 46)ba 'dri bar byed pa ni/ kye rgyal ba'i sras legs so legs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de'i phyir shin tu legs par nyon la yid la zung ④shig dang / sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs tsam bstan par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di la byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa thob pa rnams kyis thog mar sems bskyed pa de mi nyamasamanyapar yongs su bsrung bshedang / rim gror bya ba'i phyir bag yod par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de la rnam pa bcus na ⑩byang chub sems dpa' bag yod pa la /stoganas pa zhes bya stonye/ bcu gang zhe na/ tshul khrims kyi phung po shin tu bsrung ba /tshonadang /byang chub kyi sems ma nyams shing shin tu sbyangs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'achabasam pa g.yo dang sgyu med pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba 0sbyor ba phyir mi ldog pa dang / rang gi sems bskyed 7pa shin tu rtogs hu 7pa dang / phyogs khyim pa dang / so so'i skye bo dang ma 'dres pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa hu)ba'i las 'jig rten gyi 'du shes dang / 'dod pa thams cad dang bral ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam7nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa spangs zhu snapa rab tu thob pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba brtsams du nyapa nan tan rgyun chad pa med pa dang ske/ bdag gi rgyud kyi stobs kyi shugs shin tu brtags du 2pa dag ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras rnam pa bcu po 'di dag dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni bag 35—641

yod pa la gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de la byang chub sems dpa' bag yod pa la gnas pa ni41/ rnam pa bcus na g.yongs su dag par 'gyur te①/bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ kye 4rgyal ba'i sras 'di la byang chub sems dpa' ji ltar smras pa de ltar byed pa yin/ shes bzhin gyi 45dran pa can yin/ khengs pa med cing g.yo 6)ba med de/ bsam gtan zab mo (3)la rab tu gnas pa yin/sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo btsal ba la nan tan du byed cing rgyun mi gcod pa yin / lhag mthong mngon par bsgrub na pa la mkhas shing ji ltar59)thos pa'i chos la tshul bzhin du rtogs 9par zhugs pa yin/ bsam gtan gyi rjes su song ba'i sems kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa zab mo'i rjes su song ba yin / sa dang mnyam zhing mthon dman dang bral ba yin/ sbyor ba bzang ngan dang bar ma la sems nyams pa med pa yin/ sems can kun gyi nang na chung ngu na nyu1thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems gcig bskyed pa la 'ang ston pa'i bsam pa thob pa yin/ mkhan po dang slob dpon dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang /byang chub sems dpa' dang / chos smra ba rnams la rim gro dang / bkur sti'i hurtengang tshul can du gnas pa yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras rnam pa bcu po de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' bag yod pa la gnas pa/ yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de la byang chub sems dpa' bag yod pa brtson 'grus brtsams pa / dran pa nye bar bzhag 15pa 14mos pa che ba skurnal 'byor rgyun ma chad ⑩pa chos thams cad la mi gnas pa/ chos thams cad la brtson pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i tshul la zhugs pa/ sems yangs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos mtha' dang dbus med pa'i rjes su song ba rnams kyis ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 35—642

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par 'gyur te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'arkyuchos bcus de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mnyes par bya'o / /bcu gang zhe na byang chub sems dpa' tsho brtson 'grus thams cad la phyir myi ldog pa dang / lus dang srog la mi lta ba dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad /dang /'tsho ba'i rkyen la don du gnyer ba med pa dang / chos thams cad rnam par bsgomasasngon)pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang / chos kyi dbyings la yang dag par gzhol ba'i lhag mthong la mkhas pa dang / mi gnas pa'i chos rnam par bsgom gepa'i phyag rgya dang / rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsgrubs 6pa'i smon lam chen po dang / yongs su sbyangs pa'i bzod pa shes pa'i snang ba dang / rang gi dge ba'i chos bstsags (7pa dang / ma bstsags 3)pa shin tu brtags pa dang /mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i sgo shin tu byang ba ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de la byang chub sems dpa' chos bcu la gnas pa rnams kyis ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mnyes par 'gyur ba yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste bag yod pa la gnas pa dang / myi skye ba'i bzod pa la gnas pa dang / snying rje chen po la gnas pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la gnas pa dang /spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la gnas pa dang / smon lam mngon par bsgrubatso)pa lam/tsho )gnas pa dang / thabs mkhas pa la gnas pa dang / brtan 11 pa'i stobs kyi shugs la gnas pa dang / chos thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin lta bu la hurteganas pa dang / len pa med pa la gnas pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras chos de dag la gnas pa'i nyurtebyang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ de bzhin 35—643

gshegs pa mnyes par 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de la chos bcu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sa rnam par dgod pa las 'da' ba yin te/bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs shin tu bstsagasatupa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par phye ba tshad med pa'i lam gzhan gyi7dring mi 'jog pa'i ye shes snang ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'grogs pa rgyun mas chad pa dang / brtson 'grus zhig pa med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis legs par brlabs rgyapa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba sbyor bas mi skyo ba dang / theg pa'i rgyan shin tu bshams pa dang / ye shes kyi bsam pa rab tu rno ba dang / sa dang sar 5ma yin pa'i chos kyi sgo la mi gnas pa dang /'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 55)rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu gyur pa dag ste/kye rgyal ba'i sras chos bcu po de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ sa nas sar rnam par dgod pa las 'da' ba yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' de dag ni thog ma nas/ sa /rnam par dgod pa thams cad la mkhas pa rnam par dpyod pa yin te/ chos kyi sgo gang gis gang khong du chud par 'gyur ba dang / ye shes kyi sgo gang gis thob par 'gyur ba dang / bsgrubalgepa gang yin pa dang / rgyu mthun spyodapa gang yin pa dang / spyod yul gang yin pa dang ske/ rnam par 'phrul pa gang yin pa dang / yang dag par mthong ba gang yin pa dang / chos kyi sgo rnam par dbye ba'i khyad par gang yin pa dang / ji ltar thob par bya ba thams cad kyi 'ang spurnam par dpyod do/ /de dag la shin tu rnam par dpyad nyu1pas/ chos thams cad la mi gnas shing sems kyi rang bzhin 35—644

gyi chos thams cad khong du chud pas byang chub sems dpa'i sa yang dag par 'da'o①/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams mini 'di ltar bdag cag gis jisnyenas kyang myur du 'da' bar bya'o/ /snyam dusamyi sems te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag sa nas sasnyil rnam par gnas pas/ ji lta ji ltar yang dag par gnas pa de lta de ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs ches 0che ba skye bar 'gyur ⑦te/ ji lta ji ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po skyes par gyur pa/ de lta de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa'i rjes su song nizhing sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa tshad med pas nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro ⑨snyam ste de dag sbyor ba rgyun mi kyichad cing skyo ba med pa'i yid dang ldan pa dang / tshogs kyi rgyan chen pos byang chub sems dpa'i01rnam par bkod 32pa las yang dag par 'da'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ()rnam pa bcus spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyang 14bar byas te/bcu gang zhe na yo byad yongs su gzung ba med pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad tshim par byed pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blangs pa kha na ma tho ba med pa dang ske/ bzod pa dang des pa mi zad pa'i sa'i rjes su song ba dang / brtson 'grus rtsom pa phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pa dang / dran pa'i stobs kyi shugs rmongs78pa med pa dang / gcig las rnam pa tha dad pa'i chos kyi rjes su song zhing khong du chud pa dang / gnas med pa'i spyod pa bsgrub tsodaka' ba thams cad la sems ri'i rgyal po lta bu dang / sems can thams cad dang lha 7ma 'dres pa'i mu stegs su gyur pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad du sangs rgyas thams cad dang / rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu gyur pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras rnam pa bcu po 35—645

de dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyong bar 3)bya'o/ /de dag gis nabyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa de ltar yongs su sbyangs pa des rnam pa bcus shin tu dag par 'gyur54)te/ bcu gang zhe na sems can gyi gtso bo 'jig rten gyi khams gzhanama'itshon bzhugs pas yang dag par dgongs pa dang / 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i grogs kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'byin gyi rlabs yang dag par gzung ba la5ge mkhas pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la yang dag par brten (8)pa dang /mos pa dang brtson 'grus dang / bag yod pa la rab tu gnas pa dang / chos tha dad pa thams cad la tha mi dad par rtogs pa dang / snying rje'i byin gyi rlabs shin tu che ba dang / chos thams cad yang dag palo)ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par lta ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon par bsgrub 7pa dang / thabs la mkhas par 1 rnam par dpyod 12pa'i sbyor ba dang / sbyor ba thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi rjes su 'brang ba dag ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras rnam pa bcu po de dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyang bar nyu bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de la byang chub sems dpa'i gesgron lam rnam par dag 12pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste skyo ba med par sems can gyi khams yongs su smin nya9par bya ba'i smon lam dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba sna tshogs bstsags sna pas 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su dag par 32bya ba'i smon lam dang / lus dang srog gis /9bsngo zhing dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i smon lam dang / ye shes kyi sgo rnam par dbye ba nu )khong du chud pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing la 'jug pa'i smon lam dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams 35—646

cad dang gnyis su med pas tshul 1)gcig gi rgyud du 'gro ba'i smon lam dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgo la 'jug pas chos thams cad khong du chud pa'i smon lam dang / mos pa rnam par sbyangs pas blta na don yod pa'i smon lam dang /phyi ma'ikhumathar byin gyis brlabs pas5gyibaskal par gnas pa'i smon lam dang 4/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i theg pa'i rgyan rnam pa thams cad kyi sgo nas rnam par sbyang ba'ikhusmon lam dag ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni de ltar smon lam rnam par sbyong ngo / /de dag rnam pa bcus smon lam yongs su rdzogs par byed de⑥/ bcu gang zhe na yongs su skyo ba med pa dang /rgyan chen po mngon par bsgrubalgepa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i (smon lam khyad par du ⑩'phags pa rnams kyi rjes su 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thos nas/rang gi smon lam du mngon par bsgrub 11pa dang / bsam pa phyi ma'i mtha'i 12mur thug pa dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya bar gtugs pa'i smon lam chen po dang ldan pa dang / bskal pa thams cad du gnas par mi 'jigasatshwa pa dang / sdug bsngal thams cad kyis ji ⑩mi snyam pa dang ske/ bde ba thams cad la ye mi brngam 8pa dang / bsam pa mnyam pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa yongs su bsgrub pa skyedag ste/ de dag sna 7smon lam chen po de ltar yongs su sbyong zhing / yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas mthong ba'i gter zad mi shes pa'ang rab tu 'thob po/ /gzungs 'khrul pa med pa'i gter zad mi shes pa'ang rab tu 'thob po/ /smon lam zad mi shes pas chos thams cad shin tu rtogs pa'i gzungs kyang rab tu 'thob po/ /snying rje 35—647

chen pos 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa'i gter zad mi shes pa'ang rab tu 'thob po/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyud kyi gter zad mi shes pa 'ang rab tu 'thob po / /'gro ba thams cad tshim par bya ba'i bsod nams kyi gter zad mi shes pa 'ang rab tu 'thob po/ /chos thams cad nyu7yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du brtags 2pa'i ye shes kyi gter zad mi shes pa'ang rab tu 'thob po/ /rnam par phyin pa la gnas pa mngon par bsgrub ri pa'i gter zad mi shes pa'ang rab tu 'thob po/ /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs mtha' yas pa'i gter zad myi shes pa'ang rab tu 'thob po/ /'jig rten gyi khams mtha' dang dbus med par gtogs pa la 'jug ca pa'i gter zad mi shes pa 'ang rab tu 'thob po/ /de ltar gter rab tu thob cing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs zad mi shes pa dang ldan pa de dag ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pas/ sems can rnams la bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos kyi gter gyi sbyin pa byed do/ / gyede la rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can rnams7kyi bsam pa ji lta ba 7bzhin du ji ltar 'jug ce na/ sbyor ba ji lta bur〈)rgyu ba dang /rgyu dang rkyen ji lta ba dang / sems dang sems las byung ba'i sbyor ba ji lta ba las / sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'jug ste/ de dag de ltar bsam pa la zhugs pa rnams sems can rnams kyi ⑨bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes shing chos yang dag par ston tenyuX / de dag 'dod chags kyi bsam pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir mi sdug pa yang dag par ston to/ /zhe sdang gi bsam pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir/ byams pa chen po'i sbyor ba yang dag par ston to/ /gti mug gi bsam pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir chos rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas 35—648

pa7yang dag par ston to/ /cha mnyam pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir ye shes kyi khyad par dang ldan pa'i chos kyi sgo yang dag par ston to/ /'khor ba'i bsam pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal rnam pa gegasum dang ldan pa yang dag par ston to/ /gnas kyi bsam pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir gnas med pa'i chos kyi sgo yang dag par ston to/ /zhum pa'i bsam pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir/rgyasachen po'i yul yang dag par ston to/ /bdag gi nga rgyal gyis bcom pa'i bsam pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir/ chos kyi mnyam pa nyid yang dag par ston to / /g.yo dang sgyus mi mnyam pa'i bsam pa rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa mnyam pa nyid dang / zhi ba'i gnas kyi bsam pa mngon par bsgrubasdogepa yang dag par ston to/ /de dag ni de ltar sems can rnams la bsam pa ji lta bsnyebazhin du chos kyi gter yang dag par ston tone / /de yang don dbyer med pa yang dag par ston te⑦/ yi ge'i mtshams 'byor bar 8sbyar bas yang dag par ston to/ /shes pa rnam par dbye bas yang dag par ston to / /bstan pa snga phyi ma 'dres pas yang dag par ston 9)to/ /chos kyi tshul dang tshul ma yin pa'i bye brag dbyer med pas yang dag par ston to/ /mtshan nyid kyi phyag rgya rnam par mi 'khrugs pas yang dag par ston to/ /chos rab tu dgod pa rgyun chad parwanyemed pas yang dag par ston to/ /mtha' yas pa sbyang bas yang dag par ston to/ /the tshomatshamathams cad shin tu gcad 12pa'i phyir yang dag par ston to/ /dbang po'i rgyud la 'jug pa'i phyir yang dag par ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya la dgod par gzhol bas yang dag par ston to/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' mtshan nyid med pa rnam par mi 'khrugamo〉pas yang dag par 35—649

ston to/ /chos kyi dbyings la yang dag par gzhol bas yang dag par ston to/ /chos kyi rnga yang dag par brdung bas yang dag par ston to/ /gnas thams cad yang dag par spang bas 1yang dag par ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su dran pa mi gtong bas yang dag par ston to/ /tshig dang skad dang sgra dang ngag gi las nathams cad mnyam pa nyid la mi gnas pas yang dag par ston to / /rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings kyi rjes su 'gro bas yang dag par ston to/ /dpe /thams cad rnam par dgod pas rgyud dang mi 'gal bas ④brtan par bya bas yang dag par ston 5to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang gi lus su sems pa nel yang dag par gzhol bas yang dag par ston to/ /de ltar sems can la chos yang dag par ston pas9)/ rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad 8)par chos kyi nan tan gyi mtshan nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang /rang gi don rting 49tshugs par byed pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs mi gtong bas rgya 1 chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa yang dag par bsgrubakonyabo/ /de la 'ang sems can thams cad tshim par bya ba nyu dang / yo byad kyis yongs su bsdud sna pa dang / sbyor ba mnyam par yongs su gtong bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag par byed do/ /yang dag par blangs pa mi gtong ba dang /gnas pa 7med pa dang / nga rgyal med pas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag par byed do/ /nyes pa thams cad khyad du gsod pa dang /sems can thams cad kyis mi 'khrugs pa dang / mnyam pa nyid la gzhol ba dang ske/ mthon dman med pa dang / zad myi shes pa'i sa mnyam par 'dzin pas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag par byed do/ /brtsam /nyepa chen35wa 650

po brtsams0)pa dang / brtsams③pa thams cad la zhum pa med pa dang / sbyor ba phyir mi ldog pa dang / yid la byed pa phyir mi 'gyur ba dang / mthu mtha' yas pa dang / stobs la thub pa med pa dang / sngonas du 'dor ba mi 'phrogs 4pa dang ske/ dad pa'i mthu chen po dang / blang ba dang / dor ba med pa'i tshogs thams cad yongs su rgyas par bya ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgo nyams pa med pa la yang dag par 'jug pas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu sa phyin pa yongs su dag par byed do/ /'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi 'du 'dzi yongs su sbyong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / rim gyis bsam gtan dang ting nge 'dzin mngon par bsgrubalgepa dang / gnas med cing blang ba med pa shin tu rtogs pa dang /nyon mongs pa thams cad rab tu sel ba dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi nasgo mtha' yas pa mngon par bsgrub 13pa dang / mngon par shes pa chen pos rnam par 'phrul pa'i rjes su 'gro ba dang / rim gyis rnam par spong ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo la rab tu 'jug pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gcig la sgo mtha' yas par khorab tu 'jug pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul thams cad shes pa dang / de'i yul gyi rjes su rab tu zhugs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa77thams cad ye shes kyi phyag rgya mi 'khrugs pa 12thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la nye bar gyur pas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag par byed do / /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mnyan pa dang / gzung 1lhab dang / blang ba dang / bcang ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad bsnyen bkur bas yongs su mi skyo ba dang / chos 'thams cad kyis 15mi ngoms sapa dang / ji ltar thos pa la tshul bzhin du rtogs nyi tshopa dang / de la mngon sum du mnyam par 35—651

gzhog pa dang / sgro 'dogs nyu)pa'i lta ba thams cad dang bral ba dang / chos thams cad rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa dang / mtshan nyid kyi phyag rgya tha mi dad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgo nas lhun gyis grub par sgom zhing bsgom napa dang / stobs la 'jug pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'jug pa rgyun mi chad gupa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgo kun dang ldan pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgor 'jug pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag par byed do/ /'jig rten gyi bya ba'i rgyud thams cad ston pa dang ske/ sems can5ge yongs su sbyin pas yongs su mi skyo ba dang / bsam pa bzhin du bya ba ston pa dang / bya ba thams cad la mngon par chags pa med pa dang ske/ byis pa'i spyod pa dang / 'phags pa'i spyod pa bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du ston pa dang / 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa nye bar ston pa dang /sbyor ba thams cad shin tu brtags pas rgyu ba dang / rgyan thams cad bstan pa gnasam5)med pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro zhing rjes su 'brang ba dang ske/ sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i spyod pas thabasawenamakhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su sbyong ngo / /sems can gyi khams mthar thug〈pepar yongs su phyin par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mthar thug par yongs su sbyang ba dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa mthar thug par mchod pa dang / chos chags pa med pa'i mthar thug par rnam par 'tshang gshergya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings kyishemathar thug par tsu )spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang /bskal 17pa phyi ma'i mthar thug par rab tu gnas pa dang / sems bskyed pa'i mthar thug par stobs la nyu 'jug pa dang / 'gro ba dang ldog pa mthar thug 35wa 652

par mngon par 'tshang rgyashib dang / zhing gi⑧gnas kyi mthar thug par thams cad mthong ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi mthar thug pa rab tu thob par bya bas smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag par byed do/ /bsam pa'i stobasashekun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs dbang du gyur cing thub pa med pa dang / snying rje chen po'i stobs skyo ba med pa dang / byams pa chen po'i stobs snyoms pa'i sbyor ba can dang /gzungs kyi stobs don thams cad kyi sbyor ba la bsgribs ④pa med pa dang /spobs pa'i stobs 'gro ba thams cad tshim par byed pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs theg pa thams cad kyi rgyan byed pa dang / smon lam gyi stobs gcad 5du mi rung ba dang / mngon par shes pa'i stobs tshad med pa mngon par bsgrub tshipa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs la mos pa dam pa'i stobs rab tu 'dzin pas / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag par byed do/ /'dod chags kyi spyod pa khong du chud pa dang / zhe snang gi spyod pa rjes su rtogs pa dang /gti mug gi spyod pa rab tu rtogs pa dang / cha mnyam pa'i spyod pa rjes su shes pa dang / slob pa'i sems can gyi spyod pa rab tu rtogs pa dang / skad cig gcig 3)gis sems can mtha' yas pa'i spyod pa rnam par rtogs 8pa dang /sems dang bsam pa mtha' yas pa thams cad shes par byed pa 1dang / chos thams cad la yang dag pa 7ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs nya1pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi rjes su 'jug pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi sgo thams cad dang ldan pa khong du chud pas/ 8ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag par byed do/ (gede dag de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa rnams yongs su sbyong zhing pha 35—653

rol tu phyin pa de dag yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / pha rol gyi 6)phyogs mi gtong bar nabyang chub sems dpa'i theg pa rgya 5chen po'i rgyan dang ldan pa la gnas shing / sems can gyi khams ji ltar dam bcas pa bzhin du yang dag par sgrol lo/ /de dag dge ba'i las shin tu bstsags rigapa ston pas/ ngan song du 'gro ba'i sems can sgrol lo/ /brtsam 5pa chen po la gzud pas semasapo)can gyi khams 7mi khom par 'gro ba sgrol lo/ /lhag mthong nye bar bstabs 6)pas gzugs kyi khams na 'khod pa'i sems can gyi khams sgrol lo/ /phra ba'i ye shes nye bar bstabs 9pas gzugs med pa'i khams su skyes pa'i sems can rnams sgrol lo/ /zhi ba'i tshul nye bar bstabs 1 pas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la mos pa'i sems can gyi khams sgrol lo/ /stobs bcu'i rgyan chen po dang ldan pa bstabs 11pas/ theg pa chen po la mos pa'i sems can gyi khams sgrol lo/ /de ltar na sngon las dang po pa'i sa la gnas pa'i tshe/ sems can g.yang sa chen po nas lhung ba 12rnam pa tha dad par gyur pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes te / sgo sna tshogs nas gzung bar 1 bya'o/ /zhes seng ge'i sgra bsgrags ④pa de bzhin du ye shes thob pa rnam dku sems can tshathams cad bsgral ba'i phyir rab tu zhugs pa yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' ye shes de lta bu la zhugs pa ni rtag tu rgyun mi gcod par sangs rgyas kyi rigs dang chos kyi rigs dang dge 'dun gyi rigs mi gcad 1 pa'i phyir zhugs pa yin te/ de dag byang chub kyi sems gzhan gyi sems kyi 1 rgyud la gzhol bas /zhesangs rgyas kyi rigs mi gcod pa yin/ chos kyi mdzod rnam par 'grel pas chos kyi rigs mi gcod pa yin / bstan pa'i tshul dang 'gal bar mi byed pas/ dge 'dun gyi rigs ri ༷35—654

mi gcod pa yin/ smon lam chen po yang dag par brjod pas sangs rgyas kyi rigs mi gcod pa yin/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i tshul yang dag par ston pas chos kyi rigs mi gcod pa yin/ snying po thob par byed pa'i chos la brtson pas dge 'dun gyi rigs mi gcod pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa bon sems can gyi zhing la 'debs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs mi gcod pa yin/dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pas chos kyi rigs mi gcod pa yin/ tshogs chen po yongs su sdud pa la mi skyo bas nyu)dge 'dun gyi rigs mi gcod pa yin/'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi semadzad pa dran pa'i phyir/ rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa mi gtong bas/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi rigs mi gcod pa yin/ de dag de ltar skyabs gsum gyi rigs mi gcod ④pa'i phyir zhugs pas rtsom pa thams cad 4kha na ma tho ba med pa yin te/brtsams ④pa gang ci rtsom yang rung / de dag thams cad du thogs pa med par thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgor 'byung ba thob par byed do/ /de dag de ltar lus kyi las kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / ngag gi las kha na ma tho ba med pa dang /yid kyi las kha na ma tho ba med pa la gnas pas dge ba'i rtsa ba brtsam 6pa don yod par rtsoms④pa yin te/ sems can gyi don sbyor ba don yod par rtsom 8mo/ /sems can don yod par 'dul bar byed do/ /chos don yod par ston to/ /de'i chos ston nyupa thams cad kyang sems can gyi bsam pa tshim par bya ba la thogs bopa med pas khong du chud par 'gyur ro/ /de'i sems bskyed pa gcig tsam 11yang log par mi 'gyur te/ sems bskyed pa gzhan thabs dang shes rab 35wa 655

kyis 1)yongs su zin pa thams cad kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngo'os / /de de ltar chos dkar po bstsags dpa don yod pa de⑥lta bu la gnas pas rgyan rnam par phye ba bcus sems bskyed pa thams cad yongs su bsngo 2ste/bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar lus kyi rgyan sems can 'dul ba7ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par ston pa dang / ngag gi rgyan the tsomadza thams cad gcod pa dang /sems kyi rgyan skad cig gcig gis ting nge 'dzin rjes su rtogs par byed pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / 'od kyi rgyan 'od zer gyi dra ba mtha' dang dbus med pa bkye bsashe'agro ba thams cad snang bar byed pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan sems can gyi rnam pa tshad med pa'i tshogs yongs su mgu bar byed pa dang / rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyan sems can gyi bsam pa ji lta ba /stobazhin du rdzu 'phrul gyis yo rnam par 'phrul pa dang / bstan pa'i rgyan mkhas pa'i skye bo thams cad kyis yongs su gzung 1 ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyan mngon par sangs rgyas pa gcigasagis phyogs bcu ma lus par rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / chos byin gyis brlabs pa'i rgyan yul dang / dus dang snod ji lta ba bzhin du ston mapa dag ste/ de dag rgyan de lta bus sems bskyed pa thams cad du mngon par bsgrubs pas lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las don yod pa dang / ye shes chen po don yod pa rab tu 'thob ste/ de dag mthong bas kyang 'di ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su phyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir sems can rnams la don yod pa yin te/ thos pa dang bsnyen bkur ba dang / 'grogs pa dang /rjes su dran pa dang / rjes su rab tu byung ba dang / chos ston pa dang / dge 35—656

ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yid rang ba0)dang / dad cing mos pa dang / chung ngu na ming brjod pa tsam yang 'di ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sbyin pa'i phyir sems can rnams la don du 'gyur ba yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na rtsi'i ming mthong na bde ba zhes bya ba de mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams kyi lus la zhen pa 'am ltor zos pa'i dug rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin dum chos de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i dug thams cad byang〈mibar 'gyur te/ chos dkar po'i stobs kyi shugs kyang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos nyid de lta bu dang ldan zhing chos de dag la gnas te/ shes rab kyi 'od chen pos ma rig pa'i mun pa bsalamanyanas/ bdud kyi dkrugs ma'i 'khor thams cad byamasaphupa dang / snying rje chen po'i stobs kyisam pham par byas te/ye shes dang bsod nams kyi stobs kyi shugs kyis phas kyi /rmurgol ba thams cad 8zil gyis mnan nas/ rdo rje lta bu'i〈)ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pas/ sems kyi dri ma thams cad dang / nyon mongs pa'i phyogs thams cad bsal nas/ skyo nya —ba med pa'i stobs dang shugs kyis 31dge ba'i rtsa ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rab tu bsgrubs teturnye/ sngon cad hunyesangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par spyodasapa'i stobs dang shugs kyis mi khom pa dang / ngan song dang ngan 'gro'i lam thams cad rnam par bzlog nas/ mngon par zhen pa med pa'i stobs dang shugs kyis ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyangs te/ rim gyis mthabs dang shes rab kyi stobs dang / shugs kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang pha rol tu 35—657

phyin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / mngon par shes pa dang / rig pa dang mi 'jigs 15pa yongs su dag pa mngon par bsgrubs nas/ chos dkar po thams cad kyi stobs dang shugs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang / sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rgyan yongs su dag pa mngon par bsgrub napa rab tu rgyas par byas te —/ ye shes kyis 9༄shes par bya ba'i dbang 45nodang / byin gyi rlabs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos 6ma 'dres pa thams cad mnyam pa nyid khong du chud par byas nas / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang myur du 'thob cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul yang smon lam gyi khyad par ji lta ba bzhin du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi byin gyi rlabs dang / ye shes kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bstan na te/ 'dul ba ji lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor cing / mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnam 9par 'dul lo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i 1 chos de lta bu dang ldan pa dag ni 11tshul de lta bus sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid kyi bar du thob par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thob nas kyang / 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa dag tu dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin cing / chos smra ba chen po yang byed do/ /de ltar chos smra ba byed pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 1 byin gyis brlabs pa de dag chos kyi mdzod chen po gzung zhing bsrung ba'i phyir/ tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa'i nya chos kyi tshul rab tu dbye ba'i 35wa 658
