rjes su song ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor mtha' yas par bdag gi lus kyi hu)rgyan byin gyis brlabs te gebastan pa mngon par bsgrubs pas rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa dang〈 —ri/ tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa'i mkhas pa mtha' yas pa dang / ye shes mi zad pa'i sgor 'jug pa dang / dbyangs ⑤kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu rnam par phye ba'i byin gyi rlabs dang / dbyangs gcig bsgrags pas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad mgu bar byed pa'i dbyangs rtsikyi yan lag rnam par dag pa bsam pa dang /bag la nyal ba dang / shes pa'i sa ji lta ba bzhin du rjes su 'brang ba dang /lus kyi byin gyi rlabs ④'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi nang du phyin kyang zil gyis mi non7pa dang / lus kyi rgyan sgo thams cad du rnam par bstan pa dang ske/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi sems dang / bsam pa khong du chud pas rab tu rtogs pa dang / tshig grol ba'i byin gyi rlabs kyis 3 tshobastan pa dang chos 'chad pa'i byin gyi rlabs la/ mkhas pas chos kyi gtam chen po byed de / stobs dang shugs kyi dbang thub pa med pa dang / 'jigs pa med pa'i dbang 37zhum pa med pa dang / chos kyi dbang zil gyis mi non pa dang / ye shes kyi dbang gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbang chos kyi mtshan nyid 'khrugs nyi pa med pa dang / tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa'i dbang mtshams sbyor ba rgyun chad pa med par bsam pa shin tu rtogs pa dang ske/ gzungs kyi dbang chos thams cad rnam par gdon myi za ba la 'jug pa dang ske/ smon lam gyi dbang dpe (2sna tshogs kyis bstan pa'i tshul nye bar bsgrub skopa shin tu bstan pa dang / snying rje chen po'i dbang phyir mi ldog cing rgyun ma chad 35—659

pa dang / byams pa chen po'i dbang sngon shin tu bskyed 37pas bsam pa thams cad tshim napar byed cing ri/ 'od zer gyi dra ba chen po gtong bas chos kyi ④gtam chen po byed do/ /de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs shing chos kyi gtam gsung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dang smon lam gyi khyad par dang ldan pa ma gtogs par sems can gyi ris na/ byang chub sems dpa' de la phyir brgal 5ba 'am/ spyi gtsug blta ba 'am/ zil gyis gnan 46 pa 'am/ dri ba'i tshogs yongs su dri bas thub par bya bar nus pa'i sems can gang yang med de/ de ni gnas med do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gal te byang chub sems dpa' dbang de lta bu thob pa la 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa tsam du yangs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gcig yod la ⑦'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de yang sems can stong gsum gyi bdag po'i gzi brjid thob pa sha stag gis gang ba zhig yin na yang / de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i 8'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 'ongs ma thag tu lus bstan pa'i dbang gis zil gyis mnan te/ byams pa chen po'i dbang gis lus kyi gzhi tshim par byas nas 59rin shes chen po'i dbang gis sems dang bsam pa rnam par shes par byas te/ / mi 'jigs pa'i bsam pa chen pos chos ston par hu1byed cing /spobs pa chen po'i dbang gis nyu2sems can tshim par byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' de ni ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa dang ldan12/ chos rnam par 'byed pa shin tu rnam par phye ba la mkhas pa dang ldan/ dran pa'i stobs dang shugs ma nyams shing lirgya che ba dang ldan/ chos thams cad kyi tshul rnam par gdon mi za bar bzung zhing blangs 35—660

pas rtogs par mkhas pa dang ldan/ byang chub sems dpa'i 3)mkhas pa mtha' dngasadabus med pa dang ldan/ chos kyi mtshan nyid bsgribs snopa med pa'i chos ston pa la mkhas pa dang ldan/ mos pa la mkhas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis blangs pa dang ldan/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor du yang dag par gzhol ba'i ye shes kyi byin gyi brlab la mkhas pa dang ldan/ sems can thams cad kyi gtso bo 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba rnams dang / rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu gyur ④pa'i bsam pa bzang po rnam par dag pa la mkhas pa dang ldan pas/ chos smra ba chen po byed cing /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi mdzod kyang rnam par 'byed do/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i yid kyi smon lam dang /ye shes 'byamasnyiklas pas dam pa'i chos kyang yongs su 'dzin to/ /de nas56)byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros kyis yang byang chub sems dpa'adzo)rim gyis yang dag par 'byung ba'i chos kyi 3)sgo'i le'u yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /bsod nams tshogs bstsags spubyang chub sems la gnas pa huX rnams/ /rtag tu bag yod blo brtan (lhamathu chen bdog pa dag /dran dang ldan zhing byang chub sems rab mi gtong bas/ /phyogs rnams bcu por bde gshegs rnams ni mnyes par byed / /brtson 'grus brtsams〈rtepa dran ldan mos pa brtan pa can/ /'jig rten kun la rtag turwartemi gnas mi ldog pa/ /zab pa'i chos zhugs mya ngan med pa'i tshul mkhas rnams/ /phyogs rnams bcu por bde gshegs rnams ni mnyes 35—661

par byed/ /brtson 'grus brtan nya pas bde gshegs mnyes par byas nas kyang //dus gsum bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes ldan pa rigernams/ /sa rnams gnon〈 rubyed spyod mchog nyams capa med par byed/ /thub pa'i smon lam rdzogs byed stonas nacipa'ang de bzhin byed/ /ye shes gcig la zhugs pa de dag thob bya ba/ /thob nas 'gro ba kun la sbyin pa rab tu gtong / /bsam pa dag dang khams dang sbyor ba shes byas nas/ /dbang po ji bzhin mkhas pa de ltar chos kyang ston/ /pha rol phyin la brtson pa mthu chen ldan pa 6)rnams/ /'gro ba rnams la chos ston bdag riXgi don mi gtong / /pha rol phyin rdzogs grol ba mthu chen ldan pa 2)rnamasal/ /khyu mchog mthu yis 'khor ba'i mtsho las sems can sgrol/ /de ltar nyin mtshan skyo ba med par brtson byed cing / /drang srong rgyal ba chos rigs mi gcod 9zhugs pa yis/ /dkar po'i spyod pa gang yang rung ste spangs pa hu rirnams / /thams cad don yod rgyal ba rnams kyi sar 'gro'o/ /de dag ji lke/tespyod thams cad 'gro ba rnams la yang / /rnam smin don yod nyon mongs dri ma sbyong bar nyi 'gyur/ /'di 'dra'i chos ldan de dag mun pa bsal gebyas shing / /bdud 'khrugs kha'akhor lo pham byas byang chub thob par byedahunye/ /de ltar brtson zhing ye shes thob pa'i bde gshegs sras/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi chos rab mdzod kyang rab tu ston/ /de dag chos smra'i bya ba kun kyang shin tu byed/ /bdud rtsi mchog zhim sprin gyi char yang mngon par 'bebs/ /de dag snying rje byams pas 'gro ba kun bkang zhing / /brtan pa de rnams 'khor gyi bsam pa shes byas nas/ /gang gi bsam pa blo gros sems rgyud ci 'dra 8ba/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i chos ni stong phrag du ma ston/ /glang po'i stabs hu)sdug tshul bzang 35wa 662

'gros su 'gro ba hu)rnams/ /seng ge'i rtsal ltar rtag tu sus kyang mi thub cing / /ye shes rgya mtsho lta bu ri rab bzhin gnas pa/ /sprin ltar 'gro ba kun gyi nyon mongs zhi bar byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi blo gros kyis de skad ces smras pa dang / de la ston pas rjes su dgyes5 par mdzad do/ /mchos snang ba'i le'u zhes bya ba ste nyi shu gsum pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/④ bam po nyi shu bzhi pa/dkyi de nas sangs rgyas kyi yemathus/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang / lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang /gzhung de bzhin du steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar thams cad na/gling bzhi pa 'di la stsogs ④pa gling bzhi pa re re na/ de bzhin gshegs pa mang po bzhugs par snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis chos ston to/ / bdag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis chos ston to/ /3)bdag phyo kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi drung na 'khod par shes so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa ma bshig ma btang nyi )bar byang chub kyi shing drung yang ma spangs par ri rab kyi rtse mo nas/ mtsherwalhama'i gnas kyi lha'i bu rab mtshe ma'i khang pa nor bu sna tshogs gang na ba der gshegs par snang ngo / /ji ltar gling bzhi pa 'di na bcom ldan 'das rab mtshe ma'i gnas su gshegs par snang ba de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yang / rab mtshe ma'i gnas su gshegs par snang ste/ byin gyis brlabs snga ma rnams kyang de bzhin ma 'khrugs 3)par 35—663

snang ngo / /de nas lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe mas/ bcom ldan 'das rgyang ring po nas khang pa nor bu sna tshogs logs su mngon par gshegs pa mthong nas/rings pa'i gzugs su khang pa nor bu sna tshogs kyi nang du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan rdzu 'phrul gyis bsgrubs pa'i seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che las byas pa pog re brgya 1stong phrag bcus kun nas7brgyan pa/gser gyi dra ba brgya stong phrag bcus kun nas mngon par bres pa/ me tog gi bla re brgya stong phrag bcus kun tu khyab par byas pa/ phreng ba'i bla re brgya stong phrag bcus kun tu brgyus 4pa/ spos kyi bla re brgya stong phrag bcus spos thams cad kun tu 'thul bar bdugs 5pa/ rin po che'i⑧bla re brgya stong phrag bcus kun tu bres pa/ me tog gi gdugs brgya stong phrag bcusashekun nas bzungasnyib/phreng 9ba'i gdugs khobargya stong phrag bcus kun nas bzung hu)banyurnye/ rin po che'i gdugs brgya stong phrag bcus 1 kun nas bzung ba/byu/ 'od zer brgya stong phrag bcus kun nas masnang bar byas pal/ rab mtshe ma'i lha'i rgyal po brgya stong phrag bcus rab tu gdud 1 pa/ tshangs pa brgya stong phrag bcus mngon par phyag bya ba/byang chub sems dpa' brgya stong phrag bcus mngon par bstod tsho/snyepa/ rol mo brdung ba brgya stong phrag bcu'i 1 sgra phyung ba/ chos kyi glu'i dbyang brgya stong phrag bcu'i glu'i ri chodabyangs dang ldan pa/ me tog gi sprin gyi char brgya stong phrag bcu rab tu phab pa/ phreng ba'i 21sprin gyi char brgya stong phrag bcu rab tu phab pa/ rgyan gyi sprin gyi char brgya stong phrag bcu rab tu phab pa/ji nya gos kyi sprin gyi char brgya stong phrag bcu rab tu phab pas kun nas g.yogs (nyepa/ nor bu rin po che'i sprin brgya stong phrag bcu'i char rab tu phab pas kun tu snang bar byas pa/35—664

dge ba'i rtsa ba brgya stong phrag bcus7kun nas byung ba/ sangs rgyas brgya stong phrag bcus byin gyis brlabs pa/ bsod nams brgya stong phrag bcus bstsagasashosashing bsgrubs pa/ lhag pa'i bsam pa brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu sbyangs pa/smon lam brgya stong phrag bcus rnam par dag par byas pa/ spyod pa brgya stong phrag bcus kun nas bslang bani/ chos brgya stong phrag bcus rab tu brtan pa/rnam par 'phrul pa brgya stong phrag bcu dang ldan pa/ yon tan brgya stong phrag bcusasnyishin tu 'phags pa/ brjod pa brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu brjod pa bshams so/ /ji ltar gling bzhi pa 'dirapo)rab mtshe ma'i gnas kyi lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma'i khang pa nor bu sna tshogs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan btingams)ba / de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa dag gi/rab mtshe ma'i gnas su yang po)/ khang pa nor bu sna tshogs su lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan rgyan 'di 'dra ba dang / bsham pa'i tshul 'di 'dra ba dag kyang bting7bar gyur to/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe mas bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan bting nas/ zhe sa dang rim gror bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der hu)logs su thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gshegs su gsol/bde bar gshegs pa gshegs su gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bde bar gshegs sam/ de nas bcom ldan 'das lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe mas spyan drangs pa bzhin du khang pa nor bu sna tshogs su gshegs so/ /ji ltar gling bzhi pa 'di5)rab mtshe ma'i gnas su lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma'i khang pa nor bu sna tshogs su gshegs pa de bzhin du 'jig 35—665

rten gyi khams thams cad du yang rab mtshe ma'i gnas su 37khang pa nor bu sna tshogs su gshegs par snang ngo / /de nas lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma'i rigelha'i dbang po'i gnas thams cad du sgra bsgrags te/ lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe mas bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab po/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe mas sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs〈gurgyas rnams lage/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ji ltar bskyed pa de rjes su dran nas/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis de'i tshe 5tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas grags pa'i dam par mtshan btags mtshan gsol pa/ /nor bu'i zhigatsug tu gshegs pa ltar/ /des7)ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'jig rten sgron ma blo risazhes mtshan btags 'opa/ / sbyangs pa'i lam duyogashegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /bsgribs 11med gzigs pa 'dzum 12pa'i spyan du mtshan btags pa/ /rgyan gcig ldan par gshegs pa ltar1 / /des ni 'dir yang bkra hunyeshis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'jig rten sgron ma mar me mdzad ces mtshan btags pa/ /rnam par rgyal bar dgashegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /bde gshegs yang dag don gzigs pa zhes mtshan btags tshapa/ /dri med rtse mor gshegs pa ltar / /des ni 'dir yang bkra sna shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rang 'byung nyu8mchog ces mtshan btags /)pa/ /rin chen 2 )spos su gshegs pa ltar 1/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur 35wa 666

cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'jig rten sgron ma dbyig gi lha zhes mtshan btags7pa/ /dri myed sna tshogs gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'gro ba med palasmra ba'i stag ces mtshan btagasalgepa/ /thams cad tshul du gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra ④shis mchog gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis / /yon tan kun mnga' dpal gyis rgyal bar mtshan btagasalgepa/ /dga'akheba'i rgyan du gshegs pa ltar/ /des ni 'dir yang bkratswashis mchog gyur cig /bkra'ushis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /'jig rten phan brtson dka' thub drag po ⑨mtshan btags pa/ /kun nas mdog du gshegs gyur pa⑨/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra〈nyeshis mchog gyur cig /ji ltar lha'i rgyal hurtepo rab mtshe mas sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis/ sngon gyi rgyal bsngo gshegs pa brjod de mngon par bstod pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rgyal po rab mtshe tshim rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gshegs pa brjod cing / glu'icadabyangs kyis tshigs su bcad de mngon par bstod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das khang pa nor bu sna tshogs su gshegs nas gdan bting 19ba la skyil mo krung hu tshobacas te bzhugs so/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang gdan gting (3ba de dag la bzhugs par snang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das bzhugs ma thag tu khang hu7pa nor bu sna tshogs de 'di lta ste/ dper na rab mtshe ma'i lha'i ris hunye thams cad tsam du che bar gyur pa 31snang ste/ 'di na ji lta ba bzhin du du )'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yang de bzhin no/ /35—667

6)rab mtshe ma'i gnas na du rnam par 'phrul pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste/ nyi shu bzhi pa(5)// //de nas sangs rgyas kyi tsunamathus phyogs bcu nas/ byang chub sems dpa' mang po lhags par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing yang 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya 3)phrag stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu 'ongs te/byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing yang byang chub sems dpa' yisangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig ⑦tu phyin to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/ 'di ltar yon tan dang ldan pa dang / blo gros dang ldan pa dang / dpal dang ldan pa dang /dga' ba dang ldan pa dang / khrel dang ldan pa dang / brtson 'grus dang ldan pa dang / stobs dang ldan pa dang / rig pa dang ldan pa dang / blo dang ldan pa dang / ye shes dang ldan pa dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag nas 'ongs pa ste/'di ltar gnyen 9skudang ldan pa dang / me tog dang ldan pa dang / nor dang ldan pa dang / dpal dang ldan pa dang / sgron ma dang ldan pa dang / rdo rje dang ldan pa dang / bde ba dang ldan pa dang / nyi ma dang ldan pa dang / dge ba dang ldan pa dang / tshangs pa dang ldan pa dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang /1de bzhin gshegs pa tsomatshan 'di zhes bya ba dag gi zham ring /rten tshangs par spyod pa dag ste/ 'di ltar nyams pa med pa'i spyan dang ske/ gzhan ma yin pa'i spyan dang / mi g.yo ba'i spyan dang / mi skyod ④pa'i 35wa 668

spyan dang / chu'i spyan dang / bcings pa med pa'i spyan dang / kun tu spyod pa'i spyan dang / 'od kyi spyan dang / dam pa'i spyan dang / mthon thing 1gi spyan dag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcu rgyas par byas te/ gang nas 'ongs pa'i phyogs su brtan ②nas seng ge'i khri rin po che'i snying po can dag bshams te skyil mo krung chabacas nas 'khod do/ /ji ltar gling bzhi pa 'dir rab mtshe ④ma'i gnas su byang chub sems dpa' 'ongs par gyur pa de bzhin du/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa kun tu yang rab mtshe ma'i gnas kyi khang pa nor bu sna tshogs su yang lhags par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang de skad ces bya ba sha stag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan kyang de skad ces bya ba'i zham ringasnyin/ tshangs par spyod pa sha stag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yizhabs kyi bol gnyis nas 'od zer bye ba brgya stong bkye ste/phyogs bcu thams cad snang bar byas nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad bstan te/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa kun gyi rab mtshe ma'i gnas thams cad na yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa yod pa0mthong ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yon tan dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer 'od snang bas/ /phyogs rnams thams cad rnam par snang / /des ni rab tu gsal byas pas/ /mig la rab rib gang yang med/ /mtshe ma rab kyi gnas 'di na/ /gang zag dam pa sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /de bzhin kun na'ang gsal 35—669

bar snang / /de ni 'jig rten ngo mtshar to/ /sems can gtso bo bcu yi rnams / /gshegs par gyur pa dzotshomangon par stonarin/ /de dag 'khor kyang ci 'dra ba/ /de bzhin kun na rab tu snang / /phyogs rnams bcu po thams cad na / /chos kyi dam pa rab tu ston/ /de kun ming yang 'disabazhin te/ /bdag cag rnams kyi kun rdzob bzhin/ /'jig rten khams kyi ming dag kyang / /de zhes bya ba kun nas 'ongs tsho/ /gang zag dam pa de dag ni/ /tshangs pa'i spyod pa 5nide na spyod/ /bdag cag rnams la gang brtags6)pa/ /kun gyi ming yang de dang mthun ri/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams phun 3)ldan pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul ba'o(/ /mi yi 'jig rten kun na yang / /'di nam7rgyal ba bzhugs par shes/ /gzhan gyis de yi rgyal po yi/ /gnas na de bzhin bzhugs pa mthong 11/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad na/ /gang zag dam pa de bzhugs kyang / /rgyal ba mtshe ma rab gnas na/ /bzhugs par bdag cag kun kyang sems/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad na/ /sangs rgyas gzi brjid bsam mi khyab/ /de dag smon lam bskul ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten nyu2khams su rab tu bkye/ /sems can gtso bo'i rnam 'phrul panyunye/ /'di dag de rnams kun gyis mthong / /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas teyi/ /'jig rten zang zing thub pas spangs/ /phyogs rnams thams cad kun tu rgyu'i/ /chags pa med pa nam mkha' bzhin/ /de ni gcig las shin tu 'das/ /mang po dag tu'ang 7mi dmigs so/ /mtha' yas legs mnga' sangs rgyas rnams/ /de dag shes par ji ltar rung / /gnas pa med cing len pa med/ /chos dbyings rtogs par thugs su chud/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' blo gros dang 35—670

ldan pas/ /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'jig rten mgon po 'phrul chen rnams / /rdul med gang zag dam pa dag /'dus shing tshogs pa bsam yas pa'i / /bskal pa dag tu shin tu dkon/ /de dag thams cad kun gzigs pa/ /sems can gtso bo 'od mdzad de/ /srog chags kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /'jig rten mun nag 'di dag tu/ /'jig rten mgon po byung gyur pa/ /'jig rten sgron ma de dag ni/ /blta bar shin tu dka' ba yin/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa'i dngatenyutsho/ /brtson 'grus bsam gtan bsgoms ②pa dang / /shes rab sngon chad spyad pas na/ /'gro ba thams cad snang bamatshimadzad/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba gang yang med/ /de phyir de yi ④mnyam pa med/ /chos rnams yod pa ma yin pas/ /skyes bu 'tshodam pa mthong ba med/ /sangs rgyas shes rab chen po rnams/ /mtshan gyi thotshogs ni bsam mi khyab / /sku yi tshogs kyis shin tu 'phags/ /chos rnams kun gyis yang dag byung ske/ /'jig rten grags chen dam pa'i ⑦rnams/ /dpa' bo chen po de dag snang ske/ /de dag mtshan tsam thos pas kyang / /ngan song thams cad spangs par 'gyur / /bskal pa rnams ni brjod med par/ /byang chub don du 'khor byas kyang ske/ /'di yi tshul ni ma shes na/ /byang chub don du zhugs pa myin/ /sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bskal pa bye bar bkur ba dang / /gang gis tshul 'di bsamatshwakyepa gnyis/ /'di ni de las khyad du 'phags/ /gang gis brjod byas tshezhing gi rnams/ /rin chen gang ste thub gsol kyang / /'di yi tshul ni ma shes na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub de la ring / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 35—671

dpal dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas kyipha17byin gyi rlabs kyis/ phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /nam mkha'7dri ma med pa la/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer mtha' yas pari / /dpyid kyi zla ba thasem la/ /phyogs bcu dag tu rab tu snang / /de tshe spyig rgyu ci 'dra ba/ /de dag bgrang bar mi nus te/ /mig can rnams kyang de la rmongs/ /long ba rnams kyi spyod yul min/ /de bzhin sems can gtso bo yis45/ /yon tan mtha' dang dbus med pa/ /bskal pa bsam gyis myi khyab par/ /sus kyang shes par mi nus so/ /de dag gang nas blangs pa med/ / de bzhin sus kyang byas pa med/ /47)de ni ci las skyes pa med/ /rnam par bsgoms na yod pa myin/ / 'ong ba50med pa'i chos rnams la/ /'gro ba de bzhin myi dmyigs te〈pe/ /de phyir de dag rgyu yang myed / /de bzhin 'jig pa'ang yod pa myin/ /'jig pa myed pa'i chos rnams kyil/ /rang bzhin gang gis shes pas nyu )ni/ /gang la skye ba med pa yi/ /yang dag sangs rgyas mthong ba yin/ /skyes pa med pa'i chos rnams kyi/ /rang bzhin dngos po mi dmigs te/ /de 'dra'i〈medon du shes pas ni/ /nyedamigs pa med pa shes pa nyugeyin/ /'di la shes byed gang yang med/ /chos rnams thams cad mtshan nyid med/ /chos nyid 'di ni shes gyur lakha/ /yongs su shes pa gang yang med/ /skye ba dag ni brjod pa ste/ /de phyir zhing rnams rab tu brjod / /zhing gi rang bzhin shes gyur pal/ /'khrug pa med pa rab tu shes/ /gang tshe 'jig rten zhing yin par/ /tshul bzhin du ni rtogs7byed na/ /de tshe thams cad don bstan pa/ /byang chub sems dpas rab tu shes/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs 35—672

bcur rnam par bltas tenyu/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gnas 'di shin tu rgya che ste/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa yin/ /rtag tu kun tu song ba ste/ /yid du 'ong zhing gnas kyang med/ /de la yang dag brtagasamasabyas shing / /rim gro yod par dad byed na/ /sdug bsngal nam yang mi mthong ste / /ngan song rnams kyang mi mthong ngo / /tshad med de bzhin grangs med pa'i//'jig rten khams su su 'gro bas/ /gang rnams 'di na snang ba yis sangs rgyas byin rlabs thos par 'gyur/ /drang srong chen po'i byin gyi rlabs/ /gang gis thos par gyur nas kyang / /'di 'dra sangs rgyas chos so zhes/ /rtog med bla med byang chub po/ /gang rnams 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyibu / /chos nyid la ni yid ches padu/ /de kun 'jig rten sgron ma ste/ /rkang gnyis ldan pa'i dam par gyur⑥/ /sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul7pa 'di/ /la la zhig gis thos gyur cing / /thos nas dad par byed gyur spun/ /de dag mi yi dam par 'gyur//brtan pa gang rnams da ltar yang / /sangs rgyas chos la dad byed pa/ /de dag don gzigs mi 'jigs pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab par/ /'di 'dra thos pa shin tu dkon/ /smon lam dbang ni ma gtogs par/ /blo gros 'di 'drar hu1'gyur ba myin/ /sangs rgyas dam chos 'di las kyang / /legs par bshad pa gzung78byas shing / /gzhan la ston pa su byed pa/ /de dag bsam gyis myi khyab 'gyur/ /de la brtson 'grus bskyed byas shing / /yid la go carwastebago byas te/ /gang las sangs rgyas brjod pa yi/ /shes pa 'di 'dra mnyan par bya/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' khrel7dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs 35—673

bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras 7)/ /gang zhig thos nas 'di 'dra ba'i/ /dga' ba yangs pa skye ba dang / /the tsom da rnam par gcad pa /ni/ /'jig rten na ni ngo mtshar che/ /'di ltar thams cad gzigs pa'i rnams/ /nyid kyis 'gro la bka' stsal na/ /sangs rgyas mi mkhyen zigang yang med/ /de ltar sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /mi shes pa yi rgyu las ni/ /ye shes 'jug par mi 'gyur te/ /mun pa'i mthu dang snang ba gnyis//lhan cig 'byung bar 6mi 'gyur bstan/ /ji ltar gzugs dang gzugs med pa//bskal 7ba mnyam pa med par bshad/ /de ltar shes dang mi shes pa/ /'grogs par shin tu mi 'gyur ro/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa dag /ji ltar med las brtags pa ltar/ /de bzhin shes dang mi shes pa/ /mtshan nyid bzhin du dmigs pa med/ /ji ltar 'jig rten 'jig ni pa dang / /'du bar 'gyur ba ring ba ste/ /phan tshun 'grogs par mi 'gyur ba/ /shes dang mi shes de bzhin no / /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /thog ma'i sems dang tha ma'i sems/ /lhan cig myi gnas 'byung 9ba ltar/ /shes dang mi shes de bzhin no/ /ji ltar lus dang rnam shes pa/ /gzhan dang gzhan las 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin shes dang mi shes gnyis / /'grogs par 'gyur ba nam yang med/ /ji ltar dug la phan pa'i rtsi/ /'phral du dug ni dug kyi dmyin byed/ /de ltar shes pa mi shes pas11/ /shin tu sol ba byed pa brjod1ge/ /sangs rgyas bla na gang yang med / /de dang 'dra ba'ang yod pa min/ /de las gzhan du 'gyur ba med/ /de bas rgyal ba shin tu dkon/ /de nas byang chub sems hunyedapa' brtson 'grus dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i 35—674

tshe 31tshigs su bcad de ri /smras pa/ chos rnams pha'adi dag 'gal myed par/ /mkhyen nas sangs rgyas thugs su chud/ /des ni mi mkhyen gang yang myed/ /ye shes kyi yang pha rol phyin/ /ji ltar gser dang sa le sbram/ /ngo bo nyid kyis 'gal ba med/ /de ltar chos min rtso de bzhin chos/ /de dag thams cad mtshan nyid gcig /sems can sems can ma yin pa45/ /ngo bo nyid kyis nerang bzhin med/ /gdags su med las 'byung 7ba ltar/ /chos rnams rang bzhin de bzhin no/ /ma 'ongs dus ni ji lta58)bur/ /'das pas 49)brjod par bya ba ste / /de la mtshan nyid yod pa min/ /de bzhin chos la 3 sdumatshan nyid med11/ /'brel bar nyi skye dang 'gog pa dang / /rang bzhin med dang /lharang bzhin dag /rnam pa 7tha dad gyur pa ltar/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin de bzhin no/ /mya ngan 'das pa gzung myed pa/ /gnyis kyi dus na brjod par byas/ /de la bye brag gang yang med/ /de bzhin gzugs la rnam rtog tshapa'o/ /ji ltar ci 7zhig bgrang byas shing / /bgrang bar byed ces brjod pa yang / /de la tha dad gang yang med/ /de bzhin gzugs kyi rang bzhin no/ /ji ltar gcig nas gcig gi blar/ / /mang po'i tshul du bgrang ba yis/ /dngos po grangs med 'gyur ba yang ske/ /blo yi rnam pa tha dad bstan/ /'jig rten khams rnams la la dag /bsam gyis mi khyab tshig gyur kyang / /nam mkha' 'jig par 'gyur ba med/ /rang 'byung nya)ye shes de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'jig rten phyogs bcu yi/ /nam mkha' so sor brtags /rtepa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas rnams mthong ste/ /sangs rgyas rnams la rtog mi mnga'/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' stobs dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcur 2 rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe 35—675

tshigs su bcad de smras 17pa/ ji ltar dus rnams gsum po yis sems can khams rnams brjod par 'gyur ri/ /sems can de dag thams cad kyang / /phung po lnga las shin tu brjod/ /de rnams las kyi phung chen yin/ /las kyi rtsa ba'ang sems yin te/ /sems ni sgyu ma bzhin du bshad/ /sgyu mar gyur pa'ishe'agro 'di'o/ /gang na 'jig rten 'di 'byung zhing / /yang na ldog par 'gyur ba yin / /'jig rten 'jig rten myi byed de/ /gzhan gyi rgyus kyang byas pa myin / /'jig rten 'di ni pa'abyung ba 'byung / /'jig rten 'dir yang ldog par 'gyur/ /'byung zhes brjod par mi bya ste/ /de ni 'jig rten shes pa yin//gang la 'jig rten snang ba zhes/ /'du shes rnam par brtags pa yi/ /'jig rten zhes bya snyogang zhig yin/ /snang 7skub zhes bya'ang5bci zhig yin/ /dus gsum dag tu rgyu ba yi9ri/ /phung po 'di ni 'jig rten yin/ /de dag 'gog pa snang ba zhes/ /'gro ba dag tu 'du shes 'gyur( mee/ /phung po zhes bya 'di ni ci(lha//phung po'i rang bzhin ji lta bu/ /phung po rnams ni mi 'jig phyir/ /dngos po med ces rab tu brjod/ /phung po 'od dag rnam brtagasatshwa don/ /de dag rang bzhin stong pa yin/ /mi 'jig 32don ni stong pa ste/ /dngos po med ces bya ba'o/ /'jig rten ci khubazhin sangs rgyas te/ / sangs rgyas chos kyang de bzhin no/ /masangs rgyas chos dngatshaskyesangs rgyas rnams/ /ngo bo nyid kyisatshamarang bzhin med/ /ma nor yang dag ji bzhin pa'i/ /chos nyid 'di ni rtogs gyur nas/ /kun gzigs thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /sangs rgyas kun natshwanyerab tu snang / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rig pa dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcur rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de smras pa/35—676

rang bzhin dngos po med pa yisahu)/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad kyi/ /sa yi khams rnams ci ②bzhin te / /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar che/ /de yi rang bzhin 'di yin la/ /brjod cing bsngags pa mtha' yas te/ /'das pa'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /sus kyang brjod pa ma yin na(ge/ /gzhan du sems can las kyis na/ /shin tu bstan par brjod pa ste/ /sems can rnams ni ma gtogs par/ /las shes bya ba ci mi dmigs/ /de bzhin stong pa'i las kyisasakyang / /brjod pa rnams ni tshad med par6)/ /sems can kun gyi las su 'gyurazhi)/ /de la ma 'ongs 9)gang yang med/ /ji ltar kha dog dbyibs kyi rnams/ /las kyi rgyudamanyunyeni bsam mi khyab/ /snang yang de dag de na med / /rnam par rig pa'i dngos nyid 'dra/ /de bzhin sems can gtso bo yi/ /sku ni bsam gyis myi khyab pa/ /brjod pa rnams kyang tshad med par/ /zhing rnams kun na rab tu snang / /sku 7ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas min/ /sangs rgyas rnams la sku mi mnga'/ /dpa' bo chen po chos sku ste/ /chos kun rtogs par thugs su chud/ /gang gis rang byung51rnams kyi sku/ /yang dag ci〈nyabazhin mthong ba ni/ /sangs rgyas chos ni rnam kun dang / /chos rnams la yang rmongs pa med/ /'das par gyur pa'i chos rnams kun/ /mya ngan 'das par shes gyur na/ /de dag shin tu mi gnas pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mthong ba yin / /yang dag sangs rgyas sus mthong zhing / /dran pa shin tu bsgoms7byas te / /mtshan med tha dad med pasnyinams/ /de dag chos kyi rgyal po'i sras/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'apha7blo dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ji ltar ri 35—677

mo'i las rnams la/ /tshon 1rnams sna tshogs kun 'du ba/ /kun kyang 'byung ba chen por mnyam/ /sems kyis yongs su brtags pa yin/ /khams la tshonasartsi de dag myed/ /tshon rtsi la yang khams med de/ /khams rnams ma gtogs gzhan na yang / /tshon zhes dbya ba gang yang med/ /sems la ri mo de med mi //ri mo la yang sems med de'i/ /sems de ma gtogs gzhan du yang / /ri mo gang yang mi dmigs so/ /sems de rtag 6pa ma yin pa/ /bsam gyis myi khyab tshad med cing / /phan tshun shes pa myed pa yi/ /gzugs rnams thams cad ston par byed/ /ji ltar ri mo mkhan gyi rnams/ /sems ni gang gis ri mo de/ /bris pa'i sems kyang 7mi shes pa/ /de bzhin chos kyi rang bzhin no/ /sems ni ri mo mkhan dang 'dra/ /sems ni phung po byed pa ste/ /'jig rten khams na ji snyed pa'i/ /'jig rten 'di dag sems kyis bris/ /sems dang 'dra ba sangs rgyas te/ /sangs rgyas ji bzhin 'gro ba'o/ /sems dang sangs rgyas dag la yang / /ngo bo nyid kyis zad pa med/ /sems kyi rgyud rnams ci 'dra ba/ /de dag sangs rgyas rab tu mkhyen/ /de phyir sangs rgyas rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro ba sna tshogs gyur par snang / /lus kyi rnams la sems med de/ /sems la'ang lus rnams yod pa myin/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa'ang rab tu byed/ /de ltar spyod pa ngo mtshar che/ /gang zhig dus gsum thams cad kyi/ /rgyal ba thams cad shes 'dod na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sems kyi dngos/ /chos kyi dbyings su blta bar gyis/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ye shes dang ldan pas / sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gzung du med la 'dzin ces bya/ /snang ba med la 〈snang 35—678

ba ste/ /mnyan du med pa mnyan par byed0ste/ /sems med pa yi na sems dang ldan / /tshad med pa la tshad ma yinas/ /gang zhig 'dzin par mi ca'adod pa/ /de ni tshad med tshad ma yin4༄/ /nam yang 'dzin par mi 'gyur ro/ /brjod du med pa smra byed pa/ /bdag la shin tu bslu ba ste/ /de yi don kyang brjod gemi byed / /srog chags rnams kyang tshim mi'u'agyur/ /de bzhin mtha' yas brjod ldan pa'i/ /brjod pa gang zhig smra 'dod pa/ /bskal pa grangs med zad byas kyang ske/ /rang 'byung spurnams kyis tshibarjod mi zad/ /yid bzhin nor bu dag pa ni / /kha dog kun tu rab tu snang / /de la kha dog yod pa myin/ /sangs rgyas yon tan de bzhin no/ /ji ltar nam mkha' 11dri med cing / /gzugs med bstan du med yin yang / /gzugs rnams thams cad ston par byed/ /nam mkha' snang ba gang yang med/ /de bzhin thams cad gzigs pa nya rnams/ /yon tan kun dang ldan ston kyang / /de ni sus kyang mthong ba med/ /sems la'ang de ni mi dmigs 32so/ /sangs rgyas sgra ni gragasgogemod kyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra ma yin/ /sgra ni ma gtogs gzhan du yang tsha/ /sangs rgyas shes par mi rung ngo / /ji ltar bdag gi 7mthong tshul du/ /'di ni shes bya'i gnas ma yin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub blang du med/ /de la rnam par rtog nyi tshopa med/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams gang dag kyang / /su la'ang sangs rgyas gsung 38pa myed/ /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /de la de 'dra ston pa mdzad/ / shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba las/3tshe rab mtshe tsho )ma'i gnas su byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pas/ tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste/ nyi shu lnga pa lha// //35—679

sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/6) bam po nyi shu lnga napa/ de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' yon tan dang ldan pa②/sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin shin tu rnam par phye ba'i rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba la mnyam par bzhag par gyur to/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' yon tan dang ldan pa byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rnam par phye ba 4)rnam par 'byed pa de la mnyam par bzhag ⑤ma thag tu/de'i tshe phyogs bcu re rer yang / 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i pha rol nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan yon tan dang ldan pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis zhal bstan pa mthong ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis de la 'di skad 6ces bka' stsal to/ /yon tan dang ldan pa de ltar khyod byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin shin tu rnam par phye ba'i rnam par 'byed pa la mnyam par bzhag ci pa legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod la ni de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i5nirdul shin tu phra ba snyed thams cad kyang mtshan mthun spyodapa sha stag gis/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sngon gyi smon lam dang sngon gyi byin gyi rlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa bas shin tu brtan nyi pas na 'di ltar chos bstan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rnam par 'phel bar bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug par bya ba dang /sems can gyi khams rnam par bsgom /1pa dang / chags pa med pa la 'jug 35—680

par bya ba dang / sgrib0)pa med pa'i spyod yul dang / kun nas rab tu sbyor ba dang ske/ thams cad mkhyen paphurab tu bsgrubashepa dang / chos thams cad khong du chud par bya ba dang / dbang po thams cad yongs su shes par bya ba dang /chos bstan pa thams cad yongs su gzung tsubar bya ba dang / 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bcu brtsam ⑤pa rab tu 'thob 6)par bya ba'i phyir/byin gyis brlab pa mdzad kyisal/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu 'a dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis/ chos7bstan pa la spobs 7par gyis shig /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' yon tan dang ldan pa la chags pa med pa nyid nye bar bsgrubasngo1pa mdzad do//bsgrubs pa med pa nyid nye bar bsgrubasngo pa mdzad do/ /byin gyis brlab pa kyi nyid nye bar bsgrub 8pa mdzad do/ /slob skudapon med pa nyid nye bar bsgrub 35pa mdzad do/ /rmongs pa med pa nyid nye bar bsgrubasngo 7pa mdzad do/ /tha dad pa med pa nyid nye bar bsgrub tunyepa mdzad do/ /kha na ma tho ba med pa nyid nye bar bsgrub5)pa mdzad do/ /tshad med pa nyid nye bar bsgrub5) pa mdzad do/ /zil gyis du )mi non pa nyid nye bar bsgrub5nyepa mdzad do/ /zhum pa med pa nyid nye bar bsgrubs rtepa mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid kyi chos nyid thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis/phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' yon tan dang ldan pa'i mgo la byug pa mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis de ltar reg ma thag tu/ byang chub sems dpa' yon tan dang ldan pa/ ting nge 'dzin de las langs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag ste /35—681

byang chub sems dpa'i las ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de ni 'di ltar chos kyi dbyings kyis klas so/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams nyukyi spyod pa la yang slob po/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi spyod pa la yang slob pon/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi spyod pa la yang slob po/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa gang la bsams te4/ de skad du smras pa de dag gang zhe na / kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba rnams kyis gsungs pa dang / gsung ba dang / gsung bar 'gyur ba ste/ bcu gang zhe zin 'di lta ste dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang po dang / bde ba skyed yipa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gnyis pa dang / mi mthun pa med pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gsum pa dang / mi zad pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bzhi pa dang / rmongs pa med pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa lnga pa dang / lta ba bzang po zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa drug pa dang / gnas med pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bdun pa dang ske/ thub par dka' ba 7zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa brgyad pa dang ske/ chos bzang po zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dgu pa dang /bden pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bcu pa dag ste/35—682

kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba rnams kyis gsungs pa dang / gsung ba dang / gsung bar 'gyur ba'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang po dga' ba 37byed pa zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sngon gyi spyod pa'i rjes su slob cing rjes su dran par bya ba dang / yid zhum pa med pa dang / yid dang bas kun tu 'phel bar bya ba dang / yongs su gzung du ba dang / yang dag par bstan pa dang / rjes su rgya che bar byed cing / sdug bsngal ba'i sems can bde bar bya ba'i phyir/ sems can thams cad la bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba dang / 'gyod pa med pa'i sems kyi sbyor ba dang ske/ rnam par sbyin pa la ye brngams③pa med pa dang / grags pa 'dod pa med pa dang / gnyan 'dod pa med pa dang / khe 'dod pa med pa dang /gzhan rjes su bsrung byab dang / pha rol la phan gdags pa dang / sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa'i sems kyis/ sbyin pa'i bdag po sbyin pa byed pa yin techos/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang po'o/ /spyod pa de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ skye bo khumang po'i yid du 'ong ba yin te de ni sems can dbul po gang dang gang na yod pa de dang der smon lam gyi dbang gis rab tu skyes te47/ skyes nas kyang zad mi shes pa'i longs ④spyod dang ldan zhing shin tu phyug 97pa yin te/ de la gal te dus gcig du/ slong ba'i srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs myed pa zhig 35—683

'ongs te/ 'di skad du kye ga17shes par gyis shig /bdag cag thams cad ni bkres pas 'chi'o(ge/ /gal te bdag cag du nakhyod kyi bsha zos na ni 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes tshig tu smra bar gyur kyang / byang chub sems dpa' ni sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa 'di lta bu dang ldan te'i/ slong ba'i srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa de snyed cig nye bar lhags kyang / byang chub sems dpa' la de'i phyir sems bskyed pa gcig4)kyang zhum pa'i bsam pa mi 'gyur gyi/ sems can de dag thams cad la snying rje chen po rab tu skye stenya/gzhan mang po zhig 'ongs kyang de bas 9ches dga' ba dang / spro ba 'byung zhing 'di ltar bdag gis gsol ba ma btab par/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la yang dag par stobs nyu cipa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sdug bsngal zhing slong ba sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa 'di lta bu dag dang 'grogs par gyur pa ni/ bdag gis thob pa legs par thob ste/ ji 1 nas kyang sems can 'ga'i yid kyang mi nyams hunyepar bya ba de ltar bdag gis bya'o/ /bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba ci byas pa dang /ci byed pa dang / sna ci byed par 'gyur ba 8des ji tsam gyis sems can de dag thams cad 'grangs skoshing dus byed par 'gyur ba de tsam du che ba'i lus su gyur cig /sems can de dag 'grangs shing tshim par ma gyur gyi bar du gcad ⑩cing skye nyu bas mi zad pa de tsam gyi lus su gyur cig /dge ba'i rtsa ba des kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par bsgrubs te/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i khams su mya ngan las 'das par〈pebya'o/ /rnam grangs 'di bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can de dag thams cad las 'di 'dra ba dang ldan par gyur te/ de 35wa 684

dag thams cad kyang bdag gi sha ༅zos nasam bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par bsgrubs te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang 5mnyam pa'i ye shes kyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byas nas/ phung po'i lhag ma ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'da' bar gyur cig /bdag nyid kyang sems can gyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par ma byas kyi 9)bar du/bdag du 'du shes pa 'am/ sems can du 'du shes pa 'am/ srid par ga'adu shes pa 'amatsho/ srog tu 'du shes pa 'am/ so so'i skye bor 'du shes pa 'am/gang zag du 'du shes pa 'am/ shed can du 'du shes pa 'am/ shed bdag du 'du shes pa 'am/ byed pa por 'du shes pa 'am/ tshor ba por 'du shes pas(7)/gzhan du chos kyi dbyings nye bar bzung53)ba dang / sems can gyi khams mtha' yas pa'i chos nyid nye bar bzung7)ba dang / stong pa'i chos nyid nye bar bzung 7ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos nyid nye bar bzung 37ba dang /mtshan nyid med pa'i chos nyid nye bar bzung 8ba dang / dngos po med pa'i chos nyid nye bar bzung72ba dang / gnas med pa'i chos nyid nye bar bzung tshab dang ske/ gzhi77med pa'i chos nyid nye bar bzung tshab dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i chos nyid nye bar bzung 0ba ma gtogs par mngon par 'tshang rgya bar ma〈nyegyur cig ces te/rte/ de ni bdag kyang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong /bdag gis du )lus kyang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / len to zhes bya bar yang du stodag par rjes su mi mthong / len pa yang yang nirtedag par rjes su mi mthong ske/ sbyin pa'i gnas kyang yang dag par rjes su mi ri snyemathong ste/ de ni las kyang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / rnam par smin pa yang yang 24dag par 35wa 685

rjes su mi mthong / 'bras bu'ang 17yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / 'bras bu chen po'ang 5yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / 'bras bu chung ngu yang50yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo 4ri/ /de 'das pa'i dus kyi sems can thams cad kyi lus zhig par 5yid la byed do/ /ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sems can thams cad kyi lus 'jig par 45)yid la byed do/ /de 'di snyam du sems te/kye ma sems can 'di dag rang gi lus grangs med pa gzhig ni 'gags tel/'gag 9)cing 'gag par 'gyur yang / snying po med pa'i lus las snying po mi len pa ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /de lta yin gyis 1 rdzobadag gis sems can thams cad bde bas rim gror hu1bya ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su bslab par bya'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang mngon par sangs rgyas te/ chos thams cad / rnam par sbyang ba'i 12phyir/ chos nyid mi 'jig pa nye bar bzungachaste / dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du mthun pa'i 8tshul gyis zhi bar byas pas tsosems can rnams la chos bstan par bya'o/ /snyam du sems te/ kye 7rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i hu)spyod pa dang po ste/ dga' bar byed pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa gnyis pa bde ba skyed pa zhes bya ba sna gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin te/ de ni mi gnas pa yin ri / gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang / reg la mi5)gnas pa ston pa yin / rigs kyi sa bdag nyid che ba la mi gnas pa yin/ rgyud kyi bdag nyid che ba la mi gnas pa yin/ zas kyi bdag nyid che ba la mi gnas pa yin/gzugs kyi bdag nyid che ba la mi gnas pa yin/ longs spyod kyi bdag nyid che 35wa 686

ba la mi gnas pa yin te/ de ltar de ni tshul khrims las yongs su nyams pa med cing ske/ 'di ltar kun nas 'khor ba med pa dang / kun tu btsal ba med pa dang ske/ yongs su gdung ba med pa dang / bar chad med pa dang / gtse ba med pa dang / 'khrug0)pa med par bya'o/ / snad pa mimed par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyis bsngags ④pa'i chos rnams yongs su bzung mngo ④snyam du sems te/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa' de lta bu'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i drung du/ gal te nyin gcigasho'u)tu bdud bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong zhig 'ongs te/bdud re re zhing yang lha'i bu mo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 'dod pa'i cho ga thams cad la mkhas pa/ bde bar rim gror bya ba thams cad thogs pa 4)/ lus kyi rgyan gyis5nyayongs su rgyas pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong re re bsnyen 1)kyang / byang chub sems dpas 'dod pa ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bar du gcod pa yin par nyu1shes nas/ ston pa mngon du gyur pa'i phyir 'dod pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa gcig lha kyang mi 'byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la bya ba dang mi 'bral lo/ /'dod pa'i don du sems can 'ga' hurtel yang sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'gyur ba mi byed de/ chung ngu na srog gi dbang po 'gags par gyur kyang gzhan la mi dga' ba mi bskyed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa mthong nas/ chung ngu na sems kyi rgyud gcig tsam gyis 3lha'adod pa la mi spyod na/ gnyis kyis gnyis sbyar ba lta smos kyang ci dgos te 3ste'adi ni gnas med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni 'di ltar sems skye ste3 sna/sems can 'di dag ni yun ring po nas de ltar gzhol ba dang 18/ de ltar 35—687

'bab pa/ de ltar bab 1)pa/ de ltar mos pa/ de lta bu'i spyod yul can/de ltar nges pa/ de ltar bying ba/ de ltar non pa/ de ltar chags pa/ de ltar zhugs pa yin gyis / bdag gis ni bdud 'di dag dang / bdud kyi bu mo 'di dag dang / sems can thams cad ci nas kyang bla na med pa'i tshul khrims yongs su dag pa la bkod de/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyidasalas7phyir mi ldog par byas nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang gargya bar byas te⑨/ phung po'i phyulhag ma ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur bsrede ltar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su bslabs te⑨/mi bya ba thams cad yongs su spang ba tsodang / lus kyis mi shes pa thams cad yongs su spang ba ma nyu1yin pa dang / sems kyis kyang ma yin pa de ni bdag cag gi las yin gyis1ge/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag712bdag cag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i ye shes kyis sems can thams cad kyi phyin ci log rab tu spang ba'i phyir chos bstan par bya'o/ /phyin ci log ni 8sems can rnams las gzhan na'ang med de/ phyin ci log rnams las kyang sems can rnams gud na med do/ /phyin ci log tu yang sems can 'dus pa ma yin/sems can du yang phyin 8ci log 'dus pa ma yin no/ /phyin ci log rnams kyang sems can ma yin/ sems can rnams kyang phyin ci log ma yin no/ /phyin ci log rnams ni nang na yang med/ phyin ci log rnams ni phyi rol na yang med do/ /sems can rnams kyang nang na yang med/ sems can 8rnams ni phyi rol na yang med de/ chos de dag thams cad ni gsog gsob78brdzun〈nyepa bslu ba'i chos 35—688

can7te/ sgyu ma lta bu byis pa bslusab dngakhu/ ngan pa chung ba snying po med padu/ mi⑧lam lta bu/ mig por lta bu ste/ de dag khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir 'du byed rjes su rtogs pa'o/ /'du byed rjes su rtogs pa'i phyir mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu rnam par 'tshang rgya bar byed de / rgal bas ni sgrol bar byed/ grol bas ni 'grol bar byed/ zhi bas ni zhi bar byed/ dbugs phyin pas ni dbugs 'byin par byed/ bkrusal pas ni 'khru bar byed/ dag pas ni dag par byed/ mya ngan las 'das pas ni mya ngan las 'da' bar byed/ bde bar gyur pas ni bde bar byed pa ste/ bdag cag gis57de bzhin gshegs pa dang skal seb mi mthun par gnas par mi bya ste/bdag cag gis ni 'jig rten gyi spyod pa thams cad spang bar bya'o/ /bdag cag gis ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang ldan par bya'o/ /bdag cag gis ni bla na med pa'i chos mnyam pa 67nyid kyis miganas par bya'o/ /bdag cag hu)gis ni sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pas yang dag par 'jug par bya'o/ /bdag cag gis ni yul thams cad yongs su shes pa dang ldan par bya'ol/ /bdag cag gis ni yongs su spyod pa kha na ma tho ba med pa'i bag chags dang ldan par bya'o/ /bdag cag gis ni rtogs pa thams cad dang ldan par bya'o / /bdag cag gis ni hunye'abyung ba thams cad la mkhas pa dang ldan par bya'o / /bdag cag gis ni bla na med pa'i ye shes kun tu mtha' yas pa brjod du med pa/ mi gnas pa/ 'phos pa med pa/ mtha' dang dbus med pa/ mi zad pa gzugs med pa/ bstan du med pa la rab tu mos par bya'o/ /zhes zer te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gnyis 35—689

pa ste/ bde ba skyed 17pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag / de la7byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gsum pa mi mthun pa med pa zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' chos nyid la brtson te/ bzod pa dang ldan zhing mngon par smra ba'i ngang tshul can yin /te/ de yang bdagashogel gnod parasnyim yin/pha rol la gnod par ne ma yin/ gnyis ka la gnod par ma yin/ bdag bsdu bar na rim yin/ gzhan bsdu bar 9ma yin/ gnyis ka bsdu bar ma yin/bdag yongs su gzung bar 11ma yin/ gzhan yongs su gzung bar hunyam yin/gnyis ka yongs su gzung bar nyu ma yin/ yang dag par blangs pa grags pa'i phyir ma yin gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sems 'di ltar skye ste④/ bdag cag gis sems can skol mi dge ba thams cad spang ba'i phyir chos bstan par bya'o / /'dod chags spang ba dang / zhe snang spang ba dang / gti mug spang ba dang ske/ nga rgyal spang ba dang / 'chab pa spang ba dang / phrag ⑩dog spang ba dang ske/ ser sna spang ba dang / g.yo dang sgyu spang bamatshadang / bzod pa dang nges pa la 18gzhag pa'i phyir/ bdag cag gis sems can thams cad la chos bstan par bya'o/ /zhes te kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa' ni de lta bur bzod cing nges pa dang ldan pa yin pas/ de la gal te srog chags brgya stong bye ba grangs med pa zhig 'ongs la srog chags de dgatshwa)re re zhing yang kha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med par sprul te/ drung du phyin la (3 kha re re nas kyang mi snyan ni1par brjod pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pas mi snyan cing yid du mi 'ong ba dang / mi 'dod pa dang / mi sdug pa dang / mi dga' ba 35wa 690

dang ske/ mi tshul ba dang / 'phags pa ma yin pa dang / 'phags pa ma yin pas brjod pa dang / 'phags pa ma yin pas bsnyen tsho17pa dang / yongs su spang bar〈bya ba sha stag du brjod de lag pa re re zhing yang 'thab cha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa thogs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus la gnod par byas la nyin gcig blunatu ji lta ba de'ubazhin du bskal pa grangs med par yang mtshams med cing ngal mi shes/ skyo mi shes/ rgyun mi 'chad3)/ gtong ba med/sdod 6)pa med/ gcugs gsu med/ dbugs 'byin pa med/ phyir sri ba med par brtags 3 kyang / kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de lta bu'i 'jigs 9)pa chen po mi zadatshwa)pa/ ma rungs pa/ skyi g.ya' ba/ sdug bsngal ba nyams su 'bab pa/tsha 3gleb rtsub pas phog ste/ srog la bab par 'chi ma khad nyi kyang de la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa 'di tsam 1lhadag gis log pa la gal te bdag gis sems 'khrug pa zhig byas su zin na/ de ni ma dul ba dang / mi bden pa dang / mi mkhas pa dang / ma zhi ba dang / ma bsgoms pa dang / ma bsdams pa dang / ma khugs 6pa dang / byas pa myed pa dang —/ mnyam par ma bzhag 8pa dang / bdag gi lus la brten tshapas gzhan gyi sems mgu bar bya bar mi nus kyis 3 zhes te/ de lus dang sems 18rang bzhin shes nas/ thog ma dang tha ma med par skye ba dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rjes su dran nas/ chos 'di dag ni tshul gyis de bzhin no zhes nas/phyir zhing sems dang bar byed/ rab tu dang bar byed/ dga' bar byed/rab tu dga' bar byed/ tshim par byed/ gzengs mtho 19bar byed spro bar byed / rab tu spro bar byed/ 'dul bar byed ṭā/ yongs 21su 'dems 32par 35wa 691

byed de/ de ltar bdag gis nyu)kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos la bzhag⑧ste/ sems can thams cad la yang don 'di bstan par bya'o snyam mo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar lus 'di ni bdag dang bdag gis stong pa ni/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa ste ge / stong pa nyid la ribade ba 'am/ sdug bsngal ba 'am/ gnyis su brjod pa zhugang yang med do/ /gang stong pa de la ci yang med de/ chos thams cad ni ci yang ma yin pa yin gyis / de bdag gis 3)kyang yang dag par shes par byas te49ril/ sems can thams cad la dngos por 'dzin pa spang ba'i 7phyir chos thams cad sna bstan par bya dgos kyis12/ de ltar bdag gis hunye'adi dgasal byams pa'i sems dang / phan pa'i sems dang / bde ba 'i sems dang /snying rje 'ba'i sems dang / snying brtse ba'i sems dang / phan par dga' ba'i sems dang / yongs su mi gtong ba'i sems dang / 'tshang rgyasnyiba'i sems dang ske/ byang chub pa'i sems dang / tsho/ mi 'phrogs tu pa'i sems dang hunye/sangs rgyas kyi tshul gyi 2 rjes su bsnyegs pa'i sems kyis bzod par bya'o snyam mo//kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gsum pa ste/ mi mthun pa med pa zhes bya'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi spyod pa bzhi pa mi zad pa zhes bya ba de 31gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus dang ldan pa yin te/ brtson 'grus mchog dang ldan pa yin/ brtson 'grus rab dang ldan pa yin/ brtson 'grus dam pa dang ldan pa yin/ brtson 'grus phul dang ldan pa yin/ brtson 'grus 'phags pa dang ldan pa yin/ brtson 'grus gya nom pa dang ldan pa yin/35wa 692

brtson 'grus bla na med pa dang ldan pa yin/ brtson 'grus mnyam pa med 3)pa dang ldan pa yin te/ de la 'dod chags kyi rang bzhin med/ zhe sdang gi rang bzhin med/ gti mug gi rang bzhin med/ nga rgyal gyi rang bzhin med ri/'chab pa'i rang bzhin med/ phragashedog gi rang bzhin med/ 'jungs pa'i ④rang bzhin med/ ④sgyu'i57rang bzhin med/ khrel med pa'i rang bzhin med do//de ni sems can gang la yang tho brtsamashepa'i phyir/ brtson 'grus mi rtsoms3)ste/gzhan du na nyon mongs pa thams cad yongs su spang ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsoms9mo / /bag la nyal ba thams cad yang dag par gzhom pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /bag chags thams cad yongs su bsal ba'i phyir/ brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems can gyi khams yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir/ brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /shi ( )'pho dang skye ba thams cad yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir/brtson 'grus rtsom77mo/ /nyon mongs pa thams cad yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir / brtsonarwa 'grus com hunyemo/ /sems can gyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir/ brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems can thams cad kyi spyod yul yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir/ brtson 'grus rtsom mimo sems can thams cad kyi dbang po dang / brtson 'grus rnam pa tha dad pa mchog dang tha ma'i rgyu 8yongs su shes par bya ba'i 7phyir brtson 'grus com hu mo sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa shes par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom 32mo /chos kyi dbyings thams cad la 'jug pa yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom 37mo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang ngo bo nyid yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos 35—693

thams cad mnyam pa nyid yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom nya)mo/ /dus gsum la mkhas pa mnyam pa nyid yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom na)mo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad shes pa'i snang ba mnyam pa nyid yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom lamo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rtogs par 'gyur ba'i ye shes yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad tshul gcig tu mngon par 'tshang rgya ba yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos mtha' dang dbus med pa thams cad mngon par 'tshang rgya ba yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom byumo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rtogs pa'i ye shes chen po la mkhas pa yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom 5mo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rab tu dbye ba bstan pa dang bsgrub 6pa rab tu bstan pa'i rgyus yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom ste ni/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni de lta bu'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa yin no/ /de gal te 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med par nasems can rnams kyi don du sems can re re'i phyir yang bskal pa grangs med par mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por sdug bsngal du 'dug par yang spro zhing mos te/ sems can de dag kyang de tsam gyi bar gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar gyur la/ de'i dus su sangs rgyas bcom ldan ri9'das grangs med pa zhig byung ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag sus mthong ba de dag thams cad kyang bde ba'i yo byad kun dang ldan par gyur kyang byang chub sems dpa' de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang 35—694

chub tu mngon par ①'tshang mi rgya zhing / byang chub sems dpa' de ni 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med par gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi phyir/ sems can re re'i don du yang bskal pa grangs med par sems can dmyal ba chen po na/de snyed kyi sems can yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du 'dug par spro ste/de la la la ②zhig gis 'di skad du rgya mtsho chen po grangs med pa skra'i rtse mos gzhal te 'jig rten gyi khamasalgegangs med pa rdul rmodu blags te/ bgrang ba de 5snyed kyi sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba dang / sems kyi sniskad cig (7)tu yang mi 'bral ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa de lta bu dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro zhes zer na yang /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' ni de la de'i phyir sems bskyed pa 'ga' tsam yang 'gyod pa dang ldan pa mi 'byung gi de ni 'di snyam ste/ de ltar bdag gi mthus sems can 'di dag sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa de lta bu las yongs su grol51)bar gyur pa ni bdag gis 'thong btso rilegs par 'thob po/ /gal 37te thabs 'di 'dra bas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las lha 'da' bar 'gyur na yang / byang chub sems dpas sbyor ba de la spro bar bya ba yin no/ /zhes te/ de bas kyang ches dga' ba dang spro ba skye'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dganyusnye /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bzhi pa ste 14mi zad pa zhes bya'otsha//kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa lnga pa rmongs pa med pa zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' dran pa dang ldan pa yin te/dran pa'i dam pa 'khrug pa med pa/ rnam par 'khrug pa tshamed pa/ brtan pa 35—695

sra ba/ mi shigs pa/ zil gyis tsho〉mi non pa/ yongs su dag pa/ che ba tshad med pa/ rmongs pa med pa dang ldan pa yin te/ dran pa des 'jig rten pa'i spyod pa rnams kyang yongs su 'dzin pa yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshigashekyang yongs su 'dzin pa yin/ gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i tshig kyang yongs su 'dzin pa yin/ gzugs kyi rang bzhin la btags pa'i tshigashekyang yongs su 'dzin pa yin te / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa la btags 5pa'i tshig kyang yongs su 'dzin pa yin/ rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir tshig kyang yongs su 'dzin pa yin te / de 'jig rten 'di nas kyang rmongs pa med par shi 'pho'o/ /'jig rten pha rol tu yang rmongs pa med par skye ste/ ma'i mngal du yang rmongs pa med par 'gro kyi / ma'i mngal nas kyang rmongs pa med par 'byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed pa snyarmongs pa med pas 58)gnas so/ /rmongs pa med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams mgu bar byed do/ /rmongs pa med par sangs rgyas kyi chos la mos par byed do/ /rmongs pa med par bdud kyi las rnams rab tu shes so/ /rmongs pa med par bdud kyi las rnams spang bar byed do5 be/ /rmongs pa med par bskal pa brjod du med par byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa larwa byeganas so/ /de dran pa yongs su dag pa'i yan lag tshad med pa dang ldan pa yin te 11des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'am / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las bskal pa grangs med pa na chos thos par gyur pa 12zab mo zab mor snang ba 'am/ yangs pa'i chos rgyan rnam par phye ba'am / chos sna tshogs tshig 1 dang yi ge sna tshogs kyis 8bstan pa 'am/ byang 35wa 696

chub sems dpa'i rgyan gyi chos sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs snang ba can nam/bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos lhag ①pa'i bsam pa dge ba 'o dang mos pas rnam par dag pa 'am/ 'jig rten thams cad la mi gnas pa'i chos 'jig rten gyi gakhong du chud pa dang 'thun ④pa 'am/ chos yangs pa rgya chen po'i chos su bstan pa 'am/ rab rib dang bral ba'i chos 'jig rten gyis shes par bya ba 'am / 'jig rten thams cad dang thun mongasam yin pa'i chos byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi rjes su song ba 'am/ bla na med pa'i chos thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos kyis rgya cher rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa de lta bu dag thos kyang bskal pa grangs med pas brjed dupar mi 'gyur/ nyams par mi 'gyur/ rgyun 'chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyad pa la ⑧spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can su la yang dran pa rnam par 'khrug par mi byed/ chos rig pa thogs par mi byed/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i blo gros 'jig par mi byed/ gzhan gyi blo la gnod par mi byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag ⑨gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la 'di lta bu'i sgra chen po mtho ba dag dang phrad par gyur te/ drag po'i sgra dang /mi bzad par bos pa'i sgra dang / skyi g.ya'atshwa)ba'i sgra dang / yid du midza/2'ong ba'i sgrarwanyerna ba'i spyod yul du 'ongs pa dang / yid du mi 'ongs pa'i sasgra rna ba'i yul du 'ongs pa dang / sems 'khrug par byed pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa 'khrug par byed pa dang / dbang po drug 'phrog par byed pa dag dang 'grogasalgepar gyur kyang / sgra de lta bu dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i sems skad cig kyang rnam par 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ dran pa rnam par 'khrug par 35—697

mi 'gyur ro/ /spyod yul rnam par 'khrug par mi 'gyur ro/ /mgo rmongs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'khor bar myi 'gyur ro/ /bslad 3)par mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ni 'di ltar sgra de tshon lta bu dag yid du 'ong gzhing 'thun ④par byed pa dang / yid du mi 'ong zhing khong khro bar byed pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med par grags par byed pa dag gis45)/ se gol gtogasalgepa tsam du yang ting nge 'dzin las ldang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /spyod yul las ldang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /chos la 'jug pa las ldang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi spyod pa la gcig 7)tu 'dus pa las ldang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi sems yongs su bsgom na pa las ldang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa las ldang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /chos yang dag pa 7ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par brtags 1 pa las ldang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i 11ye shes rgyun chad 12par mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can yongs su dag par bya ba'i gnas shes pa rgyun chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /don nges par shes pa rgyun chad nyi par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang gis las kyi sgrib par 'gyur ba'i sdig to'i las stsogs tsopar mi byed do/ /gang gis nyon mongs pa'i sgrib par 'gyur ba'i nyon mongs pa bsdud dpar mi byed do/ /gang gis chos kyi sgrib par 'gyur ba'i chos la rim gror byed par sami byed do/ /gang gis chos 'jig par 'ong ba'i sgrib par 'gyur ba 1 dam pa'i chos yongs su spong bar mi byed do/ /de la de lta bu'i sgra'i theshe'ajig rten gyi khams grangs med par grags /tshepa/ mi snyan pa dang snyan pa bskal pa grangs med par mi sdod pa/ 'khrug par byed pa/ sems 'khrug pa/ lus 'khrug pa/ dbang po 'khrug pa/ myos par byed pa/ 'khor bar byed pa/35wa 698

rnyog 1)par byed pa/ rnam par rnyogatshwakyepar byed pa/ kun tu rnyog risapar byed pas / dkrugs5gepar byas ge)kyang / de la byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar sems skye ste(6)/ bdag gis ni 'phags pa'i chos yongs su bsgoms pas nang du mnyam par gzhag par bya'o/ /snyam du )nas de sgra thams cad kyi skye ba la rab tu rtog go/ /gnas pa la rab tu rtogs go/ /'gog pa la rab tu rtog go/ /skye ba'i rang bzhin la 'jug go/ /'gog pa'i rang bzhin la 'jug go/ /gang gis sgra de dag brjod pa de dag kyang de lta bu'i rang bzhin nyid du shes te/ sgras chags par mi 'gyur/ sgras khong khro bar mi 'gyur zhing / de'i dran pa nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /desam sgra de dag thams cad kyi mtshan ma 'dzin cing 9snamatshan ma bskyed 7de/ sgras bsgo thestob la mngon par chags par mi 'gyur12/ sgra la gnas par mi 'gyur(snye/ sgra la mngon par chags parasami skyed do/ /des sgra de dag brtags yin mi dmigs te/ sgra de dag thams cad kyi rang bzhin rab tu shes so/ /rang bzhin de yang byas pa med par khong du chud do/ /mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'i rgyas 'debs shing / chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi tshul du chags pa med pa'i mthar yang rab tu shes so/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa'i mthar thug tshapa/ phyir mi ldog pa mtha' yas pa/ bsam gtan gyi tshul tha dad pa thams cad la rab tu zhugs pa/ting nge 'dzin thams cad la rgyud gcig gi tshul du zhugs pa/ chos thams cad mtha' dang dbus med par nyu 3 rab tu nya hu chud pa'i lus kyi las tsho tshodaben pa dang ldan pa/ ngag du gi las dben pa dang ldan pa/ yid kyi las dben pa dang ldan pas / shes pa rtogs du rtepa'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ming dang sgra med 35wa 699

pa / zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin grangs 31med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang ldan pa 'thob ste/ snying rje chen po yang yangs shing tshad med par byed do/ /gal te de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin stong phrag grangs med pa sems kyi skad cig gcig gis thob par byed kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa de la de lta bu'i rnam par 'khrug pas dran pa rnam par 'khrug par mi ri rinas kyi/ de'i ril phyir zhing pa'adi snyam du sems57skye'o/ /de ltar bdag gis sems can de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i rnam pasngo/rnam par dag pa la rab tu bkod rin de/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las phyir mi ldog par byas la/phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las bzla'o49ske/ /snyam mo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa lnga pa ste/ rmongs pa med pa zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa drug pa lta tshab bzang po zhes bya ba de 11gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la brtebyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dmigs su med cing bstan pa mi dmigs pa'i nyunyelus kyi las dben pa dang / ngag gi las dben pa dang / yid kyi las dben pa thob pa 8yin/ ma chags ma bcings pa'i lus kyi las dang / ma chags ma bcings pa'i ngag gi 'alas dang / ma chags ma bcings pa'i yid kyi las skyam chags ma bcings par bstan pa/ gnas 1 tshomed pa/ mi gnas pa3snye/ sems ji lta ba bzhin du gnas pa/ sems kyi rang bzhin tshad med pa'i rjes su song ba/tshe / chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'byam klas ()pa'i rjes su song ba/35—700

mtshan nyid mi dmigs shing / mtshan nyid bstan du med pa zab pa gting dpags1dka' ba/ de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi rjes su song ba/ rnam par smin pa dang ske/ bral ba'i skyon med pa/ mngon par bsgrubashonyapa la mkhas pa/ 'gog pa dang / mthun⑧par gnas pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings kyis4)spyod yul can/ zhi ba'i rgyud rab tu thob pa⑤/ dngos po med pa'i tshul gyis46)gzhir gyur pa/ tshig gi lam chad pa/ 'gro ba thams cad las 'phags pa/ gnas med pa'i spyod pa rab tu thob pa/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i mtshan ma la mkhas pa/ rtogs pa bcings pa med pa la gnas pa/ de kho na nyid kyi chos pyaganas kyi rjes su zhugs ⑧pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyis mi brjod pa/'jig rten las 'das pa'i gnas dang ldan pa thob pa yin te/ de 'di snyam du sems so/ /kye sems can 'di dag thams cad ni rang bzhin 'di lta bu ste/'di ltar sems can med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /kye 7chos 'di dag thams cad 3 tshorang bzhin 'di lta bu ste/ 'di ltar 'dus byas pa med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /kye zhing 'di dag thams cad ni 'di lta bu'i mtshan nyid de/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid med pa'o/ /kye dus 'di dag thams cad ni 'di ltar nyu1byung ba ste/ 'di ltar tshig gi lam la gzhol zhing chos kun gyi rnam hurtepar tshig gi lam la shin tu gnas kyang / chos thams cad ni tshig gi lam la mi gnas pa'o zhes/ de de ltar chos thams cad zab pa yang rab tu shes so/ /'jig rten thams cad dben pa tunyel yang rab tu 'jug go/ /tso bode de /2ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma bskyed ⑩pa la yang rab tu 'jug go/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang 'jig rten gyi chos su rab tu 'jug go/ /'jig rten gyi chos kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos su rab tu 35—701

'jug go/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos dang 'jig rten gyi chos 'dres par mi byed do/ /'jig rten gyi 1chos dang sangs rgyas kyi chos tha dad par yang mi byed do/ /'di ltar dus gsum la gnas pa'i chos kyi dbyings tha dad pa med pa la yang rab tu 'jug go/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa'am chen po las kyang nyams par mi byed de/ sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba las kyang mi ldog ste/ sems can thams cad bskyab pa'i phyir snying rje chen po yang phyir zhing rab tu 'dzin par byed do/ /sems can gyi khams bdag gis smin par ma byas pa ni su zhig smin par byed/ sems can gyi khams bdag gis dul /bar ma byas pa ni su zhig dul bar byed/ sems can gyi khams bdag gis zhi bar ma byas pa ni su zhig zhi bar byed/ sems can gyi khams bdag gis shes par ma byas pa ni su zhig shes par byed/ sems can gyi khams bdag gis dag par ma byas pa ni su zhig dag par byed de/ de ltar bdag gis de lta bur zab pa'i chos yang dag par mthong la/ gcig pu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu rnam par grol —ribar bya ba 'di ni bdag la tshul dang mi 'dra ba ste/ sems can gyi khams 'di yang mya ngams45 chen po'i lam du zhugs pa/nyon mongs pas kun nas bzung 6 bas mdongs ri7 par gyur pa/ tshor ba nyams su bab pa mi zad pas nad par 85gyur pa/ sred spupas bskor ba'i btson tsorar zhugs pa/ sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas ma g.yos pa/ sdug bsngal gyi phung pos mi hu7skyo ba/ sdom pa gsum gyis bcugs 12su ma rung ba/ mun nag /3gi nang du rab tu zhugs 8pa/ma rig pa'i mngal du skye ba dang / 'chi bas mnar ba 'byung ba ma nyugemathong 35—702

b.rahu)ske/ mi khom par gyur pa/ mi khom pa brgyad thob pa/ sems 5kyi rab rib kyis7dri ma can du gyur pa/ nyon mongs pa sna tshogs kyi nad kyi yan lag gis btab pa/ mya ngama'i chen por 'khyams 5 pa/ lta ba'i mya ngam 6gyis bskor ba'o / /zhes de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi khams la rtog 7pa'i tshe / sems 'di ltar skye ste/ de ltar bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs te/ ye shes kyi snang ba bla na med pa la zhugs nas/sems can 'di dag ni (2)yongs su ma smin cing rnam par ma dul bar bor te/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya ba ni/dus ma yin gyi ⑨bdag gis ni bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par sems can rnams /1byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la yongs su smin par bya'o / /dus 1)de lta bus sems can byang chub tu yongs su ma smin pa rnams yongs su smin par bya'o/ /ma dul ba 32rnams gdul bar bya'o/ /snyam mo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa drug pa lta chub bzang po zhes bya ba ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyod pa de dag la gnas pas/ lha dang bdud dang /tshangs par bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze'i skye dgur tshabacas pa dang / lha dang dri za dang mi dang mi ma yin dang 15/ lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis blta na mdzes shing / byang chub sems dpa' de mthong bas kyang / sems can rnams bla na med pa yang dag par 1 rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu don yod par 'gyur ro/ /thos pa dang bsnyen bkur 18bas kyang /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu don yod par 'gyur ro/ /35—703

dmigs pa gang gis kyang rung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de dang 'grogs pa thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu don yod par 'gyur ro// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/hu) bam po nyi shu drug tshon/pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /desal byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyodasnyipa bdun pa gnas med pa zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' gnas med pa'i sems kyis 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa la 'jug pa yin/ sems bskyed pa re res zhing grangs med pa yongs su sbyong ste/ zhing la gnas mi skyedam pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med pa blta ba'i phyir 'gro zhing / me tog grangs med pa dang / spos grangs med pa dang /phreng ri ba grangs med pa dang / byug pa grangs med pa dang / phye ma grangs med pa dang / na bza' grangs med pa dang / rin po che grangs med pa dang /rgyal mtshan grangs med pa dang / ba dan grangs med pa dang / rgyan grangs med pa dang / mngon par 'du bya ba grangs med pa dang ⑦/ mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i mthar phyin pa dang / grangs med pa'i bsam pas bsam tu med pa'i chos la gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med pa la blta rin ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa dang bsnyen7bkur ba'i don du 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa re re la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med pa mthong yang / sangs rgyas de dag la gnas mi skyed pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams la gnas mi skyed pa yin/ mtshan rnams la gnas mi skyed pa 35—704

yin / dpe〈byad bzang po rnams la gnas mi skyed pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi 'od la gnas mi skyed pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa la gnas mi skyed pa yin / phyogs la gnas mi skyedasapa yin/ phyogs mtshams la gnas mi skyedamachi pa yin / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas mi skyed44)pa yin/byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa la gnas mi skyed55)pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad nyan cing dga' ba skyed de/ bsam pa yangs par byed la/ byang chub kyi sems rab tu 'dzin cing / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la shin tu gnas kyang / sangs rgyas kyi chos la gnas mi skyed rdzi)pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa re re bsnyen bkur tshul yang bskal pa brjod du med pa zad par byed cing / sangs rgyas brjod du med pa mthong bas/ bskal pa grangs med par gnas kyang / sangs rgyas blta ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mngon du bya ba dang / chos nyan⑧pas ngoms mi shes te/ sangs rgyas blta ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyan pa la gnas mi skyed 0do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyanatshwanyedang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / de bzhin gshegs pa khong du chud par byed kyang gnas mi skyed(ge/ chags pa'i sems mi skyed do32/ /'jig rten gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa la zhugs kyang khong khro ba mi skyed/mos pa med pa'i sems mi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpas ni sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid ji lta ba bzhin du/ shin tu khong du chud de / de la ni kun nas nyon mongs pa yang med/ rnam par byang ba yang med/mun pa yang med/ snang ba yang med/ rnam par phye 0ba yang med/ rnam pa tha dad pa yang med/ rnam par rtog hunyepa yang med / gzhan du 'gyur ba yang 35—705

med / bde ba tsho1 yang med/ mi bde ba yang med/ lam yang med/ lam ma yin pa yang med den/ byang chub sems dpa' de ltar chos kyi dbyings la zhugs pa ni sems can gyi khams la yang 'jug ste/ de dag kyang layongs su smin par byed cing rnam par 'dul la sems can rnams la gnas skyed pa yang med do/ /chos rnams kun nas thob par byed kyang / chos la gnas mi skyed5gedo/ /byang chub kyi sems la zhugs pa'i yid kyis 'tshang rgya bar bya ba la yang rnam par spyod de / 'tshang rgya bar bya ba de la gnas mi skyed 5do/ /tshig gi lam yang brjod de/tshig gi lam la gnas par 6mi byed do / /sems can gyi rgyud la yang 'jug ste/sems can gyi rgyud la yang naganas par 9mi byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin kyang rab tu shes shing de dag la yang mnyam par gzhog ste/ ting nge 'dzin de dag la gnas kyi sems kyang 1 rimi skyed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med par 'gro zhing 'jug 11la de dag tu phyin te mthong zhing gnas kyang gnas kyi sems mi skyedarwagedol/ /de dag nas 'gro yang chags pa'i sems mi skyedamanyu de/ de dgamasasems 'di ltar bskyed tshado/ /kye sangs rgyas kyi chos de ltaratsogazung ba med/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub de ltar bsgribs 1 pa med/ chos dang 'dul ba de ltar legs par bstan/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa de ltar legs par gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa de ltar legs par 'dug /byang chub kyi sems de ltar legs par gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa de ltar shin tu rtogs / byang chub sems dpa'i rang bzhin de ltar chags pa med/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul de ltar gnas pa med/ byang chub sems dpa'itshwanyelam de ltar shin tu sbyangs/ byang chub sems dpa'i lung bstan pa nyi de ltar byin gyis 35—706

brlabs kyang / byis pa so so'i skye bo 'di dag ni shes pa med pa/ mthong ba med pa/ ①dad pa med pa/ mos pa med pa/ mi mkhas pa'i tshonaganas la spyod pa / bsam pa rmugs pa/ 'khor ba'i rgyud shin tu 'byung ba la gzhol ba/sangs rgyas blta ④ba la logs④par zhugs pas/ 'dren pa'i sa las nyams pa/lam shes pa'i drung nas gar ba/ kha lo sgyur ba mi tshol4)ba/ stobs bcu la rim gro med pa/ byang chub sems dpa' la drin du mi gzo ba/ dma' ba la gnas pa/ dngos po med pas 'jigs pa/ rigs pas spangs pa/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa la zhugs pa/ mnyam pa nyid las log par lhung ba/ g.yang sa chen por rab tu lhung ba/ bdud kyi bsam pa la zhugs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bsam pa las ring du gyur pa/ srid pa la mngon par chags pa sha stag go/ /zhes de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi khams la 'jug cing snying rje chen po de bas kyang cher bskyed nas/ snying rje chen po rgya cher byas te gnas med pa'i dge ba'i rtsamartso)ba yang dag par bstsags (8)nas/ 'di snyam du sems bskyed rdokhu / /gal te sems can re re'i phyir yul re re dang / phyogs re rer boyang bskal pa brjod du med par sems can re re 'dul ba'i phyir 'dug la/ sems can gcigatshwa)la ji lta ba de bzhin du sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi don du 'dug kyang bdag gis de'i phyir mi dga' ba mi skyed kyi de/ yul de dang phyogs de nas kyang bdag gud du g.yo bar mi bya'o/ /gud du 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /skra'i rtse mo tsam la chos kyi dbyings thams cad 'dus par byas te12/ skra'i rtse mo'i tshul de lta bus skra'i rtse mor chud pa re re 0yang sems can gyi khams yongs su smin par bya ba dang 'dul 8ba'i phyir/ bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du 35—707

med par gnas par bya'o/ /skra'i rtse mo gcig la ji lta ba detubazhin du chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa thams cad la yang ②de ltar te/ se gol gtogs pa tsam du yang gnas kyi 'du shes mi skyed〈kyedo/ /gnas par mi bya'o/ /gnas kyi sems mi skyedams)do/ /skra'i rtse mo tsam55)re re la yang lus gnas med pa dang ske/ chos gnas med pa dang / dran pa gnas med pa dang / smon lam gnas med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gnas med pa dang / rtogs pa gnas med pa dang / spyod yul gnas med pa dang / sems can gyi khams 'dul ba gnas med pa dang / chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa gnas med pas ⑤phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mur thug pa'i bskal par byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod do / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar sems bskyed do4pe/ /bdag gis chos kyi dbyings thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya'o / /bdag gis sangs rgyas thams cad bltar med pa'i tshul du mig yor lta bur shes par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ⑧spyod pa gnas med pa'i phyir/mi lam lta bur shes par bya'o/ /bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos bstan pa brag cha 9)lta bur shes par bya'o/ /bdag gis las kyi rnam par shes pa'i mthu palas byung bas 'jig rten thams cad sprul pa lta bur shes par bya'o/ /bdag gis /(spyod pa'i mthu las byung bas lus ni yid kyi rgyu las byung bar shes par bya'o/ /bdag gis sna tshogs dang 'dres pa'i phyir 'gro ba thams cad ni sems lta bur shes par bya'o/ /rnam par 'gyur ba med pas bdag gis chos thams cad ni yang dag pa'i mtha' dang tshamanyam par bstan par bya'o/ /bdag gis phyogs bcur sna sems bskyed pas rgyas par bkang ste/ chos kyi dbyings 35—708
