kyis klas pa①/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'isko byang chub sems dpa'i spyod chosapa la gnas par bya'o/ /bdag gis sems yangs par bsgyurasreb dang / dran pa gnas med pas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos khong du chud cing / mkhas pa 'tshosems kyi skad cig gcig gis thob par bya'o zhes/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de bdag medang sangs rgyas la bdag med pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par blta 57)zhing /sems can chags pa med pa'i mthar phyin pani/ tshig gi lam gyi sa la smin par byed pa'i tshe dga' ba mtha' yas pa thob pospu/ /sangs rgyas dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos la mos pa/ tshad med pa yang yang dag par rab tu 'thob po//sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i don du7bdag gis skyo ba'i sems mi bskyedasngomado/ /sems can gyi khams yongs su mtshwa)smin cing ma dul gyi bar du skyo ba'i smon lam mi bskyad〈nyedo/ /bdag gisaca'ajig rten gyi khams thams cad las rnam par 'das par 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rgyu bar byas te/smon lam gang la sems can gyi sgra yod pa dang / sems can gyi las dang /sems can nye bar len pa dang / sems can rnam par gzhag pa dang /sems can gyi 'du shes dang ldan pa dang / sems can gyi glong dang / sems can gyi 'du byed dang / sems can gyi yul dang / sems can gyi 'jug pa dang ske/ sems can gyi ldog pa yod pa de la bdag gis gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad 'dul ba'i dbang du smon lam de las g.yo bar yangatshamami bya ste/ sems ⑩bskyed pa gcig gis kyang gnas kyi 'du shes bskyed hūṃ par mi bya'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag gis gnas med pa dang / mi gnas par bya ste3)/ bdag gi don yongs su sbyang b.rarwartebya'o/ /yongs su rdzogs par bya'o 35—709

zhes bya ba 'di ni/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 1byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bdun pa ste/ gnas ②med pa zhes bya'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thub par dka' ba ④zhes bya ba brgyad pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis 5dge ba'i rtsa ba thub par dka' ba/ gdul bar dka' ba/ rab tu gdul 6bar dka' ba/ phyed par dka' ba/ zil gyis mi non pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ kun tu mtha' yas pa mi 'phrogs ④pa bdag nyid che ba/ rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu gyur pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zham ring na/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa la spyodashepa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la shin tu dad pa yin/ yangs 1par dad pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub la shin tu mos pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi the )rgyun mi 'chad pa yin/ bskal pa thams cad du mi skyo ba'i sems dang ldan pa yin / sdug bsngal thams cad kyis 11skyid lug par hu 'gyur ba med pa yin/bdud thams cad kyis 1 phyir brgal du med pa yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis lishin tu byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i dka' thub thams cad kyis rnam par sbyangs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i brtul shugs 8kyis tshad mi rdzoshes pa yin/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam las nyu 7phyir mi ldog pa yin / de la 12byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bsgrub 17par dka'a'i ) ba la gnas te / sems bskyed pa gcig gis bskal 31pa grangs med par 'khor yang phyir mi ldog pa yin tezhuge/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam chen po yang rgyun tri mi gcod 35—710

do / /de mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / sems can rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par byed do/ /thos pa dang bsnyen bkur7bas kyang / sems can rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par byed dol / /sems can thams cad sems can med par yang shes te/ sems can gyi khams yongs su gtong ba ma yin no/ /'di lta ste dper na mnyan pa ni pha rol tu 'gro ba yang ma yin nokha / /ma nitshu rol tu 'gro ba 'ang ma yin/ chu klung gi gzhung la gnas pa 'ang ma yin/ 'gro ba dang 'ong ba rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir pha rol dang da pha rol ma yin par sems can rnams kyang sgrol lo/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang 'khor bar 'gro ba yang ma yin/ mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba yang 6ma yin/ 'khor ba'i rgyud la gnas pa yang ma yin te(spyi/ tshu rol gyi mu nas sems can rnams bskyod de/ pha rol gyi ngogs bde ba/ 'jigs pa med pa/ 'tshe 3)ba med pa/'khrug pa med par rab tu bzhagatso)kyang sems can gyi khams bgrang ba'i 3 5tshul gyis mngon par chags parwa1med do/ /sems can gcig las bskyod nas mang po la mngon par chags par yang dzo/rtemi byed/ mang po las bskyod 12nas sems can gcig la mngon par chags par yang mi byed/ sems can gyi khams 'phel bar yang mi byed/ bri 7bar yang mi byed/ sems can gyi khams skye bar yang mi byed/'gog par yang mi byed/ zad par yang mi byed/ stsogs 8par yang mi byed/rnam par rtog par yang mi byed/ rnam pa gnyis su yang 7mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can gyi khams la zhugs shing khong du chud pa ste/ chos kyi dbyings ji lta bar sems can gyi khams kyang de 35—711

bzhin te/ sems can gyi khams dang chos kyi dbyings de la gnyis su med do/ /gnyis su med pa'i chos la ni 'bripheb 'am/ 'phel ba'am/ 'gag⑧pa yang med de/ chos kyi rang bzhin ni rang bzhin gyis med par 'gyur ba 'am len pa'am / gnas pa 'am/ mngon par chags pa 'am/ gnyis su 'gyur ba med do / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings bstan pa'i tshul du gnyis su med pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings rab tu dbye ba'i mkhas pa khong du ci chud pa yin te/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa'i lus dang / dngos po med pa yongs su shes pa dang / chos kyi mtshan nyid dang rang bzhin yongs su rtogs capas mtshan nyid med pa la gnas pa yin/ de ni sems can rnam pa sna tshogs kyang shes/ sems can gyi grangs kyang shes te/'jig rten gyi khams rnams la 'ang mngon par chags pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du yang snang ngo / /sangs rgyas rnams la yang 'jug cing khong du chud par byed de/ las la rnam par rtog par mi byed do/ /don kyang shin tu rtogs 5)pa yin no/ /don gyi yi ge yang yongs su brjod do/ /chos 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mthar phyin pa thams cad kyang shes so/ /rab tu shes so/ /khong du chud do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang yang mi 'bral te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa las kyang phyir mi ldog go/ /chos kyi dbyings su bzung ba las rinanadabang sgyur 49rabar zhugs pas zad mi shes pa'i spyod pa dang ldan pa yin none/ /'di lta ste dper na/ gtsub ma las byung ba'i me'i rgyu tshad med pas/me'i dgos pa las ma 'gags 7pa yin te/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang ske/ 'jig rten thams cad na sems can gyi don las 'gag7)pa med par 35—712

zhugs pa yin te/ kun gyisatumathar byas pa 'ang ma yin/ kun gyi mtha' med par bya ba'angasam yin no/ /nye bar len pa dang bcas pa'ang ma yin/ nye bar len pa med pa'ang ma yin no/ /gnas pa'ang ma yin( ci/ mi gnas pa'ang ma yin nodu/ /'jig rten gyi chos kyi rjes su song ba yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la gzhol ba yang ma yin no/ /so so'i skye bo du57yang ma yin/ 'bras bu la gnas pa'ang ma yin no/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' thub par dka' ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ spyad bsnyul spyod de/ de ni nyan thos kyi theg pa mi ston to/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa mi ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang ston pa med do/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten gyi chos 7)nye bar len pa med do/ /sems can dang sems can 'jig rten ⑧pa nye bar len pa med do/ /nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba nye bar len pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/chos thams cad kun nas nyon mongs pa med par byang chub sems dpas khutsho yongs su7 shes so/ /chos thams cad nye bar blangs pa tsho/memed par byang chub sems dpas yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad zhugs pa med par byang chub sems dpas yongs su shes so/ /chos thams cad ldog pa med par byang chub sems dpas yongs su shes so/ /de de ltar zhi zhing phra ba dang zab pa dang /bzang po'i chos la spyod pa'i tshe/ spyod do zhes bya bar mi dmigs so/ /32spyad par bya'o zhes bya bar mi dmigs so/ /khams kyi yul dang / skye mched kyi yul dang ske/ nang gi snang ba dang / phyi rol gyi snang ba dang / phyi nang gi snang ba dang ske/ smon lam yongs su bsgrubs lha pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang /chos thams cad du yangs mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos 35—713

kyi dbyings thams cad la ni/ gang nyan thos kyi theg pa la zhugs pa 'am/rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la zhugs pa 'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la zhugs pa 'am/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs pa 'am / so so'i nya)skye bo'i khams la zhugs pu 'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i khams la zhugs pa 'am/ rnam par byang ba'i khams la zhugs pa 'am/ 'khor ba'i khams la zhugs pa 'am/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i khams la zhugs pa'i chos gang yang med do/ /de 2ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di la chos gnyis shes bya57ba gang yang med de nga mi gnyis pa yang med do/ /'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' ni phyogs bcur ma rnyed/ mi rnyed/ rnyed par mi 'gyur yang nam mkhar bgrang ba'i 55tshul yod do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpas kyang chos gang yang dmigs pa med de/ chos thams cad mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes grangs su bgrang ba yang yod de/ de ni yang dag par skyedabaden pa ste/ log pa ma yin no/ /de ni bya ba dang mi 'gal ba'i spyod pa yang ston tori// /smon lam yang mi gtong ngo ske/ /sems can gyi khams yongs su sbyin pa dag gshegadul ba yang byedamatho)do/ /chos kyi 'khor lo yang skor 1 ro/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu yang 'jig par mi byed do/ /chos nyid dang yang 'gal bar mi byed do/ /'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang yang nyunyamanyam par 'gyur ba yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyang rgyun chad par mi byed/ chos kyi tshul dang yang 'gal bar mi byed/ chos kyi rgyud kyang rab tu shes so/ /chos kyi spobs pa yang 'jig par mi byed/ chos thos pas kyang rlom sems med de/chos kyi 'byung gnas kyang rab tu thob/ chos brjod pa yang rab tu byed/ mi 35—714

'jigs pa la yang rab tu gnas/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa yang mi gtong ngo / /'jig rten gyi tshul yang 'gog par mi byed/ 'jig rten mnyam pa nyid kyang rab tu ston tehu)/ 'jig rten gyi spyod pa rnams la yang gnas pa med do/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' thub par dka' ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa la spyod de/ sems can gyi khams kyang / sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas gyen du skyod〈de/ de dag bskyod〈minas kyang yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /'dul bar byed do / /rab tu gzhog par byed do/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi lam gyi rgyud las kyang mi g.yo'o/ /'jig rten gnas pasngonadrin du mi gzo bas yongs su gang ba dang / dgras yongs su gang ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs pas yongs su gang ba dang / mi mthunasronapas yongs su gang ba dang / yid gzhag du mi rung bas yongs su gang ba medang / byis pas yongs su gang ba dang / ma dad pas yongs su gang ba dang / gzhan gyis dring tsho la rgyug pas yongs su gang ba dang /shes rab ngan tho)pas shin tu byung ba dang / 'jig rten gnas pa sred pa'i bsam pa dang / ma rig pas kun nas nyon mongs par gyur pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod de/ de 'di snyam du sems skye'o8 / /'di ltar bdag gis 'jig rten gnas pa drin du gzo bas yongs su gang ba dang / mdza' bos yongs su gang ba dang / mkhas pas yongs su gang ba dang /tshe/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad 12pa lta kyi ngo mtshar du yang ci che ste / de ji lta zhe na/ bdag ni sems can mdza' ba 'am/ mi mdza' ba gang 35—715

las kyang chung ngu na skra'i rtse mo gcig tsam 'amanyasi/ chung ngu na dge bar bya ba sbyin pa tsam yang mi 'dod mi tshol te/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal par byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod kyang / gzhan du na sems can de dag yongs su 'grol ba dang / sems can de dag yongs su dad ②par 'gyur ba dang /sems can de dag 'byung bar 'gyur ba ma gtogs par de dag las7sems skad cig tsam du bde bar 'gyur ba yang mi tshol lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag ni semasamacho skul len pa med cing / thams cad la 'dod pa med pas/ sems can gyi gtso bor 'gyur bar byed pa ste/ 'di ltar bdag gis ci nas mekyang sems can de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mthas gtugs te/shin tu bde ba'i pha rol tu phyin par 'gyur bar nan tan༄du bya'o/ /snyam mo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di dag 75ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ri kyispyod pa brgyad pa ste/ thub par dka' ba zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'ishesras dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dgu pa chos bzang po zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' lha dang 'jig rten du bcas pa/ bdud dang tsho/stobacas pa tshangs par 1 bcas pa/ dge sbyong〈nyedang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgumatshadang /she/ lha dang dri za dang / mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa na / chos kyi mu stegs bzang por gyur pa yin te/ de sangs rgyas kyi rigs mi gcad pa'i phyir / dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ra byed pa yin gzungs hu kyi snang ba rnam par dag pa thob pas/ gtam bya ba dang / lung bstan pa la spobs pa yin/chos dang ldan pa'i gzungs 12thob pas don la spobs pa yin/ chos ji lta ba 35—716

bzhin gyi gzungs7chos7yang dag par bskul7ba thob pas/ chos la spobs pa yin/ tshig dang smra ba thams cad kyi gzungs rab tu thob pas nges pa'i tshig la spobs pa yin/ tshig dang yi ge'i don kun tu mtha' yas shing zad mi shes pa la thogs pa med pa'i sgo'i gzungs thob pas spobs pa thogs pa med ri pa yin/sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i gzungs kyi dbang bskur bas mngon par dga' bar byed pa'i spobs pa dang ldan pa yin/ gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa'i gzungs kyi sgo thob pas snang ba thob pa'i spobs pa dang ldan pa yin/ spobs pa thun mong ba'i ⑤tsal la zhugs pas thun mong gi spobs pa dang ldan pa yin te/don mang po dang tshig mang po dang / yi ge mang po de dngane'u/ de dag la nges pa'i tshig gi ④gzungs kyi sgor tshud 3)pas nges pa'i spobs pa dang ldan pa yin/rgyud mtha' yas pa'i gzungs thob pas mtha' yas pa'i spobs pa dang ldan pa yin te/ des ni stongalo)gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi don du bdag gis lus gser gyi mdog57du mngon par sprul nas/ chos 'byam nyi klas pa thams cad dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo thams cad du chud pas sems can de dang de dag 'dul ba'i dbang du bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du brjod pa dang /dbang po 'byam7klas pa mtha' yas pa rnams la/ lce yangs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis dbyangs kyi yan lag rnam par dag pa dang / dus dang 'byor pa'i chos bstan pa dang / snying rje chen po 'gal ba med pas shin tu bstan pa dang /tshig gcig gi sgra brjod pas 'dul ba ji lta ba bzhin du tshim par 'gyur zhing /mtha' yas par snang bar7ston pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la spyod do/ /de ni gal te sems can re re zhing / tshig gi hunyernam pa tha dad pa'i tshig gi cho ga 735—717

las sna tshogs kyis mngon par 'du byas pa1)/ rnam par sbyin pa brjod kyis7mi lang zhing 'byam ri skuklas pas nye bar gnas pa 0bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong bsam gyis mi khyab par / grangs med pa rnam par phye ba/ rnam pas༄6)tha dad pa brjod du med pa dang ldan pa/ de lta bu'i sems can sha stag byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor du gyur la/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yang 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa betsam du yangs pa zhig yin te/ 'dul ba brjod du med pa zhig 'dus nas / sems can re re la yang kha'i sgo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa brjod du med pa yod par gyur te/ sems can gcig ji lta bar sems can de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin du de snyed kyi 8)kha'i sgo dang ldan patho)/ sems can de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' la skad du brjod pa/ bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa rnam par brtags pas dus gcig tu dbyangs gcig 1 tu byas 11te/ yongs su dri b.ram/2byas kyang byang chub sems dpa' ni de lta bu'i sems can gcig nas gcig 7/—nyetu brgyud 8pa dang / de lta bu'i skad gcig nas gcig 15tu brgyud pa dang de lta bu'i brjod pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su dris pa la 'ang / chos gzung ba khel nyu thogs pa med pa yin/ brjod pa shes par bya ba'i phyir/ rnam par rtog hu pa med pa yin te/ dri 9/)bas the tsomadza —— riyongs su dris pa la thogs pa med do/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gcigasngo tedu ji lta ba de bzhin du 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor brjod du med pa de tsam thams cad du yang de bzhin te/ de la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems so/ /gal te skra'i rtse mo re re las 22sems bskyed pa 2 re re zhing / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor brjod du med pa zhig byung la/ sems skad cig re re༄stel rtog zhu2pa gzhan dang 35—718

gzhan gyis/ skad gzhan dang gzhan du brjod pas chos kyi dbyings thams cad gang bar byed cing 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnam pa de lta bu sha stag cig skra'i rtse mo thams cad las7byung ste/ de7ltar byung bas phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal 5pa'i mur thug par byung yang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag 'byung ring)bas/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal dupa'i mur thug pa yizad par gyur te/ 'khor de rnams ni zad mi shes par byungashel skye ba'i rgyun mi 'chad pa zhig yod du zin na yang bstan par bya ba'i sa de la byang chub sems dpa' sems〈skad cig pa 'ga' tsam du yang zhum pa mi skye'o / / snyom pa mi skye'o/ /tso) sgyid lugasgokyedang / khong snyom 31mi skye'o/ /the tsom5)dang yid gnyis mi skye'o/ /bag tsha ba dang 'jigs pa mi skye'o/ /rmongs pa dang 'khrul 8pa mi skye'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos bzang po la gnas pa de ni 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis sems can 'di dag bedang sems can gzhan rnams dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad kyang tshig gi lam 8gyis yongs su mgu bar byas te/ chos bshad pa'i mthar thug par mi bya/ chos la rnam par thogs par mi bya'o/ /zhes nas/ des brjod pa de dag thams cad kyang rab tu shes te/ sems can de dag la brtag 7mi dgos par 'byung ba'i tshig dang / tshig gi cho ga rnam pa tha dad pa brtag nyi tshomi dgos par 'byung ba dang ske/ tshig gi〈nyernam par gdags pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med nyi par 'byung bas chos ston par byed do/ /de brjod pa de dag thams cad kyang 'dzin la/ sems kyi skad cig gcig gis kyang / tshig thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du dbang bskur ba/ chags pa med pa'i snying po can/ chos thams cad kyi snang ba rab tu thob pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la gzhol ba gcig 35—719

gis sems can thams cad kyang hu)go bar byed do/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa chos bzang po la ②gnas pa ni/ mngon par chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis bdag rnam par dag pa yang rab tu 'thob po/ /sems can med par 'byung ba'i tshul gyis sems can thams cad kyi don kyang yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de ni dus gcigashetu stong gsum pa bcu nas stong gsum pa brjod kyis mi lang ba'i don du byin gyis brlabs shing / bdag gi 4 lus gser gyi mdog du mngon par sprul te/dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad shes pa'i sgor chud pa/ chos thams cad du khyab pas mtha' dang dbus med pa'i chos kyi sgor 'jug cing / sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las bsgrubs terige/ 'jig rten thams cad du rgyu ba 'gags 0pas/'gro ba med pa'i lus rnams ri dang 'gro ba thams cad du 'byung bas mtha' yas par 'gro ba'i lus rnams dang / mi skye ba dang mnyam pa'i chos la brtson pas ma skyes pa'i lus rnams dang / 'gog par brjod pa thams cad dmigs pa med pas 'gagasaman)pa med pa'i lus rnams dang / ji lta ba bzhin du dmigs pas bden pa med pa'i lus rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi bden pa bzhin du rnam par dmigs pas/ bden pa med pa'i lus rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi bden pa bzhin du rnam par dmigs pasalo)mi slu ba'i lus rnams dang / 'chi 'pho ba tsodang skye ba las 'das pas mi 'pho ba'i lus rnams dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin 'jig par mi byed pas/ mi 'jigs5)pa'i lus rnams dang ske/ dus gsum gyi tshig gi lam la brtson pas skad cig gcig gi lus rnams dang ske/ chos kyi mtshan nyid shin tu rtogs pa'i mthar thug pas mtshan nyid med 35—720

pa'i lus rnams dang / lus rnam par phye ba 'byam7)klas pa bcu po de dag dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bskyed pa la sems can thams cad kyi gnas7yin no/ /dbugs chen po phyin par bya ba la sems can thams cad kyi dpung gnyen yin no/ /gnas chen po thob par bya ba la sems can thams cad kyi skyabs yin no/ /bla na med pa'i 'byung ba mthong bar bya bshel sems can thams cad kyi rten yin no/ /chos kyi tshul ladza4)'jug par bya ba la sems can thams cad kyi 'dren pa yin no/ /las kyi rnam par sbyin pa rnam par dmigs par bya ba la sems can thams cad kyi melo57mar yin no/ /chos zab mo rab tu thob par bya ba la 'jig rten thams cad kyi snang ba yin no/ /chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du rmongs pa med par khong du chud par bya ba la khams gsum thams cad kyi sgron ma yin no/ /snangapo ba'i sa rab tu thobs par bya ba la 'jig rten thams cad kyi snang ba yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam paraston 'phrul pa yang dag par bstan par bya ba la 'gro ba thams cad rab tu dga' ba yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dgu pa chos bzang po zhes bya ba ste/ de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni/sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad du 'jug par bya ba la 'gro ba thams cad kyi mu stegs yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bcu pa bden pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' bden pa'i7tshig dam pa dang ldan pas/ bden pa'i tshig can yin te/ de ni 35—721

gang smras pa de byed/ gang byed pa de smra'o/ /de 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bden pa'i gsung la yang slobalo3)bo/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bden pa'i gsung la yang slob bo/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams nasakyi bden pa'i gsung la yang slob po / /'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi (kyerigs la yang ④'jug go/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs la yang 'jug go/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rigs la yang 'jug go/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang 'thob bo/ /ma byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang pa'athob bo/ /da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang 'thob po/ /de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba thams cad dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba lhan cig6)tu gyur pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su bslab rimapa'i ye shes dang ldan pas gnyis su med par smra ba yin no/ /de sems can rnams kyi gnas dang / gnas ma yin pa'i shes pa la yang rab tu 'jug go/ /de sems can rnams kyi 'das pa dang ske/ ma 'ongs pa dang rin/ da ltar byung ba'ilo)las rnam par smin pa shes pa la yang rab tu 'jug go/ /dbang po dang / brtson 'grus rnam pa tha dad pa rdzogs pa dang / ma rdzogs pa dang / rab dang / tha ma shes pa la yang rab tu 'jug go/ /khams 3 tha dad pa dang / khams du ma la yang rab tu 'jug go/ /mos pa tha dad pa dang / mos pa du ma la yang rab tu 'jug go/ /thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam gyi ye shes la yang rab tu 'jug go/ /bsam gtan dang rnam 35—722

par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba rnam par dgod pa/ sems can rnams kyi dus dang dus ma yin0)pa'ang rab tu shes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa thams cadamasasngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i shes pa la 'ang rab tu 'jug go/ /lha'i migasechags pa med par ge yang mngon par sgrub nepo/ /zag pa zad par shes pa'ang rab tu shes te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa nye bar gzung9)ba'ang rgyun mi gcod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni 'gro ba thams cad rnam par dag par bya ba dang / gdul ba'i phyir zhugs pa yin te/ de'i du phyir zhing sems 'di snyam du skye'o/ /'di ltar 'jig rten na stiganas pa yongs su ma grol bar bdag rnam par grol ba'i tshul rab tu shes par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su ma bgrol cing 1 smon lam rjes su ma bsrungs par 17bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba 'di ni bdag la mi cha la32/ de bas na ci nas kyang sems can 'di dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mthas gtugs par 'gyur ba dang / gang 'di phung po 12lhag ma ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings kyi mthar thug par gzhol bar 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag cag ni sems can thams cad kyis gsol ba ma btab cipa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen te/ sems can thams cad kyis ma bskul bar yang dag par zhugs pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la thog mar 'gro ba'o/ /bdag cag ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 'jug pa'i phyir kha lo sgyur 8ba ste/ bdag cag gi tsheni 'gro ba kun gyis gos pa med pa'i 35—723

phyir nyutshomachog tu gyur pa'o/ /bdag cag gi⑧bla na med par kha lo sgyur7ba'i sa la dam par gyur pa'o/ /bdag cag ④ni sems can med pa'i mtha' la rab rib med pa'o/ /bdag cag ni sngon gyi smon lam gyis thob pa dang ldan pa'o/ /bdag cag ni byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan gyi rgyan thams cad kyis shin tu sprul pa'o/ /bdag cag ni sangs rgyas 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byungs ba thams cad kyis yongs su bzung (6)ba'o/ /zhes te de sngon gyi smon lam yang 'jig par mi byed do/ /bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi rgyan la yang rab tu 'jug go//sems can thams cad kyi don kyang yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sngon gyi smon lam ji ltar btab ri75pa yang thog ma dang / bar masnyedang / tha ma'i tshul gyis yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ 'gro ba thams cad rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir / chos thams cad shes pa'i mngon par shes pa'ang rab tu thob par byed do kyi / /hu risems bskyed pa re re zhing yang phyogs bcur rgyas par 'gro ste/ sems bskyed pa gcig nyu1gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa la 'jug go/ /sems bskyed pa re res kyang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa mthong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gi/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyan yongs su dag pa la yang rab tu 'jug go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 8rnam par 'phrul pa'ang yongs su ston to/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par lus tunyebyin gyis brlabs pa/ 'gro ba thams cad du khyab pa/ tshad med pa/ mi gnas pa'ang rab tu shes te/bdag gi lus de dag la 'ang zhing thams cad yongs su 'dus par kun tu ston 35—724

cing ske/ dus gsum gyi sems can thams cad dang / chos thams cad dang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyang rab tu ston to①/ /sems can de dag gi 'du shes kyi rgyud dang mthu la'ang rab tu 'jug go/ /sems can de dag gi bsam pa dang /mos pa dang las dang / rnam par sbyin pa rnam par dag paradza ji tsam pa de tsam du sems can gdul ba'i don du lus byin gyis rlob ⑧ste/ de yang 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' ni sgyu ma lta bu'i chos thams cad kyis shin tu sprul pa ste/mig yor melta bu'i sangs rgyas skye bar bya ba la pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'gro ba thams cad rmi lam lta bur rtogs pa'i yid dang ldan pa'o/ /don dngas yi ge'i tshogs la mi zad pa'i mdzod do/ /dran pas dbang bsgyuraporaba'i chos thams cad la nges par rtogs pa thob pa'o/ /shes rab che ba'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad la yang rab tu zhugs pa'o/ /gnyis su med pa'i sa la rgyud kyi tshul gcig 7ritu gyur pa'o / /sems can gyi khams gnyis la gnas pa la snying rje chen por gnas pa ste/chos de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni chosapoXbacu'i mthar dben par gyur pa ste/ chos kyi dbyings mig 'phrul lta bu la rab tu 'jug cing gnas pa'o / /chags pa med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o//khyu ⑨mchog gi mthu phyung bas seng ge'i sgra sgrog pa'o8/ /mi 'jigs pa rab tu thob pa'o/ /thogs pa med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor71ba'o/ /phyir mi ldog pa'itshwanye'ajig rten gyi khams thams cad du rjes su spyod pa'i ye shes dang rnam par thar pa dang ldan pa(rte/ ye shes rgya mtsho la rab tu zhugs pa'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bzlog pa'i phyir rab tu zhugs pa'o/ /'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor 35—725

lo'i byin gyis rlabs dang ldan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos rgya mcho1re tshul gyi kyirjes su zhugs zhing 5cigating rnyed pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bcu pa ste/bden pa dang ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bden pas/ lha dang bdud dang / tshangs par bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / dge sbyong dang bram ze'i skye dgur ③bcas pa dang ske/ lha dang dri za dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang phrad par 'dong ngo / /shes par byed do/ /tshim gepar byed55)do/ /yongs su dag par byed do/ /de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcu'i50'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed sa ⑦rnam pa drug du g.yos par gyur ton3/ /g.yos so rab tu g.yos so/ /kun tu g.yos so/ /'gul to rab tu 'gul to/ /kun tu 'gul to/ /ldeg go rab tu ldeg go/ /kun tu ldeg gol/ /chem chem rab tu chem chem/ kun tu chem chem mo/ /'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur bur/ kun tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /shig shig rab tu shig shig /kun tu shig shig go/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthus lha rdzas kyi me tog gi sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi spos kyi sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi phye ma'i sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi phreng ba'i sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi gos kyi sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo / / lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /④lha rdzas kyi rgyan gyi sprin gyi char yang mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas kyi rol mo'i sgra yang mngon par byung ngo / /lha rdzas kyi snang ba yang rab tu byung ngo / /lha rdzas kyi sgra 35—726

yang rab tu byung ngo / /gling bzhi pa 'di'i lha'i dbang po rab mtshe 3)ma'i gnas na / ji lta ba de bzhin du phyogs bcu thams cad kyang rgyas par byas te/thams cad na yang sangs rgyas kyi mthus chos 'di'unyid bstan par snang ngo / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed ni'adas pa'i pha rol nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'ongasasrete/ phyogs bcu rgyas par byas nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras/ de ltar khyod byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa'i chos nyid 'di ston pa legs so legs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras/ bdag cag kun kyang ming7yon tan dang ldan pa zhes bya ba dag ste/de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan kun tu yon tan zhes bya ba dag gi drung nas 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan gyi ⑥rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba dag nas phyin te/ thams cad na'ang sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'khor 'di 'dra ba dag na tshig 'di dag dang /yi ge 'di dag dang / bstan pa 'di dag dang / don 'di nyid brjod pas lhag chad med par chos bstan pa 'di ston to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar bdag cag thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 'khor 'dir phyin te ji ltar 'khor 'dir7bdag cag phyin pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling gzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi 9)rab mtshe hu3 ma'i gnas lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe ma'i khang pa nor bu sna tshogs zhes bya ba kun tu yang / byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong gi hu1rdul shin tu phra ba snyed phyin par gyur to// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/12 bam 35—727

po nyi shu bdun panyu)/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' yon tan dang ldan pas phyogs bcur bltas te/ 'khor yod pa thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/chos kyi dbyings la rnam par blta ②zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs yang dag par gzung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rigs yongs su spyod pa ②dang ske/ smon lam gyi rigs phyir mi ldog par bya ba dang / spyod pa'i rigs rgyun tu bsab pa dang / dus gsum gyi rgyud mnyam par bya ba dang / 'das pa dang ske/ ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs yang dag par gzung ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba ji ltar bskyed pa'i rgyudakyibarjod pa dang / dus dang ji ltar 'byor pa'i yan lag dang dbang po dang / bsam pa dang mos pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang / bag chags dang / sems dang spyod pa dang / rnam paras56g.yos pa'i rgyud thams cad yongs su brtagashepa dang /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rigs thams cad snang bar byed cing /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ nam mkha'i lam gyi rgyud gshegs shing / /bsgribs ⑧pa med par gzigs pa rdul rnams sbyangs gyur pa/ /kun tu mtha' yas spyod yul can/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang yang rgyal ba mi yi mchog /chags pa mi mnga' yon tan tshad med mnga' ba ste/ /'das dus mnyam pas mnyam gyur pa/ /rdul bstsalalo)de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams dag na/ /don gyi dam pa gzigs pa brten57pa bzhugs pa rnams/ /mtha' yas nyes pa kun bstsal tu pa/ /gnas med de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /chos dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab par/ /skyes bu 8seng ge gang rnams byon par ma 35—728

gyur pa/ /thugs rje che bskyed rnam spyod pa①/ /phan mdzad de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /dus gsum gzhal du med pa yis/ /rang byung gti mug rnam par bstsalasrib ji snyed pa/ /thams cad chos nyid mnyam pa ste/ /stobs mnga' de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /gang rnams mtha'asredabus med pa yi/ /'jig rten khams kyi srid pa'i rgyud rnams rab gzigs shing / /gzigs nas rtogasho'u)pa mi mnga' ba/ /mi g.yo de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /gang rnams chos kyi dbyings mkhyen cing / /rnam dag don gyi dam pa gzigs pa brtan⑧pa rnams/ /gti mug tha ba nga rgyal sel mdzad7pa/ /legs mnga' de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /gang rnams sems can kun mkhas shing / /chos kyi dbyings la ngo bo nyid kyisalgezhugs gyur pa'i/ /bde gshegs gzhan dring mi 'jog pa/ /⑨mkha' mnyam de dag 7spyod pa 'di yin no/ /'jig rten kun tu mtha' yas pa/ /nam mkha'77klas pa yang dag thugs su chud gyur te/ /zil gyis mi non chos mnga' ba/ /thub mchog de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /ldog pa med pa de dag rnams/ /mi dma'i chos dang ldan pa thub par dka' ba dgatso /smon lam stobs kyi mthar phyin pa/ /spyod legs mnga' ba'i spyod 'di mnyan mipar gyis/ /mtha' dang dbus ni med pa'i sar/ /rjes su zhugs shing thams cad gzigs par gyur pa7rnams / /spyod yul zab mo mnga' ba yi/ /smra ba'i seng ge'i spyod pa 'di yin no/ /rab tu dbye ba'i tshig rgyus la/ /rjes su zhugs shing rgol ba 'dul bar mdzad pa yin⑩/ (nyechos rnams rtog hu pa mnga' ba5)rnams/ /thub chen de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /'jig rten bde ba bskyedamutshamadzad cing / /sems can nyes med thugs dang ldan pa〈nyernams/ /kha lo sgyur 2)ba mnyam stemed pa'i/ /35—729

yon tan tshad med de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /nya'ajigs pa med pa stob (da mdzad cing / /sems can thams cad rab tu tshim par mdzad pa durnams/ /dang zhing rtog pa med pa yi/ /dpe pa med de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /dge ba'i thugs dang ldan par5)rnams/ /bsam pa rnam par dag cing spros pa med pa yi/ /dpal gyi gzi brjid spungs ⑥rgyas pa/ /dpal mchog ldan pa de dag spyod 'di'ol/ /don gyi pha rol phyin pa 3)rnams/ /yon tan 'byung gnas rnam par dag pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /shin tu sems pa'i blo ldan rnams/ /sridasnyenas 'phags pa de 49dag spyod 'di'o/ /bdag med nyams pa med pa tshirnams/ /rnga yi dbyangs rab mnga' ba zhing du gzhol ba dag /chos kyi tshul la gnas pa (1rnams / /tshig la nyams med de dag spyod 'di'o/ /sbyin pas shin tu 'phags pa rnams/ /bsod nams mtshan rab brgyas kyang rab tu brgyan pa dag /'gro la phan par mdzad pa sna rnams/ /blo rab de dag spyod yul 'di yin no/ /ye shes shin tu zab pa'i sar/ /rjes su zhugs shing //blo gros shin tu brtan pa tsornams / /mi g.yo brtan zhing gnas pa dag /brtul shugs brtan pa de dag spyod 'di'o/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa yisaskye/ /rjes su 'jug pa'i pha rol phyin par gyur pa dag /rnam par 'phrul la brtson pa 3 rnams/ /chos kyi nyi ma de dag spyod 'di'o/ /mi mnyam mnyam pa'i blo mnga' rnams/ /mi gnyis yongs su bsgom nyu pa'i ting nge 'dzin ldan pa/ /bsam pa shin tu rtogs7)pa dag /thams cad gzigs pa de dag spyod 'di'o/ /'jig rten khams la rab 'jug pa / / phra dang yangs 3 byedang rgya che'i rnam pa thams cad du/ /spyod du 1yul thob par gyur pa zhu rnams/ /ye shes ri bo de dag spyod 'di'o/ /yongs su dag pa'i 35—730

sems ldan pa/ /khams rnams gsum po kun tu chags pa med pa dag /tshul khrims brtul shugs0)mthar phyin pa/ /rnam dag sems ldan de dag spyod 'di'o//nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas ②gtugs pa'i/ /ye shes 'byam ⑧klas mngon par brjod du medasnyipa la/ /zhugs te bslabs ⑤pa'i blo ldan pa/ /ye shes stobs can de dag spyod 'di'o/ /ye shes gsal7ba'i phung po yis/ /dus gsum chos kyi dbyings rnams bkang ste bsgrubashebyed kyang / /sgyid lug yid du mi 'gyur b.radu/ /sangs rgyas yul zhugs de dag spyod yul lo/ /kun tu 'gro bar song gyur cingashe/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i chos rnams kun kyang shes pa 3 cirnamasal/ /lus kyi chos kyang chags med pa/ /yon tan dpal can de dag spyod 'di'o / /sems can mtha' dang dbus57med pa/ /phyogs bcu'i 32'jig rten dag na rgyu bar gyur pa〈nyernams/ /sems can kun gyi bdag ni skyabs yin pami/ /'jigs med de dag spyod pa 8'di yin no/ /rtag par brtson 'grus gnas 'cha' 8zhing / /nam yang sangs rgyas chos la zhum pa med pa 7rnams/ /de ni 'jig rten sbyang hu)phyir te/ /klu hurtechen de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /dbang po dag gi rgyus shes pa/ /mos pa'i tshul gyis57pa rol phyin par gyur pa ni rnams/ /sna tshogs khams kyang rtogs gyur pa/ /mnyam med rtogs gyur de dag spyod 'di'o / /phyogs rnams bcu po53tshad med pa'i/ /mtha' dang dbus med rin chen mang pos 'gengs byed kyang / /nam yang skyo ba'i yid med pa/ /dad par byed pa de〈nyedag spyod 'di'o/ /'od zer dra ba snyematha' yas pa/ /kun tu 'gyed cing 'jig rten snang bar byed pa7rnams/ /snang ba'i chos rnams rtogs gyur pa / /blo gros bsgoms sum̐ snapa de dag spyod 'di'o/ / rigang zhig phyogs bcu'i zhing 35—731

gi rnams/ /khrag khrig bsam gyis mi khyab thams cad skyod byed kyang / /'jigashepar 'gyur bar mi byed de/ /'jig rten phan pa bskyed la rtag57tu brtson/ /tshig gi tshul la mkhas pa ( la/rnams/ /brjod pa rnam par dbye ba'i pha rol phyin gyur pa/ /shes pa rmongs med mkhas pa dag /mi 'gul〈gesems ldan de dag spyod 'di'o/ /spyi'u tshugs rgyu la mkhas pa dag /zhing rnams rnam par dbye ba'i pha rol phyin pa'ishogernams/ /mi zad sa la zhugs pa'i4)dag /pham med7blo gros de dag spyod 'di'o/ /yon tan khrag khrig tshad med pa/ /byang chub rab la gzhol zhing spyad pa spyod pa dag /yon tan thams cad mthar phyin pa/ /legs pa mi zad de dag spyod 'di'o / /'jig rten 'das ba smra ba'i7rnams/ /smra ba'i dam pa smra ba'i seng ger gyur pa dag /'gro ba dag bya'i mthar phyin pa/ /rnam dag sems ldan de dag spyod 'di'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang bskur bas / /chos kyi dam pa rab la mngon par dbang bskur zhing / /chos kyi tshul gyi rjes su song ba 11rnams/ / yid yangs nyu ldan pa de dag spyod 'di'o/ /'gro ba'i srid pa hu kun srung zhing / /sems can thams cad rnam par bsgomachapa'i yid ldan pa/ /shin tu rtogs pa'i mdzod 'chang rnams/ /chos kyi ri bo de dag spyod 'di'om/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag gcigashegis kyang / /'khor rnams brjod du med pa shes par byed pa dag /dbyangs kyi tshul la zhugs pa rnams/ /chags med mthong ba de dag spyod 'di'o/ /gang zhig tshig lam rjes song zhing / /ye shes shin du 'phags pas rnam par mi rtog pa/ /rnam par rtog tunyemed spyod yul can/ /rang bzhin med mthong de rtedag spyod 'di'o/ /chos kyi rgya mtshor gnas 'cha' zhing / /chos rnams thams cad rgyu yis rab tu 'debs byed pa/ /35—732

mtshan nyid med pa'i tshul ldan rnams/ /dpal gyi tshul can de dag spyod 'di'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i zhing gcig tu/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi dus rnams chud byed cing / /bskal pa grangs medatu'adzud byed pa/ /skyo med brtson pa de dag spyod 'di'o/ /tha dad mtshan can mi yi dbang / /skra yi rtse mo gcigamo la sangs rgyas brjod yas pa/ /gang gis de dag mthong gyur rnams/ /spyod pa bzang ldan de dag spyod 'di'o/ /gang gis skra yi cha tsam la/ /brjod du med pa'i 'dren pa rnams ni mthong gyur cingashe/ /de bzhin chos dbyings thams cad de / /rgyal sras de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /bskal pa brjod du med paskogi rnams / /sems bskyed gcigasnyigis rab tu shes par gyur pa rnams/ /ring dang thung bar nges med pa/ /rnam thar spyod pa de dag spyod 'di'o/ /lta zhing don med mi 'gyur la/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa dag la don yod las ldan rnams/ /chags pa med pa'i yid can dag /rgyal bsnyedam pa de dag spyod 'di yin/ /gang gis sangs rgyas mthong ba'i tshe/ /bskalapo pa khrag khrig nam du'ang ngoms par mi 'gyur bar/ /dga' ba shin tu spyod pa rnams/ /blta na don yod de dag spyod 'di'o/ /sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa/ /sems shing bskal pa mang kyipo zad par byed parwa1rnams/ /sems can med par shes pa dag /sems can gtso bo de dag spyod 'di'o/ /bsod nams mang po bstsags pa /rternams/ /ye shes skyobatshwanyepa bsod nams chen po'i snying po can/ /bsod nams mu stegs 'gro ba yi/ /sems can dam pa'i spyod 'di'o/ /chos dbyings kun tu mtha' yas pa/ /nam mkha'i rnam pa bzhin du de dag tshad med pa/ /tshig gi lam la gnas pa rnams/ /seng ge'i sgra sgrogamasnyede dag spyod 'di'o/ /za gang 35—733

zhig ting 'dzin gcig pu la/ /ting nge 'dzin ni khrag khrig brjod du med pa yi/ /chos kyi gnas su zhugs gyur pa/ /smra ba'i zla ba de dag spyod 'di'o/ /bzod pa'i stobs kyi mthar phyin pa/ /de dag chos rnams thams cad zhi la bzod pa yin / /mi sgul sems dang ldan pa'i hu)rnams/ /mtha' yas shes can de dgaphuspyod 'di'o/ /'jig rten khams ni gcig ri /nas kyang / /de dag lus ni g.yo zhing 'pho 4)bar mi byed par/ /'gro ba kun tu'ang snang bsnyernams/ /mtha' yas lus can de dag spyod 'di yin/ /gang zhig zhing gi tshul rnams kun/ /rjes su 'jug pa shin tu phra ba 46rirab shes kyang / /yongs su rgyas pa'i ri7blo med pa / /mtha' yas sems dpa'abyugade dag spyod 'di'o/ /gnas dang gnas min shes gyur cing / /stobs la 'jug pa dag tu shin tu zhugs pa 6)rnams/ /stobs kyi dam pa 'dzin pa dag /stobs kyis nyu )stobs che0stode dag spyod 'di'o/ /'das pa dag dang ma 'ongs dang / /da ltar byung ba'i las rnams shin tu 'byam klas pa12/ /rtag tu shes pa 'jug gyur pa/ /tshul shes de dag spyod pa 'di yin no / /'gro ba'i dus dang dus myin pa/ /ji ltar sems can 'dul bar 'gyur ba nyi de bzhin shes/ /dus la 'bebs rshapar mkhas pa gernams/ /shes pa de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /chos la spyod pa kun srung zhing / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi rnams kyang srung byed pa/ /bdud kyi lam lamatsham zhugs pa/ /shes pa'i blo can de dag spyod 'di'o/ /rnam par gzhag pa'i rgyus mkhas pa/ /chos rnams la ni ji ltar spobs par 'jug pa 1 rnams/ /de bzhin nyid dang yul mnyam pa/ /bde sna gshegs spyod pa de dag spyod 'di yin/ /chags med mdzod la brtson nyu9pa dag /gzungs kyi sgo mo'i dkyil 'khor rab tu shes pa ge starnams/ /35—734

chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa yi/ /rjes su zhugs pa de dag spyod 'di yin/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /ji snyed bzhugs 3pa kun dang gcig sems yid ldan pa/ /rang bzhin gcig tu rtogs pa 2rnams/ /chags med rigs can de dag spyod 'di'o/ /bsgribasashosamed ye shes tshul shes shing / /bsgribasasremed ye shes phyag rgya dag la zhugs pa〈rnams/ /bsgribasam myed myig kyang bdog byed pa/ /myig can de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /gnyis su med la spyod pa yiX/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam par gzhog pa'i mgon po thams cad kun/ /rnam par 'phrul pa mkhyen pa〈nyarnams/ /gnyis su med spyod de dag spyod 'di'o/ /chos kyi sprin ni mtha' yas pa'i/ /char chen nyutshorab tu 'bebs shing zhing rnams yangs par rgyu/ /don rnams thams cad rtogs gyur pa/ /chos sprin de dag spyod yul 'di yin no/ /dad pa phyir ldog mi 'gyur zhing / /rtsa ba shin tu tshugs shing dad pa rnam dag pa/ /rnam thar hu tshoshes pa thams cad la/ /bslabs 11pa rnams kyi spyod yin mnyan par gyis/ /'gro ba 'di dag ji snyed pa/ /ma lus thams cad sems bskyed gcig nya tu chud byas te/ /sems kyi rang bzhin shes pa nyinarnamasal/ /rang bzhin med pa de dag spyod 'di yin/ /zhing rnams bsam gyis myi khyab pa/ /chos kyi dbyings rnams kun tu gang gis sprul byas shing / /mnyam pa med pasader spyod pa/ /dpe med 'gro ldan de dag spyod 'di'o/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams mutha' yas te/ /de dag kun na 'jig rten mgon po gang bzhugs pa/ /de rnams dang ni mngon sum du/ /sangs rgyas zhabs kyi drung na 'khod gyur pa/ /de dag lus ni gcig dpur yang / /ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag pa rab tu ston/ /lus ni stong phrag mtha' yas pa/ /ting nge 'dzin 35—735

las ldang na shin tu snang / /spyod pa zab dang ldan byas nas/ /spros pa med pa'i spyod pa dag la rab spyod pa/ /dga' ba'i yid dang ldan pa 3)rnams/ /sems can kun la dga' bar byed pa yin ri/ /dbang po tha dad tshul rnams la/ /blo gros gnas shing shes pa rab tu thob pa carnams/ /dbang po dag ni mi gnas par/ /ma dul 'dul ba de tshinodag spyod 'di yin/ /tha dad chos kyi tshul rnams la/ /chos rnams thams cad kun la dbang bas shes gyur pa/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas mdzad pa la/ /dmigs pa'i cho gas 7cirab tu spyod pa yin/ /shin tu yangs pa'i ljags mnga' ba/ /de dag dbang po rnams dang legs pa'i spyod thos 8na/ /su yi sems shig dang mi 'gyur/ /nam mkha' lta buratswade dag spyod 'di yin/ /kun tu mtha' yas shes ldan zhing / /chos rnamasatsokun tu mtha' yas mig yod pa/ /ye shes mtha' yas tshul ldan pa/ /mtha' yas shes can de dag spyod 'di yin/ /zad mi nus pa zad byed cing / /bsod nams 'byam 1 klas yod pas bsod nams mi zad pa/ /'gro ba dag pa'i mthar phyin rnams / /'dra med de dag spyod pa 'di yin no/ /tshogs dang ldan zhing 'jig rten dang / /de dag chos kyi lam la rab tu 'jug byas kyang / /de dag sems can 'du shes med/ /sems can bye ba khrag khrig rab tu 'grel / /nyon mongs med pa rtogs 1 shes shing / /spyod pa mngon par shes pa thams cad mthong ba tso rnams / /bde ba'i lam rnams ston byed pa/ /mig can de dag tshul ni 'di yin no/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyod pa dang / /tshad med yon tan dam patswathob par gyur pa'i tsharnams/ /mi 'jigs pa ni rnyed gyur pa/ /shes canam de dag tshul ni 'di yin no/ /'jug pa kun la rab zhugs shing 38/ /zhing la 'jug 35—736

dang chos kyi dbang la zhugs gyur pa/ /sems can zhugs la gnas byas nas/ /sems can dam pa sems can 'grol0)bar byed/ /phyogs rnams kun tu chos kyi rnga/ / brdung zhing me'ajig rten 'di dag ston byed pa'i/ /chos rab sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams/ /nyams med rtogs skyedam de dag spyod 'di yin/ / skyil mo krung 'dug gcig gegis kyang / /zhing yangs brjod du med pa kun tu rgyas byed kyang ske/ /su yi lus la gnod med pa/ /chos sku ldan pa de dag spyod 'di yin/ /don dang yi ge gcig rgyal yang / /shin tu bstan pa bye ba khrag khrig rjes su 'brang4)/ /de dag mtha' ni rnyed mi nus/ /mnyam med shes ldan de dag spyod 'di yin/ /bsgribs 5she)pa med pa'i tshul shes pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam thar tshul bzhin bslabs pam rnams/ /'jigs pa med par gyur pa dag /tshad med de dag tshul ni 'di yin no/ /de dag phyogs rnams rgya mtsho dang / /zhing rnams rgya mtsho mtha' spudang dbus 1 )med par/ /shes pa rgya mtsho ldan pa yin11/ /chos rnams rgya mtshos 'jig rten tshim par byed/ /gang rnams gshegs 12shing skyes gyur hurtedang / /byang chub rnam par 'tshang rgya 'gro ba kun dag tu/ /su lazhig mngon par snang gyur pa/ /mtha' 15dbus med pa 19de dag spyod 'di yin/ /mya ngan 'da' ba du ma yang / /zhing rnams bye ba khrag khrig 1 tshomangon par snang / /'on kyang smra ba'i seng ge 12rnams/ /mya ngan mi 'da' smon lam phyir mi ldog /chos rnams lhun ni gcig nyurtegyur cing / /sems can kun dang lus kyang gcig tu gyur pa 3 rnams/ /rgyal ba dag la rtog 21med pas/ /lus gcig 22gyur pa lhaspyod 'di yin/ /tshig dang don rnams tha dad pas ci/ /'jig rten khams rnams mtha' dang (snyedabus yod ma yin 7par/ /rang bzhin gcig 2 la mos pa 35wa 737

dag /dus gsum shes pa de dag spyod 'di yin/ /sems can dag dang rgyal ba dang / /chos kyi tshul rnams kun la zad pa med rnyed pa/ /sangs rgyas byin la mos pa dag /rgyal bas byin brlabs de dag spyod 'di yin/ /chags pa med pa'i sku 'dra zhing / /chags pa med pa'i mig gi pha rol phyin pa 3)rnams/ /chags med rna ba mkhas pa dag /chags med yid can de dag spyod 'di yin/ /mngon shes thams cad rnyed pa dang / /ye shes mngon par shes pa'i rjes su song ba na rnams/ /shes pa kun gyi dpal ldan pa/ /shes pa bzang can de dag spyod 'di yin/ /shin tu mnyam bzhag 5sems ldan zhing / /ye shes mtha' yas shes rab shin tu che ba carnams/ /kun tu spyod yul ldan pa dag /thams cad gzigs pa de dag spyod 'di yin/ /yon tan kun gyi mthar phyin pa/ /sems can yangs pa gcig rinanas gcig brgyudas sgrol ba 7rnams/ /yid ni yongs su nyams med pa/ /rtag tu brtson pa de dag spyod na'adi yin/ /kun mkhyen thams cad gzigs pa dag /sangs rgyas thams cad dus gsum gshegs pa mgon po yi / /rigs dang rgyud du skyes pa 9rnams/ /rgyal sras de dag spyod pa 'di yin no / /rjes su bstan la brtson byed pa/ /phas kyi nyu cirgol ba'i lam la 'jigs med spyod pa dang 11/ /mtha' yas blo yi spyod pa dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub rjes su zhugs pa 12rnams/ /mtha' dbus med pa 1gezhing gi rnams/ /thams cad kun tu snang ba gcig 4gis gsal bar byed/ /thams cad snang bar byed pa 7rnams/ /mun pa sel ba'i spyod pa 'di yin no/ /gang du rgyal bas mdzad 'os pa/ /der ni sems can khrag khrig shin tu 'dul skobyed cing / /sangs rgyas sku dang sangs rgyas zhing / /sangs rgyas rgyan can khrag khrig snang bar byed/ /35—738

spyod pa dag ni mtha' yas la/ /su gnas brtan 37pa de dag shes par ji ltar rung ske/ /spyadakupa thams cad shin tu ston/ /'gro ba py-i )spyod pa thams cad mthar thug byed/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa yid/ /bdag gi lus ni brjod du med par gyur pa geyis/ /de dag legs pa brjod byas kyang / /6bskal pa khrag khrig dag gis mi zad do/ /yon tan kun tu mtha' yas shing / /yon tan mchog rnams thams cad mtha' yas pa'i/ /yon tan kun ni brjod byas 3)te/ /thub pas bskal par gsungs kyang zad mi 'gyur/ /rang rgyal rnams dang nyan thos la/ /gzhol bar gyur pa'i 'jig rten gzhan gyi rnams kyisapolta/ /bskal pa brjod yas spubarjod byas kyang / /zad par mi nus de ni smos ci dgos/ /⑩yon tan gyi hunyeme tog 3)shin tu bstsags 12pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu drug pabo// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' yon tan dang ldan pas/ yang byang chub sems dpa' de dag la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gter yin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba rnams kyis gsungs skoso/ /gsung ngo / /gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dad pa'i gter dang / tshul khrims kyi gter dang / ngo tsha shes pa'i gter dang / khrel yod pa'i gter dang / thos pa'i gter dang / gtong ba'i gter dang /dam 'cha'akheba'i gter dang / rtogs nya pa'i gter dang 18/ blo gros kyi gter dang ske/ blo'i gter te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' 35—739

rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i gter bcu po de dag ni/ 'das pa dang /ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs so3/ /gsung ngo / /gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la dad pa'i gter gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad stong pa zhes bya bar dad par byed do/ /chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa zhes bya bar dad par byed do/ /chos thams cad smon pa med pa zhes bya bar dad par byed do/ /chos thams cad ma byas pa zhes bya bar dad par byed do/ /chos thams cad ma brtagasane pa zhes bya bar dad par byed do/ /chos thams cad gnas 5med pa zhes bya bar dad par byed do/ /chos thams cad tshad med pa zhes bya bar dad par byed do/ /chos thams cad bla na med pa zhes bya bar dad par byed do/ /chos thams cad 'dar mi rung ba zhes bya bar dad par byed do/ /chos thams cad 'byung ba med pa zhes bya bar dad par byed do/ /de ni chos dang mthun ri pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa yin te/ chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes bya 45bas zhum par mi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes bya bas 5)zhum par mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can gyi khams thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes bya bas zhum par mi 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes bya bas zhum par mi 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha'i dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes bya bas zhum par mi 'gyur ro/ /mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes bya bas zhum par mi 'gyur ro/ /'das pa'i dus bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes bya bas zhum par mi 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes bya bas zhum 35—740

par mi 'gyur ro/ /da ltar byung ba'i dus bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes bya bas zhum par mi 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa thams cad la 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab po zhes bya bas zhum par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i dad pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ji ltar mkhyen pa bzhin du gcigs1)tu nges par gyur pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi mtha' yang zad mi shes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams rnams kyangs②zad mi shes te/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re' yang mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par byung ngo / / yang dag par 'byung ngo ske/ /④yang dag par 'byung bar 'gyur ro'u/ /yongs su mya ngan las ne'adas so / /yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur te / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de ni 'bri peba'am/ 'phel ba'am/ skye ba'am/'gag pa'am/ 'pho ba'am/ 'gro ba'am/ nye bar byed pa'am/ ring par byed pa'am/ shes par byed pa'am/ 'byin par byed pa ma yin te/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la yang dag par gnas pas zad pa med cing / mtha' yas pa'i gedad pa'i gter dang 3)ldan pa yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /dad pa 'di ni mtha' yas pa/ kun tu mtha' yas pa mi zad pa/ phyir mi ldog pa / myu 0gur gyur pa ma yin pa/ tha dad pa ma yin pa/ ma 'dres pa/ rtsa ba brtan pa/ 'phags pa dang mthun 11pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nya rigs kyi rgyud du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs yang dag par 'dzin pa/byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mos pa yang dag par bskyed nyi pami/ de 35—741

bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 17rjes su song ba/ nges par rtogs pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs la mkhas par gyur pa yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi dad pa'i gter te/ de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad thos par gyur na/ bden par khong du chud de sems can thams cad la rnam par dbye ba'i phyir nan tan du byed par 'gyur ron / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi gter gagang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' thog mar phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ byin gyis ma brlabs pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ mi gnas pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ lhag pa'i ri4)lta ba med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ 'gal ba med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ gzhan la mi gnod pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ ma 'dres pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ skyon med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' thog mar khyaphun sum tshogs pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras ri dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' thog ma nyid du sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde bar sems pa'o)/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' byin gyis ma brlabs pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ mu stegs can gyi gnas dang / mi 'dra ba'i tshul khrims du skuyin te/ de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin 35—742

gyis dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du go cha bgos shing spyod pa'o/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'7mi gnas pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la 'dod pa'i khams la mi gnas pa'i tshul khrims can yin/gzugs kyi khams la mi gnas pa'i tshul khrims can yin/ gzugs med pa'i rikhams la mi gnas pa'i tshul khrims can yin bye/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'khoras de dag la bdag gir ⑧bya ba med de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi gnas pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' lhag par lta ba med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin zhe na / 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'gyod pa med pa'i 6rgyud 3)dang ldan pa yin te / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar mtshams med pa'i las mngon par 'du mi byed de/ tshul khrims lhod pa la gzhol ba ma yin no/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' lhag par lta ba med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'gal ba med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin zhe na / 'di la byang chub sems dpa' ma bcas pa ni 'cha' bar tshon mi byed/bcas pa ni gcod par mi byed de/ de ni mya ngan las 'das pa'imaX9)mthar mthug tu ji ltar mthun 31pa'i chos dang ldan pa yin no/ /gang 32gis pha rol gyi sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'gyur hu ba dang / pha rol 'khrul bar 0'gyur ba'i tshul khrims de lta bu dam bca' ba la dam bcas gshing mi gnas te/ de ni 'di ltar pha rol gyi sems dang bar bya ba'i phyir tshul khrims yang dag par len par byed do/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gzhan la mi gnod pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad brtse tshaba'i 35—743

phyir / tshul khrims kyi rig hu)sngags dang / gsang sngags dang / sman gyi sbyor ba de lta bu mi sgrub kyi/ de ni sems can thams cad bskyab (kyepa'i phyir tshul khrims yang dag par blangs te/ gnas so/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ma 'dres pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' chad par lta ba dang / rtag par lta ba dang / 'dres pa'i tshul khrims yang dag par len par mi byed de/ de ni 'di ltar rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ril rten ripa'i tshul khrims ⑧yang dag par len to/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'imachi6)nyon mongs pa med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin zhe na/yon tan med pa bstan par bya ba'i phyir gzhan gyi sems la rtso)blta gzhing / rtog pa rnam pa sna tshogs su 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /de ni 'di ltar chos kyis ngoms pa dang ldan pa yin te/ 'byung ba'i lam tshol zhing sbyor ba'i tshul khrims yang dag par blangs te gnas so/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' skyon med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims desashelog pa'i tshul khrims nye bar bzung ste/ gang gis pha rol po dma'achaba'i tshul khrims nyu1can du 'gyur bar bdag la mi bstod nya gzhan la mi smod do/ /de ni 'di ltar g.yeng ba med pa nye bar bzung ste/ tshul khrims yang dag par〈nyeblangs shing gnas so/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' kha na ma tho ba med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' srog gcod pa yongs su spangs pa yin te/ ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / brdzun 'du smra ba dang / phra ma'i tshig dang / ngag brlang pa dang ske/ tshig 'khyal dpa dang / chags sems dang / gnod sems dang /35—744

log par lta ba yongs su spangs pa yin te/ dge ba nyunyebacu'i las kyi lamatsha yang dag par blangs te gnas so/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' kha na ma tho ba med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa yinani/ de 'di snyam du sems bskyed gde/gang ji snyam du sems can rnams tshul khrims 'chal ba (de)can la yid ma 'cha' zhing / spyod pa thams cad ⑥ni phyin ci log gi rgyu las byung ba ste/ de ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ⑦zugs su chud de/ phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i sems can rnams ni tshul khrims log pa la spyod kyisal/ bdag gis ni ci nas kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas te/ de bzhin nyid kyi don du chos bstan par 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o snyam mo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims kyi gter te gnyis pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngo tsha shes pa'i gter gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha'i spyod pa nye bar bzung ste/ gang 'di tshe rabs kyi 'khor ba khathog ma dang tha ma med pa'i mirgyas par ma dang 'grogs pa dang / pha dang 'grogs pa dang / zhang po dang 'grogs pa dang /sring mo dang 'grogs pa dang / spun dang 'grogs pa dang / bu dang 'grogs pa dang / bu mo dang 'grogs par gyur kyang / gcig la gcig 31'tshe ba dang / gcig la gcig kyal5)ka byed pa dang / gcig la gcig0geganod par7byed pa dang / gcig la gcig5nye'akhrig pa dang / gcig la gcig sngo kheb dang / gcig la gcig 'jigs kṛ tshopa dang / gcig la gcig 3)'bod pa dang / gcig la gcigarwa1za ba dang / gcig la gcig 3 )dbang ba dang / gcig la 35—745

gcig 3)'khol bar gyur pa de yang 'dod chags kyi dbang dang / zhe sdang gi dbang dang / gti mug gi dbang dang / rgyags pa'i dbang dang / nga rgyal gyi dbang dang / 'chab pa'i dbang dang / gnya' drag gi dbang dang / phrag dog gi dbang dang / 'jungs pa'i dbang dang / g.yo'i ci dbang dang / sgyu'i dbang dang / mi dag pa'ikhulas 'di rnams shin tu blangs pa'i phyir/ sems can cher gcig la gcig tshe'adi lta bu'i rnam pa ngan pa dag nyams su myong bar 'gyur ne te/ thams cad kyang mi shes pa'i dbang gis gyur pa nasatso)/ g.yo dang sgyu'i 8bar gyi dbang gis gyur te/ gcig la gcig 49)bag mi byed/ rim gro mi byed/ gcig la gcig )bkur sti mi byed/ gcig la gcig phulamadud mi byed/ gcig la gcig sna btsam pa med pa dang / gcig la gcig nyunyemi mkhas pa dang / gcig la gcig kyi gnod pa dang / gcig la gcig tugegasod pa dang / gcig la gcig tshedagrar byed par gyur to nyu tshozhes ngo tsha bskyed hu'edo / /ji ltar 'das pa'i dus na bdag dang sems can rnams kyi rnam pa ngan pa 'di lta bu'i tshul byung ba1rte/ de bzhin da ltar byung ba'i dus na yang bdag dang sems can thams cad la rnam pa 21ngan pa de lta bu dag yod do/ /ji ltar da ltar byung ba'i dus na bdag dang sems can rnams la rnam pa ngan pa de lta bu dag yod pa de bzhin ma 'ongs pa'i dus na yang bdag dang sems can thams cad la rnam pa ngan pa de ri 2lta bu dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ni 'das pa dang ske/ ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis kyang thugs su chud do/ /de ltar bdag gi da ngo tsha med cing mi bzod la / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da 35—746

ltar byung ba 31rnams kyisaphagethugs su chud bzhin du/ rnam pa ngan pa 'di lta bu la gnas pa ni mi rigs mi chas / da ni bdag cag gis 3)ci nas kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas/de bzhin nyid kyisamedon du sems can rnams la chos bstan par 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o༅ / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni〈byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngo tsha shes pa'i gter te gsum pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /deshel byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi khrel yod pa'i gter gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' ni mtha' med par tshol bas khrel bar 49)'dzin pa yin te/ gzugs btsal ba dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / regatshwa cibatsal ba dang / bu dang bu mo'i don du btsal ba dang / nor dang / bran pho 11dang ske/ bran mo dang / g.yog yid du 'ong ba btsal pa'i phyir/ bdag gis kyang mi hu)tshul mi cha ba'i gcam bu bya 3)bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes te 0de ni 'tshol 8ba'i dbang du chags pa nye bar mi len to/ /zhe sdang nye bar mi len to/ /gti mug nye bar mi len to/ /de bzhin du nga rgyal dang / 'chab pa dang / phrag tshedog dang / 'jungs pa dang / g.yo dang / sgyu dang / gnod par bya ba nye bar mi len to/ /de 3 'di ltar dran pa skye ste32/ gang ci yang rung ste/ sems can rnams rnam pa 3)ngan pa de 2) lta bu nye bar 'dzin pa thams cad ni ma rig pa'i dbang nas/ g.yo dang / sgyu dang / gnod par byed pa'i dbang gi bar gyis byung ba ste/ de dag gcig la gcig nunyabag mi byed/ rim gro 32mi byed/ bste tsho dzāstang du mi byedapa ste/ phu dud du mi byed cing /35 btsam 20pa med de/ grogs por mi shes shing / gcig la gcig gi rmenyam nga ba 38dang / gcig la gcig 35—747

gsodas37pa dang / gcig la gcigashedagrar len pa 'di lta bu'i rnam pa ngan pa de〈(dag nye bar len to/ /mngon par dga'o/ /mngon par zhen to/ /tshol lo / /kun tu tshol lo/ /kun tu btsal nas mngon par smon to/ /'jal lo/ /kun tu 'jal lo zhi/ /de ltar yang mig nyams pa gede dag lam gang dang gang nas mngal gyi dri mas gos tersā)byung ba/ de nyid du 'khrig pa'i chos la stenashete mi gtsang ba 'byung ba rin ni kun gyis kyang shes so/ /de bas na de ltar bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon la 99khrel med pa'i dbang du gyur nas/ 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku bslu 7ba byed pa 'di ni mi rigs kyisatunye/ da5)ni bdag gis 1 ci nas kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ de bzhin nyid kyi 8don du chos bstan par 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o snyam mo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi khrel yod pa'i gter te bzhi pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 32thos pa'i gter gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' thos pa dang ldan pa yin te/'di yod na 'di 'byung ngo / /'di med na 'di mi 'byung ngo / /'di byung bas 'di skye'o/ /'di 'gags dzapas 'di 'gag go/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos so/ /'di dag ni lung bstan pa'i chos so/ /'di dag ni lung ma bstan pa'i chos so/ /de la ci yod pas gang 'byung bar 'gyur zhe na/ ma rig pa yod pas 'du byed rnams 35—748

'byung ngo / /ci med pas gang med par 'gyur zhe na/ rnam par shes pa med pas ming dang gzugs med par 'gyur ro/ /ci skyes pas gang skyes par ༅'gyur zhe na②/ sred pa skyes pas sdug bsngal skye'o/ /ci 'gags pas gang 'gagasalgepar 'gyur zhe na/ srid pa 'gags pas skye ba 'gag go/ /de la 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams gang zhe na/ gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa'o/ /de la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnamasalgegang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tshul khrims kyi phung po dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po ste/ 'di dag ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos so/ /'dus byas kyi chos rnams gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ 'dod pa'i khams dang / gzugs kyi khams dang / gzugs med pa'i khams dang / sems can gyi khams te/ 'di dag ni 'dus byas kyi chos so/ /'dus ma byas pa'i da chos rnams gang zhe na/ nam mkha' dang / mya ngan las 'das pa dang / so sor brtags te yi'agog pa dang / so sor ma brtags par 'gog pa dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / chos kyi gnas nyid de/ 'di dag ni 'dus ma byas pa'i 7 chos so/ /lung bstan 8pa'i chos rnams gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi dang / tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa bzhi dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ske/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag 1)bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad denya sdu/ 'di 35—749

dag ni lung bstan pa'i chos so/ /lung ma bstan pa'i chos rnams gang zhe na/'jig rten mtha' yod pa dang / 'jig rten mtha' med pa dang / mtha' yod pa yang ma yin/ mtha' med pa yang ma yin 17zhes bya ba 'di ri ni lung ma bstan pa'ol/ /'jig rten rtag mipa dang / 'jig rten mi rtag ri tshopa dang / ris)rtag pa yang ma 6yin / mi rtag pa yang ma yin pa ni/zhes bya ba 'di ni lung ma bstan pa'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa shi phan chad yod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shi phan chad med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shi phan chad yod kyang yod la med kyang med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shi phan chad yod pa'ang ma yin/med pa'ang ma yin she)zhes bya ba ni lung ma bstan pa'o/ /bdag dang sems can rnams yod pa dang / bdag dang sems can rnams med pa dang / bdag dang sems can rnams yod pa yang yin la/ / med pa yang yin pa dang 11/ bdag dang sems can rnams yod pa yang ma yin la 12med pa yang ma yinathe / zhes bya ba 'di ni lung ma bstan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas ji snyed cig yongs su mya ngan las 'das / rang sangs rgyas ji snyed cig yongs su mya ngan las 'das/ nyan thos ji snyed cig yongs su mya ngan las 'das/ sangs rgyas ji snyed cig ma byon/rang sangs rgyas ji snyed cig ma byon/ nyan thos ji snyed cig ma byon/ byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed cig skye bar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs/rang sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs/ nyan thos ji snyed cig bzhugs/ byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed cig bzhugs/ sangs rgyas dag pas su snga/ rang sangs rgyas dag pas su snga/ nyan thos dag pas su snga/ byang chub sems dpa' dag pas su snga/ sangs rgyas dag pas su 'phyi/ rang sangs rgyas dag pas su 35—750

'phyi / nyan thos dag pas su 'phyi/ sems can dag pas su 'phyi/ chos dag pas su snga/ 'jig rten gang nas 'ongs/ 'jig rten gang du 'gro/ 'jig rten gyi khams ji snyed cig chags par 'gyuratu/ 'jig rten gyi khams ji snyed cig gnas pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang nas 'ongs/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang zhig yongs su nga zad par 'gyur/ 'khor ri riba'i sngon gyi mtha' ni gang ske/ 'khor ba'i phyi ma'i mtha' ni gang zhes bya ba/ 'di ni lung ririm bstan pa'o / /de 'di ltar dran pa skye ste④/ sems can gang su yang rung ste/ kun tu rgyug pa dang / kun tu 'khor ba thams cad ni chos 'di dag mi shes pa'i phyir te / de ltar thos pa dang mi ldan pa'i so so'i skye bo 46 rnams kun tu rgyug go/ /kun tu 'khor ro/ /de bas na de ni bdag gis 7ci nas kyang bsam pa thams cad thos pa'i mdzod bzung ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ de bzhin nyid kyi don du chos bstanas par bya'o / /zhes bya ba 'di ni/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thos pa'i gter te lnga pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gtong ba'i gter gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gtong ba dang ldan pa yin/ yongs su gtong ba dang ldan pa yin/ nang gi gtong ba dang ldan pa yin/ phyi rol gyi gtong ba dang ldan pa yin/ phyi nang gi gtong spyo ba dang ldan pa yin/ thams cad gtong 1 snab dang ldan pa yin/ 'das pa gtong ba dang ldan pa yin/ ma 'ongs pa gtong 17ba dang ldan pa yin/ da ltar byung ba gtong ba dang ldan pa yin/ shin tu gtong ba dang ldan pa yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /ji ltar na byang chub 35—751

sems dpa' gtong ba dang ldan pa yin zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' rang bzhin gyis bgo bsha' byed pa'i ngang tshul can yin te/ de rtag tu bgo bsha' byas shing bdag kyang shas7kyis spyod pa yin te/bdag bde bar bya ba dang / bdag yongs su sbyangasab dang / bdag rim grorashebya ba'i phyir/ yo byad ji snyed du bstsags ④pa de dag thams cad kyang bgo bsha' byas shing spyod kyi/ ma bgos par ni ma yin no/ /de dag spyod pa'i tshe yang sems 'di snyam du bskyed ④de/ lus 'di la srin bu'i rigs rnam pa sna tshogs brgyad cu 3)gnas te/ de dag kyang bdag gi57)lus 'di bde bas ni bde bar 'gyur/ bdag gi lus 'di sdug bsngal bas ni sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes de gang ci la spyod pa de dag thams cad 3)kyang myong ba medashepa'i sems kyis de dag mi 'chi ba dang / de dag bde bar bya ba'i phyir gtong ngo / /gzhan yang de 'di snyam du sems te/ yun ring po nas zas dang lus bde ba la chags par gyur gyisatshi/ da ni bdag gis tsho/1lus la chags pa las rnam par 'da' bar bya'o / /zhes bya ba 'di ni gtong ba'o12/ /byang chub sems dpa'i〈geyongs su gtong ba gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' lo8/ zas sam/ skom mamami bza' ba'am/ bca' ba'am/ bldag 8pa'am/ btung ba'am/gzhib /tsho snapa'am/ myang ba'am/ gos sam/ phreng ba'am/ byug pa'am/ rgyan tam7)ci yang rung ste/ gang spyad 3tshen ni 'tsho'i/ ma spyad na ni 'chi bar 'gyur ba zhig nye bar gnas par gyur la/ de'i tshe slong ba zhig 'ongs te/ de las(nyeci nas kyang zad par 'gyur ba dang / lhag ma med par bslangs kyang de la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ sngon gyi mtha' de dag du bdag bkres 35—752

pas shi bar7gyur pa 'ang / dmigs pas mi slebs te/mi/ su la yang phan par ma gyur to/ /de'u'adi ltar rim pas sngonasachad myong ba'i chos can dang /mnyam pa nyid kyis dus byas par7gyur la/ sems can de dag kyang bde bar 'gyur na/ bdag gis 'thobalgepar bya ba legs par thob po/ /bdag gis58)'di dag kyang zad kyang rung / 'chi ba'i mthar yang thug kyang rung ste/ sems can rnams 'tsho bar bya'o/ /zhes gtong ba 'di ni yongs su gtong ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i nang gi gtong ba gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' dar zhing7bzang por gnas pa/ gzugs mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/mdog rgyas pa/ gya rnam pa dang ldan pa/ khrus dang byug pa legs par byas pa/phreng ba dang rgyan legs par btags pa/ gos sar tsho/nyapa ma babs〈rtepa bgos hunyepa/ gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su rgyal por dbang bskur bas dbangalabaskur ba7rin po che bdun dang ldan pa/ de lta bu'i drung du slong ba dag cig 'ongs te⑩/ 'di skad du bdag cag ni nad kyis gzer tunyeto/ /rgas so 'khogs〈nyeso/ /sdug bsngal gyis mnar to/ /nad tshabs che'o/ /nad g.yog med do/ /'chi la thug go/ /gal te khyod kyi lus las lag pa 'am/ rkang pa 'am / sha 'am/ khrag gam/ mgo 'am glad 3 3pa 'am/ rus pa'am/ rkang ngam / su la ci dgos pa de dag khyer cig /ces rgyal po la thag thogs5 1med par rang gi lus bdag cag5 nyebyin na/ lus 'dis bdag cag nad 'di las ldang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems teg rte/ lus 'di lta zhig chos kyis 29de 'dra bar 'gyur yang su la yang phan par ma gyur gyisadu nye/ da sdo nyani de lta bu'i chos can gyi 35—753

lus 'dis sems can 'di dag bde bar 'gyur bar bya'o/ /zhes nas/ de la sems bskyed pa 'ga' tsam yang 'gyod par 'gyur ba med pa 'di ni nang gi gtong ba zhes bya'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa'i phyi rol gyi gtong ba gang zhe na/'di la byang chub sems dpa' gzhung de bzhin du rgya cher dbang bskur ba dang /'khor los sgyur 1ba'i srid la gnas pa/ gling bzhi naril dbang ba/ rin po che bdun dang bde ba'i yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa/ thog mar〈khumangon par dbang bskur ba/ de lta bu'i drung du slong ba dag cig lhags te/ 'di skad du bdag cag 4 ni bkren no/ /dbul lo/ /shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /nor dang mi ldan no/ /khyod ni bde ba'i yo byad thams cad dang ldan nasri/ byam bupo)gling bzhi'i 'khor los sgyur 47riba'i srid bdag cag la rin byin te/ phyis 'di la dbang mi sgyur 9)bar byas na/ des ni bdag cag bde bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer na/de la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ phun sum tshogs pa7 )thams cad ni zad pa'i mthar 'gyur 11te de'i tshe ni su'i bsam pa yang yongs su mgu bar byas par 12mi nus kyis12/ bdag gis da rmeni 'phral du sems can 'di dag gi 'basam pa yongs su tshim par bya'o/ /zhes nas de'i rgyus sems bskyed pa 'ga' tsam yang 14'gyod par 'gyur ba med par gtong ba 'di ni phyi rol gyi gtong ba zhes bya'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa'i phyi nang gi gtong hu 1ba gang zhe na / 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'khor los sgyur 12ba'i srid la 1)de ltar dbang bskur ba/ bde ba'i yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa/ bstsags 1— )par bya ba 21rnam par bstsags 2 ripa/ de lta bu'i drung du slong ba dag cig 'ongs nas/'di skad du khyod kyis ni 'khor los sgyur ni ba'i rgyal po sngon chad kyang myong (ste/35—754

bdag cag ni dge ba ma myong ba yin na/ byam bu 'khor lo sgyur 1ba'i srid bdag cagababyin la khyod kyis bdag cag rim gror bya ba dang / bsnyen ldebakur bar gyis〈geshig ces zer na/ de la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te / bdag gi lus kyi chos nyid dang / srid kyirtsomachos nyid de dag thams cad kyang ske/ tha mar med par 'gyur ba ste/ lus kyang rjes su 'brang bar gnas la srid kyang che ༅zhing slong ba rnams kyang mngon du gyur pa 'di'i 7)tshe/ snying po med pa las snying po blang bar52)bya'o zhes nas/ de'i rgyus sems bskyed pas9ci'aga' tsam yang 'gyod 3 ripar 'gyur ba med par rim gro byed cing gtong ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i phyi nang gi gtong ba zhes bya'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' 11thams cad gtong 12ba gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'khor los sgyur tu ba'i rgyal srid la de ltar dbang bskur zhing / bde ba thams cad dang ldan pa de lta bu'i drung du slong ba dag cig lhags te/ 'di skad du bdag cag ni khyod kyi milegs pa dang yon tan snyan pa thos nas/ grong dang grong khyer dang /ljongs dang khams dngama'irgyal po'i gnas du tsham nas/ khyod ni gdon mi za bar bdag cag gi nya bsam pa yongs su tshim par byed par 'gyur snyam ste/ 'dir phyin na byam rme/nyebu khyod kyis 19bdag cag gi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par gyis shig ces nas/ la la ni bdag cag la rin po che bdun dgos so zhes zer/la la ni bdag cag la gling bzhi dgos 2 so zhes zer/ la la ni bdag cag la rgyal po'i bu dgos so zhes zer/ la la ni bdag cag la rgyal po'i mig gnyis dgos so zhes zer/ la la ni bdag cag la rgyal po'i lag pa gnyis dgos so zhes zer/ la la ni bdag cag 31la rgyal po'i rkang pa gnyis dgos so zhes zer/35—755

la la ni bdag cag la rgyal po'i sha dgos so zhes zer/ la la ni bdag cag la rgyal po'i khrag dgos so zhes zer/ la la ni bdag cag la rgyal po'i mgo dgos so zhes zer/ la la ni bdag cag la rgyal po'i snying dgos so zhes zer na/ de la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ sdug pa dang yid du 'ong ba thams cad dang bral zhing bye bar yang 3)'gyur 35te/ sems can gang gi⑧bsam pa geyongs su tshim par ma gyur gyis6)/ da ni bdag gi yilus 'bral bar 'gyur ba'i chos can 'dis sems can de dag gi chags sems rtse zhil ⑦bar bya ba'i phyir / bsam pa yongs su tshim par bya'o/ bcos pasnyedang ldan pa'i chos kyi gnas su ni sems bskyed par mi bya'o/ /zhes nas/ de dag thams cad btang spuyang de'i phyir de la sems bskyed pa gcig tsam yang 'gyod par 'gyur ba med de/sems can gang la yang / rim gro med par mi byed pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' nyu1thams cad gtong ba'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po nyi shu brgyad pa/sna de la byang chub sems dpa' nyi 'das pa77gtong ba gang zhe na/'di la byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ 'das pa 1gernams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thos pa dang 7/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad nyan cing thos nas/de dag thams cad la chags par mi byed/ 'bral bar mi byed/ dmigs su med pas rab tu 'jug ste/ rtog par mi byed de1 tsho/ rnam par rtog par mi byed/yongs su rtog par mi byed/ smon par mi byed/ chags par mi byed/ zhen par mi byed/ rten pa'i sems kyis gnas par mi byed she/ rmi lam gyi chos de lta 35—756

bu thob par byed kyang / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag la snying po med pa'itu'adu shes mi bskyedakudo/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag la rten pa'i 'du shes su mi byed doṭa/ /'on kyang rten pa'i sems can rnams gzud pasadang / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir brjod do/ /'chad do/ /ston to/ /'das pa'i chos nyid la brtags52na shar phyogs su rjes su mi mthong ngo / /lho phyogs dang ske/ nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs su rjes su mi mthong ngo / /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs su rjes su mi ④mthong ste/ de 'di snyam du gang ci yang rung 3)ma btang ba de ni btang ba'o snyam du sems te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'das pa gtong ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa'i spum 'ongs pa gtong ba gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma byon pa rnams kyi spyod pa nyan na/ mtshan ma'i tshul dang / dngos por 'dzin pas mi 'dzin te/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan la brtson par mi byed pa yin/tshol ba mi mnga' 3 )ba yin/ 'dod chags pa'i sems kyis〈nyemi smon pa yin/de la sems mi sdud pa yin te/ myong bar mi byed do/ /smon par mi byed dol/ /de dag 3getu dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams mi gtong ngo / /de dgatshwanyetu dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams 'jug par mi byed de/ spyod pa yang rgyun gcod par mi byed do/ /'on kyang dmigs tunyepa des tunyesangs rgyas kyi chos su 'grub par bya ba'i phyir3nya/sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang / tshogs sdud parwa tshobyed cing chos nyid kyang rab tu sdud do/ /chos de ni yul na yang mi gnas/ phyogs na yang mi gnas(335—757

nang na yang ma yin/ phyi rol na yang ma yin/ rgyang ring po na 'ang gum yin nor / /drung na 'ang ma yin no zhes de 'di snyam du sems te/ gang du yangalanam yang spyad pa med par bya'o/ /snyam pa 'di ni nga)ma 'ongs pa gtong ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa'itshabed ltar byung ba'irnyugatong ba gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po chen po bzhi'i ris kyi 9)lha rnams dang / sum bcu rtsa 3)gsum pashedang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang ske/ tshangs pa dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs lha nye 3)phan dang /tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / 'od chungatsha/rtedang ske/ tshad med nya snang ba dang / shin tu snang ba dang / dge ba dang / chung dge dang / tshad med dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang / che ba dang / chung che dang ske/ tshad med che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang / mi'og min gyi lha rnams nas/ nyan thos kyi phun sum tshogs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi phun sum tshogs pa dag kyang nyan te/ des de dag thos nas kyang gemongs par mi 'gyur/ shin tu rmongs par mi 'gyur/ rab tu rmongs par myi 'gyur/zhum par mi 'gyur/ kun nas zhum par mi 'gyur/ rnam par zhum par mi 'gyur / shin tu zhum par mi 'gyur/ dma' bar mi 'gyur te/ 'di ltar de ni shes pas 'du byed du gtogs pa thams cad rmi lam lta bur mngon du byed doke//de 'di snyam du gang sbyin par bya ba 'di ni su'i yang ma yin no snyam ste/ ngan song gi lam nye bar gnas pa bzlog par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams 35—758
