cad bsgrub pa'i phyir chos ston kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam mngon du gyur pa'i phyir de la sems rgyu ba med de/ 'di ni da ltar byung ba'i0)gtong ba zhes bya'o / /de la byang chub sems dpa' geshin tu gtong ba gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can mig dang mi ldan pa dang / rna ba dang mi ldan pa dang / sna dang mi ldan pa dang / lce dang mi ldan pa dang / lus dang mi ldan pa grangs med pa zhig gis 'di skad du bdag cag la50ci med pa de khyod kyisasrebyin la/ nged mi ldan pa med par gyis shig /khyod ni bskal pa grangs med par mi ldan par 'dug cigs3)ces zer na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni de thos ma thag tu sems can de dag mi ldan pa med par bsgrub yiste/ bskal pa grangs med par dbang po dang mi ldan pa de yang nyams su len to/ /de ma'i lto na 'dug pa'i tshe ji lta bur spyod pa dang / mer mer por〈pe'adug pa ji lta bu yin pa dang rdos par gyur pa ji lta bu yin pa dang / 'khregs du8)par gyur pa ji lta bu yin pa dang / dbang po grub pa ji lta bu yin pa dang / skyes pa ji lta bu yin pa dang ske/ rgas pas47ji lta bu yin pa dang / na ba ji lta bu yin pa dang / shi ba ji lta bu yin pa dang / lus kyi rang bzhin thog ma dang / bar ma 3 )dang / tha ma ji lta batshwa)bzhin du yang dag par rab tu shes so/ /ngom du mi rung ba dang lhan/ngo tsha hu skye ba 'phags pa ma yin pa/ dri mi zhim pa/ rjen 8pa'i dri can ror 'gyur bci/ rus pa stsogs mipa sha dang khrag gis g.yogs pa/ rma dgu nas rtag tu hu tshozag pa'o/ /zhes hunyede ni sems bskyed pa gcigapha/rjetsam gyis kyang / de don du gnyer bar mi sems te/ sems bskyed pa gcig 3 )gis kyang chags pa mi bskyed 31do/ /de shin tu gtong ba des 'dzin pa med pa'i yid dang ldan pa yin 35—759

te / lus 'di ni de ltar7snying po med pa yin na/ bdag gis lus 'di snying po med par mthong badza bzhin du lus la chags pasaji ltar byarjo/ sems can 'di dag gi bsam pa de bzhin du yongs su tshim par bya'o/ /lus snying po med pa 'dis 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /'gro ba thams cad kyis kyang shes par bya'o/ /ye shes kyi tshogs gang yang rung ba la yang mi gnas pa'i tshul gyis gzhag par bya'o zhes nas yilus kyi 'du shes kyang med/sems kyi 'du shes kyang med de/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di nisnyebyang chub sems dpa'i gtong ba'i gter te7drug pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi gter gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gzugs rab tu shes so/ /gzugs kun 'byung ba rab tu shes so/ /gzugs kyi 'gog pa rab tu shes so/ /gzugs 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam yang dag par tshiji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang dag pa ji lta ba7bzhin du rab tu hunyeshes so/ /rnam par shes pa'i kun5nye'abyung ba yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin dusarab tu shes so/ /rnam par shes pa 'gog pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ / rnam par shes pa 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tsom rig pa rab tu shes so/ /ma rig pas7kun 'byung ba rab tu shes so/ /ma rig pa 'gog pa yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /ma rig pa 'gog par 'gro7)ba'i lam yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sred pa rab tu shes so/ /sred pa kun 'byung ba rab tu shes so/ /sred pa 'gog pa rab tu shes so/ /sred pa 'gog 35—760

par 'gro ba'i lam yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /nyan thos rab tu shes so/ /nyan thos kyi chos rab tu7shes so/ /nyan thos kyi kun 'byung ba rab tu shes so/ /nyan thos kyi mya ngan las 'da' ba yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas rab tu shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi chos rab tu shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi7kun 'byung ba rab tu shes so/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rab tu shes so/ sabyang chub sems dpa'i kun 'byung ba rab tu shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' 0yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /ji ltar shes she na las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa dang / bya ba dang / mngon par 'du byed pa dang / gso ba dang / gsog dang / snying po med pa dang / bdag med par rab tu shes te/ chos gang yang snying po can du shes pa med do/ /chos gang la yang rang bzhin du 'dogs pa med de/ ngo bo nyidakyimathas gtugs pasre thams cad rab tu shes so/ /sems can0rnams la yang de bzhin nyid kyi don du chos ston te de ci'uston ce na/ 'jig7pa med pa'i phyir chos ston te/ gang 'jig pa med pa'i phyir zhe na/ gzugs 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ tshor ba 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ 'du shes 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ 'du byed 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes pa 'jig pa med pa'i phyir chos ston〈nye to/ /ma rig pa 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi chos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos 'jig pa med pa'i phyir chos ston to//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos ni〈nyem skyes pa'/ 'dutsom byas pa/ byed pa po med 35—761

pal/ rtsod 1)pa med pa/ gnas 5med pa/ ma skyes pa/ mi 'byung ba/ ma blangs pa nye bar ma blangs pa/ byed pa med pa ste/ de shes rab kyi gter de lta bu dang ldan pas ri las gron chung mdus chos thams cad la mkhas pa/ gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /shes rab kyi gter de cir yang mi zad pa yin te/ de yang shin tu bstan pa bcus mi zad pa yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ thos pa la mkhas pas mi zad do/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen56)pas mi zad do/ /tshig rab tu dbye ba la mkhas pas mi zad do/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'jug 7pa mngon par bsgrubs pasamacho8)mi zad do/ /rgyan gcig 49 pa'i ye shes kyi rjes su zhugs pas mi zad do/ /bsod nams thams cad shin tu bstsags 1 pas mi zad do/ /skyo ba med par 11mngon par bsgrubs 1 pas mi zad do/ /gzungs thams cad kyi sgor zhugs pas mi zad do/ /sems can thams cad kyi skad dang sgra dang brjod pa sna tshogs kyi phyir mi zad do/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi yid gnyis dang / nem nur dang the tsom 1snyeyang dag par gcod pa'i phyir mi zad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thuthams cad yongs su bstan pas/ sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba dang / yongs su sbyin par bya ba dang / gdul ba'i spyod pa shin tu rtogs pa'i phyir mi zad 8de/mi zad pa shin tu bstan pa bcu po de dag gis shes rab kyi gter te tsomi zad pa yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi gter yin te/ de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams shes rab dang ye shes bla na med pa rnam par 'tshang rgya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dran pa'i gter gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i 35—762

sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' dran pa dang ldan pa yin te/ de yang rgyud rmongs pa med pa'i dran pas sngon gyi gnas rjes gyo)su dran te/ 'di ltar tshe gcig52kyang rjes su dran no/ /tshe duganyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang ske/ lnga dang / tshe brgya dngas )stong dang / ge)tshe brgya phrag du ma dang / tshe stong phrag du ma dang / tshe brgya stong phrag du ma dang / 'jig pa'i bskal pa'am/'du ba'i bskal pa'am/ 'jig pa dang 'du ba'i bskal pa'am/ 'jig zhi )pa'i bskal pa du ma dang / 'du ba'i bskal ④pa du ma dang / 'du ba dang /'jig pa'i bskal53)pa du ma dang / bskal pa brgya dang / bskal pa stong dang /bskal pa spubargya stong dang bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 31tshad myed pa dang / bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong hu grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mtshungs pa med pa3ge/ kun tu mtha' yas pa/ mu med pa/ sa mtshams med pa/ gzhal du med pa/ brjod du med pa/ gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / gzhung de bzhin du brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dang / sangs rgyas skye bar lung bstan pa shin tu brjod pa gcig dang / gnyis dang / gsum dang /bzhi dang / lnga nas/ sangs rgyas skye bar lung bstan pa shin tu brjod du med mi pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dang / sangs rgyas skye ba gcig 3gebastan te/ de dang mtshams sbyor 8ba'i lung bstan pa gcig dang / gnyis dang ske/ gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga nas/ sangs rgyas skye ba shin tu bstan te / de dang mtshams sbyor ba lung bstan pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dang / mdo sde / gcig dang / gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi 35—763

dang ske/ lnga nas/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar dang dbyangs kyis 17bsnyad pa'i sde dang / lung bstan pa'i sde dang / tshigs su bcad pa'i sde dang ske/ gleng gzhi'itshun)sde dang / ched du brjod pa'i sde dang / 'di ltar 'das pa'i sde dang / skyes pa rabs ri kyi sde dang / shin tu rgyas pa'i sde dang / chos rmad padu byung ba bstan pa'i sde dang / man ngag bstan pa'i sde gcigatso/dang /gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga nas/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar dang / 'khor 'dus pa gcig57dang / chos kyi mtshams sbyar ba gcig nas/ chos kyi mtshams sbyar ba brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar dang / dbang po sna tshogs gcig nas dbang po sna tshogs brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar dang / dbang po rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs gcig nas/ dbang po rnam pashetha dad pa sna tshogs brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar dang / nyon mongs pa sna tshogs gcig nas nyon mongs pa sna tshogs nabarjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar dang ske/ ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs gcig 9nas/ ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar dag kyang dran pa dag pa1 )/ dang ba rnyog pa med pa dang 11/ rnam par gsal ba rdul med pa/ rdul dang bral ba/dri ma med pa/ 'od gsal ba/ sang sang po/ bsgribs hu pa med pas rjes su dran no/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dran pa de ni 'jig rten gyi 'khrug hunyepas mi 'phrogs khopa yin/ phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis nye bar nyon mongs par 7mi nus pa yin/ sngon sagyi dge ba'i rtsa bas nyu shin tu sbyangs pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyis ma gos pa yin/ bdud dang mu stegs can dmigs pa 35wa 764

la gnas pa gzhan gyis mi chod pa yin/ tshe rabs kun tu 'pho ba'i lus shin tu bstan pa thams cad kyis brjod par mi nus pa yin/ sngon ①gyi mtha' dang /phyi ma'i mtha' medang / da ltar byung ba'i mthas zhurnam par mi chod pa yin/'jig rten gyi khams su skye ba dang / gnas pa thams cad kyis skyon du ma gyur pa yin / sangs rgyas skyes pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa shin tu bstanasrepa thams cad kyis thogs pa med pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rjes su song ba yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di gi⑧byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dran pa'i gter te brgyad pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyipo)rtogs pa'i gter gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' rtogs pa dang ldan pa yin te/ de yang yi ge de bzhin gzhan ma yin pas/ mdo'i tshul gyi chos ston to/ /de ni tshe'i rgyud gcigashepa yang yongs su 'dzin tog/ /tshe'i rgyud brjod49)du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du ⑩yongs su 'dzin to/ /sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gcig kyang yongs su 'dzin to/ /sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brjod du med pa'i hu)yang brjod du med pa'i bar du yang yongs su 'dzin to/ /bskal pa grangs med pa bstan pa gcigatshwa kyang yongs su 'dzin to/ /bskal pa grangs med pa bstan pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du yang yongs su 'dzin to/ /de bzhin gshegs par lung bstan pa brjod pa gcigarwartekyang yongs su 'dzin noyi/ /de bzhin gshegs par lung bstan par brjod pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du yang yongs su 'dzin to/ /mdo gcig 8kyang yongs su 'dzin to/ /mdo ⑩brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du yang hu tsho35—765

yongs su 'dzin to/ /'dus pa gcig 11kyang yongs su 'dzin to/ /'dus pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du yang yongs su 'dzin to/ /chos kyi mtshams sbyar ba gcig kyang yongs su 'dzin to/ /chos kyi mtshams sbyar ba brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du yang yongs su 'dzin to/ /dbang po rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs gcig kyang yongs su 'dzin to/ /dbang po rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du yang yongs su 'dzin to/ /nyon mongs pa sna tshogs gcig kyang yongs su 'dzin to / /nyon mongs pa sna tshogs brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du yang yongs su 'dzin to/ /ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs gcig kyang yongs su 'dzin to / /ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du yang yongs su 'dzin to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rtogs pa'i gter te mi zad pa/ kun tu mtha' yas pa dgang dka' ban/ gting rnyed par dka' ba/ bsgrub par dka' ba ri/ mi 'phrog pa/ thub 4pa med pa/ bdag nyid che ba'i sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi rjes su song ba ste/ 'di ni gter dgu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi blo gros kyi gter gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par rtogs par byed pa'i rtogs 5)pa dang ldan zhing blo gros dang ldan pa yin te/ mdo sde thams cad dang mi 'gal bas de chos ston pa'i tshe/ dngos po yongs su ldog pa gciga'asne kyang brtsams te / chos ston pa nas dngos po yongs su ldog pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du chos ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi 3nomatshan 35—766

gcig nas tshul de bzhin du brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar dang /'jig rten gyi khams gcig dang / sangs rgyas su lung bstan pa gcig dang /mdo gcig hu)dang / 'khor 'dus pa gcigs dang / chos kyi mtshams sbyar ba gcig snodang / dbang po rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs gcig skyidang / nyon mongs pa sna tshogs gcig dang / ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs gcig kyang brtsams te/chos ston pa nas ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar du brtsams te chos ston to/ /nyi ma gcig gekyang zad par byed cing chos ston pa nas/ zla ba phyed dang / zla ba gcig dang / lo gcig 6)dang /lo brgya dang / lo stong dang / lo brgya phrag stong dang / bskal pa dang /bskal pa brgya dang / bskal pa stong dang / bskal pa brgya phrag stong dang /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong dang / bskal pa tshad med pa dang /bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bskal pa dpag tu med pa dang / grangs med 7)pa dang / mtshungs pa med pa dang / kun tu mtha' yas pa dang / mu med pa dang ske/ sa〈kyematshams med pa dang / gzhal du med pa dang / brjod du med pa dag kyang zad par byed cing chos ston nathoX/ tshig dang yi ge gcig brtsams kyang don dang tshig dang〈 )yi ge'i mthar thug pa med de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpas 17byang chub sems dpa'i gter bcu rab tu thob pa'i phyir te/ gter de dag thob pas gzungs kyi snying po'i sna sgo chos thams cad la yang dag par gzhol ba zhes bya ba/ gzungs brgya stong grangs med pa'i 'khor nyi can mngon du gyur7te/ de gzungs kyi 'khor brgya stong grangs med pa ston par byed do/ /chos snang ba shin tu bstan pa thob pas sems can thams cad la chos 35—767

ston to/ /chos kyi sgo snang ba'i chos can lce yangs pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 7mngon par go bar byed pa dang / dbyangs kyi yan lag la mkhas pas 'gro ba thams cad tshim par byed pa dang / dbang po ji lta ba bzhin du mgu bar byed pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang kun nas 'khor ba thams cad rnam par bzlog pa dang / sgra dang tshig rnam pa getha dad pa thams cad la rab tu zhugs pa dang / yi ge thams cad kyi spobs pas ston pa'i rjes su song ba dang /sems can thams cad kyi sa bon gang (po yongs su shes pa'i bsam pa can du byed pas chos ston te thogs par mi byed do/ /skyo bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpas nam mkha'i khams dang /chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med par rgyas ④par byed pa'i lus rab tu thob pa'i phyir tege/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i gter bcus blo gros mi zad pa/ thub 67pa med pa 'dres pa med pa rnam par mi chod 7dpa/ rgyun gcad par mi nus 25pa phyir mi ldog pa/ gting rnyed par dka' ba/ ring du gyur pa/ sgo kun dang 99ldan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos la zhugs pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gter te/ mi zad pa'i rnam pa bcus mi zad pa yin no//bla na med pa yin no/ /mthar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ sems can thams cadamu )nye bar 'tsho ba dang / sngon gyi smon lam legs par yongs su bsngos pa dang / bskal pa thams cad kyi grangs gcad du med pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings7gledang mnyam pa nyid du khong du chud pa'i phyir / sems tshad med pa dang / 'dus byas kyis ma gos pa'i phyir/ 'dus 35—768

ma byas la yongs su bsngos pa7dang / de ma thag pa'i yul du gyur pas chos thams cad zad mi shes pa dang / smon lam chen po tha dad pa med pa dang /spyod pa la gnas pa'i stobs shin tu 'dzin pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yongs su bzungaphub dang / chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur 'jug pa mtha' dang dbus med pa la zhugs pa ste/ mi zad pa'i rnam pa bcu pokhu'adi dag gis/'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad kyi mthar phyin pa zad mi shes pa'i gter chen por 'gyur ro/ /④gter mi zad pa bcu bstan pa'i le'u ste/ nyi shu bdun pa'o po)de nas sangs rgyas kyisnyemathus shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang ske/ de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogasalgematshams dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yang gling bzhisapa 'di la7rdzogs pa gling re re na yang / de bzhin gshegs pa 0rnams bzhugs57par snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis hunyechos ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi drung na 'ang 'khod par shes so//bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang (nyerdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa de phyir ma brtul / byang chub kyi shing drung tsoyang phyir ma brtul/ ri rab kyi rtse mo yang phyir ma brtul bar rab mtshe ma'i gnas nas dga' ldan gyi gnas kyi lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyi khang pa rin po che'i rgyan7ces bya ba gang na ba der gshegs par 35—769

snang ngo / /ji ltar gling bzhi pa 'di na bcom ldan 'das dga' ldan gyi gnas su gshegs par snang ba/ de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi 3)pa dag na yang bcom ldan 'das dga' ldan gyi gnas su gshegs par snang ste byin gyi na rlabs snga ma de dag kyang ma 'khrugs gepar snang ngo / /de nas lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis/ rgyang ma nas bcom ldan 'das khang pa rin po che thams cad kyi brgyanas par gshegs pa mthong nas/ rings pa'i gzugs su khang pa rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan 55pa'i nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i seng ge'i gdan nor bu rin po che las byas pa6/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i rgyu las grub 7pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi rgyu las yongs su grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis byung ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa mang pos byung ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad las byung ba'i chos dkar po las byung ban/ bsod nams kyi stobs mtha' yas pa sna tshogs thams cad dang ldan pa/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i rnam par phyin pa thams cad kyis rnam par dag pa/ mi mthun pa med pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyis byung ba / gos pa ༄9med pa/ 'gro ba thams cad du byung 3 )ba/ thub pa med pa/'gro ba thams cad kyis blta na sdug pa/ pog re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus brgyan pa/ gser gyi dra ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 37kun tu bres hu pa/ me tog gi bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 12kun nas bres skopa/ phreng ba'i bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 7kun nas lding ba/ spos kyi bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus spos kun tu 'thul bar sbyar bal/ rin po che'i bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 1 steng nas bkab pa/ me tog gi gdugs bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus kun 35—770

nas bsgreng btu)/ rin po che'i gdugs bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus kun nas bkab pa/ gdanang bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mngon par bting rib/ rin po che'i pu ④shu bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 45)rgyan du bsgrubs 46)pa/ nor bu'i dra ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus57)shin tu rnam par phye bas yog 0par byas pa/ rin po che'i dra bshebye ba brgya stong phrag bcus lnga'akhor kun tu yog 31pa/ rin po che'i phreng7)ba 'phyang hu ba'i dra ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu shin tu spyangs 7pas bkab pa / lhab lhub kyi dra ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu klubs loshing brgyan pa/gdugs kyi dra ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus kun nas khebs par bkab pa/gos sna tshogs kyi dra ba bye skyab brgya stong phrag bcus sna tshogs su yog 1 pa/ rin po che'i pad mo'i dra ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 18shin tu rgyas par bkram pa/spos rin po che'i dra ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu 'thul 1tshezhing yid du 'ong bar dri zhim pa/ rin po che'i bla re 2 chen po'i dra ba bye ba 37brgya stong phrag bcu'i rgyan chen po brgyanaspo par bres pa/ rin po che'i dril bu'i rgyan gyi bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus yid du 'ong ba'i sgra phyung 2 rib/ tsan dan rin po che'i mdog lta bu'i bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag tsugebacus yid du 'ong bar bkab 25pa/ rin po che'i me tog sna tshogs kyi bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu me tog shin tu rgyas pa dzī/ gos kha dog mtha' yas pa'i bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus sna tshogs su snang bar bkab pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus sna tshogs su kun nas bkab pa/ gdugs kyi bla re kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs 38byi ba brgya stong phrag bcus rab tu g.yogs shing rnam pa sna tshogs su snang ba/ gser gyi bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus yid du 'ong bar bkab cing rnam par dag par byas 35—771

pa / bee ḍūrya'i0)bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus lha rdzas dri ma med cing shin tu dag par byas pa/ snying po sna tshogs can gyi bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus rnam pa sna tshogs kyi bla re bkabs pa/ rin po che thams cad kyi bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu'i nor bu rin po che bzang pos ri shin tu mdzes shing khebs par bkab pal/ rin po che'i rgyan5gebye ba brgya stong phrag bcus phyogs7thams cad bkang ba/rin po che'i gzugs brnyan gyi bla re bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu rnam par phye ne zhing mdzes par brgyan pa/ rin po che'i phreng ba bye ba ⑦brgya stong phrag bcus phreng ba kun tu 'brel par brgyan pa/ spos kyi phreng ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus mchod pa la tshul dang mthun 8pa'i spos kyi dri zhim par byas pa/ lha la mchog tu bya ba'i spos dang / bdug 9 spos bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcus kha dog mtha' yas pa dang / dri zhim por gtul hu )ba'i mchod pa can/ lha la mchog tu bya ba'i lhab lhub kyi rgyud bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus5nyamangon par klubs shing dag par byas pa/ rin po che'i me tog gi phreng ba bye ba 8brgya stong phrag bcus rin po che tu thams cad kyi rgyud du mdzes par byas pa/ dpal gyi snying po'i phreng ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus rin po che sna tshogs su brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi phreng ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus rin po che thams cad kyi rgyan du bornam par dag pa/ nor bu rin po che rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyi phreng ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus gdan gyi snying po shin tu brgyan pa/ dbang po'i rdo rje bye ba brgya stong the'uphrag bcus shin tu spras pa/ rin po che'i snam bu bye ba ⑩brgya stong phrag bcu kun tu spyangs pa/ 'jig rten mtha' yas pa'i dbang po'i nor bu rin po che bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu bzang bar brgyan pa/ gser gyi snying po 35—772

bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu bsgrubs shing dag par 3)byas pa/ nor bu rin po che rnam par snang ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus rdul med par snang bar byas pa/ nor bu rin po che brgya byin mngon par chags pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus snying po mtha' yas pa〈snang b.ramu brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che dpa' ba'i rgyal ④mtshan bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu 'bar bar bsgrubs pa/nor bu rin po chesasnang ba'i 'od zer bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 'od zer snang bar byas pa/ nor bu rin po che lha la stinamachog tu bya ba labye ba brgya stong phrag bcus skar khung dugi shar bu mdzes par bres pa/ nor bu rin po che bsod nams kyis dag pa ⑨bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus kha dog gsal bar gyur pa/dngul gyi rta babs bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus bres pas 3 )snying po dkar po rab tu rnam par phye ba/ 'gro ba rgya mtsho'i zla gam bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus sbubs shin tu bsgrubs pa/ nor bu rin po che dri ma med pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus blta na mdzes par shin tu brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che sems kyi rgyal po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 'dab (1chags yid du 'ong zhing dga' bar kun tu brgyan pa/nor bu rin po che seng ge'i gdong bye ba0rtebargya stong hu phrag bcus shin tu spras pa'i mchod pa dang ldan pa/ nor bu rin po che 'dzam bu'i rgyal thamatshan bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus mthu brtan 8par shin tu brtan papo/ nor bu rin po che snying po dag pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus rnam par snang zhing mdzes par byas pa/ nor bu rin po che dbang po'i hu)rgyal mtshan bye ba 3shebargya stong phrag bcus snang ba'i gdugs su bris hu'epa/ nor bu rin poche dngul gyi snying po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus nang rnam pa sna tshogs su bkram pa/ nor bu rin po che ri rab kyi rgyal 35—773

mtshan bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus snying po 37shin tu brgyan pa/ mu tig gi phreng ba bye ba 5brgya stong phrag bcus kha dog mdzes par (bres pa/ bai ḍūrya'i chaphreng ba bye ba 45)brgya stong phrag bcus dra bar bres skyidapa/ mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba bye ba ge brgya stong phrag bcus rnam pa sna tshogs su rnam par phye 3)ba/ nor bu yid du 'ong ba'i phreng ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 49rnam pa sna tshogs su bkod pa/ rin po che shin tu snang ba'i phreng ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu rnam par phye lha 3zhing rab tu bzung ba/ rin po che'i /1'bru sna tshogs kyi nyu phreng ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus lus shin tu brgyan pa/ mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba bye bsngo brgya stong phrag bcus yid du 'ong bar snang ba/ nor bu rin po che'imukha dog du ma'i phreng ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus snying po kha dog sna tshogs shing kha dog mtha' yas pa'i mthar phyin pa/ dga' bar byed pa'i phreng ba bye ba snyebargya stong phrag bcus dag par sbyangs pa/ nor bu rin po che dpal gyi 'od zer gyi phreng ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus dpal chen po rab tu 'thob 10pa thob par gyur pa/ nor bu'i gzugs bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus phyogs shin tu spa 3 bar brgyan pa/ rin po che 18dbang po'i kha dog 39bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu la gnas yongs su 'dzin pa/dus 2 dang mthun dro 1pa'i tsan dan bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du dri zhim pos rgyas par byas pa/ rim gro ci byed pa'i mi'i ninyetshogs bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 2 risangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du ( nyerjes su song ba/spos kyi thum po shin tu che ba 37bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus kun tu rgyas pa/gzhan gyis pham 3 tshopa med pa'i spos na bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu'i dri kun tu rgyas pa/spos kyi gzugs bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu'i dri kun tu 'byung ba/ yid du 'ong 35—774

po bye ba 1brgya stong phrag bcu mngon par dga' ba'i lus can/ klu'i dbang po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu mi skyo bar lta ba/ gnod sbyin 2gyi dbang po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu thal mo sbyar 5zhing spyi bo la gzhog 4pa/ dri za'i dbang po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu mi ngoms par mos pas ldang ba/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu nga rgyal gyi yid yongs su chad risnyepa/ nam mkha' lding gi dbang po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu'i 6kha nas dar shin tu spyangs57)pa mi'am ci'i dbang po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu sems rab tu dga' ba/ lto 'phye 3)chen po'i dbang 9po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu 1 nodaga' ba'i yid du blta ba/ tshangs pa'i dbang po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu zhe sas phu dud 17du gnas pa/ 'jig rten gyi dbang po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu'i spyi bo 12dang / lus kyis btud pa/lha'i dbang po brgya byin las 12stsogs pa bye ba brgya stong mi phrag bcus shin tu blta bske/ rab mtshe 15ma'i lha'i rgyal po las khestsogs pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus dga' ba chen po'i sgra phyung ba/ rab dga' ldan gyi lha'i rgyal po las sna stsogs pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus rab tu btud pa/ rab 'phrul dga'i lha'i rgyal po las 1 stsogs pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus phyag bya ba/ dbang byed kyi lha'i rgyal po las 1 stsogs pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus thal mo sbyar ba/ tshangs pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus blta ba/ dbang phyug chen po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus mngon par brjod pa/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus mngon par bstod pa/ lha'i bu mo bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu mchod pa/ smon lam gyi lha'i bu bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu mngon par dga' ba/ sngon 'grogs pa'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus sgra phyung ba/ tshangs ris 2 kyi lha'i bu bye ba brgya 35—784

stong phrag bcus lus 3)thams cad kyis 2phyag bya ba/ tshangs lha (nye phan gyi lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus spyi bos btud 4pa/ tshangs pa kun ris 5kyi lha 6bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus bskor ba 3byas pa/ tshangs pa chen po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus yon tan mtha' yas pa'i mthar phyin pa brgya phrag 8stong gis shin tu bstod pa'i 3)sgra phyung ba/ kun snang dang ba'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus 1 'khor lngas phyag bya ba37/ 'od chung gi lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus sangs rgyas skye ba shin tu dkon pa'i sgra bsgrags pa/ tshad med 'od kyi lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus sangs rgyas legs par gshegs so zhes phyag bya ba/ kun snang dang ba'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu bstod cing mthong bar 12dka' ba'i sgra phyung ba/dge ba'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu 1lhagazhal myed khang dang ba 7can du 'phags pa / 'od chung gi lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus sems dang ba'i lus kyis mngon par btud bopa/ tshad myed dge ba'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus sangs rgyas mthong bar mos shing rang gi lus kyis btud 17pa/ dge rgyas 1 kyi lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus mchod pa dang rim gror 1 bya ba/ che ba'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus dge ba'i rtsa ba rjes su dran par bya ba/ chung che'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus //de bzhin gshegs pa che ba'i 'du shes rab tu skyes shing lta 2 tshob/ tshad med che ba'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus dge ba'i chos rtogs shing rim gro cher bya ba/ 'bras bu che ba'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus lus shin tu btud 21pa/mi che ba'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan par byas te/mngon par brjod cing lus btud 22pa/ mi gdung ba'i 22lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus sangs rgyas kyi spyan snga thunas thal mo sbyar zhing ngoms 25mi shes par blta ba/35—785

gya rnam snang ba'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus mngon par bltas te lus btud pa / shin tu mthong ba'i lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus sangs rgyas ( kyis bstan pa ngoms dmi shes par lus dbul ba/ 'og min gyi lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus spyi bos btud 45cing mchod pa/ lha sna tshogs bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus dga' ba chen pos snang ba'i sgra phyung ba/ lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu bsams shing sgrubasgrubs te brgyan pa/ lha'i byang chub sems dpa' bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus sangs rgyas kyi gdan bsgrub 6pa la byin gyis brlab rgyun mi gcadarke7pal/ lha'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po bye ba brgya dun stong phrag bcu me tog thogs pa dang / spos thogs pa dang / phreng ba thogs pa dang / phye ma thogs pa dang / byug pa thogs pa dang / na bza' thogs pa dang / gdugasaspyothogs pa dang / rgyal mtshan thogs pa dang / ba dan thogs pa dang / rin po che thogs pa dang / phyang 'phrul 1 thogs pa dang / lhab lhub thogs pas mngon par gtor zhing char du phab ste rab tu dgye ba/ lha bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus lha'i khyim mngon par 'phags pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 3 pa'i pha rol tu phyin par bya ba/ lha'i gzhal med khang bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu'i lha'i bus dad par bsu 1 ba/ lha'i bu btsun pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus lhun shin tu bzung rlob/ dbang bskur ba'i lha'i bu dbye ba brgya stong phrag bcus lhun kun nas bzung lob/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu legs par sems shing spyod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i / btsun pa'i sems bskyed pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu'i yid dga' bar /shebyed pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu rab tu sim par byed pa/ byang chub sems 35—786

dpa'i 1)lhag pa'i bsam pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu yongs su dag par byed pa/byang chub sems dpa'iho mos pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu rnam par dag par byed pa / byang chub sems dpa'i las bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu yang dag par sbyong ba la/ byang chub sems dpa'i 4 skyes pa'i rabs bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu rab tu ston par byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi sgo bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu rab tu snang bar byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu rab tu sgrub bge/ byang chub sems dpa'i ris bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu yongs su smin par 'dul ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus yang dag par byung ba/ sangs rgyas bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus byin gyis brlabs pa/bsod nams bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus yongs su grub pa/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus yongs su sbyangs pa/ smon lam bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus shin tu dag par byas pa/ spyod pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus yang dag par skyes pa/ chos bye ba brgya stong 6phrag bcus nye bar bstan 7pa/ rnam par 'phrul pa bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus ri rjes su song ba/ yon tan bye ba brgya stong phrag bcus7shin tu 'phags pa bshams so// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/kho bam po nyi shu dgurwa1pa/ ji ltar gling bzhi pa chen po 'di'i dga' ldan gyi gnas su lha'i dbang po rab dga' ldan gyi 32khang pa nor bu 12rin po che thams cad kyi 3 tshorgyan can du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan bting bar gyur pa de bzhin du/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa chen po tshadag na yang dga' ldan gyi gnas dag tu lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyi 9khang pa rin po che thams cad kyi 35—787

rgyan can dag tu rgyan 'di lta bu dang / tshul 'di lta bu dang / dad pa 'di lta bu dang / mos pa 'di lta bu dang / dga' ba 'di lta bu dang / rab tu dga' ba 'di lta bu dang / zhe sa 'di lta bu dang / rim gro 'di lta bu dang / spro ba 'di lta bu dang / nye bar sems pa 1'di lta bus de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan ribating bar gyur to/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis stan54)bting nas / zhe sa can gyi snyerim gro dang bcas par dga' ldan gyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha'i bu bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu dang lhan cig du dong ste/ bcom ldan 'das bsu tsinas me tog yon tan 7grangs myed pa'i sprin gyi char ni rab tu phab ske/ spos yon tan bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i char ni rab nyutu phab/ phreng ba 1 snayon tan sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i sprin ni rab tu bkye11/ /2gdugs rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi char ni rab tu phab/ lha rdzas kyi gos rab tu phra ba'i sprin nyu rab tu bkye / rin po che yid du 'ong ba mtha' yas pa thams cad kyi sprin gyi char ni rab tu phab/ sems shin tu dang bas lha rdzas kyi lhab lhub dang / phyang 'phrul /snyegyi sprin gyi char ni kun latu phab/ bdug spos 1 rnam pa du ma'i sprin gyis ni 12kun tu bdug19 /lha rdzas kyi tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / a ka ru'i phye 2 ma dang /spos 21dam pa thams cad kyi phye ma'i sprin gyi char ni rab tu phab/ lha'i bu mtha' yas pas kyang rang rang gi lus kyi sprin ni 2 shin tu bkyes / dga' ldan gyi ris su gtogs 2 pa'i lha'i bu bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu dang / de ma yin pa'i lha'i ris nas 'dus pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyis kyang sems shin tu dang bas zhe sa rab tu bskyed nas/ shin tu btud de na phyag 'tshal to/ /lha'i bu mo grangs med pa dag kyang dga' zhing mos pa'i sems kyis bcom ldan 'das la rab tu sems so/ /35wa 788

byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas na spyod pa grangs myed pa rnams kyang bar snang la gnas te/ sangs rgyas la mchod par brtson pa'i 1sems kyis lha rdzas las 'das pa'i mchod pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed do/ /rim gro byed do phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi narlabs dang /sangs rgyas kyi sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyu rimathun pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas rol mo bgrol ba dang / brdung ba'i tshogs grangs med pa yang sgra 'byin par gyur to/ /lha'i bu dga' ldan gyi gnas na 'khod pa rnamasamatshedang / lha'i bu mo rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das la ni lta /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba/ shin tu dkon par ni rjes su sems shing /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa bsgribasam pa med pa'i chos can no/ /zhes yang dag par lta nazhing de logs su mngon par ltalo)bar gyur to/ /dga' ldan gyi gnas na 'khod pa'i 'khor thams cad dang / lha bye ba brgya stong grangs med pa bcom ldan 'das bsu ba'i phyir rin po che thams cad kyi mye tog gi phur ma thogs thogs 1 pa dang / spos thams cad kyi phur ma thogs thogs pa dang / rin po che thams cad kyi phur 11ma thogs thogs sna pa dang / rgyan thams cad kyi phur ma thogs thogs 1 pa dang / lha rdzas kyi tsan dan thams cad kyi phye ma'i phur ma thogs thogs pa dang / lha rdzas kyi a ka thun thams cad kyi phye ma'i 'phur ma thogs thogs pa dang / lha rdzas kyi rin po che thams cad kyi phye ma'i phur ma thogs thogs pa dang / lha rdzas kyi spos kyi me tog thams cad kyi phye ma'i phur ma thogs thogs pa dang / lha rdzas kyi me tog man dā lngar ba'i phur ma thogs thogs pa rnams kyang dong ste/ bcom ldan 'das 35—789

la gtor to/ /mngon par gtor to/ /rab tu gtor to/ /lha'i bu dga' ldan gyi gnas su gtogs pa 3)bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa rnams kyang bar snang la 'khod de/ ye shes kyi spyod yul la gzhol ba'i sems kyis spos dang bdug pa'i sprin gyis bdugasko pas bar snang brgyan par cirabyas so/ /sangs rgyas la dga' zhing gzhol ba'i sems kyis lha rdzas kyi me tog thams cad kyi sprin gyi char gyis rab tu brgyan pas bar snang brgyan pa par 5byas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la zhe sa cher bya ba'i yisems kyis lha rdzas kyi gdugs sna tshogs kyi sprin gyis bar snang yog 7par byas te brgyan par 8byas so/ /sangs rgyas la stimachod par gzhol ba'i sems kyis lha rdzas kyi 7phreng ba sna tshogs kyi sprin rab tu dgye bas bar snang brgyan par /tsho1byas so/ /sangs rgyas las thos par mos pa'i sems kyis gser gyi dra ba grangs med pa las dril bu sna tshogs kyi dra ba 'khrol zhing sgra 'byin pas g.yog sna par byas te bar snang brgyan pare hu byas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la yon gyi gnas dam pa yin par 'dzin sapa'i sems kyis 8bla re grangs med pa las rin po che thams cad kyi se lamo do'i sprin lding zhing tso/ 'brul 3)ba'i rgyan gyis bar snang brgyan par 1/byas so/ /sangs rgyas la zhu nodage bar 'dun pa'i sems kyis lha rdzas kyi gzhal med khang grangs med par lha rdzas kyi rol mo brdung ba 27dang / dkrol ba thams cad kyi sgra yid du 'ong ba phyung gi bas bar snang brgyan par (nyebyas so/ /sangs rgyas skye ba shin tu dkon par dogs0stepa'i sems kyis lha rdzas kyi na bza' kha dog sna tshogs pa'i sprin dang / na bza' mtshungs pa dgemed pa'i sprin gyi char 'bab pa'i rgyan gyis tsobar snang brgyan par rju tshobyas so/ /sangs rgyas la mos pa mtha' yas pa'i sems kyis lha rdzas kyi cod pan grangs nusnye35—790

med pa'i sprin las cod pan gyi char chen po 'khor zhing 'bab pa'i rgyan 3)gyis bar snang brgyan par〈byas so/ /sangs rgyas yid las bde ba skyes5gepa'i sems kyis lha rdzas (lde)kyi rin po che kha dog sna tshogs grangs med pa'i sprin las phreng ba sna tshogs kyi char rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab pa'i rgyan 6)gyis bar snang brgyan par ⑦byas so/ /lha'i bu bye ba brgya stong grangs med pa yang lha rdzas kyi me tog kha dogs/tha dad pa grangs med pa lag na thogs te/ me tog zad mi shes pa'i mdzod rab tu bkye nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor to/ /mos pa'i spos 3) zhim po rnyed 3 2cing sangs rgyas la dad par gnas pas lha rdzas kyi spos dang /bdug (1pa kha dog sna tshogs grangs med pa lag na thogs te bcom ldan 'das la phul lo/ /rgyan chen78po sprul pa'i sems kyis lha rdzas kyi tsan dan gyi phye ma kha dog sna tshogs grangs med pa lag na thogs te/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor to/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zham ring nyi du 'brang zhing rin po che'i gdugs kha dog sna tshogs grangs med pa lag /mun thogs te/bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'gebs so/ /sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa la mos pa'i sems rnam par 'phel bas/ gos rin po che kha dog sna tshogs grangs med pa lag na thogs te/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa'i lam gos kyis yog tshapar byas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la porim gro bya bar mos pa'i sems kyis lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan rin po che sna tshogs kyi kha dog can lag na thogs shing / bcom ldan 0'das kyi zham ring du 'dong ngo / /sangs rgyas la dga' ba mtha' yas pa rnam par 'phel ba'i sems kyis lha rdzas kyi lhab lhub dang / phyang 'phrul 38kha dog sna tshogs grangs med pa'i yang grangs med pa lag na thogs te/ de bzhin 35—791

gshegs pa la phul lo/ /dad pa mi 'phrogasamatshopa'i sems kyis lha〈(rdzas kyi phreng ba grangs med pa lag na thogs te/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gsol rnguto / /mtshungs pa med pa'i dga' ba rnam par 'phel bas/ lha rdzas gyi ba dan rin po che kha dog sna tshogs grangs med pa'i yang grangs medas45)pa lag na thogs te / bcom ldan 'das kyi drung na phyi'adzin to/ /lha'i bu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa yang zhi ba la43/ rab tu gzhol zhing bag yod pa tshad med pa'i sems kyis lha rdzas kyi rol mo brdung ba dang / dkrol nib kha dog sna tshogs grangs med pa 9lag na thogs te/ yid du 'ong ba'i sgra dbyangs phyung nas/bcom ldan 'das dgyes par byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa/ dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'ongs pa'i hu )rnams kyang lha rdzas las 'das pa'i mchod pa khams gsum las rnam par 'das pa/dmyigs pa'i chos las byung ba/ rjen pa'i dri med pa/ chags pa /7med pa'i sems tshim par byed pa/ chos kyi tshul zab mos mngon par grub pa/ blo tshad med pa'i 12yangs pa las byung ba/ dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan 1 pas rnam par spel 6ba / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa las byung ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang 'phrul ba grangs 15med pas mngon par bsgrubs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mchod pa yid kyi rang bzhin las byung ba/ mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i chos kyi sgo'i tshargyas btab pas/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad kun nas yog 1 par byas so/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba'i me nyu8tog gi bla re sna tshogs kyis chos 19kyi dbyings kun nas khebs par byas so/ /lha rdzas ri tsholas 'das pa mos pa 2 rnam par dag pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul rgyas par 35—792

'gengs pa'i na bza' sna tshogs mngon par dgab pas 1chos kyi dbyings brgyan par byas so/ /chags pa med pa'i chos kyi rang bzhin rdo rje la yang dag par zhugs pa'i sems kyis lha rdzas las 'das pa'i 5mi skye ba'i chos las byung ba'i dril bu tshom bur bcadamu pa'i dra bas chos kyi dbyings brgyan par byas so/ /chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i sems kyis lha rdzas las 4)'das pa'i spos thams cad kyi mchog gis cirabadug pa'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings brgyan par 6byas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pas chos kyi dbyings rgyas par bya ba'i mesems kyis lha rdzas las 'das pa'i rin po che thams cad kyi khri sangs rgyas kyi 8gdan du btingam1)ba'i rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings brgyan par 1 byas so/ /sangs rgyas kyi mchod pa rang bzhin 'gag pa med pa'i sems kyis lha rdzas las 'das pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan yang dag par bsgreng ba'i rgyal mtshan 11gyis chos kyi dbyings brgyan par 12byas so/ /rmi lam lta bu'i chos nyid kyis bsam pa tshim pas lha rdzas las 'das pa'i 12rin po che sna tshogs kyis sangs rgyas kyi pho brang brgyan pas chos kyi dbyings brgyan par 1 byas so/ /mi gnas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba blang ba med pa las byung bas/ lha rdzas las 'das pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi pad mos kun nas yog tshapa'i rgyan gyis chos kyi tshadabyings brgyan par 1 byas so/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i spos thams cad kyi mchog gi sprin gyis chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par bya ba 18dang / me 19tog kha dog mtha' yas pa sna tshogs kyi sprin dang / na bza' kha dog rnam pa 2 sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa thams cad kyi sprin dang / tsan dan gyi dri zhim po mtha' yas par 'phro 1ba thams cad kyi sprin dang / lha rdzas las 'das pa'i rin po che thams cad kyi 35—793

gdugs rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sprin dang / spos dang bdug pa sna tshogs kyi ngad hukun tu ldang ba'i sprin dang / phreng ba yid du 'ong ba thams cad kyi sprin dang /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i lhab lhub rnam par dag pa thams cad kyi sprin dang /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa gerang gi lus gtong ba'i sprin dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan brjod pa las 'das pas bstod cing bsngags pa'i brjod pa zad mi shes pa'i sprin dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstod pas brjod pa ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par bsngags pa'i chos ma log pa las5gebyung bge/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs mtha' dang dbus med pa las rgyu bas 'gro ba thams cad bde ba'i lam bstan pa dang / tshig rnam par 'byed pa brjod du med pa smos (shepas chos tshad med pa la gzhol ba'i gzungs 6)kyi rgyud thams cad las byung ba'i tha dad pa yang dag par shes pa la mkhas pa mi zad pa dang mi 'jigs pas yid dga' bar gyur pa'i rim gro ngoms9)mi shes pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par bstod pa/ tshig rnam par dbye zhing brjod pas/byang chub sems dpa' de dag chos kyi dbyings kyi lus nam mkha'i khams rgyas par byed pa labyin gyis brlabs te/ sangs rgyas 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang —/ da ltar byung ba thams cad kyis yongs su gzung ba'i yid kyi spudabang pos mngon par bstod do/ /lha'i ris gzhan dang gzhan nas 'dus pa'i lha'i78'khor de dag thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnams kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi khya〈homachog gi mthu phyung ba/bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su ston /gecing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yang 35—794

dag par 'byung ba dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul yang dag par ston pa dang / sems can grangs med pa'i rgyud tshim par mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rgyan ①rnam par phye bas nam mkha'i khams thams cad dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par mdzad pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' yas pa brtan par mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul gzhal du med pa las byung ba/ tshig gi lam thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i ②rigs dang ldan pa thams cad kyis mngon par mos par bya ba/sems can 'dul ba ji lta ba bzhin du tshim par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi sku yangs balgerjes su khyab par gyur pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba brjod pa thams cad rnam par dag pas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan tshad med pa yang dag par ston57pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi 37ting nge 'dzin las 'byung ba/ 'gro ba thams cad ma lus pa'i lus kyi rjes su 'dalas nib / sku'i byin gyis rlabs las mtshams med pa/ yid tshad med pa yongs su mgu bar mdzad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rigs rgyun mi gcod pa/sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa mtha' dang dbus med pa 'byung ba brnyes pa/'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs su byung ba/ khams dang mos pa bgrang du med pa thams cad sbyong bar mdzad pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ye shes mngon par bsgrubaskornyipa la 'jug par mdzad pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbang po rab tum tshedaga' bar mdzad pa/ chos kyi sprin gyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad du yog par mdzad pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad ma lus par de bzhin gshegs pas 35—795

'dul ba'i byin gyi rlabs 3kyis rlob pa/ sems can thams cad kyi rtog pa bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su rgyas par mdzad pa/ mi gnas pa'i ye shes kyi rgyud kyis 'gro ba thams cad las 'phags pa/ ye shes kyi rnam pa thams cadadza brnyes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs snang ba gzigs pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin du yang dag par gzigs pa/ sems bskyed pa rgya chen po skye bar mdzad pa/ 'gro ba thams cad du /kun tu bzang po thub tshogepa med pa'i ye shes yang dag par rgyu bas 5byung ba 'gro ba dang zhing thams cad du khyab pa/chos kyi dbyings thams cad du mi ldog par gshegs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rgyud brjod du med pa 6yang dag par ston pa/ bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'khrul pa mi mnga' bar byin gyis rlob pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi tshig gi rnam pas yon tan mi zad pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pas chos kyi dbyings thams (8)cad rgyas par mdzad pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' dang dbus myed pa tho)khyab par mdzad pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyi spyi ji ltar dam bcas pa'i sems can la 11rim gror mdzad pa/ ji ltar brnyes 12pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad pa/ sems can ji ltar 'dul ba bzhin du 'dul ba 1rimadzad pa/ mos pa dang bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dag par mdzad pa/ gzugs kyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab par byin gyis rlob pa/ 'gro ba thams cad la gnas pa mi mnga' zhing mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su bzhud pa/ spyod pa tha 4dad pa las byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ba sgribs gepa med pa mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ thugs la chags pa mi mnga' bas rtag tu mnyam par gzhag cing ma 'dres pa/ ye shes thams cad la rnam par spyod pa/ don dang tshig dang yi ge tha tshadad pa yang dag par ston 35—796

pa3ske/ ye shes rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa la zhugs napa/ yon tan gyi mchog ye shes ri snying pos byung bas 4chos kyi dbyings thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi nyi ma shar ba/ 'gro ba thams cad du sngon gyi smon lam zad pa mi mnga' bar chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin la gnas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa ma nyams pa brnyes pa/ bdag gi dang yongs su gzung ba med pas gnas par pa mi mnga' ba/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad 'byung zhing 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyis ma gos pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyis 6mi shes pa'i rgyal mtshan yang dag par bcad pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi mi shes pa chen po yongs su bsal 77ba'i gnas su gyur pa 'gro ba thams cad snang bar mngon par 'don 8pa/ 'jig rten thams cad ye shes khyad par du 'phags pa la rab tu gzhog pa/ 'gro ba thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba'i bsod nams yongs su mi zad pa / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi shes pa thugs su chud pa9/ dad par bya bar 'os pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gzhol 1 ba'i byams pa chen po las byung ba thugs rje chen po yang dag par ston pas spyod pa/sangs rgyas kyi sku brjod du med pa'i chos dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gsung 11dang dbyangs kyi char 'bebs 12pa/ sems can gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par tshim par mdzad pa/ sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' dang da ltar byung ba'i mtha'i 12dmyigs pa'i byin gyi 1 rlabs shin tu dag cing bsam gyis myi khyab pas sems can dag par mdzad pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad lung bstan pa rgyun mi 'chad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs su dbang bskur bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud du byung ba/ 'jig 35—797

rten thams cad du 'khor lo mi ldog par 'khor ba/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi mngon par zhen pa thams cad las 'phags pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi mthas 1)klas pa la mi gnas pa/ 'gro ba thams cad mnyam pa nyid du thugs su chud pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsod nams kyis rnam par dag pa/ 'khor ba la mi bzhugs napar 'jig rten thams cad du snang bar gyur pa/ btsal ba mi dmigs pas chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi rang bzhin ye shes kyi zla ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med pa'i rjes su bzhud pa/sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes kyi 5byin gyis rlob pa/ mig yor lta bu'i meye shes kyis rnam par ston pa/ rmi 5skulam lta bur sko6)rjes su dran pa/ sprul pa dang mnyam par byung bske/ sems kyi rang bzhin lta bur 'jig rten sna tshogs thams cad57byin gyis rlob pa/ las kyi rnam par smin pa'i tshul dang / bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can gyi skye mched rnam par phye ba yang dag par ston pa/ sems can gyi dbang po dang mthun 8par sangs rgyas kyi sku byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dmigs pa la sems can grangs med pa'i sems yang dag par gnas pa/'jig rten thams cad rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ rnam par bstan pa'i rang bzhin du chos kyi mtshan nyid kyis yang dag par spyod pa/ ye shes kyi rgyud mtshan nyid med pa'i rang bzhin dang mtshan nyid gcig tu 3)gyur pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid snang ba mngon par bsgrub pa'i spyod pa sna yang dag par ston cing 'gro ba thams cad gdon par 17brtson pa/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod /2yul bla na med pa yang dag par ston pa/ 'jig rten dang zhing thams cad yongs su skyob 12pas sangs rgyas kyi mtshan ma bzung gebar 'jig rten 35—798

du mngon par byung ba/ 'jig rten gyi nyon mongs pa'i mtshan ma thams cad rnam par bstsal 7ba/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi tshonarjes su dran pa dang / dmigs par 'byor par gyur pa/ 'khrug pa med par khong du chud par 'gyur ba'i rgyus theg pa chen pos zhal yongs su rgyas pas5/ chos thams cad kyi don grub pa/'gro ba thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa bas rnam par phye ba nyams pa med pa'i phrin 7las rnam par smin pas rnam par dag pa/ ye shes kyi 'byung gnas 8dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dusathugs su chud pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi yongs su rtog pa yongs su mi rtog pas byung ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'od gzer gyi dra bas gsalarwastobar gyur pa/ phyogs bcu 'byam 1 klas pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi 'od kyis snang bar mdzad pa32/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su bzhud pa blta bas mi ngoms shing btang mi bra bob/ yon tan chen po dang ye shes dang mngon par shes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'byung ba dang 8/ dbang po mngon par mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul can/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyis lngasangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa rgyas par mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las shin tu sgrub nyu tshopa/ nub cing 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshul ston pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs mtha' yas pa'i char 'bebs pa/ bsam pa yangs pa'i bsgom 18pa yongs su 'dzin par mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dpal thams cad kyis 19rab tu 'bar ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku kha dog mtha' yas pa sna tshogs su 2 'jig rten thams cad la mngon par ston pa/ sgrib pa'i chos thams cad du ma lhung ba/chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyi 21don gyis dag pa yon tan gyi chos thams cad 35—799

la mnga' bas mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor can yon tan gyi 'od gzer 17mnga' ba'i nyi mar gyur pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing du shar ba/ gzi brjid thams cad kyi dra bas mngon par skyes pa/ 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi misprul pa yang dag par 'dzin pa/ 'jig rten thams cad sprul par thugs su chud pa'i ye shes snang ba ridang 4ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i go 'phang chags pa myed pa mnga' 5ba/ phyi ma'i mtha'i yon tan 'jig rten thams cad kyis rine rnam par shes pa/ 'gro ba thams cad dang mthun 7par ston pa'i ye shes kyi phyag mnga' ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i 8ye shes kyi sman pa sems can thams cad bde bar mdzad pa/ 'jig rten tshad med pa thams cad du shin tu rnam par dag pas (9 rjes su 'brang ba/ 'gro ba dang zhing 'byam 1 klas pa thams cad du phyir mi ldog pa ye shes kyi spyan phugs 11rab rib myed cing rnam par dag pa/ sangs rgyas kyi lo legs pa yang dag par ston pa/ 'khu ba'i sems can gyi khams las su rung bar 12mdzad pa/ 'dul ba sna tshogs du ma la 'jug pa/ dus bzhin du 'dul ba'i rgyun mi sna 'chad pa/ 'gro ba thams cad la mnyam pa'i thugs kyis ciyang dag par spyod pa/ las skyon med pa'i rnam par smin pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa yang dag par ston pa/ bsam pa dang las dang rgyu mthun mapa'i 'bras bu ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam par ston pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku ji lta ba bzhin du sems can gyis chos shes pa 'byung bar mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi tshesprul pa byin gyis rlob pa/ 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad la rnam par gzigs pa'i ye shes mnga' ba/ dga' ba chen po dang lhag pa'i bsam pas nyu tshodaga' bar mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas mthong ba'i dad pa'i shugs mtha' yas pas nyu8byung ba/35—800

sems can thams cad kyi rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba phyir mi ldog par mdzad pa/sems can gyi las ji lta 5)ba bzhin du rjes su 'brang bar mdzad pa / 'gro ba gnyidam kyis log pa thams cad sad par mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas skye bas dge ba yang dag par 'phel bar pa mdzad pa/ sems can la sangs rgyas kyi bag dbab pa chen po stob padza mdzad pa/ 'jig rten gyi 6)lta ba thams cad la mi gnas pa/ye shes kyi don la rab tu gzhog pa/ rab tu gzhag pa'i ye shes kyi tshul gyi spyod yul thugs su chud pa/ sangs rgyas kyis gzigs pa'i zil gyis mnon 7pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ chos kyi rgyud thugs su chud pa'i ri bo 8rnam par dag pa/sangs rgyas 'byamasa'o)klas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dang gzhan du ston pa'i/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sa la sems can rab tu 'god pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan grangs med pas 11rnam par bris pa/ las kyis sna tshogs su gyur pa'i 'jig rten du de bzhin gshegs pa sna tshogs yang dag par ston pa/sangs rgyas kyi 'byung gnas rnam par sbyong ba/ ye shes thams cad yongs su 'thob par mdzad pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi smon lam rjes su srung ba mi shigs pa/ 'gro ba thams cad la dge ba'i bshes gnyen ston pa/ snang ba dri ma med cing mchog tu dag par mdzad pa/ 'gro ba ma lus pa thams cad kyis ji tsam du mngon sum du mthong ba de tsam du brjod du 1 myed pa/ sems can thams cad kyi 'gro ba'i rjes su song ba'i byin gyi 1 rlabs mnga' ba/ grogs sngon du 'gro ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas sems can rnam par dag par mdzad pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi smon lam gyi rjes su song ba nyams pa med pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bzung 1 bas dag par mdzad pa la pastsogs pa'i 35—801

tshul gyis yongs su byung ba/ bdud kyi dkrugs 31ma thams cad rnam par 'joms 2par byung ba/ chags pa med pa'i mtha'i stobs kyis byung ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyis blta na 'od shin tu dad par snang ba/ ye shes kyi dbyings chags pa med pa'i snying po'i nyi ma sems can gang yang rung ba la chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad pa/ 'od gzer kyigyi dkyil 'khor gyi mdzod mtha' dang dbus med pa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi ye shes kyi 4dkyil 'khor mnga' ba/ 'gro ba thams cad la snang bar gyur pa/ bsam pa dang yang dag par rtogashepa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyir rgol ba shin tu bcom pa/ yon ⑥gyi gnas dam pa mchog du gyur pa / 'gro ba thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa/ yon tanamadugetshad med par 'gyur ba9/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su dag par mdzad pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu tshad med par yongs su 'dzin pa/ zad mi shes pa'i ye shes kyi sar 'dzud cing rab tu gzhog pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba sems la rag las mapar yid ches pas tshad med pa'i bsod nams dang / yon tan 11dag par mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi tshul gyis ngan song gsum gyi 'gro ba yongs su skyob pa'o12/ /zhes rnam pa de lta bur de bzhin gshegs pa la mos pa rnam pa de lta bur/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la yang dag par lta 8bske/ rnam pa de lta bur ye shes kyi mu stegs las 'bab pa/ rnam pa de lta bu'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i gang khuchen mtsho thams cad la 'jug pa/ rnam pa de lta bu'i ye shes kyi nam mkha'i rjes su bo'agro ba rnam pa de lta bur 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du yang dag pa ji lta bur 9shes pa/ rnam pa de lta bur de bzhin gshegs pa dran pa'i sgos lta ba/ rnam pa de lta bur dge ba'i 'phrin las 35—802

rnam par dag pa'i mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pas de bzhin gshegs pa la rtog pa / rnam pa de lta bu'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku chen po 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du snang bar byed pa/ rnam pa de lta bu'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad yang dag par bstan par7)rjes su sems pa rigede dag gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bcom ldan 'das kyi ba spu'i sgo re re nas 'od gzeram bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa 'byung ba/ grangs myed pa rnam 4par dag pa/ grangs med par shin tu snang ba/grangs myed par bltar yod pa/ grangs med pa'i sems can gyi dga' ba skyed lkupa / grangs med pa'i spro ba skyed 5pa/ grangs myed pa'i sangs rgyas la 'dun pa rnam par ga'aphel bar byed pa/ grangs med pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par sbyong ba/ grangs med pa'i dbang po sim par byed parin/ grangs med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul thob par byed pa mang po mthong bar gyur to/ /'od kyi 'khor lo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku las rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs kyis 'phrul zhing 'byung ba/ kha dog bsam gyis myi khyab pa/ mdog bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'od bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa thams cad rgyas par byed pa/sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs dang / sems can rnam par dag pas/ dri zhim por rab tu byung ba/ tshigs su bcad 9pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su 'dzin pa/ 'jig rten thams cad las rnam par 'das shing 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas yongs su byung ba/ rgyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang dag par ston pa/ bskal pa bye ba khrag 35—803

khrig bsam gyis mi khyab par yon tan mi zad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa zad mi shes pa las byung ba/ sangs rgyas skye ba brjod du med pa yang dag par ston pa/ ye shes kyi sgo la rab tu yog71pa/ don yangs pa shin tu ston pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa/ brjod du named pa'i tshul yang dag par ston pal/ sangs rgyas kyi 5)yul mtha' dang dbus med pa chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du byin gyi rlabs kyis byung ba 'gro ba thams cad rnam par dag pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa chags pa med pa/ mtha' dang dbus med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa las byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan 4pa'i dpal yod pa/ rin po che'i 'od 'phro ba bye ba brgya stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa de 5ltar byung 6ba mthong bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang byin gyi rlabs kyi rgyan 7smon lam chen po las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' yas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes par bya ba'i spyod pas rnam par dag pa dang / sngon gyi bag yod pa las yang dag par byung ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems chags pa med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'byam naklas pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi spu the tsom hu 3gcod pa dang 1 / de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba la sems can tshad med pa rab tu dgod pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sgo dang sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul zil gyis non pa med pa la rgya mtsho'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can gzud par hu bya ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i dbaka' bzhin byed pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun nas 'dus pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi 5byin gyi rlabs dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos 35—804

bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su brjod pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor du ji lta7)ji ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byam naklas pa bye ba 55khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du myed pa grangs myed pa dag na/ sems ma dad pa rnams dad cipar bya ba dang / sems rinodad pa 6rnams rnam par 'phel bar bya ba dang /sems rnam par 'phel bas rnams rnam par dag par bya ba dang / sems 8rnam par dag pa0)rnams yongs su smin par bya ba dang / sems khoyongs su smin pa nyi1rnams 'dul bar bya ba dang / chos zab mo khong du chud par bya ba dang / ye shes snang ba mtha' dang dbus med pa 12khong du chud par bya ba dang / sems tshad med pa'i hu rnams rgya che bar bya ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa las phyir mi ldog par bya ba dang / chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar bya ba dang / yang dag pa'i mthas kṣami skrag par bya ba dang / de bzhin nyid rab tu rtogs par bya ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i tsharnams kyang rab tu rdzogs par bya ba dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par sbyang bar bya ba dang / dmyigs pa thams cad la brtson pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yang kun tu bzang po'i tshul du 7mos par bya ba dang / bdud kyi yul las rnam par ldog par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul 'thob par bya ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid shes par bya ba dang / ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye bar bya ba dang / theg pa chen po'i smon lam las phyir mi ldog 1 par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas blta ba las mi 'phang bar bya ba dang / ye shes khong du chud par bya ba tshad med pa rtogs par bya ba dang / sa mtshams med pa'i bsod nams kyi stobs yang dag par yongs su 18bsgrub par bya ba dang / shin 35wa 805

tu dga' ba'i sems bskyed par bya ba dang / the tsom hu)med pa'i sa la 'jug par bya ba dang / kha na ma tho ba med cing yongs su dag pa 'thob par bya ba dang /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la brten tshonadapa so sor 'thob 3par bya ba dang / chos mthong ba las phyir mi ldog par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshogs kyi rjes su 'jug par bya ba dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs grub par bya ba de lta de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs rje chen po kun tu khyab pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi phung po chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyi rgyan rnam pa tha dad pa pyadamang po yang dag par bstan to/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can thams cad 'dul ba'i dbang du sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid che ba brjod pa'i phyir chags pa med pa'i ye shes kyi snying po rab tu snang bas/ sangs rgyas kyi dpal mtha' yas pa rab tu 'bar ba/sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas rnam par snang ba thams cad du zhugs sridapa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i skus rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' dang dbus med pa'i cho 'phrul gyi mthu dang ldan pa/ dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i sngon gyi smon lam gyis yongs su grub pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par gnon pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gshegs stobs 6)phun sum tshogs pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug brnyes thopas chos thams cad la mnga' ba nadang ldan pa9 / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sgo nas byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnam par dag pas shin tu skyangs papa mnga' ba/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi hu7snying po shin tu sbyangs pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi dpes dper myi 'gyur ba'i sku 35—806

gzugs mnga' ba/ mtshan thams cad kyi lo ma shin tu 'phags pa'i sku can/stobs bcu'i rgyal mtshan gyi stobs chen po dang ldan pa/ bskal pa mi zad pa thams cad du blta bas mi ngoms nyu7pa/ sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ston ri pa'i dbyangs kyisheye shes kyi nga ror gyur pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor mi zad pas 'gro ba thams cad la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa/yon tan thams cad kyi rgyal po chos thams cad kyi srid la mnga' ba'i phyir dus gsum du chasnang bar byed pa'i gsung mnga' bas byin gyi rlabs kyi rgyan sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'ikhutshogs las yang dag par byung ba'i byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas lha'i rgyal7po rab dga' ldan gyis 7 tshul 'di lta bur de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / rim gro dang / rgyan zhe kun tu bshams 9 pa byas te/dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha bye ba brgya stong grangs myed pa dang lhan cig du/ zhe sa can rim gro dang bcas par bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der thal mo sbyar te/phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gshegs su gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa gshegs su gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bde bar gshegs sam / de nas bcom ldan 'das lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis spyan drangs nas / sangs rgyas kyi rgyan rnam pa 'di lta bu dang / sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid che ba 'gro ba thams cad la mdzes pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 7mos pa / dga' ldan gyi ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad mngon par dga' ba/ lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis mi ngoms par rim gror bya zhing / tshad med pa'i sems can sangs rgyas la 37dmyigs par brtson pa bskyed 12pa/ tshad med pa'i sems 35—807

can sangs rgyas su dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa mi zad pa'i bsod nams dang ldan par gyur pa1tsho/ dad pa dri ma med pa'i tshogs kyis bstsags ( pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal blta ba dang / mchod pas skyo bar mi 'gyur ba/ lhagashogepa'i bsam pa dge ba'i tshogs kyis yang dag par bsdus pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / smon lam dang sems bskyed pa las byung bas khang pa rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan par gshegs so/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das 'dir gshegs pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi ④dang /dga' ldan gyi gnas dag du 'ang 5gshegs par snang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i khang par gshegs ma thag tu de'i tshe/rin po che thams cad kyis 46brgyan pa'i khang pa rin po che'i rgyan las shin tu 'das par gnas so/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i rin po che thams cad kyi dra bas kun nas yog 47ripar gnas so/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i rin po che thams cad kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab par gnas so/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i rin po che thams cad kyi rgyan gyi na sprin gyis brgyan par 9gnas so/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i gos 1 rithams cad kyi sprin rab tu gtong bar gnas so/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i tsan dan thams cad kyi sprin chen po rab tu gtong bar gnas so//lha rdzas las 'das pa'i dri thams cad kyi mchog dang / bdug pa 'thul ba'i sprin gyi char rab tu 'bab par gnas so/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi sprin rnam pa tha dad pa'i char rab tu 'bab par gnas so/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i me 11tog mang po'i sprin gyi tshogs kyi char rab tu 'bab par gnas so/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i sil snyan dang / brdung 12ba bye ba 35—808

brgya stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgra rab tu 'byin par gnas so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos kyi dbyings su grag ti pa'i rol mo'i nasgra dang / glu'i nadabyangs kyang rab tu 'gyed (gepar gnas par gyur te/ ji ltar bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa dang /dga' ldan gyi gnas dag tu yang rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i khang par gshegs par snang ngo / /de nas lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis lha'i gnas thams cad du lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba btab po5nyezhes sgra brjod do/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan la bar chad du mi 'gyur ba dang / sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 6tshogs dang ske/ tshad med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas brtan pa dang / mtha' yas par sems bskyed pa'i dad pa rnam par 'phel ba dang / shugs chen po yang dag par bskyed pa dang / dga' ba chen po shin tu bskyed pa dang / dge ba'i bsam pa rnam par sbyangs pa mudang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pas dga' bar bya ba dang / chos la bar chad med pa'i yid du 'gyur bar bya ba dang ske/ chos rnams mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir dga' ldan naganas kyi glu 9dang /rol mo brdung ba dang / dkrol ba'i sgra rgyun mi chad 1 par gyur to/ /de nas lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la 11dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa de dag rjes su dran nas / de'i tshe tshigs su bcad 12pa 'di dag smras so/ /bkra 12shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /chags pa med pa'i zla bar mtshan gsol mtshan btags pa/ /pho brang mchog du rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir kṣayang bkra shis legs gyur 35wa 809

cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /ye shes mtha' yas dbang zhes bya bar mtshan btags pa/ /kha dog gser du rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /kun tu mtha' yas spyan zhes bya bar mtshan btags pa/ / pad mo'i ⑨rtse mor rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /yan lag rin po che zhes bya bar mtshan btags pa/ /rin chen mdzod du rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /dpal rab rgol ba'i stag ces bya bar mtshan btags pa/ /dbang po'i7khang par rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir7yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /yon tan thams cad ston pa'i nyis)mar mtshan btags pa/ /me tog snying por rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra geshis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis / /yan lag 'od gzer 6ramatha' yas par ni mtshan btags57pa/ /shingaphugis brgyan par phyorarab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /mgon po the tsom tso'ajoms pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan te/rte/ /rin chen khang par rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /mi yi seng ge ye shes sgron ma mtha' yas pa/ /spos kyi rtse mor rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /bkra shis dam pa gang zhig gis/ /sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas 'od mnga' ba/ /nor bus brgyan par 8rab gshegs pa/ /des ni 'dir yang bkra shis legs gyur cig /ji ltar lha'i rgyal 35—810

po rab dga' ldan gyis sangs rgyas kyi mthus sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan brjod de/ glu'i 1dbyangs su tshigs su bcad pasal/ rgyal ba gshegs pa mngon par bstod 2pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snon yang lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan rnams sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis glu ④dbyangs su tshigs su bcad 55)cing / sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan brjod pa 6byed cing rgyal ba gshegs pa'ang57mngon par bstod par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi sku shin tu rnam par dag pa'i sku dang / 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / rigs gcig tu gyur pas rnam par 'phrul pa dang / rgyud kyi tshul gcig natu gyur pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su thugs su 97chud pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ske/ chos thams cad la bsgribs 1 pa myed par khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyan dang ske/ chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs rgyun mi 'chad pa dang sems can 'dul ba ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsgribs 1lhapa med pa'i rgyan gyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang / dus nyi bzhin du byung ba'i chos bstan pa dang〈rte/ byang chub sems dpa' brjod du med pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs nas lhags 14pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i skus yang dag par spyod pa/ gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sku la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas khyu skomachog gi mthu phyung bas/ rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i khang par gshegs nas gdan bting ba la skyil mo krung sna 35—811

bcas te bzhugs so/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang bzhugs 1)par gyur te/ ji ltar bcom ldan 'das rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i khang par gshegs pa dang byon pa'i tshe / sangs rgyas kyi rim gro dang mchod pa byas shing / rgyan nagyis brgyan pa ribade dag thams cad pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa gdan de la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ grangs med par gyur pa dngas ri/ grangs med pa'i rnam par lha rdzas las 'das pa'i me tog dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / spos dang / phye ma dang /na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rin po che dang / rol mo brdungasar ba dang / dkrol ba dang / glu snyo dang / bstodamuge)pa dang ske/ zhe nas dang / rim gro dang / dad pa dang / dga' ba dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang / lha rdzas las 'das pa rnam pa grangs med pa'i rgyan tshoḍabyedang /lha rdzas las 'das pa rnam pa grangs med pa'i bstod pa dang / lha rdzas las 'das pa rnam pa 11grangs med pa'i sprin gyi char 'bab pa dang / lha rdzas las 'das pa rnam 12pa grangs med pa'i gdugs gcig nas gcig du brgyud nyusnyede bsgreng ba dang / lha rdzas las 'das pa 7rnam pa grangs med pa'i rgyal mtshan la ba dan spyangs gepa dang / shin tu spyangs pa lagangs med pas sbyar ba/ lha rdzas las 'das pa'i yo byad kyi tshul dang / bsam pa rgya chen po rnam par 'phel bas/sangs rgyas mnyes par bya ba dang / mdzes pa'i rgyan 1 rnam par dag pa //thams cad kyi rin po che'i dri thams cad dang / phyogs brgyan pa'i spos kyi sprin chen po dang ske/ rim gro nyu rnam pa sna tshogs rgya che zhing yid du 'ong bas sangs rgyas la mchod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rim gro la brtson pas de 35wa 812

bzhin gshegs pa gdan la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ grangs med pa'i gyur 1du mchod pa byas so/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi dga' ldan gyi gnas dag tu yang mchod pa byas par gyur to/ /nade bzhin gshegs pa ribazhud pa dang gshegs pa dang / bzhugs pa'i rgyan 4ces bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu brgyad pa'o ④de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus phyogs bcu zhinas byang chub sems dpa' bcu mngon par lhags te/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag so so nas 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol nas 'ongs par gyur pa dag ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag re re zhing yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 7kyi byang chub sems dpa' dag dang lhan cig tu phyin to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ste/ 'di ltar rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan dang /dam pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / dpa' ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / skar nama'i rgyal mtshan dang / ye shes kyi rgyal mtshan dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang /rdul dang bral ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / dri ma med pa'i rgyal mtshan dang /dpal gyi rgyal mtshan dang / chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 'jig rten gyi khams ming 'di zhes bya ba dag ⑨nas 'ongs par gyur pa dag ste/ 'di ltar rin po che'i snying po dang /yid du 'ong ba'i snying po dang / dngul gyi snying po dang / gser gyi snying po dang ske/ nor bu'i snying po dang / rdo rje'i snying po dang / pad mo'i snying po dang /35—813

utpa la'i snying po dang / tsan dan gyi snying po dang / spos kyi snying po zhes bya ba dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan 'di zhes bya ba gyo/dag gi zham ring rin tshangs par spyod pa dag ste/ 'di ltar shin tu 'phags pa'i dpal dang / g.yo ba med pa'i dpal dang /bcings pa med pa'i dpal dang / spyod pa'i dpal dang / 'od zer gyi dpal dang ske/ mtha' las rgal ba'i dpal dang / mchog gi dpal dang / dbang phyug gi dpal dang / tshangs pa'i dpal dang / shin tu bstsagasam pa'i dpal zhes bya ba dag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ phyogs bcu rgyas par byas te/ gang nas 'ongs pa'i phyogs su brten cananas/ seng ge'i khri rin po che'i dur snying po can nor bu sna tshogs dang ldan pa dag mngon par sprul te/ gser gyi dra bas g.yogs ⑥pa'i lus dang /'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa gtong ba dang / dri ma med pa'i 'od ri rigatong ba dang / tshad med pa'i 'od rab tu skyed58)pa dang / bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i tho rin po che yang dag par 'dzin pa'i gzugs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa kha na ma tho ba med pa las byung ba'i smon lam dang /'gro ba thams cad kyis blta na yid du 'ong ba dang / blta na don yod par sems can gdul ba dang / rnam par dag pa'i chos kyis sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa tshayongs su ston nyu1pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyab par byang chub sems dpa'i rtse gcig du smon lam btab /rtepas/ skyil mo krung nyunyebacas te 'khod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 'di lta ste/chags pa med par spyod pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'gro ba dang /35—814

'di lta ste/ gnas ①med pa'i lus dang / 'di lta ste/ tshad med pa'i lus kyis kun tu 'gro ba'i ye shes kyi lus kyi na byin gyi rlabs dang / 'di lta ste/mtha' dngasnyedabus med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug pa dang / 'di lta ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgo 'byams klas pa/tshad med par gyur pa dang / 'di lta ste/ chos la mi 'jigs par mkhas pa'i snang ba mtha' yas pa dang / 'di lta ste/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal par mi zad pa'i tha dad pa yang dag pa (5)shes pa'i tshul bshad pa dang / 'di lta ste/gzugs thams cad kyis snang bar byas pa'i ye shes kyi phung 5)po rab tu rgyas pa dang / 'di lta ste/ chos kyi dbyings rgyas par gyur pa'i shes rab kyi myig rnam par dag pa'i spobs pa dang / 'di lta ste/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyis speklas par ye shes kyi spyod yul yongs su gnas pa dang / mtshams med cing mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod pa dang ldan pa rab tu thob par gyur pa dag go / /ji ltar gling bzhi pa 'di'i dga' ldan gyi gnas su/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dus par gyur pa7de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gling bzhi pa dang / dga' ldan gyi gnas dag tu yang / byang chub sems dpa' ming de skad ⑨bya ba dag /'jig rten gyi khams ming de skad ces bya ba dag nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan de skad ces bya ba dag gi zham ring na tshangs par spyod pa sha stag 'ongs par gyur 7to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs〈nyebus mo'i lha nga gnyis nas 'od gzer 12bye ba khrag khrig brgya 32stong byung stekhiske/ phyogs bcu thams cad snang bar bebyas nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad bstan to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis/ 'jig 35—815
