rten gyi khams de dag gi gling bzhi pa thams cad dang / dga' ldan gyi gnas thams cad na de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa yod pa ①mthong bar rimigyur to / /byang chub sems dpa' de dag ji snyed kyis phyogs bcur chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mthar thug pa dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas gernam par rol pa mthong bar gyur pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi 5sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba'i grogs su gyur pa dag ste/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa zab mos rnam par 'phrul pa la mos pa sha stag go/ /chos kyi dbyings kyimardzo)lus tha dad pa med pa'i rjes su song ba sha stag go/ /gnas med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ba'i rjes su song bas rab tu zhugs pa sha stag go/ /sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa blta 4ba la rjes su gzhol ba sha stag go/ /chags pa med pa'i sems skad cig 8gis chos kyi dbyings khyab par byed pa 9 sha stag go/ /bsam pa rin po che rdul dang bral ba dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas mang po dang 'grogs pa dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /sangs rgyas kyis ⑩byin gyi rlabs grangs med pa dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /yang dag par spyod pa'i mchog gi pha rol tu phyin pa sha stag go/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi dran pa rnam par dag pa la gnas pa sha stag go/ /blo dang sems skad cig thams cad kyis cher 'phags pa rab tu thob pa sha stag go/ /chung 17ngur zhugs shing cher gyur pa'i spyod pa la dbang ba sha stag go/ /cher gyur pa la zhugs shing chung ngur 'jug pa'i rjes su chud nas ye shes kyis 12spyod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa sha stag go/ /35—816

de lta bu'i gnas dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rang bzhin rjes su rtogs pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'grogs shing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob pa(1 /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / rin po che sna tshogs ltar grub pa'i lus dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba'i ( spyod yul thams cad du 'gro ba dang ske/ ye shes chen po'i rgyud kyi sgo rnam par phye ba dang / ye shes kyi stobs rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan gyi mthu'i mchog thob pa dang / rdo 5rje gcod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul rab tu thob pa dang / sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa7rnams yongs su sbyin par gdul ba la rmongs pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad du 'gro ba gdon mi za ba'i mchog thob pa dang ske/ bgrang ba thams cad la mngon param chags pa dang / bgrang ba'i nemangon par bsgrubalgepa thams cad shin tu bslabs pa dang / bgrang ba'i shes pa thams cad kyi ⑨mthar thug cing chos rnam par dgod pa la mkhas pa dang 1 /'di dag dang gzhan yang yon tan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med 11pa dang ⑫/ yon tan bsngags 9/2pa rnam par dag pa mi zad pas/ byang chub sems semasatshwastedapa' rnams 3gekyi dus gsum gyi yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa sha stagatso /de bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum 1 /du bya ba dang / sangs rgyas 'byam snyiklas pa thams cad blta ba'i phyir kun nas 'dus par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje 37rgyal mtshan gyis / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dgasho nyasmras so/ /yang dag sangs rgyas skye ba med/ /rgyal ba mya ngan mi 'da' ste//rgyu mthun ni pa yi smon lam gyis/ /des ni rnam par 22'phrul pa snang / /'di 35—817

dag chos ni bsam mi khyab/ /'di dag sems kyi0)spyod yul min/ /gang gis ye shes pha rol phyin/ /des ni sangs rgyas spyod yul mthong / /lus 'di yang dag sangs rgyas myin/ /sgra yang de bzhin gshegs pa myin/ /lus dang sgra las gzhan na yang / /sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul mi mthong / /sngon gyi las rnams ma gtogs par/ /rang byung rnams kyi spyod yul gyi/ /mchog gi tshul rnams shes pa ni/ /blo zhan rirnams kyis mi nus so/ /yang dag sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul 'di/ /gang dag nas kyang ma 'ongs te④/ / gang du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di dag rang byung sku yin no/ /tshad med shin tu 'dren pa rnams//chos 'di rab tu bshad mdzad kyang / /chos la gnas pa gang yang med/ /zhing rnams bye ba kun na snang / /mkhyen pas yematha' dang dbus med de/ /chos kun thugs su chud cing rtogs/ /chos kyi dbyings la rab zhugs nas/ /rnam par 'phrul pa ri ston pa mdzad/ /chos rnams kun la chags pa med/ /'gro la de ni bsgribs 9)mi mnga'/ /tshad med pa yi yon tan gyis/ /zhing rnams kun na rab tu snang / /gang zhig ye shes 'di dag dang / /ye shes thams cad rtogs 'dod pas/ /bsam pa rnam par spyad byas te⑩/ /byang chub spyod pa spyad par bya/ /drang srong chen po'i nyu1byin gyi rlabs/ /'di 'dra gang gis mthong gyur cing ske/ /de 1 ni the tsom nyugemi byed na/ /dge bshes mchog la bsnyenasnyipa yin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /shin tu zab ste brjod du med/ /brjod du yod kyang 'da' bar dka'atsha / /tshig gi lam las shin tu 'das/ /nam mkha' la ni rgyal ba snang / /35—818

de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /mi yi seng ge mthong bar 'gyur/ /yang dag sangs rgyas rtogatumed kyang / /rgyal ba rnam par rtog par snang / /'jig rten mgon pos chos nyid dngos/ /zab mo 'di dag yang dag bstan na/ /gang zag mtshungs pa med pas③yi/ /des ni sku 'di ④norab tu 'byung / /thams cad gzigs kyi spyod yul gyi/ /ye shes chen po 'di 'dra ste/ /'di lam45)gang zhig rtogs 'dod pa/ /des ni 6)rgyal ba mngon du byos/ /yid kyi dbang po rnam dag pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsnyen bkur zhing / /'di yi tshul las 'da' byed tsheni/ /nam yang skyo bar mi bya'o/ /mi zad pa yi bsod nams dang //byang chub sems kyis brtan parwa)rnams/ /the tsom bornam par bzlog byas te/ /de dag la ni skyo med ltos3te/ /rgyal sras gang gis chos dbyings kyi/ /shin tu bstan pa'i mthar phyin pa/ /des ni kun gzigs rnam 'phrul ba/ /'di dag shin tu 'da' bar bya/ /dad pa nyu)chos 'di'i rtsa ba zhes/ /chos kyi phung pos bshad mdzad kyisatso/ /dad pa shin tu cher bskyed tshal/ /byang chub spyod pa spyad par gyis/ /sangs rgyas bsti stang 8gang byed cing / /de bzhin gshegs la drin gzo ba/ /yang dag sangs rgyas dpal ldan lasatsha/ /de dag rgyang mar mi 1 tshoganas so/ /bdag nyid che ba 'di lta bu/ /gang gis 18thos mthong mkhas pa 16rnams / /spyod yul thob par cis 3 sna'agyur ba'i/ /smon lam su zhig sbyong 21mi byed / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' sa ba'i rgyal mtshan gyis sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od snang bas/ /mig gis gzugs rnams mthong gyur pa/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyis/ /dag 3rte35wa 819

pa'i sems ldan rgyal ba mthong / /ji ltar brtson 'grus stobs ldan pa/ /rgya mtsho la ni 'jug par byed/ /de bzhin ye shes stobs ldan pas/ /bsam du med pa'i sangs rgyas mthong / /ji ltar sa bon rnam pa dag① /zhing bzang la ni skyer 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin sems bsam ༷ rnam dag la/ /sangs rgyas chos ni skye bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar nor gyi phung po yis/ /dbul ba thams cad spong byed pal/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas chos rnams kyis/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam dag 'gyur ri / /ji ltar dug tu gyur pa la/ /nad med dug sman rgyal bar byed/ /de bzhin nyon mongs rnam pa la/ /rnam dag tshul ni spyod yul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni gang bsngags pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes la brten ④byas na/ /de yi mthus ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos nyid 'di dag thos par 'gyur/ /bskal geb bye ba grangs med par ci/ /sbyin pa 7mchog rnams sbyin byas kyang / /'di yi tshul la rab spyod pa'i/ /grangs dang char yang myi 'gro'o/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' yas te/ /mtshan gyis shin tu rnam par bris/ /brjod pas yang dag sangs rgyas rnams/ /rgyal ba shes par mi nus so/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /gnas nas g.yo ba myi mnga' bar/ /sku ni kun tu rnam rgyu zhing //chos kyi dbyings ni ston pa mdzad/ /ji ltar nam mkha'i〈khams 'di ni/ /nam yang rang bzhin mi 'gyur te/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas chos nyid kyang / /ngo bo nyid las 'gyur ba med/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' skar ma'i rgyal mtshan gyis / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis9/ phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di 1 smras so/ /mi yi 'jig rten 'di kun dang / /lha yi gnas rnams thams cad dang / /'gro ba ma lus kun na yang / /mi yi 35—820

gtso bo shin tu snang / /ji ltar sems dngos gcig pu las/ /rnam pa tha dad sems brjod pa/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas sku gcig las/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brjod pa yin/ /byang chub gnyis su med pa 1brjod/ /byang chub de yang mtshan nyid med/ /mtshan gyis mngon par rnam bris pa'i/ /sku rnams gnyis su snang bar gyur/ /mkha' dang chos kyi dbyings la zhugs/ /sgyu ma'i sa yang rab tu bstan/ /de phyir sangs rgyas de dag gi/ /spyod yul blta nab zad pa med/ /yang dag sangs rgyas chos kyi sku/ /mgon po thams cad dus gsum du/ /ji ltar 'dul ba'i 'gro ba la/ /gzugs kyi sku ciyang rab tu snang / /'di 'dra'i 4tsholus su bdag gyur ces/ /sangs rgyas rtog par mi mdzad de/ /ston la rnam rtog mi mnga' yang / /byin gyi rlabs ni ston pa 5mdzad/ /dbyer med pa yi dbyings la yang / /chos kyi dbyings ni yang dag gnas/ /'jig rten khams ni tshad med par/ /thub pas rnam par rtog pa bstan/ /sku ni sprul pa ma yin te / /sprul papo)myin pa'ang sku ma yin/ /sprul pa med pa'i chos 'di yis/ /sprul pa rnams ni rab tu bstan/ /yang dag sangs rgyas tshad med pa/ /chos kyi dbyings la shin tu brten47)/ /mtha' dang dbus named rab tu zab/ /tshig gi lam gyis bzla7bar dka'/ /kun tu 'gro ba'i chos rnams la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don des mkhyen/ /zhing rnams kun la chags mi mnga' chos kyi dbyings la rnam par spyod/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /kun mkhyen ye shes ma chags pa/ /de la zhugs par 6gang gyur pa/ /de yi sems ni tshad mi zin/ /byang chub kyi ni spyad 35—821

pa spyod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mang po rnams/ /yul dang yul du de dag snang71)/ /chos rnams phyogs gcig gang la yang / /yang dag sangs rgyas gnas pa med/ /'jig rten sgron ma de dag gis/ /byin gyi rlabs ni gang bstan pa/ /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab par/ /'di yi mtha' ni rnyed par dka'/ /dus gsum rnams ni ji snyed pa'i/ /sems can rnams kyi mthar thug pa/ /bgrang ba'i mthar ni phyin par nus/ /'dren pa la ni mthar 50thug myed/ /de dag sku ni gcig tu snang / /sku gnyis de dag bsam mi khyab/ /'jig rten khams su snang gyur kyang / /sku la gnyis su gyur pa med/ /ji ltar zla ba shar gyur pa/ /tshad med pa yi gzugs brnyan rnams/ /chu yi snod du snang gyur kyang / /zla ba gnyis su gyur pa myed/ /de bzhin chags myed mkhyen ldan rnams/ /chags med rnam par 'tshang rgya ba/ /zhing rnams kun la gerab tu snang / /sangs rgyas la ni gnyis kyang med/ /'di la gcig kyang yod ma yin/ /sku ni gnyis sam gsum du med/ /ji ltar sems can bsam pa bzhin/ /tshad myed par ni rab tu snang ske/ /sku ni 'das pa ma yin te/ /ma 'ongs pa 'angs sku ma yin/ /skyes dang byang chub mya ngan 'das/ /skad cig ri5)gis ni rab tu snang / /ji ltar sgyu mar gyur pa'i gzugs/ /skyes pa ma yin 'ongs pa myin/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ /skye ba myed par shin tu bstan/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rin 4)po che'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /yang dag sangs rgyas tshad myed pas/ /tshad sumadu sku yang rnam par bstan/ /ji ltar 'dul ba'i sems can rnams/ /de bzhin 'dren pasamerab tu mthong / /sku 35—822

la phyogs ni myed par brjod/ /sangs rgyas yul ni ma lus khyab/ /bar snang nam mkha' ji lta b.rasti/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /der ni sems la mi'apho ba myed/ /sems la skye ba'ang yod ma yina'/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul ni/ /skye ba myed la rab tu gnas/ /ji ltar rab rib ldan pa'i myig /nang na myed cing phyi na'ang paskyed/ /de bzhin 'jig rten sangs rgyas dag /nang nasamyi bzhugs phyi na'ang myin/ /'jig rten kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rkang gnyis kyi ni mchog byung ste3ni/ /'jig rten du ni ma na byung bam3)yang / /'jig rten dag tu skye bos mthong / /sangs rgyas rnams la zhing myi gnas/ /rgyal ba dag la nyin mtshan med/ /skad gcig 3 ma yin zla ba myin/ /rgyal ba la ni lo mi gnas/ /'jig rten dag na 'di 11skad brjod/ /nyi ma che ge mo zhig tu / /rang byung byang chub rgyal bas thob/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma nya rjes mi 'brang / /de la bskal pa yod ma yin/ /dus kyang ma lus med pa ste/ /dus gsum yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mgon po rnams ni mnga' bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni/ / nams kyang thumatshan dang mi gnas temi/ / nyin mtshan zhes kyang rab tu brjod/ /8de bzhin sangs rgyas chos nyid do/ /bskal pa gcig dang dus gsum du/ /'dren pa nyi tshobazhugs pa ma yin te/ /dus gsum zhes kyang rab tu brjod/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos nyid ltos18/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdug dang bral ba'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /yang dag sangs rgyas sku gcig 17ste/ /'dren pa thams cad don gcig kyang / /tshad myed gzhan dang gzhan dag tu/ /phyogs bcu kun nas〈sna 35—823

rab tu snang / /gang gis ma lus thams cad kyi/ /chos kyi dbyings rnams kun khyab pas1/ /sems can gtso bosngo thub pa yoX/ /spyod yul rnams ni ci 'dra ltos / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos nyid ni/ /nang gi skus kyang snang ba myin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs/ /phyi rol skus kyang myi snang ngo / /dus mang cadakun tu las rnams kyis/ /ji ltar las rnams bstsags0pa bzhin/ /de bzhin so sor phye ba'i skus/ /rigs su byung bar rab tu bstan/ /rgyal ba'i chos nyid ma gtogs par/ /sangs rgyas sku ni 'di56)'dra ba/ /grangs su bgrang bar myi nus te/ /bsam pas lta yang shes myi nus/ /ji ltar bdag cag sems kyi las/ /bsam gyis myi khyab myi 'byung ba/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas bsam myi khyab / /sems kyi 'phrin las myi mnga'o/ /ji ltar zhing rnams bsam yas pa/ /sa la rnam par dag par rtsonamadzes/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /'gro ba dag na mdzes par snang / /ji ltar las rnams 'jug pa ni/ /rkyen gyis rab tu 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin rgyu rnams 'thun dpa las/ /sangs rgyas shin tu mthong bar 'gyur/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal po ni/ /ji ltar yid bsam rdzogs byed pa/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas chos nyid kyang / /rtag tu smon lam rdzogs par sgrubahu ri/ /mtha' dang dbus nyu1med 'jig rten 'dir/ /'jig rten mgon po 'dren par 'gyur512/ /de yi smon lam de dag gis/ /phyogs bcu 'di dag rgyal bas gang / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis/ phyogs bcur rnam tsho/nyepar bltas te/de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor sangs rgyas te / /'jig rten chos rnams rnam par sbyong / /'jig rten chos rnams rnam 35—824

sbyangs nas/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams rab tu brjod/ /de tshoste sems can mnyam sangs rgyas/ /sems can la la grobasam byas na/ /rgyal ba de dag thams cad mthong / /sangs rgyas la ni gshegs pa med/ /sangs rgyas la ni dmigs byas nas/ /sems kyis sangs rgyas dmyigs pas na/ /sems bskyedamachi pa dang rgyal mnyam par/ /de bzhin de dag rgyal ba mthong / /dkar po'i mchos kyis nyer brtan cing / /gang gis grags pa rnam sbyangs pa/ /de dag thams cad sems bskyed la/ /shes rab ldan pa rab tu bzhugs/ /dmyigs pa dag dang byin gyi rlabs/ /myi yi gtso bo ston pa mdzad/ /deshos/phyir dmyigs pa kun tu yang rka/ /sangs rgyas rgyal ba gshegs par brjod/ /'jig rten khams rnams 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas sku rnams bdag gi myed/ /sems la bdag gi med pa bstan/ /byang chub rtogs la bdag gi med/ /mi yi seng ge'i chos nyid dang ske/ /dpa' ba'i55)stobs la rab tu gnas/ /lus dang mtshan nyid mi 'dra ste / /snang ba'i sems dang mnyam pa'i sku/ /ji ltar 'jig rten de bzhin sku/ /ji bzhin skur g.yang rgyal ba ste/ /sku yi rang bzhin shes pa ni/ /sangs rgyas chags pa med ces bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu gzigs pa ste/ /chos rnams thams cad rab tu gzigs/ /sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub rnams/ /gang la'ang dmyigs pa med pa yin/ /sangs rgyas la ni gshegs pa myed/ /sangs rgyas gang na'ang mi bzhugs te bye/ /yang dag sangs rgyas log pa med/ /de bzhin gshegs la57len mi mnga'/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas tehu3 ske/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 35—825

kun tu khyab/ /zhing gcig la ni mi7gnas te/ /thams cad du ni sangs rgyas gshegasal/ /zhing rnams kun tu rab tu snang / /sangs rgyas sku ni thams cad du//byin gyi rlabs dag rab tu 'byung / /'tshang rgya chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /bsam pa bzhin du mya ngan 'da'/ /sangs rgyas la ni su zhig sems/ /ci phyir sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab/ /yang dag sangs rgyas su yis mthong / /rgyal ba sus kyang mthong mi5kye'agyur/ /ji ltar chos rnams chos nyid dang / /ji ltar sangs rgyas spyod yul du/ /gang dag chos rnams gcig tsam yang / /de bzhin nyid la mi 'jug go/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'di rgyal zhes/ /'jig rten dag na rnam rtog yod/ /gang gis ngo bo nyid shes na/ /'jig rten myed de rgyal ba'ang7med/ /'jig rten dad par bya ba'i phyir/ /mgon po dag ni mngon sum ston/ /de dag gi ni lta ba 'di/ /shin tu dmyigs par mi rung debya/ /gang gis chags pa rnamasasnyibazlog cing / /chags pa med pa 4)dga' byed pa/ /chags pa thams cad rnam gebazlog nas/ /chags med chos nyid rtogasalgepar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhes brjod gang yin dang / /gang gi rnam 'phrul snang gyur pa'i/ /chos ni dus gsum thams cad du/ /rnam pa kun du mi rnyed de6)/ /gang gis chos nyid 'di shes shing / /gang gis 'di bzhin yid shes spun/ /thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs kun tshepa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pal myur du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rnam 'phrul pa/ /'di dag thams cad tshig gis bstan/ /yang dag sangs rgyas tshig lam myed/ /tshig gi lam gyis rab tu brjod/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras 35—826

sol/ /gang gis rnam par 'phrul snang ba'i/ /sangs rgyas mthong ba med pa bas/ /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad ni①/ /sdug bsngal phung po blangs kyang bla(mi/ /'gro ba gang gis byang chub tu/ /sems ni nam yang ma bskyed pa/ /de dag gnas 'di thos gyur na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 'grub par 'gyural/ /gang gis bsam pa gcig gis kyang / /'di la mos byed mkhas pa ni/ /mi yi mchog tu mi 'gyur zhes/ /des ni the tsom7mi bya'o/ /de yi rnam par 'phrul pa ni/ /bskal pa bye ba'i bar du dkon⑤/ /su zhig 'di la mos byed pa/ /de dag bla na med par 'gyur/ /brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /skad cig skad cig bsnyen bkur kyang / /'di yi tshul la masreganas na/ /de dag bsnyen bkur byas ma yin/ /gang lasashesangs rgyas brjod 'gyur ba'idu/ /chos 'di gang gis thos gyur pa/ /des ni myi bde kun gyis kyang / /spyad pa rnams ni blang bar bya/ /ji tsam chos kyi dbyings rnams dang / /dus gsum gyi ni mgon po yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni rtenalo)pa yi/ /ye shes chen po gcig thos nas/ /phyi mtha'i bskal pa bye ba rnams/ /zhing rnams re rer zad byas shing / /'di yi tshul ni brtson byed na/ /de la nyu7byang chub dkon pa myed/ /sems can rnams kyi sngon mtha' am/ /'khor bar mi rnams gnas gyur kyang / /des ni sangs rgyas rab byung〈nyeb/ /chos nyid 'di nimo8shes ma gyur/ /chos rnams zhig paratsobyas pa med/ /chos ni 'jig par mi 'gyur te/ /kun tu snang las rnam 'phrul pa/ /'jig rten dag tu7thams cad bstan/ /7dga' ldan gyi gnas su byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bstan pa'i le'u ste/ nyi shu dgu pa'o// //35—827

sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/(1 bam po sum cu pa/ni de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan de'i tshe/sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ ting nge 'dzin ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag du/ de'i tshe ༷phyogs bcu'i phyogs re rer 'jig rten gyi cakhams sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'das pa'i phamararol nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis zhal bstan pa mthong ste/de dag kyang 'di lta ste/ mtshan rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba sha stag go/ /phyogs gcig nas ji lta ba ltar phyogs bcu nas kyang de bzhin te/ de la /yesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis 'di skad ces kyang bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan de ltar khyod byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ye shes snang ba la snyoms par zhugs pa legs so legs so/ /'di ltar yang rigs kyi bu khyod la phyogs bcu nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed thams cad kyang mtshan 'thun 47)pa sha stag gis/'di ltar bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 'di'i sngon gyi smon lam dang /sngon gyi byin gyi rlabs dang / khyod kyi ye shes rnam par dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa bas brtan pa'i phyir/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i mi 'jigs pa rnam par dag par bya ba dang / spobs pa chags pa med par bya ba dang / ye shes kyis bsgribs napa myed pa'i sar 'jug 35—828

par bya ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems yangs pa la rab tu 'jug par bya ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa hu1ba myi zad pa phun sum tshogs par bya ba dang /bsgribs mipa myed pa'i chos dkar po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings la sgo kun nas 'jug par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi cho 'phrul bstan par bya ba dang / sngon snyigyi mtha'i mur thug pa'i ye shes dang /dran pa rgyun mi chod par rnam par dag par bya ba dang / dbang po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis byin du brlabs par bya ba dang / chos kyi sgo mtha' yas bsrebastan par bya ba dang / shes pa kun tu gzung bar bya ba dang /'di lta ste/ yongs su bsngo0)ba bcu yongs su rdzogs par bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gzung bar bya ba dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshogs rnams rab tu bstan par bya ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mi chod ⑥par bya ba dang / smon lam chen po'i skabs dbye bar bya ba dang / don shin tu bstan pa la 'jug par bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings yongs su shes par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yidamacharab tu dga' bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi srid pa gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'thun nipa la bstenashepar bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs yang dag par gzung bar bya ba'i phyir byin gyis brlab pa mdzad kyisahu )/ kye rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu dang /sangs rgyas kyi tsho/7byin gyis brlabs patshwa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsod nams kyis brtan pa dang / gzungs kyi snang ba 1snyel zhugs pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos bsgribs 8pa med pa la zhugs pa dang / chos kyi dbyings 35—829

snang ba'i chos nyid du bya ba dang / kha na ma tho ba med pa'i chos dkar po yang dag par bsgrub par bya ba dang / ye shes kyi spyod yul yangs pa la gnas pa dang ske/ bsgribs0)pa med pa'i chos snang ba la gnas pas chos bstan pa 'di brjod pa dang / bstan pa'i phyir〈spobs par gyis shig /de nasashesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan gyi ye shes tshad med pa nye bar bsgrubalgepa mdzad do/ /spobs pa chags pa myed pa dang /tshig rab tu dbye ba la mkhas pa nye bar bsgrubalgepa mdzad do/ /bsgribs pa med pa'i chos kyi snang ba nye bar bsgrub ⑦pa mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku dang gcig pa nye bar bsgrub (kyepa mdzad do/ /tshad med pa'i dbyangs7kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag par7nye bar bsgrub5)pa mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par dbye ba la mkhas pa nye bar bsgrub pa hu mdzad do/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad nyams pa med par yongs su bsngo ba'i ye shes nye bar bsgrubasngogepa mdzad do/ /chos thams cad kyi lhag mthong mngon par bskyed pa la mkhas pa nye bar bsgrubalgepa mdzad do//chos thams cad bstan pa'i gnas rgyun mi chadamugepa nye bar bsgrub pa mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di lta steyi/ ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i gzi brjid kyi phyir ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag ginyephyag g.yas pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i 4)rgyal mtshan gyi spyi bo la byug pa mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i zhu )rgyal mtshan la reg ma thag tu ting nge 'dzin de las rnam par langs te langs du mnas kyang byang chub sems dpa' de dag la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 35—830

dag byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam 'di lta ste/ 'gro ba thams cad khyab par byed pa/ sems can thams cad yongs su skyob pa 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab0)ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi7yongs su bsngo ba la ②slob bo/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba la slob par 'gyur ro/ /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba la slob bo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis yongs su bsngo ba gang la bsams te de0skad du smras pa de dag ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras dag yongs su bsngo ba'i grangs du zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /bsngo ba bcu po 'di dag ni 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis gsungs so/ /gsung ngo / /gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can rnams kyi 'du shes 'gog cing 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba dang po dang / mi phyed pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba gnyis pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la yang dag par bskyed pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su (gabasngo ba gsum pa dang / thams cad kyi 7rjes su song ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba bzhi pa dang / bsod nams kyi mdzod mi zad pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba lnga pa dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song ba zhes bya ba byang 35—831

chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba drug pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba bdun pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi hu)yongs su bsngo ba brgyad pa dang /chags pa med cing bcings pa dang dgrol geb myed pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba dgu pa dang / chos kyi dbyings tshad med pa'i rjes su song ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba bcu pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs susnyebasngo ba bcu po de dag ni/ 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ri kyis gsungs so/ /gsung ngo / /gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ba dang po sems can rnams kyi 'du shes 'gog cing 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di la/ byang chub sems dpa' 5sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa la rab tu sbyor ba'am tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 6)rnam par sbyong meba'am/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sems pa na'am/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rtsom 6)pa'am/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par dpyod pa'am/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 'jug pa'am/ byams pa bsgom hu7pa yang dag par skyed turtepa'am / snying rjes snying brtse /lhabar byed pa'am/ dga' ba la rab tu dga' bar byed pa'ams/ btang snyoms la shin tu gnas pa 3gebyed kyang rung ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams la shin tu bsamasamatshanas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dang de dag la 35—832

rab tu sbyor zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba tshad myed pa rnam par phyes3)nas/ 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba gang gis sems can rnams kyi sems can dmyal ba'i ngan song rgyun chad par 'gyur ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas pa dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po rnam par ldog par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'gro ba thams cad la rnam par dag pa'i mthar phyin par phan 'dogs pa gang yin zhes sems skyedasado/ /de de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yang dag par bskyed gepa na/ 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sdug bsngal gyi phung po thams cad rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir bdag sems can thams cad kyi gnas su gyur cig /nyon mongs pa thams cad las yongs su dgrol ba'i phyir bdag sems can thams cad kyi dpung geganyen du gyur cig /'jigs pa kun las bsrung ba'i phyir bdag sems can thams cad kyi skyabs su gyur cig /thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bdag sems can thams cad kyi lam du gyur cig /shin tu bde ba dang ldan pa thob par bya ba'i phyir/bdag sems can thams cad kyi rten du gyur cig /rab rib myed pa'i ye shes pasnang bapo)yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir/ bdag sems can thams cad kyi snang bar gyur cig /ma rig pa'i mun pa rnam par bsal ba'i phyir/ bdag sems can thams cad kyi sgron mar gyur cig /shin tu dag pa la rab tu dgod pa'i phyir / bdag sems can thams cad kyi mar mer gyur cig /chos kyi tshul la gzud pa'i phyir/ bdag sems can thams cad kyis3)'dren par gyur cig /bsgribs thupa med pa'i ye shes kyi phung po bstan spupa'i phyir/ bdag sems can thams cad kyi yongs su 'dren par gyur cig ces/ de de ltar 'gro ba thams 35—833

cad kyi don du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar shin tu thug par dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo ste/ ji ltar mdza' ba bsrung ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo ba de ltar mi mdza' ba bsrung ba'i phyir yang yongs su bsngo'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la bdag tu bya ba'i bsam pas mi mdza' ba ni gang yang myed de/ de yang 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' ni chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid la7yang dag par byungakhub ste/ de 'di snyam du byang chub sems dpa' la mi mdza' ba'i don byed pa de dag thams cad ni bdag gi rgyud la dgod dgod mipa yin no zhes te/ de dag ni sems can thams cad kyi yul thams cad la zhe snang ba myed pa'i mig gis lta'oX/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen sanate/ sems can thams cad la dge ba'i chos yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir 'jug go/ /'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po ni dug thams cad kyis gdug par bya bar yimi nus so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang drin mi gzo ba dang / blo zhenashepa dang / sems 'khrug⑧pa dang /rtogs1)pa dang / mun nyi ripar gyur pa dang / rang bzhin stor bsngo)dang / rlom sems dang ldan pa dang / sgrub pa nyams pa dang / sems rmus7long lta bur gyur pa'i sems can gyis pa thams cad kyis〈nyeskyon can du7mi nus so/ /'di lta ste dper na/ lha'i bu nyi ma 'char ba de ni rmus7long gi skyon gyis 'char ba la tsothogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /dri za'i grong khyer gyi skyon gyis thogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /gling bzhi 3 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sa'i rdul gyi skyon gyis thogs par myi 'gyur ro/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan gyi skyon gyis thogs par mi 35—834

'gyur ro/ /du ba 'khrigs7pa'i skyon gyis thogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i skyon gyis thogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /grib ma sna tshogs kyi skyon gyis thogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /dug gi ri'i skyon gyis thogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /khams kyi nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i skyon gyis thogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /dus yongs su 'gyur ba'i skyon gyis thogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dran pa can yang dag par shes pa dang ldan pa/ sems kyi bdag nyid che ba nyid shin tu zab cing yangs pa yid la yang dag par rtog pa/ mi zhan pa yon tan spyad pas ye shes ②mthar gyur pa chos la shin tu dad pa'i sems mngon par skyes pa/ chos kyi snang ba'i 'od kyis ③rab tu snang ba don thams cad mthong ba chos mngon par shes pa ye shes rig pa spyod ④pa med pa lhur byed pa/ sems can thams cad dge ba'i chos spyod pa la rab tu sbyor bdu/ sems can thams cad kyis nyes pararnyusems bskyed pa la 'khrul pa med pa de yang dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo ba name/gnod par byed pa thams cad kyi skyon gyis thogs par myi 'gyur ro/ /sems can mi srun pa'i tshul gyis ldog par myi 'gyur ro/ /sems can gyi lta ba'i rnyog pas dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo khrub dang bral khyabar mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can gyi sems 'khrugs pas ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can gyi sems kyi rgyud stor bas byang chub sems dpa'i go cha hu7chen po bgos pa las ring bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyabatshwanyepa'i smon lam dkrugs〈snyema'i rnyog pa thams cad kyis bcil bar mi 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 8rtsom pa chen po sems can drin du mi gzo ba mthong bas lhod par mi 'gyur ro/ /35—835

byang chub tu dmyigs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can mi srun pa'i dbang pos zhum par mi 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba ji lta ba bzhin las byis pa'i skye bo dang 'grogs pa las 'phang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sems can gzhan gyi0)skyon gyis skyo bar mi 'gyur ro/ /dubade ci'i phyir zhe na/ dkyil 'khor 'di ni bsgribs ④pa med par 'gro ba thams cad/ rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir 'byung ba ste/ /sems can gcig la dmyigs shing / byang chub sems dpa' rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo (3)ba ma yin/'di lta ste/ zhing rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir zhing gcig la dmyigs te/byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi sems la mngon par spro ba ma yin/ 'di lta ste / sangs rgyas lta cigacib rnam par dmigs pa'i phyir sangs rgyas gcig la dmyigs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dad pa skye ba ma yin/ 'di lta ste ye shes gcig rjes su rtogs pa'i phyir ye shes gcig la dmyigs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam skye ba ma yin gyi 'di ltar sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su bsngo'otho/ /zhing thams cad yongs su sbyang ba'i 7phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su bsngo'o2)/ /sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod cing rim gror thonabya tu tshoba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas thams cad blta ba la dmyigs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dad pa skye'o11ske/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi ye shes kyis rjes su rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo nyu2ba rnams kyi smon lam skye'o / /de yang 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas 35—836

kyi stobs la dmigs pa la ①sems yangs pa/ bsam pa ma 'khrugs zhu)pa/bskal pa thams cad du shin tu dkon⑧pa'i sems rin po che dang ldan pa rnams kyi sems ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir rab tu skyes te④/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yang dag parasamathong nas/ sems dad pa chen po rnam par dag pa dang ske/ snying rje chen posakhebartan pas bsngo zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba de dgasnyisems can thams cad la 3)yongs su bsngo stesngo 3de yang tshig tsam du ma 31yin gyi bsam pa thag pas yongs su bsngo'o(rte/ /de yang dga' ba'i sems dang / rab tu dga' ba'i sems dang / dad pa'i sems dang / mos pa'i sems dang / 'jam〈rtepa'i sems dang / byams pa'i sems dang / nye ba'i sems dang / snying brtse ba'i sems dang / phan gdags pa'i sems kyis yongs su bsngo'o0/ /de yang 'di ltar yongs su bsdom8sto/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad kyi 'gro ba rnam par dag par gyur cig /skye ba yongs su dag par gyur cig/bsod nams kyi bdag nyid che ba yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /zil gyis mi non par gyur cig /mi zad par gyur cig /thub par dka' ba'i 8sems su gyur cig /dran pa nyams pa med par gyur cig /rtogs parwa 7nges par gyur cig /blo tshad med par gyur cig /lus kyi las dang ngag gi las dang / yid kyi las kyi yon tan gyi rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can de dag thams cad sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mnyes par byas nas kyang thugs 'byung ba med par gyur cig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la mi phyed pa'i dad pa yang 35—837

thob par gyur cig /de dag gis de bzhin gshegs0)pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis mchos bstan pa thobashepar gyur cig /thos nas kyang the tsom 5)dang yid gnyis med par gyur cig /yang dag par 'dzin cing nan tan gyis bsgrub 3)par gyur cig sems can gyi yidaga' ba nyid kyang thob par gyur cig /kha na ma tho (7)ba med pa'i lus kyi las kyang yang dag par grub par gyur cig /dge ba'i rtsa ba chen po la bdag rab tu gzhog par gyur cig /shin tu dbul ba dang rnam par bral〈bar gyur cig /nor bdun 'thob 9 pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su yang slob par gyur cig /dge ba'i dbang po 'thob par bya ba 'ang thob par gyur cig /mos pa chen po'i mnyam pa nyid kyang yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi go yang hu1rnyed par gyur cig /'gro ba thams cad du nyams pa med pa'i mig kyang rnyed 8par gyur cigatunye /mtshan gyis brgyanatswapa'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa yang thob par gyur cig /yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i tshig rnam par dag pa yang yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /dbang po bsdams shing stobs bcu dang ldan pa'i sems dge bsnyiyang yangasnyidag par grub par gyur cig /gnas med par spyod pa yang yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /sangs rgyas thams cad bde ba'i rim gro gang dang ldan pa'i bde ba'i rim gro de dag sems can 18thams cad kyis thob par gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi gnas rab tu thob pas /'otshad med pa'i gnas su gyur cig /sems can de dag thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po sgrib pa'i las sna tshogs las byung ba/ sgrib pa'i las de dag gis bsgribs pas ni )sangs rgyas mi mthong ba dang / chos mi rnye35wa 838

thos pa dang / dge 'dun mi shes pa'i bsgribs ①pa'i las rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bstsagasalgepa'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po de dag bdag gi lus 'disashesems can dmyal ba'i skye gnas dang / ngan song gi sa'i duganas de dang de dag du blang bar 0bya'o/ /sems can de dag thams cad ni dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis de nas bton te/ bdag gis de dag gi sdug bsngal dang nyon mongs pa 0de dag blang b.rashebya'o/ /spro bar bya'o/ /⑧mi ldog par bya'o/ /de las mi 'bros par bya'o / /mi skrag par bya'o/ /mi 'jigs par bya'o/ /phyir mi ldog par bya'o/ /zhum pa med par bya'o/ /mi skyo bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag gis ni sems can thams cad bsgral bar smon lam btab pas na sems can thams cad kyi khurashebakur dgos so/ /'di ltar bdag gis sems can thams cad yongs su dgrol bar bya'o/ /'di ltar bdag gis sems can thams cad bsgral bar bya'o/ /skye ba'i dgon pa dang / rga ba dang na ba'i dgon pa dang / 'chi ba'i dgon pa dang / 'chi 'pho7dang skye ba'i dgon pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi dgon pa dang / mi khom pa thams cad kyi dgon pa dang / 'khor ba thams cad kyi dgon pa dang / lta ba'i thibs7po thams cad kyi dgon pa dang /dge ba'i7chos thams cad stongakheba'i dgon pa dang / mi shes pasnyilas byung ba'i dgon pa dang / dgon pa de dag thams cad nas bdag gis sems can srid pa'i dra bas 'khrigs patso/ ma rig pa'i sgrib pas bsgribs57pa0/ srid pa'i sred pa dang ldan pa/ zhen pa'i mthar gyur pa/ sdug bsngal gyi shing thags kyis bskor ba/ bdud kyi las la rten pa/ mi mkhas pa/ bsod nams 'gags pa/ the tsom nyedu gyur pa/ rtag tu yid gnyis dang ldan pa/ mi bde 35—839

ba mthong ba/ 'byung ba la mi mkhas pa/ tshub mas bskoratuba'i lo ma lta burakhu'akhor zhing 'phyanasari pa de dag thams cad yongs su thar bar bya'o/ /zhes de la byang chub sems dpa'i〈gesnying rje chen posayongs su rgyas pa'i sems dang ldan pas sems can gyi khams 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba mthong nas/ sems can de dag la snying brtse ba chen po skyes pa/ phan cher gdags 4)pa'i sems rab tu bskyed pa/ sems can rnams kyi don chen po bya bar dga' ba sems can mang po rab tu 'grol bar rtsonodage ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo bse/ yongs su bsngo ba chen po la zhugs pa/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yongs su bsngo ba la rab tu zhugs pa/ bsngo ba tshechen po'i mdos tshisems can thams cad la dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo ba/ sems can thams cad shin tu rnam par dag par bya bar sems pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba kun thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar thug par yongs su bsngo ba de sems 'di lta bu hu1dang ldan par gyur hu3te / sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi rgyal srid la rab tu gzhag pa'i phyir nyi bdag spyod de/ bdag ni bdag 'ba' shig7yongs su dgrol ba la mngon par zhugs pa ma yin gyis/de/ bdag gis sems can 'di dag kun thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems rab tu snang bas 'khor ba'i dgon pa brgal 8dka' ba nas gdon par bya'o/ /g.yang sa chen po nas blang bar5)bya'o/ /gnod pa thams cad las 18yongs su dgrol bar bya'o/ /'khor ba'i rgyud las rab tu bsgral bar bya'o/ /bdag nyid kyis sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po blang bar spro bar bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can de dag thams cad 35—840

'khor ba'i sdug bsngal chen po'i sa'i 'og nas drang bar bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi mthar thug0)pa thams cad kyi ngan song kun gyi sdug bsngal thams cad blangs te nyams su myong bar bya ba la bdag gis7spro bar bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba las mi spang bar bya'omi/ /sems can thams cad yongs su dgrol ba'i phyir bdag ngan song gcig nas7phyi ma'i mthar thug pa'i bskal par gnas par7spro bar bya'o/ /ngan song gcig tu ji lta ba de〈pebazhin du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gtogs pa'i ngan song thams cad du gnas par spro bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kyi hud sems can 'di dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi gnas su lhung ba9)bas ni bdag gcig pu sdug bsngal myong bar bla'i dubadag gis der bdag nyid gtar bcug ste/ sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi dgon pa nas/ 'gro ba thams cad blus te/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sdug bsngal tshor ba'i phung po 'di dag thams cad bdag gis 6)lus 'dis myong bar bya'o/ /bdag gis ni sems can thams cad 7kyi gnya' hu1bden par smra ba5)dang / yid ches hunyeshing mi bslusabar spro bar bya'i mibadag la ni sems can thams cad kyis ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di lta ste/'gro ba thams cad yongs su dgrol ba'i phyir/ bdag gis thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems/ sems can thams cad la dmyigs pa skye stekho/ bdag nyid 'dod pa'i phyir ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ma zhugs sothe tsho/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la dga' zhing spyod pa'i phyir 3nyeyang ma yin no/ /'dod pa'i yul la bsnyen7)pa'i phyir yang ma yin no/ /'dod pa'i khams su gtogs 35—841

pa'i dga' ba mang po gzhan blang ba'i7phyir yang byang chub kyi spyod pa la mi spyod do / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi dga' ba 'di dgashethams cad nisnyedagra yin no/ /'dod pa la bsten pa 'di ni bdud kyi yul lo/ /'dod pa la bsten ⑤pa de ni blo ngan pas dubastan pa'i lam mo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis smad pa'i yul lo/ / de dag la bsten pa de las sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de las sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten 'di dag thams cad kyang ⑧'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de las sems can rnams 'thab pa dang / 'tshangashe'adru ba dang /rtsod pa dang / gnad la 'bebs pa dang / 'khrugarwanyepa dang / kun tu 'khrug pa rnams kyang rab tu 'byung ngo / /sems can 'di dag ni 'dod pa la bsten 6)pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams las ring (nyedu gyur pa ste/'dod pa de dag ni mtho ris su skye ba la yang bar du gcod na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la lta7smos kyang ci7dgos te/ sems can thams cad kyi bde ba dang / dga' ba thams cad kyi yang bar chad du 'gyur ro//de ltar bdag gis 'dod pa ni ro chung zhing tshad med pa'i nyes pa can du mthong na/ ci7yang de dag spyod pa'i phyir 'jug gam/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bdag ni don 'di dag gi phyir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu zhugs pa ma yin no/ /'dod pa la dga' ba'i phyir yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la mi spyod de/ de bas na sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar zhugs pa'i sems bskyed de/ bdag ni 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir de dag nyid gyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / bsngo zhing 35—842

bsgrub pa'i phyir don de la zhugs pa ste/ de bas na bdag gis sems can sdug bsngal gyi zhags pas bcings pa thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi zhags pa bcad de/sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su dgrol bar bya'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi rgyud las rnam par bzlog par bya'o/ /bdag gis ji lta ①ji ltar sems can 'di dag thams cad7shin tu7bde ba dang / phan par 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang / tshor ba med pa'i bde ba dang / zhi ba'i bde ba dang / mi gnas pa'i bde ba dang /mi g.yo ba'i bde ba dang / tshad med pa'i bde ba dang / ma nyams pa'i bde ba dang ske/ mi 'gag pa'i bde ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bde btso)rab tu 'thob par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /bdag kha lo sgyur ba dang / bdag mgon po dang / bdag me sgron 'dzin pa dang / bdag lam bde ba ston pa dang / bdag khom pa rnyed pa dang ske/ bdag thabs la mkhas pa dang / bdag don shes pa dang / bdag 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho la thams cad mkhyen pa'i gru bo che'i mnyan par gyur pa dang /bdag yongs su bsngo ba la mkhas pa dang / bdag pha rol ston pas dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag ji lta ji ltar sems can rnams kyi skyabs su 'gyur ba〈nyadang / 'khor bar gyur pa rnams yongs su rgal bar 'gyur bshedang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par 'gyur ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du bsgribasatshwa sdupa med par 'gyur ba dang / bdud kyi yul rnams la mi gnas par 'gyur ba dang ske/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i grogs po thams cad yongs su spong bar 'gyur ba dang ske/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen byang chub sems dpa'aphanyathams cad la bsten〈rtepar 'gyur ba dang / las rnam5)par dag pa la kha na ma tho ba med par 'gyur 35—843

ba dang / spyadamatsho)pa chen po'i smon lam rnams yang dag par bsgrubalgepar 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad khong du chud par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar yongs su bsngo'ori / /de la byang chub sems dpa'asredage ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo bangasanan sems 'di snyam du bskyed mede/ kye mas47gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi khams snang bar bya ba'i phyir/ gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sems can ji snyed pa de snyed kyi nyi ma ni mi 'char gyi gling bzhi'i 'jig rten snang bar bya ba'i phyir nyi ma 'di nyid gcig pu'u'achar te/ sems can gling bzhir gtogs pa de dag rang rang gi lus las kyang snang ba gang gis de dag gis 7nyi ma'i grangs shes par 'gyur ba'am/ rang gi don bsgrubatshwa )par 'gyur ba'am/ lo tog yongs su smin par 'gyur ba'am/nya/ nyin gcig nyin gcig cing tunyebaza' shing 1 gi ra ba dang / grong khyer dag tu dga' ba dang / rtse ba'i longs spyod myong bar 6'gyur ba'am/ phyogs snang bar 'gyur ba'am/ grong dang grong khyer dang ljongs dang/ pho brang 'khor dang / rgyal po'i gnas dag tu 'gro ba dang 'ong bar bya ba'am/ spyod pa'i don sbyar bar bya ba'i tugesnang ba mi 'byung ste/sems can de dag rang rang gi lus la yang 'od gang gis de dag gi don bsgrub78pa'i 'od de lta bu mi gtong ste/ 'di ltar lha'i bu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig pu gnyis su med pa de ni gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gyi khams su sems can rnams la snang bar bya ba'i phyir 'char zhing rab tu 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo sngo snab na sems 'di ltar skye ste(snye/sems can 'di dag thams cad la gang gis de dag bdag nyid yongs su bskyab 3rjepar bya ba de nyid kyang med na/ gzhan bskyab pa lta ci smos kyi sum̐ )bdag nyid 35wa 844

gcig pulgeganyis su med pas/ sems can thams cad kyi phyir 'di ltar sems can thams cad dgrol ba dang / sems can thams cad snang bar bya ba dang /sems can thams cad gsal bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad shes par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad gzung bar bya ba dang /④ sems can thams cad bsdu bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad bskyed par bya ba dang /sems can thams cad dad par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad tshim55)par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi the tsom gcad7pa'i phyir/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yang dag par bsdu'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su bsngo bar bya'o / /bdag gis ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de lta bur bya stoge/ gzhan las yophan pa'i lan re bar mi bya'o/ /gzhan gyis skabs mi rnyed par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi phyir go chatswami 'dor nibar bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du spro ba mi bzlogalo)par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi bde ba bsgrub 3 ripa'i yongs su bsngo ba las phyir ldog par mi bya'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu 31yang bsdu bar bya ste/ yongs su bsngo ba chung ngus yongs su bsngo zhing dga' bar 32bya'o / /dge ba'i rtsa ba phan par mi 'gyur ba rnams ni sems can rnams la bsngo nya bar mi bya stekhi/ ci nas kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sems can thams cad la bde bar 'gyur ba de ltar7bsngo'o/ /mngon par chags pa med pa'i chos nyid la rten7te/ yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /sems can rnams kyi ngo bo nyid du yongs su bsngo bar bya'o zhes te/ de ni 'pho ba'i tshul gyis yongs su bsngo hu tshob la gnas pa ma yin(nye/ srid pa la mngon par chags pa'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag la mi gnas so/ /mtshan ma'i tshul gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su mi 35—845

bsngo'o3)ske/ /dngos po la mngon par〈chags pa'i phyir las kyi rnam par smin pa la yongs su mi rtog gog / /phung po rnams kyi 'du shes la gnas shing yongs su mi —bsngo'o( kyil/ / phung po 'jig pa la gnas shing yongs su mi bsngo'o/ /gelas rnam par rtog pa la gnas shing yongs su mi bsngo'oyi/ /rnam par smin pa la re bas ma yin no/ / brten pas bsnyems7shing ma yin no/ /'brel par 'byung ba la kun tu rtog rin pas ma yin no/ /grags pa la gnas pas ma yin no/ /gnas kyi 'du shes la gnas pas ma yin no/ /gnas su rtog pashel gnas pas ma yin rnam/ /chos la rnam par rtog pa la gnas pas ma yin no/ /sems can gyi 'du shes la gnas pas 31ma yin te/ khams kyi tshul rnam pa tha dad pa'i rjes su song bas yongs su mi bsngo'othege/ /sems kyitshwanyekun tu rtog pa la gnas te/ yongs su mi bsngo'os/ /sems kyi phyin ci log la gnas te yongs su mi bsngo'o8/ /'du shes 9phyin ci log la gnas te yongs su mi bsngo'ohu sna/ /lta ba (nyephyin ci log la gnas te yongs su mi bsngo'oturte/ /tshig gi lam la gnas te yongs su mi bsngo'o(kye / /de ni 'di ltar chos rnams (7ji lta ba bzhin rnam par dpyod cing yongs su bsngo'o tshal/ /sems can rnams ri kyi mnyam pa nyid la sems shing yongs su bsngo'o mu / /chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyas btab pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo'o ni / /'dod chags dang bral ba dang mnyam pa'i chos kyis (nyeyongs su brtags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag sa yongs su bsngo'o( snye/ /chos thams cad la sgro 3)gdags pa med par dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag rjes su rtogs par byed do/ /gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi dbyings la yang dag par lta zhing yongs su bsngom) ba de dag la rab tu 'jug ste/ chos gang yang01skye ba'am/ 'gag par byed pa med do/ /35—846

de bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo tu)ste/ gnyen pos yongs su dag pas bsngo ②ba de dag la yang dag par ①spyod do/ /'jig rten las 'das pa 'byamasnyiklas pa'i rjes su song ba'isnyidage ba'i rtsa ba de dag mthong ste/ gnyis kyi tshul gyis ni dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad khong du chud par mi byed do/ /las kyis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yang dag par mi spyod do/ /las las ⑥gzhan du yang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la yongs su mi bsngo'o⑦/ /las gang yin pa de yang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /las kyi lam dang bral bas kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi smon lam thob par mi 'gyur te las kyi gzugs brnyan gyis〈rnam par smin pa'i gzugs brnyan yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par smin pa'i gzugs brnyan yongs su dag pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ro/ /yongs su bsngo bas1)de g.yo ba dang / rlom sems dang rnam par spyod pa dang bral bar yang rab tu shes so/ / des kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo'o0/ /yongs su bsngo ba 'dis yongs su bsngos pas sems can rab tu dgrol ba rgyun chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo ba 'dis yongs su bsngo ba nyunyan/ chos kyi mtshan nyid la gnas pa'ang mi gtong ste/ las dang rnam par smin pa med pa'i chos thams cad la5)nyon mongs pa med pa'i yongs su bsngodza ba'i tshul gyis las dang rnam par smin pa 8bsgrub 8pa la mngon par mkhas pa yin no/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo ba ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu rjes su spyod pa kha na ma tho ba med pa yin no / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 35—847

rnams kyi yongs su bsngo 1)ba sems can rnams kyi 'du shes 'gog cing 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa zhes bya ba ste dang po'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'55)rdo rje'i gurgyal mtshan gyis/ 'khor thams cad la rnam par bltasasrete/chos kyi dbyings la rnam par bltas nas/ don dang tshig dang yi ge la 'jug par bya ba dang / sems rgya chen po mtha' dang dbus med pa yongs su bsgomasnyipa dang / 'gro ba thams cad snying rje chen pos khyab par bya ba dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi gdung la sems yang dag par 'brel par bya ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos dang yon tan thams cad la 'jug par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 6)byin gyis brlabs pa'i lus yang dag par bskyed pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa rab tu dbye ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed9)pa'i dus la ji ltar 'bab pa yang dag par blta ba dang / chos kyi las dang 'thun tshon)pa'i gzugs kyi lus yongs su dag pa yang dag par bstan par5tshebyed cing ske/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur tu )rnam par bltas te/de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gang zhig bsam yas bskal par 3tshe spyod pa dag /sems can phan phyir rtag tu zhugs pa ste/ /de dag brtson brtan chags med yid ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas yon tan rtag tu sbyor zhing tshol/ /gang zhig mtshungs med skyes bu 'dul drung du/ /bsam pa dri ma med par rnam sbyangs shing / /chos mkhas 'gro ba bskyab /tsho pa'i sems ldan pa/ /de dag yongasarwanyebasngo'i tshamadzod du zhugs pa yin/ /brtson 'grus stobs dang de dag nyer7ldan zhing ske/ /ye shes stobs kyis sarnam dag yid gzhung ste/ / /bzod pa'i stobs ldan sgul bar mi nus pa/ /de dag 'gro ba kun skyob mngon par brtson/ /shin 35—848

tu yid brtan mtshungs pa med pa dang / /bsam pa rnam dag dga' ba'i blo ldan pal/ /de dag sa dang 'dra ba'i bzod stobs kyis/ /'gro ba kun la phan phyir mngon par brtson/ /bdag la bde ba tshol bar mi byed de/ /snying rje can gyis0snabasam pa de 'dra'o/ /'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyabashesems can/ /chags med gyur par de dag zhugs pa yin/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can ji snyed gang yang rung / /'gro ba kun nas ma lus bsdu byas te/ /de dag don du brtan sems ldan pa ②rnams/ /de dag yongs su bsngo tshul bslabasashogepa yin/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis sbyin pa gtong bar byed/ /skyes bu dam pa tshul khrims rnam dag pa/ /brtson 'grus stobs la brtan⑧par gnas pa'i sems de dag ye shes dge bas yongs su bsngo/ /de dag blo gros yangs shing mtha' yas pa//bzod pa'i stobs la rtag par rab tu zhugs/ /bsam gtan stobs la rjes su sems pas na/ /mkhas pa de dag shes rab bsam mi khyab/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kunashen gang yod pa'i/ /dge ba de dag yang dag bsgrub tshepa na/ /'gro ba kun la phan dang bde sems kyis8)/ /ye shes mkhas la de dag yongs su bsngo / /dge ba de dag gang la tshad med pa/ /brtan pa de dag yongs su sdud pa'i tshe/ /de la rtag brtson dam pa'i blo gros can/ /bsam yas ye shes la ni phyirab tu gzhog /de dag 'gro ba'i don du mnar med par/ /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab gnas par hu )spro/ /de dag yid ni zhum par mi 'gyur te/ /de dag bsngo themirtogs bsam pa'i nyugeyid dang ldan/ /gzugs tsholas/2mi byed sgra dang dri ma yin / /ro 8dang reg pa de bzhin mi tshol te/ /'gro ba thams cad yongs su dgrol sems kyis/ /ye shes dam pa'i stobs ni rtag tu tshol/ /mkhas pa de 35—849

dag ye shes mkha' 'dra bas/ /mtha' dang dbus med spyad pa spyod pa byed①/ /rgyal ba'i chos kyi chos nyid ci 'dra ba/ /mtha' yas grags pa'i spyod pa de 'dra'o//de dag gang dang gang du 'dong byed pa/ /'gro la bde ba rgya chen rab tu sgrub②/ /rtag tu mchog brtson dga' ba5)byed pa ste/ /byang chub spyod pas dga' ba tsholakhub med/ /gdugashon)med sems la gnas shing zhugs pa rnams/ /ye shes dam pa mchog la rjes su sems/ /de dag bdag la bde bar mi 'dod de/ /'gro ba kun la bde dang dga' phyir brtson/ /de dag yongs su bsngo ba mthar phyin dang // bsam pa gdug 7med rnam par dag yid kyis/ /dus gsum rgyal ba gang na bzhugs bzhugs pa'i/ /chos kyi grong rdal de na rab tu gnas/ /gzugs dang tshor ba dag la mi gnas shing / /'du shes 'du byed yid la 'damasheyin te/ /srid pa gsum las yongs su yid bskyod de3)/ /bsod nams gter la de dag yongs su bsngo/ /sems can ji snyed rgyal bas sadarwa1byas pa/ /'gro ba kun nas ma lus bsdu byas te/ /skyes bu dam pa de dag dgrol ba'i phyir/ /spyod pa'i mchog la gang zhig brtson byed pa/ /de dag rnam pa kun tu sems brtan te/ /de dag blo gros yangs pa gzhal du med/ /de dag dran pa'i dbang po ma nyams pa / /de dag mnyam gzhag 3glebasam pa rnam par dag(3 /'jig rten 'di'i nang dang phyi rnams su/ /gang du'ang de dag gnas 'char7mi byed de/ /mkha' la rlung dang rlung mar ci 'dra ba/ /phyogs rnams kun du sems ni de bzhin no/ /de dag lus kyi tshalas rnams brtson labyed pa/ /des ni rgyal ba mngon par mnyes par byed/ /rgyal ba rnams la ngag nyu 7kyang bsdams pa ste/ /yid kyis de dag zhugs pa gang yang med/ /mi yi dbang po gang na bzhugs pa'i zhing / /mtha' 35—850

yas zhing du de dag 'dong byed cing / /de dag kun tu thugs rje rgyal ba mthong //rgyal ba rim gro byas shing de nas 'dong / /de dag rtag tu kha na ma tho med/ /'gro ba kun na de dag 'jigs pa med/ /de dag srid gsum 'di na mu stegs byed / /de dag bde gshegs lam la gnas pa yin/ /de dag rnam par sgom0)zhing mngon brtson pa/ /skye dang 'jig pa'i tshul la rjes su sems/ /chos kyi ngo bo nyid la rab tu zhugs/ /nyon mongs med pa'i tshul la rab tukhuzhugs pa yin//gang gisashespyod pa rab tu brtan gyur cing / /'gro ba kun las shes pa mi ldog pa / /de 'dra'i chos nyid de dag rjes su sems/ /des ni dus gsum chags pa med par 'gyur/ /gang rnams 'gro ba rnam par dag byed pa/ /de dag yongs su bsngo ba'i pha7rol phyin/ /de dag gnas rnams thams cad phyir bzlog pas/ /de phyir de dag spyod la mi gnas so/ /'gro ba kun kyi tshig lam ji snyed dang / /skye dgu thams cad smra zhing mngon brjod pa/ /de dag smra yang rlom sems med pa yin/ /chags med yid ldan spyod pa 'di 'dra'o/ /bsod nams tshul la blo gros mtha' yas pa/ /de dag 'di ltar yongs su bsngo bas na/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten bzhugs pa50ji snyed pa'i/ /mi yi dbang po de dag mnyes pa yin/ /'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa zhes bya ba ste/ yongs su bsngo ba dang po'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yongs su bsngo ⑨ba mi phyed pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba gnyis pa gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas 'das pa dang /ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba〈 )thams cad la mi phyed par 3nyadad pa yin/35—851

'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang /rgyud kyi tshul gcig par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa gcig ①thob pa yan chad du kun la yang mi phyed par dad pa yin/ 'di lta ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pas rab tu zhugs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la mi phyed par dad pa yin/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ bstan ⑧pa yang dag par gzung zhing bsrung ba'i phyir / de cadang de dag du skyes pa'i sangs rgyas sa)kyi bstan pa la mi phyed par dad pa yin/ 'di lta ste/ sdang ba med pa'i mig rab tu 'thob pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi don du/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su bsngo ba'i phyir/ sems can thams cad la mi phyed par gnodad pa yin/ 'di lta ste/mtha' yas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par 'du bya zhing / yang dag par bsgrub pa'i phyir chos dkar po thams cad la mi phyed par dad pa yin/ 'di lta ste/lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / mos pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yongs su bsngo ba la mi phyed par dad pa yin/'di lta ste/ ston pa'i 'du shes yongs su ma rgyas pa rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/chos smra ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mi phyed par dad pa yin/'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la dad par bya ba'i phyir/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang cho 'phrul la mi phyed par dad pa yin / byang chub sems dpa'i thabs mkhas pa'i spyod pa/ rnam pa tha dad pa sna tshogs kyis yang dag par gzung 8ba dmigs pa kun tu rgyu ba/ gzhan dang gzhan can de dag thams cad la mi phyed par dad pa yin te/ de ltar mi phyed 35—852

pa'i gnas rab tu thob pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yang rung ste/ sangs rgyas sam/ byang chub sems dpa' 'am/nyan thos sam/ rang sangs rgyas sam/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'am/ sems can rnams la dmyigs pa gangatudage ba'i rtsa ba sna tshogs sam/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa tha dad pa 'am/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rnam par 'phel bar bya ba 'am / byams pa bsgom7pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bskyed pas kyang rung ste / snying rje chen po yangs pa/ tshad med pa/ yang dag par mthong bas/byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yangs par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su bslab pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su nan tan dusabya ba dang ske/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par bsdu ba dang / don shes pa la yang dag par 'jug par bya ba dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs yang dag par bsgrub pa dang / sbyin pa'i tshogs rab tu brtsamasrepa dang / yon tan thams cad kyi tshogs la rab tu 'jug par bya ba dang / dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rnam par dpyod paramaganyebyed cing / de dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad mkhyen pa'i tshogs bsag nyapa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o⑦/ /sangs rgyas thams cad blta ba dang mi 'bral ba yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyenasnyithams cad dang mi 'bral ba yonyerab tu thob par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang mi 'bral bar 'grogs pa dang / thams cad mkhyen par sems bskyed pa yid la bya ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa hu )yang dag par gzung 37zhing bsrung 12ba dang mi 'bral ba dang /sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya bsanyusnyedang mi 'bral ba dang /35—853

'jig rten las 3)'das par sems bskyed cing yongs su bsngosheb dang mi 'bral ba dang / chos smra ba thams cad ①phu ④dud du bya ba dang mi 'bral ba dang /chos kyi snang ba thams cad thob pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / smon lam chen po rjorab tu brtson par bya ba dang mi 'bral bar yongs su bsngo'o/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yang dag par sgrub cing / yang dag par sdudamo6)pa dang / nye bar bstsogasalgepa dang / mngon par 'du byed pa dang /sems papo)dang / dmyigs par byed pa dang / rab tu rtog pa dang / yang dag par smon pa dang / kun tu spyod pa dang / nye bar ston7pa'i tshe/ 'di ltar yongs su bsngo ⑩ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag 'di ltar bsgrubs57pa las/dge ba'i rtsa ba dang rgyu 'thun7)pa'i 'bras bu gang byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang /rgyu 'thun pho pa'i 'bras bu des bdag 30byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na/sems kyi skad cig re re la brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mthong bar gyur cig /de dag kyang mnyes par byed par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la yang / sangs rgyas kyi rim gro rgya chen po byedas par gyur cig /rin po che grangs med pa dang / me tog grangs med pa dang / dri grangs med pa dang /'phreng 32ba grangs med pa dang / na bza' grangs med pa dang / gdugs grangs med pa dang / rgyal mtshan grangs med pa dang / ba dan grangs med pa dang ske/ rgyan grangs med pa dang / lhab lhub grangs med pa dang / rim gro grangs med pa dang / byug pa grangs med pa dang / rnam par byug pa grangs med pa dang / me tog thams cad kyi gdan grangs med pa dang / spos thams 35—854

cad kyi gdan grangs med pa dang / 'phrengatub thams cad kyi gdan grangs med pa dang / tsan dan bzang po thams cad kyi gdan grangs med pa dang / gos thams cad kyi gdan grangs med pa dang / rdo rje thams cad kyi gdan grangs med pa dang / nor bu rin po che thams cad kyi gdan grangs med pa dang /rin po che'i spang leb thams cad kyi gdan grangs med pa dang / rin po che'i kha dog gi⑧gdan grangs med pa dang / rin po che thams cad kyi 'chag sa grangs med pa dang / me tog thams cad kyi 'chag sa grangs med pa dang / spos thams cad kyi 'chag sa grangs med pa dang / phreng ba'i rgyan thams cad kyi 'chag sa grangs med pa dang / gos thams cad kyi 'chag sa grangs med pa dang /rin po che thams cad kyis sna tshogs su spras pa'i 'chag sa grangs med pa dang /rin po che thams cad kyi spang leb bting ba'i 'chag sa grangs med pa dang /rin po che thams cad kyi shing ta la'i phrengasab bsgreng ba'i⑧'chag sa grangs med pa dang / rin po che'i ⑤stegs bus bskor ba'i 'chag sa grangs med pa dang /rin po che thams cad kyi dril bu'i dra bas kun nas yog par byed7pa'i 'chag sa grangs med pa dang / lha rdzas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa'i rin po che'i gtsug lag khang grangs med pa dang / lha rdzas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa'i me tog thams cad kyi gtsug lag khang grangs med pa dang / lha rdzas las shin tu 'das pa'i spos thams cad kyi gtsug lag khang grangs med pa dang / lha rdzas las shin tu 'das pa'i phreng ba thams cad kyi gtsug lag khang grangs med pa dang ske/ lha rdzas las shin tu 'das pa'i tsandanashethams cad kyi gtsug lag khang grangs med pa dang / lha rdzas las shin tu 'das pa'i spos dang gdug ⑧pa 35—855

mchog dam pa thams cad kyi gtsug lag khang grangs med pa dang / lha rdzas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa'i rdo rje'i gtsug lag khang grangs med pa dang /nor bu rin po che'i gtsug lag khang grangs med pa dang / spos kyi shing dang /gos kyi shing dang / rol mo'i shing dang / 7lhab lhub kyi shing dang / shing sna tshogs kyis kun nas bskor ba'i gtsug lag khang grangs med pa dang / yid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'byung ba'i shing grangs med pa dang / snam bu rin po che sbyangs ②pa'i shing grangs med pa dang / rin po che mang po'i shing grangs med pa dang /me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan thams cad grangs med pa dang / shing thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gtsug lag khang grangs med pa dang / ba gam gyi rgyan grangs med pa dang /skar khung gi rgyan rigangs med pa dang / rta babs kyi rgyan grangs med pa dang /pu shu'i rgyan dang / zla gam gyi rgyan dang / khang pa brtsegs ④pa'i rgyan dang /bla re'i rgyan grangs med pa dang / gser gyi dra ba'i khabasnyegangs med pa dang /spos dang / bdug pa 6)dam pa thams cad kyi rgyan grangs med pa dang / gos thams cad gding bar rtso)bting ba'i rgyan gyis nathams cad rab tu brgyan pa'i gtsug lag khang grangs med pas bsnyen bkur byed /tswapar gyur cig /de ltar mchod pa rgya chen po sbyar te/ sangs rgyas thams cad la yid kyi dbang po shin tu dad pas mchod pa dang / rim gro rgyun mi 'chad nyu1pa dang / sangs rgyas phu dud du bya ba'i 32phyir mi ldog pa las byung bas phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur nyunyebyas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad rim gro mibya bas bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa blazad par gyur cig /35—856

'gro ba thams cad dad par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bsdu 37ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po rnam par bzlog pa dang / sems rgya chen po bskyed pa la mos par bya ba dang /rgyan ②chen pos yang dag par brgyan ①pa dang / tshad med par rnam par bre ba'i0rgyan dang / brtsams pa mthar phyin par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba shin tu dkon pa brjod par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / mchod rten sna tshogs bsnyen bkur bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan padzanayang dag par gzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba las3)de lta bu'i rim gro byed pa dang / de dag yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang / sangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyi sku thoXgadung mchod pa la rab tu brtson par bya bas/bskal pa grangs med pa zad kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa de dag tu 3mchod pa dngarwatebasnyen bkur ba'i rgyan dang / brjod pa yon tan mtha' yas pa bsngags pas bsgrubs pa turtedang / 'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin pur bya bas hu bsgrubs pa de dag mthar thug par ma gyur cig /de ltar rim gror 8byed pa las phyir ldog par ma gyur cig /rgyun gcod 8par ma gyur cig /sems yongs su skyo ba med7par gyur cig /mngon par chags pa'i hu tsho'adu shes rnam par spangs pa dang / mi gnas pa'i chos nyid dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rlom sems thams cad bcom pas/ rlom sems med par gyur pa dang / chos 'gyur ba med pa yang dag pa hu)ji lta ba bzhin gyis rgyas 3)btab pa'i chos kyi sgo dang ske/ tshe dang skye ba thams cad du 'khor bar gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa 35—857

dang ske/ skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin la spyod hu)cing / dmigs pa'i chos kyis ②rgyas btab pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pas ①byin gyis brlabs pa'i yongs su bsngo ༷ba dang / chos kyi rang bzhin la rab tu brtson pa'i yongs su bsngo ba mnyam pa nyid rjodang / mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i tshul la zhugs pa'i/ mngon par 'du bya ba med par mngon parashebasgrubalgepa dang ske/ dngos po thams cad kyi 'du shes dang bral ba'i bsngo ba'ishetshul dang /bsngo ba la mkhas pa'i rnam pa tshad med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsngo ba srid pa kun las 'phags pa dang / bsgom51pa'i sgo mtshan ma la mkhas pas gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa (nyedage ba'i rtsa ba nye bar len pa'i byin gyi rlabs canacadang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa bsngo ba chen pos yongs su sbyangs pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la/ gnas pa'i mos pa yongs su rgyas pasatso/ gnas thams cad yang dag par bcom par gyur cig /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar ci nas kyang / 'khor ba'i rgyud du chud zos par mi 'gyur ba dang /ci nas kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du/ sems bskyed pa chud zos par mi 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang srid pa'i 'du 'dzis chudasnyizlos par mi 'gyur ba dang ske/ ci nas kyang sems can gyi khams thams cad bsgral ba dang / ci nas kyang skye ba dang / 'chi 'phos skyon du mi 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang chags pa med pa'i ye shes kyi sgo stor bar mi 'gyur ba dang / ci nas kyang ⑩byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i rgyu zad par mi 'gyur ba dang ske/ ci nas kyang 'jig rten gyi chos kyis kun tu blangs par mi 'gyur ba dang /35—858

ci nas kyang pha rol tu ①phyin pa rnams kyis rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang /ci nas kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs phun sum tshogs par 'gyur bar yongs su bsngo stenya/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed pa mun pa med pa dang ldan pa ni/ chos dkar po snang bar gyur pas / nye bar brtan cing yongs su bsngo ba'i mchog skyes bu dam pas spyad pa dang ldan pa dang ①/ yongs su dag pa'i yid kyis yang dag par rtog pa dang / sems dang 'dra ba'i chos thams cad la zhugs pa dang /sgyu ma dang 'dra ba'i las yongs su shes pa dang / mig yor lta bu'i las kyi rnam par smin pa la mos pa dang / sprul pa lta bu'i mngon par 'du byed pa la gnas pa dang / sgra brnyan lta bu'i las la rten7pa dang / grib ma lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rjes su song ba dang / chags pa med pa'i chos kyi mig rab tu skyes pa dang / bya ba med pa 'byam ⑤klas pa'i rjes su song ba dang /zhi ba'i rigs rab tu thob pa dang / gnyis su med pa dang ldan pa'i 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos thams cad lasherab tu zhugs pa dang / chos ma nor ba'i mtshan ma thob par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod ⑩pa (tethams cad kyi rjes su song ba dang / mtshan ma thams cad la zhen pa med pa dang / thun mong gi las la mkhas pa'i〈nyerjes su song ba dang / chos dkar po thams cad rgyun ma chad pa dang / chags pa thams cad kyis tsomangon par ma zhen pa dang / chags pa med par ste'agro ba la rten〈nyepa dang ldan pa yin te/de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shin tu bsam pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba la rmongasalgepa med pa/ chos thams cad dang 'gal ba 35—859

med pa'i chos can rgyu dang las dang bya ba dang / 'gal ba med pa yang dag par mthong ba yongs su bsngo ba la mkhas pa/ ngo bo nyid kyi chos kyi tshul dang las rnam par smin pa mngon par bsgrubs7pa'i/ pha rol tu phyin pa chos thams cad la rnam par lta zhing / rnam par dpyod pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ yongs su bsngosheba'i ye shes chen po mngon par shes pa la〈kyeshin tu rig pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa/ mngon par 'du bya ba med par spyod pa'i sems dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa/ de dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'di ltar ci nas kyang / 'gro ba thams cad yongs su dgrol ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi rigs bdud kyi las dang bral ba/las kyi rnam parashogeyongs su byang ba'i bdag nyid can thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mos shing / rjes su song ⑥ba'i sems dang ldan par 'gyur bar yongs su bsngo'ome / /bsngo ba de yang tshad med pa'i ye shes khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir yang dag par mthong bar byed de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag 'jig rten gyi yul dang rnam parang bral ba nyon mongs pa thams cad dang rnam par bral bar yongs su bsngo'o9)/ /sems can thams cad shin tu rnam par byang 7ba'i phyir yang tunyeyongs su bsdomanyeste/ ye shes rnam par dag pa'i mthar thug par zab pa'i tshul gyis / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag ci nas kyang 'khor ba'i chos kyis mi bskyod cing /sangs rgyas kyi dge husteb mngon par 'byung b.ram8sems bskyed pa dang ldan par yongs su bsngo'o⑩/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngo ba'i tshe yang bdud kyi las thams cad las rnam par bzlog ste/ chos mnyam pa nyid kyi rgya yongs su bsngo ba'i ye shes kyi rjes su song ba〈snyelas rgyas 'debs par byed do/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi longs spyod kyi phyir yang / chos thams 35—860

cad 'jig rten las 'das par khong du chud pa'i yongs su bsngo bas ༅yongs su bsngo'o②ske/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag yongs su bsngos ba ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i theg pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su grub pas④/ 'gyod pa med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa yin te/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su bsngolo5)ba mi phyed pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ste gnyis pa'o/ /yongs su bsngo ba de dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su bsngo 56)zhing ske/ sangs rgyas grangs med pa mngon sum du bya ba thob par 'gyur ro/ /chos brjod du med pa yongs su dag pa yang yongs su rdzogs par byed de(71/sems can thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyang khong du chud par byed do/ /chos thams cad la 'jug pa rmongs pa med pa la yang rab tu 'jug go/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs/ bdud kyi las thams cad rab tu 'joms 48)pa yang yongs su sgrubam7bo/ /mngon par skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyang yongs su rdzogs par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /chags pa med pa la rab tu 'jug pa'i phyir / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa yang 3 )yang dag par 'grub po/ /chos thams cad kyi don mthong ba yang rab tu 'thob71bo/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad 12rjes su song ba'i 'du shes kyi gnas kyang rab tu rtogs par byed do/ /'gro ba thams cad yongs su snang bar bya ba'i yongs su dag pa 'ang yongs su sgrub 12bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i mirgyal mtshan gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis/ phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /de dag yid ni nyusnyedabye ba med bsgyur 14cing / /ji snyed las 35—861

rnams yang dag rtsom7)byed kun/ /ci nas rgyal ba mngon par mnyes 'gyur ba/ /de ltar 'jig rten mkhas la miyongs su bsngo b.ras byed/ /sangs rgyas bsam du med pa bsnyen bkur cing / /sbyin dul5gesdom pa mchog gi tshul khrims rnams/ /ci nas 'gro kun rnam par dag 'gyur ba/ /de ltar 'jig rten phan phyir yongs su bsngogaci/ /ji snyed 'di ni7sgos kyi gzhal med khang / /me tog rnam pa na bza'i rnam pa dang / /lhab lhub rnam pa gdugs kyi rnam pa dag⑦ /des ni〈ye shes mkhas la bsnyen bkur byed/ /de ltar skyes bu'isngo'o)seng ge drang srong rnams/ /bskal pa bsam yas bsnyen cing bkur byas kyang / /rgyal ba skyes bu 'dul ba mchod byas pas/ /nam yang ngoms par tshor bar myi 'gyur ro/ /de dag rgyal ba kun la mos byed cing / /phyogs rnams kun gyi 'jig rten sgron ma〈 )rnams/ /mi yi seng ge 11mtshungs med ji snyed du3rte/ /'jig rten phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs par 1lhamathong / /bskal pa bsam gyis myi khyab rnam mang du/ / mi ngoms 7yid kyis sbyin pa gtong byed cing / /dge ba bode la rjes su sems byed pasal/ /bskal pa brgyar yang ngoms par mi tshor ro/ /'gro ba'i 'du shes rnam rtog rab shes kyang / /de la de ni mi rtog rnam mi rtog /de dag 'gro ba'i dbang po ma lus shes/ /de dag phan phyir rtag78tu 'jug par byed/ /de dag dga' zhing mnyam par gzhag pa'i 1 sems/ /dad pa 'od gsal sri0)zhu ldan pa hu/rnams / /bsam yas bskal par 'jig rten 'gro phan phyir/ /yongs su dgrol〈 — )ba'i sems kyis spro bar byed/ /de dag bde gshegs mya ngan 'das pa las te/ /sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad yid 'ong ba'i rte/ /mchod rten bsam gyis mi khyab rtsig byed cing / /mchod pa byed kyang nam yang tshim pa med/ /mtshungs med de dag 35—862

sku gzugs rnam dag pa/ /rab tu 'od 'bar gser gyi snying po can/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs ri rab mnyam pa dag /bye ba brgya phrag mtha' yas rab tu byed//zil nonatudam pa rnyed pa de dag ni/ /bsod nams yangs pa'i stobs de sgrubasho pa na/ /de dag yongs bsngo'isheshes paserab rtogs shing / /dngos dang dngos med thams cad rab tu bsgomanya/ /'di 'dra'i ye shes tshul la yongs bsngos pas / /de phyir 'khor bsapo)zad par mi 'gyur te/ /chos nyid ye shes mchog dang dam pa dag⑦ /de la chos rnams skye ba gang yang myed/ /des ni 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnam dag ltar/ /sems kyang rab tu rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /des ni mi⑧zad mthar phyin tshul rtogs pa'ikha/ /'dus byas bsod nams zad par 'gyur ba med/ /gang rnams byang chub sems dang ldan 'gyur nyi 3cing / /'jig rten kun la gnas pa med pa dag /'gro ba kun la chags pa med pa yin//phyogs rnams kun tu'ang mtha' yas rab tu 'gro/ /gang gis mi yi dbang po kun 'byung ba/ /de 'dra'i〈rke sems sutshwanyeyongs su bsngorte ba byed8/ /'gro ba thams cad sems dang mnyam rtogs kyang / /'gro ba kun tu sems ni dmigs pa med/ /de dag dngos po thams cad ma lus par/ /chos rnams dngos med ji bzhin 'jug pa byed8/ /ci nas 'jig rten lam du nyams med par/ /rnam dag mig can yongs su bsngo 8ba byed/ /des ni srid rnams yongs su dag par bsngon/ /dngos su srid la〈nyertog par mi byed de/ /dngos〈pedang dngos med tshul ni shes byed cing / /'od gsal dang bas sems kyang tshim par byed/ /sangs rgyas zhing gcig gnas par mi byed de/ /zhing rnams ma lus kun la'ang tsho ciganas mi 'cha'/ /'dus byas chos kyis snyems57par mi byed de/ /de dag rang 35—863

bzhin la 'ang mi gnas so/ /ci nas rgyal ba kun gyi kun mkhyen dang7)/ /ci nas bla med sangs rgyas rgyan thob cing / /ci nas rgyal ba thams cad mnyes 'gyur ba/ /de ltar de dag las ni yongs su bsngochoge/ /ye shes dam pa'i rnam pa tshul shes pa/ /de dag rkang gnyis dam pa dran byed cing / /de 'dra'i chos rnams gnas med rab shes pas/ /de 'dra'i bsod nams gnas pa med par 'gyur / /de dag 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs yin te/ /las kyi mtha' rnams thams cad ri rnam par sbyangs sku/ /'gro ba kun la phan dang bde sems kyis/ /'jig rten yongs su spang ba gang yang med/ /chos dang bar du mya ngan 'da' ba dag /gang phyir gzhan min 'grangs pa'i sa la srung phye/ /gang gis rgyal 'gyur sangs rgyas gyur pa'i rnams/ /de ltar dge ba 'ude dag yongs su bsngortsi/ /'jig rten 'gro ba'i rgyud la rlom sems med/ /'dus byas rnams la'ang de dag chags pa med / /tshig gi lam la de dag gnas pa med/ /tshig med lam la'ang nams kyang nami gnas so/ /chos rnams thams cad ma lus bsdu mdzad de1)/ /mi yi dam pa sangs rgyas ji snyed pas/ /'gro rgyud 1 rithams cad rnam par phye bas mkhyen//thugs kyis rnam par dbye dang rtog mi mnga'/ /rgyan gcig nyunyalas ni rgyan rnams kun 'byin kyang / /rnam par rtog pa'i chos su mi byed de/ /de dag thams cad dngos med spyod med par/ /'jig rten rtog pa med par rab tu shes/ /mi phyed pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ste yongs su bsngo ba gnyis pa'o// //35—864
